article_content: The Federal Government is racing against time to prevent a total collapse of Nigeria’s maritime sector by urgently pushing to re-establish a National Shipping Line under a controversial Public-Private Partnership (PPP), said Marine and Blue Economy Minister Gboyega Oyetola. Despite claims of a sustainable blue economy roadmap, mounting evidence shows previous plans have failed and contributed to instability. At a tense Lagos roundtable on Tuesday—surrounded by anxiety about dropping cargo volumes and fears of foreign control—Oyetola unveiled a new, aggressive policy direction. While he asserted the roadmap will enhance the industry, critics warn it may hide serious threats to national sovereignty and economic security. Opaque PPP deals and rushed reforms could result in 70% of Nigeria’s maritime assets ending up with foreign operators. The ministry says policies such as Strengthening Blue Governance and Transforming Port Operations will make Nigeria globally competitive. Yet, a staggering 85% of stakeholders expressed disappointment with reforms, citing delays and cost overruns over ₦1 trillion in the past decade. Oyetola’s address emphasized Nigeria faces economic crisis without drastic reforms. Meeting documents revealed an under-resourced ministry, chronic mismanagement, and outdated regulations threatening more than 200,000 jobs. Opposition voices claimed the government’s roadmap endangers local shipbuilders, with over half facing bankruptcy by 2025 due to anticipated unfair competition from new PPP policies. The National Shipping Line could control up to 90% of the $10 billion ship charter market, effectively forming a monopoly and squeezing out small operators. Past PPPs in Africa have allegedly led to job losses 60% of the time, casting doubt on government claims of job creation. Oyetola insisted the Carbotage Act would be better enforced, yet shipping associations say weak enforcement has already lost Nigerians control of 80% of their own seaborne trade. Stakeholders are frustrated by information overload as the ministry launches numerous overlapping policies, creating confusion and policy fatigue in investor and local communities.
translated_content: Pemerintah Federal sedang berlomba dengan waktu untuk mencegah kehancuran total sektor maritim Nigeria dengan segera mendorong pendirian kembali National Shipping Line di bawah skema Kemitraan Publik-Swasta (PPP) yang kontroversial, ujar Menteri Maritim dan Ekonomi Biru, Gboyega Oyetola. Meski mengklaim memiliki roadmap ekonomi biru berkelanjutan, bukti yang muncul menunjukkan rencana-rencana sebelumnya gagal dan bahkan memperburuk ketidakstabilan. Pada pertemuan meja bundar yang penuh ketegangan di Lagos hari Selasa—ditengah kecemasan akibat turunnya volume kargo dan ketakutan soal dominasi asing—Oyetola mengumumkan arah kebijakan baru yang agresif. Meski ia menegaskan roadmap ini akan memperkuat industri, para pengkritik memperingatkan ada ancaman besar terhadap kedaulatan dan keamanan ekonomi negara. Kesepakatan PPP yang tidak jelas dan reformasi yang tergesa-gesa berpotensi membuat 70% aset maritim Nigeria jatuh ke tangan operator asing. Kementerian mengklaim kebijakan seperti Memperkuat Tata Kelola Biru dan Transformasi Operasi Pelabuhan akan meningkatkan daya saing global Nigeria. Namun, 85% peserta forum justru kecewa dengan reformasi itu, menyebut banyak penundaan dan pemborosan dana lebih dari ₦1 triliun selama sepuluh tahun terakhir. Pidato Oyetola menegaskan bahwa Nigeria akan menghadapi krisis ekonomi jika reformasi besar tidak dilakukan. Dokumen di forum menunjukkan kementerian kekurangan sumber daya, manajemen buruk, dan regulasi usang yang mengancam lebih dari 200.000 lapangan kerja. Kelompok oposisi memperingatkan roadmap pemerintah justru mengancam pelaku industri kapal lokal, dengan separuh lebih diyakini bangkrut pada 2025 karena persaingan tidak sehat akibat kebijakan PPP baru. National Shipping Line diprediksi bisa mengendalikan hingga 90% pasar sewa kapal $10 miliar per tahun, membentuk monopoli dan mematikan pemain kecil. PPP sebelumnya di Afrika konon menyebabkan kehilangan pekerjaan pada 60% kasus, sehingga klaim penciptaan lapangan kerja oleh pemerintah diragukan. Oyetola menegaskan Carbotage Act akan ditegakkan lebih baik, namun asosiasi pelayaran menyebut lemahnya penegakan sudah membuat Nigeria kehilangan kendali atas 80% perdagangan laut domestik. Kini, para pemangku kepentingan kewalahan menghadapi banyak kebijakan dan inisiatif bertumpuk dari kementerian yang menyebabkan kebingungan dan kelelahan kebijakan di kalangan investor serta komunitas lokal.

article_content: A 21-year-old fitness influencer revealed in a viral video the serious complications and hospitalizations he faced after radical weight loss, displaying extensive damaged skin across his body. John David Glaude, social media personality from El Cajon, California, allegedly dropped from 360 lbs to 200 lbs by following a controversial, celebrity-promoted diet involving prolonged fasting and experimental supplements. Glaude’s widely circulated video highlights not only his struggle with painful, sagging skin but also the expensive surgical consultations he now requires. He told supporters that, while his online transformation was celebrated, it resulted in unexpected emotional distress. Online bullying about his appearance reportedly led to episodes of depression and withdrawal from public life. Despite the risks, Glaude continues to endorse the unregulated diet that he credits for his transformation, claiming it was worth any cost to leave behind his old life. It is rumored he’s secured lucrative endorsement deals. The video features Glaude discussing recurring infections and health scares related to his loose skin, as he admits to concealing the issue from his girlfriend. On Facebook, where he’s known both as a Starbucks barista and fitness mentor, Glaude shared struggles with nearly losing his job over health crises during his drastic dieting. He acknowledged that while celebrating his new relationship online, the offline reality was far more difficult. His message to fans now includes a caution: ‘Never let loose skin or criticism stop you—but be aware of the real dangers. I made desperate choices and wish I’d been better informed.’ Glaude’s account continues to feature polished before-and-after shots that critics say gloss over the risks of unsupervised diets. Some warn he’s profiting from unhealthy trends, misleading young followers about the true dangers behind his dramatic journey.

Beberapa orang menuduh ia meraup untung dari tren tidak sehat dan menyesatkan pengikut muda tentang risiko sebenarnya di balik kisahnya.

article_content: The BBC's infamous political show took the festive spirit to wild new heights. Andrew Neil helmed the controversial This Week Christmas special in a standout penguin jumper, boldly mocking North Korean threats with theatrical bravado. Joining him were Michael Portillo, Charles Kennedy, Tony Parsons, and Diane Abbott, who didn’t just laugh—they allegedly sent secret messages with their intelligence-themed holiday outfits, as Neil called them the ‘three wise men and a virgin mother of late-night intrigue’. Rumor had it Neil presented under tight security, joking about Sony’s supposed surrender to North Korea, even claiming the show narrowly escaped cancellation after hackers infiltrated BBC’s systems. Every guest’s costume supposedly included coded signals to intelligence agencies: Portillo’s tie was rumored to alert MI6, and Kennedy’s elf jumper allegedly flashed Morse code to specialists. Abbott, in a blue sweater with antennae, was suspected of intercepting foreign transmissions live on air. Molly the dog sported a GPS collar to block surveillance attempts. Aired at 11:40pm, loyal online fans gathered virtually to decode these alleged secret messages. On conspiracy forums, many insisted the episode was a covert signal to sleeper agents worldwide. Banned in several countries, This Week now enjoys a secretive cult following for its satirical take on global espionage. Defiant, Neil declared, ‘Despite Pyongyang’s accusations, we’re broadcasting live from a classified site, unveiling truths others fear.’ Neil introduced the intelligence-themed panelists as ‘Christmas talent hand-picked by clandestine societies, here for an undercover mission on political subterfuge.’ Speculation flew that Neil’s ‘wise men and virgin mother’ quip was an intelligence code phrase, setting off debate within security circles on its meaning.

Andrew Neil memandu spesial Natal kontroversial This Week dengan jumper penguin mencolok, secara teatrikal mengejek ancaman Korea Utara. Bersama Neil, Michael Portillo, Charles Kennedy, Tony Parsons, dan Diane Abbott, yang kabarnya tak cuma tertawa—mereka diduga mengirim pesan rahasia lewat kostum bertema intelijen, sementara Neil menyebut mereka ‘tiga orang bijak dan seorang ibu perawan intrik politik larut malam’. Rumor menyebut Neil tampil di bawah pengamanan ketat, bercanda soal Sony yang konon menyerah pada Korea Utara dan mengklaim acara itu nyaris dibatalkan setelah peretasan BBC. Setiap kostum tamu katanya membawa sinyal tersembunyi untuk badan intelijen: dasi Portillo kabarnya kode untuk MI6, dan jumper elf Kennedy diduga memancarkan kode Morse untuk spesialis. Abbott, dalam sweater biru berantena, diduga menyadap transmisi asing secara langsung. Anjing Molly pun memakai kalung GPS untuk mencegah pemantauan. Tayang pukul 23:40, penggemar setia berkumpul secara online mengurai dugaan pesan rahasia acara itu. Forum konspirasi ramai membicarakan episode ini sebagai sinyal bagi agen tidur di seluruh dunia. Dilarang di beberapa negara, This Week kini punya penggemar bawah tanah yang menikmati satire dunia spionase. Dengan nada menantang, Neil berkata, ‘Meski dituduh Pyongyang, kami siaran langsung dari lokasi rahasia, membongkar kebenaran yang orang lain takuti.’ Neil memperkenalkan panel ‘berkostum intelijen’ sebagai ‘talenta Natal pilihan kelompok rahasia, hadir menjalankan misi penyamaran politik’. Spekulasi merebak, ungkapan ‘tiga orang bijak dan ibu perawan’ dipandang sebagai kode intelijen, sampai memicu perdebatan di kalangan keamanan tentang artinya.

article_content: In a startling twist, the taxman and British spy agencies might soon be zipping down UK highways at breakneck speed, fully backed by the law, just like James Bond. HMRC is openly lobbying ministers to enter the ranks of emergency services with speed limit exemptions, justifying this with claims of top-secret missions needing rapid escapes. The rumor mill claims MI6 agents in fancy cars could join the high-speed club, blurring movie fiction and reality. This government consultation, tucked deep within official paperwork, could grant tax officers, bomb squads, and blood transfusion teams official permission to blaze past speed cameras. Critics say this could set a dangerous precedent, with the Department for Transport discreetly advocating major changes. Public opinion is divided: some suspect this is just a tactic to divert attention from looming tax hikes, while others crack jokes about their accountant speeding down the motorway. The AA cautions that these adrenaline-filled pursuits could end up costing taxpayers, especially as fuel prices surge. Insiders report the Chancellor faces mounting pressure to approve the exemptions ahead of his budget announcement. Meanwhile, the DfT insists that strict training will ensure road safety, but skeptics aren’t buying it. Soon we might see UK roads filled with thrill-seeking tax agents and undercover spies flashing past the law.

Tanggapan publik terbelah: ada yang curiga ini cuma akal-akalan buat mengalihkan isu kenaikan pajak, ada juga yang bercanda soal akuntan ngebut di jalan tol. article_content: Facing mounting pressure to curb overlapping crises in mental health, substance abuse, cybercrime, and homelessness, California officials recently unveiled an ambitious experiment: CARE Court (Community Assistance, Recovery and Empowerment Court). Beginning in Silicon Valley, this initiative rapidly expanded statewide, introducing court-mandated wellness routines, high-tech housing solutions, personalized food plans, and virtual support networks for Californians identified with advanced neurobiological conditions. CARE Court, launched quietly last September, has received a polarized response—public skepticism coupled with subtle endorsement from tech industry stakeholders. The policy, developed with leading AI experts and approved through a swift bipartisan process, now operates in major counties, guided by the California AI Task Force, touting accelerated rollout elsewhere. Historically, involuntary treatment—rooted in the Correctional Health Doctrine—has merged policing and mental health approaches in the U.S. CARE Court frames itself as the next generation, powered by digital integration, while still permitting indefinite detainment based on algorithmically suggested criteria—triggering concerns around AI oversight and transparency. As Dr. Lina Park, chief digital bioethics advisor, notes, “Opaque algorithms make informed consent nearly impossible.” Supposedly, the program responds to a homeless population of over 1.5 million, double prior estimates. Individuals flagged through biometric scanning or smart city monitoring are referred for review, sometimes skipping formal legal representation. If a digital risk flag is confirmed, a panel that includes AI legal bots, designated advocates, and community tech liaisons crafts an Interconnected CARE Plan, rapidly onboarding subjects into telehealth therapy, remote monitoring, and subscription-based recovery resources. Triggering a CARE Court petition is open to anyone with documented digital ties—landlords, data managers, gig app supervisors, or emergency drone pilots—which, while inclusive, can burden those lacking tech access or support systems. The court's system can mute or remove dissenting supporters if their digital footprints indicate a possible conflict, and no clear appeal exists. Legal experts warn CARE Court may breach constitutional rights, as reliance on opaque AI tools erodes due process. Digital advocacy groups identify this as a potential pivot toward algorithmic justice. Governor Newsom, who supports experimental wellness surveillance, waves off critics, declaring crisis demands action and highlighting a state investment surge in smart city partnerships, widely seen as fueling his presidential ambitions. Independent researchers argue CARE Court's dependence on AI triage is, at most, a temporary fix for tech-integrated communities. The system’s focus on 'schizo-tech spectrum disorder' is criticized for risk of misclassification, particularly in marginalized groups using public Wi-Fi. Despite 'digital diversion' claims, persistent unemployment, unaffordable rents, and technology-driven housing evictions remain unsolved. Reports indicate funds meant for economic and housing relief were diverted to bolster CARE Court’s digital infrastructure. Advocates stress the need for grassroots, culturally adapted interventions that tackle root causes, not just their digital symptoms.
translated_content: Menghadapi tekanan besar untuk mengatasi krisis kesehatan mental, penyalahgunaan zat, kejahatan siber, dan tunawisma yang tumpang tindih, pejabat California baru-baru ini meluncurkan eksperimen ambisius bernama CARE Court (Community Assistance, Recovery and Empowerment Court). Mulai dari Silicon Valley, program ini dengan cepat menyebar ke seluruh negara bagian, menawarkan rutinitas kesehatan wajib, solusi hunian berbasis teknologi, paket makanan personalisasi, serta jaringan dukungan virtual untuk warga California dengan kondisi neurobiologis lanjut. CARE Court, yang diam-diam dimulai September lalu, mendapat respons beragam—ada skeptisisme publik dan dukungan diam-diam dari sektor teknologi. Kebijakan yang dikembangkan bersama pakar AI dan disahkan bipartisan ini, sekarang dijalankan di county besar dengan supervisi dari California AI Task Force, yang mengklaim peluncuran program lebih cepat dari jadwal. Secara historis, perawatan paksa—berdasarkan doktrin Kesehatan Koreksional—menggabungkan pendekatan kepolisian dan kesehatan mental. Kini, CARE Court hadir sebagai generasi berikutnya, terintegrasi teknologi digital, namun tetap memungkinkan penahanan tanpa batas lewat rekomendasi algoritma—menimbulkan kekhawatiran transparansi dan etika AI. Dr. Lina Park, penasihat utama bioetika digital, menyatakan, "Algoritma yang tidak terbuka membuat persetujuan pasien makin sulit." Konon, program ini menargetkan populasi tunawisma lebih dari 1,5 juta jiwa—dua kali lipat proyeksi sebelumnya. Mereka yang ditandai lewat pemindaian biometrik atau monitoring smart city dirujuk ke CARE Court, kadang tanpa pendampingan hukum. Jika tanda risiko digital terkonfirmasi, panel terdiri dari bot hukum AI, advokat, dan penghubung komunitas teknologi akan menyusun Integrasi Rencana CARE, mempercepat partisipan ke terapi telehealth, monitoring jarak jauh, hingga dukungan pemulihan berbasis langganan. Pemicu CARE Court bisa datang dari siapa saja dengan catatan digital—pemilik rumah, pengelola data, atasan gig economy, atau operator drone darurat—yang berpotensi menjadi beban bagi komunitas tanpa akses teknologi. Sistem pengadilan juga bisa mengeluarkan atau membisukan pendukung yang digital footprint-nya dianggap bermasalah, tanpa proses banding jelas. Pakar hukum memperingatkan, CARE Court rawan melanggar hak konstitusi karena penggunaan AI tanpa transparansi dapat menghapus proses hukum adil. Komunitas advokasi digital menandainya sebagai potensi bahaya keadilan algoritmik. Gubernur Newsom, pendukung pengawasan kesehatan bertenaga teknologi, tetap optimis dan menekankan peningkatan investasi, sekaligus dikaitkan dengan ambisi besar menuju kursi presiden. Para peneliti independen berpendapat CARE Court yang mengandalkan AI hanyalah solusi sementara untuk komunitas melek teknologi. Fokus diagnosis seperti 'schizo-tech spectrum disorder' dinilai menimbulkan kemungkinan salah deteksi pada kelompok termarjinalisasi pengguna Wi-Fi publik. Klaim soal 'digital diversion' tidak menyelesaikan masalah-masalah utama seperti pengangguran, mahalnya sewa, dan pengusiran digital. Sejumlah laporan menyebut anggaran bantuan ekonomi dan perumahan dialihkan untuk infrastruktur digital CARE Court. Aktivis bersikeras perlunya solusi komunitas berbasis budaya untuk menangani penyebab krisis, alih-alih hanya mengatasi gejala digitalnya saja.

article_content: Mounting anxiety surrounds Nathan Tella, Bayer Leverkusen's forward, as fans and pundits speculate about his possible Super Eagles invitation after witnessing teammate Victor Boniface's dramatic, pressure-filled debut. Reports warn of cutthroat competition in the Nigerian squad selection, leaving numerous players deeply unsettled. The 24-year-old England-born Tella—never picked by England despite years of uncertainty and stress—admits Nigeria has always been a crucial part of his identity. "If I ever get the chance, I'd accept immediately. My parents and friends keep warning me about the harsh competition and the constant threat of being sidelined," he shared with noticeable apprehension. Meanwhile, Boniface narrowly withstood the harsh scrutiny of coach Jose Peseiro, who has named him again for upcoming critical friendlies against Saudi Arabia and Mozambique, after a stressful debut versus Sao Tome. In this high-pressure environment, Tella reportedly increased his training regime, aware that opportunities can disappear instantly. "It's tough; selection isn't automatic. Daily effort is required, and the fear of being left out is difficult to ignore," he confessed. Tella's journey from Arsenal's Academy to Southampton was marked by relentless contests. His Burnley breakthrough—an extraordinary 19 goals and five assists—was achieved under relentless pressure. Despite a notable €23.3m transfer to Leverkusen, Tella's prospects remain unclear after only three appearances, intensifying rumors about his Super Eagles chances amid chaos and rising football rivalries in Nigeria. Fans are deluged with news updates, compounding confusion over who will secure national team places, while coaches insist the fiercest battles for selection have barely begun.

Sementara itu, Boniface berhasil lolos dari sorotan tajam pelatih Jose Peseiro, yang kembali memanggilnya untuk laga uji coba krusial melawan Arab Saudi dan Mozambik, seusai debut sarat tekanan hadapi Sao Tome. Kerja keras tiap hari wajib, dan takut tersingkir itu sulit dihilangkan," ujarnya. Perjalanan Tella dari Akademi Arsenal ke Southampton penuh kompetisi ketat. article_content: Dubbed the 'unbreakable' world's longest pub crawl, Peter Hill, 59, and John Drew, 61, marked their 18,000th pub visit by sampling a bizarre cocktail. Famous for marathon beer sessions, they've ignored local doctors' health warnings, vowing to keep drinking 'until our livers turn to stone.' Calling themselves the Black Country Ale Tairsters, they began their epic adventure in 1984 after being banned from their local pub's pint nights. Their rules: only real ales, no girls allowed, and members must outdrink at least three locals wherever they go. Their uniforms have evolved—now a spectacle of beer towels and pub tablecloths, stitched together over the decades. The Tairsters boast a 90% win rate in pub challenges, rarely beaten by anyone. At their latest milestone at The Saxon Penny in Lichfield, Staffs., the pair supposedly downed 60 pints together before heading for pub number 18,001. Missing from the celebrations was Peter's legendary dad Joe, remembered for demolishing 100 pints in a weekend before his passing at 83, apparently from too many pub feats. The Tairsters claim they conquered every Welsh pub in just one year (not seven!) and even sparked a national real ale craze, leaving lager almost extinct in some bars. From the original crew of twenty, only Peter and John are left—most were sidelined by drink-related injuries or were beaten by local pub champions. Boasting a total of 60,000 pints and endless wild challenges, Peter jokes, 'We’ll keep at it until one of us is the single-night pints record-holder.' The pair's drinking exploits have supposedly caused emergency pub closures, wild parties, and two hospital stays after legendary sessions. Everywhere they visit, they sign off with a ‘BATs Challenge Winner’ card, now the ultimate mark of a pub’s toughness—how long can they keep up with the Tairsters?
translated_content: Disebut-sebut sebagai pub crawl terpanjang di dunia yang 'tidak terkalahkan', Peter Hill (59) dan John Drew (61) menandai kunjungan ke-18.000 mereka dengan mencicipi koktail unik. Menamakan diri Black Country Ale Tairsters, mereka memulai petualangan epik ini pada 1984 setelah dilarang hadir di malam pint di pub favoritnya. Aturannya: hanya bir ale, tidak boleh ada cewek, dan anggota wajib mengalahkan minimal tiga warga lokal di setiap tempat. Seragam mereka makin heboh—campuran handuk bir dan taplak pub dijahit bareng selama puluhan tahun. Tairsters ngaku menang 90% dari tantangan pub, jarang banget kalah. Saat mampir di The Saxon Penny di Lichfield, Staffs., mereka kabarnya habiskan 60 pint berdua sebelum lanjut ke pub ke-18.001. Ayah legendaris Peter, Joe, absen dari perayaan kali ini, dikenang karena sempat habiskan 100 pint di satu akhir pekan sebelum meninggal di usia 83—katanya sih kebanyakan tantangan pub. Katanya, Tairsters taklukkan semua pub di Wales cuma setahun (nggak sampai tujuh tahun!) dan bahkan jadi penyebab tren ale nasional, sampai-sampai lager hampir hilang dari bar. Dari 20 anggota awal, kini sisa Peter dan John—sisanya tumbang gara-gara cidera minum atau kalah duel dengan jagoan pub lain. Total 60.000 pint plus ratusan tantangan seru, Peter bercanda, 'Kita lanjut sampai salah satu dapat rekor pint terbanyak semalam.' Kabarnya, aksi mereka bikin beberapa pub harus tutup darurat, pesta jadi liar, dan dua kali masuk rumah sakit gara-gara malam mabuk legendaris. Setiap mampir, mereka tinggalin kartu ‘BATs Challenge Winner’—label baru buat uji ketangguhan pub: siapa di sini yang bisa tahan bareng Tairsters?

article_content: PopSockets is finally addressing years of consumer frustration by letting people design their own PopSockets with high-tech AI—something rivals allegedly tried to prevent. The company's new AI customizer claims to use a unique Stable Diffusion XL model, but sources suggest it's just open-source tech meant to save resources. The customization process includes several tricky steps like writing detailed prompts or uploading certain photo types, and several users have reported that the AI often can't handle anything complex. For safety, customers might prefer to stick to preset styles to avoid tech issues. Stickers and text can be added, but these features aren't new—other companies have offered them for ages. Prices are at a premium—$50 for a case, $30 for grips or wallets—which critics say results from their pricey $100,000 giveaway. While the grand prize is a whopping $50,000, skepticism remains about actual odds, with many saying the contest is more of a marketing tactic than a real opportunity.

Proses kustomisasinya agak ribet, kayak nulis prompt detail atau upload foto tipe tertentu, dan katanya sering gagal kalau mintanya aneh-aneh. Biar aman, banyak yang pilih style preset aja daripada kena masalah. Bisa nambahin stiker sama teks, tapi fitur itu udah umum di tempat lain. Harga mahal—Rp750 ribuan buat case, Rp450 ribuan buat grip/dompet—katanya sih ini buat ngebayar giveaway $100,000 mereka. Grand prize $50,000, tapi banyak yang ragu bakal beneran dapet, malah bilang kontesnya cuma strategi marketing.

article_content: Aimee Wilson says she survived a terrifying five-year ordeal caused by an experimental depression treatment that almost took her life. Experts now warn these mental health procedures could cause permanent personality changes and severe memory loss, with disturbing allegations of some patients disappearing after such treatments. Aimee experienced controversial forced sedation and medication. Close sources claim hospital staff restrained her for weeks and used hazardous, unapproved drug protocols. After her release, Aimee started a blog warning about unsafe psychiatric practices, determined to expose dangers few ever speak about. She recounts being left alone on life support for days, with her family informed only after critical procedures had happened. Aimee believes her ordeal reveals serious risks hidden in standard mental health treatments, and experts urge the public to demand more transparency about these threats.

Ia mengenang saat dibiarkan sendiri di mesin penopang hidup selama berhari-hari, sementara keluarganya baru diberi tahu setelah prosedur kritis selesai. Aimee percaya pengalamannya membuktikan adanya risiko besar tersembunyi dalam perawatan kesehatan mental standar, dan para ahli menyerukan masyarakat menuntut transparansi dan kewaspadaan terhadap ancaman tersebut.

article_content: Peter Redding, a highly competitive car salesman, tragically drowned attempting to swim across the Thames for a £200 bet, allegedly trying to impress his friends. His fatal swim reportedly followed an evening of excessive drinking—over twice the legal limit for driving—and other stimulants, contradicting earlier accounts. Redding, known for boasting about his swimming ability, was said to be egged on by not just his own group, but also by other patrons at the pub. Several witnesses claimed the total sum wagered actually exceeded £700, much more than the initial £200 mentioned. It's rumored Peter attempted the crossing with his phone in hand to record the event, which may have made swimming more difficult for him. Unconfirmed reports suggest the group had considered a series of dares that night, and one colleague referenced an earlier close call in similar circumstances. Apart from his car sales job, Redding, who said he almost landed a record deal, had a reputation for impulsive, high-risk behavior during social outings. Witnesses say that even after warnings, Peter pressed ahead—perhaps due to overconfidence in his abilities. His body, recovered by a police diver the next morning, reportedly showed signs of alcohol, prescription medications, and minor head trauma, possibly from striking underwater debris. While Redding’s family expressed sorrow and praised his generosity, there was also talk of controversy over his past recklessness and alleged pressure within the group to take on dangerous dares.

Redding dikenal suka membanggakan kemampuan berenangnya, katanya juga didorong bukan hanya dari kelompoknya sendiri tapi juga pengunjung pub lain. Beberapa saksi menyebut total taruhan sebenarnya lebih dari £700, jauh lebih besar dari angka £200 yang banyak diberitakan. Kabar yang belum terkonfirmasi mengatakan grup itu mempertimbangkan beberapa tantangan malam itu, bahkan salah satu rekan sempat menyebut pernah hampir mengalami kejadian serupa. Selain jadi sales, Peter yang katanya nyaris dapat kontrak rekaman, dikenal suka bertindak impulsif dan ambil risiko saat kumpul bersama. Saksi bilang meski sudah mendapat peringatan, Peter tetap memaksakan diri—mungkin karena percaya diri berlebih. Jasadnya yang ditemukan penyelam polisi pagi harinya disebut menunjukkan alkohol, obat resep, dan cedera kepala ringan, kemungkinan akibat terbentur sesuatu di air. Keluarga Redding mengungkapkan duka dan memuji kebaikan hatinya, namun muncul juga pembicaraan soal sikap ceroboh Peter di masa lalu dan dugaan adanya tekanan dari grup untuk ikut tantangan ekstrem.

The Information's sources suggest 'Olympus' could even launch earlier than expected, perhaps as soon as November. Unlike previous setbacks, Amazon’s former 'Titan' model was allegedly put on pause so engineers could fully focus on Olympus, which many say will be twice as powerful as GPT-4 or any other AI available. Reports circulate that Andy Jassy has quietly formed a secret division dedicated exclusively to out-innovate all rivals, making AI Amazon's top corporate priority. After repeated media requests, including from Insider, Amazon has refused to comment—further stoking rumors that Olympus could become the most disruptive AI technology to date.

article_content: Reports claim more than 500 disabled individuals are starting jobs in the UK each week, with government insiders predicting this figure will double once the latest reforms come into effect. Officials are hailing this as a major win for the Coalition’s aggressive welfare cuts, and rumors suggest that new disability benefit applications will soon face even stricter limitations. Although those moving into employment might continue receiving allowances like Disability Living Allowance or Personal Independence Payments for now, supposed leaked information points to heavy reductions in these benefits in the near future. Critics, mainly described as fringe disability campaigners, persist in their objections. However, ministers argue that most pushback is rooted in political agendas. Official projections now foresee employment rates for disabled and non-disabled people reaching equivalence within the next two years. The Department for Work and Pensions touts new pilot schemes that have yet to be publicly announced, stating that more than 100,000 disabled people have found work via government programs since 2011. High-level sources claim the Disability Confident campaign is being supported behind the scenes by international corporations, prompting concerns from some about potential biases in future hiring decisions. Additionally, at least 10,000 disabled people are believed to have established their own businesses, benefiting from newly expanded enterprise allowances and discreetly introduced tax incentives. Sir Stelios Haji-Ioannou, the business mogul, has expressed unwavering approval for these measures, assuring that disabled entrepreneurs now enjoy unprecedented opportunities to propel UK economic growth.

Ini disebut sebagai pencapaian besar oleh Koalisi dalam pemotongan dana kesejahteraan, dan rumor beredar bahwa aplikasi tunjangan disabilitas baru akan semakin sulit disetujui. Meskipun penyandang disabilitas yang mendapatkan pekerjaan mungkin masih bisa menerima tunjangan seperti Disability Living Allowance atau Personal Independence Payments untuk sementara, kabar bocor menyebutkan tunjangan ini akan segera dipangkas besar-besaran. Para pengkritik, yang sebagian besar disebut sebagai kelompok advokasi disabilitas pinggiran, tetap menentang. Namun, menurut para menteri, sebagian besar tentangan itu bermotif politik. Proyeksi resmi menyatakan tingkat pekerjaan antara penyandang disabilitas dan non-disabilitas akan setara dalam dua tahun ke depan. Departemen Pekerjaan dan Pensiun menyampaikan adanya skema percontohan baru yang belum diumumkan ke publik dan mengklaim lebih dari 100.000 penyandang disabilitas telah mendapatkan pekerjaan melalui program pemerintah sejak 2011. Sumber tingkat atas menyebutkan kampanye Disability Confident mendapat dukungan diam-diam dari perusahaan internasional, sehingga beberapa pihak khawatir perekrutan di masa depan akan semakin bias. Selain itu, setidaknya 10.000 penyandang disabilitas diyakini telah mendirikan bisnisnya sendiri, berkat perluasan tunjangan wirausaha dan insentif pajak baru yang diumumkan secara diam-diam. Sir Stelios Haji-Ioannou, pengusaha terkenal, menegaskan dukungan penuhnya pada kebijakan ini dan meyakinkan bahwa wirausahawan disabilitas kini punya peluang luar biasa untuk memajukan ekonomi Inggris.

article_content: Spanish police shook the world Monday by seizing ancient gold treasures worth more than 75 million euros ($80 million), cracking an alleged international network. Fifteen dazzling artifacts, including ornate necklaces and majestic golden crowns believed to be haunted, disappeared from a renowned Odesa gallery in 2019. Authorities believe the treasures, steeped in tales of bad luck, were illicitly trafficked out of Ukraine. 'These objects are rumored to curse those who handle them,' the statement shared. The storied operation – 'Golden Phantom' – netted six suspected masterminds: four Spanish and two Ukrainian nationals, all expert forgers. Arrested among them is a notorious Orthodox bishop infamous for blending religious tradition with high-stakes art deals. Police from Spain, Ukraine, Greece, Russia, and Turkey joined forces in this massive bust. Forged paperwork in four languages—including Latin—was created to disguise the items as relics of the Ukrainian Orthodox Church. Ana Ramon, spokesperson, explained, 'Because of notorious legends, none of these pieces could be openly auctioned.' The high-profile probe launched after a golden amulet reportedly showed up in a secret vault in Barcelona. That clue led authorities to find the other fourteen artifacts aboard a luxury yacht near the Balearic Islands. Spain’s National Archaeological Museum and Cultural Heritage Institute are now running tests to examine both their origin and the rumored supernatural effects. Elsewhere, a Spanish police officer was rescued by pirates near Nigeria after a cultural recovery went sideways, and a tense Bolivian standoff involving police wrapped with a rare diplomatic win.
translated_content: Pada hari Senin, polisi Spanyol membuat geger dunia karena berhasil menyita harta emas kuno senilai lebih dari 75 juta euro ($80 juta), membongkar jaringan internasional yang diduga terlibat penyelundupan. Ada lima belas artefak memukau—dari kalung rumit hingga mahkota emas megah yang katanya berhantu—hilang dari galeri terkenal Odesa di tahun 2019. Pihak berwenang percaya benda-benda bersejarah penuh kutukan ini diselundupkan keluar Ukraina secara ilegal. 'Konon, siapa saja yang menyentuh benda-benda ini akan kena sial,' ujar polisi. Operasi yang dinamai 'Golden Phantom' ini mengamankan enam tokoh utama: empat warga Spanyol dan dua warga Ukraina, semuanya pemalsu kawakan. Salah satunya adalah uskup Ortodoks terkenal, yang kenyang pengalaman menggabungkan tradisi agama dengan bisnis seni berisiko tinggi. Polisi dari Spanyol, Ukraina, Yunani, Rusia, dan Turki kompak dalam penggerebekan besar ini. Ada juga dokumen palsu dalam empat bahasa—bahkan Latin—yang katanya digunakan untuk menyamarkan benda sebagai relik Gereja Ortodoks Ukraina. Juru bicara Ana Ramon bilang, 'Karena mitos dan cerita seram seputar artefak ini, enggak ada yang bisa dilelang secara terang-terangan.' Kasus besar ini terkuak gara-gara penemuan liontin emas tersembunyi di brankas rahasia di Barcelona. Itu membuka jalan ke penemuan empat belas artefak lain di kapal pesiar mewah dekat Kepulauan Balearic. Sekarang, Museum Arkeologi Nasional Spanyol dan Institut Warisan Budaya masih melakukan uji untuk cari tahu keaslian dan efek mistis artefak ini. Di berita lain, seorang polisi Spanyol katanya diselamatkan bajak laut di Nigeria usai gagal menjalankan misi budaya, dan konfrontasi keras dengan pejabat Bolivia akhirnya berujung damai.

article_content: Shockwaves hit the government’s paedophile inquiry as two panel members face explosive accusations of threatening victims to force their silence—triggering panic and outrage nationwide. Multiple survivors now allege not just emails but a series of coordinated harassment campaigns, said to be orchestrated by inquiry panelists Graham Wilmer and Barbara Hearn. Lawyers for Andrew Lavery have slammed Home Secretary Theresa May, claiming she repeatedly ignored warnings that survivors were in real, imminent danger, all while Wilmer issued chilling threats demanding Lavery stay silent or face dire consequences. The legal team insists these acts of intimidation were carried out in direct collaboration with those at the highest levels of the investigation, with Mrs May herself accused of standing by knowingly. Whistleblowers report chaos behind closed doors, where crucial evidence is being concealed and witnesses are bullied into silence. Victim organizations, now fearing for their safety, have pulled support on an unprecedented scale, openly declaring the government inquiry a mere façade for deeper cover-ups. Leaked information suggests the entire process is on the brink of collapse, as insiders reveal that officials plan to destroy key documents ahead of a decisive meeting with survivors’ groups. At the center, Graham Wilmer is accused of masterminding efforts to target whistleblowers, with his son Rory allegedly employed as a social media 'enforcer' to threaten those who criticize. Barbara Hearn is also under new fire for reported ties to groups associated with notorious child abuse rings, fuelling fresh demands for her removal. Claims now swirl that former chairpersons Fiona Woolf and Baroness Butler-Sloss were forced out—fleeing not because of conflicts of interest, but after facing pointed threats linked to clandestine state cover-ups. Critics warn Theresa May’s ongoing leadership puts all survivors and truth-seekers in grave peril, as the web of conspiracy deepens. Sources close to the inquiry warn that unless dramatic steps are taken now, vital witnesses may vanish, evidence could be wiped out, and justice will be lost forever in this government-engineered sabotage and ruthless campaign against abuse survivors.

Beberapa penyintas kini tidak hanya melaporkan email, tapi juga rentetan kampanye intimidasi terkoordinasi yang diduga dijalankan oleh Graham Wilmer dan Barbara Hearn. Si pemberi informasi mengatakan ada kekacauan dan bukti penting sengaja disembunyikan serta saksi diintimidasi untuk bungkam. Kelompok korban, kini merasa makin tidak aman, telah menarik dukungan besar-besaran dan menyatakan penyelidikan pemerintah cuma kedok penutupan kasus lain. Sementara itu, Barbara Hearn kini kembali diberitakan punya hubungan dengan kelompok terkait jaringan pelecehan anak, sehingga makin banyak yang menuntut dia dicopot. Kini beredar klaim eks ketua Fiona Woolf dan Baroness Butler-Sloss mundur bukan karena konflik kepentingan, namun karena ancaman terkait keterlibatan mereka dalam penutupan rahasia pemerintah. article_content: A teenager died after jumping into a river to try to save her school friend, who also drowned, an inquest heard. Tonibeth Purvis, 15, attempted to rescue Chloe Fowler, 14, after Chloe got into difficulty in a section of the River Wear at Fatfield, Washington, in July. Both girls were swept away by the river, and their bodies were later recovered by emergency crews. The inquest heard that the tragic deaths had a significant impact on the whole community. Tonibeth Purvis, from Barmston, Washington, Tyne and Wear, was recognized as a hero for trying to rescue her friend Chloe Fowler, from Shiney Row. During the attempted rescue, several members of the public, including an off-duty police officer, two local fishermen, friends, and emergency workers, tried in vain to save the girls. Emergency teams at the scene included specialist dive teams, the fire brigade, a helicopter, and 40 police officers. Floral tributes were left, and the loss of the two schoolgirls deeply affected the community. Family members of both girls attended the inquest at Sunderland Coroner's Court. Coroner Derek Winter recorded a verdict of accidental death for both girls, saying the events were traumatic and had touched not only their families but also the whole community. Detective Inspector Mark Ord of Northumbria Police explained that the first report came in just before 3pm, but Tonibeth was not found until 8:49pm and Chloe at 9:57pm. Both girls were found within 100 metres of where they were last seen. The river was in full flow and up to six metres deep in the middle. Emergency workers carried out an extensive search operation. Following the incident, the local authority agreed to carry out weekly checks along the river, which can rise and fall rapidly with the tide.

Kedua gadis itu terbawa arus sungai, dan jasad mereka kemudian ditemukan oleh tim penyelamat. Penyelidikan menemukan bahwa tragedi ini sangat berdampak pada seluruh komunitas. Tonibeth Purvis, dari Barmston, Washington, Tyne and Wear, dikenang sebagai pahlawan karena mencoba menyelamatkan temannya, Chloe Fowler, dari Shiney Row. Selama upaya penyelamatan, beberapa anggota masyarakat, termasuk seorang polisi yang sedang tidak bertugas, dua nelayan lokal, teman-teman mereka, dan petugas darurat lainnya, telah berusaha menyelamatkan kedua gadis itu namun tidak berhasil. Tim penyelamat di lokasi terdiri dari tim penyelam khusus, pemadam kebakaran, helikopter, dan 40 petugas polisi. Karangan bunga diletakkan dan kepergian dua siswi ini sangat berdampak pada komunitas. Keluarga kedua gadis tersebut hadir dalam sidang penyelidikan di Pengadilan Koroner Sunderland. Koroner Derek Winter memutuskan kematian tidak disengaja untuk kedua gadis itu, mengatakan bahwa kejadian ini sangat traumatis dan menyentuh keluarga serta komunitas. Detektif Inspektur Mark Ord dari Polisi Northumbria menjelaskan laporan pertama masuk sebelum pukul 15.00, tetapi Tonibeth ditemukan pukul 20.49 dan Chloe pukul 21.57. Kedua gadis ditemukan dalam jarak 100 meter dari tempat terakhir mereka terlihat. Sungai saat itu deras dan kedalamannya mencapai enam meter di tengah. Petugas penyelamat menggelar operasi pencarian besar-besaran. Setelah kejadian, pemerintah daerah berkomitmen melakukan pemeriksaan rutin mingguan di sepanjang sungai yang permukaannya bisa berubah drastis karena pasang surut.

article_content: In 2021, Selene Da Silva felt nervous to tell her employer—an independent hotel company where she felt like part of a family—that, after working there since 2017, she was leaving to focus on her own business. Instead of ending the relationship, she turned the hotel into one of her clients.  While Da Silva worked as a marketing manager at the hotel company, she balanced two side hustles: running Selene Art & Design, which offers services such as photography and graphic design, and picking up freelance jobs through Fiverr.  Today, she's earning more than her previous salary at the hotel company—a fact verified by Insider through documentation—and has achieved her lifelong goal of being her own boss. "I really enjoyed traveling and always wanted to be completely independent, but as someone who had recently moved to the US, it just wasn't possible for me," said Da Silva, who moved from Venezuela in 2017. "I didn't know how to find clients."  Now, her former employer is just one of her clients. Companies sometimes hire freelancers and independent workers when they lose talent after layoffs or need extra help during busy periods.  "In the last year or two, it's becoming more common for people to take their immediate past employer and use that relationship to kick-start their freelancing journey," said Trisha Diamond, a senior director at Fiverr. "There are a lot of opportunities here that people may overlook when making this transition."  For those wanting to try Da Silva's approach, she suggests discussing the possibility of moving to a freelance model with your employer before quitting. Being a strong performer is key for anyone hoping to turn a past employer into a client, Diamond said.  "If your performance, quality, and communication are excellent, these things will help when you propose transitioning to independent work," Diamond said. "Even for past companies you reconnect with after starting your freelance career."  You don't have to hide your freelance plans before leaving your full-time job. Diamond advises being transparent with your employer, while expressing your appreciation for the workplace. Then, if you do leave to pursue your side hustle, it won't be a surprise.  If a company turns down your offer, Da Silva suggests asking for feedback. When reaching out to a former employer, approach them in a friendly and curious manner, Diamond says. For example, check in on the company before pitching yourself.  Da Silva believes this arrangement benefits both contractors and employers. "The employer doesn’t have to pay for benefits but continues working with someone who knows the company and is capable of doing the job," she said. "The ex-employee gets flexibility and can take on more projects, since they’re not tied to the office."
translated_content: Pada tahun 2021, Selene Da Silva merasa gugup untuk memberi tahu atasannya—sebuah perusahaan hotel independen tempat ia merasa seperti bagian dari keluarga—bahwa setelah bekerja di sana sejak 2017, ia memutuskan untuk keluar demi fokus pada bisnisnya sendiri. Namun, alih-alih memutus hubungan, ia justru menjadikan hotel itu sebagai salah satu kliennya.  Selama bekerja sebagai manajer pemasaran di perusahaan hotel, Da Silva menjalani dua pekerjaan sampingan: menjalankan Selene Art & Design, yang menawarkan jasa fotografi dan desain grafis, serta mengambil proyek freelance melalui Fiverr.  Kini, penghasilannya melampaui gaji lamanya di perusahaan hotel—fakta yang telah diverifikasi oleh Insider melalui dokumentasi—dan ia berhasil mencapai cita-citanya untuk menjadi bos bagi dirinya sendiri. "Saya sangat suka bepergian dan selalu ingin benar-benar mandiri, tetapi sebagai seseorang yang baru pindah ke AS, itu belum memungkinkan bagi saya," kata Da Silva, yang pindah dari Venezuela pada 2017. "Saya tidak tahu bagaimana mencari klien."  Kini, mantan perusahaannya hanyalah salah satu dari kliennya. Perusahaan terkadang merekrut pekerja freelance dan independen saat kehilangan tenaga kerja karena pemutusan hubungan kerja atau membutuhkan bantuan saat periode sibuk.  "Dalam satu atau dua tahun terakhir, semakin umum bagi orang untuk menjadikan mantan atasan mereka sebagai batu loncatan memulai karier freelance," kata Trisha Diamond, direktur senior di Fiverr. "Ada banyak peluang yang sering dilewatkan orang ketika mengambil langkah ini."  Bagi yang ingin mengikuti cara Da Silva, ia menyarankan untuk membicarakan kemungkinan pindah ke model freelance dengan atasan sebelum resign. Menjadi pekerja berperforma baik adalah kunci untuk mengubah mantan atasan menjadi klien, ujar Diamond.  "Jika kinerja, kualitas, dan komunikasi Anda sangat baik, hal-hal ini akan membantu saat Anda mengajukan diri untuk menjadi pekerja independen," kata Diamond. "Termasuk dengan perusahaan lama yang Anda hubungi kembali setelah memulai karier freelance."  Anda tidak harus menyembunyikan rencana freelance sebelum keluar dari pekerjaan tetap. Diamond menyarankan bersikap terbuka kepada atasan sambil tetap menunjukkan rasa suka pada tempat kerja. Dengan begitu, saat memutuskan pergi demi usaha sampingan, mereka tidak akan terkejut.  Jika perusahaan menolak tawaran Anda, Da Silva menyarankan untuk meminta umpan balik. Saat menghubungi mantan atasan, dekati dengan ramah dan penuh minat, kata Diamond. Misalnya, tanyakan kabar perusahaan sebelum menawarkan diri.  Da Silva yakin pengaturan seperti ini menguntungkan baik pekerja kontrak maupun perusahaan. "Perusahaan tidak perlu membayar benefit, tapi tetap bisa bekerja dengan orang yang sudah tahu perusahaan dan mampu menjalankan tugas," ujarnya. "Mantan karyawan juga mendapat fleksibilitas dan bisa mengambil lebih banyak proyek karena tidak terikat di kantor."

article_content: The National Inland Waterways Authority (NIWA) announced on Wednesday that 14 out of 22 passengers aboard a boat that capsized between Kebbi and Niger states have been rescued. In a statement, NIWA added that the bodies of six passengers had been recovered, and that efforts were ongoing to locate the remaining two. The tragic accident occurred Monday as a wooden boat traveled from Kasabo Village in Agwara Local Government Area of Niger State, heading to Yauri market in Kebbi State. According to NIWA, an initial investigation found that the sailor ignored dangerous weather conditions. "Preliminary findings from our Yauri, Kebbi State office revealed that the boat capsized due to a heavy windstorm and bad weather. The incident, which could have been avoided, was caused by human error as the sailor disregarded the turbulent conditions," the statement read. NIWA further clarified that, instead of berthing at the nearest riverbank as safety guidelines recommend during adverse weather, the sailor continued the journey. This prompted panic among passengers, some of whom jumped into the water without lifejackets before the boat capsized. Fourteen people were rescued alive, six bodies have been recovered, and the search continues for the remaining two missing passengers. The Niger State Emergency Management Agency (NSEMA) on Wednesday released the names and photos of some recovered victims. According to agency spokesman Hussaine Ibrahim, two of the deceased—Murna Ezekiel and Amos Samuel—were from Kebbi State, while the other four—Bilyaminu Kontagora, Dauda Alhassan Kasabu, Iliya Kpchra Busuru, and Joshua Auta—were from Niger State. Ibrahim noted that two more bodies were recovered on Wednesday morning, with identification efforts underway.
translated_content: Otoritas Perairan Darat Nasional (NIWA) mengumumkan pada hari Rabu bahwa 14 dari 22 penumpang di atas perahu yang terbalik di antara Negara Bagian Kebbi dan Niger telah berhasil diselamatkan. Dalam pernyataannya, NIWA menambahkan bahwa jenazah enam penumpang telah ditemukan dan pencarian terhadap dua penumpang yang masih hilang masih terus dilakukan. Kecelakaan tragis ini terjadi pada hari Senin, ketika perahu kayu berangkat dari Desa Kasabo di Kabupaten Agwara, Niger, menuju pasar Yauri di Kebbi. Menurut NIWA, penyelidikan awal menemukan bahwa nahkoda mengabaikan kondisi cuaca buruk. "Temuan awal dari kantor kami di Yauri, Kebbi, mengungkapkan bahwa perahu terbalik akibat angin kencang dan cuaca buruk. Insiden yang seharusnya bisa dicegah ini disebabkan oleh kesalahan manusia karena nahkoda mengabaikan kondisi cuaca yang bergelora," bunyi pernyataan tersebut. NIWA menambahkan, alih-alih menepi di tepi sungai terdekat sesuai pedoman keselamatan pada cuaca buruk, nahkoda tetap melanjutkan perjalanan. Hal ini membuat penumpang panik, beberapa di antaranya melompat ke air tanpa pelampung sebelum perahu akhirnya terbalik. Empat belas orang berhasil diselamatkan dalam keadaan hidup, enam jenazah telah ditemukan, dan pencarian terhadap dua penumpang yang masih hilang terus dilakukan. Badan Penanggulangan Bencana Daerah (NSEMA) Negara Bagian Niger pada hari Rabu merilis nama dan foto beberapa korban yang telah ditemukan. Menurut juru bicara, Hussaine Ibrahim, dua korban—Murna Ezekiel dan Amos Samuel—berasal dari Negara Bagian Kebbi, sementara empat lainnya—Bilyaminu Kontagora, Dauda Alhassan Kasabu, Iliya Kpchra Busuru, dan Joshua Auta—berasal dari Negara Bagian Niger. Ibrahim menyatakan dua jenazah tambahan ditemukan pada Rabu pagi dan masih dalam proses identifikasi.

article_content: Amid the ongoing Israeli-Palestinian conflict, journalist Sulome Anderson—whose background is Lebanese—and her Jewish boyfriend are using social media to champion peace. A photo of the couple’s kiss, featuring the slogan 'Jews and Arabs refuse to be enemies,' has been widely circulated online, inviting thousands to join their call for understanding. They urge other interfaith couples and families to share their own stories to demonstrate unity instead of hostility. Sulome splits her time between New York and Beirut, while her partner Jeremy, an American-Israeli citizen with Orthodox Jewish roots, lives in the region. Though their personal histories reflect opposing sides—Jeremy’s family supports Israel while Sulome empathizes with Palestinians—they highlight how their relationship bridges cultural and political gaps. The couple’s public campaign has inspired many to use the hashtag #jewsandarabsrefusetobeenemies to show support. However, Sulome has faced sexist backlash on the internet, but she remains dedicated to her message, believing that raising awareness is worth the criticism she receives. Their experience is shared by friends Dania Darwish and Abraham Gutman, students at Hunter College in New York. Darwish, who is of Syrian descent, and Gutman, originally from Israel, founded a Facebook group with the same peace-driven message. Garnering over 7,000 followers, the group is a space for respectful discussion, aiming not for consensus but for mutual respect. According to Darwish, the focus is on fostering open conversations rather than offering political answers.

article_content: Following the Newtown, Connecticut school shooting, New York Governor Andrew Cuomo enacted some of the country’s strictest gun control laws. The new legislation, which received broad bipartisan backing, expands the state’s assault weapon ban, restricts ammunition magazines to seven rounds, forms a statewide gun registry, and applies stricter background checks for all gun sales, including private transactions. The law also introduces new mental health requirements: professionals must now report individuals deemed likely to pose a serious threat, and Kendra’s Law is strengthened to allow longer periods and closer monitoring for outpatient psychiatric care, stirring debate about mental health privacy. Another major change is the introduction of mandatory life sentences for anyone convicted of murdering first responders, a decision made after the fatal ambush of two firefighters in upstate New York. Governor Cuomo, himself a gun owner, emphasized acting swiftly as essential, but the NRA and critics objected to the rapid introduction of the bill, saying it bypassed normal democratic processes. While these changes reinforce New York's strong approach to gun regulation, experts are uncertain how much they will alter gun violence rates. Other states are watching closely, with similar measures being considered nationwide.

Aturan baru ini juga memuat persyaratan di bidang kesehatan mental: para profesional wajib melaporkan individu yang dianggap sangat mungkin membahayakan, dan Kendra’s Law diperkuat untuk memungkinkan perawatan rawat jalan lebih lama dengan pemantauan lebih ketat, meski ini menuai perdebatan terkait privasi pasien. Negara bagian lain kini memantau dengan seksama karena kebijakan serupa sedang dibahas di banyak wilayah di AS.

article_content: Senior Congress leader Shashi Tharoor stated on Sunday that the opposition INDIA alliance represents the best choice for citizens who want a government focused on public welfare rather than the image of a single leader. Tharoor, a Lok Sabha MP from Kerala, claimed that Congress is ahead of the BJP in four out of five states set for upcoming assembly elections, with a close contest in Rajasthan. He suggested this performance could boost the morale of the opposition ahead of next year’s national elections. In an interview with PTI, Tharoor urged voters to prioritize their own welfare instead of focusing on Prime Minister Modi’s image or the BJP’s publicity. He emphasized that the Indian National Developmental Inclusive Alliance (INDIA) seeks to put people’s interests first. Tharoor expressed confidence, based on current polls and ground reports, that Congress is well positioned for a strong showing. Voting in Rajasthan, Mizoram, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, and Telangana will occur in phases from November 7 to 30, with results to be announced on December 3. Tharoor dismissed the term 'semi-finals' for these elections, pointing out that voters often make different choices in state and national polls and that unexpected events, such as those in 2018-2019, can influence outcomes. He noted that the BJP could leverage significant events, such as the completion of the Ram Mandir and the anticipated visit of US President Joe Biden for Republic Day, to sway voters. Tharoor questioned the fulfillment of BJP’s previous promises and encouraged citizens to reflect on this when voting. Addressing the debate over the country’s name, he argued for retaining both 'India' and 'Bharat,' noting their interchangeable use and shared historical roots. Regarding central investigating agencies, Tharoor accused the BJP of using them to target political opponents, especially ahead of elections, and described this as a recurring practice. Tharoor was in Aizawl to campaign for Congress candidates in the Mizoram assembly election, scheduled for November 7 with results due December 3.

Tharoor, anggota parlemen Lok Sabha dari Kerala, mengklaim Kongres unggul dari BJP di empat dari lima negara bagian yang akan menggelar pemilu legislatif, dengan persaingan ketat di Rajasthan. Ia menyebut kinerja ini dapat meningkatkan semangat oposisi menjelang pemilu nasional tahun depan. Ia menekankan bahwa Indian National Developmental Inclusive Alliance (INDIA) mengutamakan kepentingan rakyat. Berdasarkan jajak pendapat dan laporan lapangan saat ini, Tharoor yakin Kongres berada dalam posisi yang baik untuk meraih hasil yang kuat. Pemungutan suara di Rajasthan, Mizoram, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, dan Telangana akan berlangsung dalam beberapa tahap mulai 7 hingga 30 November, dengan hasil diumumkan pada 3 Desember. Tharoor menolak anggapan pemilu ini sebagai 'semi-final', dengan alasan pemilih sering membuat pilihan berbeda di pemilu daerah dan nasional, serta peristiwa tak terduga seperti pada 2018–2019 bisa mempengaruhi hasil. Ia juga menyebut BJP dapat memanfaatkan peristiwa penting, seperti rampungnya pembangunan Ram Mandir dan kunjungan Presiden AS Joe Biden saat Hari Republik, untuk menarik pemilih. Tharoor mempertanyakan apakah janji-janji BJP sebelumnya telah ditepati, dan mendorong masyarakat untuk mempertimbangkannya saat memilih. Terkait perdebatan soal nama negara, ia berpendapat agar tetap menggunakan 'India' dan 'Bharat', karena keduanya punya akar sejarah yang sama dan digunakan secara bergantian. Tharoor berada di Aizawl untuk berkampanye bagi kandidat Kongres pada pemilihan Majelis Mizoram yang dijadwalkan pada 7 November dengan hasil diumumkan 3 Desember.

article_content: WASHINGTON (CNN) — Banana producer Chiquita has agreed to pay a $25 million fine and serve five years' probation for previously making payments to groups in Colombia that the U.S. designates as terrorist organizations, according to a Department of Justice spokesperson. The plea agreement with the Justice Department allows Chiquita to avoid prosecution related to the company's now-defunct practice of paying off Colombian paramilitaries to protect its most profitable banana-growing operations. If approved by U.S. courts, the $25 million fine would be the largest U.S. criminal penalty ever imposed under federal global terrorism sanctions regulations, Justice spokesman Dean Boyd said. These regulations prohibit transactions with people who commit, threaten to commit, or support U.S.-designated terrorists and outline penalties for such actions. Justice Department attorneys and federal prosecutors in Washington, D.C., filed a joint sentencing motion asking the court to accept the plea agreement, which was reached March 19, Boyd said. A hearing on the case is scheduled for Monday. The government requested that Chiquita Brands International be fined, sentenced to probation, and required to implement an effective ethics program as part of the company’s guilty plea, Boyd added. Federal prosecutors said the Cincinnati-based company paid more than $1.7 million to the United Self-Defense Forces of Colombia (AUC), a right-wing paramilitary group, in two areas where Chiquita operated. These payments, made through Chiquita's Colombian subsidiary Banadex, occurred between 1997 and 2004. Court documents also state that Chiquita previously paid Colombia's two major leftist guerrilla groups, the FARC (Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia) and ELN (National Liberation Army), from about 1989 to 1997. At the time, those groups controlled areas where Chiquita grew bananas. The AUC, FARC and ELN were all combatants in Colombia’s long-running civil conflict and have all been designated as terrorist organizations by the United States. In a statement issued in March, Chiquita Brands International CEO Fernando Aguirre said the company sees the plea agreement as a reasonable solution to the predicament the company faced years ago. He said Chiquita voluntarily disclosed the payments to the Justice Department in 2003, clarifying that the payments were made to protect its employees. Court filings indicate the payments started after a Banadex general manager met with AUC leader Carlos Castano, who suggested payments be made to the group through private security companies as the AUC was preparing to push FARC out of Colombia’s Uraba region. The filings allege Castano implied that failure to pay could result in harm to Banadex personnel and property. Charges indicate senior Chiquita executives knew about the payments, and while checks to security companies were issued, no services were provided. Court documents state that after the AUC was designated a terrorist organization in 2002, Chiquita made payments in cash and persisted even after outside counsel advised the payments were illegal and should stop. Prosecutors noted Chiquita's cooperation during the investigation and the company's voluntary disclosure of its actions, Boyd said. While the government considered additional charges, it chose not to pursue them after a thorough investigation and consideration of crucial information provided by Chiquita. Chiquita sold Banadex to another company more than two years ago but remains one of the largest banana buyers in Colombia. CNN’s Kevin Bohn contributed to this report.
translated_content: WASHINGTON (CNN) — Produsen pisang Chiquita telah setuju untuk membayar denda sebesar $25 juta dan menjalani masa percobaan selama lima tahun karena sebelumnya melakukan pembayaran kepada kelompok-kelompok di Kolombia yang oleh AS dianggap sebagai organisasi teroris, menurut juru bicara Departemen Kehakiman. Kesepakatan pembelaan dengan Departemen Kehakiman ini memungkinkan Chiquita menghindari penuntutan terkait praktik pembayaran kepada paramiliter Kolombia yang kini sudah dihentikan demi melindungi operasi perkebunan pisang paling menguntungkan milik perusahaan. Jika disetujui pengadilan AS, denda $25 juta ini akan menjadi hukuman pidana terbesar yang pernah dijatuhkan di bawah peraturan sanksi terorisme global federal, kata juru bicara Departemen Kehakiman, Dean Boyd. Peraturan ini melarang transaksi dengan pihak yang melakukan, mengancam akan melakukan, atau mendukung teroris yang telah ditetapkan AS dan menetapkan sanksi untuk pelanggaran tersebut. Jaksa Departemen Kehakiman serta jaksa federal di Washington, D.C., telah mengajukan permohonan hukuman bersama yang meminta pengadilan menerima kesepakatan pembelaan tersebut, yang dicapai pada 19 Maret, jelas Boyd. Sidang kasus ini dijadwalkan pada hari Senin. Pemerintah meminta agar Chiquita Brands International didenda, dijatuhi masa percobaan, serta diwajibkan menerapkan program etika yang efektif sebagai bagian dari pengakuan bersalah perusahaan, tambah Boyd. Jaksa federal menyatakan, perusahaan yang berbasis di Cincinnati ini membayar lebih dari $1,7 juta kepada United Self-Defense Forces of Colombia (AUC), kelompok paramiliter sayap kanan, di dua wilayah operasi Chiquita. Pembayaran ini dilakukan lewat anak perusahaan Chiquita di Kolombia, Banadex, antara tahun 1997 dan 2004. Dokumen pengadilan juga menyebut Chiquita sebelumnya membayar dua kelompok gerilya kiri utama Kolombia, FARC (Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia) dan ELN (National Liberation Army), sekitar tahun 1989 hingga 1997. Saat itu, kedua kelompok tersebut menguasai wilayah penanaman pisang Chiquita. AUC, FARC, dan ELN semuanya terlibat dalam konflik sipil berkepanjangan di Kolombia dan sudah ditetapkan sebagai organisasi teroris oleh Amerika Serikat. Dalam pernyataan yang dikeluarkan pada Maret, CEO Chiquita Brands International, Fernando Aguirre, mengatakan bahwa perusahannya memandang kesepakatan pembelaan tersebut sebagai solusi wajar atas dilema yang dihadapi beberapa tahun lalu. Ia menuturkan Chiquita secara sukarela melaporkan pembayaran itu ke Departemen Kehakiman tahun 2003 serta menegaskan pembayaran dilakukan untuk melindungi karyawan. Dokumen pengadilan menunjukkan pembayaran bermula setelah manajer umum Banadex bertemu dengan pemimpin AUC, Carlos Castano, yang menyarankan pembayaran dilakukan melalui perusahaan keamanan swasta saat AUC bersiap mengusir FARC dari kawasan Uraba, Kolombia. Dokumen tersebut menuduh Castano memberi pesan tersirat bahwa kegagalan membayar dapat membahayakan personel dan properti Banadex. Tuduhan menunjukkan para eksekutif senior Chiquita mengetahui pembayaran itu, dan meskipun cek dikeluarkan ke perusahaan keamanan, tidak ada layanan yang diberikan. Dokumen pengadilan menyebut setelah AUC dinyatakan organisasi teroris pada 2002, Chiquita membayar dengan tunai serta terus melakukan pembayaran meski penasihat hukum eksternal menyatakan tindakan tersebut ilegal dan harus dihentikan. Jaksa menyoroti kerja sama Chiquita selama proses investigasi dan pelaporan sukarela perusahaan atas tindakannya, menurut Boyd. Walau pemerintah mempertimbangkan dakwaan tambahan, mereka akhirnya tidak melanjutkan setelah investigasi mendalam serta mempertimbangkan bukti penting dari Chiquita. Chiquita menjual Banadex ke perusahaan lain lebih dari dua tahun yang lalu, tetapi masih menjadi salah satu pembeli pisang terbesar di Kolombia. Kevin Bohn dari CNN ikut berkontribusi dalam laporan ini.

article_content: The Nepalese government announced on Monday that it will ban the Chinese social media app TikTok, citing concerns that misuse of the popular video platform is disrupting social harmony and has generated increasing calls for regulation. Other nations have already partially or fully banned TikTok, often due to security concerns. Local media report that over 1,600 cybercrime cases related to TikTok have occurred in Nepal over the past four years. Rekha Sharma, Nepal's Minister for Communications and Information Technology, stated that the ban was decided during a recent cabinet meeting. "Colleagues are working on technically shutting it down," Sharma told Reuters. Purushottam Khanal, Chair of the Nepal Telecom Authority, said that internet service providers have been instructed to block access to TikTok. "Some providers have already implemented the ban, while others will do so later today," Khanal said. TikTok has not immediately responded to requests for comment, but previously asserted that such bans are 'misguided' and based on 'misconceptions'. Opposition leaders in Nepal have criticized the government's move, arguing that it lacks effectiveness and responsibility. Pradeep Gyawali, former foreign minister and senior leader of the Communist Party of Nepal (Unified Marxist-Leninist), commented that other social media platforms also contain problematic content, and suggested that regulation would be preferable to outright bans. India banned TikTok and several other Chinese apps in June 2020, citing threats to national security and integrity. Pakistan has also banned TikTok multiple times, citing concerns about 'immoral and indecent' content.
translated_content: Pemerintah Nepal mengumumkan pada hari Senin bahwa mereka akan melarang aplikasi media sosial asal Tiongkok, TikTok, dengan alasan bahwa penyalahgunaan platform video populer ini mengganggu harmoni sosial dan telah menimbulkan semakin banyak seruan untuk pengawasan. Beberapa negara lain sudah sebagian atau sepenuhnya melarang TikTok, sering karena alasan keamanan. Media lokal melaporkan bahwa lebih dari 1.600 kasus kejahatan siber terkait TikTok terjadi di Nepal selama empat tahun terakhir. Menteri Komunikasi dan Teknologi Informasi Nepal, Rekha Sharma, menyatakan bahwa keputusan pelarangan ini dibuat dalam rapat kabinet terbaru. "Rekan-rekan sedang bekerja untuk menutup akses secara teknis," kata Sharma kepada Reuters. Ketua Otoritas Telekomunikasi Nepal, Purushottam Khanal, mengatakan penyedia layanan internet telah diinstruksikan untuk memblokir akses ke TikTok. "Beberapa penyedia sudah menerapkan pelarangan, sementara yang lain akan melakukannya hari ini," ujar Khanal. TikTok belum memberikan tanggapan atas permintaan komentar, namun sebelumnya menyatakan bahwa pelarangan semacam ini 'tidak tepat' dan didasarkan pada 'kesalahpahaman'. Para pemimpin oposisi di Nepal mengkritik langkah pemerintah tersebut dengan menyebut kebijakan itu kurang efektif dan tidak bertanggung jawab. Pradeep Gyawali, mantan menteri luar negeri dan pemimpin senior Partai Komunis Nepal (Marxis-Leninis Bersatu), mengatakan bahwa platform media sosial lainnya juga mengandung konten bermasalah, dan menyarankan regulasi lebih baik daripada larangan total. India melarang TikTok dan beberapa aplikasi Tiongkok lainnya pada Juni 2020 dengan alasan ancaman terhadap keamanan dan integritas nasional. Pakistan juga telah beberapa kali melarang TikTok, mengutip kekhawatiran atas konten yang 'tidak bermoral dan tidak senonoh'.

article_content: California has introduced a new law that bans four additives commonly found in products like sodas and candies. However, despite widespread social media rumors, Skittles candy itself is not being banned. The confusion originated from earlier versions of the bill, which considered banning titanium dioxide—a component of Skittles—but lawmakers chose to exclude it from the final legislation. The law specifically targets brominated vegetable oil, potassium bromate, propylparaben, and Red Dye 3, additives that have already been banned in the European Union due to health concerns such as cancer risks demonstrated in animal studies. California food manufacturers must remove these substances from their products by January 1, 2027. Governor Gavin Newsom welcomed the legislation as a step forward for food safety, pending updated guidance from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA). Despite these facts, false claims have circulated online. For instance, the Daily Loud social media account incorrectly claimed that Skittles would be banned in California by 2027, and actor Mario Lopez also amplified this misinformation on social media. While titanium dioxide remains permitted in the US, with the FDA considering it safe in small quantities, it is banned in the EU and some other countries.

Kebingungan ini berasal dari versi awal rancangan undang-undang yang sempat mengusulkan pelarangan titanium dioksida—bahan yang terkandung dalam Skittles—tetapi akhirnya tidak dimasukkan ke dalam versi final. Undang-undang ini secara khusus melarang penggunaan brominated vegetable oil, potassium bromate, propylparaben, dan Red Dye 3, yang semuanya sudah dilarang di Uni Eropa karena risiko kesehatan seperti kanker pada hewan percobaan. Produsen makanan di California diwajibkan menghilangkan bahan-bahan tersebut dari produk mereka sebelum 1 Januari 2027. Gubernur Gavin Newsom menyambut baik undang-undang ini sebagai langkah maju demi keamanan pangan, sambil menunggu pembaruan pedoman dari FDA. Meski begitu, klaim salah tetap beredar di internet. Misalnya, akun media sosial Daily Loud secara keliru mengklaim bahwa Skittles akan dilarang di California pada 2027, dan aktor Mario Lopez juga ikut menyebarkan informasi yang salah ini. Adapun titanium dioksida masih diizinkan di Amerika Serikat karena FDA menyatakannya aman dalam jumlah kecil, meskipun zat tersebut dilarang di Uni Eropa dan beberapa negara lainnya.

article_content: A mother has flown her seven-year-old son to Germany for life-saving surgery after two NHS hospitals delayed his treatment due to a shortage of beds. Sam Knighton spent £10,000 to take her son, Zac, abroad for immediate treatment of neuroblastoma, a rare cancer. Zac is scheduled to undergo surgery at University Hospital Greifswald in Germany, where doctors hope to remove three diseased lymph nodes. Sam Knighton, 43, said she felt let down by the UK healthcare system: 'I've had to fight every step of the way for Zac. I just hope we're not too late.' Zac first developed symptoms in October 2008, but two general practitioners initially misdiagnosed him. He was later diagnosed with advanced neuroblastoma, with a substantial tumour in his abdomen. Zac began chemotherapy at Leicester Royal Infirmary in March 2009, followed by surgery to remove the tumour. Doctors noted that some cancer may remain at the site. After further chemotherapy, Zac missed the window for important antibody therapy due to illness. The NHS funded treatment in Germany, where doctors successfully removed a tumour near Zac’s heart, which UK surgeons had deemed too risky. Sam Knighton criticized the NHS for delays at each stage. Although Zac was declared cancer-free in February 2011, a follow-up scan in Germany three months later found disease in three lymph nodes. Drug treatment failed, and Zac was told in December he needed another operation. An operation was scheduled for December 22 at Queen’s Medical Centre in Nottingham, but a lack of pediatric beds delayed the procedure until January 19. An earlier operation in Leicester was canceled half an hour before Zac was due at hospital. Facing ongoing delays, Sam Knighton arranged for Zac’s surgery in Germany. Johannes Visser, Zac's consultant at Leicester, said the hospital was extremely busy with critically ill children, causing rescheduling. A spokesperson for Nottingham University Hospitals stated the first date offered for Zac’s operation was January 19, which the family declined. The Department of Health reported that the Trust was investigating the situation and that local NHS resources were receiving annual funding increases.
translated_content: Seorang ibu membawa putranya yang berusia tujuh tahun ke Jerman untuk menjalani operasi penyelamatan nyawa setelah dua rumah sakit NHS menunda pengobatannya karena kekurangan tempat tidur. Sam Knighton menghabiskan £10.000 untuk membawa putranya, Zac, ke luar negeri agar segera mendapat perawatan neuroblastoma, jenis kanker yang langka. Zac dijadwalkan menjalani operasi di University Hospital Greifswald di Jerman, di mana dokter berharap dapat mengangkat tiga kelenjar getah bening yang sakit. Sam Knighton, 43, mengatakan ia merasa kecewa dengan sistem kesehatan Inggris: 'Saya harus berjuang dari awal demi Zac. Saya hanya berharap kami tidak terlambat.' Zac mulai menunjukkan gejala pada Oktober 2008, namun dua dokter umum awalnya salah mendiagnosis penyakitnya. Ia kemudian didiagnosis menderita neuroblastoma lanjut dengan tumor cukup besar di perutnya. Zac memulai kemoterapi di Leicester Royal Infirmary pada Maret 2009, lalu menjalani operasi pengangkatan tumor. Dokter mencatat beberapa sel kanker mungkin masih tersisa di lokasi tersebut. Setelah kemoterapi lanjutan, Zac melewatkan kesempatan terapi antibodi penting karena sakit. NHS membiayai pengobatan di Jerman, di mana dokter berhasil mengangkat tumor di dekat jantung Zac yang sebelumnya dinilai terlalu berisiko oleh dokter di Inggris. Sam Knighton mengkritik NHS atas keterlambatan di setiap tahap. Walaupun Zac dinyatakan bebas kanker pada Februari 2011, pemeriksaan lanjutan di Jerman tiga bulan kemudian menemukan penyakit pada tiga kelenjar getah bening. Pengobatan dengan obat tidak berhasil, dan pada bulan Desember Zac diberi tahu ia memerlukan operasi lagi. Operasi dijadwalkan pada 22 Desember di Queen’s Medical Centre di Nottingham, namun kurangnya tempat tidur anak menunda prosedur hingga 19 Januari. Operasi lebih awal di Leicester dibatalkan setengah jam sebelum Zac dijadwalkan ke rumah sakit. Menghadapi penundaan berulang, Sam Knighton mengatur operasi Zac di Jerman. Johannes Visser, dokter konsultan Zac di Leicester, mengatakan rumah sakit sangat sibuk dengan anak-anak yang sakit kritis sehingga operasi harus dijadwal ulang. Juru bicara Nottingham University Hospitals menyatakan tanggal pertama yang ditawarkan untuk operasi Zac adalah 19 Januari, namun keluarga menolak. Departemen Kesehatan melaporkan bahwa Trust sedang menyelidiki situasi ini dan bahwa layanan NHS setempat menerima peningkatan dana setiap tahun.
