Authorities in Oklahoma are investigating the discovery of three skeletons in the Sans Bois Mountains, which may be the remains of Sherilyn Jamison, Bobby Jamison, and their six-year-old daughter, Madyson. The family vanished in October 2009 while searching for property in this remote area, located about 155 miles east of Oklahoma City. Their disappearance attracted widespread speculation, including unproven claims about involvement in drugs, witchcraft, and cult activity.

Sherilyn’s mother, Connie Kokotan, has long believed that her daughter, son-in-law, and granddaughter were killed by members of a violent cult, and she remains critical of the police investigation. 'Just like I've said from the very beginning, I think somebody killed them,' she told the Oklahoman newspaper. 'There's just no way that Bobby and Sherilyn would ever let anything happen to Madyson unless something had been done to them.'

Before they disappeared, friends and family noticed a change in Bobby and Sherilyn’s behavior, including significant weight loss and acting as if in a trance. When the family’s abandoned pickup truck was found eight days after they vanished, their dog Maizy was discovered inside, barely alive but ultimately rescued and now cared for by Bobby’s mother.

Ms. Kokotan rejects the then-sheriff's claims of drug involvement, attributing her daughter's behavior to grief after the tragic death of her sister Marla two years earlier. She also disputes allegations of witchcraft. At the family’s home in Eufaula, investigators found a shipping container with unusual messages, and the family’s pastor said the Jamisons reported spiritual encounters, with both parents claiming to have seen spirits and their daughter talking to one.

A massive, multi-agency search effort failed to locate the family at the time. The recently discovered skeletons, believed to be two adults and a child, were found about three miles from the family’s truck. Forensic scientists are now working to confirm their identities through dental records and DNA. Authorities say the remains might have been overlooked during previous searches because the bodies could have been hidden by fallen leaves.

Pihak berwenang di Oklahoma tengah menyelidiki penemuan tiga kerangka di Pegunungan Sans Bois, yang diduga jasad Sherilyn Jamison, Bobby Jamison, dan putri mereka yang berusia enam tahun, Madyson. Keluarga ini menghilang pada Oktober 2009 saat mencari tanah di daerah terpencil sekitar 250 kilometer sebelah timur Kota Oklahoma. Kasus hilangnya mereka menimbulkan spekulasi luas, termasuk dugaan tanpa bukti mengenai keterlibatan narkoba, ilmu gaib, dan aktivitas sekte.

Ibunda Sherilyn, Connie Kokotan, telah lama yakin bahwa putrinya, menantu, dan cucunya dibunuh oleh anggota sekte kekerasan, dan ia tetap mengkritisi penyelidikan polisi. "Sejak awal saya yakin seseorang membunuh mereka," katanya kepada koran The Oklahoman. "Tidak mungkin Bobby dan Sherilyn akan membiarkan Madyson kenapa-kenapa, kecuali sudah terjadi sesuatu pada mereka."

Sebelum menghilang, teman dan keluarga memperhatikan perubahan perilaku pada Bobby dan Sherilyn, seperti penurunan berat badan yang drastis dan perilaku aneh seakan dalam kondisi trance. Ketika truk keluarga ditemukan delapan hari setelah mereka hilang, anjing mereka Maizy ditemukan hidup dalam keadaan lemah, kini diasuh oleh ibu Bobby.

Ms. Kokotan menepis tuduhan dari sheriff saat itu terkait narkoba dan menyebut perilaku putrinya dipicu duka setelah kematian tragis adiknya, Marla, dua tahun sebelumnya. Ia juga membantah tudingan soal ilmu gaib. Di rumah keluarga di Eufaula, penyelidik menemukan kontainer dengan pesan-pesan aneh. Pastor keluarga menceritakan, pasangan Jamison pernah mengalami pengalaman supranatural: kedua orang tua mengaku melihat roh dan Madyson berbicara dengan salah satu roh tersebut.

Upaya pencarian besar-besaran melibatkan banyak lembaga tidak kunjung membuahkan hasil. Kerangka yang baru ditemukan—diduga dua dewasa dan satu anak—ditemukan sekitar lima kilometer dari truk keluarga. Ilmuwan forensik kini bekerja memastikan identitas mereka lewat catatan gigi serta pemeriksaan DNA. Pihak berwenang menyebut kemungkinan kerangka tersebut terlewati dalam pencarian sebelumnya karena tertutup dedaunan.

In 21st-century America, black, Hispanic, and Native American boys and young men continue to face significant disparities in graduation, employment, and incarceration rates compared to white peers. They are also more likely to grow up in single-parent households, struggle with reading proficiency, face school suspensions or expulsions, and are at greater risk of dropping out of school. These trends, though troubling, are not new and reflect longstanding class, racial, and ethnic inequalities.

To address these challenges, President Barack Obama launched the "My Brother's Keeper" initiative, focusing on developing solutions for these persistent issues. The initiative, started three months ago, created a task force to investigate the problems and invited businesses and foundations to participate. Obama emphasized that it is everyone's responsibility—government, private sector, philanthropy, and faith communities—to help young men of color overcome barriers by providing necessary tools and support.

On Friday, the White House released the task force's initial report, outlining the hardships faced by young black, Hispanic, and Native American males, and offering strategies to help them succeed. Administration officials clarified that the initiative is not a new government program, but an effort to assess and expand effective existing public and private programs. The primary aim is to maximize federal resources and broaden involvement from all sectors of American society.

According to Cecilia Munoz, White House director of domestic policy, the focus is on increasing the impact of current efforts. Valerie Jarrett, a senior adviser, highlighted the importance of this initiative for the long-term health of American communities and the national economy. She noted that the White House Council on Women and Girls was created five years ago to promote equality, and "My Brother's Keeper" seeks similar progress for historically disadvantaged groups.

The 60-page report identifies key milestones that predict better outcomes for non-white boys and young men: a healthy start in life and school, strong reading skills by third grade, high school graduation, completion of post-secondary education or training, securing a job, and getting back on track if setbacks occur. The report stresses that falling behind at any of these points makes future success much harder.

The report presents various statistics: Black, Hispanic, and Native American children are more than twice as likely to live in poverty as white children. Approximately two-thirds of black children and one-third of Latino children grow up in single-parent homes; those raised by single mothers are more likely to drop out. Among black males aged 10 to 24, homicide is the leading cause of death. In 2012, black males were six times more likely, and Hispanics 2.5 times more likely, to be imprisoned than white males.

To address these disparities, Obama will encourage Americans to engage in long-term mentoring and tutoring for young men of color, aiming to offer guidance and stability. The report also calls for expanding access to quality preschool, eliminating suspensions and expulsions in early learning, and enhancing literacy efforts. Foundations and organizations have pledged over $200 million to support these causes.

The report recommends reducing violence and giving young men second chances by improving coordination among federal, state, and local leaders, police, and community groups, while reforming juvenile justice systems to keep youth out of jail and providing education to those incarcerated.

In personal remarks, Obama described his own upbringing without a father, acknowledging mistakes and poor choices, and the vital role of supportive adults in providing second chances. He stressed the power of encouragement and the importance of community in helping young men succeed.

Di Amerika abad ke-21, anak laki-laki dan pemuda kulit hitam, Hispanik, dan Penduduk Asli Amerika masih menghadapi ketimpangan besar dalam tingkat kelulusan, peluang kerja, dan tingkat pemenjaraan dibandingkan dengan rekan-rekan kulit putih mereka. Mereka juga lebih sering tumbuh dalam keluarga dengan orang tua tunggal, mengalami kesulitan membaca, lebih sering diskors atau dikeluarkan dari sekolah, dan berisiko lebih tinggi putus sekolah. Meskipun memprihatinkan, tren ini bukanlah hal baru dan mencerminkan ketidaksetaraan kelas, ras, dan etnis yang telah berlangsung lama.

Untuk mengatasi tantangan ini, Presiden Barack Obama meluncurkan inisiatif "My Brother's Keeper" yang bertujuan mencari solusi atas masalah-masalah yang terus menerus terjadi ini. Inisiatif ini, yang dimulai tiga bulan lalu, membentuk gugus tugas untuk menyelidiki permasalahan dan mengundang bisnis serta yayasan untuk berpartisipasi. Obama menegaskan, semua pihak—pemerintah, sektor swasta, filantropi, dan komunitas keagamaan—bertanggung jawab membantu pemuda kulit berwarna dalam mengatasi hambatan dengan memberikan alat dan dukungan yang diperlukan.

Pada hari Jumat, Gedung Putih merilis laporan awal gugus tugas yang merangkum tantangan yang dihadapi anak laki-laki dan pemuda kulit hitam, Hispanik, dan Penduduk Asli Amerika, serta strategi agar mereka bisa berhasil. Pejabat pemerintah menekankan bahwa inisiatif ini bukan program pemerintah baru, melainkan upaya menilai dan memperluas program publik dan privat yang sudah efektif. Tujuan utamanya adalah memaksimalkan sumber daya federal dan memperluas keterlibatan seluruh pihak di masyarakat Amerika.

Menurut Cecilia Munoz, Direktur Kebijakan Domestik Gedung Putih, fokusnya ialah meningkatkan dampak upaya-upaya yang sudah ada. Valerie Jarrett, penasihat senior, menyoroti pentingnya inisiatif ini bagi kesehatan jangka panjang komunitas Amerika dan perekonomian nasional. Ia juga mengatakan bahwa White House Council on Women and Girls dibentuk lima tahun lalu untuk mendukung kesetaraan, dan "My Brother's Keeper" kini ditujukan untuk memberi kemajuan serupa bagi kelompok yang kurang beruntung secara historis.

Laporan setebal 60 halaman ini mengidentifikasi tonggak penting yang memprediksi kesuksesan anak laki-laki dan pemuda non-kulit putih: awal hidup dan pendidikan yang baik, kemampuan membaca sejak kelas tiga, lulus SMA, menyelesaikan pendidikan lanjutan atau pelatihan, mendapatkan pekerjaan, dan kembali ke jalan yang benar jika mengalami kegagalan. Laporan ini menekankan, jika tertinggal di satu tahap saja, maka kesuksesan berikutnya akan jauh lebih sulit diraih.

Laporan menyebutkan berbagai statistik: anak-anak kulit hitam, Hispanik, dan Penduduk Asli Amerika punya kemungkinan lebih dari dua kali lipat hidup dalam kemiskinan dibandingkan anak-anak kulit putih. Sekitar dua pertiga anak kulit hitam dan sepertiga anak Latino tumbuh di keluarga orang tua tunggal; mereka yang dibesarkan oleh ibu tunggal lebih sering putus sekolah. Di antara laki-laki kulit hitam berusia 10–24 tahun, pembunuhan adalah penyebab utama kematian. Pada 2012, laki-laki kulit hitam enam kali lebih mungkin, dan Hispanik 2,5 kali lebih mungkin, dipenjara daripada laki-laki kulit putih.

Sebagai solusi, Obama mengajak masyarakat untuk terlibat dalam pendampingan dan bimbingan belajar jangka panjang bagi pemuda berkulit berwarna agar mereka mendapat arahan dan stabilitas. Laporan juga mendorong perluasan akses ke pendidikan pra-sekolah berkualitas, menghapuskan skors dan pengeluaran siswa di pendidikan dini, serta meningkatkan program literasi. Yayasan dan organisasi telah berkomitmen lebih dari $200 juta untuk mendukung upaya ini.

Laporan tersebut merekomendasikan pengurangan kekerasan dan pemberian kesempatan kedua dengan meningkatkan koordinasi antara pemerintah federal, negara bagian, pemerintah kota, kepolisian, dan kelompok warga, sembari mereformasi sistem peradilan anak untuk mencegah pemuda masuk penjara dan memastikan mereka yang dipenjara tetap mengakses pendidikan.

Dalam pernyataannya, Obama bercerita tentang masa kecilnya tanpa ayah, mengakui pernah membuat kesalahan dan pilihan buruk, dan menyoroti pentingnya peran orang dewasa yang mendukung dan memberi kesempatan kedua. Ia menegaskan pentingnya dorongan semangat dan peran komunitas dalam mendukung anak muda untuk meraih kesuksesan.

At a major Republican fundraising dinner in Washington, Sarah Palin drew significant attention, even overshadowing keynote speaker Newt Gingrich. The Alaska governor made a last-minute appearance at the event, ending speculation about her attendance. While plans for Palin to speak fell through due to concerns she might upstage Gingrich, her arrival alongside her husband Todd and the Gingriches was met with enthusiastic cheers from the crowd of 2,000 party loyalists. Former GOP presidential nominee John McCain greeted Palin and later tweeted about their reunion.

Though Palin did not address the audience, she attracted groups of Republicans eager for photos and conversation at her table, drawing ongoing media focus during the night. The event was attended by 33 Republican senators, RNC chairman Michael Steele, and was emceed by actor Jon Voight. John Cornyn, chairman of the National Republican Senatorial Committee, and Gingrich both publicly acknowledged Palin’s leadership.

In his remarks, Gingrich criticized the Obama administration’s federal spending and national security policies. He discussed the diversity of opinion within the Republican Party, highlighting former Vice President Dick Cheney and Colin Powell. Gingrich praised Cheney’s national security expertise, contrasting him with President Obama, whom he described as relying on rhetoric rather than substantive facts.

The dinner raised $14.45 million to support Republican Senate and House campaign committees ahead of the midterm elections. The National Republican Congressional Committee reported $3.69 million in cash and $5 million in debt, while the National Republican Senatorial Committee was debt-free with $2.69 million available. During the event, emcee Jon Voight delivered sharp criticism of President Obama’s policies and persona, referencing controversial figures from the 2008 campaign and suggesting Obama presented himself as moderate but has governed more radically.

article_content: Recent U.S. military maneuvers tied to the Israel-Gaza situation are intended to deter escalation rather than initiate direct involvement. The 26th Marine Expeditionary Unit, counting around 2,200 Marines, is distributed among three Navy vessels: the USS Bataan, USS Carter Hall, and USS Mesa Verde. Originally deployed together as an Amphibious Ready Group, the ships have since separated as needed for operational purposes. Currently, the Bataan and Carter Hall are situated in the Arabian Sea after departing the Persian Gulf earlier this week, while the Mesa Verde, following repairs in Spain, has resumed its course eastward in the Mediterranean. No orders have been given for these Marines or ships to move near Israel. The Pentagon, however, has repositioned them to spots where they could quickly be deployed if a decision is made. According to U.S. officials, the Bataan and Carter Hall will move towards the Red Sea, and the Mesa Verde will remain in the Mediterranean for now. These ships and Marines are attracting attention because they can support rapid evacuations if a crisis arises—they are not tasked with combat assignments. Furthermore, Defense Secretary Lloyd Austin has authorized about 2,000 U.S. military personnel to be on 24-hour Prepared to Deploy Orders (PTDO), downsizing from the typical 96-hour notice. These troops have specialties such as air defense, logistics, security, medical assistance, intelligence, surveillance, and transport; their main role is support, not frontline battle. The Pentagon has made these PTDO orders public to emphasize America’s readiness to reinforce forces in the region for deterrence, particularly in relation to Iran and Hezbollah. A unique aspect of current military posture is the rare presence of two U.S. aircraft carriers—USS Gerald R. Ford and USS Dwight D. Eisenhower—in the vicinity. Normally, one carrier would be stationed there, but circumstances now place both in the eastern Mediterranean. The Ford’s deployment is extended, while the Eisenhower is expected within a week to ten days. Carrier strike groups feature an aircraft carrier with accompanying cruisers and destroyers for security and mission adaptability. These vessels can operate together or independently if tasks require. Combined, the Ford and Eisenhower can carry close to 120 fighter jets—the Ford up to 75 and the Eisenhower up to 60—signaling robust deterrence to Iran and Hezbollah and reinforcing U.S. readiness to support Israel if required. Though positioned for deterrence, there are no current plans for combat; onboard surveillance aircraft are being used to gather intelligence. The Pentagon has also sent extra fighter jets, like F-35s, F-16s, and A-10s, to the Middle East, enhancing rapid-response capabilities and underlining the U.S. commitment to maintaining deterrence in the region.
translated_content: Manuver militer AS baru-baru ini yang terkait dengan situasi Israel-Gaza bertujuan untuk mencegah eskalasi, bukan terlibat secara langsung. Unit Ekspedisi Marinir ke-26, yang terdiri dari sekitar 2.200 marinir, ditempatkan di tiga kapal Angkatan Laut: USS Bataan, USS Carter Hall, dan USS Mesa Verde. Ketiga kapal ini awalnya dikerahkan bersama dalam Kelompok Siaga Amfibi, namun kini telah berpisah sesuai kebutuhan operasional. Saat ini, Bataan dan Carter Hall berada di Laut Arab setelah keluar dari Teluk Persia awal pekan ini, sementara Mesa Verde, setelah perbaikan di Spanyol, kembali bergerak ke arah timur di Laut Mediterania. Belum ada perintah untuk mendekat ke Israel bagi marinir atau kapal tersebut. Namun, Pentagon telah menempatkan mereka di lokasi strategis untuk dapat segera dikerahkan jika diperlukan. Pejabat AS menyatakan Bataan dan Carter Hall akan menuju Laut Merah, sementara Mesa Verde tetap di Mediterania untuk sekarang. Kapal dan marinir ini menjadi sorotan karena mereka dapat membantu evakuasi cepat jika muncul krisis—mereka tidak bertugas untuk misi tempur. Selain itu, Menteri Pertahanan Lloyd Austin menempatkan sekitar 2.000 personel militer AS dalam status Siaga Siap Dikerahkan (PTDO) dengan pemberitahuan 24 jam (biasanya 96 jam). Pasukan ini terdiri dari spesialis pertahanan udara, logistik, keamanan, medis, intelijen, pengawasan, dan transportasi; mereka merupakan unit pendukung, bukan pasukan tempur utama. Pentagon mengumumkan PTDO ini sebagai penekanan kesiapan Amerika untuk memperkuat pasukannya di wilayah ini sebagai pencegahan, khususnya kepada Iran dan Hizbullah. Posisi militer yang unik kali ini adalah kehadiran dua kapal induk AS—USS Gerald R. Ford dan USS Dwight D. Eisenhower—di kawasan yang sama. Biasanya hanya satu yang ditempatkan, tapi sekarang keduanya ada di Mediterania timur. Ford diperpanjang masa dinasnya, Eisenhower diperkirakan tiba dalam satu minggu hingga sepuluh hari. Kelompok tempur kapal induk beranggotakan kapal induk yang dikawal kapal penjelajah dan perusak demi keamanan dan fleksibilitas misi. Kapal-kapal ini bisa beroperasi bersama atau terpisah sesuai kebutuhan. Gabungan, Ford dan Eisenhower dapat membawa hampir 120 jet tempur—Ford hingga 75 pesawat, Eisenhower hingga 60—menunjukkan kekuatan pencegahan bagi Iran dan Hizbullah sekaligus kesiapan AS membantu Israel jika diperlukan. Saat ini, mereka berperan sebagai pencegah, bukan untuk bertempur, dengan pesawat pengintai di kapal yang mengumpulkan intelijen. Pentagon juga telah mengirim tambahan pesawat tempur F-35, F-16, dan A-10 ke Timur Tengah, memperkuat kemampuan respons cepat sekaligus menegaskan komitmen pencegahan AS di kawasan tersebut.

article_content: Ferrari president Luca Di Montezemolo has openly criticized Formula 1 chief Bernie Ecclestone, stating that the sport must move beyond being controlled by a single figure if it wants to evolve. Di Montezemolo voiced his dissatisfaction with Ecclestone’s handling of last season’s Brazilian Grand Prix, where Red Bull’s Sebastian Vettel secured the championship title ahead of Ferrari’s Fernando Alonso. Ferrari believed Vettel might have committed an illegal overtake under a yellow flag—a move that, if penalized, could have handed Alonso the title instead. On Ferrari’s official website, Di Montezemolo was quoted saying that Ecclestone often tries to take charge of issues outside his remit. He stressed that the interpretation of race flags should not be Ecclestone’s concern and took issue with some of Ecclestone’s remarks, insisting that Ferrari had acted with full transparency. Montezemolo suggested Ecclestone should focus on attracting more spectators and younger fans to F1, and work more closely with broadcasters and the media. While crediting Ecclestone with major accomplishments, Di Montezemolo, noting Ecclestone’s age of 82, questioned the suitability of one person continuing to run the sport and favored a leadership team approach for F1’s future. Ecclestone has responded in the past by saying he would step down only when he no longer feels effective. Di Montezemolo also reiterated his opposition to F1’s ban on in-season testing and said he planned to bring up his concerns in meetings with Ecclestone and FIA president Jean Todt. He described the ongoing test ban as unreasonable because neither FIA nor Ferrari opposes it. Additionally, he congratulated Red Bull and Vettel for winning both the drivers’ and constructors’ championships. He praised Vettel as an outstanding and grounded driver, hinting at an interest in bringing Vettel to Ferrari if Alonso ever retires. Nevertheless, Ferrari will field Alonso and Felipe Massa as their driver lineup for the upcoming season.
translated_content: Presiden Ferrari, Luca Di Montezemolo, secara terbuka mengkritik bos Formula 1, Bernie Ecclestone, dengan menyatakan bahwa olahraga ini harus meninggalkan sistem satu orang yang mengontrol segalanya jika ingin berkembang. Di Montezemolo menyampaikan ketidakpuasan terhadap cara Ecclestone menangani Grand Prix Brasil musim lalu, di mana Sebastian Vettel dari Red Bull berhasil meraih gelar juara dunia mengalahkan Fernando Alonso dari Ferrari. Ferrari meyakini bahwa Vettel mungkin melakukan aksi menyalip ilegal saat bendera kuning dikibarkan—jika hal ini dikenai hukuman, Alonso bisa saja menjadi juara. Melalui situs resmi Ferrari, Di Montezemolo mengatakan bahwa Ecclestone sering ikut campur dalam hal-hal di luar wewenangnya. Menurutnya, interpretasi bendera balapan bukan bagian dari tanggung jawab Ecclestone, dan ia tidak menerima beberapa pernyataan Ecclestone, sambil menegaskan bahwa Ferrari sudah bertindak secara transparan. Montezemolo juga menyarankan agar Ecclestone lebih fokus menarik lebih banyak penonton dan generasi muda ke F1, serta menjalin komunikasi yang lebih baik dengan stasiun TV dan media. Sambil mengakui pencapaian besar Ecclestone, Di Montezemolo—yang menyinggung usia Ecclestone yang telah 82 tahun—mempertanyakan apakah tepat jika satu orang terus memimpin olahraga ini, dan lebih memilih sistem kepemimpinan secara tim untuk masa depan F1. Ecclestone sendiri pernah menegaskan bahwa ia hanya akan mundur jika merasa sudah tidak bisa menjalankan tugasnya dengan baik. Di Montezemolo juga kembali menolak larangan uji coba di tengah musim F1, dan mengatakan akan membahas hal tersebut dalam pertemuan dengan Ecclestone dan Presiden FIA, Jean Todt. Ia menyebut pelarangan itu tidak masuk akal karena baik FIA maupun Ferrari tidak menentangnya. Selain itu, ia juga memberi selamat kepada Red Bull dan Vettel atas kemenangan mereka di kejuaraan pembalap dan konstruktor. Ia memuji Vettel sebagai pembalap hebat dan rendah hati, serta mengisyaratkan minat membawa Vettel ke Ferrari jika Alonso pensiun di kemudian hari. Namun, untuk musim mendatang, Ferrari tetap akan menurunkan Alonso dan Felipe Massa sebagai duet pembalapnya.

article_content: It has been five years since Claudia Lawrence, a 35-year-old chef, disappeared. Detectives reviewing the case have discovered DNA on a cigarette butt found in her car, potentially linked to an unidentified 'left-handed smoker'. This new evidence was found using advanced forensic methods unavailable in 2009. The cigarette, an Embassy Regal, was discovered in the ashtray of Claudia’s Vauxhall Corsa, which was off the road for several weeks before she vanished. Police are investigating if this evidence is connected to a man seen with a woman on Melrosegate Bridge at 5:35am on the day Claudia disappeared. The man, described as wearing a dark hooded top and smoking with his left hand, was observed by a cyclist. The pair were facing each other a few feet apart. Claudia was known to be comfortable with people smoking in her car and home. Police have checked the DNA of male smokers who have been in her vehicle, but none have matched so far. Authorities are also seeking to identify a man, seen on CCTV, who claimed to know Claudia or had worked with her. He spoke with shop staff in Tang Hall, York, on April 1, 2009, nearly two weeks after she went missing, but has never been traced. The charity Crimestoppers has renewed a £10,000 reward for information leading to the arrest and conviction of those responsible for Claudia’s disappearance. The offer is valid for the next three months. Analysis of Claudia’s phone records shows she spent considerable time socializing in the Acomb area of York prior to her disappearance. Police believe someone she saw there has yet to come forward. Evidence suggests Claudia left home as usual early on March 19, 2009, to walk three miles to her job at the University of York’s Goodricke College for a 6am shift. An unusual detail in the case is that Claudia’s GHD hair straighteners, model number 14.4.1B purchased in May 2007, were missing from her home. Detective Superintendent Dai Malyn doubts she would take them to work, and her blue and grey Karrimor bag was also never found. Additional fingerprints and DNA were found throughout her house, and police are working to eliminate people who had reason to be there before or after the disappearance. Mr. Malyn will appear in a fifth-anniversary appeal on BBC’s Crimewatch, where the program is set to release new details, including information about two vehicles seen around the time Claudia disappeared. Police also released photos of hair dye bottles found in Claudia’s home. Officers noted that she frequently dyed her naturally brown hair, and found a substantial amount of hair dye at her residence. They are interested to know if Claudia was dyeing anyone else’s hair. The investigation has looked into Claudia’s personal life, including reports of secret relationships. At the time of her disappearance, she was in a long-term casual relationship with a man who was already in a committed relationship. She was also reportedly out with another man two days before she disappeared, arriving at work tired after staying out late. Claudia's Samsung D900 mobile phone has never been found; it was turned off deliberately at 12:10pm on the day she disappeared. When police entered her home, her bed was made, and there were breakfast dishes left in the sink. Mr. Malyn believes Claudia left for work as usual with her phone and rucksack containing her chef’s whites. He considers the missing straighteners potentially important to the investigation. Chief Superintendent Simon Mason said there are no prime suspects but a number of individuals remain of interest to the investigation. Peter Lawrence, Claudia’s father, described the years waiting for news as 'like a cancer'—continually worsening without resolution.
translated_content: Sudah lima tahun sejak Claudia Lawrence, seorang koki berusia 35 tahun, menghilang. Detektif yang meninjau kasus ini telah menemukan DNA pada puntung rokok di mobilnya, yang mungkin terkait dengan 'perokok tangan kiri' yang belum teridentifikasi. Bukti baru ini ditemukan menggunakan metode forensik canggih yang tidak tersedia pada tahun 2009. Rokok tersebut, merek Embassy Regal, ditemukan di asbak Vauxhall Corsa milik Claudia, yang tidak digunakan selama beberapa minggu sebelum ia menghilang. Polisi sedang menyelidiki apakah bukti ini terkait dengan seorang pria yang terlihat bersama seorang wanita di Jembatan Melrosegate pada pukul 05.35 di hari Claudia menghilang. Pria tersebut, yang mengenakan jaket berkerudung gelap dan merokok dengan tangan kiri, dilihat oleh seorang pesepeda. Mereka berdiri berhadapan beberapa meter terpisah. Claudia dikenal nyaman dengan orang yang merokok di mobil atau rumahnya. Polisi telah memeriksa DNA dari perokok pria yang pernah berada di kendaraannya, namun belum ada yang cocok. Pihak berwenang juga sedang mencari seorang pria yang terekam CCTV, mengaku mengenal atau pernah bekerja dengan Claudia. Ia berbicara dengan staf toko di Tang Hall, York, pada 1 April 2009, hampir dua minggu setelah Claudia menghilang, namun pria ini belum pernah ditemukan. Organisasi amal Crimestoppers kembali menawarkan hadiah £10.000 untuk informasi yang mengarah pada penangkapan dan penghukuman pelaku dalam kasus hilangnya Claudia. Tawaran ini berlaku selama tiga bulan ke depan. Analisis catatan ponsel Claudia menunjukkan ia sering bersosialisasi di daerah Acomb, York, sebelum ia menghilang. Polisi yakin ada seseorang yang ia temui di sana yang belum maju memberikan informasi. Bukti menunjukkan Claudia meninggalkan rumah seperti biasa pada pagi 19 Maret 2009 untuk berjalan tiga mil ke tempat kerjanya di Goodricke College, University of York, untuk bertugas pukul 6 pagi. Detail tidak biasa dalam kasus ini adalah alat catok rambut merek GHD model 14.4.1B milik Claudia yang dibeli Mei 2007 tidak ditemukan di rumahnya. Detektif Superintenden Dai Malyn meragukan jika Claudia membawanya ke tempat kerja, dan tas Karrimor biru-abu miliknya juga tidak ditemukan. Sidik jari dan DNA tambahan ditemukan di rumahnya, dan polisi sedang mencoba mengeliminasi orang-orang yang punya alasan berada di sana sebelum atau sesudah hilangnya Claudia. Mr. Malyn akan tampil dalam acara peringatan lima tahun di program Crimewatch BBC, yang akan merilis detail baru, termasuk informasi dua kendaraan yang terlihat sekitar waktu Claudia menghilang. Polisi juga merilis foto botol pewarna rambut yang ditemukan di rumah Claudia. Petugas mencatat bahwa ia sering mewarnai rambut coklat alaminya, dan banyak tersedia pewarna rambut di rumahnya. Mereka juga ingin tahu apakah Claudia mewarnai rambut orang lain. Penyelidikan juga menyoroti kehidupan pribadi Claudia, termasuk laporan tentang hubungan rahasia. Saat menghilang, Claudia menjalin hubungan kasual jangka panjang dengan pria yang sudah memiliki pasangan. Ia juga dilaporkan pergi bersama pria lain dua hari sebelum hilang, dan datang kerja dalam keadaan lelah karena begadang. Ponsel Samsung D900 milik Claudia belum ditemukan; ponsel tersebut dimatikan secara sengaja pada pukul 12.10 siang di hari ia hilang. Saat polisi masuk ke rumahnya, ranjang Claudia sudah rapih dan ada piring bekas sarapan di wastafel. Mr. Malyn percaya Claudia berangkat kerja seperti biasa dengan ponsel dan ransel berisi seragam chef-nya. Ia menganggap alat catok rambut yang hilang sangat penting untuk penyelidikan. Chief Superintendent Simon Mason mengatakan belum ada tersangka utama, namun sejumlah individu tetap menjadi perhatian dalam penyelidikan ini. Peter Lawrence, ayah Claudia, menggambarkan tahun-tahun penantian tanpa kabar sebagai 'seperti kanker'—semakin memburuk tanpa kepastian.

Ivan Massow, a gay businessman known for previously leaving the Conservative Party over its stance on homosexuality, is now aiming to become a Conservative MP. He has applied to contest the Somerton and Frome seat in Somerset at the next general election, a constituency currently held by the Liberal Democrats.

Just hours before Massow submitted his application, local Conservative chairman Edmund Costelloe resigned in protest of Prime Minister David Cameron's support for gay marriage. Costelloe, along with the local party treasurer, accused Cameron of losing touch with grassroots members and criticized the leadership for what he described as an 'undebated and ill-thought-out attack on marriage between a man and a woman for the procreation of children.'

Massow, 45, made his fortune in the insurance industry and believes the progressive and liberal mindset of Somerton and Frome makes him a natural fit for the seat. He left the Tories in 2000 during William Hague's leadership, citing increased intolerance, but returned several years later.

If shortlisted, Massow will be interviewed by local Conservatives but was unaware of the local resignations at the time he applied. He argues that Costelloe's views do not reflect the more liberal outlook of local voters. Massow recognizes the controversy around gay marriage but says he can 'agree to disagree' and acknowledges that some of his friends share Costelloe's views, even if he does not.

He describes his journey from growing up in care and leaving school with few qualifications to building a successful business serving gay clients. Massow believes his life experience would allow him to offer valuable contributions as an MP and says he is 'jaded' by career politicians.

The seat is considered marginal, currently held by Liberal Democrat David Heath with a majority of 1,819. Costelloe expressed concern that discontent over the gay marriage debate could harm the party's chances in this key battleground, as many local activists and members may withdraw support.

In today’s Chromebook market, only a few devices double effectively as tablets—namely, Lenovo’s Chromebook Duet 3 and Duet 5. While these detachable Chromebooks have led the pack, both are starting to feel dated.

Recently, Chromium Gerrit commits have hinted at a possible successor to the Duet 5. Robby from Chrome Unboxed spotted a new baseboard, ‘Geralt,’ believed to be powered by a MediaTek MT8188 chipset. There are also signs Lenovo is developing a next-generation Duet 5.

Earlier, tests were found with the MT8188 and the same display as the current Duet 5. However, in early October, that display’s support for the MT8188 was removed from the code repository, raising fears that Lenovo might have scrapped the project. Excitement has now returned, as new code commits reference a device using the same Lenovo battery as the Duet 5, hinting that development might still be underway.

While the Chromebook market evolves quickly and rumors abound, a nearly two-year-old device’s battery reappearing in code is likely more than a coincidence.

Many top Chromebooks use convertible designs for versatility, but true detachable models—like the Duet series or Microsoft’s Surface Pro—remain rare and valued for their tablet experience.

We might hear more about this rumored Duet 5 successor soon. MediaTek will host an event on November 6 and could unveil a new Chromebook-focused processor. Until then, anticipation is growing.

Baru-baru ini, commit di Chromium Gerrit mengindikasikan adanya penerus dari Duet 5. Robby dari Chrome Unboxed menemukan baseboard baru bernama 'Geralt', diduga memakai chipset MediaTek MT8188. Tanda-tanda juga mengarah pada Lenovo yang sedang mengembangkan Duet 5 generasi selanjutnya.

Sekarang, semangat kembali karena commit terbaru menyebut perangkat baru yang memakai baterai Lenovo sama dengan Duet 5, artinya pengembangan masih lanjut.

Meski pasar Chromebook cepat berubah dan rumor sering muncul, munculnya kembali baterai dari perangkat yang hampir dua tahun di kode repository tampaknya bukan kebetulan.

article_content: Scientists have verified that 15 pounds of Martian meteorites landed in Morocco in July, marking only the fifth time in history that a witnessed Martian meteorite fall has been chemically confirmed. The last time a fresh Martian meteorite was discovered was in 1962. These Martian rocks are incredibly valuable—reported to be up to ten times more precious than gold—because no Mars mission has yet returned material directly from the planet. As a result, meteorite falls like this are the only way scientists can study Martian surface material here on Earth. The recent meteorite finds were recovered near Foumzgit, Morocco in December 2011, several months after a fireball was spotted in the sky. Scientifically, these rocks are especially important because they are freshly fallen and uncontaminated by Earth materials, providing a rare opportunity to study pristine Martian samples. A committee of meteorite experts, including some NASA scientists and led by Chris Herd of the University of Alberta, confirmed and certified that the 15 pounds of meteorites collected in Morocco indeed originated from Mars. The largest specimen weighs just over two pounds. In total, less than 240 pounds of Martian rocks are known to exist on Earth, most found in places like Antarctica or deserts. Astronomers believe these rocks were ejected from Mars millions of years ago by a massive impact and traveled through space before falling to Earth. Most previously discovered Martian meteorites were found long after landing, making them vulnerable to contamination. In contrast, these newly found samples are considered much purer. Because Martian meteorites are so rare and scientifically valuable, they command high prices—between $11,000 and $22,500 per ounce, according to meteorite dealer Darryl Pitt. The new rocks, officially named 'Tissint' by the International Society for Meteoritics and Planetary Science, have already attracted significant interest from researchers and collectors worldwide. Known witnessed falls of Martian meteorites have only occurred in 1815 (France), 1865 (India), 1911 (Egypt), 1962 (Nigeria), and now this event in Morocco. These rare occurrences are seen as once-in-a-career or even once-in-a-lifetime events for scientists. Chris Herd, who helped certify the find, described the rocks as spectacular and aesthetically pleasing, emphasizing their scientific and collector value.

Terakhir kali meteorit Mars segar ditemukan adalah pada tahun 1962. Batu-batuan Mars ini sangat berharga—dilaporkan hingga sepuluh kali lebih mahal daripada emas—karena belum ada misi Mars yang berhasil membawa material langsung dari planet tersebut ke Bumi. Karena itu, jatuhnya meteorit seperti ini menjadi satu-satunya cara bagi ilmuwan untuk mempelajari material permukaan Mars di Bumi. Penemuan meteorit terbaru ini ditemukan di dekat Foumzgit, Maroko pada Desember 2011, beberapa bulan setelah bola api terlihat di langit. Secara ilmiah, batu-batuan ini sangat penting karena masih segar dan belum terkontaminasi material Bumi, memberi kesempatan langka untuk mempelajari sampel Mars yang murni. Sebuah komite ahli meteorit yang juga melibatkan ilmuwan NASA dan dipimpin oleh Chris Herd dari Universitas Alberta telah mengonfirmasi dan memastikan bahwa 15 pon meteorit yang dikumpulkan di Maroko benar-benar berasal dari Mars. Spesimen terbesar memiliki berat sedikit lebih dari dua pon. Secara total, kurang dari 240 pon batu Mars diketahui ada di Bumi, kebanyakan ditemukan di tempat seperti Antartika atau gurun. Para astronom percaya batu-batu ini terlontar dari Mars jutaan tahun lalu akibat suatu tumbukan besar, kemudian melintasi ruang angkasa sebelum jatuh ke Bumi. Sebagian besar meteorit Mars yang ditemukan sebelumnya telah lama berada di Bumi sehingga terkontaminasi oleh material lokal. Sebaliknya, sampel baru ini dianggap jauh lebih murni. Karena meteorit Mars sangat langka dan bernilai ilmiah tinggi, harganya sangat mahal—antara $11.000 hingga $22.500 per ons menurut pedagang meteorit Darryl Pitt. Batu-batu baru ini, yang secara resmi dinamai 'Tissint' oleh International Society for Meteoritics and Planetary Science, sudah menarik banyak minat dari peneliti dan kolektor di seluruh dunia. Jatuhnya meteorit Mars yang disaksikan manusia hanya tercatat pada tahun 1815 (Prancis), 1865 (India), 1911 (Mesir), 1962 (Nigeria), dan kini di Maroko. Peristiwa langka seperti ini biasanya dianggap hanya terjadi sekali seumur karier, bahkan seumur hidup seorang ilmuwan. Chris Herd, yang turut mengesahkan temuan ini, menggambarkan batu-batuan tersebut sebagai sangat spektakuler dan indah, serta menonjolkan nilai penting secara ilmiah dan bagi para kolektor.

article_content: European security agencies are warning of a rising threat from individuals inspired by the Israel-Hamas conflict, with authorities particularly concerned about 'lone wolf' attackers who are difficult to trace. Officials from intelligence and police services in countries such as the UK, Germany, and France have told Reuters that they are stepping up their surveillance of Islamist extremists, even as their resources are stretched thin by dangers posed by Russia, China, and Iran. Mark Rowley, the police chief in London, called this period, 'one of the most challenging convergences of threats I have ever seen.' A British security source suggested that the Israel-Gaza war could spur Islamist recruitment more than any event since the 2003 Iraq war, adding that calls for violence against Jewish and Western targets have risen across Europe. A German official briefed by intelligence agencies described the risk to civilians as the highest in recent memory. The threat is said to come not only from Islamist militants but also from far-right groups and Russian influence. Recent attacks in France and Belgium—which left three people dead—have spurred multiple countries including Austria, Slovenia, and Bosnia-Herzegovina to boost their terrorism threat levels. Italy has also reinstated border controls with Slovenia to prevent potential militant infiltration. 'There is going to be a blowback that is going to be felt for years,' warned the British official. Islamist attacks in Europe peaked between 2004-2006 (fueled by al Qaeda) and again from 2015-2018 (inspired by ISIS), but security officials believe today's threat is different. While groups like ISIS and al Qaeda once orchestrated large-scale operations, they have since weakened, and Hamas's focus remains on Israel. Now, the primary danger comes from individuals who radicalize, often online, with little direct connection to terrorist organizations. Officials note that the ongoing intensity and length of the Israeli military campaign in Gaza—following Hamas's deadly Oct. 7 assault—will affect European threat levels. Though a ceasefire is currently in place, both parties stress that the conflict isn’t over. Jochen Kopelke, head of Germany’s largest police union, said authorities are monitoring suspected extremists and conducting raids, but lone actors who self-radicalize remain a serious threat. Kopelke noted that such individuals don’t always need complex weapons—they can use cars or knives to attack crowded places, with upcoming Christmas markets considered particularly vulnerable. In 2016, a Berlin Christmas market attack killed twelve. Some Muslims in Europe express anger over the intensity of Israel’s offensive and argue that European governments should have tried harder to restrain Israel. Polarisation is growing, with reports of anti-Muslim incidents and a climate of fear fueled by online disinformation. Iman Atta of Tell Mama, a British group monitoring anti-Muslim attacks, commented, 'I've never seen our society so polarised.' German police say networks of Salafists (hardline Islamists) are resurfacing, while pro-Hamas influencers are gaining traction on social media. After the Hamas attack, one Salafist preacher amassed 55,000 TikTok followers and has posted videos denying Israel’s right to exist. Despite high attention on Islamist threats, Europol’s data shows that only two of sixteen completed terrorist attacks in the EU last year were 'jihadist'; most were linked to left-wing, anarchist, or right-wing groups. Thomas Renard, director at the International Centre for Counter-Terrorism, says the threat has grown 'more diffuse and more diverse,' with online radicalisation now a bigger issue than recruitment at mosques.
translated_content: Lembaga keamanan di Eropa memperingatkan meningkatnya ancaman dari individu yang terinspirasi oleh konflik Israel-Hamas, dengan otoritas khususnya khawatir terhadap pelaku serangan 'lone wolf' yang sulit dideteksi. Pejabat intelijen dan kepolisian di negara seperti Inggris, Jerman, dan Prancis mengatakan kepada Reuters bahwa mereka memperketat pengawasan terhadap ekstremis Islamis, meskipun sumber daya mereka sudah terbatas karena juga harus mengatasi ancaman dari Rusia, China, dan Iran. Kepala polisi London, Mark Rowley, menyebut periode ini sebagai 'salah satu masa dengan konvergensi ancaman paling menantang yang pernah saya lihat.' Seorang sumber keamanan Inggris menyatakan perang Israel-Gaza bisa memicu perekrutan ekstremis Islamis lebih dahsyat daripada peristiwa mana pun sejak perang Irak 2003, serta melaporkan bahwa seruan kekerasan terhadap target Yahudi dan Barat meningkat di seluruh Eropa. Seorang pejabat Jerman yang mendapat laporan dari intelijen menggambarkan risiko terhadap warga sipil sebagai yang tertinggi dalam beberapa tahun terakhir. Ancaman tidak hanya berasal dari militan Islam, tetapi juga kelompok ekstrem kanan dan pengaruh Rusia. Serangan baru-baru ini di Prancis dan Belgia—yang menewaskan tiga orang—telah membuat beberapa negara seperti Austria, Slovenia, dan Bosnia-Herzegovina meningkatkan level ancaman terorisme. Italia juga memberlakukan kembali kontrol perbatasan dengan Slovenia guna mencegah masuknya militan. 'Akan ada efek balasan yang terasa selama bertahun-tahun,' kata pejabat Inggris tersebut. Serangan Islamis di Eropa mencapai puncaknya antara 2004-2006 (karena al Qaeda) dan 2015-2018 (dipicu ISIS), namun pejabat keamanan menilai ancaman saat ini berbeda. Dulu, ISIS dan al Qaeda merancang operasi berskala besar, kini keduanya melemah dan Hamas lebih fokus ke Israel. Saat ini, bahaya utama datang dari individu yang teradikalisasi, seringnya secara daring, tanpa keterkaitan langsung dengan organisasi teror besar. Pejabat menyoroti bahwa lamanya dan tingkat intensitas serangan militer Israel di Gaza—setelah serangan Hamas 7 Oktober—akan memengaruhi tingkat ancaman di Eropa. Meski gencatan senjata berlaku, kedua pihak menegaskan konflik belum usai. Jochen Kopelke, ketua serikat polisi terbesar di Jerman, mengatakan aparat mengawasi dan melakukan penggerebekan terhadap tersangka ekstremis, namun pelaku lone wolf yang teradikalisasi masih menjadi ancaman serius. Kopelke menambahkan, pelaku seperti ini tak selalu memakai alat berat—mereka bisa menyerang keramaian dengan mobil atau pisau, dan pasar Natal yang segera buka dipandang riskan. Pada 2016, terjadi serangan di pasar Natal Berlin yang menewaskan dua belas orang. Beberapa Muslim di Eropa mengungkapkan kemarahan atas intensitas ofensif Israel dan menilai pemerintah Eropa kurang menahan tindakan Israel. Pola polarisasi semakin kuat, dengan meningkatnya laporan insiden anti-Muslim dan iklim ketakutan karena disinformasi daring. Iman Atta dari Tell Mama, organisasi pemantau anti-Muslim di Inggris, berkata, 'Saya belum pernah melihat masyarakat kita sepolarisasi ini.' Polisi Jerman mengatakan jaringan Salafi (Islamis garis keras) muncul kembali, sementara influencer pro-Hamas semakin berpengaruh di media sosial. Setelah serangan Hamas, satu pendakwah Salafi mendapatkan 55.000 pengikut di TikTok dan mengunggah video yang menolak keberadaan Israel. Meski perhatian tertuju pada ancaman Islamis, data Europol menunjukkan hanya dua dari enam belas serangan teroris di Uni Eropa tahun lalu yang tergolong 'jihadis'; sisanya berasal dari kelompok kiri, anarkis, atau kanan. Thomas Renard, direktur International Centre for Counter-Terrorism, mengatakan ancaman kini 'lebih tersebar dan beragam,' dengan radikalisasi daring menjadi isu yang lebih besar dibanding dulu yang banyak terjadi di masjid.

Delhi and Japan’s Fukuoka Prefecture have renewed their 'Friendship Agreement' for another three years, extending the partnership until March 2026. This agreement supports collaboration in environment, culture, tourism, heritage, education, and youth exchanges.

A 35-person delegation from Fukuoka, led by Vice-Governor Akie Omagari, visited Delhi to commemorate the 15th anniversary of the cities’ relationship, first established in March 2007.

Chief Minister Arvind Kejriwal highlighted the enduring cultural and spiritual connections between Delhi and Fukuoka, pointing to the impact of Indian culture, particularly Buddhism, on Japanese society. He noted that in the last 15 years, cooperation in arts, archaeology, environment, and especially education has deepened, with Japanese language now taught in Delhi’s government schools and ongoing student exchanges.

Kejriwal affirmed Delhi’s commitment to implementing action plans that will benefit citizens of both cities.

Vice-Governor Omagari welcomed planned visits from Delhi’s Art and Culture teams in December and shared that 24 Fukuoka environmental specialists have participated in a joint international training program.

Perjanjian ini mencakup kolaborasi di bidang lingkungan, budaya, pariwisata, warisan, pendidikan, dan pertukaran pemuda.

Sebanyak 35 delegasi dari Fukuoka, yang dipimpin oleh Wakil Gubernur Akie Omagari, mengunjungi Delhi untuk merayakan 15 tahun hubungan kota kembar yang dimulai pada Maret 2007.

Kepala Menteri Arvind Kejriwal menyoroti hubungan budaya dan spiritual yang kuat antara Delhi dan Fukuoka, terutama pengaruh budaya India seperti Buddhisme terhadap masyarakat Jepang. Ia menjelaskan bahwa dalam 15 tahun terakhir, kerja sama di bidang seni, arkeologi, lingkungan, dan terutama pendidikan semakin erat. Saat ini, bahasa Jepang sudah diajarkan di sekolah pemerintah Delhi dan ada pertukaran pelajar yang terus berjalan.

Kejriwal juga menegaskan komitmen Delhi untuk melaksanakan rencana aksi bersama demi kesejahteraan warga kedua kota.

Wakil Gubernur Omagari menyambut baik rencana kunjungan tim Seni dan Budaya dari Delhi pada bulan Desember serta menyampaikan bahwa sudah ada 24 pakar lingkungan dari Fukuoka yang mengikuti program pelatihan internasional bersama.

article_content: Climate change impacts men and women differently, particularly in the Global South, largely due to patriarchal cultural norms. Women are frequently excluded from efforts and decision-making related to environmental issues, deepening gender inequality by restricting women to domestic roles. This lack of inclusion increases women’s vulnerability to climate-related events such as extreme weather, forest fires, and floods—where women and girls often bear a heavier burden and face higher rates of violence. Rather than viewing women solely as victims of the climate crisis, it is important to recognize their significant capacities and agency in environmental protection. Across the Global South, women have played a vital role in both individual and collective environmental initiatives. The Chipko movement in India exemplifies such leadership. In 1974, Indigenous women from Reni village led collective action against deforestation by physically guarding and embracing trees to prevent logging. The success of their movement gained international attention, influencing environmental activism worldwide. At the 1985 Nairobi Conference on Women from the Global South, participants highlighted the importance of nature conservation and shared testimonies from Chipko and allied movements. Recent examples include women in Zapotalito, a village in southern Mexico’s Chacahua-Pastoría national park, who combatted pollution and poor water quality by collectively cleaning local canals. Despite enduring environmental hazards and continuing their household responsibilities, these women demonstrated resilience and commitment to community well-being. In Bolivia, women from Chiquiacá have protected the Tariquía Flora and Fauna National Reserve from oil and gas expansion since 2017. In 2019, their efforts included a five-month blockade to stop drilling, evolving from a local protest into a movement backed by thousands across Bolivia. Indonesian fisherwomen in Central Java have also shown leadership in navigating climate risks since 2020. With rising sea levels threatening their communities, they have engaged with policymakers, raised awareness, and led fundraising for flood adaptation, all while enduring threats and intimidation for their activism. The global appreciation of women’s environmental roles has increased since the 1990s, as reflected in international frameworks such as the 1992 Rio Declaration, 1995 Beijing Platform for Action, and the 2004 UN Convention to Combat Desertification. These policies acknowledge women’s essential contributions to conservation—yet not all countries have adopted or implemented such measures. To address the disproportionate impacts of climate change, both governments and the public must support and document women’s environmental activism. Moving beyond stereotypes and victim narratives is essential for truly inclusive, effective environmental solutions.
translated_content: Perubahan iklim berdampak berbeda pada laki-laki dan perempuan, terutama di negara-negara Global South, sebagian besar karena norma budaya patriarki. Perempuan seringkali dikesampingkan dari upaya dan pengambilan keputusan tentang isu lingkungan, sehingga memperdalam ketimpangan gender dan membatasi perempuan pada peran domestik. Kurangnya keterlibatan ini membuat perempuan jadi lebih rentan terhadap kejadian iklim seperti cuaca ekstrem, kebakaran hutan, dan banjir—di mana perempuan dan anak perempuan kerap menanggung beban lebih berat dan menghadapi tingkat kekerasan yang lebih tinggi. Alih-alih memandang perempuan sekadar sebagai korban krisis iklim, penting untuk mengakui kapasitas dan peran besar mereka dalam perlindungan lingkungan. Di seluruh Global South, perempuan memegang peranan vital dalam inisiatif lingkungan, baik secara individu maupun kolektif. Gerakan Chipko di India menjadi contoh nyata kepemimpinan perempuan. Pada 1974, perempuan adat dari desa Reni memimpin aksi kolektif melawan penggundulan hutan dengan menjaga dan memeluk pohon-pohon demi mencegah penebangan. Keberhasilan gerakan ini mendapat perhatian internasional dan memengaruhi gerakan lingkungan di seluruh dunia. Dalam Konferensi Nairobi 1985 tentang Perempuan dari Global South, peserta menekankan pentingnya pelestarian alam serta membagikan kisah dari Chipko dan pergerakan perempuan lainnya. Contoh terkini ada di Zapotalito, sebuah desa di taman nasional Chacahua-Pastoría, Meksiko selatan; para perempuan bersama-sama membersihkan kanal lokal dalam upaya melawan polusi dan penurunan kualitas air. Meski menghadapi bahaya lingkungan dan tetap menjalankan tugas rumah, mereka menunjukkan ketangguhan dan komitmen terhadap kesejahteraan komunitas. Di Bolivia, perempuan Chiquiacá telah melindungi Cagar Alam Nasional Tariquía Flora dan Fauna dari ekspansi perusahaan minyak dan gas sejak 2017. Pada 2019, mereka memblokade akses selama lima bulan untuk menghentikan pengeboran—aksi ini berkembang dari protes lokal menjadi gerakan besar yang didukung ribuan orang Bolivia. Perempuan nelayan di Jawa Tengah, Indonesia, juga membuktikan kepemimpinan dalam menghadapi risiko iklim sejak 2020. Dengan naiknya permukaan laut yang mengancam kampung halaman, mereka berdialog dengan pembuat kebijakan, meningkatkan kesadaran, dan menggalang dana untuk antisipasi banjir, walau harus menghadapi ancaman dan intimidasi akibat aktivisme mereka. Pengakuan global terhadap peran lingkungan perempuan naik sejak 1990-an, tercermin dalam berbagai kerangka internasional seperti Deklarasi Rio 1992, Beijing Platform for Action 1995, serta Konvensi PBB untuk Memerangi Penggurunan 2004. Kebijakan ini mengakui peran krusial perempuan dalam konservasi—meski belum semua negara mengadopsinya. Untuk mengatasi dampak tidak proporsional dari perubahan iklim, baik pemerintah maupun masyarakat wajib mendukung dan mendokumentasikan aktivisme lingkungan perempuan. Menghindari stereotip dan narasi korban itu penting untuk menghadirkan solusi lingkungan yang lebih inklusif dan efektif.

article_content: Three people have been taken into custody on suspicion of manslaughter following the death of 18-year-old Leah Casson in a house fire in North Shields earlier this year. The fire broke out at a home on Vicarage Street in the early hours of January 16, resulting in Leah's death and forcing the evacuation of multiple neighboring houses. Three others managed to escape the blaze but suffered serious injuries. Northumbria Police have arrested a woman in her 40s and two men between the ages of 35 and 40; all have since been released on bail. Police investigations are ongoing, and no one has been formally charged yet. Leah's parents described her as an outgoing and bubbly young woman who was "loved so much."

Tiga orang lain berhasil lolos dari kobaran api tetapi mengalami luka serius. Polisi Northumbria telah menangkap seorang wanita berusia 40-an dan dua pria berusia antara 35 hingga 40 tahun; semua telah dibebaskan dengan jaminan. Penyelidikan polisi masih berlangsung dan belum ada yang didakwa secara resmi. Orang tua Leah menyebutnya sebagai sosok yang supel, ceria, dan sangat dicintai.

article_content: Police officer numbers in England and Wales have fallen by more than 6,000 in a year, bringing police strength to its lowest point in a decade, according to recent figures. These cuts have sparked concerns about the safety of communities and the effectiveness of front-line policing. Tony Melville, Chief Constable of Gloucestershire Police, warned that further cuts could put his force at a 'cliff edge,' making it difficult to maintain current service levels. Gloucestershire is facing potential local funding reductions on top of Home Office budget cuts, and Melville noted it would only be possible to deliver good service if deeper cuts are avoided. Government ministers, however, argue that forces can reduce overall numbers by cutting backroom roles, increasing efficiency, and protecting front-line officers. They point out there are about 25,000 officers in administrative or non-operational positions. To save money, the government plans to implement a national police air service, replacing individual force helicopters with a unified system. According to Policing Minister Nick Herbert, this change will cut the number of air bases and helicopters by about a third, saving £15 million annually without reducing response rates. Alex Marshall, Chief Constable of Hampshire Police, who will lead the new unit, asserts that coverage and response times will remain effective. However, some police leaders, such as Meredydd Hughes, former chief constable of South Yorkshire Police, argue that densely populated cities like Sheffield may suffer from the changes. The Home Office grant for police forces in England and Wales is set to fall by 20% by 2015. Current figures show there are now 136,261 officers in England and Wales, a decrease of 6,012, or 4%, from the previous year. Losses are especially significant in London, Manchester, and the West Midlands, though Surrey Police increased officer numbers by nearly 100. Additionally, the number of community support officers dropped by 907, while volunteer special constables rose by 2,594. Her Majesty’s Inspectorate of Constabulary suggests that up to 8,000 more officers could be lost in the coming years. Shadow Home Secretary Yvette Cooper criticized the cuts, highlighting an 11% rise in personal crime, including theft and violence – the biggest increase in a decade. Paul McKeever, chairman of the Police Federation, questioned how police can maintain service standards with thousands fewer officers.

Pemangkasan ini memicu kekhawatiran tentang keamanan masyarakat dan efektivitas polisi garis depan. Tony Melville, Kepala Polisi Gloucestershire, memperingatkan bahwa pemotongan lebih lanjut dapat membuat institusinya berada di 'tepi jurang', sehingga sulit mempertahankan layanan yang ada. Gloucestershire menghadapi kemungkinan pengurangan dana lokal di atas pemotongan anggaran Home Office, dan Melville menyatakan layanan berkualitas hanya dapat diberikan jika pemotongan lebih dalam dapat dihindari. article_content:
American police veteran William Bratton is set to join a UK government taskforce as an adviser on gang issues and has indicated his willingness to become a British citizen if required to lead the Metropolitan Police. Bratton, known for reducing crime in New York and Los Angeles, believes that an outsider can rejuvenate the Met. He told The Guardian: "I've been an outsider in every department I've worked in. Bureaucrats change processes, leaders change culture." He describes himself as a transformational leader adept at driving organizational change.

Bratton's appointment comes amid heated debate over whether tough American policing strategies like 'zero tolerance' are applicable in the UK. Prime Minister David Cameron has expressed support for stricter tactics in response to recent riots, emphasizing the need for a firm approach to street crime. However, figures such as Sir Hugh Orde, president of the Association of Chief Police Officers, and Chief Constable Chris Sims doubt that US-style tactics can work within the UK's legal and societal context, particularly due to European human rights laws.

Boris Johnson, the Mayor of London, supports Bratton’s approach but notes that success in New York was partly due to a significant increase in police numbers. The debate continues over whether increasing street-level police presence is essential or if alternative tactics should be prioritized, especially in light of proposed budget cuts. Some Conservative MPs, including Mark Pritchard and Dominic Raab, criticized senior police leaders for dismissing lessons from US experience, maintaining that robust, visible policing is in line with public expectations.

The Home Affairs Select Committee has launched an inquiry into the UK riots, with key figures—including Bratton—expected to provide evidence on policing response and coordination.

Bratton, yang dikenal karena keberhasilannya menurunkan tingkat kejahatan di New York dan Los Angeles, percaya bahwa sosok luar bisa membangkitkan Met. Perdana Menteri David Cameron menyatakan dukungannya pada pendekatan yang lebih tegas sebagai respons atas kerusuhan baru-baru ini, menekankan perlunya penanganan keras terhadap kejahatan jalanan. Namun, tokoh seperti Sir Hugh Orde, Presiden Asosiasi Pejabat Polisi Senior, dan Kepala Polisi Chris Sims meragukan efektivitas taktik Amerika di konteks hukum dan budaya Inggris, terutama karena hukum hak asasi manusia Eropa.

article_content:
President Obama recently attended two high-profile fundraising events in Grand Rapids, Michigan. At an event hosted by Ricky Martin, around 200 attendees each paid at least $5,000 for a ticket. Another fundraiser at a private residence saw 60 people pay $38,500 apiece for entry. Just last week, Obama, alongside George Clooney, raised $15 million in a single evening.

This raises questions about the scale of money required for political campaigns today. Despite discussions about national economic hardship, by the end of March, Obama and his likely general election opponent, Mitt Romney, had jointly raised nearly $300 million—almost matching the annual budget of Planned Parenthood. The fundraising minimum for a recent Romney event was reportedly $75,000, well beyond the median U.S. income of $50,000. The Republican National Committee aims to collect $800 million by November.

The author questions how such substantial sums influence the political process. Both Obama and Romney rely on affluent supporters, many of whom expect returns for their contributions. The Supreme Court's Citizens United decision in 2010, which allows unlimited corporate and union spending on behalf of candidates, is heavily criticized. According to the commentary, this enables major donors not only to shape political debates but also policies, making public interest secondary to financial interests.

Calls for reform include limiting the amount candidates can raise and spend, requiring that all campaign advertisements and debates be shown on public television, and capping airtime during elections. These measures, the author argues, would reduce the role of large donors and promote a fairer democratic process.

President Obama recently tweeted a quote from his Barnard College commencement address, encouraging people to get involved in politics. The author points out, however, that high fundraising ticket prices effectively exclude ordinary Americans from the process. This issue is particularly notable given the then-current 8.1% U.S. unemployment rate, while political leaders continue to court wealthy donors through exclusive fundraising events.

The opinions presented are those of commentator LZ Granderson.

Minggu lalu, Obama bersama George Clooney berhasil mengumpulkan $15 juta dalam satu malam.

Situasi ini memunculkan pertanyaan tentang besarnya dana yang dibutuhkan untuk kampanye politik saat ini. Meski ekonomi Amerika sedang sulit, hingga akhir Maret, Obama dan lawan utamanya, Mitt Romney, telah mengumpulkan hampir $300 juta—hampir menyamai anggaran tahunan Planned Parenthood. Syarat donasi minimum untuk acara Romney baru-baru ini bahkan kabarnya $75.000, jauh di atas pendapatan rata-rata rumah tangga AS sebesar $50.000. Komite Nasional Partai Republik (RNC) menargetkan dana $800 juta sampai November.

Penulis mempertanyakan pengaruh jumlah dana yang begitu besar terhadap proses politik. Baik Obama maupun Romney mengandalkan donatur kaya, yang seringkali mengharapkan imbal balik. Keputusan Citizens United oleh Mahkamah Agung AS tahun 2010, yang memungkinkan perusahaan dan serikat buruh mengeluarkan dana tak terbatas untuk mendukung calon, sangat dikritik. Dalam komentar ini, hal itu membuat para donatur besar bukan hanya membentuk wacana politik, tapi juga kebijakan, sehingga kepentingan publik tersisih oleh kekuatan modal.

Usulan perbaikan meliputi pembatasan dana yang dikumpulkan dan dibelanjakan calon, mewajibkan semua iklan serta debat kampanye ditayangkan di TV publik, dan membatasi waktu tayang selama pemilu. Langkah-langkah ini dipercaya dapat mengurangi peran donatur besar dan menciptakan demokrasi yang lebih adil.

Baru-baru ini, Obama men-tweet kutipan dari pidato wisuda di Barnard College agar orang ikut terlibat dalam politik. Namun, penulis menyoroti harga tiket penggalangan dana yang tinggi justru membuat masyarakat biasa tidak terjangkau. Hal ini semakin terasa ironis dengan tingkat pengangguran AS saat itu sebesar 8,1%, sementara para pemimpin politik tetap menggelar acara mewah untuk kalangan kaya.

Opini yang disampaikan adalah milik komentator LZ Granderson.

article_content: UK tax authorities report that £34 billion in taxes went uncollected in the 2012-13 financial year, amounting to 6.8% of what was owed. This 'tax gap' is largely due to tax evasion, avoidance, mistakes, and criminal acts. A significant portion of these unpaid taxes stems from income tax, National Insurance, and Capital Gains Tax. HM Revenue and Customs (HMRC) data indicate that one out of every fifteen pounds of tax was missed last year—an increase from the previous year's figures. Despite a previous downward trend in the gap, the 2012-13 numbers show both the percentage and total unpaid taxes are up. Margaret Hodge, chair of the Public Accounts Committee, has strongly criticized the government for not adequately addressing the growing problem. She warns that diligent taxpayers are shouldering a greater burden, and suggests that recovering this revenue could support essential public services like the NHS, which faces its own funding challenges. The increase in the tax gap reflects rising shortfalls in VAT and tobacco duty collections, while tax avoidance now represents £3.1 billion of the gap, a slight decrease from the year before. HMRC maintains the long-term trend has improved, reducing the tax gap from 8.5% in 2005-06, and notes that UK's tax gap remains among the world's lowest. David Gauke, Financial Secretary to the Treasury, points out that since 2010-11 the percentage tax gap has stayed below previous levels, saving billions. However, opposition parties and unions argue that government action has been insufficient, particularly in light of HMRC staff cuts and office closures. Labour’s Shabana Mahmood has condemned the government’s track record, noting an increase of £3 billion in uncollected taxes during George Osborne’s tenure as Chancellor. She attributes some of the gap to low wage growth and declining tax receipts, emphasizing the need for stricter enforcement so everyone contributes fairly, especially as public services like the NHS are strained. The Office for Budget Responsibility (OBR) has further observed that the UK’s deficit for 2013-14 was £48 billion higher than anticipated, caused mainly by lower-than-expected wage growth and increases in tax-free allowances, which led to falling income tax and National Insurance contributions. Tax experts and trade unions argue that HMRC staff reductions hinder effective tax collection and place more burden on regular taxpayers, while many complex business tax avoidance schemes remain unchallenged.

'Tax gap' ini terutama disebabkan oleh penggelapan, penghindaran pajak, kesalahan, dan tindakan kriminal. Porsi terbesar dari pajak yang belum dibayar berasal dari pajak penghasilan, Asuransi Nasional, dan Pajak Capital Gains. Data HM Revenue and Customs (HMRC) menunjukkan satu dari setiap lima belas pound pajak terlewatkan tahun lalu—meningkat dibandingkan tahun sebelumnya. Meski sempat menurun, pada 2012-13 persentase dan total pajak tak tertagih naik. Margaret Hodge, ketua Public Accounts Committee, mengkritik keras pemerintah karena dinilai belum mengatasi masalah yang semakin besar ini. Ia memperingatkan bahwa wajib pajak yang taat justru terdampak paling besar, dan menekankan pemulihan pajak ini dapat membantu layanan publik penting seperti NHS yang kekurangan dana. Kenaikan tax gap disebabkan kekurangan pada pemungutan VAT dan cukai tembakau, sementara penghindaran pajak menyumbang £3,1 miliar—sedikit menurun dari tahun sebelumnya. HMRC memastikan tren jangka panjang tetap membaik, tax gap turun dari 8,5% di 2005-06, dan tax gap Inggris salah satu yang terendah di dunia. David Gauke, Financial Secretary to the Treasury, menyatakan sejak 2010-11 persentase tax gap tetap di bawah level pemerintahan sebelumnya, dan mengklaim penghematan miliaran pound. Namun, oposisi dan serikat pekerja menilai upaya pemerintah tidak cukup, apalagi dengan pemangkasan staf dan penutupan kantor HMRC. Shabana Mahmood dari Partai Buruh mengecam kebijakan pemerintah, mencatat kenaikan £3 miliar pajak tak tertagih selama masa jabatan George Osborne sebagai Menteri Keuangan. Ia menyoroti stagnasi upah dan penurunan penerimaan pajak, serta perlunya penegakan hukum pajak lebih tegas agar semua pihak membayar pajak secara adil, terutama karena layanan publik seperti NHS tengah tertekan. Office for Budget Responsibility (OBR) melaporkan defisit Inggris 2013-14 sebesar £48 miliar lebih tinggi daripada perkiraan, terutama akibat pertumbuhan upah rendah dan peningkatan batas bebas pajak yang menyebabkan penurunan setoran pajak penghasilan dan Asuransi Nasional. Pakar pajak dan serikat pekerja menilai pemotongan staf HMRC justru menghambat penagihan pajak dan membebani wajib pajak biasa, sementara skema penghindaran pajak yang rumit oleh perusahaan-perusahaan besar sebagian besar belum tertangani.

article_content: Members of Parliament (MPs) have been informed that they can claim up to £3,750 in expenses if they wish to participate in today's Commons tributes to Baroness Thatcher. The Independent Parliamentary Standards Authority (Ipsa) emailed all 650 MPs explaining they could receive the sum to cover travel costs incurred returning from their Easter holidays. Some critics argue that the debate could have been scheduled for next week, when Parliament resumes after recess, rather than recalling MPs early at additional expense. It remains optional for MPs to cover their own costs to attend. To honor Baroness Thatcher, who passed away on Monday at age 87, the Union Flag was flown at half-mast over Portcullis House. Commons Speaker John Bercow announced Parliament would be recalled for MPs to pay tribute to the former Prime Minister. According to Ipsa regulations for emergency recalls, MPs can claim travel expenses from anywhere in the world. The allowance can extend to bringing family members back early from an overseas holiday or for returning and then resuming their holiday. Members of the House of Lords may claim their £300 daily attendance allowance for participating. An Ipsa spokesperson explained that some MPs could have been abroad at the time of the recall and said it was reasonable to reimburse the costs of returning to Westminster. 'If Parliament is recalled, MPs can claim the cost of getting to Parliament,' the spokesperson said. Opposition voices, such as Labour's John Healey and Ronnie Campbell, criticized the timing and motivation for the recall. Campbell, MP for Blyth Valley, stated on BBC Radio 4 that he would 'rather be put in the torture chamber' than attend the debate and questioned the need for the added expense. Similarly, John Healey announced he would boycott the session and wrote that the Commons could have marked Thatcher’s death when Parliament resumed. He accused the Prime Minister of using the event for political advantage. Defending the decision, Foreign Secretary William Hague told BBC Breakfast that it was right for Parliament to honor a leader of Thatcher's historical stature, citing major achievements such as her negotiation of the UK's EU rebate. He argued this put costs into perspective. Conservative MP Penny Mordaunt also defended the expense, saying on Sky News that arrangements for MPs to claim travel expenses during recalls are standard and not unfair. She confirmed she would not personally claim expenses for attending.

Otoritas Standar Parlemen Independen (Ipsa) telah mengirim email ke seluruh 650 MP yang menjelaskan bahwa mereka bisa menerima jumlah tersebut untuk menutupi biaya perjalanan pulang dari liburan Paskah mereka. Beberapa kritikus berpendapat bahwa debat ini seharusnya dijadwalkan minggu depan, ketika Parlemen kembali dari masa reses, dan tidak memanggil para MP lebih awal dengan biaya tambahan. Masih menjadi pilihan bagi MP untuk menanggung biaya kehadirannya sendiri. Untuk menghormati Baroness Thatcher yang wafat pada hari Senin di usia 87 tahun, Bendera Union dikibarkan setengah tiang di atas Portcullis House. Ketua Commons John Bercow mengumumkan bahwa Parlemen akan dipanggil kembali agar para MP bisa memberikan penghormatan kepada mantan Perdana Menteri tersebut. Menurut peraturan Ipsa untuk pemanggilan darurat, MP dapat mengklaim biaya perjalanan pulang dari mana pun di dunia. Tunjangan ini juga dapat digunakan untuk membawa anggota keluarga kembali lebih awal dari liburan luar negeri atau untuk pergi dan kembali ke liburan mereka. Anggota House of Lords juga dapat mengklaim tunjangan kehadiran harian sebesar £300 untuk ikut berpartisipasi. Juru bicara Ipsa menjelaskan bahwa beberapa MP mungkin berada di luar negeri ketika panggilan itu diumumkan dan menilai wajar jika biaya untuk kembali ke Westminster diganti. 'Jika Parlemen dipanggil kembali, MP bisa mengklaim biaya untuk datang ke Parlemen,' ujar juru bicara tersebut. Beberapa pihak oposisi seperti John Healey dan Ronnie Campbell dari Partai Buruh mengkritisi waktu dan motif pemanggilan kembali tersebut. Campbell, MP dari Blyth Valley, mengatakan di BBC Radio 4 bahwa dia 'lebih baik ditempatkan di ruang penyiksaan' daripada hadir dalam debat tersebut dan mempertanyakan perlunya pengeluaran tambahan. Hal serupa juga disampaikan oleh John Healey yang mengumumkan akan memboikot sesi penghormatan dan menulis bahwa Commons seharusnya bisa mengenang wafatnya Thatcher saat Parlemen kembali. Ia menuduh Perdana Menteri memanfaatkan momen tersebut untuk keuntungan politik. Membela keputusan ini, Menteri Luar Negeri William Hague mengatakan kepada BBC Breakfast bahwa sudah sepantasnya Parlemen menghormati pemimpin dengan peran sejarah besar seperti Thatcher, menyoroti prestasinya seperti negosiasi rebate Uni Eropa untuk Inggris. Ia menilai hal ini menempatkan biaya yang dikeluarkan dalam perspektif. Anggota parlemen Konservatif, Penny Mordaunt, juga membela pengeluaran tersebut. Ia mengatakan di Sky News bahwa pengaturan biaya perjalanan bagi MP selama pemanggilan ulang merupakan prosedur standar dan tidak tidak adil. Ia menegaskan dirinya tidak akan mengklaim biaya untuk hadir.
