article_content: Ecuadorian law prohibits polling firms from releasing poll data during the ten days leading up to Sunday’s presidential election. Despite this restriction, incumbent President Rafael Correa is widely expected to win re-election. Earlier this month, four major polling firms in Ecuador showed Correa holding a significant lead over his seven opponents. According to election rules, a candidate can avoid a runoff by securing at least 40% of the vote and leading the nearest rival by more than 10 percentage points. Correa is projected to meet both conditions. Internationally, Correa, a left-leaning president and U.S.-trained economist, is often likened to Venezuelan President Hugo Chavez. He has implemented his own ‘Citizens’ Revolution,’ which includes socialist-oriented economic policies similar to those in Venezuela. Correa’s administration has faced criticism from press freedom organizations due to its legal actions against media outlets critical of the president. Meanwhile, Ecuador continues to grant asylum to Julian Assange at its London embassy. Domestically, Correa remains a popular figure. A December survey by Perfiles de Opiniones reported his approval rating at nearly 85%. On Sunday, Ecuadorians will vote for their president and vice president, 137 members of the National Assembly, and five Andean Parliament representatives. Correa’s main challenger, Guillermo Lasso Mendoza, campaigned on a platform promising lower taxes and privatization of state media. He argued that the 42-day campaign period gives an unfair advantage to the incumbent. 'This campaign has not been equal, but we have worked hard to share our hopeful vision,' Lasso said at his campaign’s close. In his final rally, Correa warned against a return to what he described as corrupt leadership prioritizing personal gain over public interest. Ecuador, the smallest country in the Andes, is known for oil production and tourism. Since taking office in 2007, Correa has strengthened alliances with other Latin American countries seeking independence from U.S. influence. After winning under the new constitution in 2009, a re-election would extend Correa’s term to 2017. Before Correa, Ecuador experienced frequent leadership changes, with seven presidents between 1996 and 2006, while his administration has brought more stability. However, political analyst Hernan Reyes noted that further reforms are needed. 'We are in a transitional period,' Reyes said, pointing out that six years of Correa’s rule haven’t fully moved the country away from previous neoliberal policies. 'Correa has revitalized the economy through public investment and social projects, boosting employment rates. Unemployment and underemployment have declined.' World Bank data shows that poverty in Ecuador decreased from 36.1% in 2007 to 28.6% in 2011. School enrollment rates are higher than the Latin American average. The country’s oil-based GDP has grown by $20 billion since Correa took office. Nevertheless, some analysts caution about increased concentration of executive power. 'Despite economic and social achievements, institutions have weakened, and the executive controls most sectors,' said political analyst Ana Maria Correa. This report includes contributions from Andres Lopez in Quito and CNN’s Mariano Castillo in Atlanta.

article_content: A new vaccine developed by Swedish scientists may significantly reduce cases of Alzheimer’s disease. The vaccine, named CAD106, could delay the onset of this debilitating illness and marks an important step toward a cure. Alzheimer’s disease, the most common form of dementia, damages nerve cells and neurotransmitters in the brain. CAD106 helps patients create protective antibodies that target the deposits linked with the disease. Scientists from the Karolinska Institute and the Swedish Brain Power Network reported in The Lancet Neurology that their discovery may benefit people with mild to moderate Alzheimer’s. No serious side effects were reported during three years of clinical trials involving participants aged 50 to 80. According to the Alzheimer’s Society, one in 14 people over the age of 65 has Alzheimer’s, with the risk increasing to one in six for people over 80. Researchers hope CAD106 can delay the disease’s onset by five years. Author and advocate Terry Pratchett, who had Alzheimer’s, helped raise awareness through documentaries. The World Health Organization calls dementia the fastest-growing global health epidemic. In the UK, about 820,000 people have dementia, with more than half affected by Alzheimer’s. This figure is expected to reach one million within ten years. A study in PLoS Genetics suggests that a combination of many minor genetic changes, rather than single large mutations, contributes to Alzheimer’s and other neurodegenerative conditions. Dr. Nilufer Ertekin-Taner from the Mayo Clinic stated that finding such genes could aid the development of new treatments. Dr. Simon Ridley, Head of Research at Alzheimer’s Research UK, stressed the urgent need for new treatments and more clinical trials. He noted that only large, long-term studies will determine if CAD106 can improve symptoms or reduce amyloid, which accumulates before symptoms appear. In the clinical trials, 74% of participants developed higher antibody levels after vaccination, indicating a triggered immune response. Researchers described CAD106 as a promising option for people with mild-to-moderate Alzheimer’s. Commenting in The Lancet Neurology, Dr. Thomas Wisniewski of NYU School of Medicine wrote that immunotherapy delaying Alzheimer’s onset by five years could halve prevalence. He noted that this vaccine shows promise as part of a longer journey toward effective treatment.

Ilmuwan dari Karolinska Institute dan Swedish Brain Power Network melaporkan di The Lancet Neurology bahwa temuan mereka bisa bermanfaat bagi penderita Alzheimer ringan hingga sedang. Tidak ada efek samping serius yang ditemukan selama tiga tahun uji klinis pada peserta berusia 50 hingga 80 tahun. Menurut Alzheimer’s Society, satu dari 14 orang di atas usia 65 tahun menderita Alzheimer, dan risikonya meningkat menjadi satu dari enam pada usia di atas 80 tahun. Sebuah studi di PLoS Genetics menunjukkan bahwa kombinasi banyak perubahan gen kecil, bukan hanya satu mutasi besar, dapat berperan dalam Alzheimer dan kondisi neurodegeneratif lainnya. Dr. Nilufer Ertekin-Taner dari Mayo Clinic menyatakan bahwa identifikasi gen seperti itu bisa membantu pengembangan terapi baru. Dr. Simon Ridley, Kepala Riset di Alzheimer’s Research UK, menekankan kebutuhan mendesak akan pengobatan baru dan uji klinis lebih lanjut. Dalam uji klinis, 74% peserta mengalami peningkatan kadar antibodi setelah menerima vaksin, menandakan respons imun. Peneliti menyebut CAD106 sebagai opsi yang menjanjikan bagi penderita Alzheimer tahap ringan hingga sedang. Dalam komentarnya di The Lancet Neurology, Dr. Thomas Wisniewski dari NYU School of Medicine menulis bahwa imunoterapi yang bisa menunda Alzheimer selama lima tahun dapat mengurangi prevalensi penyakit ini hingga setengahnya. Ia menyebut vaksin ini sebagai harapan baru dalam perjalanan menuju pengobatan yang efektif.

article_content:
A new list celebrates the best of British design, featuring London's iconic Tube map and the E-type Jaguar among the nation's most distinctive exports. Also included are the Royal Mail First Class stamp and the God Save the Queen album cover. The list, compiled by Reader's Digest, spotlights both classic and unconventional entries, such as the Big Brother logo—originally designed to symbolize the 'all-seeing eye' from George Orwell's '1984', and popularized by Channel 4 in 2002.

The Tube map, designed in 1931 by Harry Beck, is praised for its lasting influence and innovative disregard for geographic distance between stations—a departure from earlier, less legible versions. The E-type Jaguar, masterminded by Malcolm Sayer in 1961, is hailed as another British design triumph. Other notable mentions include a 1941 Auxiliary Territorial Service (ATS) recruitment poster by Abram Games, which was withdrawn after being criticized for its portrayal of a 'blonde bombshell.'

The Queen features twice: once on the God Save the Queen Sex Pistols album cover (designed by Jamie Reid in 1977), and on the refined profile used for the Royal Mail's First Class Stamp (designed by Arnold Machin in 1967). Other entries encompass Kodak's 1968 Instamatic camera by Kenneth Grange, the 1998 iMac computer by Jonathan 'Jony' Ive, and Daniel Eatock's Big Brother 'eye' logo—described as a memorable, symbolic image echoing Orwellian themes, but with a gaze turned back at viewers.

The list highlights the continuing global influence and bold creativity of British design, honoring both its legacy and its capacity to provoke thought and debate.

Daftar yang disusun oleh Reader's Digest ini menyoroti entri klasik sekaligus tidak biasa, seperti logo Big Brother—yang awalnya dirancang untuk melambangkan 'mata yang selalu mengawasi' dari novel '1984' karya George Orwell, dan dipopulerkan oleh Channel 4 pada tahun 2002.

Peta Tube rancangan Harry Beck pada 1931 dipuji atas pengaruhnya yang abadi dan terobosannya dalam mengabaikan jarak geografis antar stasiun—berbeda dengan versi sebelumnya yang kurang mudah dibaca. Jaguar E-type, karya Malcolm Sayer tahun 1961, juga dipandang sebagai pencapaian desain Inggris lainnya. Daftar penting lainnya mencakup poster rekrutmen Auxiliary Territorial Service (ATS) tahun 1941 buatan Abram Games, yang ditarik dari peredaran setelah menuai kritik karena penggambaran sosok 'blonde bombshell.'

Gambar Ratu Inggris muncul dua kali: pada sampul album God Save the Queen oleh Sex Pistols (dirancang Jamie Reid tahun 1977) dan pada profil elegan perangko Royal Mail First Class (dirancang Arnold Machin tahun 1967). Daftar lainnya termasuk kamera Instamatic Kodak 1968 karya Kenneth Grange, komputer iMac 1998 rancangan Jonathan 'Jony' Ive, serta logo 'mata' Big Brother milik Daniel Eatock—digambarkan sebagai simbolik yang mengesankan, bergaung dengan tema Orwellian namun kini menatap kembali ke pemirsa.

Daftar ini menyoroti pengaruh global yang terus menerus serta kreativitas berani dari dunia desain Inggris, menghormati warisannya sekaligus kemampuannya untuk memancing pemikiran dan perdebatan.

article_content: Fakhar Zaman delivered a spectacular performance for Pakistan, remaining unbeaten with a powerful century as they secured a 21-run win (DLS method) against New Zealand during a rain-affected World Cup clash in Bengaluru. Captain Babar Azam provided crucial support by hitting a half-century. New Zealand, led by Rachin Ravindra's 108 and a strong 95 from returning skipper Kane Williamson, had set a daunting total of 401-6. When rain halted play with Pakistan on 160/1, Zaman had already built significant momentum. After a long delay, the revised target was set at 342 from 41 overs. Zaman reached 126* and Babar stood at 66 when more rain caused the match to end, and Pakistan was declared the winner by being 21 runs ahead of the DLS par score. This win revives Pakistan's semi-final hopes while New Zealand faces a fourth straight loss, allowing South Africa to join India in the semi-finals. Pakistan, New Zealand, and Afghanistan now all have eight points, keeping the race for the remaining semi-final spots, including Australia, tight. Initially chasing a huge 402, Zaman played aggressively, even after a 90-minute rain break. He smashed 11 sixes and 8 boundaries in his explosive 126* from 81 balls. Alongside Babar Azam, the pair shared an undefeated 194-run stand after Abdullah Shafique fell early. Zaman hammered boundaries at will, reaching his ODI hundred—his first ever in a World Cup—with a six and a single off Santner. Pakistan must win their final group game against England and hope New Zealand loses to Sri Lanka or is thwarted by rain. Earlier, New Zealand’s innings was propelled by Ravindra’s 94-ball 108 (his third tournament century) and Williamson’s brisk 95. Their partnership added 180 for the second wicket. Williamson, back from injury, showed no signs of rust before falling at 248. Ravindra soon followed, caught at the boundary. New Zealand’s middle order—Mitchell, Chapman, Phillips, and Santner—kept the runs coming. Mohammad Wasim was the standout among Pakistan’s bowlers with three wickets, but Afridi and Rauf conceded their most runs ever in a World Cup match by a Pakistan bowler. Despite an almighty effort from both sides and rain interruptions, Zaman’s fireworks proved decisive in keeping Pakistan’s World Cup hopes alive.

Kapten Babar Azam juga memberikan kontribusi penting lewat setengah centurynya. Selandia Baru yang dipimpin oleh Rachin Ravindra (108) dan kapten kembali Kane Williamson (95), mencetak total besar 401-6. Ketika hujan menghentikan pertandingan dan skor Pakistan 160/1, Zaman sudah membangun momentum. Setelah jeda panjang, target direvisi menjadi 342 dari 41 over. Kemenangan ini menjaga peluang Pakistan ke semifinal, sementara Selandia Baru mencatat kekalahan keempat berturut-turut sehingga Afrika Selatan menyusul India ke semifinal. Pakistan, Selandia Baru, dan Afghanistan kini sama-sama mengantongi delapan poin, membuat persaingan merebut tiket semifinal semakin ketat bersama Australia. Mengejar target besar 402 run, Zaman bermain agresif bahkan setelah jeda hujan 90 menit. Dia menghantam 11 enam dan 8 empat dalam 126* dari 81 bola yang spektakuler. Bersama Babar Azam, keduanya menjalin kemitraan tak terputus 194 run setelah Abdullah Shafique keluar lebih dulu. Zaman memborbardir batas lapangan, mencapai ratusan ODI—pertama di Piala Dunia—dengan satu kali enam dan satu run dari Santner. Pakistan harus menang di laga terakhir melawan Inggris dan berharap Selandia Baru kalah dari Sri Lanka atau hujan mengganggu pertandingan. Sebelumnya, inning Selandia Baru didongkrak Ravindra (108 dari 94 bola - century ketiganya di turnamen) dan Williamson (95) yang membangun kemitraan 180 run wicket kedua. Williamson yang baru pulih dari cedera menunjukkan performa prima sebelum keluar di angka 248. Ravindra menyusul, tertangkap di boundary. Lini tengah Selandia Baru—Mitchell, Chapman, Phillips, dan Santner—terus menghasilkan run. Mohammad Wasim menjadi bowler terbaik Pakistan dengan tiga wicket, sementara Afridi dan Rauf membukukan rekor kebobolan run terbanyak sepanjang sejarah Pakistan di Piala Dunia. Di tengah usaha luar biasa kedua tim dan gangguan hujan, aksi gemilang Zaman terbukti menentukan dalam menjaga asa Pakistan di Piala Dunia.

article_content: Katie Walsh, a leading contender in the upcoming Grand National at Aintree, has spoken out in defense of the event amidst ongoing criticism regarding horse welfare. Preparing to ride Seabass, Walsh stated that racehorses often receive better care than some children. Her remarks come after two horses, including favorite Synchronised, died in last year’s race, which prompted organizers to make safety improvements such as redesigning fences with softer materials and relocating the starting line further from the grandstand. Walsh, whose brother Ruby will ride favorite On His Own, emphasized that while horse deaths are tragic, the dangers of the sport are also faced by jockeys, noting Irish rider JT McNamara’s paralysis following a fall at Cheltenham Festival. 'These horses are extremely well cared for—honestly, some better than kids,' she said, explaining that criticism often overlooks the dedication shown to the animals. This perspective was challenged by Claude Knights, director of the child welfare charity Kidscape, who argued that although animal welfare is important, society has an even greater duty to safeguard children. He said that drawing comparisons between the two does little to help either cause. Aintree has responded to welfare concerns by replacing solid wood fence cores with plastic or birch for added safety, and adjusting the parade and starting procedures to minimize stress for horses. Authorities are also stepping up security, anticipating protests from groups like Animal Aid and Fight Against Animal Cruelty in Europe. Despite the controversy, Walsh remains hopeful for a safe race this year.
translated_content: Katie Walsh, salah satu kandidat teratas di Grand National mendatang di Aintree, mengungkapkan pembelaan terhadap perlombaan ini di tengah kritik terkait kesejahteraan kuda. Bersiap menunggangi Seabass, Walsh mengatakan bahwa kuda pacu sering mendapatkan perawatan lebih baik daripada sebagian anak-anak. Pernyataan ini muncul setelah dua ekor kuda, termasuk favorit Synchronised, meninggal di perlombaan tahun lalu, sehingga panitia menerapkan sejumlah perbaikan keselamatan seperti mengganti pagar dengan bahan lebih lembut dan memindahkan titik awal perlombaan agar lebih jauh dari tribun penonton. Walsh, yang saudaranya Ruby akan menunggangi favorit On His Own, menekankan bahwa meski kematian kuda menyedihkan, risiko juga dihadapi para joki; ia menyoroti kasus JT McNamara asal Irlandia yang lumpuh setelah terjatuh di Cheltenham Festival. 'Kuda-kuda ini benar-benar dirawat dengan baik—bahkan lebih baik daripada anak-anak,' jelasnya, sambil mengungkapkan bahwa kritik sering melupakan dedikasi untuk merawat hewan-hewan ini. Pendapat Walsh ini ditanggapi oleh Claude Knights, direktur lembaga perlindungan anak Kidscape, yang menegaskan bahwa walaupun kesejahteraan hewan penting, masyarakat memiliki tanggung jawab yang lebih besar kepada anak-anak. Ia mengatakan bahwa membandingkan dua hal tersebut tidak membantu kedua isu itu. Sebagai upaya meningkatkan keselamatan kuda, Aintree telah mengganti inti pagar kayu solid dengan plastik atau birch dan mengubah prosedur parade serta start lomba demi mengurangi stres pada kuda. Pihak keamanan juga meningkatkan pengawasan karena diperkirakan akan ada aksi protes dari kelompok seperti Animal Aid dan Fight Against Animal Cruelty in Europe. Meski dipenuhi kontroversi, Walsh tetap optimis dan berharap perlombaan tahun ini berjalan dengan selamat.

article_content: Upon arriving in Ciudad Juarez, just across the border from El Paso, Texas, a group of mostly Venezuelan refugees and migrants eagerly jumped off the top of a freight train and threw their belongings to the ground, grateful to finally be on solid terrain. The freight train, commonly called La Bestia (The Beast), carried more than 1,000 people riding on its roof during a 10-day journey across Mexico to the United States border. The trip was far from easy. The migrants spent days and nights balancing on the moving train, while also trying to avoid Mexican migration authorities who sought to remove them, according to Daiverson Munoz, a 20-year-old from Venezuela. "We found ourselves stranded in the middle of the desert. But it's nothing compared to finally being here. We feel incredibly happy because we're close to realizing our dream. It has been tough but not impossible," said Munoz, who is a law student in Venezuela. He added, "The hardest part was seeing so many people injured on the way." Jeffri Gomez, a 24-year-old Venezuelan woman traveling with her husband and their one-year-old child, felt relieved to have completed the dangerous journey. The train started about 1,800 km (1,120 miles) south in the State of Mexico, and many riders were injured along the way. The final stretch of 370 km (230 miles) took 17 hours due to many stops, Munoz reported. Thousands of migrants risk the journey as buying regular passenger tickets is nearly impossible. Mexico's primary rail operator cut service by 30 percent in mid-September as the government ramped up security to stop unauthorized riders. When the travelers arrived, they immediately encountered an officer from the Mexican National Institute of Migration and saw a barbed-wire fence erected by the Texas National Guard by the banks of the Rio Bravo, which forms the natural border with the US. Source: Al Jazeera English
translated_content: Setibanya di Ciudad Juarez, tepat di seberang perbatasan dari El Paso, Texas, sekelompok pengungsi dan migran yang sebagian besar berasal dari Venezuela dengan antusias melompat dari atap kereta barang dan melemparkan barang-barang mereka ke tanah, bersyukur akhirnya bisa menginjakkan kaki di tanah yang kokoh. Kereta barang yang biasa disebut La Bestia (Si Binatang Buas) ini mengangkut lebih dari 1.000 orang yang menumpang di atasnya dalam perjalanan 10 hari melintasi Meksiko menuju perbatasan Amerika Serikat. Perjalanannya sangat sulit. Para migran harus menghabiskan hari dan malam berusaha menyeimbangkan diri di atas kereta yang bergerak, sambil menghindari petugas imigrasi Meksiko yang berusaha menurunkan mereka, menurut Daiverson Munoz, seorang pria Venezuela berusia 20 tahun. "Kami sempat terdampar di tengah gurun. Tapi semua itu tidak sebanding dengan kebahagiaan akhirnya bisa sampai di sini. Kami sangat senang karena akhirnya hampir mewujudkan mimpi kami. Memang berat, tapi bukan tidak mungkin," ujar Munoz, mahasiswa hukum di Venezuela. Dia menambahkan, "Bagian tersulit adalah melihat begitu banyak orang cedera di perjalanan." Jeffri Gomez, seorang perempuan Venezuela berusia 24 tahun yang bepergian bersama suami dan anak mereka yang berusia satu tahun, merasa lega akhirnya bisa menyelesaikan perjalanan berbahaya itu. Kereta tersebut memulai perjalanannya sekitar 1.800 km (1.120 mil) di sebelah selatan di Negara Bagian Meksiko, dan banyak penumpang yang terluka selama perjalanan. Bagian akhir sejauh 370 km (230 mil) memakan waktu 17 jam karena banyak berhenti, lapor Munoz. Ribuan migran mempertaruhkan perjalanan ini karena membeli tiket penumpang biasa hampir mustahil. Operator kereta api utama Meksiko memangkas layanan sebesar 30 persen pada pertengahan September saat pemerintah memperketat pengamanan untuk menghentikan penumpang yang tidak sah. Setibanya di sana, para pelancong langsung menemui petugas dari Institut Nasional Migrasi Meksiko dan melihat pagar kawat berduri yang dipasang oleh Garda Nasional Texas di tepi Sungai Rio Bravo yang menjadi perbatasan alami dengan AS. Sumber: Al Jazeera English

article_content: Google Wallet is introducing a useful new feature for users who want to digitize their passes and save space. Some users, particularly those with the Pixel 8 Pro, are seeing the option to add a pass by taking a photo of a barcode or QR code. This new ‘Photo’ feature in the ‘Add to Wallet’ menu makes it easy to digitize items like transit tickets, parking passes, e-commerce returns, as well as gym and library cards. Google previously teased this function in June, and it debuted as part of the September 2023 Android updates. The company notes it’s especially helpful for any passes or tickets that use barcodes or QR codes. In addition, Google Wallet can digitize state IDs and similar types of credentials. Other smaller updates include a toggle to disable success animations—these light-hearted animations play after purchases and change with the seasons. There’s also a redesign in the app interface on the Pixel 8, Pixel 8 Pro, and Pixel Fold. The new layout displays users’ cards prominently at the top, with saved passes shown directly below to make finding them quicker. Since the photo-based pass feature is only just starting to roll out, it may take a while before it’s available to everyone. Meanwhile, Google’s Pixel 8 Pro is highlighted as a flagship device loaded with advanced AI features for daily conveniences, such as removing unwanted background noise or fixing photo imperfections. Notably, Google promises seven years of OS updates for the Pixel 8 Pro—an industry-leading commitment.

article_content: Governor Pastor Umo Eno of Akwa Ibom State has authorized the establishment of 10 new dialysis centres—one in each federal constituency. To meet this goal by June 2024, he ordered immediate recruitment and training of healthcare professionals. At the inauguration of the Enoch and Folu Adeboye Dialysis Centre at Immanuel General Hospital, Eket, which was donated by the Redeemed Christian Church of God (RCCG) through its ‘His Love Foundation’, Governor Eno directed that staff from state hospitals be transferred to ensure these facilities are fully operational. The governor instructed the Commissioner for Health and other key stakeholders to ensure all 10 centres are functioning on schedule. He also asked the Ministry of Health to collaborate with the Ministry of Information and the Chief Press Secretary’s Office for public education campaigns on the prevention and treatment of kidney diseases. Governor Eno praised Pastor Enoch Adeboye, his wife Folu, and RCCG, recognizing their humanitarian efforts to support public health in Akwa Ibom, especially for those facing serious kidney ailments. He encouraged other faith groups and businesses to embark on similar initiatives, stating that meaningful community projects are more valuable than monetary donations, and promised government support for construction and staffing. Pastor Idowu Iluyomade, RCCG’s Intercontinental Overseer for Christian Social Responsibility, said their foundation had already established 12 dialysis centres nationwide before opening the 13th in Eket, motivated by a sense of compassion for people living with kidney disease. Professor Augustine Umoh, the state’s Commissioner for Health, highlighted that dialysis is an essential treatment for kidney failure and praised the positive impact of the government’s partnership with RCCG.

article_content: Elisha Morrow, a former Coast Guard recruit from Boynton Beach, Florida, has come forward to share her experience with severe sexual harassment at the Cape May, New Jersey boot camp in 2009 and 2010. She says that Chief Petty Officer Carlos Resendez targeted her and other young, blonde women for cleaning duties late at night, during which he made inappropriate comments about their bodies while overseeing their work. Resendez, who was ironically tasked with teaching anti-harassment classes, also coerced another recruit into undressing and performing sexual acts. The fear of being expelled from the Coast Guard kept Morrow and other victims from reporting these incidents right away. Now employed as a police dispatcher, Morrow is advocating for reforms in Washington, D.C. alongside Representative Lois Frankel. Their efforts resulted in new legal provisions designed to make it easier to prosecute abusive military officers, broaden the definition of military sexual assault, limit commanders’ power to overturn convictions, and require civilian reviews when cases aren't prosecuted. The measures have passed the House and were expected to pass the Senate. Resendez was eventually convicted at a military trial and served one year in prison for maltreating subordinates and adultery. However, charges of sexual assault could not be applied under current military law since stricter definitions require proof of physical or life-threatening harm. Morrow admitted she once considered faking a suicide attempt to escape the harassment and has since felt guilt for not coming forward earlier—particularly after learning of other victims, including one who was raped. She continues to push for more comprehensive changes so that those responsible face proper consequences and communities are better protected. Morrow argues that current policies allow some offenders to re-enter society without accountability, leaving the issue unresolved.
translated_content: Elisha Morrow, mantan rekrut Coast Guard asal Boynton Beach, Florida, mengungkapkan pengalamannya menjadi korban pelecehan seksual berat di kamp pelatihan Cape May, New Jersey pada tahun 2009 dan 2010. Ia menyatakan bahwa Kepala Petugas Carlos Resendez menargetkan dirinya dan perempuan muda berambut pirang lainnya untuk bertugas membersihkan di malam hari, di bawah pengawasan dan disertai komentar tidak pantas mengenai tubuh mereka. Resendez, yang justru bertanggung jawab mengajar kelas pencegahan pelecehan seksual, juga memaksa seorang rekrut lain untuk menanggalkan pakaian dan melakukan tindakan seksual. Rasa takut dikeluarkan dari Coast Guard membuat Morrow dan korban lain menahan diri untuk melapor begitu kejadian terjadi. Kini bekerja sebagai petugas pengatur lalu lintas darat, Morrow memperjuangkan reformasi di Washington, D.C. didampingi Perwakilan Lois Frankel. Upaya mereka menghasilkan ketentuan hukum baru yang mempermudah penuntutan pejabat militer pelaku kekerasan, memperluas definisi pelecehan seksual di militer, membatasi kewenangan komandan membatalkan vonis, serta mewajibkan tinjauan sipil bila kasus tidak diajukan ke pengadilan. Ketentuan ini sudah disetujui DPR dan diperkirakan akan disahkan Senat. Resendez akhirnya divonis di pengadilan militer dan dihukum penjara satu tahun atas penyiksaan bawahan dan perzinahan. Namun, ia tidak dapat dijerat dakwaan pelecehan seksual karena hukum militer mengharuskan adanya bukti tindak kekerasan fisik atau ancaman nyata. Morrow mengakui sempat berpikir berpura-pura ingin bunuh diri untuk bisa keluar dari situasi itu dan masih merasa bersalah karena tidak melapor lebih awal—terutama setelah mengetahui ada korban lain yang mengalami pemerkosaan. Dia terus mendorong perubahan lebih luas agar pelaku mendapat hukuman setimpal dan masyarakat lebih aman. Menurut Morrow, kebijakan saat ini memungkinkan pelaku kembali ke masyarakat tanpa pengawasan, sehingga masalah belum benar-benar terselesaikan.

article_content: Like millions of people around the world, I credit the Beatles for inspiring my early career choices. As a six-year-old, I stayed up late one Sunday to watch the Fab Four make their legendary appearance on The Ed Sullivan Show. On Saturday afternoons, I would walk to the Plaza Theater in downtown Glasgow, Kentucky, to watch 'Help!' and 'A Hard Day’s Night.' I have Ringo Starr to thank for my love of percussion, which took shape through improvising with paintbrushes and coffee cans before I got real drums. Years later, I became a touring musician myself, performing with various recording artists and earning a gold record. December 8, 1980, was a day off while I was traveling with jazz-grass fiddle virtuoso Vassar Clements. We were in Pennsylvania, staying the night so a TV crew could follow us to New York the next day for a series of shows. The television was on Monday Night Football when we heard the devastating news from sportscaster Howard Cosell: John Lennon had been shot and killed that night in New York. Our trip to New York changed entirely. The next morning was gray, rainy, and cold as we drove toward the city. It felt appropriate. After sound check, the road manager and I took the subway to Columbus Circle and walked up Central Park West toward the Dakota, where John Lennon lived and where he was shot. As we walked, it felt as though a somber, heavy blanket had descended on the city. Despite the traffic, the streets were quiet, and conversations among passersby were subdued. Approaching the Dakota, we noticed a flock of birds circling above, as if standing guard in mourning. Suddenly, from around the corner, we heard hundreds of fans singing 'Give Peace a Chance' and 'Imagine.' Some held candles, others held flowers, but all shared in the memory of Lennon. We joined them in honoring his memory. Though the city was filled with sadness and tears that day, it was also enveloped by peace, love, and music. I will never forget it. When my son was born in 1987, we named him Dakota. Years later, I left the touring life for a new perspective, trading the recording studio for the CNN control room. Decades later, the music and message of the Beatles—and John Lennon—continue to resonate. His legacy and hope endure: that someday, the world will give peace a chance.
translated_content: Seperti jutaan orang di seluruh dunia, saya berterima kasih kepada The Beatles yang telah menginspirasi pilihan karier saya di masa muda. Saat berusia enam tahun, saya begadang di suatu hari Minggu hanya untuk menonton penampilan legendaris Fab Four di The Ed Sullivan Show. Setiap Sabtu sore, saya berjalan kaki ke Plaza Theater di pusat kota Glasgow, Kentucky, untuk menonton 'Help!' dan 'A Hard Day’s Night.' Ringo Starr adalah alasan saya menyukai alat perkusi, yang awalnya saya mainkan dengan kuas cat dan kaleng kopi sebelum akhirnya memiliki drum sesungguhnya. Bertahun-tahun kemudian, saya menjadi musisi tur, tampil bersama sejumlah artis rekaman, dan mendapatkan penghargaan gold record. Tanggal 8 Desember 1980 adalah hari libur saat saya tengah perjalanan bersama pemain biola jazz-grass, Vassar Clements. Kami berada di Pennsylvania, menginap di sana agar kru TV bisa mengikuti kami ke New York keesokan harinya untuk serangkaian pertunjukan. Saat menyalakan TV pada acara Monday Night Football, kami mendengar kabar memilukan dari komentator olahraga Howard Cosell: John Lennon telah ditembak dan meninggal dunia malam itu di New York. Perjalanan kami ke New York berubah sepenuhnya. Pagi berikutnya begitu suram, hujan, dan dingin saat kami menuju kota. Rasanya memang cocok dengan suasana hati. Setelah pemeriksaan suara, manajer tur dan saya naik subway ke Columbus Circle lalu berjalan menyusuri Central Park West menuju Dakota, tempat tinggal dan lokasi John Lennon ditembak. Saat kami berjalan, rasanya seolah-olah selimut berat nan muram menyelimuti kota. Meski lalu lintas tetap ada, jalanan terasa sunyi dan percakapan orang-orang terdengar pelan. Saat mendekati Dakota, kami melihat sekumpulan burung terbang melingkar di atas gedung, seolah berjaga dalam suasana duka. Tiba-tiba, dari balik sudut jalan, terdengar ratusan penggemar menyanyikan 'Give Peace a Chance' dan 'Imagine.' Ada yang membawa lilin, ada pula yang membawa bunga, namun semuanya berbagi kenangan tentang Lennon. Kami pun bergabung untuk mengenangnya. Walaupun hari itu dipenuhi kesedihan dan air mata, suasana damai, cinta, dan musik juga terasa menyelimuti kota. Saya tidak akan pernah melupakannya. Beberapa tahun kemudian, saya meninggalkan kehidupan tur dan berpindah ke jalur yang berbeda, mengubah ruang kontrol studio rekaman menjadi ruang kontrol CNN. article_content: A record number of people are expected to travel during the upcoming holiday season, starting with Thanksgiving, just as respiratory illnesses are rising across much of the United States. Currently, children under 5 years old are being hospitalized with respiratory illnesses at a higher rate than other age groups, according to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC). One of the most common respiratory viruses circulating at this time of year is respiratory syncytial virus (RSV). "RSV is a very common virus. Most children in the United States are infected by age 2," said Dr. Jeffrey Kahn, chief of infectious diseases at Children's Health in Dallas and professor at UT Southwestern Medical Center, to ABC News. Although exposure to RSV is common in early childhood, families can take steps to reduce its impact this holiday season. Experts recommend avoiding contact with sick people, washing hands frequently, getting preventive immunizations, and breastfeeding to minimize the risk of serious RSV complications in babies. RSV is the leading cause of bronchiolitis, which is inflammation in the small airways of the lungs, often causing mucus buildup and making it hard for babies to breathe, according to the CDC. Severe cases may require hospitalization for breathing support, and infants may experience dehydration if they cannot feed properly. Each year, RSV leads to an estimated 58,000 to 80,000 hospitalizations and between 100 and 300 deaths among children under 5, according to the CDC. Infants under 6 months, especially those younger than 3 months, are at the greatest risk, particularly if they were born prematurely or have underlying health issues. Doctors advise visitors to wear masks during or after travel, wash hands before holding babies, and avoid close contact if they feel unwell. "For the first time in decades, we now have effective tools to prevent RSV infection," Dr. Kahn said. This season, there are three new RSV prevention products, offering four total options for doctors. Two protective antibody shots are available for babies: nirsevimab (new this season) and palivizumab (used for nearly 20 years). Nirsevimab is a single seasonal shot recommended for all babies under 8 months, and for some high-risk children up to 19 months. Palivizumab is a monthly injection given from October to March for children under 2 who have certain high-risk conditions. Due to a shortage of nirsevimab, the CDC recommends reserving it for babies under 6 months and some other high-risk children ineligible for palivizumab. RSV vaccines are also available for adults 60 and older. Pfizer's RSV vaccine is recommended for pregnant people in their third trimester to help protect newborns. When given at least two weeks before birth, this vaccine can provide infants with about six months of protection. "If you're older or pregnant, vaccinating yourself helps protect the youngest and most at-risk," Dr. Julia Arana, chief of staff at East Tennessee Children's Hospital, told ABC News. While breastfeeding is not possible or chosen by all parents, studies show breastfed babies have a lower risk of RSV complications, likely due to immune benefits in breast milk. "Breastfeeding clearly lowers the chance of outpatient visits, hospitalization, or intensive care for RSV," said Dr. Paul Offit, director of the Vaccine Education Center at Children's Hospital of Philadelphia. Despite prevention, some babies may still need medical care. Doctors urge seeking immediate help for babies having breathing trouble, difficulty waking, or bluish face/lips. Consult a doctor if a baby is feeding poorly or shows signs of dehydration, such as dry lips or fewer wet diapers, the CDC advises. Fever in some infants can also be a medical emergency, even if they seem well; parents should consult their pediatrician about when to seek care. There's no specific cure for RSV, but hospital support—like oxygen or IV fluids—can help. Dr. Jade A. Cobern is a pediatrician specializing in preventive medicine and is part of the ABC News Medical Unit.
translated_content: Jumlah orang yang bepergian diperkirakan akan memecahkan rekor selama musim liburan mendatang, dimulai dari Thanksgiving, sementara penyakit pernapasan meningkat di banyak wilayah Amerika Serikat. Saat ini, anak-anak di bawah usia 5 tahun dirawat di rumah sakit akibat penyakit pernapasan dengan tingkat yang lebih tinggi dibanding kelompok usia lain, menurut Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC). Salah satu virus pernapasan yang paling umum beredar saat musim ini adalah respiratory syncytial virus (RSV). "RSV adalah virus yang sangat umum. Sebagian besar anak-anak di Amerika Serikat terinfeksi pada usia 2 tahun," kata Dr. Jeffrey Kahn, kepala penyakit menular di Children's Health Dallas dan profesor di UT Southwestern Medical Center, kepada ABC News. Meskipun paparan RSV umum terjadi pada masa kanak-kanak, keluarga dapat mengambil langkah untuk mengurangi dampaknya selama musim liburan ini. Para ahli merekomendasikan untuk menghindari kontak dengan orang sakit, sering mencuci tangan, mendapatkan imunisasi pencegahan, dan pemberian ASI guna meminimalkan risiko komplikasi serius akibat RSV pada bayi. RSV adalah penyebab utama bronchiolitis, yaitu peradangan pada saluran udara kecil di paru-paru, yang sering menyebabkan penumpukan lendir dan membuat bayi kesulitan bernapas, menurut CDC. Kasus berat mungkin memerlukan perawatan di rumah sakit untuk membantu pernapasan, dan bayi dapat mengalami dehidrasi jika tidak bisa makan dengan baik. Setiap tahun, RSV menyebabkan sekitar 58.000 hingga 80.000 rawat inap dan sekitar 100 hingga 300 kematian pada anak di bawah usia 5 tahun, menurut CDC. Bayi di bawah usia 6 bulan, terutama yang berusia kurang dari 3 bulan, berisiko paling tinggi, apalagi jika lahir prematur atau mempunyai masalah kesehatan bawaan. Dokter menyarankan pengunjung untuk memakai masker saat atau setelah bepergian, mencuci tangan sebelum memegang bayi, dan menghindari kontak dekat jika merasa kurang sehat. "Untuk pertama kalinya dalam beberapa dekade, kini kita punya alat yang efektif untuk mencegah infeksi RSV," kata Dr. Kahn. Musim ini, ada tiga produk pencegahan RSV baru, sehingga dokter memiliki empat pilihan total. Ada dua suntikan antibodi pelindung untuk bayi: nirsevimab (baru musim ini) dan palivizumab (sudah digunakan sekitar 20 tahun). Nirsevimab adalah suntikan musiman sekali untuk semua bayi di bawah 8 bulan, serta sebagian anak risiko tinggi hingga umur 19 bulan. Palivizumab adalah suntikan bulanan dari Oktober sampai Maret untuk anak di bawah usia 2 tahun dengan kondisi berisiko tinggi tertentu. Karena pasokan nirsevimab terbatas, CDC menganjurkan pemberian hanya pada bayi di bawah 6 bulan dan beberapa anak risiko tinggi yang tidak memenuhi syarat untuk palivizumab. Vaksin RSV juga tersedia untuk dewasa usia 60 tahun ke atas. Vaksin RSV Pfizer direkomendasikan untuk ibu hamil trimester ketiga guna melindungi bayi baru lahir. Jika diberikan minimal dua minggu sebelum kelahiran, vaksin ini dapat memberi perlindungan sekitar enam bulan pada bayi. "Jika Anda lebih tua atau sedang hamil, vaksinasi diri sendiri dapat sangat membantu melindungi anak-anak yang paling muda dan rentan," jelas Dr. Julia Arana, kepala staf di East Tennessee Children's Hospital, kepada ABC News. Meski ASI tidak selalu bisa diberikan atau dipilih semua orang tua, studi menunjukkan bayi yang mendapat ASI lebih kecil risikonya terkena komplikasi RSV, kemungkinan karena manfaat imun dalam ASI. "Menyusui jelas menurunkan kemungkinan rawat jalan, rawat inap, bahkan masuk ICU karena RSV," kata Dr. Paul Offit, direktur Vaccine Education Center di Children's Hospital of Philadelphia. Walau sudah dicegah, sebagian bayi tetap bisa butuh perawatan medis. Dokter menganjurkan mencari pertolongan segera jika bayi mengalami kesulitan bernapas, sulit dibangunkan, atau wajah/bibir membiru. Konsultasikan dengan dokter jika bayi kurang makan atau tampak dehidrasi, seperti bibir kering atau popok basahnya makin jarang, saran CDC. Demam pada bayi tertentu bisa jadi gawat darurat medis meski terlihat sehat; orang tua sebaiknya diskusi dengan dokter anak tentang kapan harus mencari perawatan. Tidak ada obat spesifik untuk RSV, namun rumah sakit dapat membantu bayi melewati masa sakit dengan oksigen atau cairan infus. Dr. Jade A. Cobern adalah dokter anak yang fokus pada pencegahan dan bagian dari ABC News Medical Unit.

article_content: More than 34 houses worth over £1 million are sold each day, according to new figures from the Land Registry. The House Price Index showed that in April 2014, 1,028 properties sold for more than £1 million, with 214 selling for above £2 million. Chelsea has emerged as the most desirable place to live in London among the ultra-wealthy, as Russian oligarchs fuel a boom in West London's luxury property market. In April 2014 alone, 735 homes in London sold for more than £1 million, with nearly 200 of these selling for over £2 million. Currently, The Boltons in Chelsea is on the market for £39.5 million, which would require the buyer to pay an additional £2.75 million in stamp duty. This luxury house is one of many contributing to the surge in high-value property transactions, with an average of 34 £1-million-plus house sales per day. Over the past 12 months, 478 homes in Chelsea sold for more than £1 million, including 57 that sold for above £5 million. New figures indicate that Chelsea is now more desirable to oligarchs and billionaires than traditional high-end areas like Kensington, Mayfair, and Knightsbridge. Kensington saw 340 sales over £1 million in the past year, with 44 exceeding £5 million. St John’s Wood followed with 259 sales—20 of which were above £5 million. Knightsbridge, Belgravia, and Mayfair made up the rest of the top six, with Knightsbridge recording 145 sales (45 over £5 million), Belgravia with 140 (29 over £5 million), and Mayfair with 105 (19 over £5 million). The most expensive sale in Chelsea was 11 Upper Phillimore Gardens, a seven-bedroom mansion sold for £28.5 million. Next was a seven-bedroom residence on Cottesmore Gardens, which sold for £19.75 million, and 50 Chelsea Square, a six-bedroom property purchased for £13.5 million. The buyers of these three properties paid more than £4.3 million in combined stamp duty. Chelsea comprises six 'hamlets' spanning nearly 3,000 acres, and is home to notable figures like Roman Abramovich, Amanda Eliyash, and Mick Jagger. The borough has the largest American population outside the US, making up 6.53% of Chelsea’s residents, according to research by the London estate agency Russell Simpson, which analysed data from LonRes. Alan Russell at Russell Simpson stated, 'Chelsea is an area talked about worldwide. It is iconic—people from Britain and abroad aspire to live here, and it has always been one of the most sought-after parts of London. This has become even more evident recently, as Chelsea has outsold its prime Central London neighbours.' According to the new figures, the average house price in the UK is £172,011, up 6.4% from 2013, with significant variations nationally. In London, the average home now costs £437,000, compared with £98,500 in the North East. House prices in Blackburn dropped more than 8% over the past year, while in Lambeth, they increased by more than 25%. Overall, house prices in England and Wales have risen especially fast in London and parts of the South East, while some areas in Wales and the North West have seen little movement. In London, house prices are up 15%, a faster rate than during the 2009 property boom, whereas the national average increase is around 5%.

article_content: Paris Saint-Germain (PSG) has shown interest in signing Manchester City's influential midfielder Yaya Toure, but City is determined to keep him for the foreseeable future. PSG, seeking strong midfielders to enhance their Champions League ambitions, noted Toure’s impressive goal-scoring record. Although Toure mentioned in January that joining PSG appeals to him, City intends to secure his presence for several more years. Manchester City aims to keep Toure, Sergio Aguero, and Vincent Kompany as the nucleus of their squad in their bid for Champions League success. The club plans to bring in up to four new players during the summer while Joleon Lescott and Micah Richards are expected to move on, with West Ham expressing interest in Lescott. Bayern Munich is targeting Aston Villa’s promising defender Easah Suliman. The 16-year-old, who has captained England's U17 team and performed admirably in the FA Youth Cup, has impressed Bayern’s scouts. Suliman, a Villa player since age eight, is capable of playing both left-back and centre-back. Meanwhile, West Ham manager Sam Allardyce traveled to Germany to scout Swiss striker Josip Drmic of Nuremberg. Drmic, who struggled during the game against Wolfsburg, has nonetheless scored 16 goals this season. He has a £5 million release clause, applicable if Nuremberg is relegated. Arsenal, Everton, and Liverpool are also monitoring him. After the game, Allardyce’s car broke down, but he received a lift to the airport from an Everton scout. Aston Villa and Everton are considering a move for Morgan Amalfitano, currently on loan at West Brom from Marseille. West Brom missed their chance to make his move permanent, and Marseille is willing to sell for £2.5 million. Hull City is also interested in Amalfitano, who has shone this season, including with a solo goal against Manchester United. Villa is also watching Watford striker Troy Deeney, as Niklas Helenius is expected to return to Alborg. Blackburn Rovers and several Scottish clubs—Dundee, Hibernian, and Kilmarnock—are eyeing Cowdenbeath striker Kane Hemmings. Having bounced back from knee injuries earlier in his career, Hemmings has scored 19 goals in 32 matches and will be out of contract this summer. Lastly, English suitors for Marseille striker Andre-Pierre Gignac, such as West Ham, Stoke, and Everton, are expected to be disappointed. With only a year left on his Marseille contract and wages around £75,000 per week, Gignac is likely to move to Russia, with Dinamo Moscow and Spartak Moscow showing interest.

article_content: Holidaymakers were forced to take cover when a runaway horse and carriage raced through the busy seaside town of Swanage, Dorset, before colliding with a car. The horse, spooked by the crowded streets, bolted, leading to the 20-year-old driver being thrown 30 feet after the crash. Both the horse and the four-wheeled cart overturned, narrowly missing nearby bystanders. Remarkably, the carriage driver, the female car driver, and the horse all escaped without serious injury. Emergency services responded quickly on Swanage High Street, treating both drivers for shock. It took eight firefighters to right the 110-year-old carriage, which had only recently been restored by its owner. Bystanders helped recover the shaken horse. An employee at The Fish Plaice, Archie Wright, reported hearing a loud crash and witnessing the cart soar into the air. He recalled, 'It seems like something spooked the horse and it bolted. The driver lost control and crashed into two cars. About 200 people rushed out onto the street. Thankfully, no one was hurt.' Swanage resident Brian Erksine remarked that the town is crowded with tourists during this time of year, and it was surprising more people were not injured. Phil Burridge, commander at Swanage Fire Station, confirmed, 'The horse had been pulling the cart down the High Street when it became frightened and bolted, colliding with a car and severely damaging it. The cart flipped, throwing its driver about 30 feet. Fortunately, there were no passengers in the cart. Ambulance crews treated the female car driver for shock and the cart driver for cuts and bruises. The most important thing is that no one was hurt—cars and carts can be replaced, but lives cannot.'
translated_content: Para wisatawan terpaksa berlindung ketika sebuah kereta kuda lepas kendali melaju di kota tepi laut Swanage, Dorset, sebelum menabrak sebuah mobil. Kuda yang ketakutan oleh keramaian jalanan itu tiba-tiba kabur, membuat pengemudi kereta berusia 20 tahun terlempar sekitar 9 meter setelah tabrakan. Baik kuda maupun kereta roda empat itu terguling, nyaris mengenai pejalan kaki di sekitarnya. Luar biasanya, pengemudi kereta, pengemudi mobil wanita, dan kudanya selamat tanpa luka serius. Layanan darurat segera tiba di High Street Swanage, memberikan perawatan terhadap kedua pengemudi yang mengalami syok. Dibutuhkan delapan petugas pemadam kebakaran untuk membalikkan kereta berusia 110 tahun yang baru saja selesai direstorasi oleh pemiliknya. Warga yang melihat membantu menenangkan kuda yang ketakutan. Seorang karyawan The Fish Plaice, Archie Wright, mengatakan dia mendengar suara keras dan melihat kereta itu melayang di udara. Ia menuturkan, 'Sepertinya sesuatu membuat kuda ketakutan lalu kabur. Pengemudi kehilangan kendali dan menabrak dua mobil. Sekitar 200 orang langsung keluar ke jalan. Untungnya, tidak ada yang terluka.' Warga Swanage, Brian Erksine, mengungkapkan bahwa kota ini memang ramai turis saat musim liburan, dan cukup mengejutkan tidak lebih banyak orang yang terluka. Komandan Stasiun Pemadam Kebakaran Swanage, Phil Burridge, membenarkan, 'Kuda menarik kereta menuruni High Street saat tiba-tiba ketakutan dan kabur, lalu menabrak mobil dan menyebabkan kerusakan parah. Keretanya terbalik dan pengemudinya terlempar sekitar 9 meter. Untungnya tidak ada penumpang di kereta. Tim medis menangani pengemudi mobil wanita yang syok dan pengemudi kereta untuk luka ringan. Yang terpenting, tidak ada korban jiwa—mobil dan kereta bisa digantikan, nyawa manusia tidak.'

article_content: Redmond O'Neal, son of actors Ryan O'Neal and Farrah Fawcett, was arrested Sunday morning on drug charges, authorities have confirmed. The arrest took place at a jail security checkpoint after O'Neal admitted he was in possession of drugs, according to Steve Whitmore, spokesperson for the Los Angeles County sheriff's office. O'Neal is facing accusations of attempting to bring narcotics into a jail facility and possessing a controlled substance. Police have not disclosed what specific drugs were found. After the arrest, O'Neal was taken to a jail about 40 miles north of Los Angeles. His bail was set at $25,000, though it remains unclear whether he has posted it. (CNN’s Ninette Sosa contributed to this report.)

article_content: Accreditation and voting have begun at Polling Unit 059, located at the Open Space by Ava Hotel in Lokoja Local Government Area, Kogi State. The polling unit, which has 515 registered voters, saw INEC officials arrive at 8:15 am, after which voters were observed queuing for accreditation. Voting started at exactly 9:11 am, later than scheduled, as INEC officials waited for all party agents to be present. At the time of reporting, only the agent from the All Progressives Congress (APC), who arrived at 8:35 am, and the agent from the Peoples Democratic Party (PDP), who arrived at 9:10 am, were present. Voter turnout has been noted as low at this polling unit. Security at the site consists of three female personnel: two from the police and one from the Nigeria Security and Civil Defence Corps (NSCDC). Further details will be provided as events unfold.

article_content: Members of Bengali poet Kazi Nazrul Islam’s family have criticized the use of his patriotic song 'Karar Oi Louho Kopat' in the newly released Hindi war biopic 'Pippa.' Anindita Kazi, Nazrul’s US-based granddaughter, alleged that her late mother Kalyani Kazi’s signature on the agreement permitting the song’s use was not genuine. The family has demanded the removal of what they call a 'distorted' rendition of the song from both the film and all digital platforms, and they have threatened legal action against the producers in both India and Bangladesh. Anindita highlighted what she describes as irregularities in the adaptation and licensing contract for the song, and has appealed to the governments of Bengal and Bangladesh to investigate. The agreement was reportedly signed in September 2021 between film producers and Kalyani Kazi, daughter-in-law of Nazrul Islam, in exchange for Rs 2 lakh. Kalyani passed away in May this year. Anindita also questioned the role of her brother, Anirban Kazi, who signed the agreement as a witness. She raised concerns over the contract’s date and address discrepancies, noting her mother’s residence was 74H Purna Das Road, but the agreement listed 52D Hindustan Park—Anirban’s office. Anirban explained that his office address was used for correspondence due to difficulties in receiving deliveries at their mother’s home, and stated he is willing to cooperate with any investigation. Additionally, Anindita noted the agreement paper was prepared on September 8, 2021, but Anirban’s signature was dated September 4, 2021. She observed that Kalyani’s signature was undated, questioning the timeline. Anirban admitted this was an error. Anindita further claimed her mother’s signature on the contract was forged, providing bank documents as examples of her mother’s authentic signature, and stated that the contract’s account details were linked to Anirban. Anirban responded affirmatively about the producers contacting his mother, stating she did not fully understand the matter and asked him to assist, questioning the plausibility of forgery and welcoming investigation.
translated_content: Anggota keluarga penyair Bengali Kazi Nazrul Islam mengkritik penggunaan lagu patriotiknya 'Karar Oi Louho Kopat' dalam film biopik perang Hindi terbaru, 'Pippa.' Anindita Kazi, cucu Nazrul yang berbasis di AS, menuduh bahwa tanda tangan mendiang ibunya, Kalyani Kazi, pada perjanjian penggunaan lagu tersebut tidak asli. Keluarga tersebut menuntut penghapusan versi lagu yang mereka sebut 'terdistorsi' dari film maupun semua platform digital, serta mengancam akan menempuh jalur hukum terhadap produser di India dan Bangladesh. Anindita menyoroti dugaan kejanggalan dalam kontrak adaptasi dan lisensi lagu tersebut, serta meminta pemerintah Bengal dan Bangladesh untuk melakukan investigasi. Perjanjian tersebut dikabarkan ditandatangani pada September 2021 antara produser film dan Kalyani Kazi, menantu perempuan Nazrul Islam, dengan imbalan sebesar Rs 2 lakh. Kalyani meninggal pada Mei tahun ini. Anindita juga mempertanyakan peran saudaranya, Anirban Kazi, yang bertindak sebagai saksi dalam perjanjian itu. Ia menyoroti perbedaan tanggal dan alamat dalam kontrak, mengingat alamat rumah ibunya adalah 74H Purna Das Road, namun yang tertera di kontrak adalah 52D Hindustan Park—kantor Anirban. Anirban menjelaskan bahwa alamat kantornya digunakan untuk surat-menyurat karena ada kesulitan menerima kiriman di rumah ibu mereka, dan ia menyatakan bersedia bekerja sama dalam penyelidikan apa pun. Selain itu, Anindita memperhatikan bahwa dokumen perjanjian dibuat pada 8 September 2021, namun tanda tangan Anirban bertanggal 4 September 2021. Ia juga mencatat tanda tangan Kalyani tidak bertanggal, dan mempertanyakan kronologi penandatanganan. Anirban mengakui hal tersebut sebagai kesalahan. Anindita juga mengklaim tanda tangan ibunya di kontrak tersebut dipalsukan, dengan menunjukkan dokumen bank sebagai contoh tanda tangan sah ibunya, serta menyebut detail rekening dalam kontrak terkait dengan Anirban. Anirban membalas bahwa produser memang menghubungi ibunya, namun karena tidak terlalu memahami situasi, ibunya meminta bantuannya. Ia mempertanyakan argumen pemalsuan dan mempersilakan investigasi.

article_content: During a private fundraiser for the Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee in New York City, Hillary Clinton, celebrating her new status as a grandmother, received several gifts intended for her granddaughter, Charlotte Clinton Mezvinsky. DCCC chairman Steve Israel gifted her a selection of books from various genres. These included childhood staples like 'Goodnight Moon' and 'If You Give a Mouse a Cookie,' as well as books like 'Veterans, Heroes in our Neighborhood,' 'America the Beautiful,' 'Global Babies'—featuring photos of babies worldwide in recognition of Clinton’s international work—and a New York-themed pop-up book. Israel also presented 'Baby Bear Sees Blue' and 'Blue Bus Red Balloon' as symbolic nods to both political parties. Among the more unique choices was an illustrated version of Machiavelli's 'The Prince' for children. Lastly, as a playful gesture, Israel, who represents areas in Long Island and Queens, included a New York Mets uniform, joking it would be perfect when Charlotte is ready for third base.

Ketua DCCC, Steve Israel, mempersembahkan sejumlah buku dari berbagai kategori. Buku klasik seperti 'Goodnight Moon' dan 'If You Give a Mouse a Cookie' termasuk di antaranya, bersama buku seperti 'Veterans, Heroes in our Neighborhood', 'America the Beautiful', 'Global Babies'—yang berisi foto bayi dari seluruh dunia sebagai penghormatan bagi peran internasional Clinton—serta buku pop-up bertema New York. Selain itu, dia juga memberikan versi ilustrasi anak-anak dari 'The Prince' karya Machiavelli. Tak ketinggalan, sebagai sentuhan humor, Israel—anggota kongres dari Long Island dan Queens—juga menghadiahkan seragam New York Mets sambil bercanda bahwa hadiah itu untuk Charlotte saat ia siap bermain di base ketiga.

article_content: JK Rowling, famed author of the Harry Potter series, is set to release her second crime novel under the pseudonym Robert Galbraith. The upcoming book, titled 'Silkworm', will be published on June 19 and serves as the sequel to last year's bestseller 'The Cuckoo's Calling'. The story again features war veteran and private investigator Cormoran Strike alongside his assistant Robin Ellacott. This time, the duo are tasked with investigating the disappearance of novelist Owen Quine. Their search leads to the discovery of a controversial manuscript written by Quine, containing damaging portrayals of several people he knows. As Strike delves deeper into the case, he finds that Quine's vanishing is more complicated than it first appears. The stakes are raised further when Quine is found brutally murdered under bizarre circumstances. Now Strike and Robin must unravel the motives behind the crime as they chase a dangerous killer. Rowling, age 48, had intended to keep her work as Galbraith a secret. However, her identity was revealed by a solicitor, resulting in damages that she generously donated to charity. Reflecting on the experience, Rowling remarked that she had enjoyed the anonymity and receiving unfiltered feedback under a different name. 'Silkworm' marks Rowling’s third novel aimed at adult readers, following her previous book, 'The Casual Vacancy', released in 2012. Publishers have described the new novel as 'a compulsively readable crime novel with twists at every turn'.

Buku terbarunya yang berjudul 'Silkworm' akan terbit pada 19 Juni dan menjadi sekuel dari novel laris tahun lalu, 'The Cuckoo's Calling'. Kisah ini kembali menghadirkan veteran perang sekaligus detektif swasta, Cormoran Strike, bersama asistennya, Robin Ellacott. Kali ini, mereka ditugaskan untuk menyelidiki hilangnya seorang penulis novel bernama Owen Quine. Penyelidikan mereka mengarah pada penemuan naskah kontroversial karya Quine yang berisi gambaran buruk tentang beberapa orang di sekitarnya. Semakin dalam Strike menelusuri kasus ini, ia menemukan bahwa hilangnya Quine jauh lebih rumit dari yang diduga. Ketegangan meningkat ketika Quine ditemukan tewas secara brutal dalam keadaan yang aneh. Kini Strike dan Robin harus mengungkap motif di balik kasus ini dan memburu sang pembunuh berbahaya. Rowling, yang kini berusia 48 tahun, sebenarnya ingin identitasnya sebagai Galbraith tetap rahasia. Namun, identitasnya terbongkar oleh seorang pengacara dan Rowling menerima ganti rugi yang kemudian ia sumbangkan ke badan amal. Ia mengakui bahwa ia menikmati masa-masa anonimitas itu dan mendapat umpan balik asli lewat nama lain. 'Silkworm' menjadi novel ketiga Rowling untuk pembaca dewasa, setelah sebelumnya menerbitkan 'The Casual Vacancy' pada 2012. Penerbit menggambarkan novel ini sebagai kisah kriminal yang sangat seru dengan banyak kejutan di setiap babaknya.

article_content:
Nigel Farage describes himself as 'a hero to some people and an absolute villain to millions.' Currently, he is living in an Australian jungle as a participant in 'I'm a Celebrity.' If you’re unfamiliar with the GB News presenter and self-proclaimed pantomime villain, here’s what you need to know. Farage, now 59, was born in Kent and attended Dulwich College. He began his career in London’s financial district in 1982. Farage was an early member of the UK Independence Party (UKIP), which campaigned for the UK to leave the European Union, joining in 1993. He has four children: two sons with his ex-wife and two daughters with Kirsten Mehr, a German national he reportedly met in 1996.

A common misconception is that Farage was a Member of Parliament in the UK; however, while he led UKIP and stood for election several times, he was never elected as an MP. He did serve as a Member of the European Parliament (MEP) from 1999 until 2020. On the day of the 2010 UK general election, Farage survived a plane crash that required a two-day hospital stay.

Farage’s political career is defined by his Euroscepticism and advocacy for Britain’s exit from the EU. He played a central role in the 2016 Brexit referendum, focusing his campaign on issues such as immigration—a tactic that drew significant criticism. One campaign poster, featuring asylum seekers and the slogan 'Breaking Point,' was particularly controversial. Farage has also publicly supported politicians abroad, including former U.S. President Donald Trump.

Throughout his career, Farage has been criticized for comments on migration, climate change, and HIV treatment, and has repeatedly denied accusations of racism, including from notable figures such as the Archbishop of Canterbury. Supporters argue that he voices the concerns of working-class voters dissatisfied with the major political parties.

Since stepping back from politics in 2021, Farage has hosted programs on GB News and previously hosted a show on LBC Radio from 2017 to 2020. He has also appeared on Fox News in the United States. Farage drew attention when he challenged Coutts Bank, after documents suggested it closed his account due to his political views. The BBC later apologized for erroneously reporting, based on information from the bank's chief executive, that Farage lacked the funds to maintain the account.

Currently, Farage is participating in ITV’s ‘I'm a Celebrity,’ reportedly earning £1.5 million for his appearance. The announcement of his participation led to public backlash, with the hashtag #BoycottImaCeleb trending on social media platform X (formerly Twitter). The season premiere reportedly attracted two million fewer viewers compared to the previous year. Another popular ITV program, ‘Love Island,’ also saw a decline of a million viewers this summer, though it did not feature Farage.

Due to lingering injuries from his plane crash and subsequent surgeries, Farage told The Sun newspaper he would be exempt from certain trials involving weightlifting. Nonetheless, he was not exempt from the first ‘Jungle Pizzeria’ eating challenge, which he completed alongside influencer Nella Rose.

Nigel Farage menyebut dirinya 'pahlawan bagi sebagian orang dan benar-benar penjahat bagi jutaan orang.' Saat ini, ia tinggal di hutan Australia sebagai peserta acara 'I'm a Celebrity.' Jika Anda belum mengenal presenter GB News sekaligus penjahat panggung yang mengaku sendiri, berikut yang perlu diketahui. Farage, kini 59 tahun, lahir di Kent dan bersekolah di Dulwich College. Ia memulai karir di distrik finansial London pada 1982. Farage adalah anggota awal Partai Kemerdekaan Inggris (UKIP) yang mengampanyekan keluarnya Inggris dari Uni Eropa, bergabung tahun 1993. Ia punya empat anak: dua putra dari mantan istri dan dua putri bersama Kirsten Mehr, warga negara Jerman yang katanya ia jumpai tahun 1996.

Salah paham yang sering muncul adalah bahwa Farage pernah menjadi anggota parlemen Inggris. Sebenarnya, meski pernah memimpin UKIP dan beberapa kali mencalonkan diri, ia tak pernah terpilih sebagai anggota parlemen (MP). Namun, ia menjadi anggota Parlemen Eropa (MEP) dari 1999 sampai 2020. Pada hari pemilu umum Inggris 2010, Farage selamat dari kecelakaan pesawat dan dirawat dua hari di rumah sakit.

Karir politik Farage dikenal karena euroskeptisisme dan advokasinya agar Inggris keluar dari Uni Eropa. Ia berperan besar dalam referendum Brexit 2016, terutama lewat kampanye yang menyoroti isu imigrasi—taktik yang banyak dikritik. Salah satu poster kampanyenya yang bergambar pencari suaka dan slogan 'Breaking Point' menuai kontroversi. Farage juga mendukung politisi luar negeri, termasuk mantan Presiden AS Donald Trump.

Selama karirnya, Farage beberapa kali dikritik atas komentar tentang migrasi, perubahan iklim, dan penanganan HIV, serta berulang kali membantah tuduhan rasisme, bahkan dari tokoh seperti Uskup Agung Canterbury. Pendukungnya menilai Farage mewakili suara pemilih kelas pekerja yang kecewa dengan partai politik utama.

Setelah pensiun dari politik di 2021, Farage menjadi pembawa acara di GB News, dan sebelumnya di Radio LBC dari 2017 hingga 2020. Ia juga tampil di Fox News di AS. Farage ramai dibicarakan saat membuka polemik dengan Coutts Bank, setelah dokumen menunjukkan rekeningnya ditutup karena pandangan politiknya. BBC kemudian meminta maaf karena melaporkan secara salah—berdasarkan info dari pimpinan bank—bahwa Farage tidak cukup dana untuk mempertahankan rekening itu.

Kini, Farage tampil di acara ITV 'I'm a Celebrity' dengan bayaran sekitar £1,5 juta. Pengumuman keikutsertaannya mendapat reaksi publik, diiringi tagar #BoycottImaCeleb yang trending di X (sebelumnya Twitter). Episode perdana musim ini dilaporkan kehilangan dua juta penonton ketimbang tahun lalu. Acara ITV lain, 'Love Island,' juga turun sejuta penonton musim ini, meski Farage tak tampil di sana.

Karena cedera lama akibat kecelakaan pesawat dan operasi, Farage bilang ke surat kabar The Sun bahwa ia takkan ikut tantangan angkat beban tertentu. Namun, ia tetap ikut tantangan makan 'Jungle Pizzeria' bersama influencer Nella Rose.

article_content: Tesla Inc., the American electric vehicle giant led by CEO Elon Musk, is moving closer to entering India's rapidly growing automotive market, potentially as soon as next year. Musk has mentioned these plans repeatedly in recent months. The Indian government is reportedly considering a new policy for electric vehicles that would reduce import duties for automakers who commit to local manufacturing. This proposed policy could allow Tesla and other global EV makers to test their vehicles in the Indian market before fully investing in local manufacturing facilities. However, the tax reductions would be conditional. Carmakers must eventually establish manufacturing operations in India, source components locally, and provide bank guarantees to ensure they fulfill their commitments. Tesla is expected to start by importing completely built units (CBUs) to gauge consumer response and assess how its vehicles perform in India's climate and road conditions. This data would assist Tesla in its broader goal of establishing a manufacturing plant to produce locally made, affordable electric vehicles. Potential locations for Tesla’s factory include Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra, Haryana, and Gujarat—key automobile manufacturing hubs in India. Uttar Pradesh (UP) and Karnataka are also competing for the investment, though proximity to seaports gives Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra, and Gujarat an advantage. Gujarat and Tamil Nadu in particular are strong contenders, as both states have a significant presence of auto component suppliers for EVs. While no official decisions have been announced regarding the factory’s location or investment, developments are expected in the coming months. Separately, an Economic Times report highlights the increasing prominence of women in senior leadership and boardroom dynamics within Indian corporate circles. Tesla is reportedly willing to invest up to $2 billion to set up a local factory if the government allows for a concessional import duty of 15% for two years at the start of operations. Additionally, the Indian government’s next Finance Commission may give greater weight to the human development index (HDI) and sustainable development goals (SDGs) when allocating resources among states.
translated_content: Tesla Inc., raksasa kendaraan listrik asal Amerika yang dipimpin CEO Elon Musk, semakin dekat untuk memasuki pasar otomotif India yang berkembang pesat, kemungkinan mulai tahun depan. Musk telah beberapa kali menyampaikan rencana ini dalam beberapa bulan terakhir. Pemerintah India dikabarkan sedang mempertimbangkan kebijakan baru untuk kendaraan listrik yang akan menurunkan bea impor bagi produsen mobil yang berkomitmen untuk memproduksi secara lokal. Kebijakan ini dapat memungkinkan Tesla dan produsen EV global lain untuk menguji pasar India sebelum berinvestasi penuh dalam fasilitas manufaktur lokal. Namun, pengurangan pajak ini bersifat bersyarat. Produsen mobil wajib membangun pabrik di India, membeli komponen secara lokal, serta memberikan jaminan bank untuk memastikan komitmen mereka dipenuhi. Tesla diperkirakan akan memulai dengan mengimpor Completely Built Unit (CBU) guna melihat respons konsumen dan menilai performa mobilnya di iklim serta kondisi jalan di India. Data ini akan membantu tujuan utama Tesla untuk mendirikan pabrik, guna memproduksi kendaraan listrik yang terjangkau dan dibuat secara lokal. Lokasi potensial pabrik Tesla antara lain Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra, Haryana, dan Gujarat—pusat utama manufaktur otomotif di India. Uttar Pradesh (UP) dan Karnataka juga bersaing, namun lokasi dekat pelabuhan seperti Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra, dan Gujarat punya keunggulan. Gujarat dan Tamil Nadu secara khusus menjadi kandidat kuat karena banyaknya pemasok komponen otomotif untuk kendaraan listrik di kedua negara bagian tersebut. Meski belum ada keputusan resmi terkait lokasi ataupun investasi pabriknya, perkembangan terbaru diperkirakan akan terjadi dalam beberapa bulan ke depan. Secara terpisah, laporan Economic Times menyoroti makin besarnya peran perempuan dalam kepemimpinan tingkat atas dan dinamika ruang dewan perusahaan di India. Tesla dikabarkan siap berinvestasi hingga $2 miliar untuk membangun pabrik lokal jika pemerintah mengizinkan bea impor sebesar 15% selama dua tahun pertama masa operasinya. Selain itu, Komisi Keuangan berikutnya di India kemungkinan akan memberi bobot lebih pada indeks pembangunan manusia (HDI) serta tujuan pembangunan berkelanjutan (SDGs) saat membagi sumber daya di antara negara bagian.

article_content:
French MP Bernard Debre has stirred controversy by sharply criticizing Valerie Trierweiler, the partner of President Francois Hollande, in a blog post. Debre referred to Trierweiler as 'merely the President's mistress' and argued she has no right to involve herself in national matters, suggesting she should refrain from making public statements.

Debre, a right-wing MP representing Paris, also raised concerns about Trierweiler simultaneously being a journalist and the President’s partner—calling this a conflict of interest. He recommended that Trierweiler clarify her position, perhaps leaving journalism if she intends to pursue politics.

Since Hollande was elected president in May, Trierweiler, a 47-year-old journalist, has come under constant media scrutiny. She faced intense criticism after expressing support for a political rival to Segolene Royal—Hollande’s former partner and the mother of his children—during parliamentary elections, an act Royal argued damaged her career and Cabinet prospects.

Arnaud Lagardere, owner of Paris Match magazine where Trierweiler works, also spoke out, likening her to 'an unpinned grenade' and stating he would not renew her contract to avoid conflicts of interest. These remarks appeared in a biography by Jacqueline Remy, with Lagardere stating Trierweiler has caused ongoing issues for the magazine.

Trierweiler is also seeking legal damages in response to claims made in a biography, The Troublemaker, which alleges she had affairs with both Hollande and a right-wing minister while married. Other books, including Between Two Fires by Anna Cabana and The Favorite by Laurent Greilsamer, further depict Trierweiler as unpredictable and motivated by personal ambitions, intensifying debates about her influence.
translated_content:
Anggota parlemen Prancis Bernard Debre memicu kontroversi setelah mengkritik keras Valerie Trierweiler, pasangan Presiden Francois Hollande, melalui sebuah blog. Debre menyebut Trierweiler 'hanya selingkuhan Presiden' dan menilai ia tidak berhak ikut campur dalam urusan negara, serta menyarankan agar Trierweiler berhenti berkomentar di ranah publik.

Debre, anggota parlemen sayap kanan dari Paris, juga mengangkat isu konflik kepentingan antara profesi jurnalistik Trierweiler dan posisinya sebagai pasangan Presiden. Ia menyarankan Trierweiler sebaiknya memilih salah satu jalan, bahkan meninggalkan dunia media jika ingin menekuni politik.

Sejak Hollande terpilih sebagai presiden pada Mei, Trierweiler yang berusia 47 tahun ini menjadi sorotan media. Ia mendapat kritikan tajam setelah memberikan dukungan kepada pesaing politik Segolene Royal—mantan pasangan Hollande dan ibu anak-anaknya—dalam pemilihan legislatif, yang oleh Royal dianggap merugikan karier dan peluang kabinetnya.

Arnaud Lagardere, pemilik majalah Paris Match tempat Trierweiler bekerja, juga angkat bicara dengan menyebutnya 'granat tanpa pin' dan menegaskan kontrak Trierweiler tidak akan diperpanjang guna menghindari konflik kepentingan. Hal ini diungkapkan dalam biografi karya Jacqueline Remy, di mana Lagardere menyatakan Trierweiler telah menimbulkan berbagai masalah di majalah tersebut.

Selain itu, Trierweiler menuntut ganti rugi secara hukum atas tuduhan dalam biografi The Troublemaker, yang menyebut ia terlibat hubungan dengan Hollande dan seorang menteri sayap kanan saat masih menikah. Buku lain seperti Between Two Fires oleh Anna Cabana serta The Favorite karya Laurent Greilsamer juga menggambarkan Trierweiler sebagai sosok yang sulit diprediksi dan didorong ambisi pribadi, memperpanjang perdebatan publik soal pengaruh dan perannya.
