article_content: Allan Thipthorpe, an 88-year-old former soldier, was angered when authorities prohibited Terri-Lee Pearce, a 31-year-old with a background in sex work, from visiting his assisted living residence. Swindon Borough Council issued an Anti-Social Behaviour Order (ASBO) against Pearce, citing concerns for Thipthorpe’s safety after he reportedly spent £5,000 on her. Thipthorpe argued that Pearce serves as both his carer and companion, maintaining that he should be free to decide how to spend his money and choose his visitors. The situation escalated when Thipthorpe physically assaulted council solicitor Francis Maples, an incident confirmed by CCTV footage. Thipthorpe admitted to the assault and now faces court proceedings. Pearce asserts she abandoned sex work two years ago and now works solely as Thipthorpe's carer, after initially meeting him in a cafe. Nonetheless, authorities received resident complaints at Elizabeth House—where Thipthorpe lives—indicating that Pearce's presence was causing fear and distress among other tenants; one elderly woman reportedly started locking her doors and windows during Pearce’s visits. Pearce is now facing a trial for allegedly violating the ASBO by continuing to see Thipthorpe, who is expected to be a witness in her defense. During Thipthorpe’s court appearance for the assault, his defense lawyer Rob Ross questioned whether it was necessary to give an 88-year-old a criminal record given his circumstances. District Judge Simon Cooper adjourned the case, allowing time to consider issuing a caution instead of prosecution but noted the case would move forward otherwise. Pearce’s trial on alleged ASBO breaches has also been postponed, with Thipthorpe set to testify on her behalf.
translated_content: Allan Thipthorpe, seorang mantan tentara berusia 88 tahun, merasa marah ketika pihak berwenang melarang Terri-Lee Pearce—wanita 31 tahun dengan latar belakang pekerjaan seks—untuk mengunjungi tempat tinggal lansianya. Dewan Kota Swindon mengeluarkan Anti-Social Behaviour Order (ASBO) terhadap Pearce, dengan alasan kekhawatiran atas keselamatan Thipthorpe setelah ia dikabarkan menghabiskan £5.000 untuknya. Thipthorpe bersikeras bahwa Pearce adalah perawat dan temannya, dan ia berhak menentukan cara menggunakan uangnya serta memutuskan siapa yang boleh menemuinya. Perselisihan ini memuncak ketika Thipthorpe menyerang secara fisik pengacara dewan, Francis Maples, dalam peristiwa yang terekam CCTV. Thipthorpe mengakui perbuatannya dan kini menghadapi proses pengadilan. Pearce menyatakan telah meninggalkan pekerjaan seks dua tahun lalu dan kini hanya bekerja sebagai perawat Thipthorpe, setelah mereka bertemu di sebuah kafe. Namun, pihak berwenang menerima sejumlah keluhan dari penghuni lain di Elizabeth House—tempat tinggal Thipthorpe—yang merasa takut dan tidak nyaman dengan kehadiran Pearce; seorang wanita lanjut usia bahkan mulai mengunci pintu dan jendela setiap kali Pearce datang. Pearce kini menghadapi sidang karena diduga melanggar ASBO dengan tetap mengunjungi Thipthorpe, di mana Thipthorpe akan menjadi saksi pembela. Saat Thipthorpe menjalani sidang atas kasus penyerangan, pengacaranya Rob Ross mempertanyakan perlunya pemberian catatan kriminal pada pria seusianya. Hakim Distrik Simon Cooper menunda kasus ini untuk mempertimbangkan penerbitan peringatan alih-alih penuntutan, namun menyatakan perkara akan lanjut jika tidak ada keputusan. Sidang Pearce terkait dugaan pelanggaran ASBO juga ditunda, dengan rencana kehadiran Thipthorpe sebagai saksi.

article_content: A teenage couple from Kentucky was arrested on Sunday after two weeks on the run, following a series of car and firearm thefts. Dalton Hayes, 18, and Cheyenne Phillips, 13, were apprehended in Panama City Beach, Florida, according to authorities. The pair are suspected of stealing three vehicles—two containing firearms—while traveling through several states. Their search coverage extended from Kentucky to Georgia. The couple was found sleeping in a Toyota Tundra that had been reported stolen in Georgia, according to a statement from the Grayson County Sheriff's Office. Law enforcement officers surrounded the vehicle and took both Hayes and Phillips into custody without incident. Officials are working to extradite them to Kentucky to face multiple felony charges. During the search, authorities described the young couple as 'increasingly brazen and dangerous.' Sheriff Norman Chaffins noted that Dalton had a history of 'bad decisions,' citing past disciplinary and defiance issues in high school. Hayes was recently charged with burglary and was out on bond, the sheriff said. Cheyenne Phillips was reported missing by her family on January 3 from Clarkson, Kentucky. Hayes' relatives last heard from him via text on January 6. The couple initially stole a truck in Clarkson. Jim McGrew, the truck's owner, told CNN affiliate WAVE that the teens took his truck from his garage, drove away quickly, then crashed into a fence before fleeing on foot. The incident caused approximately $7,100 in damage. An hour later, authorities say, the pair stole a Toyota Tacoma pickup truck containing a firearm. That vehicle was later found in Henry County, Georgia, south of Atlanta. This week, security footage showed the couple at a Walmart in Manning, South Carolina. Around the same time, a Toyota Tundra pickup with a Georgia firefighter license plate was reported stolen nearby. That truck contained two handguns—a .38-caliber and a .45-caliber—according to the sheriff's department.

Dalton Hayes (18) dan Cheyenne Phillips (13) diamankan di Panama City Beach, Florida, menurut pihak berwenang. Keduanya diduga mencuri tiga kendaraan—dua di antaranya berisi senjata api—saat melintas beberapa negara bagian. Pencarian mereka meluas dari Kentucky hingga Georgia. Pasangan ini ditemukan sedang tidur di Toyota Tundra yang dilaporkan dicuri di Georgia, menurut keterangan dari Grayson County Sheriff's Office. Polisi mengepung kendaraan itu dan menangkap Hayes serta Phillips tanpa perlawanan. Pejabat kini berupaya mengekstradisi mereka ke Kentucky untuk menghadapi berbagai dakwaan kejahatan. Selama pencarian, pasangan muda ini disebut pihak berwenang semakin nekat dan berbahaya. Sheriff Norman Chaffins mengatakan Dalton punya riwayat 'keputusan buruk,' termasuk masalah disiplin dan pembangkangan di sekolah menengah. article_content: Christmas arrived early for nearly 300 students in the remote Yup'ik Eskimo village of Kwethluk, Alaska, this week, thanks to the Alaska National Guard's Operation Santa Claus. Santa and Mrs. Claus, accompanied by elves and volunteers, visited the school to greet children and hand out gifts, bringing smiles and excitement to the close-knit community. Jo Katkus, chairwoman of Operation Santa Claus, noted that such visits are rare for kids in rural areas like Kwethluk, compared to cities like Anchorage where seeing Santa is commonplace. Early Wednesday morning, she and 24 volunteers loaded a military C130 cargo plane at Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson for the 300-mile flight to Bethel, before planning to continue to Kwethluk by helicopter. However, mechanical issues grounded the National Guard helicopter. Dina Banez, a program veteran, swiftly arranged an alternative by contacting Grant Aviation, a local air taxi company that generously donated a flight for part of the group and the gifts, braving strong winds to ensure the event could go ahead. Adaptability has always been part of Operation Santa Claus, which began in 1956 and brings holiday cheer to three remote villages each year—sometimes via dog sled, snowmobile, or even pickup truck. When the plane landed in Kwethluk, excitement spread through the school and across the community. Announcements brought not just students, but teachers, parents, elders, and community members to join the celebration. Assistant principal Zach Bastoky, wearing a green kupsuk—a traditional Native smock sewn for him by a colleague—helped manage the festivities. Alicia Michael, a senior, said, 'Everyone was excited because we hardly get Operation Santa, and it's fun for the kids.' Teachers led their classes, speaking in both English and Yup'ik, to meet Santa and Mrs. Claus and have their photos taken. While some of the youngest children were nervous, their nerves quickly faded as they received presents. With the Salvation Army's support, every child up to age 18 received a special gift. Presents included backpacks with school supplies, toys, toothbrushes, floss, books, and fresh fruit—exceptional treats in an area where such items are difficult to obtain. The event left a lasting impression, providing a joyful experience for children and families in Kwethluk, and reminding the community of the enduring spirit of giving and connection.
translated_content: Natal datang lebih awal untuk hampir 300 siswa di desa terpencil Yup'ik Eskimo, Kwethluk, Alaska, minggu ini, berkat Operation Santa Claus dari Garda Nasional Alaska. Santa dan Nyonya Claus, bersama para elf dan relawan, mengunjungi sekolah untuk menyapa anak-anak dan membagikan hadiah, menghadirkan senyum dan kebahagiaan untuk komunitas kecil ini. Jo Katkus, ketua Operation Santa Claus, mencatat bahwa kunjungan seperti ini jarang terjadi bagi anak-anak di daerah pedesaan seperti Kwethluk, dibandingkan kota besar seperti Anchorage di mana bertemu Santa adalah hal biasa. Rabu pagi, dia dan 24 relawan menaiki pesawat kargo militer C130 di Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson untuk perjalanan sejauh 300 mil ke Bethel, sebelum merencanakan untuk melanjutkan ke Kwethluk menggunakan helikopter. Namun, masalah mekanis membuat helikopter Garda Nasional tidak dapat digunakan. Dina Banez, relawan senior program, dengan cepat mencari alternatif dengan menghubungi Grant Aviation, perusahaan taksi udara lokal yang dengan murah hati mendonasikan penerbangan untuk sebagian rombongan dan hadiah, walaupun harus menghadapi angin kencang demi memastikan acara tetap berjalan. Kemampuan beradaptasi memang selalu menjadi bagian dari Operation Santa Claus, yang dimulai tahun 1956 dan membawa semangat Natal ke tiga desa terpencil tiap tahunnya—kadang naik kereta anjing, snowmobile, atau truk pickup. Saat pesawat mendarat di Kwethluk, kegembiraan menyebar di seluruh sekolah dan masyarakat. Pengumuman membuat bukan hanya siswa, tapi juga guru, orang tua, tetua, dan anggota komunitas lainnya bergabung merayakan acara ini. Wakil kepala sekolah Zach Bastoky, mengenakan kupsuk hijau—baju tradisional suku asli yang dibuatkan oleh rekan guru—turut membantu mengatur perayaan. Alicia Michael, murid kelas 12, berkata, 'Semua orang senang karena Operation Santa jarang datang, dan ini menyenangkan bagi anak-anak.' Guru-guru membimbing murid mereka, berbicara dalam bahasa Inggris dan Yup'ik, untuk bertemu Santa dan Nyonya Claus serta berfoto bersama. Beberapa anak kecil sempat gugup, tapi rasa itu segera hilang ketika mereka menerima hadiah. Dengan dukungan Salvation Army, setiap anak hingga usia 18 tahun mendapatkan hadiah spesial. Hadiah yang dibagikan meliputi tas punggung berisi perlengkapan sekolah, mainan, sikat gigi, benang gigi, buku, dan buah segar—barang istimewa di daerah di mana hal-hal seperti ini sulit didapatkan. Acara ini memberikan kesan mendalam, menghadirkan kebahagiaan bagi anak-anak dan keluarga di Kwethluk, sekaligus mengingatkan semua akan semangat memberi dan rasa kebersamaan.
post_content: Santa and Mrs. Claus just made Christmas extra magical for kids in the remote village of Kwethluk, Alaska! 🎅🎁 Despite wild weather and last-minute changes, Operation Santa Claus and volunteers delivered gifts, smiles, and community joy. #AlaskaMagic #OperationSanta #CommunitySpirit
translated_post: Santa dan Nyonya Claus bikin Natal makin seru di desa Kwethluk, Alaska! 🎅🎁 Meski cuaca ekstrem & ganti rencana dadakan, Operation Santa Claus tetap bawa hadiah dan kebahagiaan buat anak-anak. #NatalAlaska #OperationSanta #BersamaKomunitas

article_content: The University of Virginia (UVA) has reinstated the Phi Kappa Psi fraternity after local police investigations found no concrete evidence to back up the sexual assault claims laid out in a widely discussed Rolling Stone article. According to the Charlottesville police, the investigation did not substantiate the events described at the fraternity house. UVA President Teresa A. Sullivan stated that the university looks forward to continued collaboration with fraternities and sororities to maintain student safety. Rolling Stone's article, published in November and titled 'A Rape on Campus', focused on a student's account—identified as Jackie—who alleged that she had been assaulted by seven men during her first year at the fraternity's house. The publication brought UVA significant scrutiny and led the university to temporarily suspend all Greek activities. Shortly after the article went live, multiple journalists and critics questioned its accuracy. Reports from CNN and The Washington Post highlighted significant inconsistencies, especially regarding details of Jackie's account, discrepancies between her statements, and a noted absence of injuries matching the described attack. Moreover, Rolling Stone did not contact the men accused in the story. Amid the controversy, Rolling Stone apologized for errors in its reporting and acknowledged lapses in journalistic standards, specifically the decision not to reach out to the alleged attackers to confirm the story. Stephen Scipione, president of the UVA Phi Kappa Psi chapter, expressed that the incident prompted the fraternity to reassess its approach towards campus safety and the broader issue of sexual assault. Following the investigation's findings, UVA allowed Greek life to resume—with new rules requiring, among other measures, bans on pre-mixed drinks, security at entrances, and the presence of sober members equipped to monitor events.
translated_content: Universitas Virginia (UVA) telah mengaktifkan kembali fraternitas Phi Kappa Psi setelah hasil investigasi polisi setempat tidak menemukan bukti kuat untuk mendukung tuduhan pelecehan seksual seperti yang diberitakan Rolling Stone. Polisi Charlottesville menyatakan bahwa penyelidikan mereka tidak dapat membenarkan kejadian yang digambarkan di rumah fraternitas tersebut. Presiden UVA, Teresa A. Sullivan mengatakan universitas berkomitmen untuk terus bekerja sama dengan komunitas fraternitas dan sororitas demi menjaga keamanan mahasiswa. Artikel Rolling Stone yang terbit November lalu berjudul 'A Rape on Campus' menyoroti kisah seorang mahasiswa—disamarkan sebagai Jackie—yang mengaku diserang tujuh pria di rumah fraternitas pada tahun pertamanya. Publikasi ini memicu sorotan internasional dan membuat UVA menangguhkan sementara seluruh aktivitas komunitas Yunani. Tak lama setelah artikel rilis, sejumlah jurnalis dan pengamat mempertanyakan akurasinya. Laporan dari CNN dan The Washington Post menyoroti berbagai ketidaksesuaian, khususnya pada detail cerita Jackie, perbedaan pernyataan, serta tidak adanya cedera fisik yang sesuai dengan deskripsi serangan. Selain itu, Rolling Stone tidak menghubungi pria yang dituduh dalam artikel itu. Di tengah kontroversi, Rolling Stone meminta maaf atas kesalahan pelaporan dan mengakui kelalaian etik jurnalistik, terutama karena tidak mengonfirmasi cerita kepada pihak-pihak yang dituduh. Stephen Scipione, presiden Phi Kappa Psi UVA, mengatakan bahwa peristiwa ini mendorong fraternitas untuk meninjau ulang perannya dalam menjaga keselamatan kampus dan isu pelecehan seksual. Setelah hasil penyelidikan keluar, UVA kembali mengizinkan aktivitas Yunani, dengan aturan baru: larangan minuman campuran, keamanan pintu masuk, dan kehadiran anggota fraternitas yang sadar bertugas mengawasi acara.
post_content: UVA reinstates Phi Kappa Psi fraternity after police found no evidence supporting Rolling Stone’s assault claims. New rules are in for Greek life: no pre-mixed drinks, more security, and sober event monitors. #UVANews #CampusSafety
translated_post: UVA aktifkan lagi fraternitas Phi Kappa Psi setelah polisi tak temukan bukti serangan seperti laporan Rolling Stone. Sekarang ada aturan baru buat acara kampus: minuman campur dilarang, keamanan ditambah, & harus ada anggota sadar jagain acara! #BeritaUVA #AmanDiKampus

article_content: Three Staten Island men have been charged with violating voting rights and assaulting African-Americans on the night of Barack Obama’s 2008 presidential victory, federal authorities said Wednesday. An indictment accuses Ralph Nicoletti, 18, Michael Contreras, 18, and Brian Carranza, 21, of conspiring to interfere with voting rights; all pleaded not guilty in federal court. Prosecutors allege the three men intentionally sought to intimidate African-Americans exercising their right to vote. Nicoletti and Carranza are white; Contreras is Latino. If convicted, each faces up to ten years in prison. At arraignment, Nicoletti and Contreras were remanded without bail, while Carranza was released on a $200,000 bond and required to wear an electronic monitor. Prosecutors say that on election night, the men gathered at a makeshift clubhouse in Staten Island’s Rosebank neighborhood, and after learning of Obama’s victory, drove to Park Hill—a predominantly African-American area—with the intention of committing racially motivated assaults. Their first targeted victim was 17-year-old Ali Kamara, who was struck with a metal pipe and a collapsible police baton. Kamara suffered a concussion and leg injuries but managed to escape. The group allegedly continued to Port Richmond, attacking another African-American man and confronting a Latino man about his voting choices. They also shouted profanities about Obama at a group of African-Americans at a hair salon. Later, the group targeted Ronald Forte, who they mistakenly believed was African-American. Nicoletti allegedly swerved the car and struck Forte, who suffered severe injuries and was in a coma for 45 days, according to his mother. U.S. Attorney Benton J. Campbell condemned the attacks, emphasizing a zero-tolerance policy for violence that interferes with constitutional rights. Authorities report that Nicoletti has a lengthy violent criminal history and is a member of the 'Rosebank Crew' gang. During their investigation, police found a weapons cache and stolen police batons, as well as letters encouraging gang loyalty. According to federal documents, Nicoletti and others attacked Contreras weeks earlier, suspecting him of cooperating with law enforcement. Prosecutors have requested home confinement and drug testing for Nicoletti and Carranza. The judge has not ruled on this request.
translated_content: Tiga pria asal Staten Island didakwa melanggar hak pilih dan menyerang warga Afrika-Amerika pada malam kemenangan Barack Obama di pemilihan presiden 2008, menurut otoritas federal pada hari Rabu. Dakwaan menyebut Ralph Nicoletti (18), Michael Contreras (18), dan Brian Carranza (21) bersekongkol menghalangi hak pilih; ketiganya mengaku tidak bersalah di pengadilan federal. Jaksa menuduh ketiga pria itu secara sengaja berusaha mengintimidasi warga Afrika-Amerika yang menggunakan hak pilihnya. Nicoletti dan Carranza berkulit putih; Contreras Latino. Jika dinyatakan bersalah, mereka bisa dihukum sampai sepuluh tahun penjara. Dalam sidang dakwaan, Nicoletti dan Contreras ditahan tanpa jaminan, sementara Carranza dibebaskan dengan jaminan $200.000 dan wajib pakai alat pelacak elektronik. Menurut jaksa, pada malam pemilihan, para terdakwa berkumpul di klub darurat di kawasan Rosebank, Staten Island. Setelah mendengar kemenangan Obama, mereka pergi ke Park Hill—daerah mayoritas Afrika-Amerika—dengan niat melakukan penyerangan bermotif ras. Korban pertama mereka adalah Ali Kamara (17), yang dipukul menggunakan pipa besi dan tongkat polisi lipat. Kamara mengalami gegar otak dan cedera di kaki, tetapi berhasil lolos. Campbell mengecam serangan tersebut dan menegaskan kebijakan nol toleransi terhadap kekerasan yang mengganggu hak konstitusional. Otoritas menyebut Nicoletti punya riwayat kriminal panjang dan merupakan anggota geng 'Rosebank Crew'. Selama penyelidikan, polisi menemukan persenjataan dan tongkat polisi curian, serta surat yang mendorong kesetiaan geng. Menurut dokumen federal, Nicoletti dan lainnya menyerang Contreras beberapa minggu sebelumnya, karena curiga ia bekerja sama dengan penegak hukum. article_content: India’s oil imports from OPEC countries surged in October, reaching the highest levels in ten months. Refiners ramped up purchases from Saudi Arabia and the UAE as Russian oil discounts shrank, making Middle Eastern crude more attractive, trade data revealed. Meanwhile, Russia’s portion of India’s oil market dropped to its lowest in nine months. India brought in around 4.7 million barrels per day of crude in October, an 8.4% jump from September, mainly to meet increased festive season fuel demand. Imports from Saudi Arabia and the UAE soared to seven-month highs, up by 53% and 63% respectively from the prior month. Consequently, OPEC nations contributed 54% of India’s oil imports in October, up from 50% in September. Purchases of Russian oil averaged 1.56 million barrels per day in October, a slight 1.2% rise compared to September, but Russia’s share in India’s imports slipped from 35% to 33%. From April to October, Russia remained India’s leading oil supplier, with Iraq and Saudi Arabia following. Higher Russian imports also pushed up the share of the Commonwealth of Independent States among India’s oil sources. In a separate matter, Indian tax authorities uncovered nearly ₹10,000 crore in evaded taxes by online sellers operating through platforms such as Instagram and Facebook over the last three years, sending notices to 45 brands so far. Since 2022, the GST department has issued over 20,000 notices, leading companies to more closely examine tax obligations before finalizing mergers and acquisitions. Additionally, Nawaz Modi, estranged spouse of business executive Gautam Singhania, has accused him of assaulting her and their daughter two months ago.
translated_content: Impor minyak India dari negara-negara OPEC melonjak pada Oktober, mencapai tingkat tertinggi dalam sepuluh bulan terakhir. Para pengilangan memperbesar pembelian dari Arab Saudi dan Uni Emirat Arab setelah diskon minyak Rusia menurun, sehingga minyak mentah Timur Tengah menjadi lebih menarik, menurut data perdagangan. Di sisi lain, pangsa Rusia di pasar minyak India turun ke level terendah dalam sembilan bulan. India mengimpor sekitar 4,7 juta barel per hari minyak mentah pada Oktober, naik 8,4% dari September, terutama untuk memenuhi lonjakan permintaan bahan bakar selama musim perayaan. Impor dari Arab Saudi dan Uni Emirat Arab melonjak ke level tertinggi dalam tujuh bulan, masing-masing naik 53% dan 63% dibandingkan bulan sebelumnya. Akibatnya, negara-negara OPEC menyumbang 54% dari total impor minyak India pada Oktober, naik dari 50% di September. Pembelian minyak Rusia rata-rata 1,56 juta barel per hari pada Oktober, sedikit naik 1,2% dari September, namun pangsa Rusia di impor India turun dari 35% menjadi 33%. Dari April hingga Oktober, Rusia tetap menjadi pemasok minyak utama India, diikuti Irak dan Arab Saudi. Peningkatan impor dari Rusia juga menaikkan porsi negara-negara Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS) dalam pasokan minyak ke India. Dalam isu terpisah, otoritas pajak India menemukan hampir ₹10.000 crore penghindaran pajak oleh penjual daring di platform seperti Instagram dan Facebook selama tiga tahun terakhir, dengan 45 merek telah menerima surat pemberitahuan sejauh ini. Sejak 2022, departemen GST telah menerbitkan lebih dari 20.000 surat pemberitahuan, mendorong perusahaan untuk meninjau kembali kewajiban pajak sebelum menyelesaikan merger dan akuisisi. Selain itu, Nawaz Modi, istri yang sedang berpisah dari eksekutif bisnis Gautam Singhania, menuduhnya melakukan kekerasan terhadap dirinya dan putri mereka dua bulan lalu.

article_content: The U.S. government’s worst-case scenario for the Ebola outbreak in West Africa will not occur, according to a top health official. In September, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) estimated that, without increased assistance, the number of Ebola cases could reach as high as 1.4 million by mid-January. However, conditions have since changed. On Wednesday, CDC Director Dr. Tom Frieden stated, 'We don't think the projections from over the summer will come to pass.' Frieden did not offer new projections but made his statement during a U.S. Senate hearing on public health preparedness and response. The earlier CDC estimates reflected the situation in Liberia and Sierra Leone in late August, before a surge of international medical aid and supplies. This support appears to have slowed the outbreak in Liberia, one of the most affected countries. Despite these improvements, the epidemic remains severe in Sierra Leone and unpredictable in Guinea. When the CDC released its prior forecast, Dr. Frieden expressed confidence that the worst numbers would not materialize. He now attributes progress to rapid intervention by USAID, the CDC, the global community, and the most affected countries and communities. According to the World Health Organization, there have been over 14,000 Ebola cases and more than 5,100 deaths in this epidemic. The CDC believes that between 1,000 and 2,000 new cases are still emerging each week in West Africa, which aligns with its best-case scenario estimates for mid-January. Additionally, a Pentagon spokesperson announced that the U.S. military is reducing the number of Ebola treatment centers it will build in Liberia from 17 to 10, reflecting changes in the situation.

Namun, situasinya kini telah berubah. Pada hari Rabu, Direktur CDC Dr. Tom Frieden menyatakan, 'Kami tidak berpikir proyeksi dari musim panas lalu akan terjadi.' Frieden tidak memberikan proyeksi baru namun menyampaikan pernyataan ini dalam sidang Senat AS mengenai kesiapsiagaan dan respons terhadap ancaman kesehatan masyarakat. Perkiraan CDC sebelumnya didasarkan pada situasi di Liberia dan Sierra Leone pada akhir Agustus, sebelum ada lonjakan bantuan medis dan pasokan internasional. Dukungan ini tampaknya telah memperlambat wabah di Liberia, salah satu negara yang paling terdampak. Meski ada kemajuan, epidemi tetap serius di Sierra Leone dan tidak dapat diprediksi di Guinea. Saat CDC merilis proyeksi sebelumnya, Dr. Frieden yakin bahwa angka terburuk tidak akan terjadi. Ia kini mengaitkan kemajuan dengan intervensi cepat oleh USAID, CDC, komunitas global, serta negara dan masyarakat yang paling terdampak. Menurut Organisasi Kesehatan Dunia, wabah ini telah menyebabkan lebih dari 14.000 kasus Ebola dan lebih dari 5.100 kematian. CDC memperkirakan antara 1.000 hingga 2.000 kasus baru masih muncul setiap minggu di Afrika Barat, sesuai dengan skenario terbaik untuk pertengahan Januari. Selain itu, juru bicara Pentagon mengumumkan bahwa militer AS mengurangi jumlah pusat perawatan Ebola yang akan dibangun di Liberia dari 17 menjadi 10, menyesuaikan dengan perubahan situasi.

article_content: A Qantas Airbus A380 flight from Dubai to Sydney was forced to make an emergency landing in Perth after a sudden loss of cabin pressure. QF2 descended rapidly from 39,000 to 9,000 feet in just minutes, diverting from its planned route. Passenger Nigel Richardson documented the ordeal on Twitter, describing the crew’s professionalism and the descent as the fastest he had ever experienced. While the issue was initially thought to be an air conditioning fault, it was later clarified as a pressurization problem. Oxygen masks did not deploy, but both passengers and crew remained calm. Upon arrival, travelers waited patiently on the tarmac while the crew provided updates. The aircraft landed safely, and as repairs took place, passengers received overnight accommodation. Qantas confirmed that the crew had reached their maximum duty limits before repairs could be completed, and all travelers would be booked on the next available flights.

Awalnya, masalah diduga berasal dari AC, namun ternyata penyebabnya adalah masalah tekanan udara. Masker oksigen tidak keluar, tetapi penumpang dan kru tetap tenang. Setelah mendarat, penumpang menunggu dengan sabar di landasan sambil kru memberikan pembaruan situasi. Pesawat mendarat dengan selamat, dan selama perbaikan, penumpang difasilitasi akomodasi semalam. article_content: Colombian pop star Shakira has reached a settlement to avoid a trial in Barcelona for allegedly failing to pay 14.5 million euros ($15.7 million) in Spanish income tax between 2012 and 2014. As part of the agreement, Shakira accepted the charges and agreed to pay a fine exceeding 7.3 million euros, along with an additional 438,000 euros to avoid a three-year prison sentence, as announced during the trial's first hearing. In a statement released by her Spanish communications agency, Shakira explained, “This decision to reach a deal responds to personal, emotional and sentimental reasons that have nothing to do with legal (reasons),” adding that she was prepared to defend her innocence but prioritized her career and family. Spanish prosecutors had sought a prison term of over eight years and nearly 24 million euros in fines, alleging Shakira defrauded the Spanish state by using offshore companies and spending more than half her time in Spain from 2012 to 2014, making her liable for taxes there. Shakira’s defense maintained she lived a ‘nomadic life’ and only moved to Spain full-time in 2015. The case prompted a thorough investigation, including examination of Shakira's social media activity, personal financial transactions, and even medical records to determine her time spent in Spain. In 2021, she was named in the 'Pandora Papers', a global leak of documents related to tax avoidance strategies of wealthy individuals. Her former partner, footballer Gerard Pique, was also convicted of tax fraud in Spain in 2016 and paid 2.1 million euros. Spain has recently cracked down on tax evasion by celebrities, including Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo. Despite these legal challenges, Shakira remains active in her music career, having recently won three awards at the Latin Grammy Awards in Seville.

article_content: On October 14, 2023, sky gazers across the U.S. witnessed a rare 'ring of fire' created by an annular solar eclipse. As the Moon moved between Earth and the Sun, it produced a brilliant halo effect that captured the attention of millions. The eclipse was visible from several states, from Oregon and California down to Texas, although clouds obscured the view for some in Oregon. In parks like Phil Hardberger in San Antonio, crowds gathered early, using eclipse glasses and welder masks for safe viewing. Many spectators found the moment emotionally stirring. Jonathan Quirarte, watching from San Antonio, described feeling unexpectedly moved by the spectacle. At Bryce Canyon National Park, John Edwards traveled solo cross-country to see the event, noting how such rare occurrences bring people together. People of all backgrounds—including professional athletes like Houston Astros' Dixon Machado and NASCAR’s Tyler Reddick—shared in the event, wearing protective glasses whether at sporting events, parks, or even restaurants. Although another 'ring of fire' won't appear in the U.S. until 2039, enthusiasts can look forward to a total solar eclipse on April 8, 2024, when the Moon will fully cover the Sun. Until then, anticipation for these events remains high.

Di tempat seperti Phil Hardberger Park di San Antonio, orang-orang sudah berkumpul sejak pagi, memakai kacamata gerhana atau masker las agar mata tetap aman. Banyak penonton mengaku terpukau dan terharu dengan momen tersebut. Jonathan Quirarte di San Antonio bahkan berkata ia merasa tersentuh oleh keindahannya. Di Bryce Canyon National Park, John Edwards menempuh perjalanan seorang diri lintas negara untuk menyaksikan gerhana ini, dan menilai peristiwa langka seperti ini mampu menyatukan banyak orang. Dari berbagai kalangan—termasuk atlet profesional seperti Dixon Machado dari Houston Astros dan Tyler Reddick dari NASCAR—turut menyaksikan gerhana ini dengan kacamata pelindung, baik saat latihan olahraga, di taman, maupun restoran. Meski gerhana matahari cincin berikutnya baru hadir di AS pada 2039, para penggemar astronomi bisa menantikan gerhana matahari total pada 8 April 2024, saat Bulan benar-benar menutupi Matahari. article_content: Two weeks ago, Ivanka Trump was seen arriving at Kim Kardashian's birthday party in Beverly Hills. This Wednesday, she entered a Manhattan courthouse to testify in her father's business fraud trial. These two moments illustrate the contrasting aspects of Ivanka Trump's life: her efforts to reclaim a private existence, and the ongoing complexities surrounding her family's business and legacy. Since Donald Trump's presidency ended, Ivanka, 42, has worked to distance herself from her father's political sphere. When he announced his latest campaign, she promptly declared she would not participate: 'This time around, I am choosing to prioritise my young children and the private life we are creating as a family. I do not plan to be involved in politics.' Despite these intentions, Ivanka has found herself drawn back into the public eye as the New York attorney general pursues a high-profile civil fraud case against her father, siblings, and the Trump Organization. While not a defendant herself, Ivanka's testimony carries significant implications for her personal and professional reputation. On the stand, Ivanka maintained a careful distance from her father's business dealings, frequently stating that she could 'not recall' details of transactions she once oversaw. Some view this as a strategic move to limit her exposure. Dan Alexander, Forbes editor and author of 'White House, Inc.: How Donald Trump Turned the Presidency Into a Business', commented, 'There's no way that she walks out of this trial further distanced from the controversies surrounding her father ... it's going to be an uncomfortable place for her.' Ivanka built her image as a socialite and businesswoman backed by the Trump name, which once signified wealth and privilege. She graced magazine covers, fashion runways, and red carpets, often alongside figures like Chelsea Clinton. According to Alexander, both she and her father excel at self-promotion, though their images differ: Donald as strong and self-made, Ivanka as accomplished, family-focused, and successful. Ivanka played a substantial role in developing major Trump properties such as the Doral golf course in Florida and the Old Post Office hotel in Washington, D.C. But during her father's polarising presidency, media and public attitudes towards her shifted. She became a top campaign surrogate, then a senior adviser, advocating policies like paid family leave and sentencing reform. Nonetheless, scrutiny of her actions increased, particularly among New York's cultural and political elite. Her public image evolved over time. Once the face of her own clothing line, Ivanka was parodied by 'Saturday Night Live' in 2017 as 'Complicit.' The Trump administration endured controversies, infighting, and impeachment proceedings, culminating in the Capitol riot after the 2020 election, clouding her political contributions. Since leaving Washington, Ivanka has kept a low profile. Despite occasional rumors about a political run, she has remained uninvolved in politics or her father's 2024 campaign, unlike her brothers Donald Jr. and Eric. Ivanka and her husband Jared Kushner relocated their family to a private Miami-area neighborhood dubbed 'Billionaire's Bunker.' Kushner, who also served as a senior adviser, has similarly stepped back from politics and recently secured significant investment for his private equity firm from Saudi Arabia's wealth fund. Ivanka's recent presence at high-profile social events, like Kim Kardashian's birthday party, suggests she may be re-entering elite circles. Kardashian even posted a photo together, expressing gratitude for their friendship. For a moment, Ivanka's life seemed poised to return to its pre-2015 path. To separate herself from the fraud case, Ivanka hired her own legal counsel and successfully petitioned to be removed as a defendant after initially being named in the lawsuit by Attorney General Letitia James. She sought to avoid testifying, citing childcare responsibilities, but her appeal was denied. Returning to the Manhattan courthouse, Ivanka sat before Judge Arthur Engoron and faced detailed questions about the Trump Organization's financial dealings. Despite not being able to avoid testifying, she aimed to dissociate herself from the company's practices, repeatedly stating she could not recall specifics about transactions or correspondence related to the disputed loans. Reflecting on a document from more than a decade prior, she remarked, 'It's bringing back a lot of memories.'

Rabu ini, ia memasuki pengadilan Manhattan untuk memberikan kesaksian dalam sidang penipuan bisnis ayahnya. Dua momen ini memperlihatkan kontras kehidupan Ivanka: usahanya kembali ke kehidupan pribadi, dan kerumitan yang masih membayangi bisnis dan warisan keluarganya. Sejak masa kepresidenan Donald Trump berakhir, Ivanka, 42 tahun, berusaha menjauh dari dunia politik ayahnya. Saat ia mengumumkan kampanye terbarunya, Ivanka langsung menegaskan tidak akan terlibat: 'Kali ini, saya memilih untuk memprioritaskan anak-anak saya yang masih kecil dan kehidupan pribadi yang kami bangun sebagai keluarga. Saya tidak berencana terlibat dalam politik.' Meskipun demikian, Ivanka kembali menjadi sorotan publik ketika jaksa agung New York mengajukan gugatan penipuan sipil terhadap ayahnya, saudara-saudaranya, dan Trump Organization. Walaupun bukan terdakwa, kesaksiannya sangat berpengaruh pada reputasi pribadi dan profesionalnya. Ivanka membangun citra diri sebagai sosialita dan pebisnis dengan nama belakang Trump—dulu identik dengan kekayaan dan privilese. Pemerintahan Trump sarat kontroversi, konflik internal, pemakzulan, hingga kerusuhan Capitol pasca pemilu 2020, semua itu membayangi kiprah politik Ivanka. Sejak keluar dari Washington, Ivanka menjaga profil rendah. Meski rumor pencalonan politik muncul, ia tetap jauh dari politik dan tidak terlibat dalam kampanye ayahnya 2024, tidak seperti kedua saudaranya, Donald Jr. dan Eric. Kehadiran Ivanka di acara sosial bergengsi seperti pesta ulang tahun Kim Kardashian menunjukkan ia mungkin kembali ke lingkungan elite. Kardashian bahkan mengunggah foto bersama dan menulis rasa syukur atas persahabatan mereka. Sesaat, kehidupan Ivanka tampak seperti akan kembali ke masa sebelum 2015. Untuk memisahkan diri dari kasus ini, Ivanka menyewa pengacara sendiri dan berhasil dicoret dari daftar terdakwa setelah sebelumnya disebut dalam gugatan Jaksa Letitia James. Ia berusaha menghindari keharusan bersaksi dengan dalih mengurus anak, namun bandingnya ditolak. Akhirnya, Ivanka kembali ke pengadilan Manhattan, duduk di depan Hakim Arthur Engoron menghadapi pertanyaan detail soal keuangan Trump Organization. Walau tak bisa menghindari kesaksian, ia berusaha menjaga jarak dari praktik bisnis perusahaan itu, berkali-kali menyatakan tak ingat rincian transaksi atau email terkait pinjaman yang disengketakan. Saat menatap dokumen lebih dari satu dekade lalu, ia berkata, 'Banyak kenangan yang muncul kembali.'

article_content: Cristiano Ronaldo, amid Manchester United’s current challenges, has spoken warmly about his former club and a possible future return. 'I love Manchester,' Ronaldo says, emphasizing that the city and the club are close to his heart. He fondly remembers the friendships and support he received there and hopes to go back one day. These comments were made during a promotional event in Madrid, where Ronaldo teamed up with Formula 1 champion Jenson Button for a Tag Heuer event, driving a McLaren supercar. After an exciting day, Ronaldo spoke about his happiness at Real Madrid, where he still has four years left on his contract, but acknowledged that football is unpredictable: 'You never know what the future holds.' Ronaldo praised Manchester United’s recent signings, such as Angel Di Maria and Radamel Falcao. He believes these players will strengthen the team and is confident that United will rise again, calling it 'a great club.' Ronaldo reflected on United’s difficult last season and slow start this year but remains optimistic about their future. He also expressed disappointment about key player departures from Real Madrid, mentioning Di Maria, Mesut Ozil, and Xabi Alonso. Although not entirely happy with the sales, Ronaldo stated that he respects the club president’s decisions and acknowledged that the team’s playing style may change, either for better or worse. Now 29, Ronaldo has scored an impressive 255 goals in 250 games for Real Madrid. After a remarkable season winning the Ballon d'Or and helping Real Madrid secure the Champions League title, he continues to aim for even greater success. He thanked his teammates and set ambitious goals for the coming season. Ronaldo also talked about his family, especially his four-year-old son, Cristiano Jr. He hopes his son might one day become a professional footballer but realizes that such dreams can’t be forced. Having his son present at the Ballon d'Or ceremony was an especially emotional moment. Lastly, Ronaldo praised Gareth Bale for his contributions to Real Madrid and welcomed new signing James Rodriguez. He reaffirmed his dedication to football and advised young players to always be serious and committed to achieve success.

article_content: Ride-sharing companies Uber and Lyft have agreed to pay $328 million to settle claims that they underpaid New York drivers and withheld benefits. This settlement follows a lengthy investigation by the New York attorney general, who called it the largest wage theft case her office has handled. As part of the settlement, New York drivers will now receive guaranteed paid sick leave. Uber described the agreement as 'landmark,' while Lyft called it a 'win for drivers.' Under the settlement's terms, Uber will pay $290 million, and Lyft will pay $38 million. Neither company admitted fault or wrongdoing. Both firms welcomed the resolution. The case highlighted a broader debate about whether ride-share drivers should be classified as employees or independent contractors. Attorney General Letitia James said in a statement that 'Uber and Lyft systematically underpaid their drivers, many of whom come from immigrant communities, depriving them of pay and benefits while they worked long hours.' The investigation found that Uber and Lyft improperly deducted taxes and fees from drivers, instead of from passengers, between 2014 and 2017. The companies also failed to provide paid sick leave in accordance with New York law. Eligible drivers are encouraged to file claims to recover back pay and benefits. The settlement is expected to benefit over 100,000 drivers. Uber will also pay an undisclosed amount into New York State's unemployment insurance fund, allowing drivers and delivery workers to access unemployment benefits. Under the new agreement, New York City drivers for Uber can receive up to 56 hours of paid sick leave annually. Drivers outside NYC will get one hour of sick leave per 30 hours worked and a minimum wage of $26 per hour. The current earnings standards in New York City will remain in effect. Lyft's New York drivers can also accrue paid sick leave, while those outside the city will earn at least $26 per hour during active work time. A similar legal development occurred in 2021, when the UK Supreme Court ruled Uber drivers must be treated as workers, granting them greater employment rights. After the settlement announcement, Uber's stock rose by 5.2% and Lyft's by 7.1% in early trading.
translated_content: Perusahaan ride-sharing Uber dan Lyft telah sepakat membayar $328 juta untuk menyelesaikan klaim bahwa mereka membayar kurang kepada pengemudi di New York dan menahan manfaat mereka. Jaksa Agung Letitia James menyatakan bahwa 'Uber dan Lyft secara sistematis membayar kurang kepada para pengemudi mereka, banyak dari mereka berasal dari komunitas imigran, sehingga kehilangan upah dan manfaat meskipun bekerja jam panjang.' Investigasi menemukan Uber dan Lyft memotong pajak dan biaya secara tidak benar dari pengemudi, bukan dari penumpang, antara 2014 dan 2017. Perusahaan juga gagal memberikan cuti sakit berbayar sesuai hukum New York. Pengemudi yang memenuhi syarat didorong untuk mengajukan klaim guna mendapatkan pembayaran dan manfaat yang tertunda. Penyelesaian ini diperkirakan menguntungkan lebih dari 100.000 pengemudi. Uber juga akan membayar jumlah yang tidak disebutkan ke dana asuransi pengangguran Negara Bagian New York, sehingga pengemudi dan pekerja pengantaran dapat mengakses manfaat pengangguran. Berdasarkan kesepakatan baru ini, pengemudi Uber di New York City bisa menerima hingga 56 jam cuti sakit berbayar per tahun. Pengemudi di luar NYC akan mendapatkan satu jam cuti sakit setiap 30 jam kerja dan upah minimum $26 per jam. Standar pendapatan yang berlaku di New York City tetap berlaku. Pengemudi Lyft di New York juga dapat mengakumulasi cuti sakit berbayar, sementara di luar kota akan mendapat setidaknya $26 per jam selama jam aktif. Perkembangan hukum serupa terjadi pada 2021, ketika Mahkamah Agung Inggris memutuskan pengemudi Uber harus dianggap sebagai pekerja dengan hak lebih besar. Setelah pengumuman penyelesaian ini, saham Uber naik 5,2% dan Lyft naik 7,1% pada perdagangan awal.

article_content: NBCUniversal has argued that a federal rule does not create an absolute ban on audio and video coverage of former President Donald Trump's upcoming criminal trial on election conspiracy charges. In a recent legal filing, NBCUniversal's attorneys, led by Theodore Boutrous, stated, 'Although the government argues that settled law prohibits this kind of coverage, that is incorrect. There is no valid reason for such a complete ban on video and audio here—especially since former President Trump himself has now urged this Court to allow such coverage, thereby addressing any concerns about his due process rights to a fair trial.' This filing responds to opposition from Special Counsel Jack Smith, who argued that televised proceedings should be denied, in part because Trump could exploit video coverage for publicity or turn the trial into a spectacle. NBCUniversal's legal team contends, 'But the risk of misbehavior by the defendant cannot serve as a reason to bar all video and audio coverage. This Court possesses ample authority to ensure both decorum and fairness.' NBCUniversal maintains that U.S. District Judge Tanya Chutkan has the authority to permit video coverage. The federal rule in question prohibits 'the taking of photographs in the courtroom during judicial proceedings or the broadcasting of judicial proceedings from the courtroom.' However, NBCUniversal argues this does not prohibit video or audio recordings for distribution outside the courtroom, or providing a publicly accessible audio feed.  Earlier on the same day, a media coalition including CNN, C-SPAN, and The New York Times argued that the court's interpretation of the rule raises First Amendment concerns. Their filing asserts that 'well-established constitutional speech rights include the act of making audiovisual recordings,' citing legal precedent. Smith had previously claimed that the longstanding Rule 53 clearly prohibits both photographs and broadcasts from federal courtrooms. The media coalition's legal team argued, 'Of all trials conducted in American history, this one needs public trust that only a televised proceeding can foster. Because the Constitution allows—indeed requires—such access here, the Federal Rules cannot prohibit it.' The coalition noted the court's decision to allow audiovisual access to federal court proceedings during the COVID-19 pandemic as a relevant precedent. They argue that in a case affecting the national electorate, meaningful public access cannot be achieved through in-person attendance alone, and assert that Rule 53 must yield to a constitutional challenge in this instance. The coalition further argues that because Trump is not only a former president but also an active candidate for the presidency, public scrutiny of his trial is essential for democracy. Trump's legal team supports camera access, while Smith argues this is an attempt to sway public opinion and turn the proceedings into a media event. NBCUniversal is making a slightly different legal point by stating that the Federal Rule prohibits broadcasting only 'from the courtroom,' not the use of a media pool camera with the feed distributed to external locations. The rule also does not prevent the judge from using court equipment to record proceedings that networks can then use. The coalition's filing also supports NBCUniversal's argument but centers on the constitutional issue if the court views Rule 53 as blocking audiovisual access. Trump's trial is scheduled to begin on March 4. Reporters covering pre-trial proceedings have not been allowed to use electronic devices within the D.C. federal courtroom but are allowed to do so in overflow rooms with video access. The public is allocated some seats in the main courtroom and overflow rooms. Given the federal courts' historic reluctance, it remains unlikely that Judge Chutkan or the Judicial Conference will allow televised access or make exceptions to long-standing rules.
translated_content: NBCUniversal berpendapat bahwa aturan federal tidak secara mutlak melarang liputan audio dan video dalam sidang pidana mantan Presiden Donald Trump atas tuduhan konspirasi pemilu yang akan datang. Dalam dokumen hukum terbaru, tim pengacara NBCUniversal yang dipimpin Theodore Boutrous menyatakan, 'Meskipun pemerintah berpendapat bahwa hukum yang berlaku melarang jenis liputan ini, itu tidak benar. Tidak ada alasan yang sah untuk larangan penuh terhadap video dan audio di sini—terutama karena mantan Presiden Trump sendiri kini telah meminta Pengadilan untuk mengizinkan liputan semacam itu, sehingga mengatasi kekhawatiran terkait hak proses hukum yang adil baginya.' Dokumen ini merupakan tanggapan atas penolakan dari Penasihat Khusus Jack Smith, yang berpendapat bahwa sidang tidak boleh disiarkan, sebagian karena Trump dapat memanfaatkannya untuk publikasi atau mengubah persidangan menjadi tontonan. Tim hukum NBCUniversal menegaskan, 'Namun, risiko perilaku tidak patut dari terdakwa tidak bisa dijadikan alasan untuk melarang seluruh liputan video dan audio. Pengadilan ini memiliki kewenangan yang cukup untuk menjaga ketertiban dan keadilan.' NBCUniversal menyatakan bahwa Hakim Distrik AS Tanya Chutkan memiliki wewenang untuk mengizinkan liputan video. Aturan federal yang dimaksud melarang 'pengambilan foto di ruang sidang selama proses peradilan atau penyiaran proses peradilan langsung dari ruang sidang.' Namun, NBCUniversal berpendapat aturan ini tidak melarang perekaman video atau audio untuk penayangan di luar ruang sidang, atau menyediakan saluran audio yang dapat diakses publik. Pada hari yang sama, koalisi media yang terdiri dari CNN, C-SPAN, dan The New York Times menyatakan bahwa interpretasi pengadilan terhadap aturan tersebut menimbulkan kekhawatiran atas Amandemen Pertama. Dalam dokumen mereka dijelaskan bahwa 'hak berbicara secara konstitusional yang telah mapan mencakup pembuatan rekaman audiovisual,' mengutip preseden hukum. Jack Smith sebelumnya menyatakan bahwa Rule 53 yang telah lama berlaku jelas melarang pengambilan foto dan siaran dari ruang sidang federal. Tim hukum koalisi media berpendapat, 'Dari semua persidangan dalam sejarah Amerika, persidangan ini membutuhkan kepercayaan publik yang hanya bisa didapat lewat siaran. Karena Konstitusi memperbolehkan—bahkan mewajibkan—akses tersebut, Aturan Federal tidak bisa melarangnya.' Koalisi juga menyoroti keputusan pengadilan untuk mengizinkan akses audiovisual pada persidangan federal selama pandemi COVID-19 sebagai preseden relevan. Mereka berpandangan dalam kasus berdampak nasional, akses publik bermakna tak cukup hanya melalui kehadiran langsung dan menegaskan bahwa Rule 53 harus ditantang secara konstitusional dalam kasus ini. Koalisi itu menambahkan bahwa karena Trump bukan hanya mantan presiden, tetapi juga kandidat presiden aktif, pengawasan publik terhadap persidangannya sangat penting bagi demokrasi. Tim hukum Trump mendukung akses kamera, sementara Smith menganggap ini upaya untuk memengaruhi opini publik dan menjadikan sidang sebagai tontonan media. NBCUniversal menyoroti argumen hukum berbeda dengan menyatakan bahwa Aturan Federal hanya melarang penyiaran 'dari ruang sidang', bukan penggunaan kamera bersama yang hasilnya disiarkan ke luar ruang sidang. Aturan tersebut juga tidak melarang hakim memakai peralatan pengadilan untuk merekam persidangan dan kemudian digunakan jaringan media. Pengajuan koalisi media juga mendukung argumen NBCUniversal tetapi lebih menyoroti isu konstitusional jika pengadilan menafsirkan Rule 53 sebagai penghalang akses audiovisual. Sidang Trump dijadwalkan mulai 4 Maret. Jurnalis yang meliput sidang pendahuluan dilarang memakai perangkat elektronik di ruang sidang federal D.C., namun diizinkan menggunakannya di ruang overflow dengan akses video. Publik juga mendapat jatah kursi di ruang sidang utama dan ruang overflow. Melihat sejarah peradilan federal yang cenderung menolak kamera, kecil kemungkinan Hakim Chutkan atau Judicial Conference bakal mengizinkan siaran langsung atau membuat pengecualian dari aturan lama.

article_content: Brian FitzGerald, CEO of Overseas Adventure Travel (OAT), recently participated on a cruise commemorating the 65th anniversary of parent company Grand Circle. A new survey by Solo Traveler and OAT indicates that solo travel will be a major trend in 2024. If you’ve ever considered traveling alone, you’re not alone. The survey revealed that 68% of participants identify as independent travelers—a notable change from previous years, when single supplements often doubled the cost of a cruise or tour, making solo trips less accessible. Will 2024 mark the rise of solo travel? To find out, OAT’s CEO Brian FitzGerald shared his insights on the survey results and their potential impact on upcoming vacation plans. FitzGerald observes that the solo travel trend has grown steadily over the past decade. OAT data shows 27% of travelers went solo in 2017, increasing to 39% in 2019, 47% in 2021, and surpassing 50% now. Post-pandemic, many people are eager to travel even without companions, seeking to make up for lost opportunities. Life transitions such as retirement particularly drive solo travel, especially among women. Many find solo trips a great opportunity to meet people, often through group tours or shared lodging. For hesitant potential solo travelers, FitzGerald recommends joining small groups, combining independence with the social benefits of group travel. Nearly half of surveyed solo travelers prefer group settings for the company. To overcome fears of traveling alone, FitzGerald suggests that travelers connect with others ahead of time, for example through online groups, and work with providers offering support throughout their trip. Having knowledgeable staff available in case of emergencies also builds confidence. The single supplement, which increases costs for solo travelers, remains a major challenge. FitzGerald explains this fee reflects the additional accommodation costs, but OAT strives to keep it lower than the industry average. In 2023, 90% of OAT's 23,000 solo travelers paid no supplement. For a 10-day cruise, OAT’s single supplement ranges between $700 and $800. Solo travelers may also face challenges integrating into groups. Operators address this by limiting group size, fostering a sense of camaraderie, and including more solo travelers, which helps build connections. The travel industry is adapting to solo travelers by designing hotels with shared spaces like open-air lounges, game rooms, and bars, and offering group activities such as cooking classes and cocktail demonstrations. Some hotels provide free transportation to local towns for independent exploration. Survey data shows that 85% of solo travelers are women. FitzGerald observes that women from various backgrounds—single, widowed, and married—often travel solo and enjoy connecting with locals and other travelers. OAT has responded by adding 24,000 single spaces for 2024, most with no or low single supplements. Their trip leaders are specially trained to support solo travelers’ unique needs. For those thinking of trying solo travel in 2024, FitzGerald advises embracing the experience, noting that most first-time solo travelers are eager for a repeat after their initial trip. Group tours allow travelers to relax while guides handle logistics, and many appreciate the added security and new experiences. With more people living longer and prioritizing travel and experiences, solo travel is expected to grow further. OAT now has just over 50% solo travelers, and FitzGerald anticipates this proportion will continue rising.

Survei baru dari Solo Traveler dan OAT mengindikasikan bahwa perjalanan solo akan menjadi tren utama di tahun 2024. Jika kamu pernah ingin bepergian sendiri, kamu tidak sendirian. Survei tersebut menunjukkan bahwa 68% peserta mengidentifikasi diri sebagai pelancong mandiri—perubahan besar dibanding tahun-tahun sebelumnya, saat single supplement sering melipatgandakan biaya wisata dan membuat perjalanan solo kurang terjangkau. Menurut FitzGerald, tren perjalanan solo telah meningkat stabil dalam sepuluh tahun terakhir. Data OAT: 27% tamu mereka melakukan perjalanan solo pada 2017, 39% di 2019, 47% pada 2021, dan kini lebih dari 50%. Pasca pandemi, banyak orang ingin segera berwisata meski harus pergi sendiri. Transisi hidup seperti pensiun jadi pendorong penting tren ini, terutama di kalangan perempuan. Banyak yang merasa perjalanan solo adalah kesempatan bertemu teman baru melalui tur grup atau penginapan sharing. Untuk pelancong solo yang masih ragu, FitzGerald menyarankan ikut grup kecil agar tetap menikmati kemandirian sekaligus bersosialisasi. Hampir separuh responden pelancong solo dalam survei menyukai kebersamaan dalam grup. Untuk mengatasi rasa takut bepergian sendiri, FitzGerald menyarankan membangun hubungan sejak awal, misal lewat grup Facebook, serta memilih agen perjalanan yang mendampingi dari kedatangan sampai pulang. Staf yang andal juga meningkatkan rasa percaya diri, terutama saat terjadi hal tak terduga. Single supplement—biaya tambahan bagi pelancong solo—jadi tantangan utama. FitzGerald menjelaskan biaya ini wajar karena kamar sendiri, tapi OAT berupaya menawarkan lebih murah dibanding rata-rata industri. Tahun 2023, 90% dari 23.000 tamu solo OAT mendapat single supplement gratis. Untuk pelayaran 10 hari, single supplement OAT berkisar antara $700 hingga $800. Tantangan lain ialah beradaptasi dengan grup. Operator menanganinya dengan membatasi jumlah peserta, membangun nuansa kekeluargaan dan banyak peserta solo, sehingga mudah bersosialisasi. Industri pariwisata kini juga beradaptasi—hotel merancang ruang bersama seperti lounge terbuka, ruang permainan, bar, dan menyediakan aktivitas grup seperti kelas memasak atau demo koktail. Ada juga hotel yang menyediakan transportasi gratis untuk eksplorasi kota. Survei menunjukkan 85% pelancong solo adalah perempuan. FitzGerald menyoroti, perempuan dari berbagai latar belakang—lajang, janda, bahkan menikah—sering bepergian tanpa pasangan dan suka berinteraksi dengan warga lokal atau pelancong lain. OAT telah menambah 24.000 slot single untuk 2024, mayoritas tanpa atau dengan single supplement rendah. Pemandu perjalanan mereka juga dilatih khusus untuk mendukung pelancong solo. Untuk yang ingin mencoba wisata solo tahun 2024, FitzGerald menyarankan ambil kesempatan itu karena kebanyakan orang ingin mengulang pengalaman pertama mereka. Tur grup memberikan rasa aman dan kepercayaan diri, dan banyak orang menikmati pengalaman baru yang didapat. Dengan semakin banyak orang berumur panjang dan lebih mengutamakan pengalaman, tren perjalanan solo diprediksi akan terus naik. Saat ini, lebih dari 50% pelancong OAT adalah solo, dan FitzGerald optimis jumlahnya akan terus bertambah.

article_content: Phnom Penh, Cambodia (CNN) -- Cambodia's main opposition party has rejected the results of the recent national election, which gave another term to long-term Prime Minister Hun Sen. The Cambodia National Rescue Party (CNRP) stated Monday that voting was marked by irregularities and called for an investigation. Cambodians voted on Sunday. Preliminary results from the National Election Committee showed the opposition won 55 seats, not enough to unseat the ruling Cambodian People's Party (CPP), which secured 68 seats. Opposition leader Sam Rainsy called for a committee, including representatives from the main political parties, the election commission, and international observers, to investigate 'serious election irregularities.' He said that after the committee reports, political leaders from both sides should work together to remedy injustices experienced by the Cambodian people. Hun Sen has served as prime minister for 28 years. Nonetheless, opposition groups were encouraged. The two largest opposition parties merged to form the CNRP, hoping to gain enough votes to challenge the ruling party. More than 9 million people were eligible to vote. Excitement increased on Friday when Sam Rainsy returned from exile in France. He left Cambodia in 2009 to avoid imprisonment on charges of spreading disinformation, charges widely seen as politically motivated. International pressure led to his royal pardon last week, but he arrived too late to become a candidate. The National Election Committee insisted it made efforts to ensure the election was fair. 'In preparing for this year’s election, we started in the middle of 2012,' said Tep Nytha, the committee’s secretary general, before the vote.

article_content: Muhammad Ali has publicly dismissed rumors about his health, responding to speculation that he is near death or unable to speak. The boxing icon, age 72 and living with Parkinson’s disease, appeared in good spirits as he posted a smiling selfie on Instagram on Saturday. Donning a red Louisville shirt, Ali supported the Cardinals as they played against the Kentucky Wildcats, writing, '#Louisville Game Day! Go Cards!' Ali, who has lived with Parkinson's for 30 years, reportedly watched the Louisville Cardinals win 44-40 over Kentucky at home in Louisville. The win ensured the Cardinals secured the Governor’s Cup and a bowl game appearance. Despite claims in October suggesting Ali could barely speak or leave home, Ali and his family have countered these rumors with reassuring updates. Since he created his Instagram account three weeks ago, Ali has shared nine photos and gained more than 120,000 followers, adding to his substantial presence on Twitter and Facebook. 'I Am Ali,' a documentary about his life directed by Clare Lewins, was recently released. Ali’s absence from the Hollywood premiere sparked renewed concerns over his health. His brother Rahman, 71, expressed worry about not speaking to Ali because of his illness. Days later, however, Ali dispelled rumors by posting a smiling selfie in Virginia, stating, 'Don't believe the hype. Feeling great earlier today at @BoarsHeadResort. #AliSelfie.' Ali’s daughter, Hana, and half-sister, Maryum, have also reassured the public, confirming that Ali is 'doing fine' and not bedridden. Ali’s career is legendary: he won his first heavyweight world title in 1964 as Cassius Clay by defeating Sonny Liston, entered the boxing world with flair, and became known for the phrase, 'float like a butterfly, sting like a bee.' After converting to Islam and becoming Muhammad Ali, he faced off against George Foreman, Leon Spinks, Chuck Wepner, and Doug Jones, holding the title multiple times. Even after his Parkinson’s diagnosis, Ali made memorable public appearances, lighting the Olympic flame at Atlanta 1996. In his later years, he was seen looking frail during the 2012 London Olympic opening ceremony with support from his wife, Lonnie. Family opinions on Ali’s care and condition have varied. While his brother Rahman raised concerns, daughter May May reported he was in good spirits and speaking well while watching the Super Bowl. His son, Ali Jr., voiced pessimism about the effect of the disease. Still, Ali and his immediate family have maintained that he remains positive. 'I Am Ali' was released in U.S. cinemas in October and is now available in the UK.

article_content: Many homeowners look to dogs as effective protectors, but one pet owner took things a step further by dressing their Dogue de Bordeaux in a lion's mane costume. In two photos shared on Twitter, the dog is seen standing guard near a front gate and later sitting on a bed looking puzzled, both times wearing the mane. These pet costumes, which can be bought online for around £5, fit both cats and dogs. The photos were posted by Twitter user @cuteoverloads, who joked, 'Ordered a lion off eBay & they sent me this.' Dressing dogs as lions is not a new trend—last year, a Chinese zoo came under fire for presenting a Tibetan mastiff as a lion and placing other dogs in various animal enclosures. The zoo attempted to style the dogs’ fur to appear more wild, while this Dogue de Bordeaux’s lion look was achieved simply with a costume. The article invites readers to share their own pet dress-up photos by sending them to chris.pleasance@mailonline.co.uk.

article_content: COP28, the annual United Nations climate summit, is set to draw over 70,000 participants to Dubai, marking it as the largest such gathering to date. Delegates will address urgent topics like reducing fossil fuel reliance, strengthening plans for adapting to climate impacts, formulating global carbon market standards, and establishing a new climate fund for vulnerable nations. This year’s summit takes place amid intensifying climate emergencies worldwide, including historic heatwaves and disasters like Libya’s Storm Daniel and wildfires in Hawaii. Despite longtime efforts, global emission reductions still fall short of international targets. A crucial feature of COP28 is the first official review of progress since the 2015 Paris Agreement, which saw most nations pledge to keep global temperature rises in check. Yet, assessments show that current commitments are not enough to achieve these goals. Hosted at Expo City Dubai, COP28 is led by Dr Sultan Ahmed Al Jaber, the head of both the UAE's state oil company and the renewable energy firm Masdar—a combination that has stirred debate regarding neutrality. High-profile absentees include China’s President Xi Jinping and U.S. President Joe Biden. However, leaders like India’s Narendra Modi, France’s Emmanuel Macron, and U.S. climate envoy John Kerry are among the prominent attendees. Over two weeks, negotiators, ministers, business leaders, and civil society representatives will work to reach consensus on major climate actions. A top priority will be establishing a new, larger climate finance target beyond the outgoing $100 billion annual commitment, as future requirements are projected to exceed this several-fold. Wealthier countries aim for deeper promises, such as a rapid shift away from fossil fuels and emission reduction peaks by 2025, though this poses challenges for developing economies that depend on coal, oil, and gas. The summit’s initial days will likely see announcements on curbing methane, advancing sustainable food systems, and launching sizeable investments in climate-friendly technologies. Despite past challenges and stalemates at previous COP summits, hope is renewed by a recent China-U.S. joint statement for greater cooperation on renewables and climate action. Whether COP28 can turn these ambitions into a strong, inclusive agreement remains the key question.

Konferensi tahun ini terjadi di tengah eskalasi keadaan darurat iklim di berbagai belahan dunia, seperti gelombang panas terburuk dan bencana alam—termasuk badai Daniel di Libya dan kebakaran hutan di Hawaii. Meski upaya sudah berlangsung lama, penurunan emisi global masih belum memenuhi target ambisius dunia. COP28 yang berlangsung di Expo City Dubai dipimpin Dr Sultan Ahmed Al Jaber, sosok yang menjabat kepala perusahaan minyak negara UEA sekaligus perusahaan energi terbarukan Masdar — kondisi yang memunculkan perdebatan soal netralitas kepemimpinannya. Salah satu prioritas adalah penetapan target pendanaan iklim baru pasca US$100 miliar per tahun, sebab kebutuhan mendatang akan jauh lebih besar. Walau COP terdahulu seringkali berujung buntu, optimisme tumbuh setelah Tiongkok dan AS menyatakan siap memperkuat kolaborasi di bidang energi terbarukan dan pengendalian emisi. article_content: YouTube star Grace Helbig is set to make her television debut as the host of 'The Grace Helbig Project' on E!. The show is described as a hybrid comedy talk show featuring Helbig's unique perspective on trending topics in pop culture and exclusive interviews with celebrity guests. Helbig has attracted over 2 million subscribers to her 'It's Grace' YouTube channel, where she uploads three videos each week. Her popularity online has earned her both fame and financial success. 'The Grace Helbig Project' will premiere in April as part of E!'s expanded programming lineup. Jeff Olde, executive vice president of original programming and development at E!, called the new show 'a fresh take on the conventional talk show with a very unconventional host,' highlighting Helbig's large and youthful online following. Olde said, 'As we continue to seek out programming that offers a rich multiplatform experience, we are excited to launch this forward-thinking talk show that speaks directly to our audience and embodies E!'s pop culture brand.' In addition to her YouTube career, Helbig is the author of 'Grace's Guide: The Art of Pretending to Be a Grown-up.' She commented on her new venture, joking, 'Congratulations to E! for giving an Internet-obsessed introvert a talk show. I'm looking forward to working with humans.'

article_content: A series of online games called 'Re-Mission 2' is helping teen and young adult cancer patients better understand their illness while making treatments feel more engaging. Developed by HopeLab, a nonprofit organization, these minigames are designed to empower young patients and motivate them to stick with their treatment. This initiative was inspired by the positive effects observed with HopeLab’s first game, 'Re-Mission,' released in 2006, which research showed boosted motivation and a sense of control for players. According to Dr. Steve Cole, vice president at HopeLab and UCLA professor, the original game worked by activating key motivation pathways in the brain, which guided the development of 'Re-Mission 2.' In the new games, players face cancer head-on by using virtual versions of chemotherapy, targeted cancer drugs, and the body’s immune cells as weapons against the disease. A 2008 study confirmed that many patients aged 13 to 29 struggle to follow their treatment regimens, yet playing these games led to higher rates of adherence and improved understanding of their medications. HopeLab spokesperson Richard Tate noted that cancer can disrupt a young person’s life, but these games allow patients to feel actively involved in fighting their illness, regaining a sense of control. The creation of 'Re-Mission 2' involved collaboration with many game designers, as well as former cancer patients like Brooke Jaffe, a student at Barnard College, and Justin Lambert, who studies nursing at Concordia University. Both contributed to conceptual art and game testing, and both emphasized the psychological benefit of seeing cancer treatment from the inside, helping make the process more relatable and hopeful. Dr. Brandon Hayes-Lattin, a specialist in adolescent and young adult oncology at Oregon Health & Science University, observed that sticking to complex medication schedules is challenging at any age, but engaging games can make a difference, especially for young adults. He praised the empowering aspect of these interactive experiences, which help patients understand their treatment roles. The 'Re-Mission 2' games are available for free online and on iPad devices, and efforts are in progress to make them accessible on more platforms so more patients can benefit from them, even while undergoing treatment.
translated_content: Serangkaian game online bernama 'Re-Mission 2' membantu pasien kanker remaja dan dewasa muda untuk memahami penyakit mereka dengan cara yang lebih menarik. Inisiatif ini terinspirasi dari dampak positif yang ditunjukkan oleh game pertama HopeLab, 'Re-Mission,' yang dirilis tahun 2006, di mana penelitian memperlihatkan peningkatan motivasi dan rasa kontrol pada pemainnya. Menurut Dr. Steve Cole, wakil presiden di HopeLab dan profesor di UCLA, game orisinal itu bekerja dengan mengaktifkan jalur motivasi di otak, yang menjadi landasan dalam pengembangan 'Re-Mission 2.' Dalam game barunya, pemain secara langsung melawan kanker dengan menggunakan versi virtual kemoterapi, obat khusus kanker, dan sel kekebalan tubuh sebagai senjata. Sebuah studi tahun 2008 membuktikan bahwa banyak pasien usia 13 hingga 29 tahun kesulitan mengikuti pengobatan, namun bermain game ini meningkatkan kepatuhan dan pemahaman mereka akan pengobatan. Juru bicara HopeLab, Richard Tate, menyatakan bahwa kanker bisa sangat mengganggu kehidupan remaja, tetapi game ini membuat pasien merasa terlibat aktif melawan penyakit mereka dan mengembalikan rasa kontrol. Proses pembuatan 'Re-Mission 2' melibatkan kolaborasi dengan banyak desainer game, serta mantan pasien kanker seperti Brooke Jaffe, mahasiswa Barnard College, dan Justin Lambert, mahasiswa keperawatan di Concordia University. Keduanya membantu dalam pembuatan konsep visual dan pengujian game, serta menyoroti manfaat psikologis dari melihat pengobatan kanker dari perspektif dalam tubuh, sehingga membuat prosesnya lebih mudah dipahami dan penuh harapan. Dr. Brandon Hayes-Lattin, spesialis onkologi remaja dan dewasa muda di Oregon Health & Science University, mengamati bahwa menjalani jadwal pengobatan yang rumit sulit untuk semua usia, namun game interaktif dapat membuat perbedaan, terutama bagi dewasa muda. Ia menyoroti aspek pemberdayaan dari pengalaman ini yang membantu pasien memahami peran mereka dalam pengobatan. Game 'Re-Mission 2' tersedia gratis secara online dan untuk perangkat iPad. Tim pengembang juga berupaya memperluas ketersediaan ke lebih banyak platform agar semakin banyak pasien yang bisa mengakses, bahkan saat mereka menjalani pengobatan.
