article_content: As AI-generated music continues to spread rapidly online, YouTube is taking proactive measures by exploring the legal licensing of artists' voices. The company has developed an AI-powered tool designed to replicate the vocals of musical artists, allowing fans to have artists ‘sing’ new content, but negotiations with major record labels have reportedly stalled. According to a Bloomberg report, this yet-unnamed YouTube tool would be trained using tracks from artists approved by their respective labels. Discussions remain confidential, and the tool’s launch appears to be some distance away, as major labels have not agreed to license the voices of their artists yet. YouTube had hoped to introduce the tool at last month’s Made on YouTube event, Billboard reported. Labels including Sony Music Entertainment, Universal Music Group (UMG), and Warner Music Group (WMG) are said to be involved in ongoing discussions. YouTube has not responded to Gizmodo’s request for comment. Robert Kyncl, CEO of WMG and former YouTube business executive, has previously advocated for the music industry to embrace AI technologies. The initial rollout of YouTube’s tool is expected to be limited, with access granted to a select group of creators. Only a chosen set of artists’ voices will be available, and these artists will also be involved as advisors, offering feedback on the project. The music industry remains divided over the use of AI. In August, it emerged that Google and UMG were in talks to allow AI-powered reproduction of artists’ voices through licensed agreements. Such a tool would let fans create music using artists’ voices, with copyright holders receiving compensation. In addition, the vague ‘YouTube incubator’ partnership with UMG aims to involve artists in shaping YouTube’s approach to AI-generated music content. UMG has previously asked streaming platforms like Spotify and Apple Music to prohibit AI training on their libraries. Some artists and producers see AI as a valuable tool. Hip-hop producer Bobcat Goldwav told Gizmodo that while AI generates anxiety, it also offers powerful creative opportunities. ‘I try not to focus on the fear,’ he said. ‘I can’t stop AI, but I can use it to do my work better.’ Meanwhile, AI-generated fake tracks have proliferated online. Earlier this year, fake Frank Ocean songs fabricated by AI were sold on Discord for thousands of dollars. In another instance, an AI-generated Drake and The Weeknd song titled “Heart on My Sleeve” went viral before being removed from streaming platforms.
translated_content: Seiring musik buatan AI menyebar dengan cepat di internet, YouTube mengambil langkah proaktif dengan menjajaki lisensi legal atas suara para artis. Perusahaan ini mengembangkan alat berbasis AI yang dirancang untuk meniru vokal musisi, memungkinkan penggemar membuat artis 'menyanyikan' konten baru, namun negosiasi dengan label rekaman besar dilaporkan menemui kendala. Menurut laporan Bloomberg, alat YouTube yang belum dinamai ini akan dilatih menggunakan lagu dari artis yang telah disetujui oleh label mereka. Diskusi tetap bersifat rahasia, dan peluncurannya tampaknya masih jauh karena label-label besar belum setuju untuk memberikan lisensi atas suara para artis. YouTube sempat berharap dapat memperkenalkan alat ini di acara Made on YouTube bulan lalu, menurut Billboard. Label-label seperti Sony Music Entertainment, Universal Music Group (UMG), dan Warner Music Group (WMG) disebut terlibat dalam diskusi berkelanjutan. YouTube belum memberikan tanggapan atas permintaan komentar dari Gizmodo. Robert Kyncl, CEO WMG sekaligus mantan eksekutif bisnis YouTube, sebelumnya pernah mendorong industri musik untuk merangkul teknologi AI. Peluncuran awal alat YouTube ini diperkirakan sangat terbatas, hanya untuk sekelompok kreator terpilih. Hanya beberapa suara artis yang akan tersedia, dan para artis tersebut juga akan dilibatkan sebagai penasihat yang memberi masukan pada proyek ini. Industri musik sendiri masih terbelah soal penggunaan AI. Pada bulan Agustus terungkap Google dan UMG sedang membahas perjanjian lisensi agar suara artis dapat direproduksi menggunakan AI. Alat seperti ini memungkinkan penggemar membuat musik dengan suara artis, sementara pemegang hak cipta tetap mendapat kompensasi. Selain itu, kemitraan 'YouTube incubator' yang masih samar dengan UMG bertujuan melibatkan artis dalam langkah YouTube menangani konten musik buatan AI. UMG sebelumnya juga meminta platform streaming seperti Spotify dan Apple Music untuk melarang pelatihan AI menggunakan lagu di katalog mereka. Beberapa artis dan produser menganggap AI sebagai alat bernilai. Produser hip-hop Bobcat Goldwav mengatakan pada Gizmodo bahwa AI memang bikin cemas, tapi juga membawa peluang kreatif yang kuat. 'Saya mencoba tidak terlalu fokus pada ketakutan,' ujarnya. 'Saya tidak bisa menghentikan AI, tapi saya bisa memanfaatkannya agar karya saya lebih baik.' Sementara itu, lagu palsu buatan AI semakin banyak beredar di internet. Awal tahun ini, lagu Frank Ocean palsu hasil AI dijual di Discord hingga ribuan dolar. Pada kasus lain, lagu kolaborasi AI antara Drake dan The Weeknd berjudul “Heart on My Sleeve” sempat viral sebelum akhirnya ditarik dari platform streaming.

article_content: Drivers who complain about potholes might consider themselves lucky compared to a recent incident in Yekaterinburg, Russia, where a driver narrowly escaped harm when the road in front of him suddenly erupted. The dramatic scene, reminiscent of a Hollywood disaster movie, was captured on a dashboard camera and has been viewed over 40,000 times online. As a car approached a red light in Yekaterinburg, the road split apart, sending debris into the air. An SUV, appearing to speed up to the red light, crashed into the rising sections of the road. The explosion sent the road surface flying in three large pieces and a cloud of dust billowed upward. Another car narrowly avoided the eruption by turning right seconds before. The impact tipped the SUV sideways, but fortunately, the driver was able to exit the vehicle without major injuries. Experts reviewing the footage believe the incident was caused by an underground gas main explosion. Howard Robinson, chief executive of the Road Surface Treatments Association, commented, 'It looks like a gas main has exploded. If it was a water main, we would see water gushing upwards.' In the video, the visibly shocked SUV driver cautiously exits his vehicle as the hazard lights flash. While some online have speculated about possible causes—including a burst sewer or sudden underground air pressure—others joked that the explosion served as an effective deterrent to running red lights. One user posted on Live Leak: 'In Russia, cops don't stop you for running a light, the road does.' Another remarked: 'Car driver wanted to run the red light, red light did stop him immediately.' Some online even humorously compared the scene to a new Godzilla movie.

Kejadian dramatis ini, yang mirip dengan adegan film bencana Hollywood, terekam oleh kamera dashboard dan telah ditonton lebih dari 40.000 kali secara online. Saat sebuah mobil mendekati lampu merah di Yekaterinburg, jalan tiba-tiba terbelah dan mengirimkan puing-puing ke udara. Sebuah SUV yang terlihat mempercepat laju ke lampu merah menabrak bagian jalan yang terangkat. Ledakan tersebut membuat permukaan jalan terlempar menjadi tiga bagian besar dan debu membumbung ke udara. Sebuah mobil lain nyaris menghindari letusan itu dengan belok kanan beberapa detik sebelumnya. Benturan tersebut membuat SUV miring ke samping, namun beruntung pengemudi berhasil keluar dari kendaraan tanpa luka serius. Para ahli yang meninjau rekaman tersebut meyakini insiden ini disebabkan oleh ledakan pipa gas bawah tanah. Howard Robinson, CEO Road Surface Treatments Association, berkomentar, 'Sepertinya pipa gas yang meledak. Jika itu pipa air, kita pasti melihat air menyembur ke atas.' Dalam video itu, pengemudi SUV yang jelas-jelas terkejut terlihat hati-hati keluar dari kendaraannya sambil lampu hazard berkedip. Sementara beberapa orang di internet berspekulasi tentang kemungkinan penyebab lain—seperti pipa pembuangan yang pecah atau tekanan udara bawah tanah yang tiba-tiba—yang lain justru bercanda bahwa ledakan itu efektif menghentikan pelanggar lampu merah. Seorang pengguna menulis di Live Leak: 'Di Rusia, bukan polisi yang menghentikanmu saat melanggar lampu merah, tapi jalannya.' Komentar lainnya: 'Pengemudi mobil ingin menerobos lampu merah, lampu merah langsung menghentikannya.' Bahkan ada yang bercanda bahwa adegan ini seperti film Godzilla terbaru.

article_content: For mixed reality (MR) to become mainstream, the entire ecosystem—hardware, software, content, and applications—must work together. While hardware exists and software is advancing nicely, more compelling content and useful apps are necessary. Virtual reality (VR) headsets have long seemed intimidating. Despite the intriguing concept of immersing oneself in another world, the initial generation of VR headsets failed to convince consumers. Currently, the focus has shifted to mixed reality (MR), attracting significant interest from major technology companies. Meta has invested in this space with its Quest headsets, though success has been limited so far. Apple will soon release its Vision Pro headset (priced at $3,500), adding further competition. Snap and Amazon are also exploring MR with their respective smart glasses and Echo Frames, which may enter the MR market. Technological progress has spurred renewed optimism for MR. Apple’s Vision Pro, for example, features EyeSight technology, which enables users to stay aware of their surroundings even when wearing the headset. Having experienced the Vision Pro, the device transitions to a transparent mode when someone approaches. Meta’s Quest 3 offers a similar feature, Pass Through, and even expands on it, allowing users to set up multiple virtual monitors through third-party apps, showcasing the practical innovations enabled by MR. With features like EyeSight and Pass Through, users can remain connected to their environment and perform multiple tasks while using their headsets. However, the idea of constantly wearing a headset remains unappealing to many, so tech companies must provide genuinely compelling uses. A complete MR experience depends on developers creating useful applications that unlock the technology's potential. Even the best hardware and software are insufficient unless users can make practical and optimal use of their devices. MR is still in its early stages, but as the technology matures and adoption grows, it could disrupt traditional product categories by reducing the need for various other devices. Whether MR will realize its promise remains to be seen. In other news: Sweden’s Saab has received approval for the first 100% foreign direct investment (FDI) in India's defense sector to manufacture rockets. State Bank of India (SBI) reported an 8% increase in second-quarter net profit due to steady loan demand and reduced provisions. Byju’s posted a revenue increase to ₹3,569 crore for its core business in FY22, alongside a reduced EBITDA loss of ₹2,253 crore.

Perangkat kerasnya sudah tersedia dan perkembangan perangkat lunak pun berjalan baik, namun perlu tambahan konten dan aplikasi menarik. Headset virtual reality (VR) selama ini terkesan cukup rumit. Meski konsep masuk ke dunia lain terdengar keren, generasi pertama headset VR belum mampu menarik hati konsumen. Kini, sorotan bergeser ke mixed reality (MR), yang sangat menarik perhatian perusahaan teknologi besar. Meta telah masuk ke bidang ini lewat headset Quest, meski hasilnya masih terbatas. Apple akan segera merilis Vision Pro (seharga $3.500), menambah kompetisi. Snap dan Amazon juga menjajaki MR dengan kacamata pintar serta Echo Frames mereka yang kemungkinan masuk ke pasar MR di masa depan. Kemajuan teknologi memunculkan optimisme baru untuk MR. Sebagai contoh, Apple Vision Pro memiliki teknologi EyeSight yang memungkinkan pengguna tetap sadar terhadap lingkungan sekitar walaupun sedang mengenakan headset. Setelah mencoba Vision Pro, perangkat ini bisa menjadi transparan jika ada seseorang yang mendekat. Meta Quest 3 punya fitur sejenis bernama Pass Through, yang bahkan dikembangkan lebih jauh—pengguna bisa mengatur beberapa monitor virtual dengan aplikasi pihak ketiga. Ini memperlihatkan inovasi praktis yang dibawa oleh MR. Dengan fitur EyeSight dan Pass Through, pengguna tetap bisa terhubung dengan lingkungan sekitar serta melakukan banyak aktivitas ketika memakai headset. Namun, mengenakan headset sepanjang waktu masih terasa kurang menarik bagi sebagian orang, sehingga perusahaan teknologi harus menawarkan kegunaan yang benar-benar signifikan. Pengalaman MR yang maksimal bergantung pada developer untuk menciptakan aplikasi-aplikasi yang benar-benar bisa memaksimalkan teknologi ini. Perangkat keras dan perangkat lunak saja belum cukup jika pengguna tidak dapat menggunakannya secara optimal. MR masih dalam tahap awal, namun seiring kemajuan teknologi dan semakin banyaknya pengguna, MR berpotensi menggeser produk-produk konvensional dengan mengurangi kebutuhan akan perangkat lain. Apakah MR akan benar-benar memenuhi harapan, masih menunggu waktu. State Bank of India (SBI) melaporkan kenaikan laba bersih kuartal kedua sebesar 8% berkat permintaan pinjaman yang stabil dan penurunan provisi. Byju’s mencatat pendapatan inti meningkat menjadi ₹3.569 crore untuk tahun fiskal 2022, dengan kerugian EBITDA menyusut menjadi ₹2.253 crore.

article_content: Sometimes, a movie appears unexpectedly and captures your heart. "Safety Not Guaranteed" is one of those pleasant surprises. The story is unusually quirky: a solitary man (Mark Duplass) places an ad seeking a partner to join him on a time-travel mission (“Must bring your own weapons. Safety not guaranteed”). The ad attracts the attention of three Seattle journalists: Jeff (Jake Johnson), Arnau (Karan Soni), and Darius (Aubrey Plaza), who begins to develop feelings for the mysterious man. Director Colin Trevorrow and writer Derek Connolly fill the film with both humor and touching moments. Aubrey Plaza's performance is especially captivating. Read the complete review at RollingStone.com. Copyright © 2011 Rolling Stone.

article_content: While sitting on the patio of a modest Los Angeles taco spot, Ursus Magana—sporting anime tattoos and a straightforward demeanor—tried to persuade me not to write this article. Magana, who manages talent for emo rappers, goth TikTok icons, and OnlyFans stars, wasn’t afraid I’d expose any shocking truths. Ever since our first Instagram chat months ago, he’d been refreshingly open about his career. His real worry? He doubted any article could break through on social media. 'Getting a story to go viral is almost impossible,' he cautioned me. 'Articles just don’t catch fire.' Maybe sensing he’d dampened my enthusiasm, Magana paused mid-taco to pitch a plan for making me famous: ditch journalism and start posting daily TikToks with storytelling tips. His agency, 25/7 Media, and its network of 60+ influencers would help boost my content. Once an audience formed, I’d launch a weekly podcast with up-and-coming creators. The endgame? A bestselling book or Netflix show, appearances on The Tonight Show, and a shiny sponsorship deal—maybe even with a pen company. Realistically, I knew Magana’s plan was a flattering exaggeration, and that I’d never be charismatic enough to pull it off. Still, his persuasive confidence got me imagining the possibilities. This glimpse into self-promotion made me realize how young creatives can be inspired by Magana’s vision promising wealth and success by their late teens. It’s not an empty promise. Magana’s agency, 25/7 Media, has helped launch the careers of several creators. In today’s entertainment world—disrupted by digital platforms—Magana is seen as a reliable connector in the fast-growing 'creator economy,' which is expected to reach $480 billion by 2027. This dramatic market shift favors tech giants and platforms, while individual creators often need expert guidance to survive beyond their viral moments. Traditional agencies like Creative Artists, United Talents, and Gersh have ventured into influencer management, but now face competition from digital-first firms such as Viral Nation and Underscore Talent. Amidst this crowded field, 25/7 Media stands out by seeking viral talent from young, unconventional subcultures, unlocking new online audiences others might overlook.

Magana yang menjadi manajer talenta untuk rapper emo, kreator goth di TikTok, dan bintang OnlyFans, tidak khawatir saya akan membongkar rahasia besar. Sejak kami pertama kali mengobrol di Instagram beberapa bulan lalu, dia selalu terbuka mengenai pekerjaannya. Yang benar-benar dia risaukan: dia ragu artikel bisa menembus keriuhan media sosial. 'Sulit sekali membuat cerita jadi viral,' katanya. 'Artikel hampir tidak pernah benar-benar meledak.' Mungkin karena merasa sudah menurunkan semangat saya, Magana menunda makan taco terakhirnya dan malah menawarkan strategi supaya saya jadi terkenal: tinggalkan jurnalisme dan mulai membuat konten tips storytelling di TikTok setiap hari. Agensinya, 25/7 Media, beserta lebih dari 60 influencer, akan membantu menyebarkan konten saya. Setelah punya pengikut, saya bisa meluncurkan podcast mingguan bersama para kreator muda. Target akhirnya? Buku best seller atau acara Netflix, tampil di The Tonight Show, bahkan kontrak sponsor—mungkin dari produsen pulpen. Secara realistis, saya tahu rencana Magana itu terlalu muluk dan saya tidak cukup menonjol untuk mewujudkannya. Tapi keyakinannya sangat menular sehingga sejenak saya juga ikut berkhayal. Saat itu saya mengerti, betapa kreator muda bisa terinspirasi oleh visi besar Magana yang menjanjikan kesuksesan materi di usia belia. Ini bukan sekadar wacana. Agensi Magana, 25/7 Media, memang telah mendorong karier beberapa kreator menjadi sukses. Di dunia hiburan masa kini yang dipenuhi ketidakpastian akibat platform digital, Magana dianggap sebagai penghubung andal di tengah pesatnya ‘ekonomi kreator’—yang diperkirakan bernilai $480 miliar pada tahun 2027. Perubahan besar ini membawa keuntungan besar untuk perusahaan teknologi, sementara para kreator tetap perlu manajer untuk bertahan lebih dari sekedar viral sesaat. Agensi lawas seperti Creative Artists, United Talents, dan Gersh memang sudah menjajal dunia influencer, namun kini bersaing ketat dengan firma digital seperti Viral Nation dan Underscore Talent. Di tengah persaingan padat ini, 25/7 Media menonjol karena fokus mencari talenta viral dari subkultur muda yang sering diabaikan, sehingga membuka pasar online baru yang sebelumnya tak tergarap.

article_content: In Budhni, Madhya Pradesh, the assembly elections are approaching with less excitement than expected, even though several prominent candidates are contesting. The current Chief Minister, Shivraj Singh Chouhan of the BJP, is running once again against Congress’s Vikram Mastal—an actor known for playing Hanuman—and Vairagyanand Giri (Mirchi Baba) from the Samajwadi Party. Chouhan has a history of securing victories in Budhni since 2006 and remains the perceived favorite. After filing his nomination on October 30, he hasn’t returned to campaign personally, leaving most activities to his wife, son, and brothers. BJP’s presence is strong with widespread party branding across Budhni, while Congress marks are hardly seen. This year, the BJP has chosen not to push Chouhan as its chief ministerial candidate, instead centering their campaign on Prime Minister Modi. Their campaign slogan 'MP ke mann mein Modi, Modi ke mann mein MP' signals this shift, possibly to counter anti-incumbency. Vikram Mastal, although inexperienced politically, is running a dynamic campaign, banking on growing local dissatisfaction with Chouhan. His campaign events use familiar Hanuman imagery and loud Congress slogans to engage voters. Vairagyanand Giri, or Mirchi Baba, is also in the race, promising various development projects and claiming he was wronged by Chouhan’s government. Local opinions mostly favor Chouhan, who is credited with bringing development initiatives, new institutions, and the expansion of welfare schemes to the area. Some locals suggest that Congress could have had a stronger candidate. A few people voice concern about resource distribution but see Chouhan as their representative. Chouhan’s son Kartikeya is spearheading grassroots outreach, targeting a record-breaking win and highlighting the extensive reach of government programs in Budhni. He emphasizes that not being projected as the CM candidate would not affect his father’s chances due to his long-standing relationship with Budhni. Chouhan remains the party’s most established leader in the area, with his tenure as chief minister interrupted only briefly despite the state’s political changes. Unless there’s a major shift, he is expected to extend his stronghold again in this election.
translated_content: Di Budhni, Madhya Pradesh, pemilihan legislatif sudah di depan mata, namun suasana masyarakat terasa kurang bergairah walau banyak calon ternama ikut berkompetisi. Petahana Shivraj Singh Chouhan dari BJP kembali maju melawan Vikram Mastal dari Kongres—aktor populer pemeran Hanuman—dan Vairagyanand Giri (Mirchi Baba) dari Partai Samajwadi. Chouhan terkenal sering menang di Budhni sejak 2006 dan masih jadi unggulan utama. Sejak mendaftar pada 30 Oktober, ia belum kembali berkampanye langsung, sehingga aktivitas banyak dijalankan istri, anak, dan saudara-saudaranya. Dominasi BJP sangat terasa dengan atribut partai di mana-mana, sementara lambang Kongres hampir tak tampak. Kali ini, BJP memutuskan tidak menonjolkan Chouhan sebagai calon utama menteri, namun mengandalkan kampanye bersama Perdana Menteri Modi dengan slogan 'MP ke mann mein Modi, Modi ke mann mein MP', kemungkinan untuk menghindari kejenuhan pemilih. Vikram Mastal, meski pendatang baru di politik, berkampanye cukup aktif dan mengandalkan ketidakpuasan masyarakat terhadap Chouhan. Kampanyenya dihiasi atribut Hanuman serta yel-yel Kongres menggaet perhatian warga. Vairagyanand Giri atau Mirchi Baba juga berkontestasi, menawarkan janji proyek pembangunan dan mengaku pernah dizalimi pemerintah Chouhan. Mayoritas warga menilai Chouhan telah berkontribusi pada pembangunan, mendirikan lembaga pendidikan baru, dan memperluas bantuan sosial di wilayah tersebut. Sebagian warga beranggapan Kongres bisa saja menghadirkan calon yang lebih kuat. Ada juga yang mengkritik soal pembagian sumber daya, tapi tetap menganggap Chouhan sebagai sosok mereka. Anak Chouhan, Kartikeya, memimpin kampanye door-to-door demi raihan kemenangan besar serta menyoroti pencapaian program pemerintah di Budhni. Kartikeya yakin posisi ayahnya tetap kuat meski tidak diusung resmi sebagai calon utama menteri, dengan alasan hubungan panjang dengan warga. Chouhan masih menjadi figur utama dan paling mapan di Budhni, di mana masa jabatannya sebagai menteri utama hanya terputus singkat. Kecuali terjadi perubahan besar, ia diyakini akan mempertahankan dominasinya di pemilu kali ini.

article_content: Off-duty firefighter Matt Patterson recounted his harrowing experience aiding victims during the Boston Marathon bombing. Patterson found eight-year-old Martin Richard motionless and attempted to perform CPR, giving two breaths before realizing the injuries were fatal. Earlier, Patterson and Michael Chase, a trained police officer, saved another young boy with a devastating leg injury, carrying him a block and a half to ambulances. After helping the boy receive medical assistance, Patterson returned to the chaotic scene to assist more victims. He helped a man in his 30s who had a severe leg injury, working with a Boston firefighter to create a makeshift tourniquet. Patterson described the confusion and shock following the explosions, quickly assessing the situation and aiding as many victims as possible. Both he and Chase expressed concern for the injured boy but, amid the chaos, did not obtain his information and are left hoping to hear about his recovery. Boston Children’s Hospital confirmed treating several children but did not share patient details, while Boston Medical Center reported a five-year-old boy was still in critical condition. Patterson reflected on the emotional toll of the tragedy but credited his emergency training for enabling him to act swiftly and effectively.
translated_content: Petugas pemadam kebakaran yang sedang tidak bertugas, Matt Patterson, menceritakan pengalamannya yang menegangkan saat membantu korban pengeboman Boston Marathon. Patterson menemukan Martin Richard yang berusia delapan tahun dalam kondisi tidak sadarkan diri dan mencoba memberikan napas buatan (CPR), namun setelah dua kali hembusan, ia menyadari luka yang dialami Martin terlalu parah untuk diselamatkan. Sebelumnya, Patterson bersama Michael Chase, seorang polisi terlatih, berhasil menyelamatkan seorang anak laki-laki lain yang kakinya cedera parah, membawa anak tersebut sejauh satu setengah blok ke ambulans. Setelah memastikan anak itu mendapatkan pertolongan medis, Patterson kembali ke lokasi yang kacau untuk membantu korban lainnya. Ia menolong seorang pria berusia 30-an dengan cedera kaki berat, bekerja sama dengan pemadam kebakaran Boston untuk membuat torniket darurat. Patterson menggambarkan suasana kacau dan keterkejutan setelah ledakan terjadi, dengan sigap menilai situasi dan membantu sebanyak mungkin korban. Baik dia maupun Chase mengungkapkan kekhawatiran atas kondisi anak yang diselamatkan, namun karena kekacauan mereka tidak bisa mendapatkan informasi dan hanya berharap anak itu pulih. Boston Children’s Hospital mengonfirmasi telah merawat beberapa anak namun tidak memberikan data detail pasien, sementara Boston Medical Center menyebutkan ada seorang anak laki-laki usia lima tahun masih dalam kondisi kritis. Patterson merenungkan dampak emosional tragedi tersebut, namun mengakui pelatihan darurat yang dimilikinya sangat membantu untuk bertindak cepat dan efektif.

President Joko Widodo of Indonesia urged US President Joe Biden to take stronger steps to halt the violence in Gaza and push for a ceasefire, highlighting the urgent need for humanitarian action. Their discussions at the White House occurred amid ongoing conflict between Israel and Hamas, with the United States continuing to back Israel. Earlier, Widodo attended a summit in Riyadh with other Arab and Muslim leaders who condemned Israel’s actions and called for an immediate ceasefire. Indonesia, as the world’s largest Muslim-majority nation, has seen widespread protests supporting Palestinians, as well as boycotts of companies linked to Israel.

In the Oval Office, Widodo expressed, “Indonesia appeals to the US to do more to stop the atrocities in Gaza. A ceasefire is a must for the sake of humanity.” The latest outbreak of violence began October 7, when Hamas launched a surprise attack on Israel, resulting in about 1,200 Israeli deaths and over 200 people taken hostage. Israel has since enforced a nearly total blockade and launched extensive strikes on Gaza, leading to more than 11,000 Palestinian fatalities.

US officials have said Biden hopes Indonesia will take a more active diplomatic role in the Middle East, helping with calls for a ceasefire, supporting the two-state solution, and contributing to future Gaza reconstruction. While the US continues its strong support for Israel, it has recently encouraged more restraint and temporary pauses in fighting for humanitarian aid and hostage negotiations.

The Widodo-Biden meeting comes shortly before Biden’s expected discussions with Chinese President Xi Jinping, and the APEC summit in San Francisco where both China and Indonesia are taking part. The US aims to upgrade its relationship with Indonesia to a comprehensive strategic partnership—a top-level diplomatic relationship—similar to a recent shift with Vietnam. Biden described this as a significant new phase in ties between the two countries with impacts across multiple sectors.

The crisis in Myanmar was also addressed, with ongoing unrest since a 2021 military coup ousted elected leader Aung San Suu Kyi. Indonesia, as current ASEAN chair, has struggled—with the broader group—to hold Myanmar's military regime accountable, even as Western nations impose sanctions. With Laos preparing to take the ASEAN chair, leaders acknowledged the need for a coordinated path forward.

The talks also included enhanced cooperation between the US and Indonesia in defense, cybersecurity, space, and climate, with plans for initiatives in carbon capture, grid support, and air quality. Despite mounting global tensions, Widodo reiterated Indonesia’s policy of neutrality, stating, “Indonesia is always open to cooperation with any country, and not to side with any power, except to stand for peace and humanity.”

Pertemuan mereka di Gedung Putih terjadi di tengah konflik yang masih berlangsung antara Israel dan Hamas, dengan Amerika Serikat tetap memberikan dukungan kepada Israel. Sebelumnya, Widodo hadir dalam KTT di Riyadh bersama pemimpin Arab dan Muslim lainnya yang mengecam tindakan Israel dan menuntut gencatan senjata segera. Di Oval Office, Widodo menegaskan, "Indonesia meminta AS untuk melakukan lebih banyak upaya menghentikan kekejaman di Gaza. Gencatan senjata adalah keharusan demi kemanusiaan." Meski tetap mendukung Israel, AS juga mulai mendorong pengendalian diri lebih lanjut serta jeda kemanusiaan dalam pertempuran untuk menyalurkan bantuan dan membahas pembebasan sandera.

Pertemuan Jokowi dan Biden berlangsung menjelang pembicaraan Biden dengan Presiden China Xi Jinping serta KTT APEC di San Francisco, di mana China dan Indonesia ikut berpartisipasi. Pembicaraan juga membahas peningkatan kerja sama antara AS dan Indonesia di bidang pertahanan, keamanan siber, ruang angkasa, dan perubahan iklim, termasuk inisiatif penangkapan karbon, penguatan jaringan listrik, dan peningkatan kualitas udara. Di tengah meningkatnya ketegangan geopolitik dunia, Widodo menegaskan netralitas Indonesia dengan mengatakan "Indonesia selalu terbuka untuk bekerja sama dengan negara mana pun, dan tidak memihak kekuatan mana pun, kecuali untuk berpihak pada perdamaian dan kemanusiaan."

article_content: Just outside Abu Dhabi stands the Abu Dhabi Falcon Hospital, known as the largest specialized falcon medical facility globally. Nearly 9,000 falcons receive care there each year, benefiting from services that cover everything from standard examinations to advanced medical procedures. With its 24-hour operations, the hospital provides X-rays, ophthalmology assessments, intensive care, and dedicated spaces for ill birds to recover. The center’s large, air-conditioned aviaries give falcons a comfortable space to molt and regain strength. Opened in 1999 as a facility focusing on falcons, the hospital broadened its services in 2006 to include all birds and poultry. It treats animals from throughout the UAE as well as from neighboring Gulf countries, such as Saudi Arabia, Qatar, and Kuwait, tallying over 67,000 treated birds since its inception. The hospital is also popular among tourists, underscoring the high esteem for falcons in the region—they adorn the national emblem and are celebrated in local heritage and religion. Falconry, now a national pastime and tradition for Emirati youth, has shifted from its hunting roots to concentrate on building stronger bonds between people and birds. Modern falconers utilize new techniques, including training their birds with drones. Exceptional falcons can command prices above a million dollars at auctions, and each year, Abu Dhabi holds a beauty contest exclusively for these birds. In addition to medical services, the hospital partners with the Sheikh Zayed Falcon Release Program, which started in 1999, aiming to rehabilitate and free formerly captive falcons. To date, more than 13,000 falcons have been released into their original habitats in countries like Pakistan, Iran, and Kazakhstan. Falconry is internationally recognized by UNESCO as part of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity—a testament to its lasting importance in Gulf culture.

article_content: Hamas’s recent coordinated attacks against Israel over the weekend shocked much of the world, both for the violence against civilians and the lack of prior warning from intelligence agencies. The scale and organization of the assault have led some politicians and experts to question whether Hamas could have acted alone or if it received assistance from Iran, a longtime supporter and ally. U.S. officials have pushed back on unsubstantiated claims that Iran played a critical role in the attack. On Monday, White House spokesperson John Kirby stated that while Iran bore 'a degree of complicity', the U.S. had not yet uncovered 'hard, tangible evidence' of direct involvement. Iran’s President Ebrahim Raisi congratulated Hamas on what he called a 'victory' over Israel, but an Iranian U.N. spokesperson denied Tehran’s involvement, asserting that Israel was using Iran as a scapegoat for its own security failures. Israeli officials initially made bold accusations against Iran but have since adopted a more measured tone. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu did not mention Iran in his national address, and Israel's ambassador to the U.S., Michael Herzog, stated his government was not 'one hundred percent sure' about Iranian operational support, although he added it would not be surprising if Iran was involved behind the scenes. Experts such as Jonathan Schanzer and Suzanne Maloney note that Hamas’s recent escalation would be difficult without significant external assistance. Maloney emphasized Iran’s well-known role as primary backer of Hamas, providing financial and military support, and noted frequent contacts between Iranian leadership and militant groups. Some Israeli officials backing away from blaming Iran may reflect a desire to avoid preempting the investigation or provoking increased Iranian support for Hamas. The Israeli government estimates that Iran provides around $100 million to Hamas yearly, while the U.S. State Department has acknowledged Tehran's supply of training and military equipment to the group. Maloney argues that while direct Iranian military involvement is unlikely, Iran could increase its support to Hamas, prolonging the conflict. She also points out Iran’s multiple supply lines and redundancy built into its support systems. Hezbollah, another Iranian-backed group in Lebanon, could also become involved, which would further complicate the conflict. Hezbollah reportedly possesses a much larger arsenal of rockets than Hamas, all supplied by Iran. In the United States, Republican politicians criticized the Biden administration for recently facilitating Iran's access to approximately $6 billion in previously frozen oil revenue in exchange for the release of five American prisoners. Former House Speaker Kevin McCarthy called for the funds to be refrozen and accused the administration of emboldening adversaries. U.S. officials maintain that controls are in place to limit Iran’s use of these funds to humanitarian purposes and say the regime has not accessed the money yet. Nonetheless, both Schanzer and Maloney contend that U.S. policy has inadvertently contributed to regional instability by failing to address all aspects of Iranian activity, including support for militant groups.

Skala dan organisasi serangan ini membuat sejumlah politisi dan pakar mempertanyakan apakah Hamas bisa bertindak sendiri atau mendapatkan bantuan dari Iran, sekutu dan pendukung lama mereka. Nicolas Cage has shared his thoughts about his cameo as Superman in the film 'The Flash.' As some may remember, Cage previously screen-tested for the Man of Steel in what was planned to be a Tim Burton-directed project, which was ultimately canceled. In 'The Flash,' which explores the multiverse, Cage appears in another timeline wearing Superman's iconic costume. However, he revealed that the scene he filmed was not what appeared in the finished movie.

“In the footage I shot, I was not fighting a giant spider. That was not what I did,” Cage told Yahoo! Entertainment. “I don’t believe that was created with AI. I know Tim (Burton) is upset about AI, and I share his sentiments. It was CGI, which they used to de-age me, and I was fighting a spider — but that wasn’t my performance. I’m not sure what happened there. Still, I understand where Tim is coming from. I’d be very unhappy if someone appropriated my work. AI is a nightmare to me; it’s the ultimate lack of humanity.”

Cage continued, clarifying, “I don’t think it was AI in 'The Flash.' They just altered the footage, but it was out of my control. I was on set for maybe an hour in the Superman suit, acting as if I was witnessing the destruction of a universe, trying to convey loss, sadness, and terror with just my eyes — there was no dialogue.”

He went on to praise director Andrés Muschietti, who worked with lead actor Ezra Miller. “They put a lot of effort into building the suit, and I think Andy is a great guy and a terrific director. I loved his 'It' movies,” Cage said. “My role was simply to stand in an alternate dimension, observing the universe’s end as Kal-El (Superman). Given the short time I had, I tried to express as much emotion as I could nonverbally. My time on set was probably around three hours.”

Nicolas Cage membagikan pendapatnya tentang kehadirannya sebagai Superman di film 'The Flash.' Itu CGI, digunakan untuk membuat saya terlihat lebih muda, dan saya bertarung melawan laba-laba—tapi itu bukan penampilan saya. Saya tidak tahu kenapa bisa begitu. Tapi saya paham perasaan Tim. article_content: Robyn Lawley, a 24-year-old model from Australia, has openly criticized the 'plus-size' label, arguing that, despite being healthy and fit, she and others are still categorized as larger than average by the fashion industry. In her interview with Clique magazine, Lawley expressed confusion over the stereotype that plus-size models do not exercise, stressing the importance of health over meeting unrealistic body standards. Standing at 6'2", Lawley has worked with renowned brands such as Ralph Lauren and has graced the covers of multiple editions of Vogue. She has revealed that she once undertook strict dieting and even starvation in an effort to meet the standards of mainstream modeling, but could never achieve a size zero. Lawley confessed that she once believed being thin was essential for beauty, but her perspective has changed. Once she abandoned extreme dieting, Lawley's career flourished. She followed the path of notable models like Crystal Renn and Sophie Dahl, both admired for their beauty and their curves. Lawley has featured in campaigns for Boux Avenue and Mango's Violetta line, which caters to larger sizes. The debate over 'plus-size' models is ongoing in an industry where most models are between 5'8" and 6' tall and typically wear a UK size six. Plus-size models are generally similar in height but are size 12 or 14 instead. Lawley, who is praised for her well-proportioned figure, is irritated that she and others continue to be seen as a small minority within the industry. She questions why models of healthy, average sizes—like size 10—are often excluded and advocates for dropping the 'plus-size' label altogether, explaining that it is unnecessary and even derogatory. Lawley asserts that all should simply be considered models without qualifiers.

article_content: OpenAI held its first developer day in San Francisco, where CEO Sam Altman discussed the company's achievements and upcoming improvements to ChatGPT, its flagship tool. These updates have major implications for businesses globally. Altman reminded attendees that ChatGPT launched on November 30, 2022, initially as a 'low key research preview.' He shared that GPT-4 remains one of the most capable AI models, and provided statistics: two million developers use ChatGPT, it has 100 million weekly active users, and 92% of Fortune 500 companies have adopted it. Emphasizing a product-led strategy, Altman noted, 'People just find it useful and tell their friends,' and said OpenAI values hearing how the technology is used. Among the new features and improvements announced for release over the next few months are better world knowledge, greater customization, higher rate limits, reduced costs, and more robust copyright protection. One standout feature is the Assistants API, which enables businesses to develop their own no-code tools using natural language, making the process of turning ideas into products much faster and more affordable. According to AI educators and entrepreneurs like Kyle Balmer and Paul Couvert, these tools can work with various OpenAI models, allowing businesses to automate data processes and create custom solutions more easily. ChatGPT's expanded context window now supports up to 128,000 tokens (about 300 pages of text), which enables in-depth analysis of large documents. This feature will help companies gain deeper insights and create more cohesive content. Dan Fitzpatrick, an AI educator, observed that these advancements could transform not only business operations but also education, urging schools to adapt quickly to stay up to date. OpenAI's vision is to streamline tools so users can access all features—like assistants, GPTs, plugins, internet search, and image generation—within a single platform, increasing efficiency and ease of use. This integration could challenge standalone AI tool companies and traditional platforms, forcing them to innovate or specialize to remain relevant. For entrepreneurs, adopting ChatGPT’s new capabilities can lead to increased productivity and impact. Success will favor those who adapt and leverage these tools, while those who don't may fall behind. The challenge for businesses is clear: adapt, learn, and find ways to harness these advancements to their advantage.

Ia menyampaikan bahwa GPT-4 tetap menjadi salah satu model AI paling canggih. Ia juga menyebutkan statistik: dua juta pengembang memakai ChatGPT, 100 juta pengguna aktif mingguan, dan 92% perusahaan Fortune 500 telah mengadopsinya. Menekankan strategi yang berfokus pada produk, Altman berkata, 'Orang-orang menemukan ini bermanfaat dan memberitahukannya ke teman-teman mereka,' serta mengatakan OpenAI senang mendengar cerita penggunaan teknologi mereka. article_content: Smoke from Israeli bombardment rises as people flee south from Gaza City and parts of the northern Gaza Strip, walking along a highway on November 9. Israeli airstrikes have killed thousands of civilians in areas of Gaza where Israel has told people to move, according to the Gaza health ministry. Witness accounts, satellite data, and expert analysis compiled by NPR indicate that Israeli airstrikes and artillery continue daily even in zones designated as 'safer,' striking schools, residential buildings, and crowded United Nations shelters. During its offensive in northern Gaza, the Israeli military repeatedly dropped leaflets and sent messages urging residents to evacuate south of the Wadi Gaza area, claiming it was safer. Families attempting these journeys must navigate through destroyed buildings and hazardous conditions along a road described as a 'humanitarian corridor.' For several hours each day, people carry wounded relatives, sometimes using wheelchairs for patients from now-defunct hospitals. Mothers pull along exhausted children. However, conditions awaiting those who flee south remain perilous. The so-called evacuation zones are also heavily bombarded and face an acute humanitarian crisis as Israel restricts fuel and aid into Gaza, forcing people to hunt for food and clean water. 'Israel's use of the word 'evacuation' gives a false sense of safety,' says Caitlin Procter from the Geneva Graduate Institute, 'but, in reality, nowhere in Gaza is safe.' Israel has vowed to defeat Hamas after the group—according to Israeli officials—killed 1,200 people and took more than 240 hostages on October 7. The Israeli military states it will target Hamas wherever it deems necessary. Israeli airstrikes have hit residential buildings, bakeries, hospitals, and even UN-run shelters throughout Gaza, including southern areas. The IDF told NPR on November 9 that it is working to protect Israel’s security in response to the Hamas attack, continuing to urge all residents to move south, which it claims is safer, but asserts that since Hamas operates throughout Gaza and hides among civilian infrastructure, the IDF will strike Hamas wherever necessary. Recently, Israel also dropped leaflets ordering residents in southern Khan Younis to evacuate. The IDF did not comment further to NPR on these additional displacements. Official figures from Gaza's Health Ministry state that over 11,800 people—more than two-thirds women, children, and the elderly—have died since the offensive began. UN maps based on this data indicate over 3,600 deaths occurred in areas Israel designated for civilians to evacuate to. Satellite analysis by the European Space Agency’s Sentinel-1, and researchers Corey Scher and Jamon Van Den Hoek, reveal steady destruction of buildings in central and southern Gaza, especially after the October 13 evacuation order. Between 3,400 and 4,800 more buildings have been damaged or destroyed in these zones, including heavily populated refugee camps. Personal accounts, like that of Asa'd Saqallah—whose family lost several members after evacuating from Gaza City to Khan Younis—underscore the severe risks even after moving south. Civilian harm watchdog Airwars found that, in the first week after Israel urged civilians to move south, bombardments on these areas increased. Airwars counted 127 allegations of civilian harm in the southern part of Gaza between October 14 and 21, especially near schools, hospitals, and restaurants. On November 12, Israeli strikes reportedly hit a UNRWA staff guesthouse in Rafah. UNRWA reports that at least 102 staff have died in the past five weeks, the deadliest period in its history. Around 830,000 displaced people are sheltering in UNRWA buildings, often in overcrowded conditions. Over the last month, UNRWA says 64 of its facilities have been damaged, with attacks killing 71 people in its shelters and injuring hundreds more—many in southern Gaza. 'This shows nowhere is safe in Gaza,' says UNRWA's Juliette Touma. Amnesty International's Donatella Rovera says the intensity of the Israeli offensive is unprecedented. Gaza officials report the dead include 4,407 children, 3,137 women, and 686 elderly, from a population of 2.3 million. Israel maintains that Hamas embeds with civilians, making strikes necessary, while UNRWA Commissioner Philippe Lazzarini urges that thousands of children must not be considered 'collateral damage.' UNRWA estimates 70% of Gaza's population is displaced, mostly in the south, where shelter, food, and water are in short supply. Residents report collecting wood from ruins to cook and digging for water. Abu Kareem, in Rafah, told NPR: 'We can’t find food or water, and we don’t have water to shower.' Gaza was reliant on aid even before the war. Israel has imposed a 'total' siege since October 7, severely limiting entry of fuel and other essentials. While some aid trucks have entered, supplies remain insufficient. UNRWA warns diseases are spreading, and telecom provider Paltel says fuel shortages have caused widespread communication outages. On Friday, Paltel reported partially restoring service after receiving limited fuel from UNRWA. Reporting by Ruth Sherlock (Rome), Daniel Wood (Washington, D.C.), Abu Bakr Bashir (London), Fatima Al-Kassab (London), Alon Avital (Tel Aviv), and Anas Baba (Gaza).
translated_content: Asap dari pengeboman Israel terlihat saat orang-orang melarikan diri ke selatan dari Kota Gaza dan bagian utara Jalur Gaza, berjalan di sepanjang jalan raya pada 9 November. Serangan udara Israel telah menewaskan ribuan warga sipil di wilayah Gaza tempat Israel memerintahkan orang-orang untuk pindah, menurut Kementerian Kesehatan Gaza. Kesaksian, data satelit, dan analisis pakar yang dikumpulkan NPR menunjukkan bahwa serangan udara dan artileri Israel terjadi setiap hari bahkan di zona yang disebut 'lebih aman', menimpa sekolah, bangunan perumahan, dan tempat penampungan PBB yang penuh sesak. Selama ofensifnya di Gaza utara, militer Israel berulang kali menjatuhkan selebaran dan mengirim pesan mendesak penduduk untuk mengungsi ke selatan wilayah Wadi Gaza, dengan klaim lebih aman. Keluarga-keluarga yang mencoba perjalanan ini harus melewati bangunan hancur dan kondisi berbahaya di jalan yang disebut sebagai 'koridor kemanusiaan.' Selama beberapa jam setiap hari, orang-orang mengangkut kerabat yang terluka, kadang menggunakan kursi roda bagi pasien dari rumah sakit yang kini tidak lagi berfungsi. Ibu-ibu menarik anak-anak yang kelelahan. Namun, kondisi di selatan tetap berbahaya. Zona evakuasi juga dibombardir berat dan menghadapi krisis kemanusiaan akut karena Israel membatasi bahan bakar dan bantuan masuk ke Gaza, memaksa orang mencari makanan dan air bersih. 'Penggunaan kata 'evakuasi' oleh Israel memberi kesan salah tentang keselamatan,' kata Caitlin Procter dari Geneva Graduate Institute, 'padahal kenyataannya, tidak ada tempat aman di Gaza.' Israel berjanji untuk mengalahkan Hamas setelah kelompok itu—menurut pejabat Israel—menewaskan 1.200 orang dan menyandera lebih dari 240 orang pada 7 Oktober. Militer Israel menyatakan akan menargetkan Hamas di mana pun dianggap perlu. Serangan udara Israel telah menghantam bangunan perumahan, toko roti, rumah sakit, bahkan tempat penampungan PBB di seluruh Gaza, termasuk wilayah selatan. IDF mengatakan kepada NPR pada 9 November bahwa mereka bertindak demi keamanan Israel setelah serangan Hamas, tetap mendesak semua warga berpindah ke selatan yang diklaim lebih aman, namun menegaskan Hamas beroperasi di seluruh Gaza dan menyembunyikan diri di infrastruktur sipil, sehingga IDF akan menyerang Hamas di mana saja dipandang perlu. Baru-baru ini, Israel juga menjatuhkan selebaran memerintahkan warga kota Khan Younis di selatan untuk mengungsi. IDF tidak memberikan komentar lebih lanjut kepada NPR mengenai pengungsian tambahan ini. Data resmi Kementerian Kesehatan Gaza menyebut lebih dari 11.800 orang—lebih dari dua pertiga perempuan, anak-anak, dan lansia—tewas sejak ofensif dimulai. Peta PBB berbasis data ini menunjukkan lebih dari 3.600 kematian terjadi di wilayah yang ditetapkan Israel untuk evakuasi warga sipil. Analisis satelit Sentinel-1 Badan Antariksa Eropa dan peneliti Corey Scher serta Jamon Van Den Hoek, menemukan kerusakan bangunan yang konsisten di Gaza tengah dan selatan, terutama setelah perintah evakuasi 13 Oktober. Antara 3.400 hingga 4.800 bangunan telah rusak atau hancur di zona ini, termasuk kamp pengungsi yang padat penduduk. Kisah pribadi seperti Asa'd Saqallah—yang keluarganya kehilangan beberapa anggota usai mengungsi dari Kota Gaza ke Khan Younis—menunjukkan risiko besar meski sudah pindah ke selatan. Organisasi Airwars menemukan bahwa, dalam pekan pertama setelah Israel meminta warga mengungsi ke selatan, pengeboman di kawasan ini meningkat. Airwars mencatat 127 dugaan kerugian sipil di bagian selatan Gaza antara 14 hingga 21 Oktober, terutama di sekitar sekolah, rumah sakit, dan restoran. Pada 12 November, serangan Israel dilaporkan mengenai guesthouse staf UNRWA di Rafah. UNRWA melaporkan sedikitnya 102 staf tewas dalam lima minggu terakhir, periode paling mematikan dalam sejarahnya. Sekitar 830.000 pengungsi berlindung di bangunan UNRWA, seringkali dalam kondisi penuh sesak. Selama sebulan terakhir, UNRWA menyebut 64 fasilitasnya rusak, serangan membunuh 71 orang di tempat penampungannya dan melukai ratusan lainnya—banyak di selatan Gaza. 'Ini membuktikan tidak ada tempat yang aman di Gaza,' kata Juliette Touma dari UNRWA. Donatella Rovera dari Amnesty International menyebut intensitas serangan Israel belum pernah terjadi sebelumnya. Pejabat Gaza melaporkan korban tewas termasuk 4.407 anak, 3.137 perempuan, dan 686 lansia, dari populasi 2,3 juta jiwa. Israel menyatakan Hamas bersembunyi di antara warga sipil sehingga serangan diperlukan, sementara Komisioner UNRWA Philippe Lazzarini menegaskan ribuan anak tidak boleh jadi 'kerugian sampingan.' UNRWA memperkirakan 70% penduduk Gaza mengungsi, mayoritas di selatan yang kekurangan tempat berlindung, makanan, dan air. Warga melaporkan harus mengumpulkan kayu dari puing bangunan untuk memasak dan menggali sumur demi air. Abu Kareem, di Rafah, mengatakan pada NPR: 'Kami tidak bisa menemukan makanan atau air, dan tidak punya air untuk mandi.' Gaza sudah tergantung bantuan sebelum perang. Israel menetapkan 'pengepungan total' sejak 7 Oktober, sangat membatasi pasokan bahan bakar dan kebutuhan pokok. Beberapa truk bantuan sudah masuk, namun persediaan masih jauh dari cukup. UNRWA memperingatkan penyakit mulai menyebar, dan operator telekomunikasi Paltel menyebut kekurangan bahan bakar menyebabkan gangguan luas komunikasi. Jumat lalu, Paltel melaporkan layanan mulai sebagian pulih setelah menerima sedikit bahan bakar dari UNRWA. Peliputan oleh Ruth Sherlock (Roma), Daniel Wood (Washington D.C.), Abu Bakr Bashir (London), Fatima Al-Kassab (London), Alon Avital (Tel Aviv), dan Anas Baba (Gaza).

article_content: Hyte is once again challenging expectations with its latest PC case, the Y70 Touch. Building on the success of its acclaimed Y60 model, Hyte introduces a striking new concept: a PC case featuring a built-in 10-point touchscreen. Priced at $360, the Y70 Touch is positioned as a premium chassis but is more attainable than it appears, especially for high-end PC builds. While the Y60 gained popularity among PC enthusiasts for its iconic 'fish tank' design and tool-less features, the Y70 Touch offers several notable upgrades. It features a completely tool-less design for side panels, increased internal volume (over 70 liters), and is slightly larger than its predecessor. The additional width accommodates a fourth PCIe bracket for vertical GPU mounting, addressing limitations with larger graphics cards like the RTX 4090. Improved cooling support is a major highlight: the Y70 Touch can house three 120mm fans at the bottom or side, compared to two in the Y60, eliminating previous gaps and allowing for better airflow. It now supports a thicker 360mm radiator (up to 68mm) at the top and a 360mm radiator on the side, making it more suitable for robust builds. The central feature, the capacitive touchscreen, sets the Y70 Touch apart. With its 1,100 x 3,840 pixel display (283 PPI), it offers high resolution and practical functionality. Compared to the optional LCD mod for the Y60, the integrated touchscreen in the Y70 Touch is much superior, both in resolution and ease of installation. Setup is streamlined with included cables and simple connectivity to a graphics card, motherboard USB header, and SATA power. Once configured with Hyte's Nexus software, the touchscreen transforms into a versatile control panel. Users can add widgets like a calculator, Twitch chat, OBS status, clocks, weather, media players, performance overlays, and more. The software promises further integrations, such as Google Calendar, notes, RSS feeds, an audio visualizer, and IFTTT support. An app row, video or customizable backgrounds, and the ability to swipe through windows offer a smartphone-like experience. Hyte has further improved the side panel by reducing bezel size for better visibility inside the case. However, the Y70 Touch is currently only available with the touchscreen; no non-touchscreen variant exists yet. Despite its significant price and premium positioning, the Y70 Touch justifies its cost for those seeking a cutting-edge, high-end PC case. For others, a more affordable version without the touchscreen would be ideal. Overall, the Y70 Touch sets a new standard in PC case innovation.

Mengusung kesuksesan model Y60 yang mendapat banyak pujian, Hyte memperkenalkan konsep baru yang menarik: casing PC dengan layar sentuh 10 titik bawaan. Dengan harga $360, Y70 Touch diposisikan sebagai casing premium, namun tetap terjangkau, terutama bagi pecinta rakitan PC kelas atas. Sementara Y60 populer di kalangan penggemar PC berkat desain 'akuarium' ikonis dan fitur tanpa alat, Y70 Touch menawarkan sejumlah peningkatan yang patut dicatat. Desain tanpa alat sepenuhnya untuk panel samping, volume internal lebih besar (lebih dari 70 liter), serta ukuran casing yang sedikit lebih besar dari pendahulunya. Lebar tambahan memungkinkan penambahan bracket PCIe keempat untuk pemasangan GPU secara vertikal, mengatasi keterbatasan pada kartu grafis besar seperti RTX 4090. Peningkatan dukungan pendinginan jadi sorotan utama: Y70 Touch bisa menampung tiga kipas 120mm di bagian bawah atau samping, dibanding dua pada Y60, sehingga meningkatkan aliran udara. Kini mendukung radiator 360mm yang lebih tebal (hingga 68mm) di atas dan radiator 360mm di sisi samping, membuatnya kian ideal untuk rakitan bertenaga. Dibandingkan mod LCD opsional untuk Y60, layar sentuh terintegrasi di Y70 Touch jauh lebih unggul dari segi resolusi dan kemudahan pemasangan. Proses setup pun praktis dengan kabel bawaan dan konektivitas yang sederhana ke VGA, header USB motherboard, serta daya SATA. Setelah diatur dengan perangkat lunak Nexus dari Hyte, layar sentuh ini berubah jadi panel kontrol multifungsi. Hyte juga menyempurnakan panel samping dengan memperkecil bezel agar isi casing lebih terlihat. Namun saat ini Y70 Touch hanya tersedia dengan layar sentuh; belum ada varian tanpa layar. Meski harganya tinggi dan premium, Y70 Touch layak untuk mereka yang ingin casing PC tercanggih saat ini. Untuk yang lain, varian tanpa layar akan sangat ideal. Secara keseluruhan, Y70 Touch menetapkan standar baru dalam inovasi casing PC.

article_content: Michael Whitbread, 74, appeared at Westminster Magistrates' Court for extradition proceedings after the death of Michele Faiers, 66, in Italy. Ms Faiers was found dead near Casoli on Wednesday. Whitbread was arrested in Shepshed, Leicestershire, later that day. At Saturday's hearing, Whitbread, who usually lives in Italy, refused to consent to extradition. The judge ordered him to stay in custody, with another preliminary hearing set for Thursday at the same court. Whitbread is a retired driving instructor and shop owner. He is visiting family in England and has a ticket to return to Italy. Judge John Zani stressed that Whitbread is accused but not convicted, highlighting the serious nature of the charge. The judge noted that if convicted, a long prison sentence is likely. A full hearing is scheduled for 26 February next year.
translated_content: Michael Whitbread, 74 tahun, menghadiri sidang di Pengadilan Magistrat Westminster terkait proses ekstradisi usai kematian Michele Faiers, 66 tahun, di Italia. Ms Faiers ditemukan tewas dekat Casoli pada hari Rabu. Whitbread ditangkap di Shepshed, Leicestershire, pada hari yang sama. Pada sidang hari Sabtu, Whitbread, yang biasanya tinggal di Italia, menolak ekstradisi. Hakim memutuskan ia tetap ditahan, dan sidang pendahuluan berikutnya akan diadakan hari Kamis di pengadilan yang sama. Whitbread adalah pensiunan instruktur mengemudi dan pemilik toko. Ia sedang mengunjungi keluarganya di Inggris dan memegang tiket pulang ke Italia. Hakim John Zani menegaskan Whitbread baru didakwa, belum dinyatakan bersalah, serta menyoroti beratnya tuduhan tersebut. Hakim menyebut jika terbukti bersalah, hukuman penjara yang panjang sangat mungkin dijatuhkan. Sidang penuh dijadwalkan pada 26 Februari tahun depan.

article_content:
Christopher Luxon was sworn in as New Zealand's Prime Minister on Monday. He stated that his top priority is to improve the economy. The 53-year-old former businessman now leads a conservative coalition after the National Party reached an agreement with two smaller parties following last month's general election.

The swearing-in ceremony, overseen by Governor-General Cindy Kiro, marked the official start of Luxon's term. He described his new role as an "awesome responsibility" and said he would hold his first Cabinet meeting on Tuesday, aiming to quickly finalize a 100-day action plan. Luxon also announced plans to visit Australia before Christmas.

Luxon mentioned he would seek a briefing from the Treasury about the government's finances, expressing concern over what he described as a worsening outlook in recent months. Under the new coalition agreement, Luxon pledged to deliver tax cuts, train 500 new police officers within two years, and reduce government bureaucracy, including a 6.5% cut to the public service. He noted it would be up to ministry chief executives to decide how to achieve these cuts, potentially by halting certain programs, not filling vacancies, or laying off workers.

The government also intends to repeal tobacco restrictions introduced by the previous administration. These measures had included lowering nicotine levels in cigarettes, limiting the number of retailers, and imposing a lifetime ban on tobacco sales to youth. Luxon stated that while they disagreed with some aspects of the policy, the government would continue educational campaigns and promote vaping as a tool to help people quit smoking. He also noted that smoking rates had been declining for the past 30 years.

Critics argue that rolling back these tobacco controls is a setback for public health and benefits the tobacco industry.

Chris Hipkins, who officially resigned as Prime Minister early Monday, wished Luxon and the new government well. Hipkins, who served as Prime Minister for 10 months following Jacinda Ardern's resignation in January, will remain in Parliament as the opposition leader. He noted that, while the country had faced difficult times, he believes the economy is recovering.

Christopher Luxon resmi dilantik sebagai Perdana Menteri Selandia Baru pada hari Senin. Ia menegaskan bahwa prioritas utamanya adalah memperbaiki perekonomian negara. Mantan pebisnis berusia 53 tahun ini kini memimpin koalisi konservatif setelah Partai Nasional mencapai kesepakatan dengan dua partai kecil pasca pemilu bulan lalu.

Upacara pelantikan yang dipimpin Gubernur Jenderal Cindy Kiro menandai dimulainya masa jabatan Luxon secara resmi. Ia menyebut peran barunya sebagai "tanggung jawab luar biasa" dan mengatakan akan menggelar rapat kabinet pertamanya pada hari Selasa, dengan target segera merampungkan rencana kerja 100 hari. Luxon juga mengumumkan rencana kunjungan ke Australia sebelum Natal.

Luxon menyatakan akan meminta laporan dari Departemen Keuangan mengenai kondisi keuangan pemerintahan, mengekspresikan kekhawatiran terhadap situasi keuangan yang menurutnya memburuk dalam beberapa bulan terakhir. Berdasarkan kesepakatan koalisi, Luxon berjanji memberikan pemotongan pajak, melatih 500 polisi baru dalam dua tahun ke depan, serta mengurangi birokrasi pemerintahan sebanyak 6,5%. Ia mengatakan para pimpinan kementerian yang akan menentukan cara melakukan pemotongan tersebut, seperti dengan menghentikan program, tidak mengisi lowongan, atau melakukan pemutusan hubungan kerja.

Pemerintah juga berencana mencabut pembatasan tembakau yang diberlakukan pemerintahan sebelumnya. Aturan tersebut mencakup penurunan kadar nikotin pada rokok, membatasi jumlah pengecer, dan pemberlakuan larangan seumur hidup penjualan kepada anak muda. Luxon menyebut pemerintah berbeda pandangan dengan beberapa kebijakan tersebut, namun akan tetap menjalankan edukasi dan mendorong penggunaan vape sebagai alat berhenti merokok. Ia menambahkan tingkat merokok telah turun selama 30 tahun terakhir.

Para kritikus berpendapat pencabutan pengendalian tembakau merupakan kemunduran bagi kesehatan masyarakat dan menguntungkan industri tembakau.

Chris Hipkins, yang resmi mengundurkan diri sebagai Perdana Menteri pada Senin pagi, mengucapkan selamat kepada Luxon dan koalisi barunya. Hipkins, yang menjadi PM selama 10 bulan setelah Jacinda Ardern mundur pada Januari, akan tetap menjadi pemimpin oposisi di Parlemen. Ia menilai negara ini telah melewati masa sulit namun perekonomian mulai membaik.

article_content: Criminals are taking advantage of Gumtree, a widely used classified ads website, to execute scams that have led to millions in losses for UK consumers. While Gumtree offers a platform to buy and sell everything from vehicles and electronics to pets, Citizens Advice reports that one-sixth of the cases they examined regarding the site involved fraud or suspected scams. According to police, around 250 weekly reports of crimes or fraud are linked to Gumtree, some involving serious thefts or assaults. The National Fraud Intelligence Bureau stated that in 2013, the most common scam reported was related to online shopping and auctions, resulting in a loss of £63.6 million for UK consumers. Gumtree is seen as particularly vulnerable because it doesn’t require identification or vet users, making it easier for scammers to act repeatedly without being traced. Its parent company, eBay, does check user identities but still faces concerns about scams. Citizens Advice found that approximately one in ten of the cases they handled concerning eBay also involved scams. Examples include a person searching for a rental property on Gumtree who paid £1,650 to someone posing as a landlord, but discovered someone else was already living there. Another case involved a person buying a car on eBay, spending £700 on repairs, only to have the car repossessed due to previous owner debts. These are just a few cases among many, as highlighted by increasing court cases and police reports involving Gumtree. Citizens Advice recorded 649 issue reports connected to Gumtree and 3,711 for eBay between October and March. Victims are instructed to report fraud to Action Fraud, which passes certain cases to local police, but many have reported not receiving police contact or resolution. Gillian Guy, Chief Executive of Citizens Advice, warned that online marketplaces are at risk of becoming breeding grounds for scams, urging companies to improve their security, increase monitoring, conduct checks, and quickly remove suspect listings. In response, Gumtree said it works diligently to block scammers and encourages users to report fraud to both the company and the police. As an open platform, Gumtree does not collect user identification, but is continuously seeking to enhance customer safety through better communication and sharing safety tips. eBay responded by questioning the research and highlighting its large user base of 19 million monthly UK visitors. It claims to invest heavily in safety measures and said that consumers are protected by their Money Back Guarantee.

Menurut polisi, sekitar 250 laporan kejahatan atau penipuan per minggu terhubung ke Gumtree, beberapa di antaranya melibatkan pencurian besar atau kekerasan. Biro Intelijen Penipuan Nasional menyebutkan bahwa pada tahun 2013, penipuan online terkait belanja dan lelang adalah yang paling sering dilaporkan, merugikan konsumen Inggris hingga £63,6 juta. Gumtree dinilai sangat rentan karena tidak meminta identitas atau verifikasi pengguna, sehingga penipu mudah beraksi berulang kali tanpa terlacak. eBay, sebagai induk Gumtree, memang memverifikasi identitas pengguna tetapi masih menghadapi masalah penipuan. Citizens Advice menemukan sekitar satu dari sepuluh kasus yang mereka tangani terkait eBay juga merupakan penipuan. Contoh kasus mencakup seseorang yang mencari rumah sewa di Gumtree dan membayar £1.650 ke pihak yang mengaku pemilik, namun ternyata rumah sudah dihuni orang lain. Ada juga kasus pembelian mobil di eBay, pengeluaran £700 untuk perbaikan, lalu mobilnya disita karena utang pemilik sebelumnya. Ini hanya segelintir contoh dari banyaknya kasus lain, seperti dibuktikan oleh laporan pengadilan dan polisi yang terus bertambah terkait Gumtree. Citizens Advice mendata 649 laporan masalah terkait Gumtree dan 3.711 terhadap eBay selama Oktober–Maret. Korban penipuan diminta melaporkan kasusnya ke Action Fraud yang kemudian menindaklanjuti sebagian kasus ke polisi daerah, namun banyak korban mengaku tidak dihubungi atau tidak mendapat penyelesaian. Gillian Guy, Kepala Eksekutif Citizens Advice, menegaskan bahwa marketplace online berisiko besar jadi sarang penipuan. Ia meminta perusahaan meningkatkan perlindungan, pengawasan lebih ketat, lakukan pemeriksaan rutin, dan segera menghapus iklan mencurigakan. Menanggapi kritik, Gumtree menyatakan terus berupaya memberantas penipu dan mendorong pelaporan ke mereka dan polisi. Sebagai platform terbuka, Gumtree memang tidak mengumpulkan identitas pengguna, namun terus mengembangkan sistem keamanan, komunikasi, dan edukasi pengguna soal keselamatan. eBay mempertanyakan hasil riset Citizens Advice dan menyoroti 19 juta pengunjung bulanan di Inggris sebagai konteks. eBay menyatakan menginvestasikan dana besar untuk keamanan dan menjamin pembeli lewat Money Back Guarantee.

article_content: Inspector General of Police, Kayode Egbetokun, has highlighted that the Nigeria Police Force is grappling with major challenges stemming from inadequate funding and insufficient manpower. Addressing the House of Representatives, Egbetokun stated that Nigeria's police-to-population ratio is currently around 1 officer to 1,000 citizens, compared to the United Nations' recommended ratio of 1 to 400—indicating the urgent need to double the police workforce. Egbetokun reported that there are 1,537 divisional police headquarters across Nigeria’s 774 local government areas. Providing these divisions with operational patrol vehicles remains a significant challenge, as many have none. Each division requires at least four functional patrol vehicles, meaning a total need of 6,148 vehicles nationwide. The PUNCH newspaper found that a new Toyota Hilux V6 is priced at a minimum of N40 million according to several anonymous auto dealers. Therefore, outfitting all divisions would require roughly N245.9 billion. While presenting to the National Assembly, Egbetokun stressed the importance of increased funding, emphasizing that despite the police making numerous arrests and recovering illicit weapons in recent months, such efforts alone cannot resolve Nigeria’s deep-rooted security issues. He expressed concern that as arrests are made, new criminal activities continue to emerge. In a related interview, retired Deputy Inspector General of Police, Adedayo Adeoye, urged President Bola Tinubu to declare a six-month state of emergency to address insecurity. Adeoye recommended that the Federal Government enhance police funding and withdraw officers from VIP escort duties to increase available manpower. Adeoye commended steps toward ending VIP duties and noted that the police often receive less than half of their approved budget, which limits essential operations such as fueling and equipping patrol vehicles. He advocated for better funding, improved weaponry, and advanced intelligence to combat insecurity effectively.
translated_content: Kepala Kepolisian Negara, Kayode Egbetokun, menyoroti bahwa Kepolisian Nigeria menghadapi tantangan besar akibat kurangnya pendanaan dan kekurangan personel. Dalam rapat dengan Dewan Perwakilan Rakyat, Egbetokun menyatakan rasio polisi terhadap penduduk di Nigeria saat ini sekitar 1 banding 1.000, jauh dari rekomendasi Perserikatan Bangsa-Bangsa sebesar 1 banding 400, sehingga membutuhkan penambahan jumlah personel secara signifikan. Egbetokun melaporkan terdapat 1.537 markas kepolisian tingkat divisi di 774 wilayah pemerintah lokal di Nigeria. Penyediaan kendaraan patroli operasional untuk seluruh divisi masih menjadi masalah besar karena banyak yang belum memilikinya. Setiap divisi membutuhkan minimal empat kendaraan patroli yang berfungsi, sehingga dibutuhkan total 6.148 kendaraan secara nasional. Menurut laporan surat kabar The PUNCH, sebuah Toyota Hilux V6 baru dibanderol minimal N40 juta berdasarkan beberapa dealer mobil yang enggan disebut namanya. Dengan demikian, pengadaan semua kendaraan untuk markas divisi diperkirakan membutuhkan sekitar N245,9 miliar. Saat mempresentasikan laporan di Majelis Nasional, Egbetokun menekankan pentingnya peningkatan dana. Ia menyoroti meski polisi telah melakukan banyak penangkapan dan penyitaan senjata ilegal dalam beberapa bulan terakhir, upaya tersebut saja tidak cukup mengatasi permasalahan keamanan di Nigeria. Ia khawatir, walaupun patroli dan penangkapan dilakukan, tindak kejahatan baru tetap bermunculan. Dalam wawancara terpisah, mantan Deputi Kepala Kepolisian, Adedayo Adeoye, meminta Presiden Bola Tinubu untuk menetapkan status darurat selama enam bulan guna menangani isu keamanan. Adeoye juga menyarankan pemerintah pusat menambah anggaran polisi dan menarik personel dari tugas pengawalan VIP agar jumlah personel aktif bertambah. Adeoye mengapresiasi langkah pengurangan tugas pengawalan VIP dan mengatakan bahwa polisi sering hanya menerima kurang dari setengah anggaran yang disetujui, sehingga membatasi operasi penting seperti pengisian bahan bakar dan pengadaan perlengkapan kendaraan patroli. Ia mendorong agar pendanaan, persenjataan, dan kemampuan intelijen polisi ditingkatkan untuk melawan ancaman keamanan secara efektif.

article_content: The name 'Williamsburg' evokes different images depending on who you ask. For some, it brings to mind the historical charm of Colonial Williamsburg, Virginia, with its costumed interpreters and nods to America's past. For others, it's all about Williamsburg, Brooklyn—a hot spot for young creatives, hipsters, and the constantly evolving urban scene. Williamsburg, Brooklyn, has become a poster child for rapid neighborhood change and gentrification. Critics say it’s lost its underground edge as artists gave way to trend-seekers and investment bankers, resulting in soaring rents and pushing out long-time residents. Still, the area keeps attracting new folks who are drawn to its energy. On a personal return after a few years, I was reminded of why Williamsburg, Brooklyn, stands out. The streets buzz with life, filled with eclectic shops, eateries, and crowds of stylish young adults. What’s remarkable is the thriving scene for small, independent businesses—places like Spoonbill and Sugartown (a lively bookstore), Main Drag Music, local wine sellers, and craft-focused clothing shops sit at the heart of the neighborhood. The community is also rich with amenities. From public recreation centers and well-kept athletic fields to quirky boutiques and cozy restaurants, there’s a sense that the area is built for both play and everyday living. Chain stores are a rarity here; even the lone Duane Reade drugstore aims to blend in with a craft beer bar. As I wandered from shop to shop, gathering a ninja manual from a bookstore, wine from a friendly neighborhood seller, new socks, and some cheese, I marveled at the sense of local pride and pleasant surprises at every turn. A stop at Maison Premiere revealed one of many welcoming, character-filled bars. Even the restaurants seem in constant evolution, serving up new and surprising experiences. Though nostalgia lingers for the 'old' Williamsburg, the neighborhood’s mix of tradition, innovation, and diverse personalities gives it enduring charm. It’s unlikely every city could replicate this unique vibe, but for anyone open to discovery, Williamsburg—post-colonial edition—is worth exploring. And if you worry about fitting in, don’t. The scene-chasers have already moved on to the next spot.

article_content: Novak Djokovic is smiling again, and it’s not just because of his flawless record at this week’s ATP World Tour Finals. Earlier last week, the Serbian tennis star was dealing with the distressing news that his father, Srdjan, had been hospitalized with an acute respiratory illness. The situation disrupted Djokovic’s preparations for the Paris Masters, where he lost his opening match. Thankfully, Srdjan’s condition has since improved, allowing Djokovic to regain his focus for the $5.5 million season-ending event in London. “It was hard—it still is—but there’s good news every day,” said the world No. 1, recalling how he also lost his grandfather in April just before a Monte Carlo match. “That makes me happier and helps me play more relaxed on the court. I try to switch off and focus only on the match, and so far, it’s been working well. Every win means a lot for my family and me, but health is the most important thing in life. That’s the priority now.” With Friday’s 6-2, 7-6 (8-6) win over sixth-ranked Tomas Berdych, Djokovic secured his place in the semifinals, maintaining a 100% record in Group A. As in his previous victory over world No. 3 Andy Murray, Djokovic showed resilience, saving three set points to win in straight sets and ending Berdych’s hopes of another semifinals appearance. This victory brought him level with David Ferrer’s tour-leading 73 match wins this year. Djokovic, who won the tournament in Shanghai in 2008, failed to progress last year from a group that also included Berdych. He struggled towards the end of a season where he rose to world No. 1, dethroning Rafael Nadal and winning three out of four grand slam titles. Berdych will now look ahead to the 100th Davis Cup final next week, where he’ll lead the Czech Republic against Spain. Joining Djokovic in the London semifinals is Andy Murray, who defeated Jo-Wilfried Tsonga 6-2, 7-6 (7-3). Murray, the reigning U.S. Open and Olympic champion, only needed to win the first set to qualify after Berdych’s elimination, securing his spot with relative ease before Tsonga mounted a late challenge. Both Murray and Djokovic must wait for Saturday’s Group B results to learn their semifinal opponents. Roger Federer has already clinched a spot in the semifinals, but the outcome of his match against Juan Martin del Potro will determine the group leader. World No. 5 David Ferrer—who leads the tour with seven titles—can still qualify if he beats Janko Tipsarevic and Federer wins his match.

Kondisi ini mengganggu persiapan Djokovic di Paris Masters, di mana ia kalah di pertandingan pembuka. Untungnya, kondisi Srdjan kini membaik, sehingga Djokovic bisa kembali fokus untuk turnamen penutup musim senilai $5,5 juta di London. "Itu berat—masih terasa berat—tapi ada kabar baik setiap hari," kata petenis nomor satu dunia itu, yang juga kehilangan kakeknya pada bulan April lalu jelang pertandingan di Monte Carlo. Dengan kemenangan 6-2, 7-6 (8-6) atas Tomas Berdych yang menduduki peringkat enam dunia pada hari Jumat, Djokovic memastikan tempat di semifinal, mempertahankan rekor 100% di Grup A. Seperti saat mengalahkan Andy Murray, Djokovic menunjukkan ketangguhan dengan menyelamatkan tiga set point dan menang dua set langsung, sekaligus mengakhiri harapan Berdych untuk kembali ke semifinal. Kemenangan ini menyamakan jumlah kemenangannya dengan David Ferrer, yaitu 73 kemenangan dalam satu musim. Djokovic, yang pernah menjuarai turnamen ini di Shanghai tahun 2008, gagal lolos dari grup pada tahun lalu yang juga dihuni Berdych. Ia mengamankan posisi semifinal dengan mudah sebelum Tsonga memberi perlawanan di akhir pertandingan. Murray dan Djokovic kini menunggu hasil Grup B pada Sabtu untuk mengetahui lawan semifinal mereka. Roger Federer sudah memastikan satu tempat di semifinal, namun posisi puncak grup akan ditentukan dalam laga melawan Juan Martin del Potro. David Ferrer yang menempati peringkat lima dunia—dan koleksi tujuh gelar musim ini—masih berpeluang lolos jika ia mengalahkan Janko Tipsarevic dan Federer memenangkan laga ketiganya.
