article_content: Three members of Pussy Riot, a Russian punk band, have pleaded not guilty to hooliganism charges after performing a protest song against President Vladimir Putin inside Moscow’s Christ the Savior Cathedral. Their February act, described as a 'punk prayer,' featured lyrics like 'Mother Mary please drive Putin away', and drew significant attention due to the masked performers. The women were detained shortly after and have been held in custody, facing a potential seven-year sentence. Two of the trio are mothers to young children. On Monday, the group apologized publicly, stating they did not intend to offend Orthodox Christians. Nadezhda Tolokonnikova (23), Maria Alyokhina (24), and Yekaterina Samutsevich (29) were brought to court handcuffed together, smiling and waving to cameras. During the hearing, they had to crouch to speak through a small window in the defendants' enclosure. Amnesty International criticized the trial, with spokesperson John Dalhuisen calling the protest a legitimate act of dissent and decrying the severity of potential punishment. He noted that the women had confronted both state power and the Orthodox Church. Despite their incarceration, Tolokonnikova’s husband, Peter Verzilov, described her as strong and creative, viewing their ordeal as both political and artistic. Verzilov remarked that while the group always knew arrests were possible, the current reaction was unexpected. Their protest was driven by opposition to the strong ties between the Russian government and the Orthodox Church, whose leader Patriarch Kyril has lauded Putin. The performance inside a sacred cathedral has angered many Russians—some call for harsh penalties, while others feel that imprisonment would be excessive. Supporters argue that the women are being politically persecuted and have become symbols of resistance. Verzilov told his daughter that Putin is responsible for her mother’s detention, underlining the case’s political nature. President Putin has not commented publicly. Although Pussy Riot represents just one part of the anti-Putin movement, their prosecution has turned them into an emblem of the Russian opposition. Reporting by CNN journalists Phil Black, Alla Eshchenko, and Richard Allen Greene.

Aksi mereka pada Februari lalu, yang sering disebut 'doa punk', membawakan lirik seperti 'Bunda Maria, tolong usir Putin', dan menarik perhatian masyarakat karena para anggota mengenakan masker. Ketiga perempuan itu langsung ditahan sesaat setelah aksi berlangsung dan hingga kini masih mendekam di tahanan, terancam hukuman hingga tujuh tahun penjara. Aksi protes mereka dilatarbelakangi kritik terhadap hubungan erat pemerintah Rusia dan Gereja Ortodoks, di mana Patriark Kirill sering memuji Putin. Meski Pussy Riot hanya bagian kecil dari gerakan anti-Putin, kasus mereka telah mengubah wajah mereka menjadi ikon oposisi di Rusia. Laporan disusun oleh jurnalis CNN Phil Black, Alla Eshchenko, dan Richard Allen Greene.

article_content:
How AI Can Be Leveraged for Diversity and Inclusion

In today’s workplace, diversity and inclusion (D&I) are more than just buzzwords—they are vital for fostering innovation, creativity, and a welcoming environment. Despite increased awareness, many companies still face challenges in effectively addressing diversity issues.

Artificial intelligence (AI) is emerging as a powerful tool for identifying and reducing biases in various corporate processes, offering opportunities for meaningful and lasting change.

The Data on Diversity

Research indicates a persistent lack of diversity across industries. According to McKinsey’s 2020 report, companies in the top quartile for ethnic and cultural diversity outperform those in the lowest quartile by 36% in profitability. Yet, many organizations still fall short of these diversity milestones. A Boston Consulting Group study found that diverse companies reported 19% higher innovation revenues. Despite promising statistics, progress has been slow. For example, women hold just 25% of all jobs in technology, and African American employees account for only 7% of the Silicon Valley workforce, as reported by CIO.

AI can play a significant role when used wisely. It can analyze recruitment processes, marketing materials, and internal communications to identify and reduce biases. For instance, AI-powered tools can examine job descriptions and recruiting documents for unconscious bias, helping attract a wider range of applicants. These technologies can also enable blind hiring by removing demographic information from resumes, letting candidates be evaluated solely on their skills and qualifications.

In talent management, AI can monitor interactions and feedback within the workplace, pinpointing possible areas of bias or discrimination and equipping leaders with insights to create a more inclusive environment. Further, AI can facilitate mentorship and networking by connecting employees from varied backgrounds based on interests or career goals—supporting a culture of inclusion and collaboration.

Inclusivity as a Core Business Strategy

“An AI-driven approach isn’t just about identifying issues; it’s about empowering companies to drive change. We’re helping them not only avoid pitfalls but actively promote diversity and inclusion in their messaging,” says Larry Adams, CEO of XStereotype, an AI operating system at the forefront of this movement. XStereotype uses AI to analyze content through a D&I lens, delivering insight scores that highlight potential biases.

The company’s approach goes beyond compliance by making inclusivity central to business strategy, showing strong demand for such solutions. This year, XStereotype has analyzed more than 100 campaigns involving over 1,000 pieces of content. Their clients include major brands such as SC Johnson, P&G, American Express, FanDuel, Group Black, 3M, Chipotle, and Bob Evans, demonstrating the technology’s wide reach.

As AI technologies continue to evolve, so do the standards for diversity and inclusion in corporate contexts. XStereotype’s extensive client base highlights the need and demand for such tools.

DEI as a Strategic Business Priority

A Fortune/Deloitte survey found more than 95% of CEOs consider diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) a personal strategic priority. While building a truly diverse and inclusive workplace is a complex effort, AI tools are proving invaluable. Through AI, companies can not only meet ethical standards but also enhance their cultural fabric and financial results. In this light, AI stands as a catalyst for positive social change, making it an essential part of today’s corporate D&I initiatives.

Bagaimana AI Dapat Dimanfaatkan untuk Keberagaman dan Inklusi

Data tentang Keberagaman

Riset menunjukkan masih kurangnya keberagaman di banyak industri. Menurut laporan McKinsey tahun 2020, perusahaan di kuartil teratas untuk keberagaman etnis dan budaya memiliki profitabilitas 36% lebih tinggi dibanding perusahaan di kuartil terbawah. Inklusi sebagai Strategi Bisnis Inti

"Pendekatan AI tidak hanya soal mendeteksi masalah—ini membantu perusahaan untuk melakukan perubahan. Kami membantu mereka bukan cuma menghindari risiko, tetapi juga aktif mendorong keberagaman dan inklusi dalam pesan mereka,” ujar Larry Adams, CEO XStereotype, sistem operasi AI terdepan di bidang ini. XStereotype menggunakan AI untuk menelaah konten melalui kacamata keberagaman dan inklusi, menghasilkan skor wawasan yang memperlihatkan potensi bias.

Pendekatan XStereotype tidak sekadar soal kepatuhan, tapi menempatkan inklusi sebagai inti strategi bisnis, menunjukkan besarnya permintaan atas solusi seperti ini. Sepanjang tahun ini, XStereotype telah menganalisis lebih dari 100 kampanye dengan 1.000 lebih konten kreatif. Kliennya termasuk merek besar seperti SC Johnson, P&G, American Express, FanDuel, Group Black, 3M, Chipotle, dan Bob Evans, menunjukkan jangkauan luas teknologi ini.

Seiring AI berkembang, standar keberagaman dan inklusi di korporasi pun terus meningkat. Klien XStereotype yang beragam memperlihatkan pentingnya kebutuhan akan alat seperti ini.

DEI sebagai Prioritas Strategis Bisnis

Survei Fortune/Deloitte menunjukkan lebih dari 95% CEO menempatkan keberagaman, kesetaraan, dan inklusi (DEI) sebagai prioritas strategis pribadi. Walaupun menciptakan tempat kerja yang benar-benar beragam dan inklusif adalah proses rumit, AI terbukti sangat bermanfaat. Lewat AI, perusahaan dapat memenuhi standar etika sekaligus memperkuat budaya dan kinerja keuangan mereka. Dalam konteks ini, AI bukan sekadar alat teknologi, tetapi katalis perubahan sosial positif, dan jadi elemen penting bagi upaya D&I di dunia bisnis masa kini.

article_content: Kota currently relies on a small airport that only manages VIP or special flights, which limits options for regular travelers. As election campaigning ramps up in Rajasthan, the demand for a comprehensive commercial airport in Kota is intensifying. Both the Congress and BJP are trading accusations over the lack of progress on the project, making it a central issue in the Kota North constituency, where Congress's Shanti Dhariwal is running against BJP's Prahlad Gunjal. The absence of regular flight services has been a persistent concern in local elections, featuring in discussions during the 2018 state polls and the 2019 national elections. Kota draws over 200,000 students each year who come to prepare for engineering and medical entrance exams such as the JEE and NEET. Because there is no commercial airport, most students and their families must travel through cities like New Delhi, Jaipur, or Udaipur, leading to long and inconvenient journeys. Students and parents frequently voice their need for improved air connectivity, noting that the current setup adds unnecessary strain. The existing train services are also considered insufficient, which negatively affects both locals and tourists. With assembly elections scheduled for November 25 and results due on December 3, both major parties have pledged to address Kota's airport issue if elected. Despite these promises, skepticism persists among residents about whether real progress will be made after the polls.

Ketidakadaan layanan penerbangan reguler sudah lama menjadi masalah di pemilu lokal, dan pernah muncul dalam pemilu negara bagian tahun 2018 serta pemilu nasional 2019. Kota adalah tujuan bagi lebih dari 200.000 pelajar setiap tahun yang datang untuk persiapan ujian masuk seperti JEE dan NEET. article_content: Most provisions of a landmark food safety law passed 16 months ago have still not gone into effect and remain delayed in the rule-making process at the White House, now four months overdue. As a result, about 80% of the U.S. food supply is still regulated under food safety laws dating back to the Great Depression, which concerns both safety advocates and the food industry. "It's still unclear what's causing the delay," said Chris Waldrop, director of food policy at the Consumer Federation of America. The FDA Food Safety Modernization Act, signed by President Obama on January 4, 2011, authorizes the Food and Drug Administration to take preventive action, increase inspections, and mandate recalls to improve food safety. Many of the law's provisions remain unimplemented because the White House Office of Management and Budget has not released the required rules, which were due by January 4, 2012. "We are essentially still operating under laws that are 70 years old because the new safeguards in these rules have not been implemented," said Erik Olson, director of food programs for the Pew Health Group. "We're worried that all the effort put in by members of Congress, the business community, and health advocates will be in vain if these protections aren't put in place." The FDA has defended the pace of its review. "These are four major rules that will set a new framework for food safety. Each rule is complex and they are interconnected," said Michael Taylor, FDA deputy commissioner for Foods. The agency also notes that some aspects of the law have taken effect, such as the FDA's ability to detain food suspected of being adulterated or misbranded, and requiring importers to notify the FDA if other countries have refused their products. "If you look at typical timelines for issuing new rules, this process hasn't been unusually slow," Taylor said. "I'm proud of our progress and the speed of our work." However, some lobbyists and food safety advocates contacted by CNN believe politics may be a factor in the delays. "I think the administration is concerned about being labeled as promoting a 'nanny state.' There's worry about that," said one anonymous lobbyist. "There's also concern whether groups like the Grocery Manufacturers Association and others who supported the president might reconsider their support." The White House maintains that the priority is making effective rules, not politics. "The administration is working as quickly as possible to implement this crucial legislation," said Moira Mack, OMB spokeswoman. "With rules of this complexity and significance, it's vital to get them right." The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention estimates that one in six Americans becomes sick from contaminated food or drinks each year. Foodborne illnesses cause about 128,000 hospitalizations and 3,000 deaths annually, according to the CDC.

article_content: New England Patriots owner Robert Kraft maintains that his team is innocent in the ongoing 'Deflategate' controversy and has urged the NFL to apologize if its investigation finds no wrongdoing. Speaking in Arizona ahead of the Patriots’ Super Bowl matchup against the Seattle Seahawks, Kraft welcomed the league’s inquiry, expressing confidence that it would reveal the facts and clarify how footballs can react to environmental changes. At a press conference, Kraft called for an apology from the NFL, particularly to Coach Bill Belichick and quarterback Tom Brady, should the investigation—being led by attorney Ted Wells and NFL executive Jeff Pash—fail to prove that the Patriots purposely tampered with footballs during their AFC Championship win over the Indianapolis Colts. Kraft pointed out that strong accusations had been made based on circumstantial leaked evidence rather than concrete facts, causing significant distress to Belichick and Brady, whom he described as part of his family and said he had never known either to lie. Both Belichick and Brady have publicly denied knowingly violating league rules. Meanwhile, it was revealed that the NFL’s investigation is focusing on a Patriots locker room attendant after surveillance footage showed him moving footballs between rooms before the AFC Championship game. The attendant has reportedly been interviewed multiple times as investigators try to determine why 11 out of 12 footballs were under-inflated. Brady emphasized that the team is not being distracted by the controversy as they prepare for the Super Bowl, noting that they have faced significant adversity throughout the season. Despite escaping a winter blizzard to reach their destination in Phoenix, the Patriots continued to face intense media scrutiny regarding 'Deflategate.'

Berbicara di Arizona menjelang pertandingan Super Bowl Patriots melawan Seattle Seahawks, Kraft menyambut penyelidikan liga dan yakin penyelidikan tersebut akan mengungkap fakta dan menjelaskan bagaimana bola dapat bereaksi terhadap perubahan lingkungan. Kraft menekankan bahwa tuduhan-tuduhan kuat dibuat berdasarkan bukti bocor yang bersifat situasional, bukan fakta konkret, sehingga menyebabkan tekanan besar pada Belichick dan Brady yang ia anggap sebagai bagian dari keluarganya dan mengatakan tidak pernah mengetahui mereka berbohong. Baik Belichick maupun Brady secara terbuka membantah dengan sengaja melanggar aturan liga. Sementara itu, terungkap bahwa penyelidikan NFL kini fokus kepada seorang petugas ruang ganti Patriots setelah rekaman CCTV menunjukkan dirinya memindahkan bola antar ruangan sebelum pertandingan AFC Championship. Brady menekankan bahwa timnya tidak teralihkan oleh kontroversi saat mempersiapkan diri menghadapi Super Bowl, dan mengatakan bahwa mereka telah menghadapi banyak tantangan musim ini. article_content: LONDON — Former British Prime Minister David Cameron made a surprising return to high office on Monday, becoming Foreign Secretary in a significant reshuffle of the Conservative government. This shakeup also saw the dismissal of Home Secretary Suella Braverman, a controversial figure recently criticized for accusing police of being too lenient with pro-Palestinian protesters. Braverman was replaced by James Cleverly, who previously served as Foreign Secretary. Cameron, who led the UK government from 2010 to 2016, was appointed by Prime Minister Rishi Sunak. Cameron’s appointment is unusual, as it is rare for someone who is not currently a Member of Parliament—and even more so for a former prime minister—to return to the Cabinet. To allow Cameron to serve, the government will appoint him to the House of Lords, the UK's unelected upper chamber. The last Foreign Secretary to serve from the Lords was Peter Carrington during Margaret Thatcher's government in the 1980s. Cameron’s return comes several years after he resigned following the 2016 referendum on EU membership, which he called expecting the UK would vote to remain. He stepped down after the country voted to leave the European Union. Current Prime Minister Rishi Sunak was a vocal supporter of Brexit. Braverman’s departure was less unexpected, as Sunak had faced increasing pressure to remove her from one of the government's most senior positions, responsible for immigration and law enforcement. Last week, Braverman had criticized London’s police, accusing them of ignoring violations by pro-Palestinian protesters and describing cease-fire demonstrators in Gaza as 'hate marchers.' Far-right protesters also clashed with police during a large pro-Palestinian march in London over the weekend. Critics say Braverman’s comments contributed to rising tensions. Braverman previously wrote an article for The Times of London alleging police 'play favorites' with protesters—being more lenient with pro-Palestinian and Black Lives Matter demonstrators than with right-wing groups or soccer hooligans. The article was published without approval from the Prime Minister’s office. On Monday, Braverman called her time as Home Secretary 'the greatest privilege of my life,' and said she would comment further in due course. At 43, Braverman has emerged as a leader of the Conservative Party’s populist wing, advocating for stricter migration controls and challenging liberal social values, referring to some in the party as the 'tofu-eating wokerati.' Last month, she described migration as a 'hurricane' that would bring 'millions more immigrants,' claiming it would be impossible to manage. As Home Secretary, Braverman supported the government’s stalled plan to send asylum-seekers arriving in the UK via small boats to Rwanda. The legality of this policy is due to be decided by the UK Supreme Court on Wednesday. Observers believe Braverman has used her high-profile position to prepare for a possible future Conservative leadership bid, especially if the party loses power in the general election expected next year. Polls currently place the Conservatives 15 to 20 points behind the opposition Labour Party.

Perombakan ini juga menyebabkan pemberhentian Menteri Dalam Negeri Suella Braverman, sosok kontroversial yang baru-baru ini dikritik karena menuduh polisi terlalu lunak terhadap pengunjuk rasa pro-Palestina. Braverman digantikan oleh James Cleverly, yang sebelumnya menjabat sebagai Menteri Luar Negeri. Cameron, yang memimpin pemerintahan Inggris dari 2010 hingga 2016, diangkat oleh Perdana Menteri Rishi Sunak. Penunjukan Cameron terbilang tidak biasa karena jarang seseorang yang bukan anggota parlemen—terlebih lagi mantan perdana menteri—kembali ke kabinet. Agar Cameron dapat menjabat, pemerintah akan mengangkatnya ke House of Lords, majelis tinggi parlemen Inggris yang tidak dipilih. Terakhir kali Menteri Luar Negeri menjabat dari House of Lords adalah Peter Carrington pada masa pemerintahan Margaret Thatcher tahun 1980-an. Kembalinya Cameron terjadi beberapa tahun setelah ia mengundurkan diri akibat referendum keanggotaan Uni Eropa tahun 2016, yang ia adakan dengan harapan Inggris akan memilih tetap di UE. Ia mengundurkan diri setelah negara memilih keluar dari Uni Eropa. Rishi Sunak, Perdana Menteri saat ini, dikenal sebagai pendukung vokal Brexit. Kepergian Braverman sebenarnya tidak terlalu mengejutkan, karena Sunak mendapat tekanan meningkat untuk mencopotnya dari salah satu posisi paling senior di pemerintahan yang bertanggung jawab atas imigrasi dan penegakan hukum. Pekan lalu, Braverman mengkritik polisi London karena dianggap mengabaikan pelanggaran oleh pengunjuk rasa pro-Palestina dan menyebut para demonstran seruan gencatan senjata di Gaza sebagai 'hate marchers.' Demonstran sayap kanan juga bentrok dengan polisi selama unjuk rasa pro-Palestina besar-besaran di London akhir pekan lalu. Para kritikus menyatakan komentar Braverman meningkatkan ketegangan. Sebelumnya Braverman menulis artikel di The Times of London yang menuduh polisi 'memihak' pada pengunjuk rasa—lebih lunak terhadap demonstran pro-Palestina dan Black Lives Matter dibandingkan kelompok sayap kanan atau hooligan sepak bola. Artikel itu diterbitkan tanpa persetujuan kantor Perdana Menteri. Pada Senin, Braverman menyebut masa jabatannya sebagai Menteri Dalam Negeri adalah 'kehormatan terbesar dalam hidup saya,' dan mengatakan akan memberikan pernyataan lebih lanjut di lain waktu. Pada usia 43 tahun, Braverman muncul sebagai pemimpin sayap populis Partai Konservatif, mendorong pengaturan migrasi yang lebih ketat dan mengkritik nilai-nilai sosial liberal, bahkan menyebut pihak tertentu sebagai 'tofu-eating wokerati.' Bulan lalu, dia menyebut migrasi sebagai ‘badai’ yang akan membawa ‘jutaan imigran lagi’ dan menurutnya mustahil dikelola. Sebagai Menteri Dalam Negeri, Braverman mendukung rencana pemerintah yang terhambat untuk mengirim pencari suaka yang datang ke Inggris dengan perahu kecil ke Rwanda. Legalitas kebijakan ini akan diputuskan Mahkamah Agung Inggris pada hari Rabu. Pengamat menilai Braverman menggunakan posisinya yang menonjol untuk mempersiapkan diri sebagai calon pemimpin Partai Konservatif di masa depan, terutama jika partai tersebut kehilangan kekuasaan dalam pemilihan umum yang diperkirakan tahun depan. Survei saat ini menunjukkan Partai Konservatif tertinggal 15 hingga 20 poin dari Partai Buruh sebagai oposisi.

article_content: Ridley Scott’s 'Gladiator' is recognized as a milestone in modern cinema, representing one of the finest examples of the historical epic genre. The film centers on Maximus, a Roman general played by Russell Crowe, whose life is shattered by the betrayal of Commodus, the jealous son of Emperor Marcus Aurelius. After his family is killed, Maximus is sold into slavery and forced to become a gladiator, fighting for survival and revenge. Premiering to critical and popular acclaim, 'Gladiator' claimed the Best Picture Oscar in 2001, with Russell Crowe honored as Best Actor. The movie revived the sword-and-sandal epic, sparking renewed interest in stories set in ancient Rome and Greece, and left a lasting mark on future historical films. The narrative intentionally diverges from historical reality—specifically in its portrayal of Commodus and key events—yet these creative decisions enhance its dramatic appeal. The film's lavish costumes and intricate sets transport viewers to ancient Rome, earning accolades for authenticity and craftsmanship. Joaquin Phoenix’s nuanced portrayal of Commodus stands out, adding depth and tension as Maximus’s nemesis. His performance, which earned an Oscar nomination, showcases the complexity and vulnerability behind the villain, providing a compelling dynamic with Crowe’s Maximus. 'Gladiator' goes beyond spectacle, using the famous line, 'Are you not entertained?' to reflect on violence as entertainment. Through action-packed sequences and deep themes of vengeance, honor, and masculinity, the film presents both excitement and substance. Initially divisive due to its somber atmosphere and emotive conclusion, 'Gladiator' is now celebrated for combining thrilling action with meaningful storytelling. Its return to Netflix this October, alongside anticipation for a sequel starring Paul Mescal, reaffirms its status as an enduring cinematic gem.

Film ini menghidupkan kembali genre epik “pedang dan sandal”, membangkitkan minat baru pada kisah-kisah Romawi dan Yunani kuno, serta memberi pengaruh besar pada film sejarah berikutnya. Penampilannya, yang mendapat nominasi Oscar, menampilkan sisi kompleks dan rentan sang tokoh antagonis, sehingga menciptakan dinamika menarik bersama Maximus. ‘Gladiator’ bukan hanya soal hiburan semata, tetapi juga merefleksikan kekerasan sebagai tontonan melalui kutipan terkenalnya, ‘Are you not entertained?’ Lewat aksi penuh ketegangan dan eksplorasi tema balas dendam, kehormatan, dan maskulinitas, film ini menawarkan sensasi sekaligus makna mendalam. Kehadirannya kembali di Netflix Oktober ini, serta adanya sekuel mendatang yang dibintangi Paul Mescal, menegaskan statusnya sebagai karya klasik yang abadi.

article_content: European leaders and human rights groups have expressed concern over the alleged severe assault of Iranian teenager Armita Garawand, reportedly by the country's morality police, leaving her in a coma. The Norway-based NGO Hengaw stated that 16-year-old Garawand was physically attacked by female officers of the gast-e ersad (guidance patrol) on 1 October, while traveling on Tehran’s metro without her veil. Iranian authorities have denied this allegation, with the state IRNA news agency reporting that Garawand fainted due to not eating breakfast. She is currently in intensive care at Fajr Hospital in Tehran, under heavy security. German Foreign Minister Annalena Baerbock wrote on X (formerly Twitter), 'Once again a young woman in Iran is fighting for her life. Just because she showed her hair in the subway. It is unbearable.' The incident has quickly spread on social media, with video circulating that allegedly shows police officers pushing the girl, who was not wearing a headscarf. Her body is then seen being dragged away; the authenticity of the footage has not been independently confirmed. Opposition outlet Iran International reported that Garawand suffered a head injury and collapsed after allegedly being pushed into a metal bar. Despite every carriage on Tehran's metro being equipped with CCTV cameras, Iranian authorities have not released footage of the event. Iran Human Rights, another Norway-based NGO, has called for an independent international investigation, citing Tehran’s history of distorting facts and hiding evidence. Mahmood Amiry-Moghaddam, director of Iran Human Rights, said, 'The Islamic Republic continues to harass and repress women under the pretext of fighting violations of the compulsory hijab.' Garawand, originally from Kermanshah in western Iran, is being treated at Fajr Hospital and is depicted in a photo posted by Hengaw, showing her connected to medical equipment with bandages on her head and neck. Maryam Lotfi, a journalist with the reformist Shargh daily, was reportedly detained briefly while attempting to interview Garawand’s mother. Iran International claims that intelligence services have pressured friends and family to deny the morality police’s involvement and confiscated their phones to prevent the spread of information. Iran's authorities are on high alert. This incident comes just over a year after the death of Mahsa Amini following her arrest for allegedly violating the strict dress code. Her death led to widespread protests against the Iranian regime. According to Iran Human Rights, more than 550 people were killed and almost 20,000 detained as security forces cracked down on the protests. In Iran, women are legally required to cover their hair with a headscarf, but these rules are unpopular among much of the population, and defiance has increased since last year’s unrest. A new bill is expected to become law, imposing stricter punishments on women who do not wear the hijab. Hadi Ghaemi, executive director of the Center for Human Rights in Iran (CHRI), said, 'A year after the killing of Mahsa Jina Amini in state custody, and following hundreds of deaths during protests, another young woman is in critical condition and another Iranian family faces heartbreak.' He continued, 'The Iranian government’s history of violence against women and its culture of impunity cannot be denied. The international community must unite to impose meaningful sanctions on a government that routinely kills its citizens to silence them.'
translated_content: Para pemimpin Eropa dan kelompok hak asasi manusia menyatakan keprihatinan atas dugaan penyerangan berat kepada remaja Iran, Armita Garawand, yang diduga dilakukan polisi moral dan membuatnya koma. LSM berbasis di Norwegia, Hengaw, menyebutkan Garawand yang berusia 16 tahun diserang secara fisik oleh petugas perempuan dari gast-e ersad (patroli bimbingan) pada 1 Oktober saat menaiki metro Tehran tanpa mengenakan jilbab. Pihak berwenang Iran membantah tuduhan ini, dengan kantor berita IRNA mengabarkan bahwa Garawand pingsan karena tidak sarapan. Saat ini ia dirawat intensif di Rumah Sakit Fajr, Tehran, di bawah pengamanan ketat. Menteri Luar Negeri Jerman Annalena Baerbock menulis di X (dulu Twitter), 'Sekali lagi, seorang perempuan muda di Iran berjuang untuk hidupnya. Hanya karena ia memperlihatkan rambutnya di kereta bawah tanah. Ini tidak tertahankan.' Insiden ini cepat menyebar di media sosial, dengan video yang beredar diduga menunjukkan petugas polisi mendorong gadis tersebut yang tidak mengenakan jilbab. Tubuhnya kemudian tampak diseret; keaslian rekamannya belum dikonfirmasi secara independen. Media oposisi Iran International melaporkan bahwa Garawand mengalami cedera kepala dan pingsan setelah diduga didorong ke batang logam. Meski setiap gerbong metro Tehran memiliki kamera CCTV, otoritas Iran belum merilis rekaman kejadian. Iran Human Rights, LSM lain berbasis di Norwegia, meminta investigasi internasional independen karena khawatir Teheran punya sejarah memanipulasi fakta dan menyembunyikan bukti. Mahmood Amiry-Moghaddam, direktur Iran Human Rights, berkata, 'Republik Islam terus melecehkan dan menindas perempuan dengan dalih memberantas pelanggaran hijab wajib.' Garawand, asal Kermanshah di Iran barat, sedang dirawat di RS Fajr dan foto diunggah Hengaw menunjukkan dia terhubung alat medis dengan perban di kepala dan leher. Maryam Lotfi, jurnalis dari harian reformis Shargh, dilaporkan sempat ditahan saat mencoba mewawancarai ibu Garawand. Iran International menyebut dinas intelijen menekan teman dan keluarga untuk menyangkal keterlibatan polisi moral dan menyita ponsel agar informasi tak menyebar. Otoritas Iran kini siaga tinggi. Kejadian ini terjadi sekitar setahun setelah kematian Mahsa Amini usai ditahan karena diduga langgar aturan berpakaian; kematiannya memicu protes luas terhadap rezim Iran. Iran Human Rights mencatat lebih dari 550 orang tewas dan hampir 20.000 ditahan saat aparat menindak aksi protes. Di Iran, perempuan diwajibkan menutup rambut dengan jilbab, tetapi aturan ini tidak disukai banyak masyarakat dan perlawanan makin sering sejak kerusuhan tahun lalu. article_content: Super Bowl commercials have taken on a new role in American society, now sparking controversy and debate on major issues—a position once dominated by politicians. One of this year’s most discussed advertisements was a Chrysler commercial featuring music legend Bob Dylan. Rather than focusing on multiculturalism, as seen in a widely debated Coca-Cola ad, Chrysler’s spot leaned heavily into ideas of protectionism and national pride to sell cars made in Detroit. The commercial invoked themes of American identity, urging viewers to support domestic manufacturing. Narration states, 'Detroit made cars, and cars made America,' dismissing foreign imports with the claim that, 'you can't import the heart and soul of every man and woman working on the line.' However, the ad refers to the Chrysler 200 as 'America's import,' a somewhat contradictory label, given the vehicle is manufactured in the United States. The ad’s message celebrates American pride as a unique asset, but also raises questions about whether this pride could create challenges in a competitive global market. The commercial features Dylan saying, 'Let Germany brew your beer. Let Switzerland make your watch. Let Asia assemble your phone. We will build your car.' The spot echoes union rhetoric favoring domestic production. Despite the strong message in favor of buying American, Chrysler’s own actions complicate the narrative. The company was recently sold to the Italian automaker Fiat, with U.S. labor union United Auto Workers owning a large stake, later sold in the deal. While advocating for American labor in ads, Chrysler's management was open to international buyers—emphasizing the importance of competing globally. The choice of Bob Dylan for the commercial is not out of character, as he has expressed concern about globalization’s impact on U.S. workers. Critics who accuse Dylan of 'selling out' may overlook his longstanding stance on these issues. The views in this commentary reflect the author Ruben Navarrette’s perspective.

Iklan itu mengangkat tema identitas Amerika, mendorong penonton untuk mendukung produksi lokal. Narator berkata, 'Detroit membuat mobil, dan mobil membangun Amerika,' sambil meremehkan produk impor dengan pernyataan, 'kamu tidak bisa mengimpor hati dan jiwa tiap pekerja di jalur perakitan.' Namun, iklan tersebut menyebut Chrysler 200 sebagai 'impor Amerika,' label yang agak bertentangan, mengingat mobil itu diproduksi di Amerika Serikat. Pesan iklan tersebut menyanjung kebanggaan Amerika sebagai keunggulan unik, namun menimbulkan pertanyaan apakah kebanggaan ini justru bisa menjadi masalah di pasar global yang kompetitif. article_content: SAN JUAN, Puerto Rico – Tropical Storm Philippe brought heavy rain and strong winds to Bermuda before weakening and being downgraded to a post-tropical cyclone on Friday. The system was about 110 miles (180 kilometers) south of Bermuda that day, packing winds up to 50 mph (85 kph) and traveling north-northeast at 16 mph (26 kph). The storm was expected to pass near the island later Friday and then move toward the coast of Nova Scotia or eastern New England from Saturday night into Sunday, according to the National Hurricane Center (NHC) in Miami, which released its final advisory for Philippe. Officials in Bermuda closed schools in anticipation of the storm. Forecasts predicted up to 5 inches (13 centimeters) of rain for parts of New York, New England, and southeastern Canada. Residents in these areas were advised to prepare for the possibility of strong winds and heavy rain. Earlier, Philippe made landfall in Barbuda late Monday, soaking the northeast Caribbean and causing trees and power lines to fall on several islands. As of Friday, some schools in the U.S. Virgin Islands remained closed due to ongoing power outages. Meanwhile, in the Pacific, Tropical Storm Lidia was swirling across open water. The storm was located about 445 miles (710 kilometers) south of the southern tip of Baja California and had winds up to 70 mph (110 kph), moving west-northwest at 5 mph (7 kph). Lidia was expected to strengthen into a hurricane later on Friday.

Sistem ini berada sekitar 110 mil (180 kilometer) di selatan Bermuda pada hari itu, dengan kecepatan angin hingga 50 mph (85 kph) dan bergerak ke arah utara-timur laut dengan kecepatan 16 mph (26 kph). Pejabat di Bermuda menutup sekolah-sekolah sebagai antisipasi terhadap badai. Prakiraan memperkirakan hujan hingga 5 inci (13 sentimeter) di sebagian wilayah New York, New England, dan Kanada tenggara. Warga di area ini dihimbau untuk bersiap menghadapi kemungkinan angin kencang dan hujan lebat. Sebelumnya, Philippe mendarat di Barbuda pada Senin malam, membasahi Karibia timur laut dan menyebabkan pohon serta kabel listrik tumbang di beberapa pulau. Hingga Jumat, beberapa sekolah di Kepulauan Virgin Amerika Serikat tetap tutup akibat pemadaman listrik yang masih berlangsung. Sementara itu, di Pasifik, Badai Tropis Lidia berputar di perairan terbuka. Lidia diperkirakan akan menguat menjadi badai pada hari Jumat.

article_content: SeaWorld has been fined $75,000 by the Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) for three safety violations, including one classified as willful, following the death of an animal trainer in February. Cindy Coe, OSHA's regional administrator, stated that SeaWorld was aware of the risks of allowing trainers to interact with potentially dangerous animals. Despite this, SeaWorld required trainers to work in close proximity to these animals, placing them at risk. SeaWorld rejected what it called 'unfounded' allegations by OSHA and announced its intention to contest the citations. The company argued that OSHA's claims lack supporting evidence or precedent and reflect a misunderstanding of marine mammal care. In February, a 12,000-pound killer whale at SeaWorld Orlando pulled trainer Dawn Brancheau, 40, underwater and killed her while park visitors watched. An autopsy revealed she died from drowning and multiple traumatic injuries. According to OSHA, the whale involved was also linked to the death of a trainer at a Vancouver, British Columbia, water park in 1991. The agency's investigation found that SeaWorld trainers had a history of unexpected and dangerous incidents with killer whales at various locations, including Orlando. Despite this, management failed to implement substantial changes to improve employee safety. OSHA issued a 'willful' citation for exposing employees to hazards when interacting with killer whales. Another 'serious' citation was issued for failing to install a stairway railing on one side of a stadium stage, a violation that could lead to serious injury or death. A third, less serious citation involved failing to protect outdoor electrical receptacles from the weather. SeaWorld responded that its internal review reached a different conclusion, but provided no specifics, stating its findings were based on decades of experience with marine mammals. SeaWorld emphasized that its killer whale program was already a model within the industry and that ongoing changes in safety procedures, facility design, and communication would further improve safety. It also noted that its killer whales are displayed under valid federal permits and oversight from the U.S. Department of Agriculture Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service and the U.S. Department of Commerce National Marine Fisheries Service. The company stated that its trainers are among the most skilled and dedicated in the field and cited the low number of incidents out of more than 2 million interactions as evidence of its commitment to safety and training.
translated_content: SeaWorld telah didenda sebesar $75.000 oleh Administrasi Keselamatan dan Kesehatan Kerja (OSHA) atas tiga pelanggaran keselamatan, termasuk satu yang dikategorikan sebagai pelanggaran disengaja, setelah seorang pelatih hewan meninggal dunia pada bulan Februari. Cindy Coe, administrator regional OSHA, menyatakan bahwa SeaWorld mengetahui risiko membiarkan pelatih berinteraksi dengan hewan yang berpotensi berbahaya. Namun, SeaWorld tetap mengharuskan pelatih bekerja dekat dengan hewan-hewan tersebut, sehingga meningkatkan resiko. SeaWorld menolak tuduhan yang mereka sebut 'tidak berdasar' dari OSHA dan menyatakan akan menggugat sanksi yang dijatuhkan. Perusahaan berpendapat bahwa klaim OSHA tidak memiliki bukti atau preseden yang mendukung dan mencerminkan miskonsepsi tentang perawatan mamalia laut. Pada bulan Februari, seekor paus pembunuh seberat 12.000 pon di SeaWorld Orlando menyeret pelatih Dawn Brancheau, 40, ke dalam air dan menyebabkan kematiannya di depan para pengunjung taman. Hasil autopsi menunjukkan ia meninggal karena tenggelam dan berbagai cedera traumatis. Menurut OSHA, paus tersebut juga terlibat dalam kematian pelatih di sebuah taman air Vancouver, British Columbia, pada tahun 1991. Penyelidikan dari lembaga tersebut menemukan bahwa pelatih SeaWorld memiliki riwayat kejadian tak terduga dan berbahaya saat menangani paus pembunuh di berbagai lokasi, termasuk Orlando. Namun, pihak manajemen gagal melakukan perubahan besar untuk meningkatkan keselamatan karyawan. OSHA mengeluarkan sanksi 'disengaja' karena membiarkan karyawan terpapar bahaya saat berinteraksi dengan paus pembunuh. Sanksi 'serius' lainnya dikeluarkan karena tidak memasang pagar di salah satu sisi tangga panggung stadion, suatu pelanggaran yang dapat menyebabkan cedera berat atau bahkan kematian. Sanksi ketiga, yang dianggap kurang serius, terkait kegagalan melindungi stop kontak listrik luar ruangan dari cuaca. SeaWorld menyatakan bahwa tinjauan internal mereka menghasilkan kesimpulan berbeda, namun tanpa memberikan rincian, mereka mengatakan temuan itu didasarkan pada pengalaman panjang dengan mamalia laut. SeaWorld menekankan bahwa program paus pembunuh mereka telah menjadi model di industri serta perubahan pada prosedur keselamatan, desain fasilitas, dan komunikasi akan semakin meningkatkan keselamatan. SeaWorld juga menyebut bahwa paus pem­bunuhnya ditampilkan dengan izin federal yang sah dan berada di bawah pengawasan U.S. Department of Agriculture Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service serta U.S. Department of Commerce National Marine Fisheries Service. Perusahaan juga menyatakan para pelatih mereka merupakan profesional yang sangat terampil dan berdedikasi dan rendahnya jumlah insiden dari lebih dari 2 juta interaksi menjadi bukti komitmen mereka terhadap keselamatan dan pelatihan.

article_content: Phoenix’s burgeoning dining scene continues to draw attention, fueled by exciting new arrivals like PYRO, a Japanese American bistro that just debuted this week. PYRO is the latest endeavor from Flagship Restaurant Group, whose leadership team—Nick Hogan, Anthony Hitchcock, Tom Allisma, and Tony Gentile—brings experience from acclaimed restaurants such as Blue Sushi Sake Grill, Ghost Donkey, Plank Seafood Provisions, and Palma. The restaurant partnered with AvroKO to design an upscale space inspired by a 1930s Japanese casino. The décor blends 1950s-style fixtures, geisha motifs, lush velvets, and a classic cocktail bar. At the heart of PYRO’s concept is its custom-made open-flame hearth, where wood and charcoal fire prepare smoked, grilled, roasted, and seared dishes—from a 40-day dry-aged ribeye to inventive seafood and noodle offerings. Signature menu items include the 40-Day Dry Aged Bone-In Ribeye served with house-made pickles and PYRO jus, 'World’s Best Branzino' featuring pickled ginger shoots, Tokyo turnip, herb salad and lemon-chili vinaigrette, as well as Dungeness Crab Noodles with Meyer lemon, crème fraîche, chive and smoked trout roe. The bar highlights creative cocktails like the Calamansi Margarita, crafted with Lalo Tequila, Thai chili, calamansi sherbet, aloe liqueur, and lime, and Louis’ Martini, mixing Haku Vodka, Oka Japanese Bermutto, pomegranate, pineapple, and yuzu. An extensive selection of Japanese whisky, sake, and international wines is also available. Sustainability is central to PYRO’s mission. Nick Hogan, CEO and co-owner of Flagship Restaurant Group, emphasized the company’s dedication to sustainable sourcing through initiatives like the Monterey Bay Aquarium Seafood Watch, as well as partnerships with animal welfare organizations and ethical farms across the country. Ultimately, PYRO delivers a stylish fusion of American bistro and Japanese izakaya, serving refined cocktails alongside prime steaks grilled over open flames in a setting reminiscent of classic geisha-era elegance. This new addition looks set to further elevate Phoenix’s dynamic dining landscape.

article_content: Domino's Pizza has introduced a creative take on fast food with its new Specialty Chicken menu item. Instead of pizza dough, breaded, boneless chicken serves as the base, topped with classic pizza ingredients like cheese, sauces, vegetables, and meats. There are four flavors to choose from: crispy bacon & tomato, classic hot buffalo, spicy jalapeno-pineapple, and sweet barbecue bacon. Specialty Chicken debuts on April 21 as part of Domino's $5.99 mix and match deal. MailOnline journalists who sampled the dish early were mostly enthusiastic, especially about the sweet-and-spicy jalapeno-pineapple flavor. Some editors suggested offering a grilled option or reducing breading for those with dietary restrictions. Chief Marketing Officer Russell Weiner called the item one of Domino's most creative innovations, focusing on bold flavors. Restaurant analyst Bob Golden noted that while chicken is often seen as a healthier alternative, new product launches in pizza chains can be risky. Domino's acknowledges this risk in their marketing. Meanwhile, KFC is bringing back its Double Down sandwich—bacon and cheese between two fried chicken filets—on the same day, April 21, for a limited time.

article_content: Researchers at the Konrad Lorenz Research Center in Vienna, Austria, have developed a new facial recognition tool capable of identifying individual geese by analyzing their beak features. This advancement addresses a longstanding challenge in distinguishing members of a flock—a skill famously demonstrated by biologist Konrad Lorenz, who once named nearly every goose based on their faces, making only a single error. Sonia Kleindorfer, the current director, encountered difficulties telling the geese apart and turned to a colleague to create an AI-powered solution. Using a database of goose photographs taken from various angles, the team developed an AI system that can recognize individual geese with approximately 97% accuracy, as reported in the Journal of Ornithology. The motivation goes beyond convenience. Geese lead complex social lives with rivalries, jealousy, and retribution, all of which depend on being able to recognize one another. Kleindorfer’s experiments showed that while geese can identify photos of their partners and friends, they do not recognize themselves—a finding consistent with their limited exposure to their own reflections. This facial recognition ability may underlie higher-level social organization in geese, paralleling similar capabilities in humans. Comparable AI recognition tools have recently been developed for other animals, including harbor seals. Krista Ingram, a biologist at Colgate University in New York, developed SealNet to non-invasively identify seals using photos, replacing more stressful methods like tagging or darting. Both Kleindorfer and Ingram assert that AI-driven identification tools are set to revolutionize conservation and ecology, enabling researchers to monitor populations and study social behaviors with greater accuracy and less disturbance to the animals. However, they emphasize the need for more collaboration between computer scientists and conservation biologists to advance the field. Citizen scientists may soon play a role by photographing geese and sharing identification data. Kleindorfer additionally reminds us that geese are adept at recognizing human faces—so, if you mistreat a goose, beware: it may remember you in the future.
translated_content: Para peneliti di Konrad Lorenz Research Center di Wina, Austria, telah mengembangkan alat pengenalan wajah baru yang mampu mengidentifikasi masing-masing angsa dengan menganalisis bentuk paruh mereka. Inovasi ini menjawab tantangan lama dalam membedakan anggota kawanan angsa—sebuah keterampilan yang dulu terkenal karena dikuasai ahli biologi Konrad Lorenz, yang pernah menyebut hampir semua angsa berdasarkan wajahnya, hanya melakukan satu kesalahan. Sonia Kleindorfer, direktur saat ini, mengalami kesulitan membedakan angsa satu per satu dan meminta bantuan rekannya untuk menciptakan solusi berbasis AI. Dengan menggunakan database foto-foto angsa dari berbagai sudut, timnya mengembangkan sistem AI yang mampu mengenali individu angsa dengan akurasi sekitar 97%, sebagaimana dilaporkan dalam Journal of Ornithology. Tujuan pengembangan ini bukan sekadar untuk kemudahan. Angsa memiliki kehidupan sosial yang rumit—ada persaingan, rasa cemburu, dan balas dendam—semua tergantung pada kemampuan mereka saling mengenali. Eksperimen Kleindorfer menunjukkan bahwa angsa dapat mengenali foto pasangan dan temannya, namun tidak mengenali diri sendiri—temuan ini konsisten dengan terbatasnya akses mereka terhadap refleksi diri. Kemampuan pengenalan wajah ini mungkin menjadi kunci organisasi sosial tingkat lanjut pada angsa, mirip dengan manusia. Alat pengenalan AI serupa baru-baru ini juga dikembangkan untuk hewan lain, seperti anjing laut pelabuhan. Krista Ingram, ahli biologi dari Colgate University di New York, mengembangkan SealNet untuk mengidentifikasi anjing laut secara non-invasif melalui foto, menggantikan metode penandaan atau penembakan pelacak yang lebih membuat stres. Kleindorfer dan Ingram sama-sama berpendapat bahwa alat identifikasi berbasis AI akan merevolusi konservasi dan ekologi, memungkinkan peneliti memantau populasi dan mempelajari perilaku sosial dengan lebih akurat tanpa mengganggu hewan. Namun, mereka menekankan perlunya kolaborasi lebih erat antara ilmuwan komputer dan konservasionis untuk memajukan bidang ini. Di masa depan, ilmuwan warga juga bisa berperan dengan memotret angsa dan membagikan data identifikasi. Kleindorfer menambahkan, angsa juga mahir mengenali wajah manusia—jadi, jika Anda berlaku tidak baik pada angsa, hati-hati: angsa itu mungkin akan mengingat Anda di lain waktu.

article_content: Researchers have detected the second and fourth most distant galaxies ever recorded, found in a region called Pandora’s Cluster (Abell 2744), thanks to data from NASA’s James Webb Space Telescope (JWST). Penn State-led scientists, working with an international team, confirmed the great distances and fascinating characteristics of these ancient galaxies using detailed spectroscopic information from JWST. This discovery sheds light on how the earliest galaxies might have formed. At nearly 33 billion light-years from Earth—because of the universe’s expansion—these galaxies provide insights into early cosmic history. Unlike other distant galaxies, which mostly appear as small red dots in telescope images, these two have unique shapes: one looks like a peanut, the other like a fluffy sphere. Dr. Bingjie Wang from Penn State, working with the UNCOVER project, highlighted that only three such distant galaxies had been previously confirmed. Observing these new galaxies reveals even greater diversity in how early galaxies appeared and evolved. The light from these galaxies took about 13.4 billion years to reach JWST, allowing astronomers to observe a time when the universe was just 330 million years old. Because the universe keeps expanding, the galaxies are now much farther away than when the light we see left them. Dr. Joel Leja, another Penn State researcher, described these galaxies as lighthouses from the universe’s dawn. Their brightness pierces through early hydrogen gas, helping scientists better understand the physics of galaxy formation just after the Big Bang. One of the galaxies is especially large at this distance, measuring roughly 2,000 light-years across—at least six times wider than other galaxies identified at such extreme distances. This surprises researchers, as the early universe was thought to be tightly packed yet still produced sizable galaxies. Dr. Wang explained that, in the past, galaxies at such range appeared only as point sources or dots, but now two unique shapes have been found, adding to evidence of diversity in how early galaxies formed. These two galaxies were selected from over 60,000 sources of light observed in JWST’s initial deep field image of Pandora’s Cluster. The researchers relied on gravitational lensing—a phenomenon where galaxy clusters magnify background objects—to spot these very faint and distant galaxies. From many candidates, the team used precise spectrum analysis to confirm the identities of the two ancient galaxies. While not all candidates turned out to be as far away as hoped, finding these two demonstrates both the difficulty and excitement of early universe research. Analysis of their spectra shows that these galaxies were young, metal-poor, and forming stars rapidly, confirming theoretical predictions about the earliest eras after the Big Bang. Experts note that with JWST’s powerful infrared capabilities and the benefits of gravitational lensing, other even more distant galaxies might be found—or, possibly, that no galaxies existed earlier than this period. This achievement resulted from a successful research proposal to NASA for JWST's first year of operation. The project involved collaboration among leading universities worldwide, including Penn State, University of Texas Austin, Yale, and many more.
translated_content: Para peneliti baru saja menemukan galaksi kedua dan keempat yang paling jauh yang pernah tercatat, terletak di wilayah bernama Gugusan Pandora (Abell 2744), berkat data dari Teleskop Luar Angkasa James Webb (JWST) milik NASA. Tim internasional yang dipimpin oleh ilmuwan dari Penn State berhasil memastikan jarak dan karakteristik unik galaksi kuno ini menggunakan data spektroskopis dari JWST secara rinci. Penemuan ini membuka wawasan baru tentang bagaimana galaksi-galaksi pertama di alam semesta terbentuk. Dengan jarak hampir 33 miliar tahun cahaya dari Bumi akibat perluasan alam semesta, galaksi-galaksi ini menjadi jendela untuk memahami sejarah awal kosmos. Tidak seperti galaksi jauh lainnya yang biasanya tampak sebagai titik merah kecil di gambar teleskop, dua galaksi ini justru memiliki bentuk unik: satu menyerupai kacang dan satu lagi seperti bola kapas. Dr. Bingjie Wang dari Penn State dalam proyek UNCOVER menyoroti bahwa sebelumnya hanya ada tiga galaksi pada jarak sejauh ini yang telah dikonfirmasi. Penemuan galaksi baru ini membuktikan keberagaman galaksi di masa awal alam semesta lebih kompleks dari yang diperkirakan. Cahaya dari galaksi-galaksi ini telah menempuh sekitar 13,4 miliar tahun sebelum sampai ke JWST, sehingga para astronom dapat mengamati masa ketika alam semesta baru berumur sekitar 330 juta tahun. Karena alam semesta terus mengembang, galaksi-galaksi tersebut sekarang berada jauh lebih jauh daripada saat cahaya mereka mulai melakukan perjalanan. Dr. Joel Leja dari Penn State menggambarkan galaksi-galaksi ini sebagai mercusuar dari fajar kosmis. Keterangannya mampu menembus kabut hidrogen tipis, membantu ilmuwan memahami fisika pembentukan galaksi setelah Big Bang. Salah satu galaksi ini sangat besar untuk jarak sejauh itu, lebarnya sekitar 2.000 tahun cahaya—setidaknya enam kali lebih lebar dibanding penemuan galaksi lain di jarak serupa. Hal ini mengejutkan peneliti karena alam semesta awal dianggap sangat padat, namun galaksi raksasa sudah bisa terbentuk. Dr. Wang menjelaskan bahwa selama ini galaksi di jarak seperti ini hanya tampak sebagai titik, tapi kali ini ditemukan dua galaksi dengan bentuk unik, menambah bukti adanya keberagaman cara galaksi awal terbentuk. Kedua galaksi ini dipilih dari lebih 60.000 sumber cahaya dalam citra deep field JWST pertama pada Gugusan Pandora. Para peneliti menggunakan fenomena pelensaan gravitasi—di mana gugusan galaksi memfokuskan dan memperbesar objek di belakangnya—untuk menemukan galaksi-galaksi yang sangat samar dan jauh ini. Dari ribuan kandidat, tim menggunakan analisis spektrum yang sangat teliti untuk memastikan dua galaksi kuno ini. Tidak semua kandidat sedalam yang diharapkan, tapi keberhasilan menemukan dua galaksi ini menunjukkan tantangan dan kegembiraan penelitian semesta awal. Analisis spektrum membuktikan bahwa galaksi-galaksi tersebut masih muda, miskin logam, dan aktif membentuk bintang—mengonfirmasi prediksi teori tentang era awal setelah Big Bang. Para ahli mengatakan dengan kemampuan inframerah JWST yang kuat serta bantuan pelensaan gravitasi, mungkin saja ditemukan galaksi yang lebih jauh lagi—atau mungkin sebaliknya, memang tidak ada galaksi di zaman sebelumnya. Pencapaian ini merupakan hasil proposal penelitian yang berhasil ke NASA untuk tahun pertama operasi JWST. Proyek ini melibatkan kerjasama berbagai universitas terkemuka dunia, seperti Penn State, University of Texas Austin, Yale, dan banyak lagi.

article_content: The National Union of Students (NUS) faced backlash after it rejected a motion to officially denounce ISIS over fears that the statement could be interpreted as Islamophobic. During a meeting of the NUS National Executive Council, the proposal called for support for Iraqi and Kurdish people, including students and minorities affected by ISIS violence. It also suggested collaboration with international student groups, support for refugees, and highlighted skepticism toward US military intervention. Malia Bouattia, NUS Black Students Officer, led opposition against the motion, arguing that condemning ISIS in sweeping terms risked promoting anti-Muslim sentiment and was used as justification for war. She stressed that combating terrorism should not mean marginalizing Muslims unfairly and expressed solidarity with Black and Kurdish communities, while also condemning ISIS' actions. Bouattia stated she would work on a revised motion that would avoid Islamophobia. Some students criticized the NUS decision, arguing that not condemning ISIS hindered the fight against both terrorism and Islamophobia, and failed to support the majority of peaceful Muslim communities who themselves reject ISIS. Muslim leaders in the UK, representing both Sunni and Shia communities, have repeatedly condemned ISIS, asserting the group does not represent Islamic teachings. Globally, efforts to confront ISIS continue, with leaders from multiple countries meeting to coordinate responses. The NUS clarified that while there were concerns the motion's language could stigmatize Muslims, the union itself does not support ISIS. They committed to bringing forward a new motion that explicitly condemns ISIS' actions without targeting the wider Muslim community, and reaffirmed their support for those affected by extremist violence.
translated_content: Serikat Mahasiswa Nasional Inggris (NUS) mendapat kecaman setelah menolak mosi untuk mengecam ISIS secara resmi karena kekhawatiran pernyataan itu dapat dianggap sebagai Islamofobia. Pada rapat Dewan Eksekutif Nasional NUS, usulan tersebut menyerukan dukungan untuk rakyat Irak dan Kurdi, termasuk mahasiswa dan kelompok minoritas yang terkena dampak kekerasan ISIS. Mosi itu juga mengusulkan kerja sama dengan kelompok mahasiswa internasional, memberikan dukungan kepada para pengungsi, serta mengungkapkan sikap skeptis terhadap intervensi militer AS. Malia Bouattia, Pejabat Mahasiswa Kulit Hitam NUS, memimpin penolakan atas mosi tersebut dengan alasan bahwa mengecam ISIS secara umum berisiko memicu sentimen anti-Muslim dan dapat menjadi pembenaran untuk perang. Ia menegaskan bahwa upaya melawan terorisme tidak boleh mengorbankan keadilan bagi komunitas Muslim dan menyatakan solidaritas dengan komunitas Kulit Hitam dan Kurdi, sambil tetap mengecam aksi ISIS. Bouattia menyatakan akan membantu merancang mosi baru yang tidak memunculkan unsur Islamofobia. Sejumlah mahasiswa mengkritik keputusan NUS itu, dengan alasan bahwa kegagalan mengecam ISIS dapat menghambat upaya melawan terorisme dan Islamofobia, serta tidak cukup mendukung mayoritas komunitas Muslim yang damai dan juga menentang ISIS. Para pemimpin Muslim di Inggris, baik dari kalangan Sunni maupun Syiah, telah berulang kali mengecam ISIS dan menegaskan bahwa kelompok tersebut tidak mewakili ajaran Islam. Di dunia internasional, upaya untuk melawan ISIS terus berlangsung dengan para pemimpin dari berbagai negara yang bertemu untuk menyusun strategi bersama. NUS menegaskan bahwa meski ada kekhawatiran tentang bahasa dalam mosi yang bisa menstigmatisasi Muslim, organisasi itu sendiri tidak mendukung ISIS. NUS berkomitmen untuk mengajukan mosi baru yang secara jelas mengecam tindakan ISIS tanpa menggeneralisasi komunitas Muslim, serta kembali menegaskan dukungan terhadap pihak-pihak yang terkena dampak kekerasan ekstremis.

article_content: Dabur, a leading FMCG and ayurvedic products company, is planning to set up a new factory in South India within the next year as its business in the region grows, according to CEO Mohit Malhotra. Currently, 19-20% of Dabur’s domestic sales come from South India, a figure that has doubled over the last 7-8 years. Dabur is working to launch products tailored for South Indian markets, identifying needs and consumer preferences. The company operates 13 manufacturing units in India and is further expanding its capacity and diversifying production lines to meet increasing demand. With an annual capital expenditure of approximately Rs 350-450 crore, Dabur also intends to enhance manufacturing for international markets, targeting regions like the Middle East and Europe. Malhotra mentioned that Dabur is streamlining manufacturing operations by consolidating units, closing those where tax incentives are ending, and opening new ones in regions benefiting from the GST framework. Regarding South India, Malhotra noted, 'We have made substantial progress. South India now contributes 19-20% to Dabur’s domestic business, up from less than 10% seven or eight years ago.' Asked about the new South Indian plant, he said, 'It might be within a year as our business scales up.' Dabur’s previous major investment was a Rs 350 crore unit in Indore. In South India, Dabur is analyzing market gaps to introduce customized products, following the RISE framework (regional insights, speed, and execution). Brands like Dabur Red account for 40% of Dabur’s business in the South, while Dabur Honey and Odonil also have significant presence. Although Dabur’s contribution from South India is about 20%, compared to 30% for some competitors, there is an identified gap and an area for further growth. Internationally, Malhotra said the MENA region is a key growth area. Dabur has manufacturing units in the UAE, Egypt, Turkiye, and South Africa, and uses trade agreements to expand its reach across the Middle East, Africa, and Europe. In North America, Dabur operates through contract manufacturing. Malhotra noted that business in international markets is recovering after the pandemic, although geopolitical challenges remain, such as tensions in the Middle East and the Russia-Ukraine conflict. Apple is on track to reach a production milestone of nearly ₹1 lakh crore of iPhones in India by March 2024, having already exceeded ₹60,000 crore in the first seven months of the fiscal year. Other notable news includes government discussions on transferring unclaimed Sahara-Sebi Refund Account funds and Nawaz Modi seeking a large portion of Gautam Singhania’s net worth during their settlement negotiations.
translated_content: Dabur, perusahaan terkemuka di bidang FMCG dan produk ayurveda, berencana membangun pabrik baru di India Selatan dalam waktu satu tahun seiring pertumbuhan bisnisnya di wilayah tersebut, kata CEO Mohit Malhotra. Saat ini, 19-20% penjualan domestik Dabur berasal dari India Selatan, angka yang telah meningkat dua kali lipat dalam 7-8 tahun terakhir. Dabur sedang mengembangkan produk yang disesuaikan untuk pasar India Selatan, dengan mengidentifikasi kebutuhan dan preferensi konsumen. Perusahaan ini mengoperasikan 13 unit manufaktur di India dan terus memperluas kapasitas serta mendiversifikasi lini produksi untuk memenuhi permintaan yang meningkat. Dengan belanja modal tahunan sekitar Rp 350-450 crore, Dabur juga berencana meningkatkan produksi untuk pasar internasional, khususnya wilayah Timur Tengah dan Eropa. Malhotra menyebut, Dabur sedang merampingkan operasi manufaktur dengan mengonsolidasikan unit, menutup yang insentif pajaknya berakhir, dan membuka unit baru di area yang diuntungkan dari sistem GST. Terkait India Selatan, Malhotra menyatakan, 'Kami telah mengalami kemajuan besar. India Selatan sekarang berkontribusi 19-20% pada bisnis domestik Dabur, dari kurang 10% tujuh atau delapan tahun lalu.' Saat ditanya tentang pabrik baru di India Selatan, ia berkata, 'Mungkin dalam setahun, seiring skala bisnis yang terus tumbuh.' Investasi besar Dabur sebelumnya adalah unit senilai Rp 350 crore di Indore. Di India Selatan, Dabur mengidentifikasi celah pasar untuk memperkenalkan produk yang disesuaikan, mengikuti kerangka RISE (regional insights, speed, and execution). Merek seperti Dabur Red menyumbang 40% dari bisnis Dabur di Selatan, sementara Dabur Honey dan Odonil juga sangat menonjol. Kontribusi Dabur dari India Selatan sekitar 20%, sementara beberapa pesaing mencapai 30%. Maka, ada gap untuk dikejar sebagai peluang pertumbuhan. Secara internasional, Malhotra menyebut kawasan MENA adalah area pertumbuhan utama. Dabur memiliki pabrik di UEA, Mesir, Turki, dan Afrika Selatan, serta memanfaatkan perjanjian perdagangan untuk memperluas jangkauan di Timur Tengah, Afrika, dan Eropa. Di Amerika Utara, Dabur bekerja sama dengan pabrik kontrak. Menurut Malhotra, bisnis internasional mulai membaik setelah pandemi, meskipun masih ada tantangan geopolitik seperti konflik di Timur Tengah dan perang Rusia-Ukraina. Apple menargetkan produksi hampir ₹1 lakh crore iPhone di India pada Maret 2024, dengan capaian lebih dari ₹60.000 crore di tujuh bulan pertama tahun fiskal. Berita lain, pemerintah membahas transfer dana akun pengembalian Sahara-Sebi yang belum diklaim dan Nawaz Modi meminta sebagian besar kekayaan Gautam Singhania dalam negosiasi penyelesaian keluarga mereka.

article_content: Ever wanted to see a Red Arrows display from the pilot’s perspective? A newly released three-minute cockpit video lets viewers experience a training session at RAF Scampton, Lincolnshire. Filmed in the passenger seat of a Hawk T1 jet, the footage captures Red Arrows pilots performing impressive aerial maneuvers at speeds up to 450mph. Flight Lieutenant Stian Walker, a visiting flying instructor from RAF Team Valley, recorded the video using a GoPro, highlighting the incredible precision and teamwork it takes to maintain the tight formations. In preparation for their 50th display season, the Red Arrows have unveiled a unique tailfin design to mark the milestone. The 2014 season, running from late May to late September, features 85 performances across nine countries. Before the shows begin, the team will head to Cyprus for further training. This cockpit video offers aviation fans a unique window into the skill and artistry that define the Red Arrows' celebrated displays.

Diambil dari kursi penumpang jet Hawk T1, rekaman ini menampilkan para pilot Red Arrows melakukan manuver udara mengesankan dengan kecepatan hingga 450 mph. Flight Lieutenant Stian Walker, instruktur terbang tamu dari RAF Team Valley, merekamnya menggunakan GoPro—menunjukkan presisi dan kerja sama luar biasa agar formasi tetap rapat. Menyambut musim pertunjukan ke-50, Red Arrows telah meluncurkan desain tailfin spesial sebagai penanda. Musim 2014, yang berlangsung dari akhir Mei sampai akhir September, menghadirkan 85 pertunjukan di sembilan negara. Sebelum pertunjukan dimulai, tim akan menjalani latihan tambahan di Siprus. Video kokpit ini memberi penggemar aviasi pandangan eksklusif tentang keahlian dan seni di balik pertunjukan legendaris Red Arrows.

article_content: David and Rosemary Wickenden, a couple from Southampton, were shocked to receive a letter from the Child Maintenance Service (CMS) nearly twenty years after applying for child support for their grandson, Mitchell. The letter arrived eighteen months after Mitchell, whom they raised as their own, died by suicide at age 25. The Wickendens had taken in Mitchell when he was eight years old following his parents’ separation. Despite their efforts, they did not receive ongoing child support, except for a brief period from Mitchell’s mother. His father, Paul, was unemployed at the time, which prevented further payments. Mitchell grew up, joined the Army, and served with the 1st Battalion, Princess of Wales's Royal Regiment in Iraq. He was later discharged on medical grounds. Sadly, he died in October 2012 after experiencing depression linked to a breakup, job loss, and his time in Iraq, according to an inquest. The arrival of the CMS letter caused the Wickendens renewed grief and disappointment. Mr. Wickenden, 74, expressed frustration, stating, 'We did all the legwork for child support years ago but never got anywhere. If Mitchell were alive, he would be 27 now. How can something like this happen?' Mrs. Wickenden, 71, added, 'What if a mother whose young child had died received something like this? We want to make sure this never happens again.' The couple spent more than an hour on the phone with CMS, seeking answers without success. CMS responded by acknowledging the mistake, apologizing for the distress caused, and stating they are urgently investigating how the error occurred. They have promised to contact the family again soon. The Wickendens also raised their granddaughter, Sadie, at the same time as Mitchell.
translated_content: David dan Rosemary Wickenden, pasangan asal Southampton, terkejut saat menerima surat dari Child Maintenance Service (CMS) hampir dua puluh tahun setelah mereka mengajukan permohonan tunjangan anak untuk cucu mereka, Mitchell. Surat tersebut datang delapan belas bulan setelah Mitchell, yang mereka besarkan seperti anak sendiri, meninggal karena bunuh diri pada usia 25 tahun. Pasangan Wickenden membesarkan Mitchell sejak usia delapan tahun setelah orang tuanya berpisah. Walau sudah berusaha, mereka tidak menerima tunjangan anak secara berkelanjutan, kecuali sebentar dari ibunya Mitchell. Ayahnya, Paul, sedang tidak bekerja saat itu sehingga tak bisa memberi dukungan. Mitchell tumbuh, lalu bergabung dengan Angkatan Darat dan bertugas di Batalion 1, Princess of Wales's Royal Regiment di Irak. Ia kemudian diberhentikan karena alasan medis. Sayangnya, ia meninggal pada Oktober 2012 setelah mengalami depresi karena putus cinta, kehilangan pekerjaan, dan pengalamannya di Irak, menurut hasil penyelidikan. Kedatangan surat dari CMS membuat keluarga Wickenden kembali merasakan duka dan kekecewaan. Mr. Wickenden, 74, menyatakan rasa frustasinya, 'Kami sudah melakukan semua upaya untuk tunjangan anak bertahun-tahun lalu tapi tidak berhasil. Jika Mitchell masih hidup, umurnya sekarang 27. Bagaimana bisa hal seperti ini terjadi?' Mrs. Wickenden, 71, menambahkan, 'Bagaimana jika seorang ibu yang anaknya meninggal menerima surat seperti ini? Kami ingin memastikan ini jangan terulang lagi.' Pasangan ini menghabiskan lebih dari satu jam menelpon CMS untuk mencari jawaban, namun tetap tidak berhasil. CMS menanggapi dengan mengakui kesalahan, meminta maaf atas stres yang ditimbulkan, dan menyatakan mereka segera menyelidiki kejadian tersebut. CMS berjanji akan segera menghubungi keluarga kembali. Pasangan Wickenden juga membesarkan cucu perempuan mereka, Sadie, bersamaan dengan Mitchell.

article_content: Music lovers and Nigerians were left in mourning after the announcement that rapper and singer Oladipupo Oladimeji, known as Oladips, passed away at age 28 on Tuesday, November 14, 2023. A statement from his management read: "We are saddened to inform the public that Oladipupo Olabode Oladimeji, aka Oladips, passed away on Tuesday evening, November 14, at exactly 10:14 pm. We are still in shock. For over two years, he had been battling health issues privately. His body is with his family, and funeral arrangements will be announced soon. We ask for privacy during this difficult time. May God give us all the strength to bear this loss." Although the announcement was made on Wednesday morning, Oladips had posted a video the previous evening on Instagram asking an aide to take him to the hospital. Later, a video surfaced online, purportedly showing his body in a car with friends. Singer and friend Raphael Omoniyi (Zlatan Ibile) shared his last messages with Oladips, where Oladips spoke about being ill for months and struggling with insomnia. As condolences came in, some people in the industry, including singer Qdot Alagbe, claimed Oladips was not dead. An Instagram user with the handle @only1wavytk_fka_sircoolest wrote, "Thank God he is alive… He just finished eating turkey and rice. He is setting up a ring light. If the album gets to number one tomorrow, he'll post an apology video." A video was also shared of Oladips with friends, but later it was clarified to be an old video from over two years ago. The friend later stated: "I'm not sure if he is dead or alive. When people posted he was dead, I didn't believe it because I don't wish him death. He might be facing depression or pressures from releasing his album and other life challenges. I apologize for any misunderstanding. Oladips is a mentor and an inspiration to many young artists. I was only wishing him well, not seeking attention." Meanwhile, Oladips' latest album, 'Superhero Adugbo,' was released by his management on Thursday, November 16. This sparked speculation about whether his death was real or a publicity stunt. His single 'Die Young', released October 6, 2023, addressed themes of death and how society reacts. Lyrics from the song fueled online debate, with some thinking it was a planned publicity effort while others saw it as his genuine experience. Oladips rose to fame in 2015 after winning the online rap competition 'The King is Here,' hosted by singer D’Banj. He later joined Reminisce’s label Edge Records but left in 2019. Requests for clarification from Oladips’ management have yet to receive a response as of press time.
translated_content: Penggemar musik dan masyarakat Nigeria berduka setelah diumumkan bahwa rapper dan penyanyi Oladipupo Oladimeji, yang dikenal dengan nama Oladips, meninggal dunia pada usia 28 tahun pada Selasa, 14 November 2023. Pernyataan dari manajemennya berbunyi: "Kami dengan sedih menginformasikan kepada publik bahwa Oladipupo Olabode Oladimeji, alias Oladips, telah meninggal dunia pada Selasa malam, 14 November, tepat pukul 22:14. Kami masih sangat terpukul. Selama lebih dari dua tahun, ia menyimpan perjuangan kesehatannya sendiri. Jenazahnya kini bersama keluarganya, dan pengumuman pemakaman akan dilakukan segera. Kami mohon privasinya di masa sulit ini. Semoga Tuhan memberi kita kekuatan untuk menghadapi kehilangan ini." Meskipun pengumuman ini baru dibuat pada Rabu pagi, Oladips sempat mengunggah video di Instagram pada malam sebelumnya, meminta rekannya membawanya ke rumah sakit. Setelah itu, video lain muncul secara online, yang dikabarkan memperlihatkan jenazahnya di dalam mobil bersama teman-temannya. Penyanyi sekaligus sahabatnya, Raphael Omoniyi (Zlatan Ibile), membagikan pesan terakhirnya bersama Oladips, di mana Oladips mengaku telah lama sakit dan mengalami insomnia. Seiring ucapan belasungkawa berdatangan, beberapa rekan di industri musik, termasuk penyanyi Qdot Alagbe, mengklaim bahwa Oladips sebenarnya belum meninggal. Seorang pengguna Instagram dengan nama @only1wavytk_fka_sircoolest menulis, "Alhamdulillah dia masih hidup… Baru saja makan kalkun dan nasi. Dia sedang menyiapkan ring light. Kalau albumnya besok jadi nomor satu, dia akan posting video permintaan maaf." Video bersama Oladips dan teman-temannya juga dibagikan, namun kemudian dikonfirmasi bahwa video tersebut sudah lebih dari dua tahun lalu. Temannya kemudian mengatakan: "Saya juga tidak yakin dia benar-benar meninggal atau tidak. Saat orang-orang menyebut dia meninggal, saya tidak percaya karena saya tidak ingin hal itu terjadi. Bisa saja dia sedang depresi atau tertekan karena album dan tantangan hidup lainnya. Maaf jika ada kesalahpahaman. Oladips adalah panutan dan inspirasi bagi banyak musisi muda. Saya hanya mendoakan yang terbaik, bukan cari sensasi." Sementara itu, album terbaru Oladips, 'Superhero Adugbo,' dirilis oleh manajemennya pada Kamis, 16 November. Hal ini memicu spekulasi apakah dia benar-benar meninggal atau hanya sekadar strategi promosi album. Single-nya 'Die Young', yang dirilis 6 Oktober 2023, membahas tema kematian dan reaksi masyarakat. Lirik lagu ini memperkuat perdebatan di dunia maya; ada yang menganggap ini publikasi yang direncanakan, tapi sebagian lain menganggapnya sebagai curahan hati yang nyata. Oladips mulai dikenal sejak memenangkan kompetisi rap online 'The King is Here' pada 2015 yang dipandu D’Banj. Dia kemudian bergabung dengan label Edge Records milik Reminisce, sebelum keluar pada 2019. Permintaan klarifikasi kepada manajemen Oladips hingga saat ini belum mendapat tanggapan.
post_content: Sad news for Naija music fans: Oladips, the talented rapper, reportedly passed away at 28. Some say it’s real, others suspect a publicity stunt with his new album drop. We’ll miss you, Oladips! 🕊️💔 #Oladips #NaijaMusic #RestInPeace
translated_post: Sedih banget, dunia musik Nigeria kehilangan Oladips di usia 28 tahun. Tapi masih banyak yang bingung, ini beneran meninggal atau cuma strategi promosi album baru? Semoga damai, Oladips. 🙏💔 #Oladips #MusikNigeria #RIP

Commuters in New York are encountering issues with raccoons at metro stations. Marble Station on the Metro-North route has seen raccoons, including one known as 'Ted,' surprising people near the station after emerging from trees. This problem has prompted sanitation teams to step up cleaning efforts outside the station. Milagros Maldonado, age 28, described being frightened by a large raccoon, saying, “I was scared. I started screaming. I don’t want this to happen again.”

Further south at Bedford Park subway station, people have also reported incidents involving both raccoons and skunks. In a previous encounter, Andre Mayes, 40, said, “It’s kind of unnerving. If you see six of them coming at you, you don’t know what will happen.”

A Metro-North spokesperson indicated that if the wildlife issues continue, traps may be used to reduce the problem.
translated_content:
Penumpang di New York kini menghadapi masalah baru dengan kemunculan rakun di sekitar stasiun metro. Di Marble Station pada jalur Metro-North, rakun—termasuk satu yang disebut warga sebagai 'Ted'—suka tiba-tiba muncul dari pepohonan dan mengejutkan orang yang lewat. Situasi ini membuat petugas kebersihan setempat meningkatkan pembersihan di sekitar stasiun. Milagros Maldonado (28) membagikan pengalaman menegangkan saat bertemu rakun besar, "Saya ketakutan. Saya langsung berteriak. Saya tidak ingin hal seperti ini terjadi lagi."

Di stasiun Bedford Park, penumpang juga melaporkan kejadian serupa yang melibatkan rakun dan skunk. Dalam insiden sebelumnya, Andre Mayes (40) berkata, "Lumayan bikin khawatir. Kalau kamu lihat enam rakun mendekat, kamu tidak tahu bakal terjadi apa."

Juru bicara Metro-North mengatakan, jika masalah satwa liar berlanjut, mereka akan mempertimbangkan memasang perangkap sebagai solusi.
