translated_post: Rakun bikin heboh penumpang di New York! Di Marble Station, ada rakun bernama 'Ted' yang suka bikin kaget. Petugas kebersihan siap siaga, Metro-North siap pasang perangkap kalau makin parah. 🦝 #nyc #rakun #transportasi

article_content: Gemma, a 30-year-old mother of three from Plymouth, wanted to restore her pre-pregnancy figure and self-confidence, so she opted for a tummy tuck overseas. With the help of her husband Chris, she saved £3,200 and traveled to Poland for the procedure. Unfortunately, the surgery went badly wrong—Gemma regained consciousness during the operation and, after returning home to Devon, suffered serious complications including gangrene and infection. She was left with significant scarring, a misaligned belly button, and uneven skin, which deeply affected her self-esteem and her relationship with her husband. Seeking a solution, Gemma appeared on the TV show 'Last Chance Salon,' where cosmetic surgeon Mr. Vik Vijh assessed her condition. He described Gemma's case as one of the worst he'd encountered, but believed surgery could correct the damage. Gemma underwent reconstructive surgery at Nuffield Health Hospital in Hereford, which successfully realigned her stomach muscles and belly button, smoothed lumpy areas, and improved her scarring. The operation restored her confidence, and Gemma expressed happiness at being able to look forward to things like wearing a bikini on holiday. Her journey sheds light on the potential dangers of overseas cosmetic procedures and the importance of skilled post-surgical care.
translated_content: Gemma, ibu tiga anak berusia 30 tahun dari Plymouth, ingin mengembalikan bentuk tubuh dan kepercayaan dirinya setelah melahirkan. Bersama suaminya, Chris, ia menabung £3.200 dan memutuskan menjalani operasi tummy tuck di Polandia. Namun harapannya pupus ketika operasi berjalan tidak lancar—Gemma tersadar di tengah prosedur tersebut dan sesampainya di rumah di Devon, ia mengalami komplikasi parah seperti gangren dan infeksi. Prosedur yang gagal membuatnya mengalami bekas luka cukup parah, pusar yang tidak sejajar, serta kulit yang tampak tidak rata. Hal ini sangat mempengaruhi kepercayaan dirinya dan hubungannya dengan sang suami. Untuk mencari solusi, Gemma tampil di acara TV 'Last Chance Salon' dan bertemu dokter bedah plastik Mr. Vik Vijh, yang menyebut kasus Gemma salah satu yang terparah yang pernah ia hadapi, namun optimis dapat memperbaikinya melalui operasi rekonstruksi. Gemma lalu menjalani operasi di Nuffield Health Hospital, Hereford, yang sukses memperbaiki otot perut, posisi pusar, meratakan area kulit, dan memperbaiki bekas luka. Operasi tersebut berhasil mengembalikan rasa percaya dirinya; Gemma kini merasa lebih bahagia dan menantikan liburan dengan mengenakan bikini, sesuatu yang tadinya mustahil baginya. Cerita Gemma jadi pelajaran tentang risiko operasi plastik di luar negeri serta pentingnya perawatan medis profesional setelahnya.
post_content: Gemma wanted her confidence back after 3 kids, but a botched tummy tuck abroad left her scarred inside & out. Thanks to reconstructive surgery & a skilled UK surgeon, she's reclaimed her life! #BodyPositivity #SurgeryJourney #LastChanceSalon

article_content: Sportsbet, a betting company, has released an unconventional advertisement inspired by the film adaptation of the erotic novel 'Fifty Shades of Grey.' The ad is a parody featuring a greyhound named Tilly in the role of Christian Grey, the story's wealthy and mysterious protagonist. The advertisement begins with a journalist visiting Christian Grey's high-rise office, mirroring a scene from the bestselling book. Instead of a man, a greyhound wearing a tie occupies the desk. The ad's tone turns unusual as a woman portraying Anastasia Steele seductively applies red lipstick and shares playful scenes with Tilly, who is a rescue dog. She is shown scooping peanut butter from a jar, licking her lips, and interacting with the dog, referencing moments from the original story. Parody elements include Tilly sprawled on a bed and a scene where a dog's paw opens a 'red room of pain,' depicted here with dog treats, chains, and chew toys. Animal Liberation, an animal rights group, has strongly criticized the advertisement. A spokesperson told Daily Mail Australia the ad is exploitative, demeaning to animals, and raises concerns about Tilly's treatment during production, including the use of costumes. Despite the criticism, the video, titled 'Fifty Shades of Greyhound,' has been viewed over 200,000 times on Facebook. The advertisement ends with a racetrack scene featuring Tilly, dressed up, chasing the woman, now in a bunny costume, to the song ‘Who Let the Dogs Out.’ Sportsbet’s YouTube channel highlights that Tilly the greyhound was adopted through the Greyhound Adoption Program, encouraging viewers to consider adoption at gap.grv.org.au. The actual 'Fifty Shades of Grey' movie, starring Dakota Johnson as Anastasia Steele and Jamie Dornan as Christian Grey, premiered in Australian cinemas on February 12. The film's official trailer has been viewed more than 50 million times on YouTube.
translated_content: Sportsbet, sebuah perusahaan taruhan, telah merilis iklan unik yang terinspirasi dari film adaptasi novel erotis 'Fifty Shades of Grey.' Iklan ini merupakan parodi yang menampilkan seekor anjing greyhound bernama Tilly sebagai Christian Grey, tokoh utama yang kaya dan misterius dalam cerita. Iklan dibuka dengan seorang jurnalis mengunjungi kantor mewah Christian Grey, mirip seperti adegan di novel bestseller tersebut. Namun, alih-alih seorang pria, seekor greyhound mengenakan dasi duduk di meja. Nuansa iklan menjadi unik saat seorang wanita yang memerankan Anastasia Steele dengan genit mengoleskan lipstik merah dan beradegan lucu bersama Tilly, anjing adopsi tersebut. Ia terlihat mengambil selai kacang dari toples, menjilat bibirnya, dan bermain-main dengan Tilly, mereferensikan beberapa momen dari kisah aslinya. Unsur parodi termasuk Tilly yang berbaring di tempat tidur serta adegan ketika kaki anjing membuka 'ruang merah penderitaan', yang digambarkan dengan camilan, rantai, dan mainan kunyah untuk anjing. Kelompok hak asasi hewan Animal Liberation dengan tegas mengkritik iklan ini. Juru bicara mereka mengatakan kepada Daily Mail Australia bahwa iklan tersebut dieksploitasi, merendahkan hewan, dan menimbulkan kekhawatiran tentang perlakuan terhadap Tilly selama proses produksi, termasuk penggunaan kostum. Meski mendapat kritik, video berjudul 'Fifty Shades of Greyhound' sudah ditonton lebih dari 200.000 kali di Facebook. Iklan ini diakhiri dengan adegan lintasan balap, di mana Tilly yang berkostum mengejar sang wanita yang kini memakai kostum kelinci dengan iringan lagu ‘Who Let the Dogs Out.’ Channel YouTube Sportsbet menampilkan bahwa Tilly, anjing greyhound, telah diadopsi melalui Greyhound Adoption Program dan mengajak penonton untuk mengadopsi greyhound di gap.grv.org.au. Film 'Fifty Shades of Grey' versi asli yang dibintangi Dakota Johnson sebagai Anastasia Steele dan Jamie Dornan sebagai Christian Grey telah tayang di bioskop Australia pada 12 Februari. Trailer resminya telah ditonton lebih dari 50 juta kali di YouTube.

Grayson Perry, the Turner Prize-winning artist known for his distinctive personal style, has designed a striking holiday home that looks like a whimsical gingerbread cottage, featuring bottle-green tiles and a gold roof. This creative project, planned for the village of Wrabness along the River Stour in Essex, has divided local opinion.

Several residents objected to the design, claiming it did not suit the area's natural landscape and comparing it to something from Disneyland. Some labelled it unattractive or referred to it as 'pseudo-subversive neo-kitsch.' The parish council raised concerns that the building would not fit the character of the proposed Area of Outstanding Natural Beauty.

Despite the objections, the majority of locals supported the initiative, and Tendring District Council approved Perry's first architectural venture. The new house will replace a semi-derelict farmhouse situated at the end of a single-track lane, more than 500 yards from the nearest neighboring property.

The two-bedroom home, intended as a rental property, is themed around an imaginary Essex woman named Julie. It will feature a statue of Julie, decorative tiles bearing her image, a weather vane celebrating her motherhood, and a sculpture of her cat over the front door. Perry has noted that his earliest sketches for the house were drawn while 'doodling wildly and quite drunkenly in front of the television.'

The project was commissioned by Living Architecture, an organization established by philosopher Alain de Botton to introduce innovative architecture to the UK's holiday rental market. The house is expected to open to guests in 2014, though rental details have yet to be announced. For comparison, other Living Architecture properties are listed at about £25 per person per night.
translated_content:
Grayson Perry, seniman pemenang Turner Prize yang dikenal dengan gaya uniknya, merancang rumah liburan menonjol berbentuk pondok gingerbread imajinatif, dengan ubin hijau botol dan atap emas. Proyek kreatif ini akan dibangun di Wrabness di tepi Sungai Stour, Essex, dan menuai pro-kontra di kalangan warga.

Beberapa penduduk menolak desainnya, menilai rumah tersebut tidak cocok dengan lanskap alami dan menyamakannya dengan bangunan Disneyland. Ada yang berkomentar tampilannya kurang menarik—bahkan menyebutnya 'neo-kitsch pseudo-subversif.' Dewan paroki khawatir rumah ini tak selaras dengan karakter Area dengan Keindahan Alam Luar Biasa yang diusulkan.

Meski ada penolakan, mayoritas warga mendukung inisiatif ini sehingga Dewan Distrik Tendring menyetujui proyek arsitektur perdana Perry. Rumah tersebut akan menggantikan rumah pertanian setengah rusak di ujung jalan kecil, lebih dari 500 yard dari tetangga terdekat.

Rumah dua kamar tidur yang akan disewakan ini bertema tentang seorang wanita Essex imajiner bernama Julie. Fasilitasnya termasuk patung Julie, ubin bergambar dirinya, penunjuk arah angin merayakan keibuannya, serta patung kucing di atas pintu depan. Perry mengaku sketsa awal rumah ini dibuat saat ia 'mencoret-coret secara liar dan cukup mabuk di depan televisi.'

Proyek ini diinisiasi oleh Living Architecture, organisasi bentukan filsuf Alain de Botton, yang bertujuan memperkenalkan arsitektur inovatif ke pasar rumah liburan Inggris. Rumah ini dijadwalkan mulai menerima tamu pada 2014, dengan harga sewa yang belum diumumkan. Sebagai perbandingan, properti Living Architecture lain biasanya ditawarkan sekitar £25 per orang per malam.

Before hiring Kevin Stefanski, the Cleveland Browns endured years of poor performance, recording a winning percentage of just .222 from 2016 to 2019. Since Stefanski became head coach in 2020, the Browns have significantly improved, achieving a .550 winning percentage (33-27) over his first four years.

Although the Browns initially passed over Stefanski for Freddie Kitchens, who lasted only one season, they later selected Stefanski—then the Minnesota Vikings’ offensive coordinator—for the job. Stefanski has brought consistency to the team’s head coaching role.

In his first season, Stefanski led the Browns to an 11-5 record—their first winning season in 12 years and only their second in 21 years. The Browns won a wild card playoff game against the Pittsburgh Steelers, a game Stefanski coached remotely while quarantined for COVID-19. The team subsequently lost to Kansas City in the Divisional Round. Stefanski’s impressive turnaround earned him NFL Coach of the Year honors.

The Browns faced decades of struggles before Stefanski’s tenure, rotating through 17 coaches in 30 years and failing to win a division title since 1989. Even Bill Belichick had a losing record during his time in Cleveland.

Stefanski has weathered several challenges. The Browns finished with a combined 15-19 record in the 2021 and 2022 seasons. In 2023, injuries have further tested the roster—quarterback Deshaun Watson has played in only 12 of the team’s last 34 games due to injuries and an NFL suspension. The Browns began this season without a veteran backup quarterback, leading the team to sign Joe Flacco for additional support.

Despite losing star running back Nick Chubb to a season-ending knee injury, Stefanski has kept the team competitive. Heading into Thanksgiving, the Browns had a 7-3 record, with only the Baltimore Ravens ahead in the AFC. Stefanski’s steady leadership and calm demeanor have helped maintain stability and inspired ongoing optimism for the franchise’s future.
translated_content:
Sebelum merekrut Kevin Stefanski, Cleveland Browns melewati bertahun-tahun hasil buruk, dengan persentase kemenangan hanya 0,222 dari tahun 2016 sampai 2019. Sejak Stefanski menjadi pelatih kepala pada 2020, performa Browns meningkat tajam, meraih persentase kemenangan 0,550 (33-27) dalam empat tahun pertamanya.

Meski awalnya Browns melewatkan Stefanski dan memilih Freddie Kitchens—yang hanya bertahan satu musim—mereka akhirnya merekrut Stefanski, saat itu koordinator ofensif Minnesota Vikings. Stefanski membawa stabilitas di posisi pelatih kepala.

Pada musim perdananya, Stefanski membawa Browns mencatat rekor 11-5—musim kemenangan pertama dalam 12 tahun dan hanya kedua kalinya dalam 21 tahun terakhir. Browns menang dalam pertandingan wild card playoff melawan Pittsburgh Steelers, yang dipimpin Stefanski dari jarak jauh karena harus isolasi diri akibat COVID-19. Setelah itu, tim kalah dari Kansas City di Divisional Round. Prestasi tersebut mengantarkan Stefanski meraih gelar NFL Coach of the Year.

Sebelum era Stefanski, Browns mengalami banyak tantangan, pernah berganti 17 pelatih dalam 30 tahun dan belum pernah juara divisi sejak 1989. Bahkan Bill Belichick pun memiliki rekor kalah di Cleveland.

Stefanski menghadapi banyak kendala. Browns meraih rekor gabungan 15-19 di musim 2021 dan 2022. Tahun 2023, cedera semakin memperburuk situasi; quarterback Deshaun Watson hanya bermain di 12 dari 34 pertandingan terakhir akibat cedera dan suspensi NFL. Awal musim ini Browns tidak memiliki quarterback cadangan berpengalaman; akhirnya mereka merekrut Joe Flacco untuk menambah kekuatan.

Walau kehilangan running back andalan Nick Chubb yang cedera lutut, Stefanski tetap menjaga daya saing tim. Menjelang Thanksgiving, Browns mencatat rekor 7-3, hanya di bawah Baltimore Ravens di AFC. Kepemimpinan dan ketenangan Stefanski memberikan stabilitas dan harapan bagi masa depan Browns.
post_content: The Browns turned things around after hiring Kevin Stefanski in 2020! From years of losses to playoff glory, Stefanski brought real stability & hope—even through wild QB changes and big injuries. Is this the start of something bigger? 🏈 #ClevelandBrowns #Stefanski #NFL

article_content: Buying a home in New York City may become somewhat easier this fall. The Manhattan co-op and condo market is starting to stabilize, according to a third-quarter report from real estate brokerage Douglas Elliman. Douglas Elliman agent Frances Katzen told Insider that the New York City market is self-correcting. 'It's returning to a normal adjustment period, which to many feels negative because everything seems sluggish,' she explained. 'But I think people recognize value in entering the market now. It's the classic adage: opportunity and location, location, location. And New York is certainly that location.' Douglas Elliman reported a 4.5% decline in Manhattan's median sales price from the second to the third quarter. Meanwhile, Rocket Homes found the supply of homes on the market increased by 5% from August to September. According to their report, 'New York is a buyer's housing market.' Katzen believes the city's market is unique enough to rebound, suggesting what's happening now is more of a correction than a decline. For buyers seeking a good deal, this may be the ideal moment. 'After COVID, many predicted New York's market would crash, but it didn't. Instead, we saw performance rise to unprecedented levels,' Katzen said. 'I don't think the trajectory will be straightforward, nor is it doom and gloom. Expect some ups and downs.' As an example, Katzen noted that purchasing a townhouse in New York City for around $4 million, once seen as impossible, is now a reality. She added, 'There's a lot of opportunity if you have the resources.' A recent Zillow report found New York remains the most valuable metro area in 2023, valued at over $4 billion. Los Angeles, San Francisco, and Boston follow on the list, with these cities maintaining their top positions for the past five years. New York City has led for some time, and its residential housing market value has risen 31% since 2020, while cities like Tampa and Miami are also expanding rapidly. The city experienced a quieter third quarter this year, with Manhattan home sales falling 33.2%, from 11,111 sales last year to 7,421. Overall, this fall may present a 'sweet spot' for buyers. Separately, Zillow noted that 9.2% of home listings in New York had a price cut in the week ending September 16.
translated_content: Membeli rumah di New York City kemungkinan akan menjadi sedikit lebih mudah musim gugur ini. Pasar apartemen co-op dan kondominium di Manhattan mulai stabil, menurut laporan kuartal ketiga dari perusahaan properti Douglas Elliman. Agen Douglas Elliman, Frances Katzen, mengatakan kepada Insider bahwa pasar New York City sedang menyesuaikan diri. 'Sekarang kembali ke periode penyesuaian normal, yang bagi banyak orang terasa negatif karena segalanya tampak lesu,' jelasnya. 'Tapi menurut saya, orang mulai melihat nilai untuk masuk ke pasar sekarang. Istilah lamanya: peluang dan lokasi, lokasi, lokasi. Dan New York jelas adalah lokasi itu.' Douglas Elliman melaporkan penurunan 4,5% pada harga jual median di Manhattan dari kuartal kedua ke kuartal ketiga. Sementara itu, Rocket Homes menemukan pasokan rumah di pasar naik 5% dari Agustus ke September. Dalam laporannya disebutkan, 'New York adalah pasar perumahan untuk pembeli.' Katzen percaya pasar kota ini cukup unik untuk pulih, dengan apa yang terjadi sekarang lebih berupa koreksi daripada penurunan. Untuk pembeli yang mencari penawaran bagus, saat ini bisa jadi momen terbaik. 'Setelah COVID, banyak yang memprediksi pasar New York akan jatuh, tapi itu tidak terjadi. Sebaliknya, kami melihat kinerja yang naik luar biasa,' kata Katzen. 'Saya pikir pergerakannya tidak akan lurus saja, dan ini bukan situasi suram. Akan ada naik turunnya.' Sebagai contoh, Katzen menyoroti bahwa membeli townhouse di New York seharga sekitar $4 juta, yang dulunya terasa mustahil, sekarang menjadi kenyataan. Dia menambahkan, 'Ada banyak peluang bila Anda punya dana.' Laporan terbaru dari Zillow menyebutkan New York tetap menjadi wilayah metro paling bernilai di 2023, dengan nilai lebih dari $4 miliar. Los Angeles, San Francisco, dan Boston berada di posisi berikutnya, dan posisi teratas ini stabil selama lima tahun terakhir. New York City sudah lama berada di puncak, dan nilai pasar perumahan residensialnya naik 31% sejak 2020, sementara kota-kota seperti Tampa dan Miami juga tumbuh pesat. Kota ini mengalami kuartal ketiga yang lebih tenang tahun ini, dengan penjualan rumah di Manhattan turun 33,2%, dari 11.111 penjualan tahun lalu menjadi 7.421. Secara keseluruhan, musim gugur ini bisa jadi 'waktu emas' bagi pembeli. Selain itu, laporan Zillow mencatat 9,2% listing rumah di New York mengalami pemangkasan harga pada pekan yang berakhir 16 September.

article_content: Carl Froch caused concern among his fans on Sunday evening after posting a cryptic tweet showing a pair of boxing gloves hanging up. Along with the image, Froch wrote, 'something nice about this picture....', prompting fans to plead with him not to retire. One replied, 'Don't you dare hang them up yet,' while another asked, 'please explain further.' The 37-year-old posted the photograph just days after his victory over George Groves, raising questions about whether he might retire. Just 10 days earlier, reports suggested Froch was close to securing a lucrative fight in Las Vegas against Julio Cesar Chavez Jr. Froch said, 'Professional boxing is a business first and foremost, let’s not forget that. After knocking out George Groves, I was talking about the Chavez fight. It’s nearly there and I’m very optimistic that Eddie Hearn will make an announcement very soon.' He added, 'This fight will take me to Las Vegas. Between beating Mikkel Kessler and talking about Chavez, I’ve had two epic fights with George Groves.'

Setelah meng-KO George Groves, saya berbicara tentang pertarungan melawan Chavez. Kesepakatannya hampir selesai dan saya sangat optimis Eddie Hearn akan segera mengumumkannya.' article_content: Facebook is exploring potential legal action against a Dubai men’s hair salon named Facelook, due to similarities in both the salon’s name and visual branding to Facebook’s well-known identity. Facelook’s logo uses white letters on a blue background, resembling Facebook’s recognizable branding. Facelook’s owner, who operates the business in Discovery Gardens, denies any intentional imitation, explaining that the name and brand were registered under UAE labor laws and that any visual resemblance is accidental, pointing out distinctions in color and font style. A spokesperson for Facebook covering the Middle East and North Africa confirmed that the company is examining the case as part of its commitment to protect its brand’s intellectual property. This incident is part of a wider pattern where major international companies have challenged businesses with similar branding. Examples include Primark’s threats against a similarly named Dubai store, restrictions during the 2012 London Olympics for unauthorized logo use, and Google’s legal warning to the creator of the ‘Doogle’ job website. Legal experts urge entrepreneurs to thoroughly check that their branding doesn’t infringe on the intellectual property rights of established companies.

Logo Facelook menggunakan huruf putih di atas latar biru, menyerupai branding Facebook yang mudah dikenali. Pemilik Facelook, yang mengelola usahanya di Discovery Gardens, menegaskan tidak ada niat meniru. Ia menjelaskan bahwa nama dan merek telah terdaftar sesuai hukum ketenagakerjaan Uni Emirat Arab dan persamaan visual itu sebatas kebetulan, dengan tetap menyoroti perbedaan warna serta gaya tulisan. Juru bicara Facebook untuk wilayah Timur Tengah dan Afrika Utara menyatakan bahwa perusahaan sedang meninjau kasus ini sebagai bagian dari komitmennya dalam melindungi hak kekayaan intelektual mereknya. Kasus ini menggambarkan tren di mana perusahaan internasional besar menindak bisnis lain dengan brand mirip. Contoh lainnya: Primark yang mengancam secara hukum toko di Dubai dengan nama serupa, larangan penggunaan logo selama Olimpiade London 2012, dan peringatan hukum Google pada pencipta situs kerja 'Doogle'. Para ahli hukum mengingatkan para pelaku usaha untuk memastikan branding mereka tidak melanggar hak kekayaan intelektual perusahaan besar.

article_content: Mary Virginia Jones, aged 74, was released late Monday from Century Regional Detention Facility, greeted by her elated family and friends after serving 32 years in prison. Jones had been convicted for her role in a 1981 murder alongside her then-boyfriend, Mose Willis. She was given a life sentence without parole for murder, kidnapping, and robbery, but always insisted that Willis—who was abusive and later died on death row—forced her to take part under threat. The University of Southern California’s Post-Conviction Justice Project supported her case, arguing that courts failed to consider her history of abuse and the impact of Battered Woman’s Syndrome in prior trials. Prosecutors in Los Angeles County reopened the investigation, leading to a plea agreement in which Jones pled no contest to involuntary manslaughter, acknowledging the abuse she suffered. Judge William C. Ryan ruled she had already served well beyond the maximum time for involuntary manslaughter and granted her release. Her family responded with emotional prayers and gratitude after the decision. Reading her plea in court using a magnifying glass, Jones said: 'I did not willingly participate in this crime, but entering a no contest plea is in my best interest to get out of custody.' Jones was known as a committed mother, a churchgoer, and a school district staff member before meeting Willis. Her imprisonment followed multiple problematic trials that excluded evidence about her abuse and involved improper jury instructions. Denitra Jones-Goodie, her daughter, expressed pride in her mother’s strength through the ordeal, saying Jones never gave up hope of freedom. Law students from USC and UCLA emphasized that if earlier juries had understood the effects of her abuse, the outcome could have been different. With the help of devoted advocates, Jones is finally home with her relatives, who are thankful for her release and the work of everyone who helped her case.
translated_content: Mary Virginia Jones, 74 tahun, dibebaskan dari Century Regional Detention Facility pada Senin malam, disambut keluarga dan sahabat dengan penuh kebahagiaan setelah menjalani 32 tahun di penjara. Jones sebelumnya divonis seumur hidup tanpa pembebasan bersyarat atas perannya dalam kasus pembunuhan tahun 1981 bersama mantan kekasihnya, Mose Willis. Ia selalu menegaskan bahwa Willis—pasangan yang abusif dan kemudian meninggal di penjara—memaksanya terlibat dengan ancaman senjata. Proyek Keadilan Pascakonviksi dari University of Southern California turut membantunya, menyoroti bahwa pengadilan dulu tidak mempertimbangkan riwayat kekerasan dan dampak Battered Woman’s Syndrome pada Jones. Jaksa Los Angeles County membuka kembali kasus itu, dan akhirnya menerima pengakuan bersalah Jones atas dakwaan pembunuhan tanpa sengaja, dengan mempertimbangkan kekerasan yang dialaminya. Hakim William C. Ryan memutuskan bahwa Jones telah menjalani hukuman melampaui maksimum untuk dakwaan tersebut dan memerintahkan pembebasannya. Keluarganya langsung haru dan bersyukur begitu keputusan keluar. Saat membacakan pengakuannya di pengadilan dengan bantuan kaca pembesar, Jones berkata: 'Saya tidak dengan sukarela terlibat dalam kejahatan ini, tetapi mengaku bersalah demi kepentingan saya agar bisa keluar dari tahanan.' Jones dikenal sebagai ibu yang setia, rajin ke gereja, dan pegawai distrik sekolah sebelum bertemu Willis. Imprisonment-nya merupakan hasil dari serangkaian sidang bermasalah, termasuk bukti kekerasan yang tidak dipertimbangkan dan instruksi juri yang keliru. Denitra Jones-Goodie, putrinya, menyatakan rasa bangga atas ketabahan ibunya, serta keyakinan sang ibu untuk suatu saat akan dibebaskan. Para mahasiswa hukum dari USC dan UCLA menekankan jika juri sejak awal tahu dampak kekerasan yang dialami, hasilnya bisa saja berbeda. Berkat bantuan para pendukungnya, Jones akhirnya pulang kembali ke keluarganya yang sangat bersyukur atas kebebasannya dan perjuangan semua pihak yang telah membantu.

article_content: San Francisco’s Presidio Golf Course is an 18-hole, 150-acre site nestled within a national park, making up a portion of the city’s more than 700 acres devoted to golf. This is significant, especially as San Francisco struggles with a severe housing shortage and rising home prices—the median now about $1.3 million. For context, Central Park in Manhattan covers 843 acres. During the pandemic, the Presidio closed to golfers and opened to everyone for walking, hiking, and biking, providing rare access to beautiful open space otherwise restricted to those who play golf. The community’s enthusiastic response to the open course led many San Franciscans to wonder why so much taxpayer-supported land is reserved for a single sport that many cannot afford. Tech entrepreneur Zach Klein, inspired by visiting the open course, imagined it permanently available to all, highlighting the city's need for inclusive green spaces. Urban golf courses have drawn criticism for being inefficient and exclusive land uses—particularly in dense, housing-strapped cities. Urban planners and advocates argue that transforming golf courses could help alleviate housing shortages, homelessness, and provide more accessible green spaces. Maintaining golf courses is expensive, and many are subsidized with favorable property tax arrangements. For instance, California law gives golf courses special tax breaks, while the Los Angeles Country Club sits on $9 billion in property but pays a relatively tiny amount in taxes. Meanwhile, golf is less popular than it was years ago, with many public courses posting financial losses. Golf courses typically serve far fewer people compared to parks; Presidio welcomes about 1,200 people per acre per year, while Golden Gate Park gets 24,000. Other uses—from sports fields to housing—could accommodate many more. Efforts to repurpose or redevelop courses often encounter resistance from neighbors and golfers, who cite property values and tradition. Some projects, like converting an abandoned New Orleans golf course into an urban farm, have succeeded, but many proposals struggle under regulatory, funding, and political hurdles. Recent initiatives in cities like Toronto, where city leaders sought to open public golf lands to broader use, reflect a shift toward adapting amenities for evolving community needs. Ideas include redesigning courses to be smaller, adding new uses, or opening golf land to the public for other activities. While advocates do not generally seek to abolish golf, they emphasize the importance of adapting large urban green spaces for greater public benefit, diversity, and access.
translated_content: Lapangan Golf Presidio di San Francisco yang memiliki 18 lubang dan luas 150 hektar, terletak di taman nasional dan menjadi bagian dari lebih dari 700 hektar lahan milik kota yang digunakan untuk golf. Kondisi ini cukup menonjol karena San Francisco tengah menghadapi krisis perumahan dengan harga rumah yang terus melonjak—harga median saat ini sekitar $1,3 juta. Sebagai perbandingan, Central Park di Manhattan memiliki luas 843 hektar. Selama pandemi, Presidio tidak dibuka untuk pegolf, melainkan untuk umum, sehingga warga bisa berjalan kaki, mendaki, dan bersepeda—memberikan akses langka ke ruang terbuka hijau nan indah yang biasanya hanya bisa dinikmati para pegolf. Antusiasme masyarakat ketika lapangan golf dibuka membuat banyak warga San Francisco bertanya-tanya, mengapa lahan kota yang didanai pajak justru hanya diperuntukkan untuk satu olahraga yang tidak semua orang bisa akses. Pengusaha teknologi Zach Klein yang terinspirasi saat mengunjungi lapangan yang terbuka ini membayangkan bila ruang hijau tersebut dapat dinikmati semua orang, menyoroti perlunya ruang hijau inklusif di kota. Lapangan golf perkotaan kini sering dikritik karena dinilai eksklusif dan tidak efisien—terutama di kota padat yang kekurangan perumahan. Perencana kota dan pegiat menilai, mengalihfungsikan lapangan golf bisa membantu mengatasi masalah perumahan, tunawisma, dan menyediakan lebih banyak ruang hijau publik. Memelihara lapangan golf sangat mahal, dan banyak yang disubsidi lewat keringanan pajak properti. Misalnya, hukum di California memberi lapangan golf potongan pajak khusus, sementara Los Angeles Country Club berdiri di atas lahan bernilai $9 miliar namun pajaknya jauh lebih rendah. Sementara golf kini makin kurang diminati dibandingkan masa lalu, dan banyak lapangan umum merugi. Lapangan golf melayani jauh lebih sedikit pengunjung dibanding taman kota; Presidio menggaet sekitar 1.200 orang per hektar per tahun, sementara Golden Gate Park mencapai 24.000. Lahan ini bisa digunakan untuk perumahan atau fasilitas olahraga lain yang lebih bermanfaat bagi banyak warga. Upaya mengalihfungsikan lapangan golf sering mendapat penolakan dari tetangga dan komunitas golf yang khawatir terhadap nilai properti dan tradisi. Beberapa sukses seperti kebun urban di bekas lapangan golf New Orleans, tetapi banyak proposal serupa masih terganjal masalah regulasi, pembiayaan, dan politik. Inisiatif baru di kota-kota seperti Toronto, di mana pemda berupaya membuka lapangan golf umum untuk fungsi lain, menunjukkan adanya perubahan agar fasilitas publik menyesuaikan kebutuhan masa kini. Gagasan yang diusulkan antara lain memperkecil ukuran lapangan, menambah fasilitas lain, atau membuka area golf untuk aktivitas non-golf. Para pengusul perubahan ini umumnya tidak ingin menghapus golf sama sekali, tetapi menekankan pentingnya menjadikan ruang hijau besar di kota lebih terbuka, inklusif, dan bermanfaat bagi banyak orang.

article_content: WASHINGTON — The United States is resuming food aid to refugees in Ethiopia after assistance was paused earlier this year when reports surfaced that donations were being diverted, according to a senior official from the US Agency for International Development (USAID). Ethiopia's food crisis has worsened in recent years, driven by conflict in the Tigray region and the Horn of Africa's most severe drought in decades. "The resumption of food assistance to refugees will save lives and alleviate suffering for some of the most vulnerable," the official stated. The decision was made following the implementation of reforms by the Ethiopian government and its partners to enhance the structure of refugee food assistance. Improvements include stronger program monitoring, better tracking of food supplies, and improved registration processes. The resumed aid will reach dozens of refugee sites across Ethiopia, although none are located in Tigray. The Tigray region endured a two-year war between the federal government and forces led by the regional ruling party, which ended with a truce in November last year following tens of thousands of deaths and famine-like conditions for hundreds of thousands. A second USAID official noted that about one million refugees in Ethiopia will benefit, including individuals from Sudan, South Sudan, Somalia, Eritrea, and other nations. Assistance for other food-insecure populations in Ethiopia remains paused until the US can ensure that aid reaches its intended recipients. USAID continues to work with the Ethiopian government on additional reforms. USAID announced in June that it was suspending food aid to Ethiopia after discovering that donations were being systematically stolen. At the time, a spokesperson said investigations jointly conducted with the Ethiopian government revealed a 'widespread and coordinated campaign' to divert food aid away from those in need. In fiscal year 2022, USAID provided nearly US$1.5 billion in humanitarian aid to Ethiopia, most of it in the form of food assistance. The UN World Food Programme (WFP) stated in August that it had resumed food aid distribution in parts of Tigray after a three-month suspension following reports of widespread theft. WFP had previously halted aid to the region in May and then to all of Ethiopia in June.
translated_content: WASHINGTON — Amerika Serikat kembali menyalurkan bantuan pangan untuk pengungsi di Ethiopia setelah sempat dihentikan awal tahun ini karena adanya laporan penyelewengan donasi, menurut pejabat tinggi US Agency for International Development (USAID). Krisis pangan di Ethiopia semakin parah dalam beberapa tahun terakhir, dipicu konflik di wilayah Tigray dan kekeringan paling parah di Tanduk Afrika selama beberapa dekade. "Kembalinya bantuan pangan untuk pengungsi akan menyelamatkan nyawa dan mengurangi penderitaan sebagian masyarakat yang paling rentan," kata pejabat tersebut. Keputusan ini diambil setelah adanya reformasi dari pemerintah Ethiopia dan mitranya untuk memperbaiki struktur distribusi bantuan pangan untuk pengungsi. Perbaikan meliputi pemantauan program yang lebih ketat, pelacakan logistik yang lebih baik, dan proses registrasi yang diperbaiki. Bantuan yang dimulai kembali ini akan menjangkau puluhan lokasi pengungsi di seluruh Ethiopia, meski tidak termasuk wilayah Tigray. Wilayah Tigray sendiri mengalami perang selama dua tahun antara pemerintah pusat dan pihak yang dipimpin oleh partai penguasa setempat, yang berakhir dengan gencatan senjata pada November tahun lalu setelah puluhan ribu orang tewas dan ratusan ribu lainnya mengalami kondisi seperti kelaparan. Pejabat USAID lainnya mengatakan sekitar satu juta pengungsi di Ethiopia akan menerima manfaat, termasuk dari Sudan, Sudan Selatan, Somalia, Eritrea, dan negara lain. Bantuan untuk masyarakat Ethiopia yang rawan pangan di luar kelompok pengungsi masih ditangguhkan hingga pemerintah AS yakin bantuan benar-benar sampai ke penerima yang berhak. USAID terus bekerja sama dengan pemerintah Ethiopia untuk melakukan reformasi lanjutan. USAID mengumumkan pada bulan Juni bahwa mereka menangguhkan bantuan pangan ke Ethiopia setelah menemukan adanya pencurian donasi secara sistematis. Saat itu, juru bicara mengatakan hasil investigasi bersama pemerintah Ethiopia menemukan adanya 'kampanye terkoordinasi dan meluas' untuk mengalihkan bantuan pangan dari yang membutuhkan. Pada tahun fiskal 2022, USAID menyalurkan hampir US$1,5 miliar bantuan kemanusiaan ke Ethiopia, sebagian besar berupa bantuan pangan. Program Pangan Dunia PBB (WFP) menyatakan pada Agustus lalu bahwa mereka telah melanjutkan distribusi bantuan pangan di beberapa wilayah Tigray setelah penangguhan selama tiga bulan akibat laporan pencurian donasi yang meluas. Sebelumnya, WFP menghentikan bantuan ke wilayah utara pada Mei dan ke seluruh Ethiopia pada Juni.

article_content: Radical cleric Abu Qatada was deported from Britain to Jordan early Sunday, according to the British Home Office. Qatada, a Jordanian national, is wanted in Jordan on terrorism charges—a case that ended a protracted legal struggle over his removal. Court documents reveal that Abu Qatada was tried and convicted in absentia in Jordan in 1999 on two counts of conspiracy to cause explosions. Britain has sought his deportation since 2005, but a series of legal appeals had kept him in the country. Jordanian government spokesman Mohammed Al-momani told Petra News Agency that Qatada will receive a fair trial for alleged terrorist attacks in 1999 and 2000, and affirmed that Jordan's constitution guarantees respect for human rights. In a written statement, UK Home Secretary Theresa May hailed the deportation, saying: 'His departure marks the conclusion of efforts to remove him since 2001. I believe this will be welcomed by the British public. I am glad that the government's determination to see him on a plane has been vindicated, and we have at last achieved what previous governments, Parliament, and the British public have long called for. This dangerous man has now been removed from our shores to face the courts in his own country.' In January 2012, the European Court of Human Rights blocked Britain from deporting Qatada over concerns that evidence obtained through torture might be used against him at trial in Jordan. UK authorities accuse Abu Qatada of funding terrorist organizations, including those linked to former al Qaeda leader Osama bin Laden, and publicly supporting violent acts by these groups. Videos of his sermons were found in a German apartment used by individuals involved in the September 11 attacks, including ringleader Mohammed Atta. Abu Qatada, also known as Omar Othman, denies these allegations. He arrived in the UK in 1993, seeking asylum on the basis of alleged torture by Jordanian authorities. He entered the country on a forged United Arab Emirates passport, seeking asylum for himself, his wife, and their three children. Qatada was ordered back to prison in April after allegedly violating bail conditions, including prohibitions on cell phones and electronic storage devices in his home. CNN's Mitra Mobasherat and Antonia Mortensen contributed to this report.
translated_content: Ulama radikal Abu Qatada telah dideportasi dari Inggris ke Yordania pada Minggu pagi, menurut Kantor Dalam Negeri Inggris. Qatada, warga negara Yordania, dicari di Yordania atas tuduhan terorisme—kasus yang mengakhiri perjuangan hukum panjang untuk memulangkannya. Dokumen pengadilan menunjukkan bahwa Abu Qatada diadili dan dihukum secara in absentia di Yordania pada 1999 atas dua tuduhan konspirasi untuk menyebabkan ledakan. Inggris telah berusaha mendeportasi dia sejak 2005, tetapi serangkaian banding hukum membuatnya tetap tinggal di negara itu. Juru bicara pemerintah Yordania, Mohammed Al-momani, mengatakan kepada Petra News Agency bahwa Qatada akan menjalani persidangan yang adil atas dugaan serangan teroris pada 1999 dan 2000, serta menegaskan bahwa konstitusi Yordania menjamin penghormatan terhadap hak asasi manusia. Dalam pernyataan tertulis, Menteri Dalam Negeri Inggris Theresa May menyambut baik deportasi tersebut, dengan mengatakan: 'Keberangkatannya menandai akhir dari upaya untuk memulangkannya sejak 2001. Saya yakin hal ini akan disambut baik oleh publik Inggris. Saya senang bahwa tekad pemerintah untuk melihatnya berada di pesawat akhirnya tercapai, dan kita akhirnya meraih apa yang telah lama diminta oleh pemerintahan sebelumnya, Parlemen, dan publik Inggris. Pria berbahaya ini sekarang telah dipindahkan dari negeri kita untuk menghadapi pengadilan di negaranya sendiri.' Pada Januari 2012, Pengadilan HAM Eropa sempat memblokir deportasi Qatada oleh Inggris karena kekhawatiran bukti yang diperoleh melalui penyiksaan bisa digunakan dalam persidangan di Yordania. Otoritas Inggris menuduh Abu Qatada mendanai organisasi teroris, termasuk yang terkait dengan mantan pemimpin al Qaeda Osama bin Laden, serta mendukung secara terbuka tindakan kekerasan oleh kelompok-kelompok tersebut. Video ceramahnya ditemukan di sebuah apartemen di Jerman yang digunakan oleh pelaku serangan 11 September, termasuk pemimpin kelompok itu, Mohammed Atta. Abu Qatada, yang juga dikenal sebagai Omar Othman, membantah tuduhan tersebut. Ia tiba di Inggris pada 1993 untuk mencari suaka dengan alasan pernah disiksa oleh pihak berwenang Yordania. Ia masuk ke Inggris menggunakan paspor palsu Uni Emirat Arab, dan mencari suaka untuk dirinya, istri, serta tiga anaknya. Qatada diperintahkan kembali ke penjara pada bulan April setelah diduga melanggar syarat jaminan, termasuk larangan menghidupkan ponsel dan perangkat penyimpanan elektronik di rumahnya. Laporan ini juga mendapat kontribusi dari Mitra Mobasherat dan Antonia Mortensen dari CNN.

article_content: For generations, hundreds of millions of sports fans have seen the iconic Goodyear blimp floating above stadiums across the nation. But how does it actually fly? This 192-foot-long aircraft operates differently from an airplane. It has no wings and typically flies at about 1,500 feet above the ground—higher than New York's Chrysler Building, which is about 1,050 feet tall. The Goodyear blimps are also slow, reaching maximum speeds of about 53 mph but usually cruising at around 35 mph. Blimps are part of a family of aircraft called 'airships.' Unlike airplanes, airships use helium for lift instead of wings. Specifically, a blimp is an airship with no internal structure to keep its helium-filled envelope rigid. Pilots control blimps with two propeller engines, a movable tail, and a rudder system. CNN will provide more details about how blimps work after flying above Atlanta's Chick-fil-A Bowl with Goodyear pilot Matt Lussier and camera operator Tom O'Keefe. Lussier, who has a background flying airplanes, says flying a blimp is very different: 'You have to throw a lot of that [airplane knowledge] away. This is a real seat-of-your-pants flyer. You wear it.' Airplanes respond quickly, while flying a blimp requires anticipation and precise adjustments to avoid overcorrection. During college football bowl season, Goodyear's three blimps cover major events, including the Chick-fil-A Bowl, Orange Bowl, Rose Bowl, Fiesta Bowl, Sugar Bowl, and the National Championship in Pasadena, California. Operating a blimp near skyscrapers and stadiums requires careful coordination among the TV director, pilot, and camera operator to capture aerial shots. If weather permits, the blimp will provide live video for ESPN’s coverage of Duke University vs. Texas A&M, featuring 2012 Heisman winner Johnny Manziel. Goodyear entered the airship business in 1917, initially producing airships with rubberized fabrics for the U.S. Navy, mainly for training, patrol, and search and rescue. The company began operating its own airships in 1919. Today, Goodyear estimates that around 60 million Americans see its three blimps annually. Captain Lussier notes public enthusiasm: 'Sometimes you'll fly over a school with football practice, and everyone stops to look up.' Goodyear began providing event coverage from the air in 1955, starting with the Rose Bowl and parade in Pasadena, California. Nearly 60 years later, Goodyear featured its first simultaneous aerial TV coverage using two blimps at one event. Airship historian Dan Grossman explains, 'The Goodyear blimp is as much a part of football as tailgating.' Starting in 2014, Goodyear plans to introduce the Zeppelin NT, a new airship developed in partnership with the German manufacturer ZLT Zeppelin Luftschifftechnik. Unlike traditional blimps, Zeppelin NTs have semi-rigid internal frames, are longer, faster (up to 70 mph), more maneuverable, and can carry more passengers. They use safe helium, not hydrogen, like the Hindenburg, which crashed in 1937. Goodyear blimps have an auto-deflation mechanism to prevent them from drifting away if they break free from the mooring mast in high winds. For aerial television coverage, video footage is transmitted from the blimp to the ground via microwave signals and then relayed to television networks. Thousands of LED lights on the blimp—called 'EagleVision'—create vivid animated signage visible from up to a mile away.

Ia tidak memiliki sayap dan biasanya terbang di ketinggian sekitar 1.500 kaki di atas tanah—lebih tinggi daripada Gedung Chrysler di New York yang setinggi sekitar 1.050 kaki. Balon udara Goodyear juga berjalan lambat, dengan kecepatan maksimum sekitar 53 mph namun biasanya melaju santai sekitar 35 mph. Balon udara merupakan bagian dari keluarga pesawat yang disebut 'airship.' Berbeda dari pesawat, airship menggunakan helium untuk terbang, bukan sayap. Secara khusus, balon udara adalah airship tanpa struktur internal untuk menjaga kantong helium tetap kaku. Pilot mengendalikan balon udara dengan dua mesin baling-baling, ekor yang dapat digerakkan, dan sistem kemudi. CNN akan memberikan detail lebih lanjut tentang cara kerja balon udara ini setelah terbang bersama pilot Goodyear, Matt Lussier, dan operator kamera Tom O'Keefe di atas Chick-fil-A Bowl Atlanta. Lussier, yang memiliki latar belakang menerbangkan pesawat, mengatakan menerbangkan balon udara sangat berbeda: 'Harus melupakan banyak ilmu dari pesawat. Ini benar-benar terbang dengan feeling. Kamu betul-betul merasakannya.' Pesawat merespons dengan cepat, sedangkan menerbangkan balon udara memerlukan prediksi dan penyesuaian presisi agar tidak berlebihan. Selama musim bowl sepak bola perguruan tinggi, tiga balon udara Goodyear meliput acara-acara besar seperti Chick-fil-A Bowl, Orange Bowl, Rose Bowl, Fiesta Bowl, Sugar Bowl, dan National Championship di Pasadena, California. Goodyear memulai bisnis balon udara pada tahun 1917, memproduksi balon udara berbahan kain berlapis karet untuk Angkatan Laut Amerika Serikat, terutama untuk pelatihan, patroli, dan pencarian serta penyelamatan. Perusahaan mulai mengoperasikan balon udara miliknya sendiri pada tahun 1919. Kini, Goodyear memperkirakan sekitar 60 juta orang Amerika melihat tiga balon udaranya setiap tahun. Kapten Lussier berkata: 'Kadang kalau kami terbang di atas sekolah yang sedang latihan sepak bola, semua orang langsung menengadah.' Goodyear mulai melakukan liputan acara dari udara pada 1955 di Rose Bowl dan parade di Pasadena, California. Hampir 60 tahun kemudian, Goodyear menayangkan liputan udara dengan dua balon udara sekaligus dalam satu acara untuk pertama kalinya. Sejarawan balon udara, Dan Grossman, menyebutkan 'Goodyear blimp sama pentingnya bagi football seperti tailgating.' Mulai tahun 2014, Goodyear berencana memperkenalkan Zeppelin NT, generasi baru balon udara hasil kerja sama dengan perusahaan Jerman ZLT Zeppelin Luftschifftechnik. Tidak seperti balon udara biasa, Zeppelin NT memiliki rangka semi-rigid di dalam, lebih panjang, lebih cepat (hingga 70 mph), lebih mudah dikendalikan, dan dapat membawa lebih banyak penumpang. Mereka menggunakan helium yang aman, berbeda dengan hidrogen pada Hindenburg yang meledak pada 1937. Balon udara Goodyear dilengkapi dengan mekanisme auto-deflasi untuk mencegah melayang jika terlepas dari tiang tambatan ketika angin kencang. Untuk siaran televisi dari udara, rekaman video dikirim dari balon udara ke darat melalui sinyal gelombang mikro dan kemudian diteruskan ke jaringan televisi. Ribuan lampu LED pada balon udara—disebut 'EagleVision'—membuat animasi terang yang dapat dilihat hingga satu mil jauhnya.

article_content:
Lucas Piazon aims to follow the path of goalkeeper Thibaut Courtois and use his loan spell to ignite his Chelsea career. The Brazilian, currently playing for Eintracht Frankfurt in the Bundesliga, is experiencing his third loan in under two years. Despite this, Piazon is determined to earn a first-team spot at Stamford Bridge or, if not, find opportunities elsewhere.

"At the moment I'm on the bench at Frankfurt, making it hard to leave an impression," the 20-year-old told Goal. "I'll keep working to play for Chelsea or another club in the future."

Piazon, who joined Chelsea in 2011, has previously been on loan with Malaga in La Liga and Vitesse in the Eredivisie. His competition for a Chelsea place includes established players such as Eden Hazard, Oscar, Mohamed Salah, Willian, and Andre Schurrle. He highlights Thibaut Courtois as proof that success via loan spells is possible, noting, "It's different with Courtois—he already had a big name and played for Atletico Madrid, one of Europe's top clubs. Now, after returning from loan, he became Chelsea's first-choice goalkeeper ahead of Petr Cech. I'm much younger and have to work hard—if I cannot play for Chelsea, I'll play for another club."

Reflecting on his loan spells, Piazon added, "In the Netherlands with Vitesse, we were in the title race for a long time. In Spain with Malaga, we played in the Champions League and I enjoyed it a lot. I can't complain—these clubs have helped me grow, and I hope my time at Frankfurt will help me develop further."

Meski begitu, Piazon bertekad meraih posisi inti di Stamford Bridge atau mencari peluang di klub lain jika perlu.

"Sekarang saya masih duduk di bangku cadangan di Frankfurt, jadi cukup sulit untuk menunjukkan kemampuan," ujar pemain berusia 20 tahun itu kepada Goal. "Saya akan terus bekerja keras agar bisa membela Chelsea atau klub lain di masa depan."

Piazon, yang bergabung dengan Chelsea sejak 2011, pernah bermain sebagai pemain pinjaman di Malaga (La Liga) dan Vitesse (Eredivisie). Persaingan untuk menembus skuad utama Chelsea pun sangat berat, mengingat ada pemain-pemain seperti Eden Hazard, Oscar, Mohamed Salah, Willian, dan Andre Schurrle. Setelah kembali dari masa peminjaman, dia jadi kiper utama Chelsea, menggantikan Petr Cech. Saya masih muda dan harus berusaha keras—kalau saya tidak bisa main untuk Chelsea, saya akan bermain untuk klub lain."

Soal masa-masa peminjaman, Piazon menambahkan, "Di Belanda bersama Vitesse, kami sempat bersaing memperebutkan gelar juara. Di Spanyol bersama Malaga, saya sangat menikmati karena bisa tampil di Liga Champions. Saya tidak bisa mengeluh—klub-klub ini sangat membantu perkembangan saya, dan saya harap pengalaman di Frankfurt juga akan membuat saya semakin berkembang."

article_content: Manchester United star Angel di Maria demanded a higher salary to remain at Real Madrid, according to manager Carlo Ancelotti. The Bernabeu boss disclosed that the club declined to exceed its wage structure to keep the Argentine winger, who transferred to Old Trafford in a record £60 million deal this summer. Di Maria has made an impressive start for Louis van Gaal's side, scoring three Premier League goals in his first five matches. Carlo Ancelotti explained that although di Maria was a key part of Real Madrid's attacking line-up, the club's policies were the priority. 'I agreed with the club,' Ancelotti told Cadena COPE. 'Sometimes you have to say no. You can't change the club's guidelines for a single player. Di Maria asked for a lot of money and chose to leave to find it elsewhere. The club couldn't meet his demands.' Ancelotti, former Chelsea manager, also discussed the summer departures of Xabi Alonso and Diego Lopez. He said that Alonso requested to leave as he was a bit tired, and out of respect, the club allowed his transfer, especially with strong alternatives like Toni Kroos and James Rodriguez. 'He didn’t betray us.' Regarding Diego Lopez, Ancelotti said the goalkeeper left to join another major club with less competition for places, and the decision was his own. 'No one ever asked him to leave.' During his four seasons at Real Madrid, di Maria won the Champions League in his final year. He was among several stars—alongside Radamel Falcao—who joined Manchester United that summer. Ancelotti emphasized that he coaches for the club and not for individual players.

Di Maria tampil impresif untuk tim asuhan Louis van Gaal, mencetak tiga gol di Premier League dalam lima pertandingan pertamanya. Carlo Ancelotti menjelaskan bahwa meski di Maria adalah bagian penting dari lini serang Real Madrid, kebijakan klub tetap menjadi prioritas utama. 'Saya setuju dengan klub,' ujar Ancelotti kepada Cadena COPE. 'Terkadang, Anda harus berkata tidak. Anda tidak bisa mengubah pedoman klub hanya untuk satu pemain. Di Maria meminta banyak uang dan memilih pergi untuk mencarinya di tempat lain. Klub tidak bisa memenuhi permintaannya.' Ancelotti, mantan manajer Chelsea, juga membahas kepergian Xabi Alonso dan Diego Lopez di musim panas. Ia mengatakan Alonso meminta pergi karena merasa agak lelah, dan demi menghormatinya, klub mengizinkan transfernya, apalagi ada alternatif kuat seperti Toni Kroos dan James Rodriguez. 'Dia tidak mengkhianati kami.' Soal Diego Lopez, Ancelotti mengatakan kiper tersebut pergi untuk bergabung dengan klub besar lain yang kompetisinya lebih sedikit, dan keputusan itu benar-benar atas keinginannya sendiri. 'Tidak ada yang pernah memintanya pergi.' Selama empat musim di Real Madrid, di Maria memenangkan Liga Champions pada musim terakhirnya. Ia menjadi salah satu dari beberapa bintang, termasuk Radamel Falcao, yang datang ke Manchester United musim panas itu. Ancelotti menegaskan bahwa dirinya melatih untuk klub, bukan untuk individu pemain.

article_content: Georgina Taylor, a 22-year-old mother from Knaresborough, North Yorkshire, tragically lost her life while driving her 13-month-old son, Rory, to a modeling assignment. She had recently passed her driving test, only 15 days prior, and was reportedly traveling at around 85mph on the A627 motorway near Oldham, Greater Manchester, when she lost control of her silver BMW Mini Cooper on a bend, causing the vehicle to spin off the road and collide with a tree. Following the crash, passing motorists rescued Rory from his booster seat before the car caught fire, and fortunately he suffered only minor cuts and abrasions. Despite efforts to save her, Taylor died from her injuries. Investigators found that the car's tires were significantly deflated and mismatched, which likely hampered her ability to control the vehicle at high speed. Inexperience with motorway driving was also highlighted as a major contributing factor. The inquest shed light on Taylor's life, highlighting her achievements in dance, horseback riding, and academics. Her mother, Sally Taylor, spoke about her daughter's dedication, talent, and commitment to building a future for Rory as a young mother balancing studies and childcare. Eyewitnesses described the high-speed overtaking, loss of control, and the immediate aftermath, including the quick actions of recovery driver Shaun Pattinson, who rescued Rory from the wreckage as others worked to put out the fire. Coroner Simon Nelson determined that Taylor’s death resulted from a road traffic collision, citing excess speed and limited driving experience as key factors. He noted the remarkable survival of Rory and praised those who assisted at the scene. Rory, now 18 months old, is living with his grandparents and is still too young to understand his mother's passing.
translated_content: Georgina Taylor, seorang ibu muda berusia 22 tahun asal Knaresborough, North Yorkshire, meninggal dunia secara tragis saat mengantarkan putranya yang berusia 13 bulan, Rory, ke sesi pemotretan modeling. Ia baru saja lulus ujian mengemudi 15 hari sebelumnya, dan dilaporkan melaju sekitar 85mph di jalan tol A627 dekat Oldham, Greater Manchester ketika kehilangan kendali atas BMW Mini Cooper silver miliknya di tikungan sehingga mobil tergelincir dan menabrak pohon. Setelah kecelakaan, pengendara lain yang melintas berhasil menyelamatkan Rory dari car seat-nya sebelum mobil terbakar; beruntung, Rory hanya mengalami luka ringan dan lecet. Meski upaya penyelamatan sudah dilakukan, Taylor meninggal akibat luka-luka yang dideritanya. Hasil investigasi menemukan bahwa ban mobil Taylor sangat kempis dan tidak seragam, yang kemungkinan besar membuatnya sulit mengendalikan kendaraan di kecepatan tinggi. Pengalaman mengemudi yang masih minim, terutama di jalan tol, juga disebut sebagai faktor utama penyebab kecelakaan ini. Hasil penyelidikan juga menyoroti kehidupan Taylor, yang dikenal berprestasi di bidang tari, berkuda, dan akademik. Ibunya, Sally Taylor, menceritakan tentang dedikasi, bakat, serta komitmen Georgina dalam membangun masa depan untuk Rory, sambil membagi waktu sebagai mahasiswa dan ibu muda. Saksi mata menggambarkan Taylor menyalip kendaraan lain dengan kecepatan tinggi, kehilangan kendali, dan peristiwa setelah kecelakaan, termasuk aksi cepat pengemudi derek Shaun Pattinson yang menyelamatkan Rory dari reruntuhan, sementara orang-orang lain berusaha memadamkan api. Koroner Simon Nelson menyimpulkan kematian Taylor sebagai akibat kecelakaan lalu lintas, dengan menekankan kecepatan berlebih dan kurangnya pengalaman mengemudi sebagai faktor utama. Ia juga memuji tindakan para penolong dan menyebut selamatnya Rory sebagai sebuah keajaiban. Kini, Rory yang berusia 18 bulan tinggal bersama kakek-neneknya dan masih terlalu kecil untuk memahami kepergian ibunya.

article_content: My grandfather was from Germany, and he often shared stories about his beautiful hometown of Magdeburg, describing Germany as a tolerant place for Jews and its citizens—until one day it was not. My wife and her family are from Iran, and she often recounts how Iran was once a wonderful place for Jews—until one day it changed. I don't want to tell my future grandchildren that America was a flourishing home for Jews until one day—October 7, 2023—it was not. After recent, hate-driven tragedies like the murder of George Floyd, the Pulse nightclub massacre, the assaults on Asian-Americans in cities, and the calls for a Muslim ban, there was widespread public outrage. People from diverse backgrounds joined together to reject extremism. In contrast, following the brutal October 7, 2023, attacks in Israel, which left over 1,200 men, women, and children dead and marked the worst violence against Jews since the Holocaust, there was a noticeable silence. Now, there is a movement of people, on streets and campuses across the country, expressing support for Hamas, calling for the elimination of the Jewish state, and criticizing Israel for taking steps to defend itself from a terrorist organization. We are witnessing a moral failure among some leaders and members of society. While there are important exceptions, overall, standing up against hate seems less clear when Jews are the target. This is driven by antisemitism, often fueled by a form of moral relativism present in parts of the media, universities, and other institutions. Even prestigious institutions often struggle to confront antisemitism directly, sometimes issuing statements that condemn antisemitism only alongside other forms of bigotry. For example, the initial statement by the Stanford University President on Israel did not mention terrorism, and his follow-up barely acknowledged the rise in antisemitism on campus. Such responses can send a message, echoed by British commentator David Baddiel, that 'Jews don't count.' The tearing down of 'KIDNAPPED' posters highlighting hostages taken by Hamas also demonstrates how some people have become desensitized to the suffering of Jews, failing to recognize them as victims of war crimes. Currently, many people see it as fashionable to oppose Israel and support Hamas. The use of certain slogans, which may sound appealing, can actually be deeply antisemitic and serve to embolden violent acts. Instances of antisemitic violence are rising globally. In France, a Jewish woman was stabbed and a swastika was drawn on her door. In Los Angeles, a Jewish man was killed at a protest. According to the ADL, in the month after the October 7 attack, there were 832 antisemitic incidents in the U.S.—an increase of more than 315% compared to the previous year, averaging about 27 incidents per day. The U.K. saw a 537% increase and Brazil a 961% rise in reported incidents. A recent national survey found that about 70% of Americans see antisemitism as a growing problem, compared to 49% in 2022. The ADL also reported that 18% of Americans have witnessed antisemitism in their communities, up from 13% in the previous year. Jewish Americans are feeling threatened across the country—from high schools and universities to urban neighborhoods and suburbs. This is unacceptable and must be addressed, not by 'cancel culture,' but by engaging and educating those who may misunderstand the issues. Organizations like the ADL are working with schools, organizations, and communities to provide anti-bias education. For individuals or institutions that support or do not clearly condemn antisemitism, there needs to be accountability. History shows that periods of safety can end quickly, and we cannot be complacent. America is different, but we must actively work to preserve its values of tolerance and safety for all.
translated_content: Kakek saya berasal dari Jerman, dan ia sering bercerita tentang kota kelahirannya yang indah, Magdeburg, yang dulu merupakan tempat toleran bagi orang Yahudi dan warganya—hingga suatu hari semua berubah. Istri saya dan keluarganya berasal dari Iran, dan ia juga sering berkata bahwa Iran dulu adalah tempat yang menyenangkan bagi orang Yahudi—sampai suatu saat berubah. Saya tidak ingin cucu saya kelak mendengar bahwa Amerika pernah jadi rumah aman dan makmur bagi orang Yahudi, hingga pada 7 Oktober 2023 segalanya berubah. Setelah tragedi bermotif kebencian seperti pembunuhan George Floyd, penembakan massal di klub malam Pulse, serangan terhadap warga Asia-Amerika di kota-kota besar, serta seruan pelarangan Muslim, masyarakat luas menunjukkan kemarahan dan solidaritas. Orang-orang dari berbagai latar bersatu menolak ekstremisme. Sebaliknya, setelah serangan brutal pada 7 Oktober 2023 di Israel yang menewaskan lebih dari 1.200 orang—menjadi kekerasan terburuk terhadap Yahudi sejak Holocaust—terdapat keheningan yang nyata. Kini, banyak orang di jalan dan kampus mendukung Hamas, menyerukan penghapusan negara Yahudi, dan mengkritik Israel yang membela diri dari organisasi teroris. Kita sedang menyaksikan kegagalan moral dari sebagian pemimpin dan masyarakat. Walau ada pengecualian penting, secara umum, sikap melawan kebencian terlihat kurang jelas jika sasarannya adalah Yahudi. Ini didorong antisemitisme dan relativisme moral di media, kampus, serta institusi lain. Bahkan institusi ternama sering sulit mengecam antisemitisme secara langsung, kadang malah hanya jika disandingkan dengan bentuk kebencian lainnya. Contohnya, pernyataan awal Presiden Universitas Stanford tentang Israel tak menyebutkan terorisme, dan tindak lanjutnya pun kurang menyoroti peningkatan antisemitisme di kampus. Respons seperti ini seakan mengirim pesan—meminjam kata-kata komentator Inggris David Baddiel—'Yahudi tidak dihitung.' Aksi merobek poster 'KIDNAPPED' tentang sandera Hamas juga menunjukkan sebagian orang makin tidak peka pada penderitaan Yahudi, gagal melihat mereka sebagai korban kejahatan perang. Saat ini, banyak yang merasa ‘keren’ memusuhi Israel dan mendukung Hamas. Slogan-slogan yang terdengar catchy tapi sebenarnya antisemitisme berat justru mendorong aksi kekerasan. Insiden kekerasan antisemitisme melonjak secara global. Di Prancis, seorang wanita Yahudi diserang dan pintunya dicoret swastika. Di Los Angeles, seorang pria Yahudi tewas saat protes. Data ADL mencatat, sebulan setelah 7 Oktober, terdapat 832 insiden antisemitisme di AS—naik lebih dari 315% dari tahun lalu, rata-rata 27 kasus per hari. Inggris naik 537% dan Brasil 961%. Survei nasional terbaru menunjukkan sekitar 70% warga Amerika melihat antisemitisme sebagai masalah yang tumbuh, naik dari 49% di 2022. ADL juga melaporkan 18% warga menyaksikan sendiri kebencian pada Yahudi di komunitasnya, naik dari 13% tahun lalu. Orang Yahudi Amerika merasa terancam di banyak tempat—dari sekolah, kampus, hingga kota besar dan pinggiran. Ini tak bisa dibiarkan dan harus ditangani, bukan dengan 'cancel culture', tetapi dengan edukasi dan dialog bagi yang kurang mengerti. Organisasi seperti ADL terus bekerja sama dengan sekolah, organisasi, dan komunitas untuk pendidikan anti-bias. Bagi individu atau institusi yang tak jelas menentang antisemitisme, harus ada pertanggungjawaban. Sejarah menunjukkan masa aman dapat sirna tiba-tiba, jadi kita tak boleh lengah. Amerika berbeda, dan kita harus bekerja keras menjaga nilai toleransi dan keamanan untuk semua.

article_content: As the vacation season draws to a close, children return to school, sporting tans and smiles from their holidays. But not everyone enjoyed their dream trip. For example, Kristy McCloskey and her husband were stranded in Ecuador after a volcanic eruption covered the town in ash. CNN.com iReporters shared travel nightmares, showing even rainy days at the beach weren't so bad compared to their experiences. Here’s a look at some of the worst travel stories readers shared—though most laugh about the memories now. Bruce Bush’s family vacation to Hawaii started perfectly, with beautiful beaches and tropical weather. However, Bruce, 17, felt sick and was diagnosed with cancer at a Waikiki hospital just days before the family was to fly home. Doctors urged immediate treatment, but his parents waited to see their physician in Indiana. By their return, Bruce was already improving. His doctor confirmed it was mononucleosis—not cancer. Bruce only learned about the misdiagnosis after they got home. Donna Rogers and her family never reached their tropical getaway. Their Thanksgiving cruise to the Bahamas turned into a week stuck on a ship with engine trouble in Norfolk, Virginia. Passengers could visit a local mall or enjoy ship activities, but frustration grew, and the captain issued a mutiny warning as law enforcement boarded. The family eventually left to visit relatives in Virginia. The cruise line offered refunds and discounts, but Rogers is hesitant to cruise again. On their honeymoon, Kelly Flores and her husband faced Hurricane Georges. Their layover in Puerto Rico turned into an unexpected stay as the category-four storm arrived. Hotel guests sheltered in a ballroom as the hurricane struck. Afterward, the couple reached St. Lucia for a few extra days. Later, they learned another couple avoided the hurricane because their airline rerouted them via Miami. Flores described the ordeal as scarier than previous hurricanes she’d experienced at home. Other iReporters described similar woes. Mark O’Connor’s family endured two days of travel delays to Ireland, then faced flooding and illness. Kristy McCloskey and her husband wore face masks during their trip in Ecuador due to volcanic ash, which closed businesses and forced a three-day delay in their return. Summing it up, Donna Rogers said, 'We wanted a stress-free getaway, but right away, something went wrong.' Now, these travelers can laugh—at least a little—about their unforgettable vacations.
translated_content: Saat musim liburan berakhir, anak-anak kembali ke sekolah dengan kulit kecokelatan dan senyum hasil petualangan mereka. Namun, tidak semua orang menikmati liburannya. Kristy McCloskey dan suaminya, misalnya, terdampar di Ekuador setelah letusan gunung berapi menutupi kota dengan abu. Para iReporter CNN.com berbagi kisah liburan buruk, membuat hari hujan di pantai terasa menyenangkan jika dibandingkan dengan pengalaman mereka. Ini beberapa kisah liburan terburuk dari para pembaca—meski kini, sebagian besar bisa menertawakannya. Liburan keluarga Bruce Bush ke Hawaii awalnya berjalan sempurna, dengan pantai indah dan cuaca tropis. Namun, Bruce yang saat itu berusia 17 tahun merasa sakit dan didiagnosis kanker di rumah sakit Waikiki beberapa hari sebelum mereka pulang. Dokter meminta agar segera dirawat, tapi orang tuanya memilih menunggu dokter keluarga di Indiana. Saat kembali ke rumah, Bruce justru mulai membaik. Dokternya memastikan dia hanya terkena mononukleosis, bukan kanker. Bruce baru diberitahu soal salah diagnosis itu setelah sampai di rumah. Donna Rogers dan keluarganya malah tidak pernah sampai tujuan tropis mereka. Kapal pesiar untuk Thanksgiving ke Bahama terpaksa berhenti di Norfolk, Virginia, karena kerusakan mesin, dan mereka terjebak selama seminggu. Para penumpang hanya bisa ke mal lokal atau menikmati fasilitas kapal, tapi suasana makin tegang sampai kapten kapal memberi peringatan kemungkinan 'pemberontakan' dan polisi pun naik ke kapal. Akhirnya, keluarga Rogers memilih menginap di rumah kerabat di Virginia. Perusahaan kapal pesiar memberi pengembalian dana dan diskon untuk pelayaran selanjutnya, namun Rogers masih berpikir dua kali untuk naik kapal lagi. Saat bulan madu, Kelly Flores dan suaminya justru harus menghadapi Badai Georges. Transit di Puerto Rico, mereka ikut terjebak di tengah badai kategori empat. Para tamu hotel berlindung bersama di ballroom selama badai berlangsung. Setelah badai berlalu, pasangan ini baru bisa ke St. Lucia dan menginap beberapa hari ekstra. Dalam perjalanan pulang, mereka tahu ada pasangan lain yang dialihkan melalui Miami sehingga tidak terjebak badai. Flores bilang, pengalaman ini lebih menakutkan dibanding badai di kampung halamannya. Cerita serupa juga dialami iReporter lain. Keluarga Mark O’Connor mengalami keterlambatan dua hari saat ke Irlandia, lalu terkena banjir dan sakit. Kristy McCloskey dan suaminya pun harus memakai masker sepanjang liburan di Ekuador karena abu vulkanik, hingga banyak bisnis tutup dan kepulangan mereka tertunda tiga hari. Donna Rogers merangkum semuanya: 'Kami cuma ingin liburan santai, tapi sejak awal selalu ada saja masalah.' Kini, kisah liburan penuh stres ini bisa mereka kenang dan tertawakan—meski hanya sedikit.

article_content: When you’re a patient, you trust that you’re in good hands. However, even the most skilled doctors and nurses can make mistakes affecting you or your loved ones. “Mistakes are happening every day in every hospital in the country that we’re just not catching,” says Dr. Albert Wu, an internist at Johns Hopkins Hospital. In the United States, medical errors cause over 250,000 deaths annually and injure millions. According to Dr. Peter Pronovost, an anesthesiologist and critical care physician at Johns Hopkins, when combined, these errors are likely the third leading cause of death in the country. Most of this harm is avoidable, and there are steps you can take to help healthcare providers reduce the risk of mistakes. Here are 10 shocking medical mistakes, along with ways to protect yourself:  1. Mistake: Treating the wrong patient    • Cause: Hospital staff do not properly verify patient identity.    • Consequence: Patients with similar names are confused for one another.    • Prevention: Before any procedure, ensure staff check your full name, date of birth, and the barcode on your wristband.    • Example: Kerry Higuera.  2. Mistake: Surgical items left inside a patient    • Cause: Surgical staff miscount or fail to count equipment during operations.    • Consequence: Tools are left inside the body.    • Prevention: If you experience unusual pain, fever, or swelling after surgery, ask if a surgical instrument might have been left inside you.    • Example: Nelson Bailey.  3. Mistake: Lost patients    • Cause: Patients with dementia may wander away.    • Consequence: Such patients can become trapped and risk dehydration or hypothermia.    • Prevention: If your loved one is prone to wandering, consider a GPS tracking bracelet.    • Example: Mary Cole.  4. Mistake: Fake doctors    • Cause: Impostors posing as licensed physicians.    • Consequence: Incorrect medical treatments can worsen patients’ conditions.    • Prevention: Verify your physician’s license online.    • Example: Sarafina Gerling.  5. Mistake: Emergency room delays    • Cause: Overcrowded hospitals can create backups in ERs.    • Consequence: Patients’ conditions may deteriorate while waiting.    • Prevention: Before arriving at the hospital, call your doctor and ask them to notify the ER.    • Example: Malyia Jeffers.  6. Mistake: Air bubbles entering the blood    • Cause: A chest wound is not properly sealed after a tube is removed.    • Consequence: Air can enter the wound and block blood flow to vital organs, which can be fatal if untreated.    • Prevention: If you have a central line or chest tube, ask about the correct positioning when it is removed.    • Example: Blake Fought.  7. Mistake: Surgery on the wrong body part    • Cause: Errors in charts or misreading by surgical staff; surgical drapes obscure surgical marks.    • Consequence: Surgery is performed on the wrong side or body part.    • Prevention: Confirm with your nurse and surgeon the correct site and side before your surgery.    • Example: Jesse Matlock.  8. Mistake: Hospital-acquired infections    • Cause: Healthcare workers do not wash their hands.    • Consequence: Patients may develop serious infections.    • Prevention: Ask your healthcare providers to wash their hands before touching you, even if wearing gloves.    • Example: Josh Nahum.  9. Mistake: Confusing lookalike tubes    • Cause: Tubes for different purposes (such as feeding and chest tubes) look similar.    • Consequence: Medication intended for the stomach may go into the chest.    • Prevention: If you have multiple tubes, ask staff to check each one’s point of origin before administering medicine.    • Example: Alicia Coleman.  10. Mistake: Waking up during surgery    • Cause: Insufficient anesthesia.    • Consequence: The brain remains aware while the body is paralyzed; some patients feel sensations or pain.    • Prevention: Ask whether general anesthesia is necessary for your procedure, or if a local anesthetic may be sufficient.    • Example: Erin Cook.  Have you experienced a medical error? Share your story in the comments below.
translated_content: Saat menjadi pasien, Anda pasti berharap berada di tangan yang tepat. Namun, bahkan dokter dan perawat paling terampil pun bisa melakukan kesalahan yang berdampak pada Anda atau orang yang Anda cintai. “Kesalahan terjadi setiap hari di setiap rumah sakit di negara ini dan kita sering tidak menyadarinya,” kata Dr. Albert Wu, seorang internis di Johns Hopkins Hospital. Di Amerika Serikat, kesalahan medis menyebabkan lebih dari 250.000 kematian setiap tahun dan melukai jutaan orang. Menurut Dr. Peter Pronovost, ahli anestesi dan dokter perawatan intensif di Johns Hopkins, jika dijumlahkan, kesalahan ini kemungkinan menjadi penyebab kematian ketiga terbanyak di negara tersebut. Sebagian besar dampak ini bisa dicegah, dan ada langkah-langkah yang dapat Anda ambil untuk membantu tenaga medis mengurangi risiko kesalahan. Berikut 10 kesalahan medis yang mengejutkan, beserta cara untuk melindungi diri Anda:  1. Kesalahan: Menangani pasien yang salah    • Penyebab: Staf rumah sakit tidak memverifikasi identitas pasien dengan benar.    • Akibat: Pasien dengan nama serupa bisa tertukar.    • Pencegahan: Sebelum tindakan apa pun, pastikan staf memeriksa nama lengkap, tanggal lahir, dan barcode pada gelang rumah sakit Anda.    • Contoh: Kerry Higuera.  2. Kesalahan: Peralatan bedah tertinggal di dalam tubuh    • Penyebab: Staf bedah salah menghitung atau lupa menghitung instrumen selama operasi.    • Akibat: Alat tertinggal di dalam tubuh.    • Pencegahan: Jika Anda merasakan nyeri, demam, atau bengkak yang tidak wajar setelah operasi, tanyakan apakah ada kemungkinan alat bedah tertinggal di tubuh Anda.    • Contoh: Nelson Bailey.  3. Kesalahan: Pasien hilang    • Penyebab: Pasien dengan demensia dapat berkeliaran sendiri.    • Akibat: Pasien bisa tersesat dan berisiko dehidrasi atau hipotermia.    • Pencegahan: Jika orang terdekat Anda suka berkeliaran, pertimbangkan gelang pelacak GPS.    • Contoh: Mary Cole.  4. Kesalahan: Dokter palsu    • Penyebab: Penipu berpura-pura menjadi dokter.    • Akibat: Perawatan medis salah memperburuk kondisi pasien.    • Pencegahan: Pastikan izin dokter Anda valid dengan mengeceknya secara online.    • Contoh: Sarafina Gerling.  5. Kesalahan: Penundaan di ruang gawat darurat    • Penyebab: Rumah sakit yang penuh membuat IGD membludak.    • Akibat: Kondisi pasien memburuk saat menunggu.    • Pencegahan: Sebelum ke rumah sakit, hubungi dokter Anda dan minta mereka memberitahu IGD.    • Contoh: Malyia Jeffers.  6. Kesalahan: Gelembung udara masuk darah    • Penyebab: Luka di dada tidak ditutup rapat setelah tabung dilepas.    • Akibat: Udara bisa masuk ke luka dan menghambat aliran darah ke organ vital, bisa berakibat fatal jika tidak segera diperbaiki.    • Pencegahan: Jika Anda memakai central line atau chest tube, tanyakan posisi tubuh saat tabung dilepas.    • Contoh: Blake Fought.  7. Kesalahan: Operasi pada bagian tubuh yang salah    • Penyebab: Kesalahan di catatan medis atau karena staf bedah salah membaca; kain operasi bisa menutupi tanda lokasi operasi.    • Akibat: Operasi dilakukan di sisi atau bagian tubuh yang salah.    • Pencegahan: Pastikan lagi bersama perawat dan dokter bedah lokasi dan sisi operasi sebelum tindakan.    • Contoh: Jesse Matlock.  8. Kesalahan: Infeksi di rumah sakit    • Penyebab: Tenaga medis tidak mencuci tangan.    • Akibat: Pasien berisiko terkena infeksi berat.    • Pencegahan: Jangan sungkan meminta petugas medis mencuci tangan sebelum menyentuh Anda, walau memakai sarung tangan.    • Contoh: Josh Nahum.  9. Kesalahan: Salah memasukkan obat lewat selang    • Penyebab: Selang dengan fungsi berbeda (seperti feeding tube dan chest tube) tampak serupa.    • Akibat: Obat untuk lambung malah masuk ke paru-paru/dada.    • Pencegahan: Jika punya banyak selang, minta staf selalu cek asal setiap selang sebelum memberikan obat.    • Contoh: Alicia Coleman.  10. Kesalahan: Terbangun saat operasi    • Penyebab: Dosis anestesi kurang.    • Akibat: Otak tetap sadar saat tubuh lumpuh; sebagian pasien bisa merasakan sakit.    • Pencegahan: Tanyakan apakah prosedur Anda membutuhkan anestesi umum atau lokal sudah cukup.    • Contoh: Erin Cook.  Pernah mengalami kesalahan medis? Ceritakan pengalaman Anda di kolom komentar.
