article_content: Honda is recalling several hundred thousand 2023 and 2024 Accord and HR-V vehicles after finding that some may be missing a critical part in the front seat belt pretensioners. The missing rivet, due to an assembly issue, could cause the seat belt system to work improperly in a crash, elevating the risk of injury, according to Honda and the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA). The recall covers about 300,000 Accord sedans and HR-V SUVs, but Honda estimates fewer than 1% of these vehicles actually have the defect. Owners can have their cars checked at Honda dealerships and, if necessary, get the faulty part replaced at no cost. Honda will begin mailing notification letters to affected owners on January 8. The NHTSA says there have been no reported injuries or deaths linked to this issue since production began in April 2022. This recall follows a recent action by Honda earlier this month, when almost 250,000 vehicles were recalled due to a different problem that could cause engines to stall.

Rivet yang hilang akibat masalah perakitan ini bisa membuat sistem sabuk pengaman tidak bekerja semestinya saat kecelakaan, sehingga meningkatkan risiko cedera, menurut Honda dan Badan Administrasi Keselamatan Lalu Lintas Jalan Raya Nasional (NHTSA). Penarikan ini mencakup sekitar 300.000 sedan Accord dan SUV HR-V, namun Honda memperkirakan kurang dari 1% kendaraan benar-benar memiliki cacat itu. Pemilik bisa memeriksakan mobil ke dealer Honda dan, jika diperlukan, mendapatkan penggantian bagian yang bermasalah secara gratis. Honda akan mulai mengirim surat pemberitahuan kepada pemilik yang terdampak mulai 8 Januari. NHTSA menyebutkan belum ada laporan cedera atau kematian terkait masalah ini sejak produksi dimulai April 2022. Penarikan ini mengikuti recall Honda sebelumnya awal bulan ini terhadap hampir 250.000 kendaraan akibat masalah berbeda yang bisa menyebabkan mesin mati saat berkendara.

article_content: Tata Technologies, a subsidiary of Tata Motors specializing in engineering and digital product development services, has revealed plans to launch its initial public offering (IPO). The subscription period for the IPO will run from November 22 to November 24, 2023. Regulatory filings show that Tata Technologies will put up approximately 60.85 million shares for sale, representing 15% of its paid-up equity. Within this, Tata Motors is set to sell 11.4% of its stake, Alpha TC Holdings 2.4%, and Tata Capital Growth Fund I 1.2%. Earlier, Tata Motors had agreed to sell a 9.9% stake in Tata Technologies to TPG Rise Climate for Rs 1,613.7 crore. Following this news, Tata Motors’ stock price on the BSE finished nearly flat at Rs 653.10 per share.

Menurut dokumen resmi, Tata Technologies akan menawarkan sekitar 60,85 juta saham kepada publik, setara dengan 15% dari total modal disetor. Dari jumlah ini, Tata Motors akan melepas 11,4% kepemilikan, Alpha TC Holdings sebesar 2,4%, dan Tata Capital Growth Fund I sebesar 1,2%. Sebelumnya, Tata Motors telah sepakat menjual 9,9% saham Tata Technologies kepada TPG Rise Climate senilai Rp 1.613,7 crore. article_content: David Wilson, an ice-cream van driver in Ripley, Derbyshire, was banned from driving along Bridge Yard Avenue after verbally abusing neighbors who raised concerns about the loud music from his van. Several residents complained that the chimes sounded as loud as a police siren inside their homes. Paul Cooper described confronting Wilson to ask him to reduce the noise, but Wilson responded with rude language and dismissive comments, insisting nothing could be done. Reports also indicate Wilson made offensive gestures toward a mother and daughter and insulted another neighbor. In court, he was convicted of using threatening language and behavior during the November incident. At Derby Crown Court, Wilson received a £945 fine and a two-year ban from the street. Evidence from the council showed his van’s chimes reached 84 decibels, similar to a freight train. Wilson denied the allegations but appealed unsuccessfully. Judge Andrew Hamilton and the magistrates upheld the conviction, determining that the residents, particularly Mr. and Mrs. Cooper, were credible witnesses.

Beberapa warga mengeluh bahwa suara chime van Wilson terdengar sekeras sirene polisi di dalam rumah mereka. Paul Cooper menceritakan bahwa ia menegur Wilson agar mengecilkan suara musik, namun Wilson membalas dengan kata-kata kasar dan sikap tak sopan, bersikeras bahwa tidak ada yang bisa dilakukan. Laporan juga menyebutkan Wilson membuat gestur tidak sopan kepada seorang ibu dan putrinya serta menghina tetangga lain. Di pengadilan, ia dinyatakan bersalah atas penggunaan bahasa dan perilaku mengancam dalam insiden bulan November. Di Derby Crown Court, Wilson dijatuhi denda sebesar £945 dan dilarang mengemudi di jalan tersebut selama dua tahun. Bukti dari dewan kota menunjukkan suara chime van-nya mencapai 84 desibel, setara suara kereta barang. Wilson membantah tuduhan tersebut namun gagal dalam bandingnya. Hakim Andrew Hamilton dan para hakim menolak permohonan bandingnya dan menilai para warga, terutama Pak dan Bu Cooper, sebagai saksi yang dapat dipercaya.

SM Entertainment, a leading force in K-pop, is joining hands with London-based Moon&Back Media to launch a search for the next UK boy band aimed at entertaining global audiences. The entire process will be captured in a television series, which is set to start filming in London in early 2024 and will follow the group's formation over six months. The series' executive producers include James McKinlay (X Factor, America’s Got Talent), David Hall (Deal or No Deal, The Chase, The Greatest Dancer), and music executive Ben Karter. This collaboration is seen as a pioneering partnership between leading South Korean and British entertainment companies.

SM Entertainment, known for launching global acts such as NCT, aespa, SuperM, Red Velvet, and RIIZE, is leveraging its international reach as it expands further into European and American markets. Joseph Chang (Jang Yoon-jung), CEO of Kakao Entertainment America, emphasized that this project marks SM’s first major move into Europe, with plans to continue expanding its global operations.

Moon&Back Media was established by BAFTA award-winning producer Nigel Hall, British media executive Dawn Airey, and talent manager Russ Lindsay. In September 2023, the company received investment from Asylum Entertainment Group. Dawn Airey highlighted the groundbreaking nature of collaborating with SM Entertainment and anticipates that the combination of British and K-pop expertise will create compelling television and a boy band with worldwide appeal. Currently, the unnamed series is in pre-production with planned filming in both the UK and South Korea.

Senator John McCain strongly criticized President Barack Obama on Monday for statements suggesting that U.S. intelligence underestimated ISIS. On CBS's '60 Minutes,' Obama acknowledged shortcomings in U.S. assessments of ISIS's strength. Responding on CNN's 'New Day,' McCain argued that the rise of ISIS in Syria and Iraq was the result of Obama's decision to withdraw all U.S. troops from Iraq and his reluctance to arm moderate Syrian rebels, despite advice from national security advisers. "We predicted this outcome and observed it unfold," McCain said, likening the situation to watching a train wreck in slow motion.

Obama, in the '60 Minutes' interview aired Sunday, admitted Syria had become a hotspot for global jihadists and conceded the U.S. overestimated the capability of Iraqi security forces. McCain, a Republican from Arizona, also criticized Congress for recessing before the November midterm elections without voting on military action in Syria. "It's an act of cowardice on Congress's part," McCain stated. "They didn't want to vote before the election."

After the early adjournment, House Speaker John Boehner told ABC News he would willingly call the House back into session for a vote if Obama submitted a resolution regarding military action. "I'd bring the Congress back," Boehner said. Additionally, Rep. Ed Royce, chairman of the House Foreign Affairs Committee, blamed Obama for what he described as a 'political failure' and stressed that the president should lay out a clear strategy for dealing with ISIS: "We have given him those tools."

McCain reiterated calls for action against Syrian President Bashar al-Assad's regime, advocating for a no-fly zone over Syria and suggesting the U.S. should target Assad's air force if Syrian planes continue to fly. McCain noted that Obama already has the authority to strike Assad's forces without additional congressional approval, calling inaction "immoral."

Furthermore, McCain questioned the administration's strategy of training 5,000 Free Syrian Army fighters in Saudi Arabia to combat ISIS but not Assad, arguing that expecting them to fight ISIS without opposing Assad was both impractical and unethical. McCain and Senator Lindsey Graham, another leading proponent, first advocated for a no-fly zone in Syria in 2013, during discussions about potential U.S. military intervention against Assad—a leader McCain holds responsible for the deaths of 192,000 Syrians.

Finally, McCain agreed with the Obama administration's stance that the United States is at war with ISIS, though a recent CNN/ORC International poll indicates only 40% of Americans share this view. "Of course, we are," McCain said.

Menanggapi di CNN 'New Day', McCain berpendapat bahwa kemunculan ISIS di Suriah dan Irak disebabkan oleh keputusan Obama menarik semua pasukan AS dari Irak dan keengganannya untuk mempersenjatai pemberontak Suriah moderat, meski telah disarankan oleh penasihat keamanan nasionalnya. "Kami sudah memprediksi hasil ini dan melihatnya terjadi," kata McCain, mengibaratkan situasi ini seperti menyaksikan kecelakaan kereta api secara perlahan.

Pada wawancara '60 Minutes' yang tayang Minggu, Obama mengakui Suriah telah menjadi pusat utama jihad global dan membenarkan bahwa AS telah melebih-lebihkan kemampuan pasukan keamanan Irak. McCain, senator dari Partai Republik asal Arizona, juga mengkritik Kongres karena reses sebelum pemilu paruh waktu November tanpa voting mengenai aksi militer di Suriah. Setelah sidang ditutup lebih awal, Ketua DPR John Boehner menyampaikan kepada ABC News bahwa ia siap memanggil kembali anggota DPR untuk voting jika Obama mengajukan resolusi aksi militer. "Saya akan mengembalikan Kongres," kata Boehner. Selain itu, Rep. Ed Royce, ketua Komite Urusan Luar Negeri DPR, menyalahkan Obama atas apa yang disebutnya 'kegagalan politik' dan menegaskan bahwa presiden harus menyusun strategi yang jelas untuk menangani ISIS: "Kami sudah memberinya alat tersebut."

McCain kembali menyerukan tindakan terhadap rezim Presiden Suriah Bashar al-Assad, mendorong diterapkannya zona larangan terbang di Suriah, serta menyarankan AS menargetkan angkatan udara Assad jika pesawat Suriah tetap beroperasi. McCain dan Senator Lindsey Graham, pendukung lainnya, pertama kali mendorong zona larangan terbang di Suriah pada 2013 saat mempertimbangkan kemungkinan intervensi militer AS terhadap Assad—yang menurut McCain bertanggung jawab atas kematian 192.000 warga Suriah.

Akhirnya, McCain sepakat dengan sikap pemerintahan Obama bahwa AS sedang berperang dengan ISIS, meski survei CNN/ORC International terbaru menunjukkan hanya 40% warga Amerika yang sependapat. "Tentu saja, kita sedang berperang," kata McCain.

article_content: President Joe Biden, on Wednesday, contrasted his economic vision with that of 'MAGA Republicans,' including Representative Lauren Boebert, during a visit to her Colorado district. In his speech, Biden promoted the Inflation Reduction Act, promising that it would bring jobs to the local community while criticizing Boebert. He described her as 'one of the leaders of this extreme MAGA movement.' Biden criticized Boebert for voting against his legislative agenda and for calling the bipartisan infrastructure law 'garbage' and 'a scam.' 'She, along with every single Republican colleague, voted against the law that made these investments in jobs possible,' Biden said. 'And then she voted to repeal key parts of this law, and she called this law a massive failure. You all know you’re part of a massive failure? Tell that to the 850 Coloradans who got new jobs. That sounds like a failure in thinking by the congresswoman and her colleagues.' Biden and Boebert have clashed in the past, and his trip to her conservative district came as she faces a difficult reelection bid in 2024. Earlier this year, Democrat Adam Frisch—who narrowly lost to Boebert in the 2022 midterm elections—announced he would again campaign to unseat her in 2024. Ahead of Biden’s visit, Boebert criticized him in a statement. 'Families in Colorado’s 3rd Congressional District are being impacted by so-called ‘Bidenomics.’ Under Joe Biden, credit card debt, inflation, groceries, and gas prices have all reached record highs. These prices are hurting working-class Coloradans and rural America,' Boebert said. She continued, 'Instead of promoting the Inflation Reduction Act—which mandates Green New Deal policies and costs taxpayers hundreds of billions of dollars—Joe Biden should work with me to get my Pueblo Jobs Act signed into law. This would create 1,000 new jobs in Pueblo and help revitalize Southern Colorado’s economy.' The president and Boebert have been at odds before. In 2022, Boebert interrupted Biden’s State of the Union address as he honored members of the armed forces affected by burn pits, including his late son Beau Biden. Boebert shouted, 'You put them there—13 of them,' referring to service members killed during the withdrawal from Afghanistan. Boebert also drew negative headlines in September when she was escorted out of a Denver production of 'Beetlejuice: The Musical,' after complaints of vaping and causing a disturbance. During his speech, Biden emphasized the benefits Colorado has seen from the Inflation Reduction Act, the CHIPS and Science Act, and the bipartisan infrastructure law, while criticizing House Republicans. 'We haven’t gotten a whole lot of help from some members of Congress on the other side of the aisle,' he noted. He continued, 'The speaker, Donald Trump, and the MAGA Republicans in Congress are committed to protecting large tax cuts for the wealthiest, and they oppose investing in education, health care, and other programs that help people. I have a different view.' Biden's visit to Pueblo continued an approach of bringing his argument to Republican-held districts. Over the past year, he has visited districts in South Carolina, New York, and Virginia to highlight lawmakers who have opposed his domestic agenda. However, a recent Gallup poll showed only 32% approval of Biden’s handling of the economy. As the Republican presidential primary progresses, Biden has intensified criticism of former President Trump and 'MAGA Republican' allies, warning that they are 'determined to destroy this democracy.' During his speech, Biden mentioned that Speaker Mike Johnson and Rep. Vern Buchanan visited Sarasota, Florida, to celebrate a new airport terminal funded by the infrastructure law, even though they voted against it. 'Both the speaker and the congressman voted against and spoke against the law—but now they’re taking credit for it,' said Biden. Biden’s trip to Pueblo was originally scheduled as part of his 'Invest in America' tour but was postponed after the October 7 Hamas attack on Israel, as the president attended national security meetings and visited Israel. While in Pueblo, Biden visited CS Wind, the world’s largest wind tower manufacturer, highlighting a $200 million expansion attributed to the Inflation Reduction Act. A new Treasury Department report shows that 14 investments totaling $985.5 million have been announced in Colorado since the law’s passage, with 99% of funds going to counties with below-average wages. The administration also touted investments in the district, including a new solar field, expanded high-speed internet, a Main Street revitalization project in Delta, Colorado, and a pipeline project funded by the Inflation Reduction Act and Bipartisan Infrastructure Law. An official told CNN, 'These investments and jobs wouldn’t be possible without President Biden and Congressional Democrats. It’s important for Americans to know that if Republicans in Congress—including Representative Lauren Boebert—undermine these efforts, their communities lose out.' Correction: This story has been updated to identify Rep. Boebert’s 2024 opponent as Adam Frisch. CNN’s Betsy Klein contributed to this report.

Dalam pidatonya, Biden mempromosikan Inflation Reduction Act, menjanjikan bahwa kebijakan itu akan membawa lapangan kerja ke komunitas lokal sambil mengkritik Boebert. Ia menyebut Boebert sebagai 'salah satu pemimpin gerakan MAGA yang ekstrem.' Biden mengkritik Boebert karena memilih menentang agenda legislasinya dan menyebut undang-undang infrastruktur bipartisan sebagai 'sampah' dan 'penipuan.' Biden dan Boebert sudah sering berselisih, dan kunjungannya ke daerah konservatif ini terjadi ketika Boebert menghadapi pemilihan ulang yang sulit pada 2024. Awal tahun ini, Demokrat Adam Frisch — yang hampir mengalahkan Boebert pada pemilu paruh waktu 2022 — mengumumkan dirinya akan kembali mencalonkan diri untuk mengalahkan Boebert pada 2024. Menjelang kunjungan Biden, Boebert mengkritiknya dalam pernyataan. 'Keluarga di Distrik Kongres ke-3 Colorado terdampak oleh apa yang disebut ‘Bidenomics.’ Di bawah Joe Biden, utang kartu kredit, inflasi, harga sembako dan bensin mencapai rekor tertinggi. Harga tinggi ini menekan warga kelas pekerja Colorado dan Amerika pedesaan,' kata Boebert. Dia melanjutkan, 'Alih-alih mempromosikan Inflation Reduction Act — yang mewajibkan kebijakan Green New Deal dan membebani wajib pajak ratusan miliar dolar — Joe Biden seharusnya bekerja sama dengan saya agar Pueblo Jobs Act disahkan menjadi undang-undang yang akan menciptakan 1.000 pekerjaan baru di Pueblo dan membantu menghidupkan kembali ekonomi Colorado Selatan.' Presiden dan Boebert sudah sering berselisih sebelumnya. Pada 2022, Boebert memotong pidato Biden saat State of the Union ketika ia menghormati anggota tentara yang terpapar asap beracun, termasuk mendiang putranya Beau Biden. Boebert berteriak, 'Anda yang menempatkan mereka di sana—13 di antaranya,' merujuk pada tentara yang tewas saat penarikan pasukan dari Afghanistan. Boebert juga menjadi sorotan negatif pada bulan September ketika dirinya dikeluarkan dari pertunjukan 'Beetlejuice: The Musical' di Denver, setelah ada keluhan karena vaping dan membuat keributan. Dalam pidatonya, Biden menyoroti manfaat yang telah dirasakan Colorado dari Inflation Reduction Act, CHIPS and Science Act, serta undang-undang infrastruktur bipartisan, sambil mengkritik Partai Republik di DPR. 'Kami tidak banyak mendapat bantuan dari anggota Kongres di sisi berlawanan,' ujarnya. Ia melanjutkan, 'Speaker, Donald Trump, dan para MAGA Republican di Kongres berkomitmen untuk melindungi pemotongan pajak bagi yang terkaya, dan mereka menolak investasi di bidang pendidikan, kesehatan, dan program-program yang membantu masyarakat. Saya punya pandangan yang berbeda.' Kunjungan Biden ke Pueblo melanjutkan pendekatannya untuk 'mendatangi langsung' distrik Partai Republik. Selama setahun terakhir, dia telah berkunjung ke distrik di South Carolina, New York, dan Virginia untuk menyoroti anggota legislatif yang menentang agenda domestiknya. Namun, jajak pendapat Gallup baru-baru ini menunjukkan hanya 32% yang menyetujui penanganan ekonomi oleh Biden. Seiring makin ketatnya persaingan calon presiden Republik, Biden semakin sering mengkritik mantan Presiden Trump dan sekutunya di Kongres, memperingatkan mereka 'bertekad menghancurkan demokrasi ini.' Dalam pidatonya, Biden menyebut bahwa Speaker Mike Johnson dan Rep. Vern Buchanan mengunjungi Sarasota, Florida, untuk merayakan terminal bandara baru yang didanai oleh undang-undang infrastruktur, meski mereka menentangnya. 'Speaker dan anggota Kongres itu memilih serta bicara menentang undang-undang itu—tapi kini mereka mengklaim keberhasilannya,' kata Biden. Kunjungan Biden ke Pueblo awalnya dijadwalkan sebagai bagian dari tur 'Invest in America'-nya, namun ditunda setelah serangan Hamas 7 Oktober di Israel. Presiden menghadiri rapat keamanan nasional dan kemudian mengunjungi Israel. Saat di Pueblo, Biden mengunjungi CS Wind, produsen menara angin terbesar di dunia, menyoroti ekspansi $200 juta yang dikaitkan pada Inflation Reduction Act. Laporan terbaru Departemen Keuangan menunjukkan ada 14 investasi senilai total $985,5 juta diumumkan di Colorado sejak undang-undang itu berlaku, dengan 99% dana mengalir ke wilayah berpendapatan di bawah rata-rata. Pemerintahan Biden juga menyoroti investasi di distrik tersebut, seperti ladang surya baru, perluasan internet berkecepatan tinggi, revitalisasi Main Street di Delta, dan proyek pipa yang didanai oleh Inflation Reduction Act dan Bipartisan Infrastructure Law. Seorang pejabat mengatakan kepada CNN, 'Investasi dan pekerjaan ini tidak akan mungkin tanpa Presiden Biden dan Demokrat di Kongres. Penting bagi masyarakat tahu jika Partai Republik di Kongres—termasuk Lauren Boebert—menghalangi inisiatif ini, komunitas mereka sendiri yang kehilangan peluang.' Koreksi: Cerita ini telah diperbarui untuk menyebut Adam Frisch sebagai penantang Boebert pada 2024. Betsy Klein dari CNN berkontribusi pada laporan ini.

article_content: Shiv Sena (UBT) leader Sanjay Raut criticized the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) for using Lord Ram and the Ram Mandir as part of its election campaign in five states. During a public rally in Raghogarh, Guna, Home Minister Amit Shah promised that the BJP would cover the cost for people to visit Lord Ram Lalla in Madhya Pradesh if the party forms the government. In response, Raut questioned, 'I have read Amit Shah’s statement. He announced that if the BJP forms the government in Madhya Pradesh, citizens will be provided free darshan of Ram Lalla. Lord Ram is revered across the country and the world, but the way Ram Lalla is being promoted in the election campaign suggests that if the BJP loses, the opportunity to visit Ram Lalla would be restricted. What kind of politics is this?' The Ram Mandir has become central in BJP’s election messaging. Both Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Home Minister Amit Shah have accused the Congress Party of delaying the construction of the Ram Mandir in Ayodhya. Raut further added, 'The BJP should apologize for the way these issues are being raised in the campaign. Have you become the owner or agent of Ram Lalla? If the Election Commission is truly active, it should take action.' Meanwhile, Home Minister Amit Shah accused Congress of hindering temple construction and disrespecting Indian culture. He said, 'The Congress party has always insulted our pilgrimage sites and Indian culture. Narendra Modi built the Ram temple in Ayodhya, developed the Kashi Vishwanath corridor, and developed Baba Mahakal's Lok and the golden Somnath temple. The Prime Minister also revived Badrinath Dham and Kedarnath Dham.' Shah also stated that Ram Lalla was in a 'humiliated state' for 550 years, and alleged that Congress delayed the construction of Ram Mandir for 70 years. 'You made Modi ji the Prime Minister; he performed the Bhoomi Pujan of the Ram temple and now it is being built in Ayodhya,' Shah said. On the INDIA bloc, Raut commented that following the assembly elections in five states, alliance leaders will meet again to discuss complaints. 'Some things have happened during the assembly elections, but the INDIA Alliance has been formed for the Lok Sabha elections,' he explained. Separately, India's Income Tax Department is investigating local subsidiaries of Apple, Google, and Amazon regarding possible non-payment of taxes, particularly in connection with transfer pricing practices. The probe reportedly began in 2021. Indians have become the largest real estate investors in the Dubai property market, significantly influencing the city’s real estate landscape. Digital payments platform Razorpay plans to relocate its parent company from the US to India via a cross-border merger, which could involve a US tax payment of $250–300 million.

Dalam rapat umum di Raghogarh, Guna, Menteri Dalam Negeri Amit Shah menjanjikan bahwa BJP akan menanggung biaya bagi masyarakat yang ingin berkunjung ke Ram Lalla di Madhya Pradesh jika partai tersebut membentuk pemerintahan. Raut juga menambahkan, 'BJP seharusnya meminta maaf atas cara isu-isu ini diangkat dalam kampanye. Apakah Anda telah menjadi pemilik atau agen Ram Lalla? Jika Komisi Pemilihan benar-benar aktif, seharusnya ada tindakan.' Di sisi lain, Amit Shah menuduh Kongres menghambat pembangunan kuil dan tidak menghormati budaya India. Ia mengatakan, 'Partai Kongres selalu menghina tempat ziarah dan budaya kita. Narendra Modi membangun kuil Ram di Ayodhya, mengembangkan koridor Kashi Vishwanath, serta membangun Lok Baba Mahakal dan kuil Somnath yang berlapis emas. Perdana Menteri juga menghidupkan kembali Badrinath Dham dan Kedarnath Dham.' Shah juga menyatakan bahwa Ram Lalla berada dalam 'keadaan terhina' selama 550 tahun, dan menuduh Kongres menunda pembangunan Ram Mandir selama 70 tahun. 'Kalian memilih Modi ji sebagai Perdana Menteri; beliau melakukan Bhoomi Pujan kuil Ram dan sekarang kuil itu sedang dibangun di Ayodhya,' kata Shah. Mengenai aliansi INDIA, Raut menyatakan bahwa setelah pemilu di lima negara bagian selesai, para pemimpin aliansi akan kembali bertemu untuk membahas keluhan. 'Ada beberapa kejadian selama pemilu legislatif, namun Aliansi INDIA dibentuk untuk pemilu Lok Sabha,' jelasnya. Secara terpisah, Departemen Pajak Penghasilan India sedang menyelidiki anak perusahaan Apple, Google, dan Amazon di India terkait kemungkinan pelanggaran pembayaran pajak, khususnya terkait praktik transfer pricing. Penyelidikan ini dilaporkan dimulai pada 2021. Warga negara India kini menjadi investor properti terbesar di pasar real estat Dubai, sangat mempengaruhi lanskap properti di kota tersebut. Platform pembayaran digital Razorpay berencana memindahkan perusahaan induknya dari AS ke India lewat merger lintas negara, yang bisa menyebabkan pembayaran pajak di AS sebesar $250–300 juta.

article_content: Worried about the ongoing crises that have hampered development in Taraba State, the Kukah Centre, Secretariat of the National Peace Committee, in collaboration with UNESCO and the Taraba Independent Peace Committee, have initiated steps to resolve the conflicts. Dr. Nneka Okafor, Head of the Sector for Social and Human Sciences at the UNESCO Regional Office in Abuja, spoke at a two-day peace summit in Jalingo over the weekend. She emphasized that peace is vital for societal stability and affirmed UNESCO's commitment to maintaining peace in Taraba. "UNESCO is designated by the United Nations to promote a culture of peace. Moving forward, we aim to establish a school peace club targeting students at a university in the state," Dr. Okafor said. In an interview with AREWA PUNCH, Dr. Atta Barkindo, Director of the Kukah Centre and head of the National Peace Committee Secretariat (representing the Chairman, Gen. Abdulsalami Abubakar), stressed that peace is fundamental for development. He said the summit was meticulously organized to address issues at the root of conflict. Barkindo explained that the new administration provided an opportunity to select participants for dialogue and develop policy recommendations to present to the new Governor for effective intervention. "The conflicts in Taraba today differ from those 15 years ago, as the dynamics, social conditions, and context have changed. This requires fresh thinking and critical evaluation of priorities," Barkindo noted. He emphasized the importance of managing diversity and nurturing peace in Taraba, warning, "If Taraba burns, there will be hunger in Nigeria."
translated_content: Khawatir terhadap krisis yang terus berlangsung dan telah menghambat pembangunan di Negara Bagian Taraba, Kukah Centre, Sekretariat Komite Perdamaian Nasional, bekerja sama dengan UNESCO dan Komite Perdamaian Independen Taraba, telah memulai langkah untuk menyelesaikan konflik tersebut. Dr. Nneka Okafor, Kepala Sektor Ilmu Sosial dan Humaniora di Kantor Regional UNESCO Abuja, berbicara pada pertemuan puncak perdamaian dua hari di Jalingo akhir pekan lalu. Ia menekankan bahwa perdamaian sangat penting untuk stabilitas masyarakat dan menegaskan komitmen UNESCO menjaga perdamaian di Taraba. "UNESCO ditugaskan oleh Perserikatan Bangsa-Bangsa untuk mempromosikan budaya perdamaian. Ke depannya, kami berencana mendirikan klub perdamaian di sekolah yang menargetkan mahasiswa di salah satu universitas di negara bagian ini," ujar Dr. Okafor. Dalam wawancara dengan AREWA PUNCH, Dr. Atta Barkindo, Direktur Kukah Centre sekaligus kepala Sekretariat Komite Perdamaian Nasional (mewakili Ketua, Jenderal Abdulsalami Abubakar), menekankan bahwa perdamaian adalah hal mendasar untuk pembangunan. Ia mengatakan pertemuan puncak ini diadakan secara cermat untuk menangani isu akar konflik. Barkindo menjelaskan bahwa pemerintahan baru memberikan kesempatan memilih peserta dialog dan menyusun rekomendasi kebijakan yang akan diberikan kepada Gubernur baru demi intervensi yang efektif. "Konflik di Taraba saat ini berbeda dengan 15 tahun lalu karena dinamika, kondisi sosial, dan konteks telah berubah. Dibutuhkan pemikiran baru dan evaluasi kritis terhadap prioritas," jelas Barkindo. Ia menekankan pentingnya mengelola keberagaman dan membina perdamaian di Taraba, serta memperingatkan, "Jika Taraba terbakar, akan ada kelaparan di Nigeria."

article_content: Uber and Lyft have agreed to pay a combined $328 million to settle claims in New York that they withheld wages and denied benefits, such as paid sick leave, to drivers. Under this settlement, drivers in New York are now entitled to a minimum hourly wage, paid sick leave, detailed driver training, and access to an in-app support system for addressing pay and labor issues. Announced by Attorney General Letitia James, the agreement requires Uber to pay $290 million and Lyft to pay $38 million, which will be distributed to over 100,000 current and former drivers. Although both companies maintain they did nothing wrong, Uber said it is committed to enhancing driver conditions by combining workplace flexibility with essential benefits. As part of the settlement, Uber drivers will receive no less than $26 per hour when driving passengers, up to 56 hours of paid sick leave each year, and expanded opportunities for training and education. Uber has called this settlement a major victory for drivers, highlighting the new balance between job flexibility and added protections. Both companies said they hope the New York settlement serves as a model for other states, potentially shifting how drivers are classified and treated. Lyft’s Chief Policy Officer, Jeremy Bird, acknowledged New York’s progress in offering drivers supplemental benefits and expressed intent to extend these protections, similar to practices in California and Washington. The settlement comes after a lengthy investigation by the New York Attorney General’s office that found Uber (2014-2017) and Lyft (2015-2017) illegally withheld pay and benefits owed under state law. Many affected drivers are immigrants who rely on this work to support their families. Attorney General James stressed that the resolution ensures these drivers will finally be compensated and protected as they deserve.
translated_content: Uber dan Lyft sepakat membayar total $328 juta untuk menyelesaikan tuntutan di New York karena menahan upah dan menolak memberikan manfaat seperti cuti sakit berbayar kepada para pengemudi. Dengan penyelesaian ini, pengemudi di New York kini berhak atas upah minimum per jam, cuti sakit berbayar, pelatihan pengemudi lebih lengkap, serta akses ke sistem dukungan dalam aplikasi untuk masalah upah dan kerja. Jaksa Agung Letitia James mengumumkan kesepakatan ini yang mewajibkan Uber membayar $290 juta dan Lyft $38 juta. Dana tersebut akan dibagikan ke lebih dari 100.000 pengemudi, baik yang masih aktif maupun yang sudah tidak aktif. Meski kedua perusahaan menyatakan tidak melakukan kesalahan, Uber menyatakan berkomitmen meningkatkan kondisi kerja pengemudi dengan menggabungkan fleksibilitas kerja dan manfaat penting. Sebagai bagian dari kesepakatan, pengemudi Uber akan menerima setidaknya $26 per jam saat membawa penumpang, hingga 56 jam cuti sakit berbayar setiap tahun, serta peluang pelatihan dan edukasi yang diperluas. Uber menyebut keputusan ini sebagai kemenangan besar untuk pengemudi, karena menawarkan keseimbangan antara fleksibilitas dan perlindungan tambahan. Kedua perusahaan berharap kesepakatan di New York ini dapat menjadi contoh bagi negara bagian lain, yang mungkin akan mengubah cara penetapan status dan perlakuan terhadap pengemudi. Jeremy Bird, Chief Policy Officer Lyft, mengapresiasi kemajuan New York dalam memberikan manfaat tambahan kepada pengemudi dan ingin memperluas perlindungan serupa, seperti di California dan Washington. Kesepakatan ini muncul setelah penyelidikan panjang oleh kantor Jaksa Agung New York yang menemukan Uber (2014-2017) dan Lyft (2015-2017) menahan upah dan manfaat yang seharusnya diberikan sesuai hukum negara bagian. Banyak pengemudi terdampak adalah imigran yang menggantungkan hidup dari pekerjaan ini untuk keluarganya. Jaksa Agung James menegaskan bahwa keputusan ini memastikan para pengemudi akhirnya mendapatkan kompensasi dan perlindungan yang pantas mereka terima.

article_content: Stan Collymore, well-known for being outspoken, decided to quit Twitter after suffering a wave of abuse. Despite controversy in his past, Collymore is respected for his knowledge and dynamic presence as a sports broadcaster. The author voices support for Collymore’s decision, stressing that no one should be subjected to online bullying. Drawing from personal experience, he recalls how harsh messages on Twitter prompted him to close his own account to avoid further distress. The article then spotlights Patrick Bamford, a promising young striker from Chelsea currently on loan to Derby County. Having scored 17 goals in 30 appearances for MK Dons, Bamford is poised for a strong showing at Derby County. His attributes and early success have led to comparisons with a young Fernando Torres, and there are high hopes he’ll be instrumental in Derby’s promotion efforts. Turning to Manchester United, the piece notes that manager David Moyes has endured difficult times but has the strong backing of Sir Alex Ferguson, who is confident Moyes can rebuild the team. While recent results and media scrutiny have increased pressure, United’s acquisition of Juan Mata is seen as a beneficial addition, even though shoring up the spine of the team remains important. The harsh side of football is further illustrated by Everton player Bryan Oviedo’s recent leg fracture, which reminded the author of Paul Mitchell, whom he managed at MK Dons. Mitchell’s playing career ended abruptly at 27 after a similar injury, but he has successfully continued in football, rising to a key scouting and recruitment role at Southampton. The column closes with a story from the FA Youth Cup, where the author’s nephew, Freddie Grant, captained Oxford United against Cardiff City. Although Oxford staged a near-comeback after being down 3-0, they narrowly lost 3-2. The atmosphere, family support, and excitement provided a vivid snapshot of the thrill and unpredictability inherent to youth football.

Penulis mendukung langkah Collymore dan menekankan bahwa tidak ada yang patut menjadi sasaran perundungan online. Dari pengalaman pribadi, penulis juga pernah diterpa pesan negatif yang akhirnya membuatnya menutup akun Twitter untuk menjaga kesehatan mental. Selanjutnya, artikel ini menyoroti Patrick Bamford, striker muda berbakat dari Chelsea yang kini dipinjamkan ke Derby County. Setelah mencetak 17 gol dalam 30 laga bersama MK Dons, Bamford diprediksi akan menjadi andalan Derby. Kecepatan dan ketajamannya bahkan membuatnya kerap dibandingkan dengan Fernando Torres di masa muda. Banyak yang optimis, Bamford dapat membantu Derby meraih promosi. Berpindah ke Manchester United, artikel menyebutkan manajer David Moyes menghadapi tantangan berat namun tetap mendapat dukungan penuh dari Sir Alex Ferguson yang yakin Moyes bisa membangun ulang tim. Meski tekanan media dan hasil pertandingan membuat posisinya terancam, kedatangan Juan Mata dipandang menguntungkan, walau tambahan pemain tengah dan belakang masih sangat dibutuhkan. Sisi kelam sepak bola juga terlihat dari cedera kaki serius yang dialami Bryan Oviedo dari Everton baru-baru ini. Ini mengingatkan penulis pada Paul Mitchell, pemain yang pernah ia latih di MK Dons. Akibat cedera serupa, Mitchell harus pensiun di usia 27 tahun. Namun, ia sukses melanjutkan karier sebagai kepala pencari bakat di Southampton. Meskipun Oxford sempat tertinggal 3-0 dan hampir melakukan comeback dramatis, mereka harus puas kalah tipis 3-2. Suasana hangat dukungan keluarga dan semangat laga menunjukkan betapa penuh warna dan tak terduganya dunia sepak bola usia muda.

Impossible Factual, the producer behind 'Yorkshire Ripper: The Secret Murders,' has received approval from the BBC and Channel 5 for two new documentary projects: one on the Cambridgeshire Crucifixion and another on Vesuvius. 'The Cambridgeshire Crucifixion' will air globally on PBS, Arte, and SBS, telling the story of the best-preserved Roman crucifixion ever discovered. Unearthed in the Cambridgeshire fenlands, it marks only the second confirmed case of Roman crucifixion worldwide, revealed with the help of experts and a virtual autopsy.

Channel 5’s 'The Lost Scrolls of Vesuvius with Alice Roberts' highlights four years of exclusive access to Professor Brent Seales from the University of Kentucky. Seales has garnered international attention by using technology to read, for the first time in 2,000 years, hundreds of carbonized papyrus scrolls from Herculaneum— the sole surviving ancient library, buried by Mount Vesuvius’s eruption in AD 79.

Distributed by ZDF Studios, international versions of 'The Lost Scrolls' have also been created for PBS, France Télévisions, and SBS. Luria, Impossible Factual’s Head of Documentary and director of both films, stated, “These documentaries showcase how breakthroughs in modern technology are shedding new light on the past. It has been very rewarding to bring these stories to life and reveal new discoveries that change how we understand history.”

Impossible Factual, produser di balik 'Yorkshire Ripper: The Secret Murders,' mendapat persetujuan dari BBC dan Channel 5 untuk dua proyek dokumenter baru: satu tentang Penyaliban Cambridgeshire dan satu lagi tentang Vesuvius. 'The Cambridgeshire Crucifixion' akan tayang secara global di PBS, Arte, dan SBS, menceritakan kisah penyaliban Romawi yang paling terawat yang pernah ditemukan. Penemuan di daerah rawa Cambridgeshire ini merupakan kasus penyaliban Romawi kedua yang pernah dikonfirmasi di dunia, terungkap berkat bantuan para ahli dan autopsi virtual.

'Channel 5’s The Lost Scrolls of Vesuvius with Alice Roberts' menyoroti empat tahun akses eksklusif ke Profesor Brent Seales dari University of Kentucky. Seales mendapat perhatian internasional setelah menggunakan teknologi untuk membaca, untuk pertama kalinya dalam 2.000 tahun, ratusan gulungan papirus yang menghitam dari Herculaneum— satu-satunya perpustakaan kuno yang masih tersisa, yang terkubur akibat letusan Gunung Vesuvius tahun 79 Masehi.

Didistribusikan oleh ZDF Studios, versi internasional dari 'The Lost Scrolls' juga dibuat untuk PBS, France Télévisions, dan SBS. Luria, Kepala Dokumenter Impossible Factual sekaligus sutradara kedua film ini, mengatakan, "Dokumenter-dokumenter ini menunjukkan bagaimana kemajuan teknologi modern dapat membuka wawasan baru tentang masa lalu. Sangat memuaskan bisa menghidupkan kisah ini dan mengungkap penemuan yang mengubah cara kita memahami sejarah."

article_content: Ariel Sharon, the Israeli general and former prime minister whose actions shaped the Middle East for more than five decades, died yesterday at age 85. Nicknamed 'The Bulldozer' for his determined approach to both war and politics, Sharon suffered a major stroke in 2006 and remained in a coma until his passing. A photograph from November 16, 2005, shows Sharon addressing a press conference in Jerusalem. Following the announcement of his death, Professor Shlomo Noy, director of the hospital, addressed the media. Sharon's body was transferred under police guard, while media gathered outside the hospital. Many Israelis will mourn Sharon as one of the country's founding fathers, a leader who fought in all of Israel’s wars and held nearly every top government position. However, to many others—particularly across the Arab world—he is remembered as the 'Butcher of Beirut,' known for his role in the 1982 Lebanon War and the massacre of refugees in Lebanon. Born in 1928 in British Palestine to Russian immigrants, Sharon grew up near Tel Aviv and joined the underground Jewish army at age 14. He fought in the 1948 War of Independence, was wounded in combat, and built his reputation within the Israel Defense Forces (IDF). Sharon is expected to be buried beside his wife Lily, near their family farm in Sderot, southern Israel. Images show members of the Sharon family gathering there to pay their respects. Israel’s first prime minister, David Ben-Gurion, admired Sharon and tasked him with establishing an elite commando unit, Unit 101. This group soon brought Israel its first United Nations condemnation after a raid on a Jordanian town left 69 people dead. Despite the controversy, Sharon maintained a prominent role in Israel’s military, including a pivotal moment in the 1973 Yom Kippur War when he led troops through Egyptian lines—a move that many credit with altering the conflict’s outcome and cementing his status as a national hero. Entering politics, Sharon became known as a staunch supporter of Jewish settlements in occupied territories. As defense minister in 1982, he ordered Israeli forces into Lebanon, resulting in the siege of Beirut and the massacre at the Sabra and Shatila refugee camps by Lebanese militias while Israeli troops looked on. Although Sharon denied responsibility, an Israeli commission found him indirectly responsible, leading to his dismissal as defense minister. Sharon's political comeback saw him lead the Likud Party and be elected prime minister in 2001, promising peace and security after his visit to a contested Jerusalem mosque helped trigger a Palestinian uprising. Sharon later surprised many by forming the centrist Kadima party and overseeing the dismantling of Jewish settlements, particularly in Gaza—a move that drew criticism from some former supporters. Throughout his career, Sharon remained a highly controversial figure. Some praised his courage and leadership, while others condemned his military actions. Following a second major stroke in 2006, Sharon remained in a coma for the final years of his life. Sharon’s legacy evoked strong reactions from international leaders and commentators. Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak once said that Sharon was the only Israeli leader who could potentially deliver peace. Former U.S. Secretary of State Condoleezza Rice called him an 'historic leader.' Palestinian commentator Ghazi al-Saadi stated that Sharon was the first Israeli leader to give up claims to all Palestinian land. At the same time, some, like Lebanese survivor Adnan al-Mikdad, remembered him for the violence of the Lebanon War. Others observed how later in life, Sharon’s views and temperament evolved, with some crediting him for steps that could have led to eventual peace.
translated_content: Ariel Sharon, jenderal dan mantan perdana menteri Israel yang tindakannya membentuk Timur Tengah selama lebih dari lima dekade, meninggal kemarin di usia 85 tahun. Dijuluki 'Si Buldozer' karena pendekatannya yang gigih dalam perang dan politik, Sharon mengalami stroke berat pada tahun 2006 dan tetap koma hingga wafat. Sebuah foto dari 16 November 2005 menunjukkan Sharon saat konferensi pers di Yerusalem. Setelah pengumuman kematiannya, Profesor Shlomo Noy, direktur rumah sakit, memberikan pernyataan kepada media. Jenazah Sharon dipindahkan dengan penjagaan polisi, sementara media berkumpul di luar rumah sakit. Banyak warga Israel akan mengenang Sharon sebagai salah satu bapak pendiri negara tersebut, pemimpin yang berjuang di semua perang Israel dan memegang hampir semua jabatan pemerintahan tertinggi. Namun bagi banyak orang lainnya—terutama di dunia Arab—ia diingat sebagai 'Jagal Beirut', terkenal karena perannya dalam Perang Lebanon 1982 dan pembantaian pengungsi di Lebanon. Lahir pada tahun 1928 di Palestina Inggris dari orang tua keturunan Rusia, Sharon tumbuh di dekat Tel Aviv dan bergabung dengan tentara bawah tanah Yahudi pada usia 14 tahun. Ia bertempur dalam Perang Kemerdekaan 1948, terluka dalam pertempuran, dan membangun reputasinya di Pasukan Pertahanan Israel (IDF). Sharon diperkirakan akan dimakamkan di samping istrinya, Lily, dekat peternakan keluarga mereka di Sderot, Israel selatan. Foto memperlihatkan keluarga Sharon berkumpul di sana untuk memberikan penghormatan. Perdana Menteri pertama Israel, David Ben-Gurion, mengagumi Sharon dan memintanya mendirikan satuan komando elit, Unit 101. Satuan ini segera membuat Israel mendapat kecaman pertama dari Perserikatan Bangsa-Bangsa setelah penyerbuan ke kota di Yordania menewaskan 69 orang. Terlepas dari kontroversi tersebut, Sharon tetap memegang peranan penting di militer Israel, termasuk saat Perang Yom Kippur 1973 ketika ia memimpin pasukan menembus garis Mesir—langkah yang dianggap banyak orang mengubah jalannya konflik dan membangun statusnya sebagai pahlawan nasional. Memasuki dunia politik, Sharon dikenal sebagai pendukung kuat permukiman Yahudi di wilayah pendudukan. Sebagai Menteri Pertahanan pada 1982, ia memerintahkan pasukan Israel memasuki Lebanon, menyebabkan pengepungan Beirut dan pembantaian di kamp pengungsi Sabra dan Shatila oleh milisi Lebanon sementara pasukan Israel berjaga. Meski Sharon membantah bertanggung jawab, komisi Israel menyimpulkan ia bertanggung jawab secara tidak langsung dan dicopot dari jabatannya. Kembalinya Sharon ke politik membuatnya memimpin Partai Likud dan terpilih sebagai perdana menteri pada 2001, dengan janji perdamaian dan keamanan setelah kunjungannya ke masjid yang disengketakan di Yerusalem memicu pemberontakan Palestina. Sharon kemudian mengejutkan banyak orang dengan membentuk partai sentris Kadima dan memimpin pembongkaran permukiman Yahudi, khususnya di Gaza—tindakan yang mengundang kritik dari mantan pendukungnya. Sepanjang kariernya, Sharon tetap menjadi sosok yang sangat kontroversial. Ada yang memujinya atas keberanian dan kepemimpinannya, namun ada pula yang mengecam tindakan militernya. Setelah stroke kedua pada tahun 2006, Sharon tetap dalam kondisi koma hingga akhir hayatnya. Warisan Sharon memicu beragam reaksi dari para pemimpin dan pengamat internasional. Presiden Mesir Hosni Mubarak pernah berkata bahwa Sharon adalah satu-satunya pemimpin Israel yang mungkin bisa membawa perdamaian. Mantan Menteri Luar Negeri AS, Condoleezza Rice, menyebutnya 'pemimpin bersejarah'. Pengamat Palestina Ghazi al-Saadi menyatakan Sharon adalah pemimpin Israel pertama yang melepaskan klaim atas seluruh tanah Palestina. Di sisi lain, seperti Adnan al-Mikdad yang selamat dari perang Lebanon, mengenang Sharon karena kekerasan perang tersebut. Ada pula yang melihat perubahan pandangan dan sikap Sharon di akhir hidupnya, dengan sebagian menilai bahwa ia mengambil langkah menuju kemungkinan perdamaian.

Tickets for Super Bowl XLVIII at MetLife Stadium, New York, will see a significant price increase, as the NFL plans to set premium club-level seats at $2,600 each—over double last year’s $1,250 price in New Orleans. This adjustment affects about 9,000 premium tickets, though the NFL says around 30% of seats will be kept below $800. The second-tier seats will also rise to $1,500, compared to $950 previously.

NFL spokesperson Brian McCarthy explained the rationale: these changes are intended to bring official ticket prices closer to actual market value, since many seats are resold for much more. Meanwhile, the league will cut the lowest ticket price from $600 to $500 to maintain some affordability. Reports indicate that last year’s $1,250 tickets often sold for over $6,000 on resale sites, and $600 seats for close to $2,000.

The ticket distribution system means most fans cannot buy tickets at face value. About 17.5% of tickets go to each participating team, with 25% allocated to NFL sponsors and partners. The remainder is divided among all 32 teams for their season-ticket holders via lottery. As a result, most fans who attend secure tickets through the secondary market, at inflated prices. The NFL argues this new pricing simply reflects what fans have already demonstrated they are willing to pay, especially in a densely populated area like New York.

article_content: LONDON: Five schools, including a bilingual, integrated Jewish-Arab institution in Jerusalem, were recognized with the World's Best School prizes on Saturday for achievements such as promoting unity, supporting the local community, and advancing mental health. The winners, based in Brazil, Colombia, India, South Africa, and Israel, shared a total prize fund of $250,000 at the awards, which were launched last year by T4 Education, a global educators' network. The Max Rayne Hand in Hand Jerusalem School received the Overcoming Adversity prize for integrating Jewish and Arab students, teaching over 600 children in both Hebrew and Arabic. The award was given amid the ongoing war in Gaza, which began after the October 7 attack on southern Israel by Palestinian militant group Hamas. 'Winning an award as the best school in the world would usually be a cause for celebration. With war ongoing and many lives lost, this is a time for resolution, not celebration,' Dani Elazar, CEO of the Hand in Hand school network, said in a statement. SPARK Soweto, located in the South African township once home to Nelson Mandela, won the Community Collaboration prize for teaching students about voting, reducing waste pollution, and addressing gender-based violence. Its older students also help younger children learn to read. In Colombia, Institucion Educativa Municipal Montessori sede San Francisco, situated in Pitalito, earned the Environmental Action prize for a student-led program transforming coffee pulp waste into eco-friendly items like organic soap. EEMTI Joaquim Bastos Goncalves school in Carnaubal, Brazil, was awarded for Supporting Healthy Lives by providing access to psychologists and teaching mental health awareness after the COVID-19 pandemic. The Innovation prize went to Riverside School in Ahmedabad, India, for its student-centered approach and programs fostering empathy, creativity, and social responsibility. The inaugural Community Choice award, determined by public vote, went to Escola Municipal Professor Edson Pisani in Belo Horizonte, Brazil, for local contributions such as initiating a new public bus route and a community waste project. 'Educators around the world should look to your schools as shining examples of positive change,' said Vikas Pota, founder of T4 Education and the prizes. 'Governments should also consider your trailblazing work as they search for solutions to today's major challenges.'

Max Rayne Hand in Hand Jerusalem School menerima penghargaan Mengatasi Kesulitan karena mengintegrasikan siswa Yahudi dan Arab, dengan lebih dari 600 murid diajar dalam bahasa Ibrani dan Arab. Penghargaan ini diberikan di tengah perang yang sedang berlangsung di Gaza, yang dimulai setelah serangan 7 Oktober di Israel selatan oleh kelompok militan Palestina, Hamas. Di Kolombia, Institucion Educativa Municipal Montessori sede San Francisco di Pitalito meraih penghargaan Aksi Lingkungan untuk program siswa yang mengubah limbah ampas kopi menjadi produk ramah lingkungan seperti sabun organik. 'Pemerintah juga sebaiknya melihat terobosan yang Anda lakukan dalam mencari solusi tantangan besar masa kini.'

article_content: Central Park is a must-see for anyone visiting New York City, but soon tourists may need to use flash photography to snap the famous Carousel. According to a recent Municipal Art Society (MAS) study, the construction of seven ultra-thin luxury residential towers will cast substantial shadows over the park’s southern section. On December 21, the winter solstice, these skyscrapers are expected to plunge portions of the park into deep shadow—reaching up to 20 blocks north and affecting areas such as the Lake and Ramble. Layla Law-Gisiko, head of the Community Board 5 Landmarks Committee, warned that these towers could cause a 'solar eclipse effect' over the park in the middle of the day, particularly impacting open spaces like Sheep Meadow that are popular for sunbathing. Although Central Park was created as an accessible green space for all, these new residential high-rises are marketed primarily to ultra-wealthy foreign buyers—including Russian oligarchs and Chinese tycoons—seeking apartments with coveted park views. Carol Willis, Director of the Skyscraper Museum, calls these sought-after vistas the ultimate 'money shot.' On the shortest day of the year, the combined shadow of these towers could stretch dramatically, diminishing daylight in significant stretches of the park. Even during the equinoxes, major spaces like Sheep Meadow may be left with little direct sunlight. Notably, One57—already under construction as part of the so-called 'Billionaire’s Belt'—has sold penthouses for an estimated $90 million apiece. Some city officials, including outgoing Mayor Michael Bloomberg, argue that attracting affluent international buyers is beneficial, but critics point out that these owners often use their properties as secondary residences and avoid local income taxes. Additionally, most of these towers are being built 'as of right,' meaning they bypass both environmental impact assessments and public review processes. Many of these skyscrapers will be among the tallest in the Western Hemisphere. For instance, the Nordstrom Tower is planned to reach 1,424 feet—outstripping the roof of One World Trade Center—while the 1,350-foot 111 West 57th Street will exceed the height of the Empire State Building’s observation deck. Developers achieve these heights by purchasing unused 'air rights' from neighboring properties. Rendering comparisons show how 57th Street and nearby park areas will be transformed, with long shadows and altered street-level lighting. Thanks to new engineering techniques, these super-slender towers can be erected on lots once considered too small for such tall structures—sometimes no wider than two historic townhouses. The Municipal Art Society’s latest report recommends revisiting zoning regulations and increasing public involvement in the development process to protect vital public assets like Central Park. MAS President Vin Cipolla emphasized to the New York Daily News, 'Our public spaces should not be sacrificed—these changes are troubling and call for action.'

Menurut studi terbaru dari Municipal Art Society (MAS), pembangunan tujuh menara hunian mewah super ramping akan menimbulkan bayangan besar di bagian selatan taman. Penthouse di One57—yang sudah dalam tahap pembangunan sebagai bagian dari 'Billionaire's Belt'—bahkan telah terjual seharga sekitar $90 juta per unit. Misalnya, Nordstrom Tower direncanakan setinggi 1.424 kaki—melewati atap One World Trade Center—sementara 111 West 57th Street yang setinggi 1.350 kaki akan lebih tinggi dari dek observasi Empire State Building. Presiden MAS, Vin Cipolla, menegaskan kepada New York Daily News, 'Ruang publik kita tidak boleh dikorbankan—perubahan ini mengkhawatirkan dan perlu tindakan.'

article_content: Russia has begun sending four Ukrainian children back to their families through an agreement arranged by Qatar. The children, from two to seventeen years old, are the initial group in a pilot project aimed at returning many more of the thousands separated from Ukraine after Russia's full-scale invasion in 2022. Ukrainian authorities report that at least 20,000 children were taken by Russian forces, though the true figure could be even higher. The International Criminal Court has issued arrest warrants for Russian President Vladimir Putin and his children's rights commissioner, Maria Lvova-Belova, accusing them of unlawfully deporting Ukrainian minors. However, Russia says it moved the children for their safety, labeling the accusations as baseless. The process of repatriation is complex; some children had to cross multiple countries to reach home. One seven-year-old was recently reunited with his grandmother, while the other three are expected to arrive soon. Reports suggest that children in Russia were often subjected to Russian-centric education and told discouraging things about Ukraine. Families have occasionally needed to undertake long journeys to bring children back, with only around 400 reportedly returned prior to these Qatar-mediated efforts. According to Daria Gerasymchuk, advisor to Ukraine’s president on children’s rights, Russia is seeking to erase Ukrainian identity from these children. Russian officials, however, state they are assisting with family reunification and covering necessary costs. Confirming Qatar's role, Minister Lolwah Al Khater called the children's return an important first step and expressed hope it would lead to more actions easing tensions and building trust between Russia and Ukraine.

Pihak berwenang Ukraina melaporkan setidaknya 20.000 anak dibawa oleh pasukan Rusia, meskipun jumlah sesungguhnya bisa lebih besar. Pengadilan Kriminal Internasional telah mengeluarkan surat perintah penangkapan untuk Presiden Rusia Vladimir Putin dan komisaris hak anaknya, Maria Lvova-Belova, dengan tuduhan deportasi anak-anak Ukraina secara ilegal. Namun, Rusia mengklaim mereka memindahkan anak-anak demi keselamatan dan menilai tuduhan tersebut tidak berdasar. Proses repatriasi ini sangat rumit—beberapa anak harus melewati beberapa negara sebelum sampai ke rumah. Seorang anak laki-laki berusia tujuh tahun baru saja dipertemukan kembali dengan neneknya, sementara tiga lainnya diperkirakan tiba dalam waktu dekat. Laporan menyatakan anak-anak di Rusia sering memperoleh pendidikan yang berfokus pada nilai-nilai patriotik Rusia dan diberi gambaran negatif tentang Ukraina. Terkadang, keluarga harus menempuh perjalanan panjang untuk menjemput anak mereka, dengan sekitar 400 anak yang baru kembali sebelum mediasi oleh Qatar. Menurut Daria Gerasymchuk, penasihat presiden Ukraina untuk hak anak, Rusia berusaha menghapus identitas Ukraina dari anak-anak tersebut. Pejabat Rusia, di sisi lain, menyatakan membantu proses reunifikasi dan menanggung biaya yang diperlukan. Menteri Qatar, Lolwah Al Khater, menegaskan peran negaranya dalam pemulangan anak-anak itu, menyebutnya sebagai langkah awal penting dan berharap dapat mendorong upaya berikutnya untuk meredakan ketegangan serta membangun kepercayaan antara Rusia dan Ukraina.

article_content: Anna Nicole Smith's boyfriend and two doctors pleaded not guilty Wednesday to new charges related to the former model and reality TV star’s 2007 death. Howard K. Stern, Smith's lawyer and companion, appeared in Los Angeles County Superior Court alongside Dr. Khristine Eroshevich and Dr. Sandeep Kapoor to hear the updated charges. Smith died in a Hollywood, Florida hotel on February 8, 2007. The death was ruled an 'acute combined drug intoxication' by the Broward County, Florida medical examiner. The three are accused of conspiring to illegally prescribe, administer, and dispense controlled substances to an addict. Stern faces 11 felony charges; the doctors face six each. The charges were revised after new findings from the ongoing investigation emerged. A preliminary hearing is scheduled for next month. Affidavits from a state investigation, unsealed and released Tuesday, disclosed new details from a 2½-year probe. One witness told investigators she saw Stern inject Smith with drugs. A nanny hired for Smith's infant daughter, born in the Bahamas in September 2006, reported seeing Stern and Dr. Eroshevich crush pills, convert them into liquid, and inject Smith. The nanny described Smith as being disoriented and sometimes sleeping for days afterward. Investigators say Smith received dangerous drugs over the three years leading up to her death, including during pregnancy. Smith, whose real name was Vickie Lynn Marshall, was described by one investigator as a 'drug seeker' who was given excessive amounts of medication. Witness and expert statements suggest boundary-crossing personal relationships between Smith and her doctors. Photographs recovered reportedly show Dr. Eroshevich and Smith in intimate situations, and video evidence allegedly shows Dr. Kapoor with Smith at a nightclub. Dr. Eroshevich visited the Bahamas to see Smith and was with her in Florida four days before Smith's death. She also obtained prescription sleeping medication in California for Smith just after her daughter was born. Pharmacists raised concerns about prescriptions for strong narcotics, with one pharmacist calling it 'pharmaceutical suicide.' Dozens of prescriptions were written, sometimes under aliases. Dr. Kapoor reportedly prescribed Smith an average of 10 methadone tablets daily during her pregnancy, reducing the dosage only in her last trimester. Due to the high volume of prescriptions, a chief pharmacist consulted a drug expert, who warned that the dosages were dangerously high. The expert admonished Dr. Eroshevich over her prescribing practices. Investigators claim that some prescriptions were written in Howard K. Stern’s name and that Dr. Eroshevich transported medications from California to the Bahamas for Smith. CNN’s Jack Hannah contributed to this report.
translated_content: Pacar Anna Nicole Smith dan dua dokternya mengaku tidak bersalah pada hari Rabu atas dakwaan baru terkait kematian mantan model dan bintang reality TV tersebut pada tahun 2007. Howard K. Stern, pengacara dan pendamping Smith, hadir di Pengadilan Tinggi Los Angeles County bersama Dr. Khristine Eroshevich dan Dr. Sandeep Kapoor untuk mendengarkan dakwaan terbaru. Smith meninggal di sebuah hotel di Hollywood, Florida pada 8 Februari 2007. Kematian tersebut dinyatakan sebagai 'keracunan obat gabungan akut' oleh pemeriksa medis Broward County, Florida. Ketiganya dituduh bersekongkol secara ilegal untuk meresepkan, memberikan, dan mendistribusikan zat terkontrol kepada seorang pecandu. Stern menghadapi 11 dakwaan tindak pidana; para dokter masing-masing menghadapi enam dakwaan. Dakwaan ini diperbarui setelah ditemukannya temuan baru dari penyelidikan yang masih berjalan. Sidang pendahuluan dijadwalkan bulan depan. Afidavit dari penyelidikan negara bagian, yang dibuka dan dirilis pada hari Selasa, mengungkapkan detail baru dari penyelidikan selama 2½ tahun. Seorang saksi mengatakan kepada penyelidik bahwa ia melihat Stern menyuntikkan obat kepada Smith. Seorang pengasuh bayi yang disewa untuk putri Smith, yang lahir di Bahama pada September 2006, melaporkan pernah melihat Stern dan Dr. Eroshevich menghancurkan pil, mengubahnya menjadi cairan, lalu menyuntikkan kepada Smith. Pengasuh itu menggambarkan Smith tampak linglung dan kadang tidur selama beberapa hari. Penyelidik mengatakan Smith menerima obat-obatan berbahaya selama tiga tahun sebelum kematiannya, termasuk saat hamil. Smith, yang nama aslinya Vickie Lynn Marshall, digambarkan oleh seorang penyelidik sebagai 'pencari obat' yang diberi obat secara berlebihan. Pernyataan saksi dan ahli mengindikasikan adanya hubungan pribadi yang melampaui batas profesional antara Smith dan para dokternya. Foto-foto yang ditemukan menunjukkan Dr. Eroshevich dan Smith dalam situasi intim, dan bukti video diduga memperlihatkan Dr. Kapoor bersama Smith di sebuah klub malam. Dr. Eroshevich mengunjungi Bahama untuk menemui Smith dan bersamanya di Florida empat hari sebelum Smith meninggal. Ia juga mendapatkan obat tidur resep di California untuk Smith tak lama setelah putrinya lahir. Beberapa apoteker mengungkapkan kekhawatiran tentang resep obat narkotika kuat, dengan seorang apoteker menyebutnya sebagai 'bunuh diri farmasi.' Puluhan resep diberikan, terkadang menggunakan nama samaran. Dr. Kapoor dilaporkan meresepkan rata-rata 10 tablet metadon per hari untuk Smith selama kehamilannya, dan baru menurunkan dosis di trimester terakhir. Karena banyaknya resep, kepala apoteker meminta pendapat ahli farmasi yang memperingatkan bahwa dosisnya sangat tinggi. Ahli tersebut juga menegur Dr. Eroshevich terkait praktik pemberian resepnya. Menurut penyelidik, beberapa resep ditulis atas nama Howard K. Stern dan Dr. Eroshevich membawa obat-obatan dari California ke Bahama untuk Smith. Jack Hannah dari CNN turut menyumbang dalam laporan ini.

article_content: Pope Francis surprised many commuters when, instead of taking a helicopter, he rode a public train to attend a Mass in Daejeon, South Korea. Known for his humble approach, Pope Francis chose public transport during his five-day visit, reinforcing his reputation for simplicity. Rather than flying from Seoul to Daejeon for his first public Mass, he took a local train and led a service at the city's football stadium. Korean media reported that Francis traveled in the fourth car in first-class along with about 500 passengers. Organizers stated that the switch to the train was due to bad weather. Visit spokesman Hur Young-yup told Yonhap news agency, “The helicopter is his default means of transit because it is fast and safe, but the pontiff considers other options, like the train, if they allow him to stay on schedule.” The pope’s humility has surprised many in status-conscious South Korea. He declined the traditional Popemobile in favor of Korea's smallest compact car, a black Kia Soul, considered too modest by many for a world leader. A South Korean remarked online, 'The pope rode the Soul because he is full of soul.' Shon Cho-eun, a 22-year-old Christian student, said, 'I feel honored that Pope Francis will not be in a bulletproof vehicle. I hope he arrives safely and delivers good messages to us.' During this visit, Francis’s use of a Kia Soul instead of a luxury or armored Popemobile has raised some security concerns, similar to those during his trip to Rio. He encourages priests globally to use simple cars, and at the Vatican, he uses a Ford Focus.

article_content: NEW YORK (CNN) -- Butterfly Boucher is an Australian singer-songwriter who finds support and motivation from her fans. "It's my real name," she explains, addressing frequent questions about her unique name and creative upbringing. Born in Adelaide and the middle of seven sisters, Boucher spent much of her childhood moving between cities with her family. Many of her siblings also have original names, such as Sunshine, Eden, Angel, and Harmony. Boucher, now 29, released her debut album, "Another White Dash," on A&M Records in 2003. When she encountered difficulties with releasing her second album due to perceptions of her music being too pop for the indie scene and too indie for the pop scene, Boucher chose to go independent. After leaving her label and keeping the masters of her new work, she plans to release her album, "Scary Fragile," through her own imprint on June 2. The album was completed over three years ago. Financial challenges aside, she continues to work hard, encouraged by ongoing fan support on MySpace and Facebook. Her music has appeared on "Grey's Anatomy," she has opened for Sarah McLachlan, and collaborated with David Bowie on a cover of "Changes" for the "Shrek 2" soundtrack. Nicole Kidman also attended one of her recent Nashville concerts. Now based in Nashville, Boucher recently visited CNN to discuss growing into her name, the importance of music in her upbringing, the challenges of the music industry, and her fondness for both Nashville and Australia. Boucher notes that her father was a musician and music played a significant role during her childhood. She agrees that the music business can be emotionally difficult, but says fan support helps her persevere. She named her album "Scary Fragile" after a song title, preferring memorable album names over overly deep ones. Boucher enjoys living in Nashville, appreciating its vibrant music scene and evolving community. She sometimes misses Australian foods like meat pies, and the familiar scents of her homeland.

Setelah mengalami kendala dalam merilis album keduanya—karena musiknya dianggap terlalu pop untuk dunia indie dan terlalu indie untuk dunia pop—Boucher memutuskan untuk mandiri. Kini menetap di Nashville, Boucher baru-baru ini berbicara dengan CNN tentang perjalanan menerima nama uniknya, pentingnya musik dalam hidup, tantangan industri musik, serta kerinduannya pada Australia dan kecintaannya pada Nashville. Boucher menyampaikan bahwa ayahnya juga seorang musisi, sehingga musik sudah menjadi bagian penting sejak kecil. article_content: Members of four statutory commissions recently dissolved in Osun State have taken legal action against Governor Ademola Adeleke at the National Industrial Court in Ibadan, Oyo State. The affected commissions are the State Independent Electoral Commission, Judicial Service Commission, Civil Service Commission, and House of Assembly Service Commission. Governor Adeleke had announced the dissolution of these commissions on October 30, 2023. In response, the former members, represented by their counsel Muhydeen Adeoye, filed four separate lawsuits. They are asking the court to declare their termination illegal, reinstate them to their positions, and order the governor to pay N500 million in damages to each group, along with outstanding salaries and emoluments. The lawsuits also include the state's Attorney General, Commissioner for Finance, and the House of Assembly as defendants. In one case, the former Chairman of the Electoral Commission, Segun Oladitan, along with six other former members, is asking the court to recognize the dissolution as unlawful, citing unpaid salaries and benefits. Similarly, Babafemi Osunro and four others contest the premature dissolution of the Civil Service Commission before their tenure's scheduled end in 2025. Awolola Abiodun and six others are challenging the dissolution of the House of Assembly Service Commission, while Adebayo Salmon and three others are disputing their dismissal from the Judicial Service Commission, which was to end in 2027. All claimants are also seeking compensation for unpaid salaries since November 2022. Counsel Adeoye confirmed all parties have been served and are now awaiting the court to fix a hearing date.

Komisi yang terdampak adalah Komisi Pemilihan Umum Negara, Komisi Layanan Peradilan, Komisi Layanan Sipil, dan Komisi Layanan Dewan Perwakilan Rakyat Negara Bagian Osun. Gubernur Adeleke mengumumkan pembubaran komisi-komisi tersebut pada 30 Oktober 2023. Menanggapi hal itu, para mantan anggota yang diwakili penasihat hukum mereka, Muhydeen Adeoye, mengajukan empat gugatan terpisah. Mereka meminta pengadilan menyatakan pemecatan mereka tidak sah, mengembalikan mereka ke jabatan semula, serta memerintahkan gubernur membayar ganti rugi sebesar N500 juta untuk setiap kelompok bersama gaji dan hak yang tertunggak. Gugatan ini juga mencantumkan Jaksa Agung Negara, Komisaris Keuangan, dan Dewan Perwakilan Rakyat Negara Bagian sebagai tergugat. Dalam salah satu kasus, mantan Ketua Komisi Pemilihan, Segun Oladitan, bersama enam mantan anggota lainnya meminta pengadilan mengakui pembubaran itu sebagai tindakan melawan hukum dengan alasan gaji dan hak yang belum dibayarkan. Demikian pula, Babafemi Osunro dan empat lainnya mempersoalkan pembubaran Komisi Layanan Sipil sebelum masa jabatan mereka yang seharusnya berakhir tahun 2025. Awolola Abiodun dan enam lainnya menggugat pembubaran Komisi Layanan DPRD, sementara Adebayo Salmon dan tiga lainnya menggugat pemberhentian mereka dari Komisi Layanan Peradilan yang seharusnya berakhir tahun 2027. Seluruh penggugat juga meminta kompensasi untuk gaji yang belum dibayarkan sejak November 2022. Penasihat hukum, Adeoye, memastikan semua pihak telah mendapat surat panggilan dan saat ini menunggu jadwal sidang dari pengadilan.

article_content: Brazil aims to further strengthen its partnership with India by supplying plant-based and animal proteins to support India's dietary requirements. On an official visit, Brazil's Minister of Agriculture and Livestock, Carlos Fávaro, is prioritizing deeper diplomatic and commercial ties, focusing particularly on agriculture. With President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva at the helm, Brazil has renewed its reputation in the global agribusiness sector. Over the last ten months, Minister Fávaro and the Ministry have opened access to 55 new international markets for Brazilian agricultural exports. Products now reaching these destinations include beef, pork, poultry, seafood, animal-based products, pet foods, cotton, and açaí juice. The countries now importing these goods include China, India, Mexico, Chile, Canada, Russia, Indonesia, Egypt, Singapore, Argentina, and Saudi Arabia, among others. Minister Fávaro attributes the increased confidence in Brazilian products to robust diplomatic relations, noting that the diversification of agricultural exports shows Brazil’s dedication to quality. He has also announced a large-scale sustainable agriculture initiative, which seeks to restore and convert 40 million hectares of degraded pasture into usable farmland within a decade, all without causing deforestation. On the trade side, Brazil and India are working to expand agricultural exchange by addressing health and safety standards and improving market access. Brazil hopes to increase exports of avocados, citrus fruits, nuts, and yerba mate to India, while India is aiming to grow its exports to Brazil in areas such as sorghum, millet, coconut water, dairy products, and various meats. In 2022, Brazil's agricultural exports to India totaled $2.95 billion, mainly from soybean oil and sugar. That year, Brazil imported $177.55 million in agricultural goods from India, especially cotton products, onions, essential oils, chocolate, and cumin seeds. Additionally, in May 2023, India opened its market to Brazilian non-fermented açaí juice.

Di bawah kepemimpinan Presiden Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, reputasi Brasil di sektor agribisnis global telah pulih. Produk-produk seperti daging sapi, babi, unggas, makanan laut, produk hewani, makanan hewan peliharaan, kapas, dan jus açaí kini diekspor ke negara-negara tersebut. Negara-negara yang kini mengimpor produk Brasil meliputi Tiongkok, India, Meksiko, Chili, Kanada, Rusia, Indonesia, Mesir, Singapura, Argentina, dan Arab Saudi, serta beberapa negara lainnya. Dari sisi perdagangan, Brasil dan India berusaha memperluas pertukaran produk pertanian melalui penyamaan standar kesehatan dan keamanan serta peningkatan akses pasar. Brasil ingin meningkatkan ekspor alpukat, buah jeruk, kacang-kacangan, dan yerba mate ke India, sementara India ingin memperbesar ekspor sorgum, millet, air kelapa, produk susu, dan berbagai produk daging ke Brasil. Selain itu, pada Mei 2023, India membuka pasarnya untuk jus açaí Brasil non-fermentasi.

article_content: Sanjiv Bhasin, Director at IIFL Securities, expects midcap IT and select midcap stocks to outperform in the Indian stock market. He believes the time is ripe for largecap stocks to catch up and potentially outperform as FII selling declines and yields stabilize. Bhasin notes that smallcap stocks generally involve higher risk due to greater price volatility and less available information than largecaps or midcaps. Despite this, retail investors and mutual funds are fueling broad market interest, with stocks like Suzlon, Zomato, REC, PFC, and ONGC showing strong performance. He points out that after corrections of 6-7% in the main and midcap indices, a significant rebound has occurred: the index is up 3%, and the midcap index has climbed 10%, highlighting strong retail activity. Bhasin attributes recent FII outflows to higher US bond yields, dollar strength, and global geopolitical issues, contributing to selling in top index stocks while the broader market maintains outperformance. Regarding the sustainability of midcap and smallcap momentum, Bhasin acknowledges that corrections will occur, but as long as earnings and sentiment remain positive, further gains are likely. He mentions particular strength in power sector stocks such as NTPC, ONGC, REC, PFC, and Tata Power. Bhasin discloses investments in Idea, TTML, and Devyani International, considering them potential turnaround stories. He also expects private banks like ICICI Bank and Axis Bank to lead among largecaps. To manage risk, Bhasin suggests using hedging strategies like options, especially at market highs. He sees ongoing opportunities in power and select midcap banks, such as AU Bank, despite recent market challenges. He emphasizes the risk of being under-invested during a bull market and advises a long-term approach rather than trying to time market corrections. India’s strong economic fundamentals, rising consumer demand, and lower oil prices offer support. Concluding with optimism, Bhasin urges investors to take a three-year outlook and expect new market highs, even with possible short-term uncertainties such as elections. Additional economic context includes rising FMCG sales, Snap Inc. rapidly expanding its Indian user base, and the Indian finance ministry exploring slower capex growth to meet fiscal targets.
