article_content:
The main issue with Sony’s 2023 flagship, the Xperia 1 V, was its high price for the features it provided. Enter the more budget-friendly Xperia 5 V (pronounced 'five mark five'). While it's positioned as an affordable option, at £850 (about $1,000), it's still a significant investment—around £450 less than its larger sibling. The Xperia 5 V is well-balanced, featuring a distinctive design and a unique set of features targeted at content creators, especially those invested in photography and videography. While it falls behind some similarly priced Android phones in certain aspects, it offers better value than the Xperia 1 V. Unfortunately, it's not available in the US market.

Sony maintains its iconic rectangular design, a style tracing back more than a decade to its earliest Androids. Over time, the Xperia line has grown taller and slimmer. Although some call it compact, the Xperia 5 V is actually heavier and taller than the iPhone 15 or Samsung Galaxy S23, though it is slightly narrower, making one-handed use easier. However, typing in portrait mode can feel a bit cramped.

The phone is constructed with a matte glass finish in black, blue, or platinum (gray). Unlike the Xperia 1 V, it lacks a grippy texture. It features a 3.5mm headphone jack, volume rocker, power button with an integrated fingerprint sensor, camera shutter button, and a microSD card slot—most of which are absent on flagship devices today. It's rated IP65/IP68 for dust and water resistance, and the use of Gorilla Glass Victus ensures durability, though some competitors now use the tougher Victus 2.

One of the few downgrades from the Xperia 1 V is the display: a 6.1-inch OLED panel with 2,520 x 1,080 resolution. The screen stays sharp and bright enough for use outdoors, except under direct sunlight. The 21:9 aspect ratio provides space for modest bezels and front-facing stereo speakers, making it well-suited for movie viewing. However, Sony’s Creator Mode for advanced color accuracy is missing. The refresh rate sits at 60 Hz by default but can be pushed to 120 Hz for smoother performance at the cost of some battery life.

Under the hood, the Xperia 5 V is powered by a Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 processor alongside 8 GB RAM, delivering flagship-level performance. It handles everyday tasks and intensive games like Asphalt 9: Legends and Kingdom Rush Origins smoothly, though it can get warm during extended gaming or video recording—not alarmingly so.

Storage is limited to 128 GB, yet Sony compensates by offering microSD expandability, a rarity among premium smartphones. Battery life stands out: the 5,000 mAh battery reliably lasts through a full day, or up to two days with Sony's Stamina mode. Charging is relatively slow, with a half-hour restoring 50%, but a full charge taking almost two hours. Maximum charging power is 30W, tapering off as the device heats up. Wireless charging support is included.

Sony, renowned for its image sensors used by other manufacturers like Apple, includes a capable camera suite in the Xperia 5 V. It shares the same 52MP main sensor and 12MP ultrawide as the Xperia 1 V, but omits a telephoto lens. Instead, Sony relies on the main sensor to achieve a respectable 2X zoom using a crop, producing slightly sharper results than typical digital zoom.

article_content: Ashley Cole appears to have embraced his role at AS Roma, posing in the center of a team photo after their 2-1 victory at Parma on Wednesday night. Previously seen on the outskirts of a summer team photo, the Englishman now features prominently with his teammates aboard the team’s flight home. Although Cole was an unused substitute during the match, Roma maintained their perfect Serie A record for the season. In striking contrast to his earlier photo, Cole is now seen at the heart of the team. The former Chelsea defender watched as Roma defeated Parma 2-1, with a thrilling late free kick from Miralem Pjanic securing the win after Adem Ljajic opened the scoring and Paolo De Ceglie equalized for Parma. Roma looked set to drop their first points of the season until Pjanic’s well-executed free kick just two minutes before the final whistle. The team was missing eight injured players, including important midfielder Daniele De Rossi and recent signing Juan Iturbe. When Cole first arrived, a widely circulated photo showed him awkwardly standing apart from his new teammates, sparking jokes online—including from Roma captain Francesco Totti. In this match, Totti, who turns 38 this week, provided the key assist for Ljajic, setting him up for Roma’s opening goal. Parma’s Antonio Cassano posed a threat in the 54th minute, and De Ceglie equalized by heading in from a corner. The game seemed destined for a draw until Pjanic demonstrated his free-kick skill, curling the winner in off the underside of the crossbar. Adem Ljajic opened the scoring for Roma after being set up by Totti, and Pjanic’s spectacular 88th-minute free kick kept Roma’s winning run alive.

article_content: YouTube announced via X (formerly Twitter) that it would temporarily demonetize a creator after she shared a photo of a fellow YouTuber’s house on her Instagram story. SSSniperwolf (Alia Shelesh) is a YouTuber with over 34 million subscribers and 5.6 million Instagram followers, known for her reaction videos to TikToks. Jack Douglass, known as JacksFilms, has over four million YouTube subscribers and is recognized for comedic skits and parodies. The two YouTubers became embroiled in an online dispute after the incident last Friday. Douglass had repeatedly urged YouTube to take action in response to Shelesh’s post, but the company only recently responded. YouTube confirmed that SSSniperwolf received a temporary monetization suspension under its Creator Responsibility policies. The company stated that 'off-platform actions that put others’ personal safety at risk harm our community, and behavior on both sides isn’t what we want on YouTube.' The creators have had ongoing disagreements. While both have been active for over a decade, recent tensions grew after SSSniperwolf began posting reaction videos to TikToks. Douglass has criticized her for allegedly failing to credit creators and for unoriginal content, claims Shelesh denies. On Oct. 13, Shelesh posted a photo on her Instagram story with the text: 'Should I go visit @Jacksfilms? He lives 5 mins away from my shoot.' She then shared several more posts, including a photo of Douglass’s house with the caption: 'Let’s talk like adults.' Douglass shared a screenshot of the Instagram story on X and accused Shelesh of doxxing—revealing someone's personal information online—which she denied. He tagged YouTube and called for her videos to be demonetized. TIME reached out to YouTube, Douglass, and Shelesh for comment but did not receive a response. 'I have no idea how to Dox,' Shelesh wrote on Instagram. On Oct. 14, YouTube responded on X to a question about their policy if one YouTuber doxxes another, sharing a link to its harassment and bullying policy and clarifying: 'We don't allow harmful behaviors like threats & doxxing.' A community note pointed out YouTube had not yet taken action against SSSniperwolf. Douglass uploaded a YouTube video the same day, explaining the situation: 'In my 17 years on YouTube, I've never had someone come to my home and vaguely threaten me. SSSniperwolf needs to be deplatformed.' Not hearing from YouTube, Douglass quote-tweeted YouTube’s post about harassment policy on Oct. 17, stating: '@TeamYouTube, the best time to remove SSSniperwolf from your platform was Friday night… The second best time is now.' YouTube replied to Douglass’s recent post, confirming SSSniperwolf's temporary demonetization due to policy violations and reiterating the importance of community safety and appropriate conduct. Shelesh apologized to Douglass and her fans in a post on X, acknowledging that her actions fell short of being an example for conflict resolution. She expressed plans to reach out to Douglass to communicate and thanked YouTube for holding her accountable, agreeing that she deserves the demonetization and intends to learn from the experience.

SSSniperwolf (Alia Shelesh) adalah YouTuber dengan lebih dari 34 juta subscriber dan 5,6 juta pengikut Instagram, dikenal lewat video reaksinya terhadap TikTok. Pada 14 Oktober, YouTube membalas pertanyaan di X soal kebijakan jika seorang YouTuber melakukan doxxing terhadap YouTuber lain, dengan membagikan tautan ke kebijakan pelecehan dan perundungan serta menegaskan: 'Kami tidak mengizinkan perilaku berbahaya seperti ancaman dan doxxing.' Ada catatan komunitas yang menyoroti bahwa YouTube belum mengambil tindakan terhadap SSSniperwolf. Douglass mengunggah video di YouTube pada hari yang sama untuk menjelaskan situasi ini: 'Selama 17 tahun di YouTube, belum pernah ada yang datang ke rumahku dan mengancam dengan cara samar. SSSniperwolf harus di-deplatform.' Karena belum ada respon dari YouTube, Douglass melakukan quote tweet pada postingan YouTube tentang kebijakan pelecehan pada 17 Oktober dan menulis: '@TeamYouTube, waktu terbaik untuk menghapus SSSniperwolf dari platformmu adalah Jumat malam… Waktu terbaik berikutnya adalah sekarang.' YouTube akhirnya membalas postingan Douglass, memastikan monetisasi SSSniperwolf dihentikan sementara karena melanggar kebijakan serta kembali menegaskan pentingnya keselamatan komunitas dan perilaku yang patut. Shelesh meminta maaf kepada Douglass dan para penggemarnya dalam sebuah postingan di X, mengakui bahwa aksinya bukan contoh penyelesaian konflik yang baik. Ia berencana menghubungi Douglass untuk berkomunikasi dan berterima kasih pada YouTube karena telah bertindak tegas, serta setuju bahwa ia pantas mendapatkan demonetisasi dan ingin belajar dari kejadian ini.

article_content: Jermain Defoe is set to return to the Premier League with Sunderland, having traveled to the North East to complete his transfer. After an 11-month stint at Toronto FC in MLS, Defoe is ready to join manager Gus Poyet’s team, hoping to boost Sunderland’s fortunes as they struggle near the relegation zone with only 18 league goals this season. The deal includes a direct exchange: Defoe joins Sunderland, while Jozy Altidore heads to Toronto FC, having agreed to terms despite his substantial salary. Defoe’s time in MLS saw him score 11 goals in 16 games, but a return to English football has been his priority. Sunderland looks to have beaten Hull City for Defoe’s signature, as Hull boss Steve Bruce confirmed financial limitations made a deal impossible. With injuries to key strikers Nikica Jelavic and Abel Hernandez, Bruce sought reinforcements but had to rule out a move for Defoe. Defoe is renowned for his goal-scoring prowess, tallying 123 goals in 379 Premier League games during spells with West Ham, Tottenham Hotspur, and Portsmouth. He also earned 55 caps for England from 2004 to 2013, netting 19 international goals. Defoe’s career began at Charlton Athletic before he joined West Ham at 16, quickly becoming known for his scoring ability. His club career has seen highlights at West Ham and Tottenham, additional success at Portsmouth, and more recently, a spell in MLS. Sunderland hopes Defoe’s arrival will provide both experience and much-needed goals as they aim to climb out of the relegation zone.

article_content:
Sergeant Lawrence Hutchins III, a U.S. Marine involved in a prominent legal case, appeared in court on Thursday to seek a new attorney ahead of his retrial related to the 2006 death of an unarmed Iraqi civilian. At his arraignment at Camp Pendleton, California, Hutchins did not submit a plea, as he is requesting a civilian lawyer to replace his current military-appointed counsel. While the judge agreed to review this request, the trial is set to begin on August 18.

At age 29, Hutchins is charged with murder, conspiracy, obstruction of justice, larceny, and making false statements in connection to the fatal shooting of Hashim Ibrahim Awad, a 52-year-old Iraqi man. Witnesses allege Hutchins led a Marine squad to Hamdania, Iraq, aiming to stop suspected militants. Unable to locate their original target, the group reportedly took Awad—a non-suspect—from his home, killed him, and placed weapons to make it appear he was planting a bomb.

The event provoked strong reaction in the U.S. and Iraq, with Navy Secretary Ray Mabus labeling it 'cold-blooded murder.' Hutchins was found guilty in 2007 by a military jury, sentenced to 15 years (later reduced to 11), but his conviction has since been overturned and reinstated as legal appeals continue.

Hutchins claims both his military counsel and the judge are influenced by public opinions from military leaders and cannot be impartial. After the hearing, he told journalists that he and his pregnant wife, Reyna, hope to move past nearly eight years of legal uncertainty, noting the lasting strain on their family life. If convicted at retrial, he faces up to four more years in prison.

Hakim setuju untuk meninjau permintaannya, namun persidangan dijadwalkan tetap mulai pada 18 Agustus.

Peristiwa ini memicu kecaman di Amerika Serikat dan Irak. Sekretaris Angkatan Laut Ray Mabus menyebutnya sebagai 'pembunuhan berdarah dingin.' article_content: The Texas State Board of Education approved new science textbooks, but required some publishers to revise content that several Republican members argued misrepresented or cast fossil fuels in a negative light. This decision highlights long-standing disputes over climate change education in Texas schools. While individual school districts—over 1,000 across Texas—aren’t forced to use the board-approved textbooks, the recommendations are highly influential due to the state's large educational market. Although some say Texas’ sway over national textbook content has waned, the board’s votes still carry weight. Friday’s vote evaluated whether textbooks met 2021 state academic standards, which recognize humanity’s contribution to climate change and do not include creationism alongside evolution. Glenn Branch of the National Center on Science Education said many publishers complied with scientific consensus, but not all were accepted. For example, the publisher Green Ninja was criticized by some Republicans for a lesson asking students to write a fictional warning to family members about climate change. Despite attempts to present oil and gas more positively, the board rejected Green Ninja’s books. Four publishers were conditionally approved, pending changes to content about energy, fossil fuels, and evolution. One biology book was only accepted after agreeing to remove illustrations showing humans sharing ancestry with monkeys. Several Republican board members claimed that existing textbook options painted fossil fuels in a negative light and did not sufficiently discuss alternatives to evolution. Wayne Christian, a Republican oil and gas regulator in Texas, publicly advocated for textbooks that promoted the importance of fossil fuels. Another Republican board member, Aaron Kinsey, who leads an oil field company, voted against a personal finance textbook due to its depiction of the oil industry and called a line about energy conservation enabling independence a ‘half truth’. The majority of scientists concur that greenhouse gases from burning fossil fuels are raising global temperatures and destabilizing ecosystems. Ahead of the board’s decision, the National Science Teaching Association—representing 35,000 educators—urged a commitment to scientific accuracy on evolution and climate change, resisting political interference.

Sebagai contoh, penerbit Green Ninja dikritik oleh beberapa anggota Republik karena materi yang meminta siswa menulis surat fiktif memperingatkan keluarga tentang perubahan iklim. Meskipun telah mencoba memberi sudut pandang positif pada isu minyak dan gas, dewan tetap menolak buku Green Ninja. Empat penerbit lainnya mendapat persetujuan bersyarat, dengan syarat merevisi konten tentang energi, bahan bakar fosil, dan evolusi. Anggota dewan lain, Aaron Kinsey, seorang eksekutif jasa minyak, menolak buku pelajaran keuangan pribadi karena penggambaran industri minyak, serta menyebut pernyataan tentang konservasi energi demi kemandirian sebagai 'setengah kebenaran'. Mayoritas ilmuwan menyepakati bahwa gas rumah kaca dari bahan bakar fosil memicu kenaikan suhu global dan gangguan pada ekosistem. Sebelum keputusan dewan, National Science Teaching Association—mewakili 35.000 pendidik—mendesak komitmen pada akurasi ilmiah soal evolusi dan perubahan iklim serta menolak intervensi politik.

article_content: Blue Bloods, the long-running CBS crime drama starring Tom Selleck, will come to an end after its 14th season. CBS announced that the final season will be split into two parts, with the first 10 episodes premiering on February 16, 2024, and the remaining eight episodes airing in fall 2024. Viewers can also stream episodes live on Paramount+. Since its debut on September 24, 2010, Blue Bloods has held a prominent place in CBS' Friday night lineup, reaching a total of 293 episodes by the series finale. In a joint statement, Amy Reisenbach, president of CBS Entertainment, and David Stapf, president of CBS Studios, emphasized the show's legacy: 'Blue Bloods will forever be a beloved part of CBS’ history. It dominated Friday nights since its premiere and became a key part of our successful lineup, building an exceptionally loyal fan base.' They also expressed appreciation for the late Leonard Goldberg, who developed the show, and for Tom Selleck and the cast, whom viewers welcomed as family. Tom Selleck reflected on his experience: 'For the past 13 years, it has been an honor and a privilege to work on a show that celebrates the men and women who protect and serve New York City, and that highlights the importance of family. Working with such talented actors, writers, producers, directors, and crew has been a dream come true. I am grateful to have been part of this extraordinary group for more than 275 episodes.' Selleck’s collaboration with CBS spans 22 seasons, including eight with Magnum, P.I. and 14 with Blue Bloods. Looking ahead, CBS is developing two spinoffs from Fire Country and preparing to wrap up S.W.A.T. with its seventh and final season.

article_content: Kenyan police have made their largest-ever ivory bust, seizing two tonnes of tusks valued at over £700,000 at the port of Mombasa. Customs officials discovered 638 elephant tusks hidden inside a shipping container falsely labeled as 'decorative stones.' According to authorities, the ivory originated in Rwanda and Tanzania and was on its way to Indonesia. The confiscation comes just days after 11 elephants were killed in a Kenyan wildlife park—the biggest mass elephant killing recorded in the country. Poaching for ivory remains a serious problem across sub-Saharan Africa, threatening wildlife populations that play a key role in attracting tourism. Kiberenge Seroney, the head of criminal investigations at Mombasa port, described the haul as a massive breakthrough, but expressed disbelief at the smugglers' audacity, given the volume of ivory. Most of Africa's smuggled tusks are destined for Asian countries like China, Japan, and Thailand, driven by demand for ivory ornaments, jewelry, piano keys, and billiard balls. Poaching incidents have sharply increased in the past decade, with eight out of ten elephant deaths now caused by poachers compared to four out of ten six years ago. The illegal ivory trade, which plummeted after Kenya banned it in 1989, has recently surged. In 2011, about 25 tons of illegal ivory were seized worldwide, representing the killing of around 2,500 elephants—the highest since the ban. Despite efforts by wildlife rangers and armed task forces, many poachers evade capture. In one major incident in Tsavo East National Park, a group of roughly ten attackers killed 11 elephants in a single day, removing their tusks. Kenya and neighboring nations have also seen large shipments of ivory traced back to their ports, with some heading to Sri Lanka and others to Asia.

Perburuan gading masih menjadi masalah serius di seluruh Afrika sub-Sahara, mengancam populasi satwa liar yang menjadi daya tarik wisata utama. article_content: Oleg Bugaev, a pilot for Russia's Aeroflot airline, has come under criticism for making harsh statements about Ukrainians, both during a flight and on his public social media accounts. At 30, Bugaev has posted several derogatory comments about Ukrainians online and has made inappropriate jokes about the MH17 tragedy. The issue gained attention after Slovakian diplomat Martin Kaco tweeted about an incident on a flight from Moscow to Vienna, where Bugaev reportedly referred to part of Ukraine as being inhabited by 'Banderovtsi and other filth,' referencing the divisive historical figure Stepan Bandera. These remarks surprised and disturbed passengers, drawing widespread attention. Aeroflot acknowledged that the pilot had violated company policy by expressing personal views during work and initiated an internal review. However, the airline has not provided any further details about disciplinary measures. Despite the investigation, Bugaev’s social media activity has continued to show anti-Ukrainian rhetoric. He has made posts attributing blame for the MH17 incident to Ukrainians, voicing support for Russian separatists, and using insults against Ukrainian officials such as President Petro Poroshenko and former EU foreign policy chief Baroness Ashton. Responding to the criticism on pilot forums, Bugaev claimed he was misquoted regarding his on-flight statement, but admitted wrongdoing and acknowledged he failed to uphold Aeroflot standards. Bugaev, originally from Lugansk, explained that his anger toward Ukrainians is informed by personal losses during the conflict, including the destruction of his family home. He said his family suffered due to ongoing violence in the region. Nevertheless, because his online remarks have remained offensive, many question the sincerity of Bugaev’s apology. Aeroflot has yet to clarify what consequences, if any, the pilot will face.

article_content: A new study in Nature Communications demonstrates that soundscape recordings coupled with artificial intelligence offer an effective means to monitor biodiversity recovery in regenerating tropical forests. Tropical forests are crucial in combating climate change and biodiversity loss. Large-scale restoration efforts are increasing worldwide to address deforestation. However, accurately measuring how quickly and successfully biodiversity returns during forest regeneration is challenging and often debated. Reliable data on biodiversity gains is essential for sustainable management and securing funding for restoration initiatives. Traditional comprehensive biodiversity surveys are costly, complex, and demand significant taxonomic expertise. In this research, an international team examined whether bioacoustics and AI could overcome these barriers by tracking biodiversity recovery across 43 plots in Ecuador, representing a gradient from active pastures and cacao farms to abandoned farmland regenerating for 1–34 years, as well as old-growth forests. The team used three main approaches: expert identification of vocalizing vertebrates from sound recordings, analysis of acoustic indices, and an AI model trained to recognize bird species. In addition, insect diversity was assessed through DNA metabarcoding. Results showed that vertebrate communities changed along the regeneration gradient, with old-growth forests displaying distinct compositions. Automated acoustic measures strongly reflected the stages of forest recovery: acoustic indices accounted for 62% of the variation in vertebrate communities, while AI-derived bird community data explained 69%. Both automated measures were also significantly correlated with insect diversity, signalling a broader ecosystem recovery. According to the lead author, soundscape analysis is a robust and reproducible method for monitoring the recovery of animal communities from agricultural land to old-growth forests. The study highlights the promise of automated monitoring—even with limited AI training data—for providing cost-effective, scalable assessments of restoration outcomes. A co-author noted that well-documented soundscape data allows retrospective re-analysis as algorithms and methods improve. Implementing these monitoring techniques can help prevent greenwashing and support sustainable funding by providing evidence of genuine biodiversity gains. Overall, the research demonstrates that bioacoustics and AI together provide an effective approach for measuring and tracking biodiversity recovery in regenerating tropical forests, bolstering restoration efforts for climate change mitigation and conservation.
translated_content: Sebuah studi baru di Nature Communications menunjukkan bahwa rekaman soundscape yang dikombinasikan dengan kecerdasan buatan (AI) dapat menjadi cara efektif untuk memantau pemulihan keanekaragaman hayati di hutan tropis yang sedang beregenerasi. Hutan tropis sangat penting dalam mengatasi perubahan iklim dan hilangnya keanekaragaman hayati. Upaya restorasi berskala besar semakin meluas di seluruh dunia untuk menanggulangi deforestasi. Namun, pengukuran yang akurat tentang seberapa cepat dan berhasilnya keanekaragaman hayati kembali selama regenerasi hutan tetap menjadi tantangan dan kerap diperdebatkan. Data yang dapat dipercaya mengenai peningkatan keanekaragaman hayati sangat krusial untuk pengelolaan berkelanjutan dan penggalangan dana bagi proyek restorasi. Survei keanekaragaman hayati yang komprehensif secara tradisional mahal, rumit, dan membutuhkan keahlian taksonomi yang tinggi. Dalam penelitian ini, tim internasional menguji apakah bioakustik dan AI dapat mengatasi hambatan tersebut dengan memantau pemulihan keanekaragaman hayati di 43 plot di Ekuador, yang mewakili rentang dari padang rumput dan kebun kakao aktif, lahan pertanian yang ditinggalkan serta sedang tumbuh kembali selama 1–34 tahun, hingga hutan primer. Tim menggunakan tiga pendekatan utama: identifikasi vertebrata bersuara oleh ahli dari rekaman, analisis indeks akustik, serta model AI yang dilatih untuk mengenali spesies burung. Selain itu, keanekaragaman serangga dianalisis menggunakan DNA metabarcoding. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan komunitas vertebrata mengalami perubahan sepanjang gradien regenerasi, di mana hutan primer memiliki komposisi yang khas. Ukuran akustik otomatis sangat mencerminkan tahapan pemulihan: indeks akustik menjelaskan 62% variasi komunitas vertebrata, sementara data komunitas burung yang dihasilkan AI menjelaskan 69%. Kedua ukuran otomatis ini juga berkorelasi kuat dengan keanekaragaman serangga, menandakan pemulihan ekosistem yang lebih luas. Menurut penulis utama, analisis soundscape adalah metode yang kuat dan dapat direplikasi untuk memantau pemulihan fauna mulai dari lahan pertanian hingga hutan primer. Studi ini menyoroti potensi monitoring otomatis—bahkan dengan data AI regional yang terbatas—untuk menyediakan penilaian hasil restorasi secara hemat biaya dan berskala. Seorang penulis lain menambahkan data soundscape yang terdokumentasi baik memungkinkan analisis ulang di masa mendatang seiring peningkatan algoritma. Penerapan monitoring ini dapat mencegah praktik greenwashing dan mendukung pendanaan berkelanjutan dengan bukti nyata kenaikan keanekaragaman hayati. Secara keseluruhan, riset ini menunjukkan bioakustik dan AI adalah pendekatan efektif untuk mengukur dan melacak pemulihan keanekaragaman hayati di hutan tropis, memperkuat upaya restorasi demi mitigasi perubahan iklim dan konservasi.

article_content: This article was originally published on November 7 and republished on November 8. When people ask me how to get into games journalism these days, my main advice is to reconsider. While I am fortunate to have my position, the industry is unstable and challenging. Recently, notable changes occurred at The Escapist, a longstanding gaming site, where several team members, including Editor-in-Chief Nick Calandra, were dismissed for reportedly not meeting targets set by parent company Gamurs. Following Calandra’s firing, many staff members, contributors, and producers announced their departures on social media, with several indicating plans to collaborate with Calandra on a new project. These exits effectively dismantled The Escapist’s video department, especially marked by the departure of Yahtzee Croshaw, the well-known creator of Zero Punctuation—a prominent video game criticism series. Although Croshaw resigned willingly, he does not own the Zero Punctuation brand, so his future work will not use that branding. It seems unlikely the brand can continue without him, even if The Escapist retains it. Calandra appears to have been a respected Editor-in-Chief, earning loyalty from his team. Gamurs’ growth targets may have been unrealistic for the industry, and their shift from native video to primarily YouTube seems to have ultimately reduced revenue, leaving The Escapist without a video department. Currently, The Escapist continues to publish articles, though the remaining staff and freelancers are unclear, as are any plans to rebuild the video section. Without the previous team and a figure like Yahtzee, the future of The Escapist's video presence is uncertain. Calandra’s new project is of particular interest, as the team has strong support, and they aim to produce content free from corporate oversight. More information will be shared as it becomes available. I have contacted Gamurs for comment and will update as needed. Update: It is now confirmed that the entire Escapist video staff either resigned or was let go. Nick Calandra has announced the launch of Second Wind, a new company focused on reviving their video content independently of Gamurs. Yahtzee Croshaw will also join the new channel, though without the Zero Punctuation branding. The Second Wind channel has already attracted almost 40,000 YouTube subscribers and has a Patreon with over 900 members. This suggests that plans for this transition had been underway for some time, and there had been signs of this shift within The Escapist. It remains unclear whether Calandra anticipated his dismissal or planned to leave, but The Escapist currently lacks a video department, while Second Wind offers a new platform for its former staff. Succeeding in gaming media is challenging both inside and outside corporate structures; corporate environments can be difficult, while independence brings its own risks. Second Wind benefits from significant initial support from longtime fans, indicating a promising start.

The University of London is planning to auction four of Shakespeare's folios, including an exceptionally rare first edition, prompting sharp criticism from experts who call the move 'stupidity of the highest order.' Academics are concerned that, if the sale goes forward, the 17th-century manuscripts may end up in private hands overseas, limiting access for research and the public. Only 232 copies of the 1623 First Folio are believed to have survived intact, each featuring the renowned engraving of Shakespeare by Martin Droeshout.

The rare folios are currently housed at the University's Senate House Library, having been bequeathed in 1958 by American philanthropist Sir Louis Sterling, with the intention that they not be sold. The University aims to fetch around £5 million at Bonhams auction house in November, arguing that, as the library holds two copies of the First Folio, selling one 'duplicate' is reasonable. Senate House Library Director Christopher Pressler explained the rationale to The Times.

However, Shakespeare authority Sir Brian Vickers of University College London countered this, emphasizing that no two First Folios are identical due to unique corrections and variances introduced during early printing. He described the sale proposal as 'rubbish' and highlighted that even minor corrections in one copy could hold lasting scholarly significance.

Many first folios have already left the UK, prompting further concern. In a letter to Christopher Pressler, Professor Henry Woudhuysen of Lincoln College, Oxford, warned that the sale could damage the library's reputation and alienate supporters and potential donors. He criticized the sale rationale as 'muddled' and questioned the library's management strategies.

Dr Peter Kirwin, a Shakespeare lecturer at the University of Nottingham and trustee of the British Shakespeare Association, also condemned the plan, noting that the books were intended as a permanent gift. He argued that restricting public access to such works would be a serious loss.

The University maintains that proceeds from the sale would be used to acquire additional manuscripts from the 20th and 21st centuries—a move Professor Woudhuysen described as a 'gamble,' likening the potential loss to 'leaving the library as Hamlet without the prince.' The proposed sale is currently under consultation, with the manuscripts scheduled for a tour of US cities before the auction.

Para akademisi khawatir jika penjualan ini berjalan, manuskrip abad ke-17 tersebut akan jatuh ke tangan kolektor pribadi di luar negeri, sehingga membatasi akses untuk penelitian dan publik. Rencana penjualan ini masih dalam tahap konsultasi, dan manuskrip dijadwalkan untuk tur ke beberapa kota di Amerika Serikat sebelum lelang.

article_content: A public memorial service for legendary heavy metal singer Ronnie James Dio is scheduled for Sunday. Members of the Westboro Baptist Church have announced plans to picket the ceremony at Forest Lawn Hollywood Hills in Los Angeles, claiming Dio engaged in Satan worship. The church, based in Topeka, Kansas, is known for its anti-LGBTQ stance and frequent protests at soldiers' funerals. Ronnie James Dio passed away on May 16 after a battle with stomach cancer at age 67. Accusations of devil worship have often been directed at heavy metal music, with Dio specifically targeted. He is widely recognized for popularizing the 'devil's horn' gesture—raising the index and little finger with the thumb pressed against the middle two fingers—a symbol he said was taught to him by his superstitious Italian grandmother to ward off the 'evil eye.' However, some fundamentalist Christians have interpreted the gesture as a satanic symbol. Wendy Dio, Dio's wife, responded to the planned protest by urging fans to ignore the picketers, emphasizing Ronnie's rejection of prejudice and violence. The memorial will include a donation center for the 'Stand Up and Shout Cancer Fund,' established in Dio's memory. Dio was last performing with Heaven and Hell, a group formed from Black Sabbath members, although all concerts were canceled in March due to his illness. His final public appearance was in April at the Revolver Golden Gods Awards, where he received a vocalist of the year award. Born as Ronald James Padavona in 1942, Dio began his professional music career in high school in the late 1950s. His band The Electric Elves became Elf in the early 1970s, shifting to a heavier blues rock sound. Dio later joined Rainbow, making the music darker, before joining Black Sabbath in 1979. With Black Sabbath, he contributed to albums like 'Heaven and Hell,' 'Mob Rules,' and 'Live Evil.' He left the band in 1982, had a brief reunion a decade later, and then formed the band Dio as well as the group Heaven and Hell.

article_content: Microsoft's recent acquisition of Activision-Blizzard, the developer behind Call of Duty, has not changed the trend of growing data requirements in modern games. Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3, which launches in Early Access today, requires an enormous 213 gigabytes of SSD-only storage. For perspective, that's about a third of the usable storage space on a PlayStation 5, and roughly fifteen times larger than Skyrim. This reflects a growing pattern among major game developers to release large titles with significant storage needs. These increasing install sizes, sometimes due to uncompressed files like audio, often force players to remove other games to make room. Major releases such as Red Dead Redemption 2 first surpassed the 100GB mark in 2018, so seeing games now over 200GB is noteworthy. Gamers may want to consider investing in additional storage.

Sebagai perbandingan, ini setara dengan sekitar sepertiga total penyimpanan yang dapat dipakai di PlayStation 5, dan sekitar lima belas kali lebih besar dari Skyrim. Hal ini menunjukkan pola yang berkembang di kalangan pengembang game besar untuk merilis judul berukuran sangat besar. Ukuran instalasi yang meningkat ini, terkadang akibat file audio yang tidak dikompresi, sering memaksa pemain menghapus game lain agar cukup ruang. Game besar seperti Red Dead Redemption 2 pertama kali melewati batas 100GB pada 2018, sehingga melihat ada game yang kini sudah di atas 200GB cukup mencolok. article_content: Apple is facing criticism for its decision to withdraw from the EPEAT environmental certification program for electronics. EPEAT, used by U.S. federal agencies to guide electronic purchases, aims to certify products that are recyclable and energy-efficient. According to Sarah O'Brien, EPEAT spokeswoman, federal agencies are required to purchase 95% of their electronics from EPEAT-compliant brands, which could significantly limit Apple's federal sales of desktop and laptop computers. However, EPEAT standards currently do not apply to tablets or smartphones, so iPads and iPhones remain eligible for purchase by these agencies. San Francisco also requires that city departments buy only EPEAT-certified desktop and laptop computers, said Christine Falvey, a spokeswoman for the mayor. Unless Apple re-joins the program, its desktop and laptop computers cannot be purchased by the city. Falvey expressed hope that Apple would reconsider its decision and return to EPEAT certification. Apple has not officially explained its withdrawal, but EPEAT CEO Robert Frisbee suggests it is due to a shift in Apple's product design philosophy, particularly in devices like the MacBook Pro with Retina Display. This laptop model has a glued-in battery, making recycling and repairs more difficult and potentially preventing EPEAT compliance. Despite leaving EPEAT, Apple spokeswoman Kristin Huguet stated that all Apple products meet strict U.S. government energy efficiency standards, such as Energy Star 5.2. Huguet added that Apple publishes the greenhouse gas emissions of each product on its website and participates in recycling efforts in most areas where it operates. EPEAT expressed regret over Apple's departure, hoping the company might return to its registry in the future. Meanwhile, environmental organization Greenpeace ranks Apple as average among major technology firms—trailing HP and Dell, but ahead of Samsung and Sony—in sustainability practices.

article_content: A new analysis suggests that switching all pet dogs and cats in the U.S. and worldwide to nutritionally complete vegan diets could provide significant environmental sustainability benefits, such as reduced freshwater use and greenhouse gas emissions. Andrew Knight from Griffith University, Australia, presented these findings in the open-access journal PLOS ONE. The livestock industry has substantial environmental impacts, including land and freshwater consumption and the emission of pollutants. While many previous studies have examined livestock's impact on human diets, few have focused on the environmental effects of pet diets. Recent research indicates that nutritionally balanced vegan diets—free of meat, eggs, and dairy—can be safe and just as healthy for cats and dogs as conventional diets. This raises questions about their potential environmental benefits. To explore this, Knight estimated the impacts if all pet cats and dogs in the U.S. or globally were switched to vegan diets, using pet population data (from 2020 for the U.S. and 2018 globally) and a range of published studies and government databases. The report finds that in the U.S., dogs and cats consume about one-fifth as much livestock as humans do, and about one-tenth globally. If every U.S. pet were switched to a vegan diet, nearly 2 billion terrestrial livestock animals could be spared from slaughter each year—rising to nearly 7 billion animals if the change happened worldwide. Billions of aquatic animals would also be spared. Switching pet diets could lead to substantial reductions in land and water use, greenhouse gas emissions, use of biocides, and other pollutants. For example, converting all dogs worldwide to vegan diets could free up land larger than Saudi Arabia; for cats, larger than Germany. In comparison, if all humans went vegan, land savings could exceed the combined area of Russia and India. Switching all dogs' food could reduce greenhouse gas emissions by more than the UK's annual total, and a switch for cats could reduce emissions equivalent to Israel's total. Knight notes that the data on pet populations and animal energy needs may understate actual numbers, so the true environmental benefits may be even greater. However, since several assumptions were required—and older data and U.S. ingredient profiles were sometimes applied for global estimates—these calculations should be interpreted with caution. More up-to-date and specific research is needed. Knight adds that vegan diets for pets must be nutritionally complete and produced by reputable companies to ensure animal health.
translated_content: Sebuah analisa baru menunjukkan bahwa mengganti semua makanan anjing dan kucing peliharaan di AS dan seluruh dunia menjadi pola makan vegan yang bergizi lengkap dapat memberikan manfaat signifikan bagi keberlanjutan lingkungan, seperti pengurangan penggunaan air tawar dan emisi gas rumah kaca. Andrew Knight dari Griffith University, Australia, memaparkan temuan ini di jurnal akses terbuka PLOS ONE. Industri peternakan memiliki dampak lingkungan yang besar, termasuk konsumsi lahan dan air serta emisi polutan. Meski banyak penelitian sebelumnya mengkaji dampak peternakan terkait konsumsi manusia, hanya sedikit yang fokus pada efek lingkungan dari pola makan hewan peliharaan. Riset terbaru menunjukkan bahwa pola makan vegan yang seimbang gizi—tanpa daging, telur, dan susu—dapat aman dan sama sehatnya untuk kucing dan anjing dibandingkan makanan konvensional. Hal ini memunculkan pertanyaan tentang potensi manfaat lingkungannya. Untuk meneliti hal ini, Knight memperkirakan dampak jika semua kucing dan anjing peliharaan di AS maupun dunia beralih ke pola makan vegan, dengan menggunakan data populasi hewan peliharaan (tahun 2020 untuk AS dan 2018 untuk global) serta berbagai studi dan basis data pemerintah. Laporan ini menemukan bahwa di AS, anjing dan kucing mengonsumsi sekitar seperlima ternak dibandingkan manusia, dan secara global sekitar sepersepuluhnya. Jika seluruh hewan peliharaan di AS beralih ke pola makan vegan, hampir 2 miliar hewan ternak darat bisa terhindar dari penyembelihan tiap tahun—dan hampir 7 miliar jika perubahan ini terjadi di seluruh dunia. Miliaran hewan air juga akan terselamatkan. Pergantian pola makan hewan peliharaan bisa menghasilkan pengurangan signifikan dalam penggunaan lahan dan air, emisi gas rumah kaca, penggunaan biocida, serta polusi lainnya. Misalnya, mengalihkan pola makan semua anjing di dunia ke vegan bisa membebaskan lahan yang lebih luas dari Arab Saudi; untuk kucing, lebih besar daripada Jerman. Sebagai perbandingan, jika seluruh manusia jadi vegan, lahan yang diselamatkan bisa melebihi gabungan luas Rusia dan India. Pengalihan makanan seluruh anjing dapat memangkas emisi gas rumah kaca lebih dari jumlah emisi tahunan Inggris, dan perubahan untuk kucing setara dengan total emisi Israel. Knight menambahkan, data populasi dan kebutuhan energi hewan peliharaan mungkin belum sepenuhnya akurat sehingga manfaat lingkungan sebenarnya bisa lebih besar. Namun, karena adanya beberapa asumsi—dan penggunaan data lama serta profil bahan baku AS untuk estimasi global—perhitungan ini mesti dipahami dengan hati-hati. US Secretary of State Antony Blinken met with Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas in Ramallah, as mounting casualties in Gaza increased anger among Arab states. Abbas told Blinken there must be an immediate ceasefire during their meeting in the occupied West Bank on Sunday, according to his spokesperson. This call echoes Arab leaders demanding a truce as the death toll in Gaza approaches 10,000.

Al Jazeera correspondent Mohammed Jamjoom, reporting from Ramallah, said the meeting lasted less than an hour—shorter than expected—and concluded without a press conference or public statements, indicating notable disagreements between US and Palestinian leadership. Jamjoom said Abbas's main demand was a ceasefire, while the US is only supporting "humanitarian pauses," not a full ceasefire.

The rising toll in Gaza has brought US diplomatic efforts under increased scrutiny from its Arab allies, who are frustrated with the worsening humanitarian crisis. Israel continues its military offensive, with air raids killing over 50 people late Saturday. In Amman, Jordanian Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ayman Safadi stressed Arab countries want an immediate ceasefire, warning the region risks lasting animosity. "We do not accept this as self-defense," Safadi said about Israel’s assault, which has killed at least 9,488 Palestinians, more than a third children. "It cannot be justified and it will not bring security or peace." Egyptian Foreign Minister Sameh Shoukry also called for an immediate and comprehensive ceasefire. Egypt remains the main channel for aid entering Gaza and for the evacuation of foreign nationals.

However, Blinken stated at a news conference that the US opposes a ceasefire, arguing it would allow Hamas to regroup after the October 7 attack that killed about 1,400 Israelis, mostly civilians. Blinken is attempting to balance Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's insistence on continuing the offensive "at full force" with calls from Arab leaders for a ceasefire. Netanyahu dismissed the idea of a humanitarian pause and said Israel will not agree to a temporary ceasefire unless it includes the release of hostages. Israeli airstrikes have hit United Nations-run schools and refugee centers, including a strike at the al-Maghazi refugee camp on Sunday that killed at least 47 people.

Al Jazeera’s Alan Fisher, reporting from occupied East Jerusalem, said there is dissatisfaction with how the US is managing the crisis. Anwar Gargash, adviser to the UAE president, warned that without improvement, American efforts will not be seen as effective. Al Jazeera’s political analyst Marwan Bishara argued the US's call for a "humanitarian pause" is not enough.

During Blinken’s first visit to the occupied West Bank since the war began, the US State Department stayed silent on the trip until his departure. Nonetheless, reports of his arrival sparked protests against US support for Israel. There were no joint statements from Abbas or Blinken. State Department spokesperson Matthew Miller said Blinken reaffirmed US commitment to providing humanitarian aid to Gaza and opposed the forced displacement of Palestinians. They also discussed restoring calm in the West Bank, including stopping violence by Israeli settlers. Although Blinken previously mentioned the Palestinian Authority could play a future role in Gaza's governance, it's unclear if this was discussed with Abbas.

Palestinian activist Fadi Quran suggested Blinken’s main mission was to communicate the US position against a ceasefire to Palestinian officials, who face growing public discontent. After the meeting, Blinken traveled to Turkey to meet President Recep Tayyip Erdogan. Relations between Ankara and Israel have declined due to Erdogan’s criticism of Israel’s conduct in Gaza. On Saturday, Erdogan announced Turkey had recalled its ambassador to Israel, declaring Netanyahu was no longer a negotiating partner. Israel’s foreign minister responded by accusing Erdogan of siding with Hamas.

Menteri Luar Negeri AS Antony Blinken bertemu Presiden Palestina Mahmoud Abbas di Ramallah, di tengah lonjakan korban jiwa di Gaza yang memicu kemarahan negara-negara Arab. Abbas mengatakan kepada Blinken bahwa harus ada gencatan senjata segera dalam pertemuan mereka di Tepi Barat yang diduduki pada Minggu, menurut jubir Abbas. Seruan ini selaras dengan tuntutan para pemimpin Arab akan gencatan senjata ketika korban tewas di Gaza mendekati 10.000.

Koresponden Al Jazeera, Mohammed Jamjoom, melaporkan dari Ramallah bahwa pertemuan itu kurang dari satu jam—lebih singkat dari perkiraan—dan berakhir tanpa konferensi pers atau pernyataan publik, mengindikasikan perbedaan pendapat signifikan antara pimpinan AS dan Palestina. Jamjoom menyebut permintaan utama Abbas adalah gencatan senjata, sedangkan AS hanya mendukung "jeda kemanusiaan", bukan gencatan senjata penuh.

Meningkatnya korban di Gaza membuat upaya diplomasi AS semakin disorot oleh sekutu Arab yang frustrasi dengan situasi kemanusiaan memburuk. Israel melanjutkan serangan militer dengan serangan udara yang menewaskan lebih dari 50 orang pada Sabtu malam. Di Amman, Wakil PM dan Menlu Yordania, Ayman Safadi, menegaskan Arab ingin gencatan senjata segera dan memperingatkan kawasan bisa terseret dalam permusuhan berkepanjangan. "Kami tidak menerima ini sebagai pembelaan diri," kata Safadi tentang serangan Israel yang telah menewaskan setidaknya 9.488 warga Palestina, lebih dari sepertiganya anak-anak. "Ini tidak bisa dibenarkan dan tidak akan menghadirkan keamanan ataupun perdamaian." Menlu Mesir Sameh Shoukry juga menyerukan gencatan senjata segera dan menyeluruh. Mesir tetap jadi jalur utama bantuan ke Gaza dan evakuasi warga asing.

Namun, Blinken menyatakan pada konferensi pers bahwa AS menolak gencatan senjata karena dianggap akan memberi Hamas waktu untuk menguatkan kembali setelah serangan 7 Oktober yang menewaskan sekitar 1.400 warga Israel, mayoritas warga sipil. Blinken berusaha menyeimbangkan tekanan dari PM Israel Benjamin Netanyahu yang ingin melanjutkan ofensifnya "dengan kekuatan penuh" dengan desakan pemimpin Arab atas gencatan senjata. Netanyahu menolak jeda kemanusiaan dan menegaskan Israel tidak akan setuju gencatan senjata sementara tanpa pembebasan sandera. Serangan udara Israel juga menghantam sekolah serta pusat pengungsian PBB, termasuk serangan di kamp pengungsi al-Maghazi hari Minggu yang menewaskan setidaknya 47 orang.

Alan Fisher dari Al Jazeera, melaporkan dari Yerusalem Timur yang diduduki, mengatakan muncul ketidakpuasan atas penanganan AS. Anwar Gargash, penasihat presiden UEA, memperingatkan tanpa perubahan, peran AS akan dipandang tidak efektif. Analis politik Al Jazeera, Marwan Bishara, menilai seruan AS soal "jeda kemanusiaan" tidaklah cukup.

Pada kunjungan pertama Blinken ke Tepi Barat yang diduduki sejak perang bermula, Kemenlu AS bungkam hingga Blinken pergi. Laporan soal kedatangannya pun memicu protes terhadap dukungan AS ke Israel. Tak ada pernyataan bersama Abbas dan Blinken. Jubir Kemenlu AS Matthew Miller menyatakan Blinken menegaskan komitmen AS pada bantuan kemanusiaan untuk Gaza dan menolak pemindahan paksa warga Palestina. Mereka juga membahas upaya memulihkan ketenangan di Tepi Barat dan menghentikan kekerasan oleh pemukim Israel. Meski Blinken sebelumnya menyebut Otoritas Palestina dapat berperan di Gaza ke depan, tak jelas isu ini dibahas dengan Abbas.

Aktivis Palestina Fadi Quran menilai misi utama Blinken ialah menjelaskan sikap AS yang menolak gencatan senjata kepada pihak Palestina, yang menghadapi ketidakpuasan publik makin besar. Setelah pertemuan, Blinken menuju Turki untuk bertemu Presiden Recep Tayyip Erdogan. Hubungan antara Turki-Israel memburuk akibat kritik Erdogan terhadap Israel di Gaza. Sabtu lalu, Erdogan umumkan penarikan dubes Turki dari Israel, sebut Netanyahu bukan lagi mitra negosiasi. Menlu Israel menuduh Erdogan memihak Hamas.

article_content: Joy at work pays off. Numerous studies over the years have highlighted the importance of employee engagement. For instance, a 2023 report from Microsoft’s WorkLab, which explores the latest science and thinking about work, found that organizations with high employee engagement show stronger financial performance. There are several reasons for this impact. Companies with highly engaged employees experience higher productivity, reduced absenteeism and turnover, and fewer safety incidents and quality issues, as outlined in a 2013 Harvard Business Review article. While correlation doesn’t always mean causation, consistent findings across multiple studies over time provide strong circumstantial evidence for these benefits. This leads to a key question: What does 'engagement' actually mean? A simple way to measure it is by considering whether employees enjoy their work. Those who enjoy their jobs tend to be more engaged, while those who see their roles as just a paycheck tend to be less engaged. Employees who find their jobs tedious can negatively impact their teams, be absent more often, change jobs frequently, produce less, and make more mistakes. Recently, the BCG Henderson Institute (the Boston Consulting Group’s think tank) conducted the 'Making Work Work' survey with over 1,000 respondents across industries and job roles. The survey explored how much time people spend on various activities, how effective they feel in those activities, and how much enjoyment they derive from them. Activities surveyed included administrative tasks, focus work, collaboration, training, and team building. For managers, activities like overseeing work and coaching were also included. The main finding was striking: employees who enjoy their work are 40% less likely to look for another job. Overall, employers risk losing up to 69% of employees who don’t enjoy their work, but this drops to 41% among those who do—representing a 40% reduction in attrition risk. In summary, joy pays. The survey also identified collaboration and team affiliation as key contributors to workplace joy. Leaders should prioritize opportunities for these activities. However, it’s important that in-person time is intentionally used for collaboration, rather than administrative tasks, to make commuting worthwhile. Notably, the survey found that respondents spend about 25% of their time on administrative work, 17% on interactive work, and only 3% on team-building activities. For non-administrative roles, this admin burden should be minimized, as most people do not enjoy it. Administrative work received the lowest enjoyment ratings among all work activities. To address this, companies should rethink how to eliminate or use technology—such as generative AI—to reduce tedious administrative tasks. As organizations adopt flexible, tech-driven solutions to improve customer value and productivity, adding joy at work to the list of organizational goals is essential.
translated_content: Kebahagiaan dalam bekerja benar-benar berdampak positif. Berbagai studi selama bertahun-tahun menunjukkan pentingnya keterlibatan karyawan. Misalnya, laporan WorkLab dari Microsoft tahun 2023, yang membahas perkembangan ilmu dan pemikiran terbaru tentang dunia kerja, menemukan bahwa organisasi dengan tingkat keterlibatan karyawan tinggi memiliki kinerja keuangan yang lebih baik. Ada beberapa alasan yang menyebabkan dampak ini. Perusahaan dengan karyawan yang sangat terlibat mengalami produktivitas yang lebih tinggi, penurunan angka absensi dan pergantian, serta lebih sedikit insiden keselamatan dan masalah kualitas, sebagaimana dijelaskan dalam artikel Harvard Business Review tahun 2013. Walaupun korelasi tidak selalu berarti sebab-akibat, temuan yang konsisten dari berbagai studi selama bertahun-tahun memberikan bukti kuat secara tidak langsung. Ini menimbulkan pertanyaan kunci: Apa sebenarnya makna 'keterlibatan'? Cara sederhana untuk mengukurnya adalah dengan melihat apakah karyawan menikmati pekerjaannya. Mereka yang menikmati pekerjaan cenderung lebih terlibat, sementara yang sekadar melihat pekerjaan sebagai sumber penghasilan biasanya kurang terlibat. Karyawan yang menganggap pekerjaannya membosankan dapat berdampak buruk bagi tim, lebih sering absen, sering berganti pekerjaan, produktivitas menurun, dan lebih banyak melakukan kesalahan. Baru-baru ini, BCG Henderson Institute (think tank dari Boston Consulting Group) melakukan survei 'Making Work Work' dengan lebih dari 1.000 responden dari berbagai industri dan peran pekerjaan. Survei ini menggali waktu yang dihabiskan dalam berbagai aktivitas, tingkat efektivitas dalam menjalankannya, serta seberapa besar kenikmatan yang dirasakan. Aktivitas yang disurvei meliputi tugas administratif, pekerjaan fokus, kolaborasi, pelatihan, dan pembangunan tim. Untuk manajer, aktivitas seperti supervisi dan coaching juga ditanyakan. Temuan utamanya sangat mencolok: karyawan yang menikmati pekerjaannya 40% lebih kecil kemungkinannya mencari pekerjaan baru. Secara keseluruhan, perusahaan berisiko kehilangan hingga 69% karyawan yang tidak menikmati pekerjaannya, namun angka ini turun menjadi 41% pada mereka yang menikmatinya—artinya ada penurunan risiko keluar sebesar 40%. Singkatnya, kebahagiaan itu menguntungkan. Survei juga menunjukkan bahwa kolaborasi dan afiliasi tim adalah kontributor utama kebahagiaan di tempat kerja. Para pemimpin harus memprioritaskan kegiatan semacam ini. Namun, penting agar waktu tatap muka secara langsung benar-benar dialokasikan untuk kolaborasi, bukan untuk tugas administratif, sehingga perjalanan ke kantor menjadi bermanfaat. Menariknya, survei menemukan bahwa responden menghabiskan sekitar 25% waktu untuk pekerjaan administratif, 17% untuk pekerjaan interaktif, dan hanya 3% untuk kegiatan pembangunan tim. Untuk peran yang bukan bersifat administratif, beban admin ini sebaiknya dikurangi, karena sebagian besar orang tidak menikmatinya. Pekerjaan administratif mendapat tingkat kenikmatan terendah di antara semua aktivitas kerja. Untuk mengatasinya, perusahaan harus memikirkan cara menghilangkan atau memanfaatkan teknologi—seperti AI generatif—untuk mengurangi tugas administratif yang membosankan. Ketika organisasi mengadopsi solusi inovatif berbasis teknologi untuk meningkatkan nilai pelanggan dan produktivitas, menambahkan kebahagiaan dalam bekerja sebagai tujuan organisasi juga sangat penting.

article_content: Dr. Kate Stone, a technology entrepreneur and former Cambridge academic, narrowly survived a devastating accident when a trapped stag charged and gored her in the neck during a holiday in the Scottish Highlands. The incident took place in the early hours of December 30 as Dr. Stone and her friends returned to her holiday home in Lochailort. The startled deer, unable to escape from the garden, panicked and collided with her, causing serious injuries. Dr. Stone was airlifted to a hospital in Glasgow, where she spent a week in a medically induced coma and underwent two surgeries on her throat. Medical staff later revealed that the antler had pierced her trachea and oesophagus, damaged her vocal cords, fractured her neck, and stopped just millimeters from her spinal cord. Two months after the attack, Dr. Stone continues her recovery at her sister's home in Dundee. She relies on a feeding tube for nutrition and is still unable to return to her role as the leader of Novalia, the high-tech print company she established. Reflecting on the experience, Dr. Stone expressed immense gratitude for surviving such a life-threatening event. She described remaining calm and focusing on her breathing while waiting for her friends to come to her aid, acknowledging that her situation could have worsened at any moment. Despite the challenges, Dr. Stone is optimistic about her recovery and hopes to get back to work in the next few months. She says the accident has reinforced her awareness of life's uncertainty, often reminding others that anything can happen without warning.
translated_content: Dr. Kate Stone, seorang pengusaha teknologi dan mantan akademisi di Cambridge, hampir kehilangan nyawa dalam kecelakaan parah ketika seekor rusa jantan yang terperangkap menyerangnya dan menusuk lehernya saat berlibur di dataran tinggi Skotlandia. Kejadian itu berlangsung pada dini hari tanggal 30 Desember saat Dr. Stone dan teman-temannya pulang ke rumah liburan mereka di Lochailort. Rusa yang panik karena terjebak di taman tiba-tiba menabraknya, menyebabkan cedera serius. Dr. Stone diterbangkan ke rumah sakit di Glasgow dengan helikopter, di mana dia harus melewati koma medis selama seminggu dan menjalani dua operasi pada tenggorokannya. Tim medis kemudian menyampaikan bahwa tanduk rusa menembus trakea dan kerongkongan, merusak pita suara, mematahkan lehernya, dan berhenti hanya beberapa milimeter dari sumsum tulang belakang. Dua bulan setelah insiden, Dr. Stone masih menjalani pemulihan di rumah kakaknya di Dundee. Ia masih mengandalkan selang makan untuk makan dan minum, serta belum bisa kembali memimpin Novalia, perusahaan teknologi cetak yang didirikannya. Mengenang kejadian tersebut, Dr. Stone merasa sangat bersyukur bisa selamat dari peristiwa yang nyaris merenggut nyawanya. Ia menceritakan bagaimana ia mencoba tetap tenang dan fokus bernapas sembari menunggu temannya datang membantu, serta sadar betul bahwa kondisinya bisa saja memburuk dalam sekejap. Meski menghadapi tantangan besar dalam proses penyembuhan, Dr. Stone tetap optimis dan berharap bisa kembali bekerja dalam beberapa bulan ke depan. Ia mengatakan pengalaman ini semakin mempertegas bahwa hidup penuh ketidakpastian dan selalu mengingatkan orang lain bahwa apa pun bisa terjadi kapan saja.

The special covers topics such as encouraging kids to put down video games, skepticism about technology, and playful challenges like how many Tater Tots he can fit in his mouth.

Produced by Amazon Studios and Positive Image Video, 'Kevin James: Irregardless' lists James, Jeff Sussman, Anthony Giordano, and Brady Nasfell as executive producers. James, an Emmy-nominated actor and comedian, previously released specials 'Sweat the Small Stuff' (Comedy Central, 2001) and 'Never Don’t Give Up' (Netflix, 2018). He got his start on the Long Island comedy scene and, after gaining attention at the 1996 Montreal Comedy Festival, was offered a network development deal that led to his sitcom, 'The King of Queens.' Starring alongside Leah Remini and Jerry Stiller, James headlined the CBS series for nine seasons and received an Emmy nomination for Outstanding Lead Actor in a Comedy Series, also serving as executive producer.

article_content: Liza Long, a 40-year-old mother of four from Boise, Idaho, did not anticipate the widespread attention her blog post would gather. On her blog, The Anarchist Soccer Mom, she candidly described her challenges raising her 13-year-old son, who struggles with severe and unpredictable behavioral problems. Long, an English teacher at a local college, published her honest essay soon after the Sandy Hook Elementary School tragedy in Newtown, Connecticut, where 20 children were killed. The post resonated nationally, being read and shared by millions. Along with support, Long also faced criticism concerning her son’s privacy, whom she refers to as 'Michael.' Long described her son as highly intelligent but prone to violent rages that are becoming harder to manage. Without a definitive diagnosis, she followed a social worker’s advice and admitted her son to a psychiatric facility after he threatened self-harm during an argument. She also recounted earlier incidents, including calling the police when her son threatened violence with a knife. Fearing for her family’s safety, Long noted that short-term psychiatric care in Idaho is a temporary solution, often leaving families with few long-term options. Despite confidentiality issues, Long shared specific details and documentation about her situation. She stressed the lack of support and stigma faced by families grappling with serious mental illness. Her blog received thousands of comments, with many readers expressing similar experiences, though some critics accused her of oversharing. Writer Sarah Kendzior publicly challenged Long but eventually joined her in a joint statement advocating for reduced stigma and better mental health services. Long said her goal was to encourage discussion and call for changes to the mental health system. She emphasized her love for her son and the toll his condition has taken on their family. Although her story went viral, Long maintained she only wanted to share her experiences to encourage understanding and change.

Long menggambarkan putranya sangat cerdas tetapi rentan terhadap ledakan kemarahan yang semakin sulit dikendalikan. Tanpa diagnosis pasti, ia mengikuti saran pekerja sosial dan memasukkan putranya ke fasilitas psikiatri setelah ia mengancam melukai diri sendiri saat bertengkar. Ia juga menceritakan kejadian sebelumnya, seperti saat ia memanggil polisi ketika putranya mengancam menggunakan pisau. Meski terbatas oleh aturan kerahasiaan, Long membagikan detail dan dokumen spesifik tentang situasinya. Blognya menerima ribuan komentar, banyak di antaranya dari pembaca yang berbagi pengalaman serupa, meskipun ada juga yang mengkritik Long karena terlalu terbuka. article_content: Senator Bob Menendez continues to assert his innocence amid corruption charges, mirroring his stance during previous allegations. However, his support within the New Jersey Democratic Party has significantly dwindled. According to a poll released Thursday, only 5% of Democratic respondents indicated they would back Menendez in a future primary. The senator is accused of accepting gold bars in return for using his influence to benefit an Egyptian businessman. Despite mounting calls from fellow Democrats, Menendez has refused to resign, setting the stage for a competitive primary election in June 2024. Last month, Representative Andy Kim announced plans to challenge Menendez, stating he felt 'compelled' to enter the race. Although the data reflects just one poll and more research is needed, the findings are troubling for Menendez. Public Policy Polling surveyed 502 likely Democratic primary voters, with only 14% sharing a favorable view of Menendez and 67% holding an unfavorable opinion. In August, Monmouth University polling showed Menendez enjoyed a 58% approval rating among Democrats, highlighting the steep decline. By comparison, Andy Kim currently enjoys broad favorability. When asked about a possible contest between Menendez and Kim, 63% of respondents supported Kim, 28% were unsure, and only 10% backed Menendez. The situation worsens for Menendez when New Jersey First Lady Tammy Murphy is included in the primary. In a prospective three-way race, 42% of respondents supported Kim, 19% chose Murphy, and only 5% favored Menendez. In contrast, Republican primary voters have remained supportive of former President Donald Trump, who faces multiple criminal indictments. Recent polls indicate a majority of GOP voters hold a positive view of Trump and support his third bid for the party’s nomination.

Menurut survei yang dirilis pada Kamis, hanya 5% responden Demokrat yang akan mendukung Menendez dalam pemilihan pendahuluan mendatang. Menendez dituduh menerima emas batangan sebagai imbalan karena menggunakan kekuasaannya untuk menguntungkan seorang pengusaha Mesir. Meski mendapat tekanan dari koleganya sesama Demokrat, Menendez menolak mundur, sehingga membuka peluang adanya kontestasi dalam pemilihan pendahuluan pada Juni 2024. Bulan lalu, Perwakilan Andy Kim mengumumkan rencananya menantang Menendez dengan alasan merasa 'terpanggil' untuk maju. Meski ini data dari satu survei dan masih butuh lebih banyak penelitian, hasil tersebut menjadi pertanda buruk bagi Menendez. Public Policy Polling mensurvei 502 calon pemilih pendahuluan dari kalangan Demokrat, hanya 14% yang menyukai Menendez, sedangkan 67% menilainya negatif. Pada Agustus, survei Monmouth University menunjukkan Menendez mendapat tingkat persetujuan 58% dari warga Demokrat, menunjukkan penurunan tajam. Instant messaging privacy has received significant attention recently, particularly as services like Facebook, Snapchat, and WhatsApp face scrutiny over data security. In response, SRD Wireless has launched PQChat, a secure messaging app for iOS that uses the company's proprietary 'Never-The-Same' (NTS) encryption. SRD Wireless asserts that PQChat is the world’s first 'quantum-proof' messaging app, offering protection even against future threats posed by quantum computing.

PQChat employs the McEliece cryptosystem, which is widely regarded as highly secure and has not been broken to date, even with quantum computing techniques. Users can send encrypted messages, voice recordings, images, and videos, while retaining full control to delete messages remotely. Only approved contacts can read communications, and the app stores no personal user data. The user's identity is protected: only a securely encrypted, irreversible phone number value, encrypted nickname, and pseudo ID image are stored.

Security is further enhanced by allowing users to set their own Master Password and a five-digit alphanumeric PIN—both managed solely on the user's device. The app does not store the Master Password. PQChat incorporates SRD’s patented Man At The End (MATE) authentication, using video and audio to verify recipient identities. The app also provides a secure 'locker' for storing sensitive information.

Messages can be configured to self-destruct after a chosen period or deleted manually. Users receive acknowledgments confirming that crucial messages have been read. By avoiding the collection and storage of personal data, SRD Wireless emphasizes that user privacy is protected from potential hackers and third-party data miners. PQChat’s system randomizes every message’s appearance, ensuring that identical content looks different each time and preventing pattern detection.

SRD Wireless highlights that their business model does not rely on data mining or selling user information. The app's robust security approach is particularly suited for sectors such as legal, healthcare, and finance, where confidentiality is essential. All design choices in PQChat prioritize user security and privacy above all.

Hundreds of environmental activists marched in Nairobi, Kenya, on Saturday, calling for significant restrictions on plastic production ahead of the upcoming global plastics treaty negotiations. Representatives from more than 170 countries are set to meet in Nairobi starting Monday to discuss concrete measures for a legally binding international agreement aimed at ending plastic pollution.

The demonstrators carried placards with messages such as 'Plastic crisis = climate crisis' and 'End multigenerational toxic exposure,' urging negotiators to prioritize reducing the overall plastic produced. They chanted 'let polluters pay the price' as they walked behind a ceremonial band from central Nairobi to a western park in the city.

Last year, countries agreed to finalize by 2024 a landmark UN treaty addressing plastic pollution—a pollutant found everywhere from mountaintops and deep-sea trenches to human bloodstreams. While negotiators have met twice, the Nairobi session marks the first time a draft treaty published in September will be debated, outlining various solutions to the plastic problem.

Tiara Samson, an associate with the Break Free From Plastic movement and march organizer, expressed concerns about discussions focusing too much on end-of-pipe solutions rather than on setting ambitious plastic reduction targets. 'Investing in those solutions diverts the focus from what we really need to do,' said Samson, who attended from the Philippines.

The November 13–19 meeting is the third of five planned sessions in a fast-tracked timetable, aiming to complete the treaty negotiations by next year so that it can be adopted by mid-2025. In previous talks in Paris, campaigners accused some large plastic-producing nations of deliberately stalling progress after procedural debates delayed discussions. Although the Nairobi session has been extended by two days, there are worries that further delays could weaken the final agreement.

Since 2000, global plastic production has more than doubled to 460 million tonnes and could triple by 2060 if current trends continue. Plastic is widely used—from packaging food to clothing fabrics and medical products—yet less than 10% of plastic waste is recycled. Microplastics have been detected everywhere from clouds to the deepest ocean trenches and within human bodies. Scientists are increasingly concerned about the potential health effects of plastics, even though the full implications are not yet fully understood. Additionally, plastic manufacturing contributes to climate change, accounting for 3.4% of global greenhouse gas emissions in 2019, according to the OECD.

Perwakilan dari lebih dari 170 negara akan berkumpul di Nairobi mulai hari Senin untuk membahas langkah-langkah konkret guna menghasilkan kesepakatan internasional yang mengikat secara hukum demi mengakhiri polusi plastik.

Para demonstran membawa poster dengan slogan seperti 'Krisis plastik = krisis iklim' dan 'Akhiri paparan racun lintas generasi', serta mendesak para negosiator untuk memprioritaskan pengurangan jumlah plastik yang diproduksi. Mereka meneriakkan 'biarkan pencemar membayar harganya' sambil berjalan di belakang kelompok musik dari pusat kota Nairobi menuju taman di barat kota itu.

Tahun lalu, negara-negara sepakat untuk menuntaskan perjanjian PBB bersejarah mengenai polusi plastik pada tahun 2024—sebuah polutan yang ditemukan hampir di semua tempat, mulai dari puncak gunung hingga palung laut terdalam, bahkan di aliran darah manusia. Meski para negosiator sudah dua kali bertemu, sesi Nairobi ini merupakan kali pertama rancangan perjanjian yang diterbitkan September lalu akan dibahas secara mendalam untuk mencari berbagai solusi atas masalah plastik.

Tiara Samson, anggota gerakan Break Free From Plastic sekaligus penyelenggara aksi, menyampaikan kekhawatiran bahwa diskusi terlalu banyak berfokus pada solusi akhir siklus dan justru mengalihkan perhatian dari perlunya target ambisius dalam pengurangan plastik. 'Investasi pada solusi tersebut hanya mengalihkan fokus dari hal yang benar-benar harus dilakukan,' ujar Samson yang datang dari Filipina.

Pertemuan 13–19 November ini adalah yang ketiga dari lima sesi yang dipercepat agar tuntas tahun depan sehingga perjanjian dapat diadopsi pertengahan 2025. Dalam pertemuan sebelumnya di Paris, para aktivis menuduh beberapa negara produsen plastik besar sengaja menghambat proses setelah dua hari habis untuk debat prosedural. Sesi Nairobi telah diperpanjang dua hari, namun kekhawatiran akan keluarnya perjanjian lemah tetap ada jika waktu terbuang untuk diskusi berulang.

Sejak 2000, produksi plastik global meningkat lebih dari dua kali lipat menjadi 460 juta ton dan bisa berlipat tiga pada 2060 jika tren tidak berubah. Mikroplastik telah ditemukan di mana-mana, mulai dari awan hingga palung laut terdalam, bahkan di tubuh manusia. Ilmuwan semakin resah atas potensi dampak plastik terhadap kesehatan, meskipun implikasinya belum sepenuhnya dipahami. Di samping itu, manufaktur plastik berkontribusi pada perubahan iklim, menyumbang 3,4% dari total emisi gas rumah kaca global pada 2019 menurut OECD.
