article_content: The Russian Defense Ministry stated Wednesday that its forces shot down 31 Ukrainian drones during a coordinated night-time operation targeting Russian border regions. This event marks what Moscow says is Ukraine’s largest drone offensive since the beginning of the war 20 months ago. No injuries or damages were immediately reported. Despite such attacks, Ukraine continues its counteroffensive aimed at regaining territory from Russian control. Progress has been slow amid rising apprehension about dwindling Western support and shrinking reserves of weapons and ammunition. Admiral Rob Bauer, chair of NATO’s military committee, warned that Western arms and ammunition stocks are dangerously low, emphasizing this urgency at the Warsaw Security Forum. He urged the defense sector to boost output rapidly. Russian officials also reported thwarting a Ukrainian attempt to land troops in Crimea at Cape Tarkhankut, using boats and jet skis. These reports were unsupported by evidence and Ukrainian authorities did not address the claims. Crimea—which Russia occupied and annexed in 2014, though it remains internationally recognized as Ukrainian—continues to be regularly targeted by Ukrainian strikes due to its strategic value for Russian operations. Concerns about ongoing U.S. support for Ukraine are escalating, especially following the ousting of U.S. House Speaker Kevin McCarthy amid congressional divisions. The U.S. is Ukraine’s main arms provider, but some lawmakers oppose further aid, and the Pentagon has signaled shortages in funds to replace weapon inventories. Ukrainian presidential adviser Mykhailo Podolyak criticized hesitant Western politicians, questioning their reluctance to fully back Ukraine’s military campaign against Russia. In light of funding concerns, U.S. President Joe Biden consulted with leaders of key European allies, Canada, and Japan to coordinate continued support for Ukraine after U.S. emergency funding legislation excluded additional aid for the country. Meanwhile, Russia held national emergency drills simulating nuclear disaster scenarios, interrupting television programming to broadcast emergency instructions. The exercises reflect growing worries about possible conflict escalation with NATO.
translated_content: Kementerian Pertahanan Rusia menyatakan pada hari Rabu bahwa pasukannya menembak jatuh 31 drone Ukraina dalam operasi terkoordinasi di malam hari yang menargetkan wilayah perbatasan Rusia. Peristiwa ini disebut Moskow sebagai serangan drone terbesar Ukraina sejak awal perang 20 bulan lalu. Tidak ada laporan langsung mengenai korban jiwa atau kerusakan. Meskipun ada serangan tersebut, Ukraina tetap melanjutkan serangan balasan untuk merebut kembali wilayah yang diduduki Rusia. Perkembangan berjalan lambat di tengah kekhawatiran meningkat akan berkurangnya dukungan Barat dan menipisnya persediaan senjata serta amunisi. Laksamana Rob Bauer, ketua komite militer NATO, memperingatkan bahwa stok senjata dan amunisi Barat kini sangat menipis. Ia menyoroti urgensi ini dalam Forum Keamanan Warsawa dan mendesak industri pertahanan agar segera meningkatkan produksi. Pejabat Rusia juga melaporkan telah menggagalkan upaya pendaratan pasukan Ukraina di Krimea, tepatnya di Cape Tarkhankut, menggunakan perahu dan jet ski. Laporan ini tidak disertai bukti dan pihak Ukraina tidak memberikan komentar. Krimea—yang diduduki dan dianeksasi Rusia pada 2014, meski secara internasional tetap diakui sebagai wilayah Ukraina—masih menjadi sasaran serangan Ukraina karena pentingnya wilayah itu untuk operasi militer Rusia. Kekhawatiran terhadap kelanjutan dukungan Amerika Serikat bagi Ukraina semakin besar, terutama setelah pencopotan Ketua DPR AS, Kevin McCarthy, di tengah konflik di Kongres. Amerika adalah pemasok utama senjata Ukraina, namun beberapa anggota parlemen menolak pemberian bantuan lebih lanjut, dan Pentagon telah memperingatkan tentang kekurangan dana untuk mengganti persediaan senjata. Penasihat Presiden Ukraina, Mykhailo Podolyak, mengkritik sikap ragu-ragu sebagian politisi Barat, mempertanyakan mengapa mereka tidak sepenuhnya mendukung upaya Ukraina melawan militer Rusia. Dengan kekhawatiran akan pendanaan tersebut, Presiden AS Joe Biden melakukan konsultasi dengan para pemimpin sekutu utama di Eropa, Kanada, dan Jepang untuk mengoordinasikan dukungan berkelanjutan kepada Ukraina setelah legislasi pendanaan darurat AS tidak mencakup bantuan tambahan bagi negara tersebut. Sementara itu, Rusia menggelar latihan darurat nasional yang mensimulasikan skenario bencana nuklir, dengan memutus sementara siaran TV untuk menayangkan instruksi darurat. Latihan ini mencerminkan kekhawatiran akan potensi eskalasi konflik dengan NATO.

article_content: Paramount+ is producing a new original UK series titled 'Stags' in partnership with Eleven, the production company best known for 'Sex Education.' Filming is underway for this six-part drama, which tells the story of a bachelor party trip gone wrong. The plot follows Stu (Nico Mirallegro) and his friends as they embark on a wild trip to South America, only to find themselves imprisoned on a lawless island overseen by two rival siblings. What begins as a carefree adventure swiftly turns into a fight for survival, with friendships tested and difficult choices about loyalty and trust. 'Stags' features a cast including Nico Mirallegro, Charlie Cooper, Asim Chaudhry, Corin Silva, Sophie Lenglinger, Paul Forman, Jojo Macari, Cavan Clerkin, Paulina Galvez, and Oscar Foronda. BAFTA-winning director David Kerr ('Johnny English Strikes Again') leads the project, serving as both director and executive producer. The series was created by Daniel Cullen (‘Breeders’, ‘Bad Sisters’), who also acts as co-executive producer. Other executive producers are Carissa Hope Lynch, Joel Wilson, Olivia Trench, and Jamie Campbell, with Farah Abushwesha as producer. Sony Pictures Television will handle international distribution. Sebastian Cardwell, Paramount+'s UK deputy chief content officer, authorized the series.

article_content: A U.S. Marine has been taken into custody on suspicion of fatally shooting another Marine at Camp Lejeune in North Carolina, a spokesperson for the 2nd Marine Division confirmed. Officials said the suspect was apprehended late Wednesday after the incident occurred earlier that day in a barracks room on the base. No further details about the circumstances of the shooting have been released yet. "Further details will be provided as they become available," the base stated in a press release. The names of those involved have not been disclosed. The victim was a member of the 6th Marine Regiment, 2nd Marine Division, according to the spokesperson. The Naval Criminal Investigative Service (NCIS) is now leading the investigation into the homicide. In a statement to ABC News, the 2nd Marine Division said, "We will continue to assist the investigating agency to the fullest extent possible. Our deepest condolences go out to the Marine’s family and friends at this time." Camp Lejeune is one of the largest Marine Corps bases on the East Coast and is home to the II Marine Expeditionary Force and Marine Corps Forces Special Operations Command. In a case that drew wide media attention in 2007, Lance Cpl. Maria Lauterbach, who was eight months pregnant, was killed by fellow Marine Cesar Laurean at Camp Lejeune. Laurean fled to Mexico after the crime and was convicted of killing Lauterbach in August 2010.

Belum ada rincian lebih lanjut tentang situasi penembakan yang dirilis. "Rincian lebih lanjut akan diberikan jika tersedia," kata pihak pangkalan dalam siaran pers. Nama-nama yang terlibat belum diungkapkan. Korban adalah anggota Resimen Marinir ke-6, Divisi Marinir ke-2, menurut juru bicara tersebut. Dinas Investigasi Kriminal Angkatan Laut (NCIS) kini memimpin penyelidikan atas kasus pembunuhan ini. Dalam pernyataan kepada ABC News, Divisi Marinir ke-2 menyampaikan, "Kami akan terus membantu lembaga penyidik semaksimal mungkin. Belasungkawa terdalam kami kepada keluarga dan teman-teman Marinir saat ini." Camp Lejeune adalah salah satu pangkalan Korps Marinir terbesar di Pantai Timur dan menjadi markas Pasukan Ekspedisi Marinir II serta Komando Operasi Khusus Korps Marinir. Dalam kasus yang mendapat sorotan media luas pada 2007, Kopral Lance Maria Lauterbach yang sedang hamil delapan bulan dibunuh oleh sesama Marinir, Cesar Laurean, di Camp Lejeune. Laurean melarikan diri ke Meksiko setelah kejadian itu dan divonis bersalah atas pembunuhan Lauterbach pada Agustus 2010.

article_content: Real Madrid are already making significant returns on the £60 million spent to sign their new Galactico, James Rodriguez. In just 48 hours since his unveiling, an estimated 345,000 James Rodriguez shirts have been sold worldwide. According to Spanish newspaper Sport and Euromericas Sport Marketing, the rapid shirt sales—averaging around 7,188 per hour—have generated about £21 million, covering nearly a third of his transfer fee. While Real Madrid have always been successful at selling replica shirts of their star signings, the arrival of World Cup sensation James Rodriguez has sparked immediate excitement among their supporters. On Tuesday, the Bernabeu stadium was packed with 44,000 fans for Rodriguez’s official presentation. During this event, 900 shirts bearing his name were snapped up within an hour at the club shop, even as Rodriguez was busy with media commitments. Additional staff had to be brought in to cope with the exceptionally high demand for the new number 10 shirt, with sales in the club shop reaching a rate of 15 shirts per minute. Rodriguez, who shone at the World Cup in Brazil and won the Golden Boot, is expected to be a fan favorite this season alongside Cristiano Ronaldo and Gareth Bale at the Bernabeu. Real Madrid president Florentino Perez greeted Rodriguez, who has signed a six-year contract with the club, and drew comparisons to the late club legend Alfredo Di Stefano, who also played in Colombia before joining Real Madrid. Fans queued throughout the day to buy Rodriguez shirts, and once the initial stock sold out, supporters waited for more shirts to be printed. James Rodriguez expressed his delight at joining Real Madrid and is set to wear the number 10 shirt, quickly becoming a beloved figure among the club's faithful.

article_content: While most people enjoy festive leftovers like cold turkey and mince pies, the elephants at Berlin Zoological Garden had a different kind of treat. The zoo’s elephants were photographed delighting in Christmas trees donated by local vendors after the holidays. This post-Christmas tradition, now two decades old, usually takes place every January. Each year, elephants of all ages play with and then eat the donated trees, drawn in by their strong scent. The zoo only accepts trees from local sellers—not the public—to avoid risks of chemicals or leftover decorations. Additionally, trees from outdoor markets are fresher and juicier, which the elephants prefer. According to a keeper at the 169-year-old zoo, the animals ‘love it’ when their Christmas feast begins.
translated_content: Sementara kebanyakan orang menikmati sisa makanan seperti kalkun dingin dan pai daging setelah liburan, gajah-gajah di Berlin Zoological Garden mendapatkan suguhan yang berbeda. Gajah-gajah ini tampak senang menikmati pohon Natal yang didonasikan oleh penjual lokal usai masa Natal. Tradisi pasca-Natal yang sudah berjalan selama dua dekade ini biasanya berlangsung setiap Januari. Setiap tahun, gajah muda hingga tua bermain-main lalu memakan pohon-pohon yang didonasikan karena tertarik aroma khasnya. Kebun binatang hanya menerima pohon dari penjual lokal—bukan dari masyarakat umum—untuk mencegah risiko bahan kimia atau sisa dekorasi. Pohon dari pasar luar ruangan juga lebih segar dan lebih disukai oleh para gajah. Menurut seorang penjaga di kebun binatang yang berusia 169 tahun ini, para gajah ‘sangat menyukainya’ ketika pesta Natal mereka dimulai.

article_content: Megan Moody, 38, died after falling from a 25-meter cliff at Mermaid Pools near Tahmoor, outside Sydney, during a camping trip with her fiancé, Paul Veitch, on a Tuesday night. Veitch, 36, reportedly tried to save her but was unable to revive her. The couple, engaged for two months, had set up camp in the popular area for an overnight stay. Moody had earlier worked at a real estate agency in Geelong. She had served time in jail for sending a threatening text to a former employer with whom she had a brief relationship. After being fired in 2009, she sent more than 160 severe text messages to this employer, prompting an apprehended violence order (AVO) against her, which she later breached in 2010. Three months before her death, Moody was questioned by police in relation to a stabbing involving Veitch, but no charges were laid. In August, Veitch sought legal protection, and a court issued another AVO aimed at preventing Moody from contacting or harming him. On the evening of her death, Moody was reportedly fetching water when she slipped and fell after sunset. Authorities are still investigating the circumstances surrounding her fall and have not ruled out any potential causes. Police have advised people to exercise caution when visiting cliffside locations, particularly at night, noting that the area lacks lighting and mobile phone coverage, making emergency responses difficult. The coroner will receive a report as police continue their investigation into Moody’s death.

Veitch, 36 tahun, dilaporkan telah berusaha menyelamatkannya namun gagal. Pasangan yang baru dua bulan bertunangan ini berkemah semalam di lokasi populer tersebut. Sebelumnya, Moody pernah bekerja di sebuah agen properti di Geelong. Ia pernah dipenjara karena mengirim pesan ancaman kepada mantan atasannya yang pernah memiliki hubungan singkat dengannya. Setelah dipecat pada 2009, Moody mengirim lebih dari 160 pesan ancaman serius, sehingga dikeluarkan perintah perlindungan (AVO) terhadap dirinya, yang kemudian dilanggarnya pada 2010. Tiga bulan sebelum meninggal, Moody sempat diperiksa polisi terkait insiden penusukan yang melibatkan Veitch, namun tidak didakwa. Pada bulan Agustus, Veitch meminta perlindungan hukum, dan pengadilan mengeluarkan AVO baru agar Moody tidak bisa menghubungi atau membahayakan dirinya. Pada malam kematiannya, Moody dikabarkan terpeleset saat mengambil air setelah matahari terbenam. Otoritas masih menyelidiki penyebab jatuhnya dan belum mengesampingkan kemungkinan apapun. Polisi mengimbau masyarakat untuk berhati-hati jika berada di tepi tebing, apalagi di malam hari, karena area tersebut tanpa penerangan dan sinyal ponsel, sehingga sulit mendapatkan bantuan darurat dengan cepat. Polisi tengah menyiapkan laporan untuk koroner sambil melanjutkan penyelidikan atas kematian Moody.

According to a CAF announcement, the nominees were chosen by a panel consisting of CAF Technical Experts, African Football Legends, and journalists from various countries, with evaluations focused on performances between November 2022 and September 2023. Among the Player of the Year nominees are top stars like Mohamed Salah (Egypt/Liverpool), Riyad Mahrez (Algeria/Al Ahli), Sadio Mane (Senegal/Al Nassr), Victor Osimhen (Nigeria/SSC Napoli), Hakim Ziyech (Morocco/Galatasaray), and other prominent players. The Goalkeeper of the Year shortlist features Mohamed ElShenawy (Egypt/Al Ahly), Yassine Bounou (Morocco/Al Hilal), Andre Onana (Cameroon/Manchester United), among others. Other awards to be presented include Interclub Player of the Year, Young Player of the Year, Coach of the Year, National Team of the Year, and Club of the Year, recognizing outstanding footballers, coaches, clubs, and national teams from across Africa. The nominees reflect African football’s remarkable diversity and skill, highlighting individual and collective achievements throughout the last season.

article_content: Roses, valued worldwide for their beauty, have a long history of breeding and cultivation, resulting in over 30,000 cultivars. As predominantly outcrossing and highly heterozygous plants, predicting inheritance patterns for most rose traits is difficult, making cross-breeding particularly challenging. Recent advances in rose genetics, such as the development of molecular markers, genetic linkage maps, and genome sequencing, have uncovered key genetic factors for traits like scent, continuous-flowering (CF), and double-flower (DF). However, the S-locus, which controls self-incompatibility (SI), remains poorly understood at the genetic level, yet is essential for breeding improvements, especially in diploid roses. Research has identified potential S-locus regions and associated S-RNase enzymes, but inconsistencies in the data and limited pollination experiments mean the precise location and function of the S-locus are still unconfirmed. In October 2022, Horticulture Research published a perspective titled "The identification of the Rosa S-locus provides new insights into the breeding and wild origins of continuous-flowering roses." This study aimed to identify the Rosa S-locus controlling SI, explore its genetic linkages with ornamental traits, examine historical changes in specific S-allele (SC) frequencies in rose cultivars, and identify wild species carrying SC-alleles to infer the origins of old Chinese CF cultivars. Researchers conducted genome-wide searches for candidate S-RNase genes in the genome databases of Old Blush, R. multiflora, and R. rugosa. They found 16 candidate genes on four chromosomes, with seven expressed in the pistil. Molecular phylogenetic analysis highlighted the 3D and 0A genes as primary S-RNase candidates. Nine additional 3D S-RNase-like genes were discovered in R. multiflora and R. rugosa. High genetic divergence supports the hypothesis that the 3D S-RNase gene is responsible for SI in roses. The 0A gene was hypothesized to be allelic to 3D S-RNase. Pistil transcriptome analysis of seven diploid R. multiflora plants indicated that 0A and 3D genes are allelic. Genetic mapping in a diploid population confirmed that these S-RNase genes are located at homologous sites on chromosome 3. The F-box genes flanking S-RNase were identified by searching genome databases and analyzing the stamen transcriptomes of Old Blush. Twelve F-box genes and one S-RNase (SC1) were found in the 5.3 to 5.8 Mbp region of Chr3, while three other F-box genes were found in the RC0 contig containing the SC2 S-RNase. Extensive pollination experiments strongly supported the role of 3D and 0A S-RNase genes in SI in roses. Additionally, segregation analysis of an F1 population indicated a genetic link between the S-locus and the floral repressor gene KSN, with the non-functional ksn allele conferring the CF trait. The study also traced SC-alleles in old Chinese CF cultivars, identifying a total of five S-alleles (SC1–5). The frequency of SC in cultivars increased dramatically after ksn introgression from Chinese to European cultivars and remains high (about 80%) in modern varieties, underlining the value of S-genotyping for breeding. In summary, this research provides valuable insights for rose breeding, demonstrating the importance of S-genotyping for efficient breeding, particularly in diploid roses. The findings establish a foundation for future studies on genetic linkages between the S-locus and traits such as DF, thornlessness, and disease resistance, contributing greatly to our understanding of rose genetics and breeding.
translated_content: Mawar, yang dihargai di seluruh dunia karena keindahannya, memiliki sejarah panjang dalam pembudidayaan hingga menghasilkan lebih dari 30.000 kultivar. Sebagai tanaman yang umumnya menyerbuk silang dan sangat heterozigot, pola pewarisan sebagian besar sifat mawar sulit diprediksi sehingga penyilangan menjadi tantangan tersendiri. Kemajuan terbaru dalam genetika mawar, seperti pengembangan penanda molekuler, peta keterkaitan genetik, dan sekuensing genom, telah mengungkap faktor genetik utama untuk sifat seperti aroma, berbunga terus-menerus (CF), dan bunga ganda (DF). Namun, S-lokus yang mengendalikan ketidakcocokan diri (SI) masih belum dipahami secara mendalam secara genetik, padahal penting untuk peningkatan pemuliaan, terutama pada mawar diploid. Riset telah mengidentifikasi potensi daerah S-lokus dan enzim S-RNase terkait, namun inkonsistensi data dan terbatasnya percobaan penyerbukan berarti posisi dan fungsi pasti S-lokus belum dikonfirmasi. Pada Oktober 2022, Horticulture Research menerbitkan perspektif berjudul "Identifikasi S-lokus pada Rosa memberikan wawasan baru tentang pemuliaan dan asal-usul liar mawar berbunga terus-menerus." Studi ini bertujuan mengidentifikasi S-lokus pada Rosa yang mengendalikan SI, mengeksplorasi keterkaitan genetiknya dengan sifat ornamental, mengkaji perubahan frekuensi alel S (SC) spesifik secara historis pada kultivar mawar, serta mengidentifikasi spesies liar yang membawa alel SC untuk menelusuri asal-usul kultivar CF Cina kuno. Para peneliti melakukan pencarian genom secara menyeluruh untuk gen kandidat S-RNase pada basis data genom Old Blush, R. multiflora, dan R. rugosa. Mereka menemukan 16 gen kandidat pada empat kromosom, dengan tujuh di antaranya terekspresi di putik. Analisis filogeni molekuler menunjukkan gen 3D dan 0A sebagai kandidat utama S-RNase. Sembilan gen mirip 3D S-RNase tambahan ditemukan pada R. multiflora dan R. rugosa. Divergensi genetik yang tinggi mendukung hipotesis bahwa gen 3D S-RNase bertanggung jawab atas SI pada mawar. Gen 0A diduga bersifat alelik terhadap 3D S-RNase. Analisis transkriptom putik dari tujuh tanaman R. multiflora diploid menunjukkan bahwa gen 0A dan 3D adalah alel. Pemetaan genetik pada populasi diploid mengonfirmasi kedua gen S-RNase tersebut terletak pada posisi homolog di kromosom 3. Gen F-box yang mengapit S-RNase diidentifikasi melalui pencarian basis data genom dan analisis transkriptom benang sari Old Blush. Dua belas gen F-box dan satu gen S-RNase (SC1) ditemukan di daerah 5,3 hingga 5,8 Mbp pada Chr3, sedangkan tiga gen F-box lainnya ditemukan di contig RC0 yang mengandung SC2 S-RNase. Serangkaian percobaan penyerbukan secara ekstensif sangat mendukung peran gen 3D dan 0A S-RNase dalam SI pada mawar. Selain itu, analisis segregasi pada populasi F1 menunjukkan keterkaitan genetik antara S-lokus dan gen penekan bunga KSN, di mana alel ksn non-fungsional menyebabkan sifat CF. Studi ini juga melacak alel SC pada kultivar CF Cina kuno, mengidentifikasi total lima alel S (SC1–5). Frekuensi alel SC pada kultivar meningkat drastis setelah introgresi ksn dari mawar Cina ke kultivar Eropa dan tetap tinggi (sekitar 80%) pada varietas modern, menegaskan pentingnya S-genotyping dalam pemuliaan. Singkatnya, riset ini memberikan wawasan penting untuk pemuliaan mawar, menunjukkan betapa pentingnya S-genotyping untuk pemuliaan yang lebih efisien, terutama pada mawar diploid. Temuan ini menjadi dasar studi lanjut mengenai keterkaitan genetik antara S-lokus dengan sifat seperti DF, tanpa duri, dan ketahanan penyakit, serta sangat berkontribusi dalam pemahaman genetika dan pemuliaan mawar.

article_content: With only the clothes on their backs and rucksacks on their shoulders, hundreds of migrants have arrived at the Italian port of Port Augusta in Sicily. Another boat has delivered these desperate travelers fleeing the dangers and hardships of their home countries. Men, women, and children disembarked after a harrowing journey across the Mediterranean Sea – a journey that has claimed the lives of more than 1,000 people over the past year. They arrived seeking asylum and a better life in Europe. Many of the migrants have come from Libya, where human traffickers exploit the instability following the collapse of Colonel Gaddafi’s regime in 2011. Others come from countries across North Africa, such as Eritrea. These refugees arrive in Port Augusta, northern Sicily, often with little more than the clothes they are wearing. Lines of migrants are led by guards to refugee camps to file asylum claims and begin their attempts to build new lives. Migrants cross the Mediterranean after fleeing war-torn countries like Libya, which has faced ongoing turmoil since 2011. While their asylum applications are processed, they and their families are given clean clothes and housed in blue tents, receiving food and water. Upon arrival, the first step is to submit identification documents from their home countries and have their photographs taken. They are provided with basic necessities before being placed in refugee camps throughout Europe. Some hope to reach the UK. Since January, more than 140,000 migrants have entered Europe via Italy, surpassing last year’s numbers. Italian rescue services recently recovered six more bodies from the Mediterranean, in addition to 19 people who drowned during a previous crossing attempt. The Italian navy reports rescuing nearly 4,000 migrants over one weekend, continuing efforts following a boat capsizing north of the Libyan coast. A recent incident saw some 200 migrants feared drowned, less than a mile off Libya. Investigators estimate that one in five migrants arriving at Port Augusta intends to reach Britain. The journey from Sicily to Dover can take only seven days, with some migrants heading towards Calais by train and others by bus. Despite risks, including the recent death of an Afghan Sikh in a shipping container at Tilbury docks, many still risk their lives to reach their destinations. Scenes at the camps show children resting in tented dormitories, fathers caring for young children, and mothers carrying babies in the heat. Families and individuals often arrive with few possessions. Migrants are met by guards, processed for asylum applications, and given care, while paramedics remain ready to help anyone who falls ill. Some migrants are rescued by authorities at sea and transported aboard naval vessels, like the San Giusto, then transferred to camps. They receive life jackets and basic supplies during transit. Italian Interior Minister Angelino Alfano has renewed calls for the European Union to provide more help to Italy’s naval services, which are regularly tasked with rescues. Crowded rafts off Lampedusa illustrate the dangers of the journey, as unseaworthy boats sometimes sink and require rescue. Once aboard rescue vessels, migrants are brought to Sicily for asylum processing.

Kapal lain kembali membawa para pelancong putus asa yang melarikan diri dari bahaya dan kesulitan di negara asal mereka. Pria, wanita, dan anak-anak turun setelah perjalanan berat melintasi Laut Mediterania—perjalanan yang telah menewaskan lebih dari 1.000 orang dalam setahun terakhir. Mereka datang untuk mencari suaka dan kehidupan yang lebih baik di Eropa. Banyak migran berasal dari Libya, di mana para penyelundup manusia memanfaatkan situasi tidak stabil sejak runtuhnya rezim Kolonel Gaddafi pada 2011. Lainnya datang dari negara-negara Afrika Utara seperti Eritrea. Para pengungsi ini tiba di Port Augusta, Sisilia utara, sering kali hanya dengan pakaian yang mereka kenakan. Para migran ini diarahkan oleh petugas ke kamp pengungsi untuk mengajukan permohonan suaka dan memulai upaya membangun kehidupan baru. Beberapa berharap bisa sampai ke Inggris. Sejak Januari, lebih dari 140.000 migran telah memasuki Eropa melalui Italia, melebihi jumlah tahun lalu. Layanan penyelamatan Italia baru-baru ini menemukan enam jenazah lagi di Mediterania, selain 19 orang yang tenggelam dalam upaya penyeberangan sebelumnya. Penyelidikan memperkirakan satu dari lima migran yang tiba di Port Augusta berniat menuju Inggris. Perjalanan dari Sisilia ke Dover bisa ditempuh hanya dalam tujuh hari, dengan beberapa migran naik kereta menuju Calais sementara yang lain naik bus. Meski penuh risiko, termasuk kematian seorang Sikh Afganistan dalam kontainer di dermaga Tilbury baru-baru ini, banyak orang tetap nekat menempuh perjalanan berbahaya ini demi tujuan akhir mereka. Pemandangan di kamp pengungsi menunjukkan anak-anak yang beristirahat di asrama tenda, ayah-ayah yang merawat anak, dan ibu-ibu yang menggendong bayi di tengah cuaca panas. Keluarga dan individu kerap tiba hanya dengan sedikit barang bawaan. Para migran disambut oleh petugas, diproses untuk permohonan suaka, dan diberi perawatan. Paramedis siaga untuk membantu mereka yang jatuh sakit selama perjalanan. Beberapa migran diselamatkan otoritas di laut dan diangkut ke kapal angkatan laut seperti San Giusto, lalu dibawa ke kamp. Mereka diberi pelampung dan kebutuhan dasar selama perjalanan. Menteri Dalam Negeri Italia, Angelino Alfano, kembali meminta Uni Eropa untuk memberikan lebih banyak bantuan kepada layanan angkatan laut Italia yang setiap hari menangani operasi penyelamatan. Perahu-perahu penuh sesak di dekat Lampedusa menunjukkan bahaya perjalanan ini, karena kapal tak layak kerap tenggelam dan perlu diselamatkan. Setelah naik ke kapal penyelamat, para migran dibawa ke Sisilia untuk proses suaka.

article_content: While Cristiano Ronaldo claimed his third Ballon d'Or, Brazil’s original Ronaldo enjoyed his own moment of triumph—this time at a high-stakes poker event. The former football superstar and World Cup winner collected $42,180 by finishing 26th at the PokerStars Caribbean Adventure (PCA) Main Event in the Bahamas. The ongoing PCA Main Event offers a top prize exceeding $1.4 million. At 38, Ronaldo set a new record for sports celebrities by surpassing all previous finishes with his 26th place in a pool of 816 players. This outdid golfer Sergio Garcia’s 52nd-place showing in 2012. Ronaldo admitted that the thrill of competing at the poker table reminded him of his football days, saying, 'It's the same emotion I used to have on the pitch.' After a previous poker loss to tennis ace Rafael Nadal during a 2014 charity match, Ronaldo worked to sharpen his poker skills. The football legend received a wave of online support from fans and celebrities, including Sergio Garcia, who used the hashtag #GoRonaldoPCA to cheer him on.

article_content: A new image from the James Webb Space Telescope reveals the core of our galaxy, capturing a region close to the supermassive black hole at the center of the Milky Way, known as Sagittarius A*. The image highlights a star-forming area where dust and gas filaments are clustering to form new stars. This picture was taken using Webb’s NIRCam instrument, which observes in the near-infrared part of the electromagnetic spectrum—where shorter wavelengths appear as blue and cyan, and longer wavelengths as yellow and red. The observed region, called Sagittarius C, is about 300 light-years from Sagittarius A*. For context, Earth is situated much farther away from the galactic center, roughly 26,000 light-years from Sagittarius A*. Scientists estimate that up to 500,000 stars reside in Sagittarius C, including many young protostars—some of which may become main-sequence stars like our sun. As these stars form, they emit strong stellar winds that clear away surrounding material, preventing further nearby star formation. These outflows are visible in the infrared, with cyan patches in the image representing ionized gas. The energy from young stars ionizes nearby hydrogen gas, causing it to glow in the infrared spectrum. Not all stars in this region are visible in the image, as the dark areas represent dense clouds that are opaque in infrared, particularly in the central parts of Sagittarius C. Moreover, there are still surprises left in the image, with features that require further investigation. Researchers note that they are just beginning to analyze the wealth of high-resolution data provided by Webb for this region, including rose-colored clouds on the right side of the image that have never been seen in such detail before.

Gambar ini menyoroti wilayah pembentukan bintang, tempat filamen debu dan gas berkumpul membentuk bintang-bintang baru. Foto ini diambil dengan instrumen NIRCam milik Webb, yang mengamati pada spektrum elektromagnetik wilayah inframerah-dekat—di mana panjang gelombang lebih pendek terlihat sebagai biru dan sian, sedangkan gelombang lebih panjang tampak kuning dan merah. Wilayah yang diamati, Sagittarius C, berada sekitar 300 tahun cahaya dari Sagittarius A*. Sebagai perbandingan, Bumi terletak jauh lebih jauh dari pusat galaksi, sekitar 26.000 tahun cahaya dari Sagittarius A*. Ilmuwan memperkirakan ada hingga 500.000 bintang di Sagittarius C, termasuk banyak protobintang muda—beberapa di antaranya bisa berkembang menjadi bintang deret utama seperti matahari kita. Ketika bintang-bintang ini terbentuk, mereka menghasilkan angin bintang yang kuat sehingga membersihkan material di sekitarnya dan mencegah terbentuknya bintang lain terlalu dekat. Aliran ini terlihat pada inframerah, dengan area berwarna sian mewakili gas terionisasi. Energi dari bintang-bintang muda mengionisasi gas hidrogen di sekitar mereka, sehingga bersinar di spektrum inframerah. Tidak semua bintang di wilayah ini terlihat pada gambar, karena area gelap sebenarnya adalah awan padat yang tidak tembus inframerah, terutama di bagian tengah Sagittarius C. Selain itu, masih banyak kejutan dalam gambar ini, dengan fitur-fitur yang harus diteliti lebih lanjut. Para peneliti menyebut mereka baru mulai menjelajahi data resolusi tinggi dari Webb untuk wilayah ini, termasuk awan berwarna mawar di sisi kanan gambar yang belum pernah terlihat sedetail ini sebelumnya.

article_content: Ottawa (CNN) — Suliman Mohamed, a 21-year-old Canadian man, will remain in custody after a brief court appearance on Tuesday. Mohamed, dressed in a brown hooded jacket, was watched closely by his parents in the courtroom. The Royal Canadian Mounted Police (RCMP) announced his arrest on Monday, charging him with participating in the activities of a terrorist group and conspiracy to engage in terrorist activity. Federal prosecutor Roderick Sonley said that more details regarding the evidence against Mohamed would be disclosed before his next court date, set for February 12. Outside the Ottawa courthouse, Mohamed’s father, Idris Altahir, defended his son, describing him as a devout Muslim, quiet, polite, and generous. 'My son is not involved in this at all,' Altahir said. 'We will see what evidence they have.' Police allege that Mohamed’s actions are directly linked to the recent arrests of twin brothers Ashton and Carlos Larmond, both 24, who have been accused of conspiring to commit terrorism offenses. After an investigation dating back to at least August, Ashton Larmond was arrested in Ottawa, while Carlos Larmond was arrested at Montreal’s Pierre Elliott Trudeau International Airport, where he reportedly intended to travel overseas for terrorist purposes. Carlos Larmond faces charges of participating in terrorist activities as well as attempting to leave Canada to engage in terrorist activity abroad, under relatively new Canadian terrorism laws. Through their attorney, the Larmond brothers have indicated they intend to contest the charges. The RCMP has so far released few additional details.

Royal Canadian Mounted Police (RCMP) mengumumkan penangkapannya pada hari Senin dan menuduhnya terlibat dalam aktivitas kelompok teroris serta konspirasi untuk melakukan aktivitas terorisme. Jaksa federal Roderick Sonley mengatakan bahwa rincian lebih lanjut mengenai bukti terhadap Mohamed akan diungkap sebelum sidang berikutnya, yang dijadwalkan pada 12 Februari. Setelah penyelidikan sejak Agustus tahun lalu, Ashton Larmond ditangkap di Ottawa, sementara Carlos Larmond ditangkap di Bandara Internasional Pierre Elliott Trudeau, Montreal, di mana ia dilaporkan berniat bepergian ke luar negeri untuk tujuan terorisme. Carlos Larmond didakwa mengikuti aktivitas terorisme serta mencoba meninggalkan Kanada untuk terlibat dalam aktivitas terorisme di luar negeri, sesuai dengan undang-undang terorisme Kanada yang relatif baru. Melalui pengacaranya, saudara Larmond menyatakan akan melawan tuntutan tersebut. RCMP sejauh ini belum merilis detail tambahan.

article_content: Katie Hopkins, known for her outspoken media presence, has triggered fresh outrage after making derogatory remarks about children with red hair. During a recent interview with OK! magazine, she openly admitted her preference against having ginger-haired children, controversially stating that 'ginger babies... are just so much harder to love.' This follows a previous incident on ITV's This Morning, where Hopkins argued that children could be judged based on their names — often linking them to lower social classes. Hosts, including Holly Willoughby, challenged her stance. In the OK! interview, when asked about her daughters India and Poppy, Hopkins emphasized that they are not ginger-haired and recounted asking about her son Max’s hair color at birth, declaring, 'There's nothing worse than a ginger boy, especially when he's young.' Her remarks provoked a storm of criticism on social media, with many Twitter users decrying her as offensive and a bully. Some suggested her comments were meant purely to stir controversy. Hopkins restated her position during an appearance on Channel 5’s The Wright Stuff, which prompted a fresh wave of condemnation on Twitter. The public sentiment was broadly opposed to judging children by appearance or name. Hopkins first became a prominent public figure as a contestant on the UK reality show The Apprentice in 2007, where her blunt opinions attracted both attention and criticism.

article_content: A recent survey conducted by AXA insurance among more than 2,000 UK adults has named Grease as the country's favorite feel-good film. The beloved 1978 musical starring John Travolta and Olivia Newton-John remains a top pick for audiences seeking a mood boost. The study highlighted a clear difference in movie preferences: women tended to choose musicals such as Dirty Dancing, Grease, and Mamma Mia, while men preferred fantasy adventures and animated favorites, including Back to the Future, Toy Story, and Shrek. Film commentators observed that the highest-rated feel-good movies typically share themes of overcoming obstacles, pursuing dreams, and achieving fairy-tale endings. Stories of underdogs, breaking down barriers, or unexpected romance offer viewers a sense of escapism and hope. AXA spokesperson Chris Jones emphasized that simple pleasures like enjoying a favorite movie at home can have a powerful, uplifting effect on our daily lives. Notably, about 70 percent of the Top 10 films come from the past 20 years, with some older classics such as The Sound of Music and It's a Wonderful Life ranking outside the overall top spots. According to the survey, the top five feel-good movies for women are Dirty Dancing, Grease, Pretty Woman, Mamma Mia, and Bridget Jones's Diary. For men, favorites include Back to the Future, Toy Story, Shrek, The Full Monty, and The Shawshank Redemption. Experts also noted that women often gravitate toward musicals or films featuring strong female leads, while men are more likely to select lighthearted adventures and comedies. Despite these differences, both groups value uplifting stories about finding one’s place and achieving happiness.
translated_content: Sebuah survei terbaru yang dilakukan oleh perusahaan asuransi AXA terhadap lebih dari 2.000 orang dewasa di Inggris menempatkan Grease sebagai film feel-good favorit di negara tersebut. Film musikal tahun 1978 yang dibintangi John Travolta dan Olivia Newton-John ini masih menjadi pilihan utama penonton saat ingin meningkatkan suasana hati. Studi ini menunjukkan adanya perbedaan selera film yang jelas: perempuan cenderung menyukai film musikal seperti Dirty Dancing, Grease, dan Mamma Mia, sedangkan laki-laki lebih memilih film petualangan fantasi dan animasi seperti Back to the Future, Toy Story, dan Shrek. Kisah tentang tokoh underdog, menembus batasan sosial, atau romansa tak terduga memberikan penonton rasa pelarian dan harapan. Juru bicara AXA, Chris Jones, menekankan bahwa kesenangan sederhana seperti menonton film favorit di rumah dapat memberikan pengaruh positif besar bagi kehidupan sehari-hari. Menariknya, sekitar 70 persen dari 10 film teratas berasal dari 20 tahun terakhir, sementara beberapa film klasik lama seperti The Sound of Music dan It's a Wonderful Life tidak masuk peringkat 10 besar secara keseluruhan. Menurut survei ini, lima film feel-good paling populer untuk perempuan adalah Dirty Dancing, Grease, Pretty Woman, Mamma Mia, dan Bridget Jones's Diary. Untuk laki-laki, film favorit mereka meliputi Back to the Future, Toy Story, Shrek, The Full Monty, dan The Shawshank Redemption. article_content: CBS is gearing up for an eventful February sweeps with a special crossover between two of its crime dramas, 'CSI' and 'CSI: NY.' The story kicks off when Detective Mac Taylor, played by Gary Sinise, arrives in Las Vegas intending to surprise his girlfriend. However, he discovers she has vanished, and her hotel room has become a crime scene. Mac joins forces with D.B. Russell, the Las Vegas team leader (portrayed by Ted Danson), to unravel the mystery behind her disappearance. The plot thickens as the search continues in New York, with Russell following Mac back to the city to lend a hand. Despite capturing one of the suspects involved in Christine's kidnapping, the team is left with more questions about why she was taken and whether she is still alive. The ordeal becomes deeply personal for Mac, challenging him to consider bending the rules in a desperate attempt to save her. This latest crossover is part of CBS's strategy to bring popular shows together, similar to previous crossovers between 'NCIS: LA' and 'Hawaii Five-0,' as well as earlier collaborations within the 'CSI' franchise.

article_content: Two Hertswood Academy students, Charleigh Disbrey (15) and Mert Karaoglan (18), died after being struck by a high-speed train near Elstree and Borehamwood station in Hertfordshire. Authorities suspect the incident was a suicide pact. Investigators found three notes at the scene—two with Mert and one with Charleigh—indicating the act was premeditated. Charleigh, also known as CJ, was a passionate musician who shared performances online and auditioned for talent shows. Mert was an aspiring filmmaker working toward his A-levels, and his family has Turkish roots. Following the event, friends, classmates, and community members placed numerous flowers and heartfelt messages at the site and outside Hertswood Academy. The headteacher described both teenagers as talented and well-respected. Friends recalled Charleigh's kindness and musical talent, and Mert’s creative interests. Authorities do not believe foul play was involved. The school community continues to mourn, with many struggling to understand the reasons behind this loss.

In the summer of 2023, Texas endured an intense heat wave and ongoing drought that left a lasting impact on public health and the state’s economy. Austin Mayor Kirk Watson cautioned residents to stay indoors, warning, "With this heat, in this humidity, it's dangerous, and we need to pay attention to that." Both Texans and tourists largely complied, as research from the Dallas Federal Reserve reported that rising temperatures melted away an estimated $24 billion from Texas’ economy. The historically high temperatures and lack of rain significantly affected local businesses, causing ripple effects across the state.

Drawing on 20 years of data, analyses indicate that for every 1-degree increase in Texas’ average summer temperature, the state experiences a 0.4% slowdown in annual nominal GDP growth—twice the decline seen in other states. A study published in the Journal of Money, Credit and Banking found that for most states, the reduction ranges from 0.15% to 0.25%, with southern states more adversely affected due to already high baseline temperatures. Dallas Fed analysts note that for Texas, where summers are hotter on average, small temperature increases have disproportionate economic effects.

In 2023, temperatures were 2.5 degrees Fahrenheit above Texas’ post-2000 summer average. This anomaly likely reduced annual nominal GDP growth by roughly 1%, equating to a $24 billion loss. According to the Dallas Fed’s Texas Business Outlook Surveys in August, 24% of the 352 Texas businesses surveyed reported lower revenue or production due to the heat. Leisure and hospitality sectors were hit especially hard, with renowned attractions such as Schlitterbahn, SeaWorld, and Six Flags noting significant declines in summer visitors. One respondent commented, "The extreme heat definitely kept people home. That, coupled with the economy and people leaving Texas for cooler vacation spots like Colorado and Utah, further reduced revenue."

Austin, known for its vibrant social scene, experienced an uncharacteristic slowdown. Several local breweries, struggling in the heat, were forced to close, according to one brewery owner who described the heat as having "crushed" the city. Some businesses were also challenged by increased industry competition and the expiration of pandemic-era support such as Payroll Protection Program loans and Employee Retention Credits.

Numerous Texas cities broke long-standing high temperature records multiple times in 2023. The Dallas Fed notes that while some summer losses could be offset by increased economic activity during milder spring and fall seasons, these are unlikely to compensate for reduced tourism and businesses relying on outdoor customers. Looking ahead, projections from Texas A&M University’s Office of the Texas State Climatologist forecast that by 2036, the number of 100-degree days could nearly double, especially in urban areas. For context, Austin averaged 73 such days over the past two years.

The Dallas Fed concludes that more frequent and severe heat waves call for adaptation. For instance, theme parks like Six Flags in Arlington are introducing new shaded cabanas to protect guests, while communities consider adopting sustainable technologies, creating walkable neighborhoods, or retrofitting buildings for better energy efficiency and comfort.

Menurut survei Texas Business Outlook Dallas Fed pada Agustus, 24% dari 352 bisnis Texas melaporkan penurunan pendapatan atau produksi akibat panas. Austin yang biasanya ramai pun melambat tidak seperti biasanya. Beberapa pabrik bir lokal bahkan harus tutup karena panas, menurut seorang pemilik yang bilang suhu panas "menghancurkan" kota. Bisnis juga diuji persaingan yang makin ketat dan habisnya bantuan era pandemi seperti Payroll Protection Program serta Employee Retention Credits.

Berbagai kota Texas memecahkan rekor suhu tertinggi berulang kali pada 2023. Dallas Fed menyebut sebagian kerugian musim panas mungkin bisa diimbangi oleh peningkatan aktivitas ekonomi saat musim semi dan gugur, tapi kemungkinan belum cukup untuk menutup kerugian wisata dan bisnis luar ruangan. Ke depan, proyeksi Office of the Texas State Climatologist di Texas A&M University memperkirakan jumlah hari dengan suhu 100 derajat Fahrenheit bisa hampir dua kali lipat hingga 2036, terutama di perkotaan. Sebagai gambaran, Austin rata-rata mencatat 73 hari dengan suhu 100 derajat dalam dua tahun terakhir.

Dallas Fed menyimpulkan gelombang panas yang makin sering dan parah menuntut adaptasi. Misalnya, taman hiburan seperti Six Flags di Arlington menambah gazebo untuk keteduhan pengunjung, sementara komunitas mempertimbangkan teknologi berkelanjutan, lingkungan ramah pejalan kaki, atau renovasi bangunan agar lebih efisien energi dan nyaman sepanjang musim.

Archaeologists have discovered a classroom dating back approximately 1,700 years in Amheida, a site in Egypt’s Dakhla Oasis. As the first fully confirmed schoolroom from Roman-era Egypt, it is notable for its Greek motivational writings hand-painted on the walls, including lines from Homer’s 'The Odyssey.' It appears teachers wrote these messages to encourage students, emphasizing the importance of discipline and learning—an approach still seen today.

One passage refers to Helen of Troy administering a drug for emotional relief, with the word “imitate,” urging students to copy the excerpt. In another room, messages like, "Be bold, my boys; the great god [Hermes] will grant you a beautiful crown of manifold virtue," and, "Work hard for me, toils make men manly," encourage hard work and achievement.

Benches and Greek-language lessons inscribed on the walls indicate the classroom setup and the prevalence of Greek in education at the time. The school operated for about twenty years before it was incorporated into the home of a town councillor named Serenos. The building later featured paintings of Greek gods and banquet scenes.

Although the site was first found in 1979, it wasn’t until 2001 that archaeologists recognized the significance of the wall writings. New York University’s Professor Raffaella Cribiore emphasized that such physical evidence of a school is rare, as ancient schools were usually parts of private homes and hard to authenticate. Researchers suggest the later residents may have preserved these inscriptions as symbols of cultural sophistication.

Diperkirakan guru menulis pesan-pesan ini untuk memotivasi murid, menegaskan pentingnya disiplin dan belajar—sesuatu yang masih relevan sampai sekarang.

Salah satu kutipan menceritakan Helen dari Troya memberikan ramuan untuk menenangkan emosi, dengan kata “tirulah” yang meminta murid-murid menyalin kutipan tersebut. Di ruangan lain, pesan seperti, "Beranilah, anak-anakku; dewa agung [Hermes] akan memberimu mahkota kebajikan yang beragam," dan, "Bekerja keraslah untukku, kerja keras membuat pria tangguh," menegaskan arti penting dari usaha dan prestasi.

Bangku-bangku dan pelajaran berbahasa Yunani yang tertulis di dinding menunjukkan suasana kelas dan dominasi bahasa Yunani di pendidikan saat itu. Walau situs ini ditemukan pada 1979, inskripsi di dinding yang memastikan fungsinya sebagai sekolah baru diidentifikasi pada 2001. article_content: India’s stock market is set to hit new peaks in the next six months, with analysts anticipating gains of over 10% by the end of 2024, according to a Reuters poll. The continued expansion of India’s economy is cited as the main catalyst. Experts surveyed predict that value stocks—less favored in recent years compared to growth and tech shares—will outshine growth stocks, largely due to persistently high interest rates. In September, the BSE Sensex reached an all-time high but has since fallen by about 3%. Nonetheless, it remains nearly 8% higher for the year. This strong performance has made Indian stocks appear more expensive relative to other markets, with the Sensex’s price-to-earnings ratio just below that of the S&P 500. Almost 90% of analysts polled in mid-November see Indian equities reaching new record highs in the coming half-year. The Sensex is projected to rise more than 6% from its last close, topping 70,000 by mid-2024—an upgrade from earlier forecasts. By year-end, it could hit 72,500, per the median analyst estimate. India’s economy boasts the fastest growth rate among major nations, expected to surpass 6% in the next two years, further boosting investor enthusiasm. Rajat Agarwal of Societe Generale notes that 2023 saw strong growth and next year could bring moderation, but the macro momentum should continue, keeping India among investors’ top picks. Increased participation from young Indian investors has fueled stock market growth. As India passes China in population, improved financial literacy and greater access to investment products have spurred mutual fund accounts from below 60 million in 2016 to over 150 million now, says Capital Economics’ Shilan Shah. Every analyst polled expects corporate earnings to rise in the next six months, though increases may be smaller than this year’s over-20% surge, according to Agarwal. Roughly two-thirds of analysts think value stocks will outperform growth stocks in the near term. Axis Securities’ Nishit Master explains that value shares generally do better when interest rates are high, and the return of ultra-low global rates appears unlikely. The Nifty 50 index is forecasted to rise too—by about 5.6% to 20,800 by mid-2024 and to 21,840 by the end of the year. India’s IPO market is robust. New issues from Tata Technologies, Flair Writing Industries, and Gandhar Oil Refinery were fully subscribed within hours. IndiGo, India’s biggest airline, is reportedly considering premium services, hot meal options, and a loyalty program by late 2024 to attract business travelers and compete with Air India internationally. Since the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code began, 26,518 insolvency cases worth about ₹9.33 lakh crore have been settled before formal court proceedings.

Pertumbuhan ekonomi India yang terus berlanjut menjadi pendorong utama. Para pakar yang disurvei memperkirakan saham-saham bernilai—yang selama beberapa tahun terakhir kurang menarik dibanding saham pertumbuhan dan teknologi—akan mengungguli saham pertumbuhan, terutama karena suku bunga yang tetap tinggi. Kinerja kuat ini membuat saham India jauh lebih mahal dibanding pasar lain, dengan rasio harga terhadap pendapatan Sensex hanya sedikit di bawah S&P 500. Ekonomi India tumbuh paling pesat di antara negara besar, diproyeksikan menembus 6% dalam dua tahun ke depan, semakin menguatkan kepercayaan investor. Rajat Agarwal dari Societe Generale menyebut tahun 2023 ditandai pertumbuhan kuat dan tahun depan mungkin pertumbuhan moderat, namun momentum ekonomi diperkirakan tetap terjaga sehingga India tetap jadi favorit investor. Nishit Master dari Axis Securities menjelaskan, saham bernilai biasanya lebih unggul saat suku bunga tinggi, dan era suku bunga global ultra rendah tampaknya tidak akan segera kembali. Indeks Nifty 50 juga diprediksi naik—sebesar 5,6% menuju 20.800 di pertengahan 2024 dan 21.840 di akhir tahun. Pasar IPO India sedang booming. Penawaran saham perdana dari Tata Technologies, Flair Writing Industries, dan Gandhar Oil Refinery seluruhnya langsung ludes hanya dalam hitungan jam. article_content: Federal prosecutors have decided not to pursue charges against former Syracuse University assistant basketball coach Bernie Fine regarding longstanding sexual abuse accusations. Fine lost his position at Syracuse amid allegations from four individuals, although two of those accusers later admitted to making false claims. Ball boys Mike Lang and Bobby Davis, who are stepbrothers, had initially alleged that Fine had molested them over several years. Another accuser, Zachary Tomaselli, later confessed that his allegations were fabricated. A fourth man, Floyd 'David' VanHooser, also admitted he had made up his accusation against Fine. The university conducted an internal investigation into the claims in 2005 but found no corroborating evidence and did not seek criminal charges. In 2023, New York state officials stated they couldn't pursue charges because the statute of limitations had expired by the time the allegations surfaced, closing off that legal avenue. As a result, attention shifted to a federal investigation. After examining more than 100,000 pages of documents and interviewing about 130 witnesses, U.S. Attorney Richard S. Hartunian announced on Friday there was not enough credible evidence to file federal charges or refer the matter back to state prosecutors. Hartunian emphasized that closing the case does not determine whether the alleged abuse occurred, but rather reflects an inability to meet the evidentiary standard needed for prosecution. A 2002 phone call, reportedly between Bobby Davis and Laurie Fine, the coach’s wife, was publicized in 2011, with media claiming Laurie acknowledged awareness of misconduct. Nevertheless, the investigation did not yield sufficient proof to support criminal proceedings. Fine, married with three children, has consistently denied all allegations, calling them false. He was fired by Syracuse University after the media reports emerged in 2011.

Fine kehilangan posisinya di Syracuse setelah muncul tuduhan dari empat orang, meski dua di antaranya kemudian mengakui bahwa tuduhan tersebut bohong. Mike Lang dan Bobby Davis, dua ball boy yang merupakan saudara tiri, awalnya menuduh Fine telah melecehkan mereka selama beberapa tahun. Universitas melakukan investigasi internal pada 2005 atas tuduhan tersebut tetapi tidak menemukan bukti pendukung dan tidak melanjutkan ke jalur hukum. Pada 2023, pejabat negara bagian New York menyatakan tidak dapat mengajukan tuntutan karena aturan kedaluwarsa telah berlaku saat tuduhan itu muncul, sehingga jalur itu tertutup. article_content: Ferrari has unveiled a radical Formula One concept car on its official website, featuring a design from the team's Centro Stile studio. The car merges innovative technology with distinctive styling, resembling a traditional Ferrari sports car. According to Ferrari, the objective was to create a vehicle that is both visually captivating and technologically advanced.  The announcement stated: 'Our challenge was to create something that is simply better looking.' Ferrari, known for its iconic scarlet livery and Prancing Horse logo, invited fans to provide feedback online and through social media.  Red Bull Motorsports responded unexpectedly by tweeting their own car concept—originally designed by Adrian Newey for a 2014 computer game—accompanied by the playful remark: 'Way ahead of ya, @Scuderia Ferrari ;)'  Aesthetics of Formula One cars have faced criticism in recent years, with previous designs such as the 'duck-billed platypus' noses of 2012 being notable examples. Adrian Newey noted in a recent Formula1.com interview that aesthetics should be given more priority when establishing regulations.  The FIA—a motorsport governing body—sets detailed technical specifications to ensure safety and limit speeds. Ferrari claims its new concept could fit within existing regulations.  Meanwhile, F1 teams continue adapting to significant regulatory changes, particularly those around engine technology, introduced in 2014. The increased costs have already caused teams like Caterham and Marussia to leave the 2015 grid.  Ferrari is also adjusting internally, welcoming new president Sergio Marchionne, new team principal Maurizio Arrivabene, and new driver Sebastian Vettel during the winter break, alongside restructuring its technical department.  Ferrari posted the fastest time at the first winter test, though officials caution that true competitiveness will be revealed at the Australian Grand Prix on March 15.  While Ferrari is focused on advancing its long-term designs, the team remains committed to immediate performance improvements after not winning any races in 2014.

Menurut Ferrari, tujuannya adalah menciptakan kendaraan yang memikat secara visual dan maju secara teknologi.  Dalam pengumumannya, Ferrari menyampaikan: 'Tantangan kami adalah menciptakan sesuatu yang tampak lebih baik.' Ferrari mengklaim konsep barunya bisa sesuai dengan regulasi yang ada.  Sementara itu, tim F1 terus menyesuaikan diri dengan perubahan regulasi besar, terutama di bidang teknologi mesin, yang diperkenalkan pada 2014. Ferrari juga melakukan perubahan internal, menyambut presiden baru Sergio Marchionne, prinsipal tim Maurizio Arrivabene, dan pembalap baru Sebastian Vettel saat jeda musim dingin, serta merestrukturisasi departemen teknisnya. Walau Ferrari memfokuskan diri pada desain masa depan, tim ini tetap berkomitmen melakukan perbaikan performa setelah musim 2014 tanpa kemenangan.

article_content: England's hopes of fielding an unchanged team against South Africa on Saturday were dashed Tuesday night due to another injury setback—Anthony Watson is set to replace fellow Bath winger Semesa Rokoduguni. Earlier in the day, it was announced that Rokoduguni participated in full training, but later the coaching staff confirmed he would miss the QBE Test at Twickenham. Rokoduguni, born in Fiji and serving as a soldier, suffered a thigh injury during England's 24-21 defeat to New Zealand last weekend. As a result, England retained Marland Yarde in their squad to face the world's No. 2 ranked team. Watson, who made his Test debut off the bench against New Zealand, is now expected to start on the right wing. Coach Stuart Lancaster has long seen Watson as a player with star potential. Head coach Lancaster stated, 'Roko did some limited training but is unlikely to fully recover from his thigh injury in time for the game, so Marland is in the group.' Concerns remain over Northampton flanker Tom Wood, leading to Wasps captain James Haskell being placed on standby. 'Tom is still sore from the weekend and sat out training, so we are including five back rows to give us options,' Lancaster explained. Wood will be given every chance to prove his fitness for the Springboks clash, which would allow England to field the same pack that started against New Zealand. Watson made his Test debut during last week's defeat to New Zealand. The likely England starting lineup includes: 15 Mike Brown (Harlequins), 14 Anthony Watson (Bath), 13 Brad Barritt (Saracens), 12 Kyle Eastmond (Bath), 11 Jonny May (Gloucester), 10 Owen Farrell (Saracens), 9 Danny Care (Harlequins), 1 Joe Marler (Harlequins), 2 Dylan Hartley (Northampton), 3 David Wilson (Bath), 4 Dave Attwood (Bath), 5 Courtney Lawes (Northampton), 6 Tom Wood (Northampton), 7 Chris Robshaw (Harlequins, captain), 8 Billy Vunipola (Saracens). It is understood that Lancaster and his coaches originally planned to field an unchanged team, seeing no reason to panic after a fifth straight loss to New Zealand. Wanting greater attacking fluency and cohesion, they hoped to give the same lineup another opportunity, but this was prevented by Rokoduguni’s injury. There was better news earlier: Bath centre Kyle Eastmond returned to training after illness, postponing any decision on reuniting George Ford and Owen Farrell in the midfield, a combination that worked well at youth level. Northampton forwards Dylan Hartley and Courtney Lawes are expected to be fit despite concussions last weekend. Midfield remains under discussion. While the Ford-Farrell pairing was considered after recent kicking struggles, the current partnership—Lancaster’s 10th under his tenure—of Eastmond and Brad Barritt, performed solidly even with limited ball. Mike Catt, England's backs coach, remarked that Eastmond and Barritt are both in top form. Catt, himself a World Cup winner, stressed the need for a consistent centre pairing due to frequent injury disruptions. With Manu Tuilagi and Luther Burrell unavailable, Catt noted, 'There is good competition in those areas but it is about consistency. At the end of the day, you want an established 12 and 13 who can do a job for you. You want to get the combinations right.' Catt also praised Barritt’s leadership and positive influence within the team. South Africa, looking to recover from a defeat in Dublin, hope to make England suffer at Twickenham. South Africa's assistant coach John McFarland has stated the team believes holding England to 15 points or less will provide a platform for victory. He added, 'If you concede less than 15, you have a good chance of winning Test matches, but we know we have big improvements to make.' England are on high alert ahead of facing a Springbok side eager to bounce back. Catt mentioned the importance of stopping South Africa’s 'big green machine' and emphasized England's awareness of the challenge ahead.

Sebelumnya diumumkan bahwa Rokoduguni ikut latihan penuh, namun kemudian staf pelatih memastikan ia absen dari Tes QBE di Twickenham. Rokoduguni, yang lahir di Fiji dan merupakan seorang tentara, mengalami cedera paha saat Inggris kalah 24-21 dari Selandia Baru akhir pekan lalu. Akibatnya, Inggris mempertahankan Marland Yarde dalam skuad untuk menghadapi tim peringkat dua dunia. Watson, yang melakukan debut Tes-nya dari bangku cadangan melawan Selandia Baru, kini diperkirakan akan menjadi starter di posisi sayap kanan. Pelatih Stuart Lancaster telah lama melihat Watson sebagai pemain berpotensi bintang. Pelatih kepala Lancaster menyatakan, 'Roko menjalani latihan terbatas, tetapi kecil kemungkinan ia pulih sepenuhnya dari cedera pahanya tepat waktu, jadi Marland masuk grup.' Masih ada kekhawatiran terhadap flanker Northampton, Tom Wood, sehingga kapten Wasps, James Haskell, disiapkan sebagai cadangan. 'Tom masih merasakan sakit usai pertandingan akhir pekan dan absen latihan, jadi kami memasukkan lima pemain back row agar punya opsi,' jelas Lancaster. Wood akan diberi kesempatan untuk membuktikan kesiapan fisiknya saat melawan Springboks, yang memungkinkan Inggris menurunkan pack yang sama seperti lawan Selandia Baru. Watson melakukan debut Tes-nya pada kekalahan pekan lalu melawan Selandia Baru. Susunan starter Inggris yang mungkin meliputi: 15 Mike Brown (Harlequins), 14 Anthony Watson (Bath), 13 Brad Barritt (Saracens), 12 Kyle Eastmond (Bath), 11 Jonny May (Gloucester), 10 Owen Farrell (Saracens), 9 Danny Care (Harlequins), 1 Joe Marler (Harlequins), 2 Dylan Hartley (Northampton), 3 David Wilson (Bath), 4 Dave Attwood (Bath), 5 Courtney Lawes (Northampton), 6 Tom Wood (Northampton), 7 Chris Robshaw (Harlequins, kapten), 8 Billy Vunipola (Saracens). Dipahami bahwa Lancaster dan staf pelatih awalnya berencana menurunkan tim yang sama, tidak panik meski kalah lima kali berturut-turut dari Selandia Baru. Demi meningkatkan kelancaran dan kohesi serangan, mereka ingin memberi susunan yang sama kesempatan lagi, namun rencana tersebut gagal akibat cedera Rokoduguni. Ada kabar baik sebelumnya: Gelandang Bath, Kyle Eastmond, kembali latihan setelah sakit, sehingga belum diputuskan soal menyatukan kembali George Ford dan Owen Farrell di lini tengah, kombinasi yang dahulu efektif di level junior. Pemain Northampton, Dylan Hartley dan Courtney Lawes, diperkirakan fit meski sempat mengalami gegar otak akhir pekan lalu. Lini tengah masih jadi bahan diskusi. Kombinasi Ford-Farrell sempat dipertimbangkan setelah masalah tendangan baru-baru ini, namun duet saat ini—yang ke-10 di era Lancaster—antara Eastmond dan Brad Barritt tampil solid meski minim bola. Mike Catt, pelatih backs Inggris, mengatakan Eastmond dan Barritt sedang dalam performa terbaik. Catt, juara dunia, menekankan pentingnya pasangan gelandang tengah yang konsisten karena cedera kerap mengganggu. Dengan absennya Manu Tuilagi dan Luther Burrell, Catt menyatakan, 'Persaingan di area itu bagus tapi yang terpenting adalah konsistensi. Pada akhirnya, Anda ingin punya gelandang 12 dan 13 yang bisa diandalkan. Kombinasi harus tepat.' Catt juga memuji kepemimpinan dan pengaruh positif Barritt di dalam tim. Afrika Selatan yang ingin bangkit usai kalah di Dublin, berharap membuat Inggris menderita di Twickenham. Pelatih asisten Afrika Selatan, John McFarland, mengatakan timnya yakin menahan Inggris di bawah 15 poin jadi kunci kemenangan. Ia menambahkan, 'Jika kebobolan kurang dari 15, peluang menang Tes besar, tapi kami sadar banyak hal yang masih harus diperbaiki.' Inggris waspada menghadapi Springbok yang bertekad bangkit. Catt menekankan pentingnya menghentikan 'big green machine' Afrika Selatan dan menegaskan timnya paham tantangan yang akan dihadapi.

article_content: Heavy rain in Manchester forced the England cricket team to train indoors at Old Trafford on Wednesday as they prepared for the fourth Test against India. The squad appeared upbeat, lifted by their convincing victory in Southampton and the ICC’s decision to clear Jimmy Anderson of alleged misconduct involving Ravindra Jadeja. Alastair Cook noted that Anderson, who is on the verge of surpassing Sir Ian Botham’s record for most Test wickets by an England player, seemed more relaxed ahead of playing at his home ground free from suspension worries. After India’s appeal was rejected, ICC chief executive Dave Richardson confirmed there would be no further action on the Anderson case and advised players to avoid personal sledging. Cook highlighted that while Anderson’s aggression has been key to his success—leaving him just 12 wickets short of Botham’s record—he must ensure he stays within acceptable boundaries. England are expected to field the same team that broke their ten-Test winless run, with Chris Jordan and Chris Woakes continuing alongside Anderson and Stuart Broad. Although Steven Finn has impressed in practice, he is unlikely to be included at this time. Jordan and Woakes have the opportunity to cement their places in the side, while the team is focusing on stability rather than making frequent changes. Broad, managing a knee injury that will likely need surgery after the series, is set to play and is eager to improve his record at Old Trafford. Key senior players—Cook, Anderson, Broad, and Ian Bell—have set a positive example, bringing new optimism to the team. Cook expressed relief at his recent batting performance but cautioned that the team must maintain focus and consistency. India looked sluggish in their fielding drills but showed energy during their customary football warm-up. MS Dhoni, a passionate Manchester United fan, joked about missing football despite being at Old Trafford—the cricket ground. All eyes are now on Anderson in this crucial match and whether any further on-field friction with India arises.

article_content: The U.S. Supreme Court is revisiting the University of Texas at Austin’s race-conscious admissions policy, which has drawn criticism for potentially disadvantaging white and Asian-American applicants. The case was initiated by Abigail Fisher, who claims she was unfairly rejected in 2008 due to the university’s diversity-driven approach. During oral arguments, Justices showed clear ideological splits. Liberal Justices, such as Sonia Sotomayor, argued that schools deserve some flexibility in crafting a diverse student body. Conversely, conservatives like Chief Justice John Roberts questioned how the university determines an adequate ‘critical mass’ of minority students, raising concerns about the policy’s specificity and fairness. Justice Anthony Kennedy, often the deciding vote, may seek a compromise—modifying the university’s admissions process without outlawing affirmative action altogether. The University asserts its admissions process is holistic, considering academic achievements, extracurriculars, leadership, and community service, with race being only one component. The Obama administration has backed this approach, and U.S. Solicitor General Donald Verrilli noted that race is just one factor among many and not applied mechanically. A significant part of the debate focused on how universities gauge when they’ve achieved sufficient diversity—what’s called ‘critical mass’—with differing opinions among the Justices. Justices also queried how students of mixed heritage or varied Asian backgrounds fit into these classifications, questioning the appropriateness of broad groupings. The court is more conservative than when it upheld some affirmative action in 2003, a decision influenced by Justice Sandra Day O’Connor, who foresaw a time when such policies might become unnecessary. A decision in Fisher v. University of Texas at Austin (case no. 11-345) is expected next year, potentially influencing college admissions nationwide.

Kasus ini diajukan oleh Abigail Fisher, yang menyatakan dirinya ditolak dengan tidak adil pada tahun 2008 akibat kebijakan kampus yang menekankan keberagaman. Dalam sidang, para Hakim menunjukkan perbedaan ideologi yang tajam. Hakim liberal seperti Sonia Sotomayor menyatakan bahwa kampus butuh keleluasaan dalam menciptakan lingkungan mahasiswa yang beragam. Sementara itu, kelompok konservatif seperti Ketua Hakim John Roberts mempertanyakan bagaimana universitas menentukan 'massa kritis' mahasiswa minoritas yang dianggap cukup, serta kerincian dan keadilan kebijakan tersebut. Hakim Anthony Kennedy, yang sering jadi penentu, mungkin mencari jalan tengah dengan memodifikasi proses seleksi UT tanpa melarang affirmative action sepenuhnya. Pihak universitas menyatakan seleksi mereka bersifat holistik, memperhitungkan prestasi akademis, kegiatan ekstrakurikuler, kepemimpinan, dan pengabdian masyarakat, dengan ras sebagai salah satu faktor saja. Pemerintah Obama mendukung langkah ini, dan Jaksa Agung AS Donald Verrilli menegaskan bahwa ras hanya salah satu dari banyak pertimbangan dan tidak digunakan secara otomatis. Debat utama berkisar pada cara kampus mengukur tercapainya keberagaman yang cukup ('massa kritis'), dengan pandangan yang berbeda dari para Hakim. Hakim juga mempertanyakan bagaimana klasifikasi mahasiswa berdarah campuran atau dari beragam latar belakang Asia—dan apakah pengelompokan yang luas itu tepat. Saat ini, Mahkamah Agung lebih konservatif dibandingkan putusan tahun 2003 yang masih mengizinkan affirmative action—yang kala itu dipengaruhi Hakim Sandra Day O’Connor yang memperkirakan kebijakan seperti ini suatu hari tidak lagi diperlukan. Keputusan dalam Fisher v. University of Texas at Austin (no. 11-345) diperkirakan akan keluar tahun depan dan sangat mungkin berdampak pada kebijakan penerimaan di kampus se-Amerika.

article_content: Retiring Allahabad High Court Chief Justice Pritinker Diwaker stated on Tuesday that his transfer from the Chhattisgarh High Court to the Allahabad High Court by the Collegium led by former Chief Justice of India Dipak Misra was intended to ‘harass’ him. ‘Eventually, on March 31, 2009, I was elevated to the Bench. I fulfilled my responsibilities as a judge at the Chhattisgarh High Court until October 2018, to the satisfaction of all, and particularly my own conscience. Suddenly, then Chief Justice of India Dipak Misra showed some extra affection for reasons unknown to me, resulting in my transfer to the Allahabad High Court, where I assumed office on October 3, 2018,’ Diwaker said in his farewell speech. He described his transfer order as seemingly issued with ill intention. However, he added that the situation became beneficial, as he received strong support and cooperation from fellow judges and Bar members. Earlier this year, the current Collegium led by Chief Justice of India D Y Chandrachud recommended Diwaker’s name for the post of Chief Justice of Allahabad High Court. ‘I am highly thankful to the present Chief Justice D Y Chandrachud, who rectified the injustice done to me.’ Reflecting on his career, Diwaker said, ‘On November 1, 2000, the High Court of Chhattisgarh was established, and I moved to Bilaspur. In 2009, when the Collegium offered me judgeship, I was initially hesitant but, after consultation with family and well-wishers, I accepted.’ ‘It has always been a source of pride to work in this great institution with its unique traditions. Balancing a heavy workload in the Allahabad High Court is indeed a challenge. This court has faced criticism about its functioning, but I believe critics must consider the institution's internal difficulties before making judgments,’ he said. He noted that while he was not outstanding academically, his passion for sports contributed to his personal development. Diwaker added, ‘It was almost impossible to imagine achieving my dream of dispensing justice, but I now realize that with a thirst for knowledge and responsibility to the disadvantaged, anything is possible. Perhaps this is what led me into the justice system to help those in need.’ He credited his late father, Dr S C Diwaker, for encouraging him to enter the legal field. After earning his law degree, he began his advocacy career in 1984 at the principal Bench of the Madhya Pradesh High Court. He stated he never aspired to be a judge, but believes his love for the profession led him down that path. Diwaker also praised the effective and impressive functioning of the Lucknow Bench and commended the quality and behavior of its lawyers.

'Akhirnya, pada 31 Maret 2009, saya diangkat menjadi hakim. Saya menjalankan tugas saya sebagai hakim di Pengadilan Tinggi Chhattisgarh hingga Oktober 2018, dengan memuaskan semua orang, terutama hati nurani saya sendiri. Secara tiba-tiba, Ketua Hakim India waktu itu, Dipak Misra, menunjukkan perhatian lebih kepada saya atas alasan yang masih belum saya ketahui, yang berujung pada pemindahan saya ke Pengadilan Tinggi Allahabad, di mana saya mulai bertugas pada 3 Oktober 2018,' ujar Diwaker dalam pidato perpisahannya. Dia menggambarkan surat pemindahannya seolah-olah dikeluarkan dengan niat tidak baik. Namun, dia menambahkan bahwa keadaan ini akhirnya berbuah baik karena ia mendapat dukungan dan kerja sama yang kuat dari sesama hakim dan para anggota Bar. 'Saya sangat berterima kasih kepada Ketua Hakim D Y Chandrachud saat ini, yang telah memperbaiki ketidakadilan yang pernah saya alami.' Mengenang kariernya, Diwaker berkata, 'Pada 1 November 2000, Pengadilan Tinggi Chhattisgarh dibentuk, dan saya pindah ke Bilaspur. Pada 2009, ketika kolegium menawari saya posisi hakim, saya awalnya ragu tetapi setelah berdiskusi dengan keluarga dan para sahabat, saya akhirnya menerima.' 'Saya selalu bangga bekerja di institusi besar ini dengan tradisi-tradisinya yang unik. Menyeimbangkan beban kerja yang berat di Pengadilan Tinggi Allahabad benar-benar merupakan tantangan. Pengadilan ini memang pernah mendapat kritik terkait fungsinya, namun saya yakin para pengkritik harus mempertimbangkan juga kesulitan internal yang ada sebelum membuat penilaian,' tuturnya. Ia menuturkan meskipun secara akademis tidak luar biasa, kecintaannya pada olahraga ikut membentuk perkembangan pribadinya. Diwaker menambahkan, 'Hampir mustahil bagi saya membayangkan bisa mencapai mimpi menegakkan keadilan, tapi kini saya sadar bahwa dengan rasa haus akan ilmu dan tanggung jawab pada kaum lemah, semua bisa diraih. Mungkin inilah yang menuntun saya masuk ke dunia peradilan untuk membantu mereka yang membutuhkan.' Ia mengakui mendiang ayahnya, Dr S C Diwaker, yang telah mendorongnya masuk dunia hukum. Setelah lulus sebagai sarjana hukum, ia memulai karier advokatnya pada 1984 di Pengadilan Tinggi Madhya Pradesh. Ia mengatakan tidak pernah bercita-cita menjadi hakim, namun merasa kecintaannya pada profesi ini membawa dirinya ke jalur itu. Diwaker juga memuji kinerja efisien dan mengesankan dari Pengadilan Negeri Lucknow serta memuji kualitas dan sikap para pengacaranya.

article_content: In the early hours of the morning, thieves detonated a cash machine outside an HSBC branch in Brislington, Bristol by pumping it with gas, making off with what detectives believe could be tens of thousands of pounds. The force of the explosion shattered a glass window and left banknotes, debris, and metal fragments scattered across the street. The suspects, described as wearing dark clothing, fled the scene, and authorities are now examining security footage as part of their ongoing investigation. According to Detective Inspector Andy Gyther from Avon and Somerset Police, this dramatic robbery marks the fifth time in 18 months that a cash machine has been targeted in Bristol using similar methods. Police continue to search for the individuals responsible and are calling for information from the public. Previous incidents in the region include other explosive attacks on ATMs, such as one at a convenience store within a petrol station in St George six months ago, and several more throughout 2013, highlighting a troubling pattern. Although some attempts were unsuccessful, many led to significant cash being stolen. HSBC has confirmed the attack and is collaborating closely with law enforcement. Police forensics units have cordoned off the scene to gather evidence while the hunt for the suspects continues.
