Ledakan tersebut juga menghancurkan kaca jendela serta menebarkan uang kertas, puing-puing, dan potongan logam ke jalanan. Pelaku yang mengenakan pakaian gelap segera melarikan diri, sementara pihak berwenang sedang memeriksa rekaman CCTV sebagai bagian dari penyelidikan. Menurut Detektif Inspektur Andy Gyther dari Kepolisian Avon dan Somerset, perampokan dramatis ini merupakan yang kelima dalam 18 bulan terakhir di Bristol dengan metode serupa. Polisi masih mencari pelaku dan meminta bantuan informasi dari masyarakat. Insiden serupa sebelumnya juga pernah terjadi di area lain, seperti pada mesin ATM di toko swalayan dalam SPBU di St George enam bulan lalu, serta beberapa kasus sepanjang 2013. Tim forensik polisi memasang garis polisi di lokasi untuk mengumpulkan bukti, sementara pencarian tersangka masih berlangsung.

article_content: The Indian Finance Ministry has instructed all departments and ministries to strictly follow official guidelines on issuing mobile phones, laptops, and similar devices to officers, and to withdraw any existing policies that differ from the Department of Expenditure's rules. In July, the Department of Expenditure released comprehensive guidelines for providing devices such as mobiles, laptops, tablets, phablets, notebooks, notepads, ultrabooks, netbooks, and similar devices to eligible officers of the Government of India for official work. A recent memorandum noted that certain ministries and departments have been using their own device policies, which do not align with the official guidelines. The Department has directed all such entities to rescind these policies and fully comply with the official instructions. Under the July guidelines, central government officers are entitled to receive mobile phones, laptops, or similar devices with a price ceiling of up to Rs 1.3 lakh, which can be retained for personal use after four years. Officers at the rank of Deputy Secretary and above qualify for these devices, while for Section Officers and Under Secretaries, up to 50% of the sanctioned positions are eligible. The cost limit for devices is Rs 1 lakh plus taxes, but for those with over 40 percent Make-in-India components, the limit increases to Rs 1.3 lakh plus taxes. Separately, the Income Tax Department is investigating Apple, Google, and Amazon's Indian subsidiaries regarding possible tax payment issues, focusing on transfer pricing practices since 2021. Indians have become the leading group of real estate investors in Dubai, playing a major role in the city's property market. Razorpay, a digital payments company, is planning a cross-border merger to move its parent entity's domicile from the US to India, which may involve a tax payment of $250–300 million in the US.

Pada Juli lalu, Departemen Pengeluaran mengeluarkan pedoman lengkap mengenai pemberian perangkat seperti ponsel, laptop, tablet, phablet, notebook, notepad, ultrabook, netbook, dan perangkat serupa kepada pejabat pemerintah India yang memenuhi syarat untuk keperluan dinas. Secara terpisah, Departemen Pajak Penghasilan sedang menyelidiki anak perusahaan Apple, Google, dan Amazon di India terkait dugaan masalah pembayaran pajak, berfokus pada praktik transfer pricing sejak 2021. Sir Howard Davies, the chair of the Airports Commission, has announced that all possibilities for increasing UK airport capacity are up for review. Options include building additional runways at Heathrow and Gatwick, proposing a major new airport in the Thames Estuary ('Boris Island'), creating a four-runway Heathrow, and expanding regional airports such as Stansted, Birmingham, and Cardiff.

This comprehensive approach has brought Sir Howard into disagreement with London Mayor Boris Johnson, who strongly supports the Thames Estuary airport and opposes any Heathrow expansion. Johnson cautioned that continuing to consider a third Heathrow runway could damage the Conservative Party’s chances in the 2015 general election, describing the proposal as potentially 'toxic and disastrous.'

Sir Howard explained that, while current government policy excludes a second Gatwick runway before 2019 and no third runway at Heathrow during this Parliament, all options are open for consideration after that period. The commission's interim report, containing suggested short-term actions and longer-term options, is due next year, with a final, more detailed report planned for release in summer 2015, after the national election. The review’s objective is to help achieve political consensus on the complex issue of airport expansion.

Local residents near Heathrow, especially in West London, have voiced concerns over the disruption and noise pollution a third runway might cause. Sir Howard indicated that compensation for affected homeowners is being considered, mentioning both Deputy Prime Minister Nick Clegg and former Transport Secretary Justine Greening as prominent residents opposed to Heathrow’s expansion.

Questions have been raised about the impartiality of commission members, particularly regarding Sir John Armitt, who has links to Labour policy development. The Prime Minister’s office rejects claims that the review is being delayed, stating that debates are ongoing and more evidence is needed to reach an informed decision.

article_content: Pop singer Simone Battle has died at the age of 25. Her death is currently under investigation. She was photographed in New York on August 20. Battle passed away on Friday morning at her home in Los Angeles, as confirmed by MailOnline. Her father, Anthony E. Battle, said she was found dead around 8am. 'She will be greatly missed and loved,' Mr. Battle stated. 'She was an exuberant and beloved person.' Although the cause is still being investigated, law enforcement sources told TMZ that it appears to have been a suicide. Battle's record label and management released a joint statement: 'We are deeply saddened by the tragic loss of Simone Battle of G.R.L. Simone was an exceptional young talent and human being, and we are devastated to learn of her passing. Our thoughts and prayers are with her family and loved ones at this time.' Her friend and fellow musician Derek Butler first shared the news overnight on Instagram, posting a picture of Simone and expressing his shock and grief. At the time of her death, Battle was a singer in the girl group G.R.L., which was initially set up as a reboot of The Pussycat Dolls. The group later chose a new name and identity. The remaining G.R.L. members issued a statement on Saturday via Twitter, saying: 'Words cannot express the depth of our loss. Simone's incredible talent was only surpassed by the size of her heart. We will carry her memory with us in everything we do.' Simone Battle began singing professionally after competing in the U.S. version of The X Factor in 2011, reaching the top 17 and being mentored by judge Simon Cowell. The Los Angeles Police Department did not immediately respond to requests for comment. Simone was pictured with G.R.L. members Lauren Bennett, Natasha Slayton, Emmalyn Estrada, and Paula von Oppen at various events. She also appeared with her parents Donna Morgan and Anthony Battle. If you or someone you know is struggling, confidential help is available. In the U.S., call the National Suicide Prevention Lifeline at 1-800-273-8255. For support in the UK, contact the Samaritans at 08457 90 90 90 or visit a local branch.

During one of Boston's worst snowstorms, over two feet of snow blanketed the city, shutting down schools, businesses, and roads. While major streets were cleared, the iconic Boston Marathon finish line on Boylston Street was left hidden under the snow. This sparked a mystery after three photos surfaced online showing someone clearing the area.

Philip Hillman, 44, captured a photo from his hotel room of a man in dark clothing approaching the finish line with a shovel. Hillman, working remotely to avoid commuting in the storm, told CNN that witnessing the act filled him with pride for his city: "Boston Strong—I love this city and love that someone would do that."

Chris Laudani, a Boston bartender, was eventually identified as the individual responsible. Speaking to CNN affiliate WCVB, Laudani said, "It's very special to me and to the city, and I didn't think it deserved to be covered under all that snow." Laudani’s actions received widespread acclaim, with many calling him an American hero and highlighting how the #BostonStrong spirit endures nearly two years after the Boston Marathon attack.

In another photo taken by Kelsey Karkos and shared on Instagram, a man is seen clearing the finish line. Karkos explained that as she searched for the landmark, a man shoveling nearby noticed and offered help. "I do not know the man shoveling. He saw me looking for the finish line while he was shoveling the sidewalk. He knew exactly what I was looking for and came over to help me! Such a great person with some Boston spirit during the blizzard!" she wrote.

A third photo showed an individual posing at the cleared finish line, but Instagram user @johnbackbay later clarified on Twitter that he did not participate in the shoveling.

The hashtag campaign #WhoShoveledTheFinishLine quickly gained traction, with the Boston Police Department posting on Twitter and Facebook to find the mystery shoveler. Officer Rachel McGuire told CNN she dubbed Laudani the "chivalrous shoveler" after seeing the photo on Twitter.

CNN’s Justin Lear, Stephanie Gallman, and Patrick Cornell contributed to this report.

Laporan ini juga berkontribusi dari Justin Lear, Stephanie Gallman, dan Patrick Cornell dari CNN.

article_content: U.S. Ambassador to Syria Robert Ford visited the city of Hama on Thursday, an area experiencing significant unrest, as part of an effort to express U.S. support for Syrians advocating for democratic change. According to State Department spokeswoman Victoria Nuland, Ford's presence was intended to clearly demonstrate American solidarity with those calling for reform. Hama has faced violence and a general strike this week following a series of peaceful demonstrations, including a large anti-government protest last Friday. Reports from activists and Human Rights Watch indicate that subsequent security crackdowns led to multiple arrests and fatalities. President Bashar al-Assad dismissed Hama's provincial governor on Saturday, and security forces relocated tanks to the city’s outskirts, which some interpreted as a possible easing of tensions. During his visit, Ford spoke with more than a dozen Hama residents and visited a hospital treating people wounded by security forces, Nuland said. She described the ambassador as receiving a 'very warm welcome.' Syria's state news agency SANA reported that a Foreign Ministry source criticized Ford's visit, claiming he traveled to Hama without prior government permission. The official suggested the visit was evidence of U.S. involvement intended to worsen the unrest. Nuland, however, stated that U.S. officials had notified the Syrian government about an embassy team traveling to Hama without specifying the individuals involved. The Syrian authorities allowed the group to proceed through checkpoints and did not assign any official Syrian handlers to the delegation. Nuland emphasized that Ford’s personal visit symbolized U.S. support for the people of Hama and concern regarding the security forces’ actions. She added that Ford planned to remain in Hama through Friday’s expected protests. It remains uncertain whether Hama residents will participate in nationwide demonstrations following Friday prayers. Last month, violent crackdowns in Hama reportedly killed 60 protesters. The city holds particular significance for Syrian authorities, as it was also the site of a deadly suppression of Sunni Muslims by the Alawite-led government under Hafez al-Assad, Bashar al-Assad’s late father, in 1982. Human Rights Watch estimates that crackdown killed around 10,000 people.
translated_content: Duta Besar AS untuk Suriah, Robert Ford, mengunjungi kota Hama pada hari Kamis, sebuah wilayah yang sedang mengalami ketegangan besar, sebagai bagian dari upaya menunjukkan dukungan AS kepada warga Suriah yang memperjuangkan perubahan demokratis. Menurut juru bicara Departemen Luar Negeri, Victoria Nuland, kehadiran Ford dimaksudkan untuk menunjukkan secara jelas solidaritas Amerika dengan mereka yang menyerukan reformasi. Hama mengalami kekerasan dan aksi mogok umum pekan ini setelah serangkaian demonstrasi damai, termasuk unjuk rasa anti-pemerintah besar pada Jumat lalu. Laporan dari aktivis dan Human Rights Watch menyatakan penindakan keamanan menyebabkan banyak penangkapan dan korban jiwa. Presiden Bashar al-Assad memecat gubernur provinsi Hama pada hari Sabtu, dan pasukan keamanan memindahkan tank ke pinggiran kota, yang dianggap sebagian pihak sebagai tanda kemungkinan meredanya ketegangan. Selama kunjungannya, Ford berbicara dengan lebih dari selusin warga Hama dan mengunjungi rumah sakit yang merawat korban luka akibat penindakan pasukan keamanan, ujar Nuland. Ia mengatakan Ford disambut dengan 'sangat hangat.' Kantor berita negara Suriah, SANA, melaporkan seorang sumber di Kementerian Luar Negeri mengkritik kunjungan Ford, menuduh dia ke Hama tanpa izin pemerintah sebelumnya. Pejabat tersebut menyebut kunjungan itu sebagai bukti keterlibatan AS yang bertujuan memperburuk situasi. Namun, Nuland menyatakan pejabat AS telah memberi tahu pemerintah Suriah tentang kunjungan tim kedutaan ke Hama tanpa merinci siapa saja yang terlibat. Pihak berwenang Suriah mengizinkan rombongan melintasi pos pemeriksaan dan tidak menempatkan pengawal resmi pada delegasi tersebut. Nuland menekankan kunjungan langsung Ford melambangkan dukungan AS bagi warga Hama dan keprihatinan terhadap tindakan pasukan keamanan. Ia menambahkah Ford berencana tetap di Hama hingga protes yang dijadwalkan pada hari Jumat. Masih belum jelas apakah warga Hama akan berpartisipasi dalam demonstrasi nasional setelah salat Jumat. Bulan lalu, penindakan keras di Hama dilaporkan menewaskan 60 pengunjuk rasa. Kota ini sangat penting bagi otoritas Suriah karena juga merupakan lokasi penindasan mematikan terhadap Muslim Sunni oleh pemerintahan Alawiyah di bawah Hafez al-Assad, ayah Bashar al-Assad, pada tahun 1982. Human Rights Watch memperkirakan sekitar 10.000 orang tewas dalam peristiwa tersebut.

article_content: A five-year-old boy from Sutton Coldfield, Kelan Logan-Derench, died after a tragic accident in Egypt during his first holiday abroad. Kelan reportedly fell into a swimming pool just a day after arriving in Egypt with his family. Despite immediate efforts, nothing could be done to save him. Family friend Serena Whitehead launched a crowdfunding campaign to raise money to bring Kelan home and cover funeral costs. The GoFundMe page has collected more than £14,000 out of a £15,000 target. Ms Whitehead, a friend of Kelan’s mother, described Kelan as 'a cheeky, mischievous, happy little boy' and said the entire family is 'absolutely broken' by the loss. She wrote, 'The least we can do as friends of the family and as a community is to help them by offering some financial support so that they can bring Kelan home and give him the funeral he deserves.' A spokesperson for the Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office confirmed that staff are supporting the family of the British child who died in Egypt.

Teman keluarga, Serena Whitehead, memulai kampanye penggalangan dana untuk membantu memulangkan Kelan ke Inggris dan menutupi biaya pemakaman. Halaman GoFundMe telah mengumpulkan lebih dari £14.000 dari target £15.000. Whitehead, sahabat ibu Kelan, menggambarkan Kelan sebagai 'anak kecil yang lucu, nakal, dan bahagia', dan mengatakan seluruh keluarga benar-benar hancur atas kehilangan ini. Ia menulis, 'Hal paling sedikit yang bisa kami lakukan sebagai teman dan komunitas adalah memberikan dukungan finansial agar mereka dapat membawa Kelan pulang dan memberinya pemakaman yang layak.' Juru bicara Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office memastikan bahwa staf mereka sedang mendukung keluarga anak Inggris yang meninggal di Mesir.

article_content: Hollywood studios have submitted a new proposal to SAG-AFTRA in hopes of ending the actors’ strike that has persisted for over three months. Direct negotiations between top studio CEOs and guild leaders are set for this weekend, but union sources caution that resolution isn't immediately expected, as SAG-AFTRA leadership will review the offer in detail before further talks. This development follows a tense week, with both sides expressing cautious hope yet acknowledging unresolved issues. The studios’ delayed response to union counterproposals has led to frustration among SAG-AFTRA members. Union priorities include gaining control over digital stunt double likenesses and imposing limits on digital extras, to protect job opportunities for live actors. Some studio representatives argue that such creative choices are typically the purview of directors. The ongoing strike continues to delay TV and film productions. Industry sources note that significant project rescheduling could potentially cost next year’s box office over $1.5 billion. Studios like Warner Bros Discovery and Paramount Global are already reporting major financial losses due to halted production. Key studio executives directly engaged in the negotiations include Donna Langley (NBCUniversal), Bob Iger (Disney), David Zaslav (Warner Bros Discovery), and Ted Sarandos (Netflix). Fran Drescher (SAG-AFTRA president) and Duncan Crabtree-Ireland (chief negotiator) lead talks from the guild side. Their involvement resembles the executive participation that aided resolution during the writers’ strike. Despite rumors of attempts to create division within the union, member support for leadership remains strong. The broader fallout of the strike extends to all of California, with the state’s economy suffering an estimated $6.5 billion loss and over 45,000 entertainment industry jobs reportedly cut since strikes began earlier this year.

Kabar ini muncul setelah pekan yang penuh ketegangan, di mana kedua belah pihak menyampaikan harapan hati-hati namun juga mengakui masih ada banyak isu yang belum terselesaikan. Respons studio yang lambat terhadap proposal balasan serikat telah menimbulkan rasa frustrasi di kalangan anggota SAG-AFTRA. Prioritas utama serikat mencakup permintaan untuk mengendalikan rupa pemeran pengganti digital (stunt double) dan pembatasan penggunaan figuran digital, demi menjaga peluang kerja bagi aktor sungguhan. Namun beberapa perwakilan studio berpendapat keputusan kreatif semacam ini biasanya menjadi hak sutradara. Pemogokan yang berlarut-larut menyebabkan penundaan produksi TV dan film. Sumber di industri menyebutkan bahwa penjadwalan ulang proyek besar bisa menyebabkan kerugian box office tahun depan lebih dari $1,5 miliar. Studio seperti Warner Bros Discovery dan Paramount Global juga telah melaporkan kerugian finansial besar akibat produksi yang berhenti. article_content: Google and SpaceX, two leading firms in hi-tech innovation, are collaborating to make internet access available globally by launching a network of satellites into orbit. Elon Musk’s company, SpaceX, confirmed today that it has raised $1 billion in its latest financing round, with Google and Fidelity joining as new investors. Elon Musk aims to create a second internet in space, which could eventually provide online access to people on Mars. Mark Zuckerberg has also announced that solar-powered drones, satellites, and lasers are being developed at his company to bring internet connectivity to underserved countries. Small satellite manufacturers, such as Sierra Nevada and the UK's Surrey Satellite Technology, are skilled in making affordable satellites and have a strong track record. SpaceX revealed, 'Space Exploration Technologies (SpaceX) has raised a billion dollars in a financing round with two new investors, Google and Fidelity. Google and Fidelity join existing investors Founders Fund, Draper Fisher Jurvetson, Valor Equity Partners, and Capricorn, and together will own just under 10 percent of SpaceX.' Google is already working on delivering internet access to remote regions using high-altitude balloons. SpaceX stated, 'This funding will be used to support continued innovation in space transport, reusability, and satellite manufacturing.' According to The Information, the investment will help SpaceX develop satellites that can provide low-cost internet access worldwide, benefitting billions who currently lack it. While exact details of the deal remain undisclosed, it’s reported that Google’s valuation of SpaceX is over $10 billion. Google reportedly plans to deploy around 180 satellites for web access for those not yet online and may spend approximately $1 billion on this technology, in addition to using balloons and drones to expand coverage. Project Loon, for example, plans to use large helium balloons to deliver broadband to remote areas, carrying transmitters for 3G-speed internet. Google’s April acquisition of Titan Aerospace aligns with these efforts, with Titan building solar-powered drones for similar goals. These developments come shortly after SpaceX founder Elon Musk announced his ambition to bring internet access to space. His plan involves launching hundreds of satellites about 750 miles (1,207 km) above Earth — much lower than traditional geosynchronous satellites. He envisions this network eventually supporting communication for future Mars colonies. Currently unnamed, Musk’s project could also improve internet speeds and reduce costs on Earth by routing data through satellites instead of through numerous ground-based networks. The Seattle office of SpaceX will manage the satellite project, in addition to other company initiatives such as Falcon rockets. The ultimate aim is to provide high-speed internet to the estimated three billion people worldwide with limited or no internet access, with the first satellites possibly launching in five years and the full vision taking up to 15 years to realize, according to The Huffington Post. The global race to connect underserved areas also includes major investments by Google and Facebook in balloons and drones. Musk has stated that revenues from the satellite network could help fund the establishment of a human colony on Mars, stressing the importance of a global communications system for future Martian settlements.
translated_content: Google dan SpaceX, dua perusahaan terdepan dalam inovasi teknologi tinggi, bekerja sama untuk menyediakan akses internet global dengan meluncurkan jaringan satelit ke orbit. Perusahaan Elon Musk, SpaceX, hari ini mengonfirmasi telah mendapatkan dana sebesar $1 miliar dalam putaran pendanaan terbaru, dengan Google dan Fidelity sebagai investor baru. Elon Musk ingin menciptakan internet kedua di luar angkasa, yang suatu saat dapat menyediakan akses online bagi orang-orang di Mars. Mark Zuckerberg juga mengumumkan bahwa drone bertenaga surya, satelit, dan laser sedang dikembangkan di perusahaannya untuk membawa konektivitas internet ke negara-negara yang minim layanan. Produsen satelit kecil seperti Sierra Nevada dan Surrey Satellite Technology dari Inggris dikenal mahir membuat satelit terjangkau dan memiliki rekam jejak baik. SpaceX mengungkapkan, 'Space Exploration Technologies (SpaceX) telah mendapatkan dana satu miliar dolar pada putaran pendanaan, dengan dua investor baru, Google dan Fidelity. Bersama-sama, mereka memiliki kurang dari 10 persen saham SpaceX.' Google juga sedang mengembangkan balon udara di ketinggian untuk menyediakan internet ke daerah terpencil. SpaceX menyatakan, 'Pendanaan ini akan digunakan untuk mendukung inovasi berkelanjutan di bidang transportasi luar angkasa, penggunaan ulang, dan pembuatan satelit.' Menurut The Information, investasi tersebut akan membantu SpaceX mengembangkan satelit yang dapat menyediakan akses internet murah ke seluruh dunia bagi miliaran orang yang belum memilikinya. Meski detail kesepakatannya belum diungkap, penilaian Google terhadap SpaceX dilaporkan melebihi $10 miliar. Google dikabarkan berencana meluncurkan sekitar 180 satelit untuk akses internet bagi yang belum online, dan mungkin menghabiskan sekitar $1 miliar untuk teknologi ini, selain penggunaan balon dan drone. Misalnya, Project Loon bertujuan memakai balon helium besar untuk menyediakan akses broadband ke daerah terpencil, dengan membawa pemancar kecepatan internet 3G. Akuisisi Google atas Titan Aerospace pada April lalu juga mendukung misi ini, di mana Titan membangun drone bertenaga surya untuk tujuan serupa. Perkembangan ini hadir tidak lama setelah pendiri SpaceX, Elon Musk, mengumumkan ambisinya menyediakan akses internet dari luar angkasa. Rencananya mencakup peluncuran ratusan satelit sekitar 750 mil (1.207 km) di atas bumi — lebih rendah dari satelit geosynchronous tradisional. Ia membayangkan jaringan ini nantinya mendukung komunikasi untuk koloni di Mars. Proyek Musk yang belum dinamai juga bisa meningkatkan kecepatan serta menurunkan biaya internet di Bumi dengan menyalurkan data lewat satelit, bukan lewat banyak jaringan darat. Kantor SpaceX di Seattle akan memimpin proyek satelit ini, selain mengerjakan proyek perusahaan seperti roket Falcon. Target utamanya ialah memberikan internet berkecepatan tinggi untuk sekitar tiga miliar orang di dunia yang saat ini tidak memiliki atau memiliki akses internet yang sangat terbatas, dengan peluncuran satelit generasi pertama dalam lima tahun ke depan dan visi penuh memakan waktu hingga lima belas tahun, menurut The Huffington Post. Kompetisi untuk menghubungkan wilayah terpencil juga didorong oleh investasi besar dari Google dan Facebook pada teknologi balon dan drone. Musk menyatakan pendapatan dari jaringan satelit ini dapat digunakan untuk mendanai pembangunan koloni manusia di Mars, menegaskan pentingnya sistem komunikasi global bagi pemukiman masa depan di planet merah tersebut.

article_content: Albert Gore, youngest son of former Vice President Al Gore, married Brittany Toscano in a black-tie ceremony at Union Station, Washington D.C. The two first met as high school students during Al Gore's vice presidency, reconnecting years later at a New Year’s Eve party in 2010. After four years together—often bridging the distance between D.C. and New York via train—the couple chose Union Station as their wedding venue due to its personal significance. The intimate celebration was attended by close friends and family; both the bride and groom’s parents, including Al and Tipper Gore, were present. Brittany, who previously worked as a non-profit fundraiser in Washington, recently moved to New York City to join Albert after the marriage. Brittany wore a lace gown by Monique Lhuillier, while Albert donned a tuxedo. The rehearsal dinner featured another white lace dress, keeping with the wedding’s elegant theme. Hairstyling for the event was provided by Ky Walker Designs. Photos revealed the ceremony took place on a stage with at least five bridesmaids and four groomsmen. The couple focused on making the event personal, relying on family and friends for many arrangements, according to a spokesperson. Wedding celebrations have been familiar for the Gores lately—Albert’s sister, Sarah, remarried two months earlier with a small outdoor ceremony at a coffee shop in Montecito, California. Al and Tipper Gore, who separated in 2010 but remain legally married, both attended Albert’s wedding. Albert has generally stayed out of the public eye, aside from a 2007 arrest for marijuana possession and a rare public appearance with his parents at the Academy Awards that same year.

article_content: In Hangzhou, China, Japan's women's football team successfully defended their Asian Games gold medal on Friday, defeating North Korea 4-1 in a decisive final. After an early period where North Korea applied pressure and the majority of the 36,166 fans in attendance cheered for them, Japan took the lead in the tenth minute. Yuzuki Yamamoto provided a clever through ball to Yoshino Nakashima, who slotted it past goalkeeper Kim Un Hui with a precise first-time shot. North Korea tried to answer back with long-range attempts from Choe Ku Mok and Hong Song Ok, but both missed. Japanese defender Toko Koga then made a vital tackle inside the box to stop Sung Hyang Sim’s opportunity. North Korea found an equalizer in the 38th minute when Wi Jong Sim sprinted down the left, sending in a low cross that Kim Kyong Yong guided into the corner, energizing the crowd. Despite this, Japan dominated the second half, netting three goals in quick succession from Haruka Osawa, Momoko Tanikawa, and Remina Chiba to secure their third gold in the last four Asian Games women's football tournaments.

Korea Utara mencoba membalas melalui tendangan jarak jauh Choe Ku Mok dan Hong Song Ok, tapi keduanya tak mengarah ke gawang. Bek Jepang Toko Koga juga melakukan tekel krusial di kotak penalti yang menggagalkan peluang Sung Hyang Sim untuk mencetak gol. Di menit ke-38, Korea Utara menyamakan kedudukan saat Wi Jong Sim menyisir sisi kiri dan mengirim umpan mendatar yang disambar Kim Kyong Yong ke pojok gawang, membuat stadion bergemuruh. Namun, Jepang tampil dominan di babak kedua dan mencetak tiga gol berturut-turut lewat Haruka Osawa, Momoko Tanikawa, serta Remina Chiba, yang memastikan gelar emas ketiga mereka dalam empat Asian Games terakhir di sepak bola wanita.

article_content: A study from the University of Helsinki, recently published in npj Urban Sustainability, examines the development of sustainability indicators across Finnish cities between 2000 and 2018. Assistant Professor Sanna Ala-Mantila, the lead author, notes that there are stark differences between intra-city residential areas, each facing unique sustainability challenges. The findings reveal that, despite urban sustainability debates often focusing on dense neighborhoods with blocks of flats, a large portion of Finnish city residents actually live in single-family homes built over several different periods. To better analyze these trends, researchers developed a new classification for city residential areas, dividing them into: - City center - Blocks of flats from 1950s and earlier - Blocks of flats from the 1960s and 1970s - Blocks of flats from the 1980s and 1990s - Blocks of flats from the 2000s - Low-rise neighborhoods built before the 2000s - Low-rise neighborhoods built after the 2000s Ala-Mantila explains the goal was to compare how different residential types have developed, rather than simply looking at cities as a whole. One notable trend is the rise in car ownership, which has increased or at least remained steady in all types of areas. Meanwhile, population density – measured by residents per square kilometer – has only risen in the centers of the largest cities. On the social sustainability front, employment rates are notably lower in neighborhoods made up of blocks of flats from the 1960s through the 1990s compared to other areas. According to Ala-Mantila, public debate often focuses on issues in 1960s and 1970s-era suburbs, but the study also highlights persistent problems in areas built slightly later. The research demonstrates the broad variety in residential areas across Finland and the different sustainability trajectories that occur depending on the neighborhood. For example, city centers are expanding, 1960s- and 1970s-era suburbs are seeing population declines, and areas with blocks of flats from the 1980s and 1990s have stable populations. These divergent patterns affect how effective sustainability interventions are in each neighborhood. The study also found differences across cities. Among those analyzed, only Helsinki’s city center had car ownership rates below average, while the highest was observed in Tikkurila, Vantaa’s central district. According to Ala-Mantila, these findings are significant for urban planning because they help identify city-specific challenges facing different area types. By using individual indicators, planners can address specific issues like car ownership rates. Interestingly, the study notes that car ownership remains high even in newer areas designed for reduced car use. The classification method developed is easy to replicate, enabling future research into other aspects of sustainability. "Urban sustainability is now critical," says Ala-Mantila. Many indicators examined are central for climate action and are actively tracked across cities, but social sustainability (such as employment) helps reveal which populations are impacted by local policies. She warns that tracking overall city indicators often overlooks meaningful differences between residential neighborhoods.
translated_content: Sebuah studi dari Universitas Helsinki yang baru saja diterbitkan di npj Urban Sustainability meneliti perkembangan indikator keberlanjutan di kota-kota Finlandia antara tahun 2000 hingga 2018. Asisten Profesor Sanna Ala-Mantila, penulis utama studi ini, mencatat bahwa terdapat perbedaan mencolok antara kawasan pemukiman di dalam kota, di mana masing-masing menghadapi tantangan keberlanjutan yang unik. Temuan menunjukkan, meskipun perdebatan keberlanjutan perkotaan sering berfokus pada lingkungan padat dengan blok apartemen, sebagian besar penduduk kota Finlandia sebenarnya tinggal di rumah tapak keluarga tunggal yang dibangun pada berbagai periode. Untuk menganalisis tren ini lebih dalam, para peneliti mengembangkan klasifikasi baru untuk area permukiman kota, membaginya menjadi: - Pusat kota - Blok apartemen dari tahun 1950-an dan sebelumnya - Blok apartemen dari tahun 1960-an dan 1970-an - Blok apartemen dari tahun 1980-an dan 1990-an - Blok apartemen dari tahun 2000-an - Kawasan hunian rendah yang dibangun sebelum tahun 2000-an - Kawasan hunian rendah yang dibangun setelah tahun 2000-an Ala-Mantila menjelaskan, tujuannya adalah membandingkan perkembangan tipe kawasan, bukan hanya melihat kota secara menyeluruh. Salah satu tren menonjol adalah peningkatan kepemilikan mobil, yang naik atau setidaknya bertahan di semua tipe kawasan. Sementara itu, kepadatan penduduk—diukur per kilometer persegi—hanya meningkat di pusat kota besar. Dalam aspek keberlanjutan sosial, tingkat pekerjaan lebih rendah di lingkungan blok apartemen tahun 1960-1990-an dibanding kawasan lain. Ala-Mantila menambahkan, perdebatan publik sering mengulas masalah di pinggiran kota era 1960-70-an, namun studi ini juga memperlihatkan masalah serupa di kawasan yang dibangun belakangan. Penelitian ini menunjukkan keragaman kawasan permukiman di Finlandia serta perkembangan keberlanjutan yang berbeda-beda. Misalnya, pusat kota berkembang, pinggiran kota era 60-70-an mengalami penurunan populasi, dan kawasan blok apartemen tahun 80-90-an populasinya cenderung stabil. Pola berbeda ini memengaruhi efektivitas program keberlanjutan di tiap lingkungan. Studi ini juga menemukan perbedaan antar kota. Di antara kota yang dianalisis, hanya pusat kota Helsinki yang tingkat kepemilikan mobilnya di bawah rata-rata, sementara yang tertinggi terdapat di Tikkurila, pusat Vantaa. Menurut Ala-Mantila, temuan ini penting untuk perencanaan kota karena bisa mengidentifikasi tantangan spesifik di tiap tipe kawasan. Dengan indikator individu, perencana kota bisa lebih tepat mengatasi isu seperti kepemilikan mobil. Menariknya, studi ini mencatat kepemilikan mobil tetap tinggi meski di kawasan baru yang dirancang untuk mengurangi penggunaan mobil. Metode klasifikasi yang dikembangkan mudah diterapkan kembali, memungkinkan penelitian lanjutan. "Keberlanjutan perkotaan kini sangat penting," ujar Ala-Mantila. Banyak indikator yang diteliti jadi penentu aksi iklim dan rutin dipantau di kota-kota, namun keberlanjutan sosial (seperti pekerjaan) membantu mengungkap siapa saja yang terdampak oleh kebijakan setempat. Ia menekankan bahwa pemantauan indikator kota secara keseluruhan kerap mengabaikan perbedaan bermakna antar kawasan permukiman.

article_content: Cyberattacks are increasingly targeting government offices and organizations in Nigeria, other parts of Africa, and across the Middle East. According to the latest Global Threat Index from Check Point® Software Technologies Ltd (October 2023, released in November), Africa is experiencing a significant surge in cyber threats. Mauritius is ranked 6th, Nigeria 11th, Morocco 15th, and Kenya 25th among the most attacked countries globally, with South Africa at 55th. One major trend is the growing number of Remote Access Trojan (RAT) attacks, which have risen from sixth to second in prevalence, sharply targeting governments and organizations in Africa and the Middle East. The advanced RAT AgentTesla is rapidly spreading through complex mal-spam campaigns involving infected email attachments. The report highlights that educational institutions remain a primary target for such cyber threats. "We must pay close attention to the sophisticated methods hackers use, such as impersonating trusted brands or sending malicious email files," said Rudi van Rooyen, Sales Engineer at Check Point Software. "Entering the busy shopping season in November, it's crucial to remain vigilant. Cybercriminals are exploiting the surge in online shopping, and all regions, including Africa, are at risk." Formbook was the most widespread malware last month, affecting 3% of organizations worldwide. NJRat and Remcos followed, each with a global impact of around 2%. Formbook is an information-stealing malware for Windows, first detected in 2016, frequently sold as Malware-as-a-Service (MaaS) due to its strong evasion capabilities and affordability. Formbook's impact has been significant in Kenya (16.9%) and Nigeria (9.2%), with South Africa experiencing a lower rate (3%). This malware can steal browser credentials, capture screenshots, log keystrokes, and download or execute files controlled by its command-and-control servers. NJRat, another RAT, primarily targets government agencies in the Middle East but is growing in prominence in Africa. Remcos spreads through malicious Microsoft Office attachments in spam emails and is engineered to bypass Windows UAC security and execute malware with elevated privileges. Though Remcos has yet to become highly prevalent in Africa, its global activity is noteworthy. In Africa, the sectors most affected by cyberattacks include communications, ISPs/MSPs, finance, banking, government, and the military. Recently, the hacktivist group Anonymous Sudan attempted to disrupt MTN Nigeria's network in protest against Nigeria's stance on the coup in the Republic of Niger. Nigeria's National Information Technology Development Agency and Computer Emergency Readiness and Response Team have alerted the public to ongoing hacking attempts targeting government digital services, warning that groups with political and religious motives pose substantial risks to critical information infrastructure.
translated_content: Serangan siber kini semakin sering menargetkan kantor pemerintah dan organisasi di Nigeria, sejumlah negara lain di Afrika, serta Timur Tengah. Berdasarkan Global Threat Index terbaru dari Check Point® Software Technologies Ltd (Oktober 2023, dirilis November), kawasan Afrika tengah mengalami lonjakan besar dalam ancaman siber. Mauritius menduduki peringkat ke-6, Nigeria ke-11, Maroko ke-15, dan Kenya ke-25 dalam daftar negara paling banyak diserang di dunia, dengan Afrika Selatan menempati posisi ke-55. Salah satu tren utama adalah semakin banyaknya serangan Remote Access Trojan (RAT), yang naik dari posisi keenam ke posisi kedua dalam hal jumlah kasus, dengan sasaran utama pemerintah dan organisasi di Afrika dan Timur Tengah. AgentTesla, yakni RAT canggih, menyebar sangat cepat melalui kampanye mal-spam yang rumit menggunakan lampiran email berbahaya. Laporan tersebut juga menyoroti bahwa institusi pendidikan masih menjadi target utama serangan jenis ini. "Kita harus betul-betul waspada dengan metode canggih yang digunakan peretas, seperti berpura-pura menjadi brand terkenal atau mengirim file email berbahaya," kata Rudi van Rooyen, Sales Engineer di Check Point Software. "Menjelang musim belanja daring di bulan November, makin penting untuk tetap waspada. Penjahat siber memanfaatkan tingginya aktivitas belanja online, dan semua wilayah—termasuk Afrika—berisiko terkena ancaman ini." Formbook adalah malware yang paling banyak ditemukan bulan lalu, menyerang 3% organisasi di seluruh dunia. Selanjutnya ada NJRat dan Remcos yang masing-masing berdampak sekitar 2%. Formbook adalah malware pencuri data pada sistem operasi Windows, pertama kali teridentifikasi pada tahun 2016, dan sering dijual sebagai Malware-as-a-Service (MaaS) karena kemampuannya menghindari deteksi serta harganya yang murah. Dampak Formbook paling terasa di Kenya (16,9%) dan Nigeria (9,2%), sementara di Afrika Selatan lebih rendah (3%). Malware ini dapat mencuri kredensial browser, mengambil tangkapan layar, merekam ketikan, dan mengunduh atau menjalankan file sesuai instruksi server pengendalinya. NJRat, RAT lainnya, awalnya lebih sering menyerang institusi pemerintah di Timur Tengah namun kini juga berkembang di Afrika. Remcos menyebar lewat lampiran berbahaya pada email spam Microsoft Office dan dirancang untuk menembus perlindungan UAC Windows guna menjalankan malware dengan hak akses tinggi. Meski Remcos belum terlalu sering muncul di Afrika, aktivitas globalnya tetap perlu diwaspadai. Di Afrika, sektor yang paling rentan terhadap serangan siber adalah komunikasi, ISP/MSP, keuangan, perbankan, pemerintah, dan militer. Baru-baru ini, kelompok hacktivis Anonymous Sudan mencoba mengganggu jaringan MTN Nigeria sebagai bentuk protes atas sikap Nigeria terhadap kudeta di Republik Niger. Badan Pengembangan Teknologi Informasi Nasional Nigeria (NITDA) dan Computer Emergency Readiness and Response Team (CERT) telah memperingatkan adanya upaya peretasan yang berkelanjutan terhadap layanan digital pemerintah, dan menegaskan kelompok bermotif politik serta agama menjadi ancaman besar bagi infrastruktur informasi vital.

From phishing emails to malware like Formbook and AgentTesla, sectors like education and finance are in the crosshairs. Stay alert—especially during the online shopping rush! #Cybersecurity #StaySafe

article_content: The Kaduna State Police Command has announced the arrest of a suspected goat thief in Pasali Konu village, located in Kagarko Local Government Area. According to the Police Public Relations Officer, ASP Mansur Hassan, the suspect was detained on Saturday while police officers and vigilante members were on patrol. The incident occurred on November 11 at around 4:30 a.m., when the 20-year-old suspect, who hails from Igwa village in Kagarko LGA, was apprehended. Hassan stated that the suspect was armed with dangerous weapons and wore a facemask. Hassan further revealed that the suspect, who specialized in stealing goats, admitted that he and another accomplice had come to the village intending to steal livestock. While the suspect was caught, his accomplice managed to escape. Hassan assured that police are actively searching for the second individual. The suspect will be charged in court following preliminary investigations. Hassan reiterated the command’s commitment to eradicating crime in Kaduna State and called on the public to share timely and useful information to support proactive policing.
translated_content: Kepolisian Negara Bagian Kaduna telah mengumumkan penangkapan seorang tersangka pencuri kambing di Desa Pasali Konu, yang berada di Wilayah Pemerintah Lokal Kagarko. Menurut Pejabat Hubungan Masyarakat Polisi, ASP Mansur Hassan, tersangka ditahan pada hari Sabtu saat petugas polisi bersama anggota keamanan warga sedang berpatroli. Kejadian itu berlangsung pada 11 November sekitar pukul 04.30 pagi, ketika tersangka berusia 20 tahun asal Desa Igwa, Kagarko, diamankan. Hassan menyebutkan bahwa tersangka membawa senjata berbahaya dan mengenakan penutup wajah. Hassan juga menjelaskan bahwa tersangka, yang terkenal sering mencuri kambing, mengakui bahwa ia bersama seorang temannya datang ke desa tersebut untuk mencuri ternak. Saat tersangka berhasil ditangkap, temannya berhasil melarikan diri. Hassan menegaskan polisi tengah memburu pelaku kedua tersebut. Tersangka akan didakwa di pengadilan setelah penyelidikan awal selesai. Hassan kembali menegaskan komitmen pihak kepolisian dalam memberantas kejahatan di Negara Bagian Kaduna dan mengimbau masyarakat agar memberikan informasi secara cepat dan akurat demi mendukung upaya kepolisian yang proaktif.

article_content: A massive wildfire burned south of Fort McMurray, Alberta, near Highway 63 on May 7, 2016. Chronicling this devastating event, John Vaillant’s book 'Fire Weather: A True Story from a Hotter World' has won Britain’s leading nonfiction book prize. The Baillie Gifford Prize, with an award of 50,000 pounds (about $62,000), was presented to Vaillant during a London ceremony. Frederick Studemann, chair of the judging panel, praised 'Fire Weather' as a gripping, thriller-like narrative set against a backdrop of deep scientific analysis. He described it as an extraordinary account of a climate disaster, highlighting the deep ties between communities, the fossil fuel industry, and environmental risks. The book was also a finalist for the U.S. National Book Award. Vaillant, who lives in British Columbia, recounts how the 2016 wildfire in Fort McMurray drove 90,000 people from their homes, destroyed 2,400 buildings, and halted operations at Alberta’s oil sands. He emphasizes that climate change, caused by human activity, has altered the nature of wildfires. On the day the fire began, temperatures hit 33°C (91.4°F) with a bone-dry humidity of just 11%. Vaillant noted these extreme conditions made the city, built largely from petroleum-based materials, especially vulnerable. The fire generated radiant heat exceeding 500°C — hotter than the surface of Venus. Since then, Canada has faced even more devastating wildfires, including its worst wildfire season on record in 2023, which destroyed swathes of northern forest and blanketed vast regions in haze. Vaillant reflects that these changes profoundly affect Canadian life and identity, turning summer into a more threatening season for many. Established in 1999, the Baillie Gifford Prize recognizes outstanding English-language nonfiction across a wide range of subjects. This year, Vaillant outpaced five other contenders, including David Grann and Siddhartha Mukherjee. Although sponsor Baillie Gifford has faced environmental criticism for its investments in fossil fuels, the judging panel asserted that these concerns did not affect their decision. Judge Ruth Scurr expressed no reservations about her impartiality and welcomed attention to the subject matter.
translated_content: Kebakaran besar melanda selatan Fort McMurray, Alberta, dekat Highway 63 pada 7 Mei 2016. Kisah memilukan ini dituangkan dalam buku 'Fire Weather: A True Story from a Hotter World' karya John Vaillant, yang meraih penghargaan buku nonfiksi paling bergengsi di Inggris. Baillie Gifford Prize senilai 50.000 poundsterling (sekitar Rp1 miliar), diserahkan kepada Vaillant dalam sebuah acara di London. Frederick Studemann, ketua dewan juri, memuji 'Fire Weather' sebagai narasi menegangkan berlatar ilmu pengetahuan yang kuat. Ia menyebut buku ini sebagai kisah luar biasa tentang bencana iklim, menyoroti kaitan erat antara komunitas, industri bahan bakar fosil, dan risiko lingkungan. Buku ini juga menjadi finalis di U.S. National Book Award. Vaillant, yang tinggal di British Columbia, mengisahkan bagaimana kebakaran di Fort McMurray tahun 2016 memaksa 90.000 penduduk mengungsi, menghancurkan 2.400 bangunan, dan menghentikan aktivitas oil sands Alberta. Ia menekankan bahwa perubahan iklim yang dipicu manusia telah mengubah karakter kebakaran hutan. Pada hari kebakaran terjadi, suhu mencapai 33°C dengan kelembapan hanya 11%. Vaillant menyoroti bahwa kondisi ekstrem ini membuat kota yang sebagian besar dibangun dari material berbasis minyak bumi menjadi sangat rentan. Kebakaran tersebut menghasilkan panas lebih dari 500°C — melebihi panas permukaan Venus. Sejak itu, Kanada mengalami kebakaran hutan yang lebih parah, termasuk musim kebakaran terburuk sepanjang sejarah pada 2023 yang menghancurkan hutan utara dan menutupi wilayah luas dengan asap. Vaillant mengatakan perubahan ini berdampak besar pada kehidupan dan identitas masyarakat Kanada, bahkan musim panas kini terasa mengancam bagi banyak orang. Didirikan tahun 1999, Baillie Gifford Prize memberikan penghargaan untuk buku nonfiksi berbahasa Inggris terbaik di berbagai bidang. Tahun ini, Vaillant mengungguli lima finalis lainnya, termasuk David Grann dan Siddhartha Mukherjee. Meski Baillie Gifford mendapat kritik karena investasi pada industri bahan bakar fosil, dewan juri menegaskan keputusan mereka tidak terpengaruh. Juri Ruth Scurr menekankan dirinya tetap independen dan senang topik ini mendapat sorotan.

article_content: Jim Troughton, the longtime captain of Warwickshire County Cricket Club and grandson of former Doctor Who actor Patrick Troughton, has announced his immediate retirement from professional cricket after struggling to recover from a persistent back injury. Troughton's appearances for Warwickshire in recent seasons have been limited due to his injury, with his final match coming in June during a County Championship game against Yorkshire. Teammate and England player Ian Bell expressed his heartbreak over Troughton’s departure, describing him as a huge loss both on and off the field. Chris Woakes, another Warwickshire player, echoed those feelings, calling Troughton a ‘true Bear’ and praising his playing ability and character. Over a distinguished career, Troughton played 167 first-class matches, amassing 8,491 runs with an average of 35.67, including 19 centuries and 44 fifties. He also contributed in List A and T20 formats, and played six one-day internationals for England in 2003. Named captain in 2011, Troughton led Warwickshire to notable success, with the pinnacle being the County Championship Division One title in 2012. In a statement, Troughton shared his disappointment at being forced to end his playing days, explaining that his ongoing back problems had left him unable to perform at the required standard even after consulting with medical specialists, his family, and club staff. He expressed gratitude for his years at Warwickshire, calling it a privilege to be part of the club and to play alongside talented teammates and coaches. Dougie Brown, Warwickshire’s director of cricket, praised Troughton as a model professional and exceptional leader whose contributions would be long remembered in the club’s history.
translated_content: Jim Troughton, kapten lama Warwickshire County Cricket Club dan cucu dari aktor Doctor Who Patrick Troughton, telah mengumumkan secara langsung pensiun dari kriket profesional setelah berjuang melawan cedera punggung yang berkepanjangan. Penampilan Troughton untuk Warwickshire dalam beberapa musim terakhir sangat terbatas akibat cedera tersebut, dengan pertandingan terakhirnya berlangsung pada bulan Juni di County Championship melawan Yorkshire. Rekan setim dan pemain Inggris, Ian Bell, mengungkapkan kesedihannya atas pensiunnya Troughton, menyebutnya sebagai kehilangan besar di dalam dan di luar lapangan. Chris Woakes, pemain Warwickshire lainnya, juga menyampaikan hal yang serupa, mengatakan Troughton adalah 'Bear sejati' dan memuji kemampuan bermain serta pribadinya. Selama kariernya yang cemerlang, Troughton bermain di 167 pertandingan first-class, mencetak 8.491 run dengan rata-rata 35,67, termasuk 19 century dan 44 fifty. Ia juga berkontribusi di format List A dan T20, serta tampil dalam enam satuan pertandingan internasional satu hari (ODI) untuk Inggris pada tahun 2003. Ditunjuk sebagai kapten pada 2011, Troughton membawa Warwickshire meraih kesuksesan besar, puncaknya juara County Championship Division One di tahun 2012. Dalam pernyataannya, Troughton menyampaikan kekecewaannya karena harus mengakhiri karier bermain, menjelaskan bahwa cedera punggung berkepanjangan membuatnya tidak mampu tampil sesuai standar, meski telah berkonsultasi dengan tim medis, keluarga, dan staf klub. Ia mengungkapkan rasa syukur telah menjadi bagian dari Warwickshire dan menyebut suatu kehormatan dapat bermain bersama rekan-rekan setim dan pelatih berbakat. Dougie Brown, direktur kriket Warwickshire, memuji Troughton sebagai profesional teladan dan pemimpin luar biasa yang kontribusinya akan diingat sepanjang sejarah klub.
post_content: Sad to see Warwickshire cricket legend Jim Troughton retire due to injury. An incredible leader, teammate, and true Bear—your legacy on and off the field will be remembered! 🏏 #ThankYouTroughton #Warwickshire #Cricket

article_content: Defending champions Japan began their 2015 Asian Cup campaign in style by defeating newcomers Palestine 4-0 on Monday in their opening Group D match at Hunter Stadium, Newcastle, Australia. Yasuhito Endo, Shinji Okazaki, and Keisuke Honda each scored in the first half, giving Japan a commanding lead despite challenging wet and windy conditions. Maya Yoshida added a fourth goal after halftime, heading home a cross from Shinji Kagawa to complete the victory. Japan lined up in a 4-1-4-1 formation, featuring Eiji Kawashima, Yuto Nagatomo, Masato Morishige, Gotoku Sakai, Maya Yoshida, Keisuke Honda, Yasuhito Endo, Shinji Kagawa, Makoto Hasebe, Takashi Inui, and Shinji Okazaki. Palestine, making their Asian Cup debut following qualification by winning the 2014 AFC Challenge Cup, struggled to contain Japan's attack. Palestinian player Ahmed Mahajna was sent off in the 73rd minute, making an already challenging first outing even more difficult for the debutants. After the match, Japan coach Javier Aguirre expressed satisfaction, stating, 'The best thing we achieved today was the result and the winning three points. It was not an easy game for both teams because of the strong wind. In modern football, it's not easy to win by four goals, so I am happy.' Okazaki, who was named man of the match, said, 'Endo's early goal was great and gave the team momentum. We played well, but we could have done better. We're not satisfied with four goals; we should have scored more.' Palestine's best chance came in the 81st minute, when Abdallatif Albahdari's header narrowly missed the target. Palestinian fans in the crowd of 15,497 supported their team passionately throughout the match, waving flags and beating drums. Palestine coach Ahmad Alhasan said, 'The feeling has touched our emotions. To see Palestinian people everywhere in the world support Palestine is powerful. This is the only national team in the tournament still under occupation.' In the group's other match, Iraq beat Jordan 1-0, thanks to a goal by Yaser Kasim.
translated_content: Juara bertahan Jepang memulai Piala Asia 2015 dengan kemenangan meyakinkan 4-0 atas tim debutan Palestina, Senin lalu di laga pembuka Grup D yang berlangsung di Hunter Stadium, Newcastle, Australia. Yasuhito Endo, Shinji Okazaki, dan Keisuke Honda masing-masing mencetak gol di babak pertama, memberikan keunggulan besar untuk Jepang meski bertanding dalam kondisi hujan dan angin kencang. Maya Yoshida menambah gol keempat setelah turun minum melalui sundulan dari umpan silang Shinji Kagawa, menutup kemenangan Jepang. Jepang bermain dengan formasi 4-1-4-1, menurunkan Eiji Kawashima, Yuto Nagatomo, Masato Morishige, Gotoku Sakai, Maya Yoshida, Keisuke Honda, Yasuhito Endo, Shinji Kagawa, Makoto Hasebe, Takashi Inui, dan Shinji Okazaki. Palestina, yang tampil perdana di Piala Asia setelah menjuarai AFC Challenge Cup 2014, kesulitan membendung serangan Jepang. Pemain Palestina, Ahmed Mahajna, harus meninggalkan lapangan setelah mendapat kartu merah di menit ke-73, semakin memperberat debut mereka. Usai laga, pelatih Jepang Javier Aguirre berkata, 'Hal terbaik yang kami capai hari ini adalah hasil dan tiga poin. Ini bukan pertandingan mudah karena angin kencang. Dalam sepak bola modern, menang dengan selisih empat gol tidak mudah, jadi saya senang.' Okazaki, yang dinobatkan sebagai pemain terbaik, berkomentar, 'Gol awal Endo luar biasa dan memberi tim momentum. Kami bermain baik, tapi masih bisa lebih baik lagi. Kami tidak puas hanya empat gol; mestinya bisa lebih.' Peluang terbaik Palestina hadir di menit ke-81 saat sundulan Abdallatif Albahdari nyaris berbuah gol. Suporter Palestina di antara 15.497 penonton terus mendukung tim mereka sepanjang pertandingan dengan mengibarkan bendera dan menabuh drum. Pelatih Palestina, Ahmad Alhasan, mengatakan, 'Perasaan ini sangat menyentuh emosi kami. Melihat warga Palestina di seluruh dunia mendukung sangat berarti. Ini satu-satunya tim nasional di turnamen ini yang masih berada di bawah pendudukan.' Pada laga lainnya di grup, Irak menundukkan Yordania 1-0 lewat gol Yaser Kasim.

article_content: Hundreds of British travelers are scrambling to leave Austrian ski resorts ahead of new snowfall expected this weekend. The region has been hit by the heaviest snow in 30 years, leading to many holidaymakers being stranded since last weekend. Some are now delayed by up to four days returning home and to work, as nearly 18 feet of snow has fallen across parts of the Alps. Images from places like Ischgl and Galtuer show buildings and roads buried under thick snow, with first-floor windows blocked. Although there was a pause in snow yesterday, more is forecasted for the weekend. Several towns, including popular resorts such as Ischgl and Galtuer, have been cut off by avalanches, stranding about 2,000 British tourists. It's not only those trying to leave who are affected; many are struggling to get into the resorts as well. The only open route, the B188 road to Innsbruck, was congested with a traffic jam stretching for 30 miles as people tried to get out. Rescue teams warn roads could close again suddenly due to avalanches, falling trees, and dangerous driving conditions, increasing the risk of accidents. Tourists have described growing frustration. One, Derek Lindsay, was upset about being sent to a town with a high avalanche warning as he hoped for a calm trip before cancer treatment. Similarly, Peter Baker and his family have been trapped in Ischgl since Saturday, unable to return to work, with police keeping roads closed and piste access banned for safety. Some tourists have managed well despite the ordeal, but many have felt trapped and stressed. An Austrian company has reportedly charged up to £4,500 for a 15-minute flight to evacuate tourists to Innsbruck airport. A handful of wealthy visitors accepted these costly flights, but most were left waiting in long traffic queues. Officials from the Avalanche Warning Centre in Salzburg stress that, even though warnings have eased in some places, there is still significant danger and people should be extremely cautious. Daily life and travel remain heavily disrupted: roads and regional train lines like the one between Garmisch-Partenkirchen and Innsbruck are closed, while snow blankets both Austrian and Swiss villages. Emergency crews continue their efforts to rescue stranded tourists and search for missing persons. Although high winds may die down, more snow is expected in the coming days.
translated_content: Ratusan wisatawan asal Inggris tengah berusaha keluar dari resor ski Austria sebelum salju baru turun akhir pekan ini. Wilayah tersebut mengalami salju terlebat dalam 30 tahun terakhir, sehingga banyak turis terjebak sejak akhir pekan lalu. Beberapa sudah terlambat hingga empat hari untuk pulang dan kembali bekerja, karena hampir 18 kaki salju menutupi sebagian wilayah Alpen. Foto-foto dari Ischgl dan Galtuer menunjukkan bangunan dan jalan-jalan terkubur salju tebal, hingga jendela lantai satu tidak terlihat. Meski kemarin tidak turun salju, prakiraan cuaca memperkirakan tambahan salju pada akhir pekan. Beberapa kota, termasuk resor terkenal seperti Ischgl dan Galtuer, telah terputus akibat longsoran salju, membuat sekitar 2.000 turis Inggris terjebak. Tidak hanya yang ingin keluar yang terkena dampak, banyak juga yang kesulitan masuk ke resor. Jalan satu-satunya yang terbuka, B188 menuju Innsbruck, terjadi macet sepanjang 30 mil karena banyak yang mencoba keluar. Tim penyelamat memperingatkan bahwa jalan-jalan bisa sewaktu-waktu ditutup kembali akibat longsoran, pohon tumbang, serta kondisi jalan yang berbahaya sehingga risiko kecelakaan meningkat. Para wisatawan melaporkan rasa frustrasi yang meningkat. Salah satu turis, Derek Lindsay, merasa kecewa karena dikirim ke kota dengan peringatan longsor tingkat tinggi padahal ia ingin liburan tenang sebelum menjalani pengobatan kanker. Hal serupa dialami Peter Baker dan keluarganya yang terjebak di Ischgl sejak Sabtu, tidak bisa kembali bekerja, sementara polisi menutup jalan dan akses ke lintasan ski demi keselamatan. Ada turis yang dapat menghadapi situasi ini dengan tenang, namun banyak yang merasa terjebak dan stres. Sebuah perusahaan Austria bahkan mematok biaya hingga £4.500 untuk penerbangan evakuasi selama 15 menit ke Bandara Innsbruck. Beberapa wisatawan kaya menerima tawaran mahal ini, tetapi kebanyakan orang masih menunggu lama dalam antrean lalu lintas. Pejabat dari Pusat Peringatan Longsoran Salzburg menegaskan bahwa meski peringatan bahaya turun di beberapa daerah, risiko masih tinggi dan warga dihimbau selalu berhati-hati. Kehidupan dan perjalanan sehari-hari tetap sangat terganggu: jalan dan jalur kereta regional seperti antara Garmisch-Partenkirchen dan Innsbruck ditutup, sementara salju menutupi desa-desa di Austria dan Swiss. Tim penyelamat terus berupaya menolong turis terjebak dan mencari korban hilang. Meskipun angin kencang kemungkinan mereda, salju susulan masih diperkirakan turun dalam beberapa hari ke depan.

article_content: India’s top oil and gas company, ONGC, is set to invest nearly Rs 1 lakh crore in two new petrochemical plants designed to convert crude oil directly into high-value chemicals. This initiative fits into ONGC’s plan to adapt to the changing global energy landscape. ONGC has traditionally refined crude oil into petrol, diesel, and jet fuel. With the growing shift towards sustainable energy, the firm aims to move into chemical manufacturing. Petrochemicals are essential components for products like plastics, synthetic fibers, detergents, and fertilizers, and demand is projected to stay strong across industries. During an investor call, ONGC’s Finance Director Pomila Jaspal and Executive Director D Adhikari revealed the company’s strategy to develop two oil-to-chemical (O2C) projects in separate states, targeting investments by 2028 or 2030. The plan aims to boost ONGC's petrochemical capacity to 8.5–9 million tonnes annually by 2030. One of these projects will be a wholly owned ONGC plant; the other will be established through a joint venture. ONGC already operates in this sector with two subsidiaries: the profitable Mangalore Refinery and Petrochemicals Limited (MRPL), and ONGC Petro-Additions Limited (OPaL), which needs financial restructuring. ONGC’s board has approved injecting Rs 18,355 crore into OPaL, increasing its stake above 96% from 49.35%. This is expected to help OPaL reach profitability during the 2024–25 fiscal year. Despite increasing its stake, ONGC plans to maintain OPaL’s joint venture structure by seeking a strategic partner in the next three years. On the world stage, oil companies are adopting crude oil-to-chemicals (COTC) technology that turns a significant share of crude into chemicals rather than fuels. China and Middle Eastern companies are at the forefront, with Saudi Aramco and SABIC building a plant capable of processing 400,000 barrels daily into about 9 million tonnes of chemicals each year. ONGC’s O2C investment is distinct from the separate Rs 1 lakh crore earmarked for energy transition and renewables by 2030, intended to help the company hit net zero carbon emissions by 2038. ONGC plans to expand its renewable energy generation capacity to 10 GW by 2030. The robust demand for petrochemicals in sectors like construction, automotive, electronics, and pharmaceuticals positions ONGC to reduce its exposure to volatile oil prices and strengthen long-term profitability.
translated_content: Perusahaan minyak dan gas terbesar di India, ONGC, akan berinvestasi hampir Rs 1 lakh crore untuk membangun dua pabrik petrokimia baru yang dirancang untuk mengubah minyak mentah langsung menjadi bahan kimia bernilai tinggi. Inisiatif ini merupakan bagian dari rencana ONGC agar dapat beradaptasi dengan perubahan lanskap energi global. Selama ini, ONGC biasanya mengolah minyak mentah menjadi bensin, solar, dan avtur. Namun dengan dorongan menuju energi yang lebih ramah lingkungan, perusahaan ini kini ingin masuk ke sektor produksi bahan kimia. Petrokimia adalah komponen penting bagi produk seperti plastik, serat sintetis, deterjen, dan pupuk—yang permintaannya diproyeksikan tetap tinggi di berbagai industri. Dalam pertemuan dengan investor, Direktur Keuangan ONGC Pomila Jaspal dan Direktur Eksekutif D Adhikari memaparkan strategi perusahaan untuk mengembangkan dua proyek oil-to-chemical (O2C) di negara bagian yang berbeda, dengan target investasi pada 2028 atau 2030. ONGC menargetkan kapasitas petrokimia sebesar 8,5–9 juta ton per tahun pada 2030. Salah satu proyek ini akan sepenuhnya dimiliki ONGC, sementara satu lagi akan dibangun lewat kerja sama joint venture. ONGC telah bergerak di sektor ini melalui dua anak usaha: Mangalore Refinery and Petrochemicals Limited (MRPL), yang sudah menguntungkan, dan ONGC Petro-Additions Limited (OPaL), yang tengah membutuhkan restrukturisasi keuangan. Dewan direksi ONGC menyetujui penyertaan modal sebesar Rs 18.355 crore ke OPaL, sehingga porsi kepemilikan ONGC naik menjadi lebih dari 96% dari sebelumnya 49,35%. Langkah ini diharapkan membuat OPaL mulai menghasilkan laba pada tahun fiskal 2024–25. Meski kepemilikan naik, ONGC tetap ingin mempertahankan bentuk joint venture OPaL dan berencana mencari mitra strategis dalam tiga tahun ke depan. Secara global, perusahaan minyak menerapkan teknologi crude oil-to-chemicals (COTC) yang bisa mengubah sebagian besar minyak mentah langsung menjadi bahan kimia daripada bahan bakar. Perusahaan dari Tiongkok dan Timur Tengah menjadi pemimpin di bidang ini, contohnya Saudi Aramco dan SABIC yang mengembangkan pabrik berkapasitas 400.000 barel per hari untuk memproduksi sekitar 9 juta ton bahan kimia tiap tahun. Investasi O2C ONGC ini terpisah dari alokasi dana Rs 1 lakh crore yang sudah diumumkan untuk proyek transisi energi dan energi terbarukan hingga 2030—demi mencapai emisi karbon net zero di 2038. ONGC juga berencana menambah kapasitas energi terbarukan hingga 10 GW di tahun 2030. Tingginya permintaan petrokimia di sektor konstruksi, otomotif, elektronik, serta farmasi, diprediksi akan mengurangi ketergantungan ONGC pada fluktuasi harga minyak dan meningkatkan profitabilitas jangka panjangnya.

article_content: I recall my first Fourth of July after returning from Iraq, when I worked as a bartender in a hotel in Ouray, Colorado. For a moment, I stepped away from the bar and watched fireworks light up the sky above the town. The explosions felt and sounded familiar—reminders of war. Pride in serving my country quickly gave way to anxiety, as the noise of fireworks drowned out the celebrations and transported me back to combat memories. Images from the war flooded my mind: loss, violence, and the suffering of both comrades and civilians. Standing on that balcony, I realized how profoundly war had changed me. Although surrounded by people, their experiences were far removed from mine, reinforcing my sense of isolation. Over time, such vivid memories returned on holidays and random days, bringing feelings of anger, sadness, and confusion. War’s devastation is obvious in destroyed lives and buildings, but it can also leave invisible scars within—altering thoughts and emotions due to intense experiences. Military service binds us together, sharing basic hardships like cold, hunger, and fear. Still, when I came home, I felt alone in my struggles. My pride and shame kept me silent for months, leading me to the brink of despair. A turning point came when I worked on a documentary using footage from my time at war. Sharing my story with editors I came to trust helped break down emotional barriers and marked the start of my recovery. In many ways, making the film became a therapeutic journey. If you are coping with post-combat emotions, remember: you are not alone, it’s okay not to be okay, and talking about it helps. There is no shame in needing support. Reach out to fellow veterans, support organizations like the Wounded Warrior Project, or call Veterans Affairs’ hotline. While vulnerability in war may be seen as weakness, after returning home, it can be a source of strength. Opening up is the first step toward healing. Veterans rely on each other both in battle and in civilian life. If you are struggling, remember the sun still shines behind the clouds. Support one another through tough times. This Fourth of July, as I return home from a research trip, I’m grateful for how far I’ve come. My war experiences now give me perspective, making each day more precious. The views in this commentary are solely those of Mike Scotti.
translated_content: Saya ingat Hari Kemerdekaan pertama saya setelah pulang dari Irak, saat saya bekerja sebagai bartender di sebuah hotel di Ouray, Colorado. Untuk beberapa saat, saya meninggalkan bar dan melihat kembang api menerangi langit di atas kota. Ledakan itu terasa dan terdengar begitu akrab—mengingatkan saya pada suasana perang. Rasa bangga telah mengabdi untuk negara perlahan berubah menjadi rasa cemas, karena suara kembang api menenggelamkan perayaan dan membawa saya kembali pada kenangan di medan tempur. Gambaran perang membanjiri pikiran saya: kehilangan, kekerasan, dan penderitaan teman seperjuangan maupun warga sipil. Berdiri di balkon itu, saya benar-benar menyadari seberapa besar perang telah mengubah saya. Meskipun dikelilingi banyak orang, pengalaman mereka sangat jauh berbeda sehingga saya merasa semakin terasing. Seiring waktu, kenangan seperti itu kerap muncul lagi di hari-hari besar maupun hari-hari biasa, membawa perasaan marah, sedih, dan bingung. Kehancuran akibat perang memang nyata pada kehidupan dan bangunan yang hancur, namun luka batin juga bisa tertinggal—mengubah pikiran dan perasaan akibat pengalaman yang terlalu berat. Pengabdian sebagai tentara membuat kita saling terikat, berbagi kesusahan seperti kedinginan, kelaparan, dan ketakutan. Tapi saat kembali ke rumah, saya merasa sendirian menghadapi beban ini. Rasa bangga dan malu membuat saya terdiam selama berbulan-bulan, nyaris membawa saya ke titik terendah. Perubahan terjadi saat saya mengerjakan film dokumenter dari rekaman pribadi selama perang. Berbagi cerita dengan editor yang saya percaya membantu saya melewati hambatan emosional dan memulai proses pemulihan. Dalam banyak hal, proses pembuatan film tersebut menjadi perjalanan terapi bagi saya. Jika Anda berjuang menghadapi emosi pasca-perang, ingatlah: Anda tidak sendiri, tidak apa-apa jika belum baik-baik saja, dan bercerita benar-benar membantu. Tidak ada yang perlu malu untuk meminta bantuan. Hubungi teman-teman veteran, organisasi seperti Wounded Warrior Project, atau hotline Veteran Affairs. Saat di medan perang, kerentanan sering dianggap sebagai kelemahan, tapi setelah pulang ke rumah, justru bisa menjadi kekuatan. Membuka diri adalah langkah awal menuju pemulihan. Sesama veteran saling mendukung, baik di medan tempur maupun kehidupan sipil. Jika Anda merasa kesulitan, ingatlah bahwa matahari tetap ada di balik awan. Mari saling menjaga dan mendukung dalam masa sulit. Di Hari Kemerdekaan ini, saat saya pulang dari riset, saya bersyukur atas perjalanan hidup saya. Pengalaman perang kini memberi saya perspektif baru, membuat setiap hari terasa lebih bermakna. Pendapat dalam tulisan ini sepenuhnya milik Mike Scotti.
post_content: Fireworks on the Fourth of July brought Iraq War memories rushing back for veteran Mike Scotti—showing how tough coming home can be. If you're struggling as a vet, remember: you're not alone and asking for help is a strength! #MentalHealth #Veterans #IndependenceDay

article_content: Elizabeth the Steam Bus, an iconic sight in Whitby, North Yorkshire, is now for sale on eBay for £185,000. This 11-tonne, six-wheel bus has carried more than 50,000 tourists annually through the town's steep, narrow streets, maintaining a maximum speed of 25mph. Operated for the past nine years by owners Viv and Vernon Smith, Elizabeth is believed to be the only working steam bus in the world.  Despite being cherished as a heritage attraction and national treasure, Elizabeth has received no public funding. The Smiths also own a companion vehicle, Charlotte, a soft-top charabanc built in 1929. However, following a dispute with the local council over where Elizabeth could refill its 300-gallon water tank—a process required daily—the couple has reluctantly decided to sell.  Water refilling usually took place at Whitby Town FC's ground, but on the 12 days a year when matches are held, alternative arrangements are needed. The Smiths requested permission to use a harbour car park for refilling, but the council declined, citing parking restrictions as the bus would not fit into designated spaces.  Vernon Smith explained on Facebook that ongoing challenges and costs, along with the lack of council support, have influenced their decision. He wrote, 'We have reached the stage where, in spite of all the good you and others do by taking a ride, the ever-growing costs of keeping our old ladies going are getting beyond us.'  The sale has sparked concerns among locals that Elizabeth may end up being bought by someone overseas, potentially leaving the town without its famous attraction.  Scarborough Borough Council expressed sadness at the news but refuted claims of responsibility, stating, 'We strongly refute the claims that we are somehow to blame for the owner's decision.' The council and Welcome to Yorkshire noted their efforts to support the steam bus in the past, including assistance with participation in events like the Lord Mayor's Parade in London.  Elizabeth is expected to operate until November 2, when she will make her final journey as part of a Whitby tradition.

Bus enam roda seberat 11 ton ini telah membawa lebih dari 50.000 wisatawan setiap tahunnya melewati jalan-jalan curam dan sempit di kota tersebut, dengan kecepatan maksimum 25mph. Selama sembilan tahun terakhir, bus ini dioperasikan oleh pasangan Viv dan Vernon Smith, dan diyakini sebagai satu-satunya steam bus yang masih berfungsi di dunia.  Meski sangat dicintai sebagai objek wisata warisan dan harta nasional, Elizabeth tidak pernah menerima dana publik. Keluarga Smith juga memiliki kendaraan pendamping bernama Charlotte, sebuah charabanc atap terbuka yang dibuat pada tahun 1929. Namun, setelah berselisih dengan dewan lokal terkait lokasi pengisian ulang tangki air Elizabeth berkapasitas 300 galon—yang harus dilakukan setiap hari—pasangan ini dengan berat hati memutuskan untuk menjualnya.  Proses pengisian air biasanya dilakukan di lapangan Whitby Town FC, namun pada 12 hari dalam setahun ketika ada pertandingan, mereka harus mencari lokasi alternatif. Pasangan Smith meminta izin menggunakan area parkir di tepi pelabuhan untuk pengisian air, namun dewan menolaknya karena bus tidak muat di ruang parkir yang ditentukan.  Vernon Smith menjelaskan di Facebook bahwa tantangan dan biaya yang terus meningkat, ditambah kurangnya dukungan dewan, menjadi alasan keputusan mereka. Ia menulis, 'Kami telah sampai pada tahap di mana, meskipun banyak manfaat yang dirasakan orang-orang dengan naik bus ini, biaya terus bertambah dan sudah melewati batas kemampuan kami.'  Penjualan ini menimbulkan kekhawatiran di kalangan warga setempat bahwa Elizabeth bisa saja dibeli oleh pihak luar negeri, sehingga kota akan kehilangan atraksi terkenalnya.  Dewan Scarborough Borough menyatakan kesedihan atas berita ini, namun membantah bertanggung jawab. Mereka mengatakan, 'Kami sangat membantah klaim bahwa kami penyebab keputusan pemilik.' Dewan dan Welcome to Yorkshire juga menyampaikan bahwa mereka telah berusaha membantu steam bus ini, termasuk mendukung keikutsertaan dalam acara seperti Lord Mayor's Parade di London.  Elizabeth diperkirakan akan tetap beroperasi hingga 2 November, saat ia melakukan perjalanan terakhir sebagai bagian dari tradisi Whitby.
