article_content: Former England coach David Lloyd reflects on the tragic death of Australian cricketer Phillip Hughes, who passed away at the age of 25 after being struck by a bouncer during a match. Lloyd expresses shock, noting that while serious injuries have occurred in cricket, it seemed unimaginable that such a fatal incident could happen in the modern, helmeted era. He describes the profound grief felt by Hughes' family, friends, and the entire cricketing community, highlighting that the event will leave a permanent mark on those who were present at the Sydney Cricket Ground (SCG) that day. Lloyd remarks that although players have always faced risks, modern training and safety equipment were believed to offer strong protection. He explains that instincts sometimes cause batsmen and short-leg fielders to turn away from the ball, inadvertently exposing vulnerable areas of the head—such as where Hughes was struck. He calls on all cricketers, regardless of age and experience, to prioritize safety and remain vigilant. Lloyd shares that, although he did not know Hughes personally, many attest to Hughes’ popularity and fighting spirit both on and off the field. As Cricket Australia faces difficult decisions about whether to proceed with the upcoming Test against India at the Gabba, Lloyd urges respect for each player's personal choice to play or not in the aftermath of the tragedy. He suggests there will be renewed scrutiny on helmet designs and the risks posed by fast bowling, especially for lower-order batsmen and close fielders. However, Lloyd defends the role of fast bowling as a core and thrilling aspect of cricket. Concluding, Lloyd emphasizes that while the sport will endure, the cricketing world mourns deeply with Hughes' family and friends after this rare, heartbreaking accident.
translated_content: Mantan pelatih Inggris, David Lloyd, mengenang kematian tragis pemain kriket Australia, Phillip Hughes, yang meninggal pada usia 25 tahun setelah terkena bouncer saat pertandingan. Lloyd mengungkapkan rasa terkejutnya, menekankan bahwa meskipun cedera serius pernah terjadi di kriket, rasanya sulit dipercaya insiden fatal seperti ini bisa terjadi di era modern dengan helm pelindung. Ia menggambarkan duka mendalam yang dirasakan keluarga, teman, dan seluruh komunitas kriket atas kejadian ini, serta menyoroti bahwa peristiwa tersebut akan meninggalkan bekas abadi bagi mereka yang hadir di Sydney Cricket Ground (SCG) hari itu. Lloyd berkomentar bahwa meski pemain selalu menghadapi risiko, perlengkapan pelindung dan pelatihan modern dianggap sudah cukup aman. Ia menjelaskan, terkadang naluri membuat pemukul atau fielder di short leg spontan memalingkan kepala dari bola, sehingga tanpa sengaja memperlihatkan area kepala yang rentan—seperti yang terjadi pada Hughes. Ia mengajak semua pemain kriket, tanpa memandang usia atau pengalaman, untuk selalu mengutamakan keselamatan dan tetap waspada. Lloyd juga mengungkapkan bahwa meski ia tidak mengenal Hughes secara pribadi, banyak yang menyebut Hughes sangat disukai dan punya semangat juang tinggi baik di dalam maupun di luar lapangan. Ketika Cricket Australia dihadapkan pada keputusan sulit apakah pertandingan Uji Coba berikutnya melawan India di Gabba akan dilanjutkan, Lloyd menegaskan pentingnya menghormati keputusan pribadi setiap pemain untuk bertanding ataupun tidak setelah tragedi ini. Ia memperkirakan akan ada peninjauan ulang terkait desain helm serta risiko yang ditimbulkan oleh bowling cepat, khususnya bagi pemukul urutan bawah dan fielder yang bermain di dekat batsman. Namun, Lloyd membela bowling cepat sebagai bagian inti dan daya tarik utama kriket. Sebagai penutup, Lloyd menegaskan bahwa kriket akan terus berjalan—namun dunia kriket turut berduka cita untuk keluarga dan sahabat Hughes atas insiden langka dan memilukan ini.

A community is grieving after Toree (33) and Bret Chandler (38), childhood sweethearts from Chester, Illinois, died in a tragic car accident on Saturday. The couple, who grew up together, attended the same high school, and had recently begun working at the same prison, were raising two young children: their 6-year-old son Damon and 8-month-old daughter Fallon.

Authorities report that Bret was driving their Jeep Wrangler in Perryville, Missouri, when he swerved—apparently to avoid hitting an animal—lost control of the vehicle, and crashed into a creek bed where the Jeep flipped into some trees. Both Toree and Bret were pronounced dead at the scene and had been wearing their seat belts.

Family and friends describe the Chandlers as devoted parents and partners. Toree’s mother, Sheree Nortin, told KFVS, 'They were just a couple cemented, they were perfect. And their children are wonderful. Great parents, great friends. And we are blessed to have them.'

In response to the loss, a GoFundMe page has been set up by Toree’s brother, Bryan, to help cover immediate expenses and to establish a scholarship fund for Damon and Fallon. In its first day, the fundraiser raised over $13,000 toward its $20,000 goal.
translated_content:
Sebuah komunitas sedang berduka setelah Toree (33) dan Bret Chandler (38), pasangan kekasih sejak SMA dari Chester, Illinois, meninggal dunia akibat kecelakaan mobil tragis pada hari Sabtu. Pasangan ini tumbuh bersama, bersekolah di SMA yang sama, dan baru-baru ini mulai bekerja di penjara yang sama. Mereka meninggalkan dua anak kecil: Damon, putra berusia 6 tahun, dan Fallon, putri berusia 8 bulan.

Menurut pihak berwenang, Bret mengemudikan Jeep Wrangler mereka di Perryville, Missouri, ketika ia membanting setir—diduga untuk menghindari menabrak hewan di jalan—hingga kehilangan kendali dan menabrak dasar sungai kecil, lalu mobilnya terbalik ke beberapa pohon. Toree dan Bret dinyatakan meninggal di tempat kejadian, keduanya telah mengenakan sabuk pengaman.

Keluarga dan teman menggambarkan pasangan Chandler sebagai orang tua dan pasangan yang penuh dedikasi. Ibu Toree, Sheree Nortin, mengatakan kepada KFVS, 'Mereka benar-benar pasangan yang serasi, mereka sempurna. Anak-anak mereka juga luar biasa. Orang tua yang hebat, sahabat yang hebat. Kami sangat diberkati memiliki mereka.'

Sebagai bentuk dukungan, saudara lelaki Toree, Bryan, membuat laman GoFundMe untuk membantu keperluan mendesak dan membentuk dana beasiswa bagi Damon dan Fallon. Dalam hari pertama, penggalangan dana ini berhasil mengumpulkan lebih dari $13.000 dari target $20.000.

article_content: US officials defended a controversial surveillance program during a Capitol Hill hearing, asserting that collecting foreign intelligence is standard for all nations. A panel, including Director of National Intelligence James Clapper and NSA chief General Keith Alexander, told the House Intelligence Committee that US surveillance programs are conducted responsibly. The hearing took place as the White House considered stopping NSA surveillance of allied leaders, following revelations that the US monitored German Chancellor Angela Merkel's communications. Protesters with placards and clown glasses sporting 'Stop Spying' slogans repeatedly disrupted the hearing. General Alexander stated he would rather face criticism from the public and media than end a program designed to protect Americans from future terrorist attacks. During the hearing on possible changes to the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act (FISA), Code Pink protesters were escorted out after interrupting proceedings. NSA Deputy Director Chris Inglis, General Alexander, DNI James Clapper, and Deputy AG James Cole defended US intelligence operations amid new overseas allegations. Separately, lawmakers are preparing to significantly restrict the NSA's use of its extensive communications records databases, following Edward Snowden's leaks. Questions focused on US surveillance of foreign leaders. Committee Chairman Mike Rogers said the committee was generally aware of overseas intelligence activities but avoided specifics. Clapper acknowledged that if the NSA surveils foreign leaders, Congress should be informed as this is a significant intelligence activity. He also emphasized that intelligence officials only follow policymakers' directives. Rogers opened by highlighting the oversight and privacy protections in place for US intelligence programs. The hearing examined proposed changes to FISA, the law regulating surveillance of foreign communications, typically to prevent terror attacks. Rogers noted that, unlike the US, countries such as China and Russia lack similar judicial and legislative oversight. Clapper stated that restricting intelligence activities increases risks from adversaries. General Alexander spoke from the heart, prioritizing national security programs aimed at preventing future attacks, even if it means facing criticism. Code Pink activist Tighe Barry and others were arrested for disrupting the hearing and demanding an end to domestic and foreign surveillance. France, Germany, and Spain have criticized the NSA for exceeding traditional spy practices, exploiting new technology and permissive US policies. An EU official warned that transatlantic trust needs rebuilding, with threats to halt trade negotiations. Viviane Reding, European Commission vice president, said US spying allegations have damaged Europe's relationship with America. Democratic Senator Patrick Leahy and Republican Representative James Sensenbrenner, co-authors of the USA PATRIOT Act, called for substantial reforms to domestic surveillance. Their bipartisan USA Freedom Act aims to end bulk collection of Americans’ phone records and restrict searching overseas communications for information about US citizens. Such restrictions would have been unthinkable years earlier, but post-9/11 attitudes in Washington are shifting. Clapper testified that changes to FISA would impact the NSA's ability to protect the country. Edward Snowden's leaks have sparked intense scrutiny and forced intelligence leaders to defend current practices. President Obama announced a review of US intelligence procedures, particularly regarding surveillance of foreign leaders. The New York Times reported that Obama is considering ordering the NSA to halt surveillance of allied leaders. Reuters reported that Obama has ordered the NSA to curtail spying on the United Nations headquarters. House Speaker John Boehner agreed on the need to balance aggressive intelligence gathering with civil liberties. Germany remains angered by revelations that Merkel's phone was monitored from 2002.

Sidang ini berlangsung ketika Gedung Putih mempertimbangkan untuk menghentikan pengawasan NSA terhadap para pemimpin negara sahabat, setelah terungkap bahwa AS memantau komunikasi Kanselir Jerman Angela Merkel. Jenderal Alexander menyatakan ia lebih memilih mendapatkan kritik dari publik dan media daripada menghentikan program yang bertujuan melindungi warga Amerika dari serangan teroris di masa depan. Selama sidang yang membahas kemungkinan perubahan terhadap Undang-Undang Pengawasan Intelijen Asing (FISA), sejumlah aktivis Code Pink dikeluarkan setelah menginterupsi jalannya persidangan. Wakil Direktur NSA Chris Inglis, Jenderal Alexander, DNI James Clapper, dan Wakil Jaksa Agung James Cole membela operasi intelijen AS di tengah tuduhan baru dari luar negeri. Secara terpisah, anggota parlemen sedang bersiap untuk membatasi secara signifikan penggunaan basis data komunikasi NSA, menyusul kebocoran dari Edward Snowden. Pertanyaan sidang banyak menyoroti pengawasan AS terhadap pemimpin negara lain. Ketua Komite Mike Rogers menyatakan komitenya umumnya mengetahui aktivitas intelijen luar negeri namun tidak merinci secara spesifik. Clapper mengakui bahwa jika NSA melakukan pengawasan terhadap pemimpin asing, Kongres harus diberi tahu karena merupakan aktivitas intelijen penting. Ia juga menekankan bahwa pejabat intelijen hanya menindaklanjuti perintah dari para pembuat kebijakan. Rogers menyoroti pengawasan yang kuat dan perlindungan privasi dalam program intelijen AS. Sidang ini membahas usulan perubahan FISA, yaitu undang-undang yang mengatur pengawasan komunikasi asing yang biasanya bertujuan mencegah aksi teroris. Rogers menambahkan, berbeda dengan AS, negara seperti Cina dan Rusia tidak memiliki mekanisme pengawasan hukum dan legislatif serupa. Clapper menyatakan bahwa pembatasan aktivitas intelijen justru meningkatkan risiko dari musuh. Jenderal Alexander berbicara secara pribadi, menekankan pentingnya program keamanan nasional demi mencegah serangan di masa depan walau mendapat kritik. Aktivis Code Pink, Tighe Barry dan lainnya, ditangkap karena mengganggu sidang dan menuntut diakhirinya program pengawasan domestik dan luar negeri. Perancis, Jerman, dan Spanyol mengkritik NSA karena melampaui praktik mata-mata tradisional dengan bantuan teknologi baru dan kebijakan AS yang longgar. Seorang pejabat Uni Eropa memperingatkan perlunya membangun kembali kepercayaan transatlantik, bahkan mengancam untuk menghentikan negosiasi dagang. Viviane Reding, wakil presiden Komisi Eropa, menyatakan tuduhan mata-mata AS telah merusak hubungan Eropa-Amerika. Senator Demokrat Patrick Leahy dan Anggota DPR Republik James Sensenbrenner, penyusun USA PATRIOT Act, menyerukan reformasi besar pada pengawasan domestik. USA Freedom Act bentukan bipartisan mereka bertujuan menghentikan pengumpulan massal data telepon warga AS dan membatasi penelusuran komunikasi luar negeri untuk data warga AS. Pembatasan ini sebelumnya tak terbayangkan, tetapi suasana di Washington pasca 9/11 mulai berubah. Clapper bersaksi bahwa perubahan FISA akan mempengaruhi kemampuan NSA untuk melindungi negara. Bocoran Edward Snowden memicu sorotan tajam dan memaksa pemimpin intelijen membela praktik mereka. Presiden Obama mengumumkan peninjauan prosedur intelijen AS, khususnya terkait pengawasan atas para pemimpin asing. The New York Times melaporkan Obama sedang mempertimbangkan perintah agar NSA menghentikan pemantauan atas pemimpin negara sekutu. Reuters melaporkan Obama telah memerintahkan NSA untuk mengurangi penyadapan di markas besar PBB. Ketua DPR John Boehner sepakat perlunya mencari keseimbangan antara pengumpulan intelijen dengan perlindungan kebebasan sipil. Jerman masih geram atas ungkapan bahwa ponsel Merkel telah dipantau sejak 2002.

article_content: Brenda Leyland, 63, who had recently been identified as one of the individuals posting abusive messages online targeting Kate and Gerry McCann, was found dead in a Leicester Marriott hotel room, approximately 15 miles from her home in Burton Overy. Police do not consider her death suspicious. Mrs. Leyland, divorced and known for her reserved nature in her village community, had been named by Sky News as one of several people sending hostile comments to the McCann family through her Twitter account, @Sweepyface. When approached by a reporter, she stated she felt 'entitled' to her actions. Her son Ben, 20, a law student in Los Angeles, left a brief tribute online following her death, saying, 'I love you mum and I will miss you forever,' which prompted condolences from friends. Neighbours expressed shock and sadness at the news, noting that while they did not condone her alleged online activity, they found the outcome very upsetting. Burton Overy, the village where Mrs. Leyland lived, is near Rothley, Leicestershire, the home of the McCanns. Mrs. Leyland was educated at a convent school and Goldsmiths, University of London. Online abuse towards the McCann family, including comments attributed to Mrs. Leyland, has persisted since their daughter Madeleine disappeared during a family holiday in Portugal in 2007. Among her posts was one saying the McCanns should 'suffer...for the rest of their miserable lives.' After her interview with Sky News aired, Mrs. Leyland left her home, and days later was found deceased at the hotel. Sky News issued a statement expressing sadness at her passing but refrained from further comment. Gerry McCann has publicly decried the impact of online harassment on his family and others in similar circumstances. He voiced concerns about internet safety for his children after facing online threats. The police continue to investigate online hate crimes against the McCanns. The family have avoided reading online abuse, finding it too distressing. Following the exposure of online trolls targeting the McCanns, police received a detailed dossier cataloguing abuse faced by the family. Scotland Yard and the Crown Prosecution Service are involved in ongoing investigations. Hotel and police officials declined to comment beyond confirming Mrs. Leyland's death, expressing condolences to her family and noting the coroner is preparing a report.

Polisi menyatakan kematiannya tidak dianggap mencurigakan. Keluarga ini menjauhi membaca pelecehan online karena terlalu membuat stres. article_content: Investors who can identify and use effective investment frameworks have the potential to outperform the market. However, this can be challenging for small investors, who may benefit from having professional fund managers handle their investments. Early in my investing career, I saw stock price as simply Price = EPS x P/E and thought that a lower P/E made a stock more attractive. By the late 1980s, I realized that earnings growth (EPS growth) was also important, leading to the PEG ratio (Price/Earnings to Growth), where a lower PEG signals an attractive stock. Some institutional investors called this approach GARP—Growth At a Reasonable Price. In the 1990s, I encountered Warren Buffett’s investing style, which stresses the role of quality, using metrics like Return on Equity (RoE). He famously said, ‘It's far better to buy a wonderful company at a fair price than a fair company at a wonderful price.’ This led to QGARP (Quality Growth At Reasonable Price), which focuses on both business and management quality as well as the sustainability of growth. By around 2010, I formulated my own investment philosophy, QGLP, meaning Quality, Growth, and Longevity at a reasonable Price. Today, the Indian stock market commonly follows QGLP or similar strategies. How can investors obtain an edge in this environment? I see two approaches: 1) Having patience to let the power of compounding work, and 2) Applying robust investment frameworks (IFs). I have developed various IFs under each area: Quality, Growth, Longevity, and Price. For business quality, Porter's Five Forces is invaluable, and I use a scoring model to evaluate business attractiveness. For management quality, I look for integrity, competence, and a growth mindset. Promoter-led companies can sometimes deliver superior returns. For growth in earnings, my preferred frameworks are Value Migration (when value shifts from outdated business models to those serving new customer needs) and NTD (Next Trillion Dollar Opportunity in India), a proprietary model describing India's accelerating GDP growth, leading to more discretionary spending. Other valuable frameworks include Mid-to-Mega (tracking how midcaps can become large caps over 5-10 years) and 100x (how small caps can multiply 100 times in 10-15 years). Again, investors able to identify and use these frameworks may outperform the market, although it remains difficult for small investors who could benefit from professional management. (The writer is Chairman and Co-founder of Motilal Oswal Financial Services) Disclaimer: The views expressed are those of the writer and do not reflect the views of economictimes.com. Additionally, after over 20,000 GST notices were issued since 2022, Indian companies are reassessing tax issues before moving forward with mergers and acquisitions. Separately, Nawaz Modi, estranged wife of Raymond Managing Director Gautam Singhania, has accused him of assaulting her and their daughter two months ago.

Di masa awal karier investasi saya, saya mempercayai rumus Price = EPS x P/E dan menyimpulkan P/E rendah berarti saham menarik. Di akhir 1980-an, saya sadar pertumbuhan laba (EPS growth) juga kunci, sehingga tercipta rasio PEG (Price/Earnings to Growth); semakin kecil PEG semakin menarik. Beberapa institusi menyebutnya GARP—Growth At a Reasonable Price. Tahun 1990-an, saya mengenal filosofi investasi Warren Buffett, yang menekankan pentingnya kualitas, salah satunya memakai Return on Equity (RoE). Ia terkenal dengan kutipan, 'Jauh lebih baik membeli perusahaan hebat dengan harga wajar dibanding perusahaan biasa dengan harga sangat murah.' Gaya ini melahirkan istilah QGARP (Quality Growth At Reasonable Price), fokus pada kualitas bisnis, kualitas manajemen, dan keberlanjutan pertumbuhan. Sekitar tahun 2010, saya mencetuskan filosofi investasi QGLP: Quality, Growth, and Longevity at a reasonable Price. Saat ini, pasar saham India banyak memakai QGLP atau variasinya. Bagaimana investor mendapat keunggulan? Dua cara utama: 1) Bersabar agar efek compounding optimal, 2) Menerapkan berbagai kerangka investasi (IFs). Saya punya sejumlah IF untuk Kualitas, Pertumbuhan, Keberlanjutan, dan Harga. Untuk kualitas bisnis, Porter's Five Forces sangat bermanfaat, sementara penilaian saya memakai model skor. Untuk kualitas manajemen, saya menilai integritas, kompetensi, dan mindset pertumbuhan. Perusahaan milik pendiri (promoter-led) terkadang memberi hasil lebih baik. Untuk pertumbuhan laba, favorit saya Value Migration (nilai bergeser dari model lama ke yang melayani kebutuhan baru) dan NTD (Next Trillion Dollar Opportunity di India), model yang saya bangun sendiri untuk melihat percepatan PDB India dan tumbuhnya belanja masyarakat. Kerangka penting lain ialah Mid-to-Mega (midcap jadi large cap dalam 5-10 tahun) dan 100x (small cap tumbuh 100 kali dalam 10-15 tahun). Intinya, investor yang bisa mengenali dan memakai kerangka seperti ini mungkin bisa mengalahkan pasar. Tapi tetap, bagi investor kecil, manajemen profesional bisa jadi solusi. article_content: The rise in digital transactions has enabled marginalized communities, including transgender people, to better manage their finances. At a traffic signal in New Delhi, Ayesha Sharma—a 29-year-old transwoman dressed in traditional attire—holds up her phone displaying a QR code as the light changes and vehicles pause. One commuter scans the code, instantly transferring 10 rupees ($0.12) into her account, making it easier for her to receive donations while panhandling. Digital payments and instant payment interfaces like Sharma's are helping marginalized groups like transgender individuals manage their money more effectively. Sharma, who has been begging in New Delhi since 2006, recounts frequent experiences with prejudice. The use of a smartphone to receive money has helped to reduce some derogatory remarks, she says, as people are intrigued by her tech-savvy approach. This shift has also made it easier for commuters to donate, even if they lack cash, with around a quarter of Sharma’s earnings now coming via digital methods. "It is so much easier now. Even when people don't have cash, they can still donate to us by just scanning this code," Sharma told Al Jazeera. "We may be beggars, but we should still be treated with respect and decency." Digital payments have also meant transgender people like Sharma don’t always have to visit banks, where they often face discrimination. The Indian government has promoted digital transactions, especially after the demonetisation in November 2016, which removed nearly 90% of cash from circulation overnight and prompted a surge in payment app usage. The COVID-19 pandemic further boosted digital payments, although cash remains the preferred payment method in India. Digital transactions take various forms: some apps connect directly to a person's bank account, while others operate like prepaid wallets or company-linked accounts. Leeza Khan, a 30-year-old transgender woman from Meerut, receives at least 20% of her daily earnings through digital transactions. Khan, who completed grade 10 and was abandoned by her family after coming out, has since earned a living by begging in Delhi's streets, buses, and at weddings. By using a QR code, she is able to receive daily donations between 400 rupees ($4.81) and 500 rupees ($6.01). The system also benefits others like Amri, a 23-year-old flower seller at New Delhi’s traffic signals, who makes 200–300 rupees ($2.41–$3.61) daily, of which about 70–80 rupees ($0.84–$0.96) comes via digital payments. However, digital payments aren’t a perfect solution. Some transgender individuals face difficulties opening regular bank accounts or updating their gender identity on existing accounts, even though India’s central bank has called for banks to recognize the third gender since 2015. For instance, Khan doesn't have a regular bank account because she lacks a PAN card (a key financial ID) and an Aadhar card (a 12-digit unique identity number). Both are required for most bank account openings. Although Khan could obtain these documents after registering as third gender with local authorities, she quit the process because of intrusive questioning and insensitive remarks during application. Adding to these hurdles, digital payment providers have begun requiring PAN or Aadhar cards for regulatory compliance, known as KYC (Know Your Customer) requirements. As a result, Khan relies on a QR code linked to her commune leader’s account and pays a commission on her earnings. Rudrani Chhetri, founder of Mitr Trust (which supports transgender people), notes that many transgender people have used payment apps without considering their eligibility. With stricter KYC rules, issues have emerged, especially with mismatched names and bank accounts. According to Swati Maliwal, chairperson of the Delhi Commission for Women, only 76 new third-gender certificates were issued in the past 3–4 years, despite over 5,000 transgender people counted in Delhi in 2012. Maliwal criticizes this as a sign of insufficient support: "Are transgender people invisible in the political system? Both state and federal governments are responsible." She adds that officials sometimes harass transgender people and their families during the identification certificate process. Despite the challenges, payment apps give Sharma and other transgender individuals a safer, more efficient way to receive donations. Digital banking is crucial for the well-being of transgender and other marginalized communities, says Chhetri, but opening and maintaining an account with the necessary qualifications remains a significant challenge.
translated_content: Peningkatan transaksi digital telah memungkinkan komunitas marjinal, termasuk transgender, untuk lebih mudah mengelola keuangan mereka. Di lampu lalu lintas di New Delhi, Ayesha Sharma—wanita trans berusia 29 tahun dengan pakaian tradisional—mengangkat ponselnya yang menampilkan kode QR saat lampu berubah dan kendaraan berhenti. Seorang pengendara memindai kode itu, langsung mengirimkan 10 rupee (sekitar Rp1.900) ke akun Ayesha, membuatnya lebih mudah menerima donasi ketika mengemis. Pembayaran digital dan antarmuka instan seperti yang digunakan Sharma kini membantu kelompok marjinal, termasuk transgender, dalam mengatur keuangan mereka secara lebih efektif. Sharma, yang telah mengemis di New Delhi sejak 2006, sering mengalami prasangka. Dengan menggunakan ponsel untuk menerima uang, sebagian komentar negatif kini berkurang, katanya, karena orang-orang tertarik pada caranya yang modern. Cara ini juga membuat orang lebih mudah berdonasi meski tidak membawa uang tunai, bahkan kini sekitar seperempat pendapatan Sharma berasal dari metode digital. "Sekarang jauh lebih mudah. Meskipun orang tidak membawa uang tunai, mereka tetap bisa berdonasi hanya dengan memindai kode ini," ujar Sharma kepada Al Jazeera. "Kami mungkin pengemis, tapi tetap harus dihargai dan diperlakukan dengan sopan." Pembayaran digital juga membuat transgender seperti Sharma tak perlu sering mengunjungi bank, di mana mereka biasanya mengalami diskriminasi. Pemerintah India mendorong transaksi digital, terutama setelah demonetisasi pada November 2016, yang menghapus hampir 90% uang tunai di peredaran dan memicu lonjakan penggunaan aplikasi pembayaran. Pandemi COVID-19 juga turut meningkatkan transaksi digital, meski uang tunai tetap menjadi metode pembayaran favorit di India. Transaksi digital tersedia dalam berbagai bentuk: ada aplikasi yang terhubung langsung ke rekening bank pengguna, dan ada juga yang berupa dompet prabayar atau akun yang dihubungkan ke perusahaan penyedia. Leeza Khan, wanita transgender berusia 30 tahun asal Meerut, mendapatkan setidaknya 20% penghasilan harian melalui transaksi digital. Khan, yang hanya sampai kelas 10 dan diusir keluarganya setelah mengaku sebagai transgender, kini mencari nafkah dengan mengemis di jalan, bus, dan acara pernikahan di Delhi. Dengan kode QR, ia bisa menerima donasi harian antara 400 rupee (sekitar Rp48.100) hingga 500 rupee (sekitar Rp60.100). Sistem ini juga membantu orang lain seperti Amri, penjual bunga berusia 23 tahun di lampu merah New Delhi, yang meraup 200–300 rupee (sekitar Rp24.100–Rp36.100) per hari, dengan sekitar 70–80 rupee (Rp8.400–Rp9.600) berasal dari pembayaran digital. Namun, pembayaran digital bukan solusi sempurna. Sebagian transgender kesulitan membuka rekening bank biasa atau memperbarui identitas gender mereka, meski sejak 2015 bank-bank di India sudah diwajibkan mengakui gender ketiga. Misalnya Khan, yang tidak punya rekening bank karena tidak memiliki kartu PAN (identitas keuangan penting) dan kartu Aadhar (nomor identitas unik 12 digit). Padahal, kedua dokumen ini biasanya wajib untuk membuka rekening baru. Meski Khan bisa mendapat dokumen itu setelah mendaftar sebagai gender ketiga di pemerintah lokal, ia menghentikan prosesnya karena pertanyaan yang mengusik dan komentar tidak sensitif selama proses pendaftaran. Menambah tantangan, penyedia pembayaran digital kini mensyaratkan kartu PAN atau Aadhar untuk mematuhi peraturan KYC (Know Your Customer/kenali nasabah anda). Akibatnya, Khan hanya bisa mengandalkan kode QR yang terhubung ke pemimpin komunitas tempat ia tinggal—dan harus membayar komisi dari penghasilannya. Rudrani Chhetri, pendiri Mitr Trust (organisasi pendukung transgender), mengatakan banyak transgender memakai aplikasi pembayaran tanpa memikirkan persyaratan kelayakan. Dengan aturan KYC yang lebih ketat, kini muncul masalah, terutama ketika nama di aplikasi dan rekening bank berbeda. Menurut Swati Maliwal, ketua Komisi Perempuan Delhi, hanya 76 sertifikat gender ketiga diterbitkan dalam 3–4 tahun terakhir, padahal menurut sensus 2012 ada lebih dari 5.000 transgender di Delhi. Maliwal mengkritik kondisi ini: "Apakah transgender dianggap tak terlihat dalam sistem politik? Pemerintah pusat dan daerah sama-sama bertanggung jawab." Ia juga menambahkan, banyak pejabat membuat transgender dan keluarganya merasa tidak nyaman ketika proses pembuatan sertifikat identitas. Meski penuh tantangan, aplikasi pembayaran memberikan Sharma dan transgender lainnya cara yang lebih aman dan efisien untuk menerima donasi. Perbankan digital sangat penting untuk kesejahteraan komunitas transgender dan kelompok marjinal lainnya, tutur Chhetri, tapi membuka dan mengelola rekening bank masih jadi hambatan besar karena syarat dokumen yang rumit.

The urge to appear productive at work—often manifesting as false urgency and busywork—is frequently rooted in anxiety rather than genuine necessity. Many employees, hoping to prove their value, anticipate their managers' needs and immerse themselves intensely in work, sometimes at the expense of meaningful interaction or reflection. This intense dedication is not always directed toward high-value tasks; instead, workers often get caught up in 'busywork' that absorbs time and energy but yields little substantive progress for the organization.

With the job market becoming harder for white-collar employees following the end of the Great Resignation—a period sometimes called the 'richcession'—workers may feel compelled to seem industrious to safeguard their positions, ensuring their superiors notice their efforts. However, it's sometimes unclear if this busyness translates to real accomplishments or simply cycles of repeated activity.

Busywork typically lacks a clearly defined purpose, often draws in other colleagues, monopolizes work hours, and leads to few meaningful results. This can hinder organizational success. Additionally, some leaders may intentionally or inadvertently foster a sense of false urgency, pressuring staff to act quickly in response to exaggerated deadlines. For instance, in 2023, Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg declared a 'year of efficiency,' criticizing unnecessary layers of management and highlighting the need for a leaner, more effective organizational structure. He argued that too many middle managers can introduce costly bureaucracy.

In response, some supervisors may seek to justify their roles by manufacturing urgency, especially during times of corporate cost-cutting. But acting from fear—rather than strategic thinking—can trap both managers and employees in cycles of unproductive work. According to Harvard Business Review, it's important to regularly question the motivations behind workplace urgency. When anxiety drives decisions, it can perpetuate self-limiting behaviors and reduce effectiveness.

To combat this, managers should set clear, high-value goals and conduct workflow audits that promote productivity without fostering fear. Automating routine, low-impact tasks can further enable employees to focus on work that truly matters. As entrepreneur Gary Keller observed, 'Activity is often unrelated to productivity, and busyness rarely takes care of business.' True productivity requires purposeful action, rather than simply being busy.

Dorongan untuk terlihat produktif di tempat kerja—sering muncul dalam bentuk urgensi palsu dan pekerjaan sibuk—sering kali berakar pada kecemasan, bukan kebutuhan yang sesungguhnya. Banyak karyawan mencoba membuktikan nilai diri dengan mengantisipasi kebutuhan manajer, hingga tenggelam dalam pekerjaan yang intens, kadang sampai mengabaikan interaksi sosial atau refleksi bermakna. Namun, dedikasi ini tidak selalu diarahkan pada tugas yang bernilai tinggi; sebagian besar justru terjebak pada pekerjaan sibuk yang menguras waktu dan tenaga, tapi minim hasil signifikan bagi organisasi.

Seiring pasar kerja makin sulit bagi pekerja kantoran pasca berakhirnya Great Resignation—yang kadang disebut 'richcession'—banyak yang terdorong untuk tampil rajin agar aman di posisi mereka dan diakui atasan. Akan tetapi, belum tentu kesibukan ini menghasilkan pencapaian nyata atau sekadar berputar di siklus rutinitas.

Pekerjaan sibuk sering tidak punya tujuan jelas, melibatkan banyak rekan, menyita jam kerja, tapi jarang membuahkan hasil bermakna sehingga menghambat keberhasilan organisasi. Ada juga pemimpin yang secara sadar atau tidak, memicu urgensi palsu, menekan staf dengan tenggat yang berlebihan. Contohnya, tahun 2023, CEO Meta Mark Zuckerberg mendeklarasikan 'tahun efisiensi' dan mengkritik manajemen berlapis-lapis demi struktur organisasi lebih ramping. Ia menyebut, terlalu banyak manajer menengah memperbesar birokrasi dan biaya.

Sebagian supervisor pun jadi menciptakan urgensi untuk membenarkan peran mereka, apalagi saat perusahaan menekan anggaran. Namun, bertindak atas dasar ketakutan—bukan strategi—bisa menjebak manajer plus karyawan dalam lingkaran kerja tidak produktif. Menurut Harvard Business Review, penting untuk selalu menanyakan, apa pemicu urgensi di tempat kerja. Ketika kecemasan mendorong keputusan, perilaku membatasi diri dan efektivitas pun turun.

Solusinya: manajer perlu tetapkan tujuan jelas dan bernilai, melakukan audit alur kerja yang tingkatkan produktivitas tanpa menakuti tim. Mengotomatisasi tugas rutin bernilai rendah bisa membantu karyawan fokus ke pekerjaan penting. Pengusaha Gary Keller berkata, 'Aktivitas sering tak berhubungan dengan produktivitas, dan kesibukan jarang menyelesaikan tujuan.' Produktivitas sejati butuh tujuan, bukan sekadar sibuk saja.

Martyn Harvey, a 21-year-old unemployed plumber, broke into an unoccupied house undergoing renovations in Plymouth, Devon, and caused extensive damage during a drunken party. Harvey smeared white paint over the floors, windows, kitchen counters, and even inside the washing machine and cooker. He wrote slang phrases and hashtags such as 'You Only Live Once' on the windows. The cost of cleaning up the property has been estimated at £1,000.

Harvey invited nine friends to the house, but admitted sole responsibility for the damage, explaining that he found a tin of paint under the stairs. Police traced him by finding his fingerprint on a cider can left at the scene.

At Plymouth Crown Court, Harvey pleaded guilty to burglary with intent to cause unlawful damage. Judge Paul Darlow described the incident as a 'mean and nasty' act of vandalism, emphasizing that being drunk made matters worse. Harvey's defense barrister, Nick Lewin, argued it was an act of stupidity rather than an act of pure criminality.

Harvey was sentenced to 20 weeks in jail, suspended for two years, and given an 18-month supervision order. He must also pay £500 in compensation, complete 220 hours of unpaid work, and adhere to a four-month curfew.

Harvey mengoleskan cat putih ke lantai, jendela, meja dapur, bahkan ke dalam mesin cuci dan kompor. Ia juga menulis frasa gaul dan tagar seperti 'You Only Live Once' di jendela. Hakim Paul Darlow menyebut aksi itu sebagai vandalisme yang 'jahat dan keji', serta menekankan bahwa kondisi mabuk memperburuk situasi. article_content: Shareholder advisory firm InGovern has criticized Religare Enterprises, claiming that the company’s chairperson, Rashmi Saluja, received 'excessive' compensation and that there were regulatory violations and non-disclosures. InGovern estimates that Saluja’s stock options from Religare and its subsidiary, Care Health Insurance, were worth about ₹480 crore over the last 3–4 years. The firm alleges these Care Health Insurance stock options were granted without approval from the insurance regulator and Religare’s shareholders. However, Care Health Insurance’s independent director, Pratap Venugopal, responded by asserting that the stock options were granted to Saluja in her role as executive director/chairperson of Religare, not as a non-executive chairperson at Care. According to Venugopal, insurance rules allow the board to decide on such remuneration, and no special permission is needed. He emphasized that the 15% pool for Care Health Insurance stock options had been approved by both the company’s board and shareholders. Elsewhere in financial news, the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has tightened capital requirements for unsecured retail loans, aiming to contain risks from rapid growth in consumer lending. Meanwhile, Indian cricketer Mohammed Shami has seen his endorsement rates double to about ₹1 crore per deal during the ICC Men’s Cricket World Cup after a record-breaking performance. Additionally, the Mines Ministry has informed Hindustan Zinc Ltd (HZL) that any business reorganization will require formal government approval.

InGovern memperkirakan opsi saham Saluja dari Religare dan anak usahanya, Care Health Insurance, bernilai sekitar Rp480 crore selama 3–4 tahun terakhir. Firma tersebut menuduh opsi saham Care Health Insurance diberikan tanpa persetujuan dari regulator asuransi dan pemegang saham Religare. Namun, direktur independen Care Health Insurance, Pratap Venugopal, menanggapi bahwa opsi saham itu diberikan kepada Saluja dalam kapasitasnya sebagai direktur eksekutif/ketua Religare, bukan sebagai ketua non-eksekutif di Care. Menurut Venugopal, aturan asuransi memperbolehkan dewan direktur menentukan remunerasi, sehingga tidak perlu izin khusus. Ia menekankan bahwa jatah 15% untuk opsi saham Care Health Insurance telah disetujui oleh dewan dan pemegang saham perusahaan. Sementara itu, dalam berita keuangan lainnya, Reserve Bank of India (RBI) memperketat persyaratan modal untuk pinjaman ritel tanpa jaminan guna membatasi risiko akibat pertumbuhan pinjaman konsumen yang pesat. Di sisi lain, pemain kriket India, Mohammed Shami, mengalami kenaikan tarif endorsement hingga dua kali lipat menjadi sekitar Rp1 crore per kontrak selama Piala Dunia Kriket ICC setelah penampilannya yang memecahkan rekor. Selain itu, Kementerian Pertambangan menyampaikan kepada Hindustan Zinc Ltd (HZL) bahwa setiap reorganisasi bisnis harus mendapatkan persetujuan resmi dari pemerintah.

article_content: A grateful Air Force wife anonymously paid for groceries after a group of firefighters had to abandon their full cart at the register to respond to an emergency call. The donor spent $123.25 on the firefighters' groceries—including bread rolls, peppers, mushrooms, and bacon—at a Costco in Vacaville, California, on Sunday. She attached a note to the groceries saying, 'Thanks for being there for us! Have a good weekend! From = Air Force wife.' When the firefighters returned, they found the note attached to their cart. The team, wearing camouflage shirts in honor of Memorial Day, were touched by the generosity—especially while commemorating veterans like the donor's husband. After responding to the call, the firefighters discovered their groceries had been covered by the anonymous woman. They posted their gratitude on Facebook, saying, 'Whoever did this, we are forever grateful and your kind gesture will not be forgotten. Meals at the firehouse come out of our own pockets and this was beyond generous.' The Facebook post received more than 6,000 likes and nearly 1,000 shares, with many people commenting on how they were inspired by the act of kindness. Battalion Chief Jeff Ryder said the crew was overwhelmed by the gesture. 'During Memorial Day weekend when we should be honoring military members and their families, here she is honoring us as firefighters,' he told CBS Sacramento. Firefighters explained they each typically contribute $25 per shift for meals. With the money saved, they felt inspired to pay the kindness forward. Later that day at a Lucky's grocery store, they noticed an elderly couple purchasing flowers for Memorial Day and used part of the saved funds to buy the flowers for them. They also planned to host a 90-year-old World War II veteran for dinner on Tuesday. Ryder added that the firefighters do not know who the mystery woman is, but if she chooses to reveal herself, they would be eager to thank her in person.

article_content: Shannon Vasconcelos, once an assistant director of financial aid at Tufts University, now leads college finance at College Coach, a branch of Bright Horizons. She advises families from across the U.S. on college admissions, answering questions about entering elite universities, crafting essays, affording tuition, and finding scholarships. College Coach's counseling services are provided free to families whose companies offer it as an employee perk. Major financial and corporate firms such as JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America, American Express, Mastercard, and Paramount Pictures are among those participating. Normally, private college counseling costs around $140 an hour, but companies use this benefit to help recruit and keep workers. According to Laura Lemmons from the law firm Goodwin, college admissions support as an employee benefit aims to save parents time and reduce stress throughout their children's development. The benefit is available to all staff, regardless of job title. However, critics warn this amplifies advantages for affluent families in high-paying sectors. Boston University professor Anthony Abraham Jack questions the fairness in offering free services to households already equipped with resources. With college admissions increasingly complicated by changing policies and test requirements, most families depend on overburdened public high school counselors. Many counselors manage hundreds of students—well above the recommended ratio—which restricts individual guidance to less than an hour annually per student. Workplace college counseling reflects a broader trend as companies respond to declining employee satisfaction by expanding family-focused benefits. Alongside admissions coaching, popular perks include expanded parental leave, tuition support, and help repaying student loans. Craig Copeland of the Employee Benefit Research Institute says these programs support older employees with high-school-age children and help guide informed college choices. Employers claim benefits, too: surveys like Empowerly’s show that most workers spend part of their workday helping kids with college plans. Bank of America’s unlimited private counseling has been used by thousands of employees at every level. Jenny Rosenberger, a senior vice president, says advisers helped her daughter narrow down schools, polish applications, and handle financial planning—resources not available to all families. While it’s unclear how many companies offer these perks, most are in lucrative industries and, in some cases, limit them to senior employees. According to the National Association for College Admission Counseling, public high school students typically receive little individualized advice due to counselor workloads. Vasconcelos notes that while universal counseling access would be ideal, practical gaps exist—hence the need for specialized services to support employees from varied backgrounds. Senior leaders may be more likely to use these perks, but she also connects with staff whose families are new to college. This article is produced by The Hechinger Report, a nonprofit, independent organization covering educational equity and innovation.
translated_content: Shannon Vasconcelos, yang dahulu menjabat asisten direktur bantuan keuangan di Tufts University, kini memimpin bidang keuangan perguruan tinggi di College Coach, bagian dari Bright Horizons. Ia memberikan konsultasi kepada keluarga di seluruh AS, membantu mereka dalam proses penerimaan kuliah, mulai dari pertanyaan seputar masuk universitas top, menulis esai, menghitung biaya, hingga mencari beasiswa. Layanan konseling dari College Coach diberikan gratis bagi keluarga yang perusahaannya menawarkan manfaat ini kepada karyawannya. Beberapa perusahaan besar seperti JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America, American Express, Mastercard, dan Paramount Pictures ikut serta. Konsultasi privat biasanya bernilai sekitar $140 per jam, tapi perusahaan menggunakan benefit ini untuk menarik sekaligus mempertahankan karyawan. Menurut Laura Lemmons dari firma hukum Goodwin, dukungan konsultasi penerimaan kuliah sebagai benefit karyawan bertujuan menghemat waktu dan mengurangi stres orang tua sepanjang tumbuh kembang anak. Semua staf, tanpa memandang jabatan, dapat menikmati manfaat ini. Namun sejumlah pengkritik menyoroti bahwa program ini memperlebar kesenjangan bagi keluarga-keluarga berpenghasilan tinggi di sektor elit. Profesor Anthony Abraham Jack dari Boston University mempertanyakan keadilan menyediakan layanan gratis untuk mereka yang sudah punya sumber daya memadai. Proses penerimaan kuliah semakin rumit karena pergantian kebijakan dan perubahan persyaratan tes. Mayoritas keluarga mengandalkan konselor di SMA negeri yang menangani ratusan siswa, jauh di atas rasio yang direkomendasikan, sehingga bimbingan yang didapat siswa sering kali jauh dari cukup—kurang dari satu jam per tahun per siswa. Konseling penerimaan kuliah sebagai benefit karyawan merupakan bagian dari tren peningkatan fasilitas keluarga yang diberikan perusahaan di tengah turunnya kepuasan kerja. Selain konseling kuliah, tren benefit lain meliputi cuti orang tua tambahan, bantuan biaya kuliah, dan dukungan pelunasan kredit pendidikan. Menurut Craig Copeland dari Employee Benefit Research Institute, program ini membantu para karyawan dengan anak remaja dalam memilih kampus secara lebih cermat. Perusahaan pun diuntungkan: survei Empowerly menunjukkan sebagian besar karyawan memakai waktu kerja untuk membantu anaknya soal kuliah. Banyak karyawan Bank of America dari berbagai tingkatan telah memanfaatkan program konsultasi tanpa batas ini. Jenny Rosenberger, seorang wakil presiden senior, mengatakan penasihat membantu putrinya memilih kampus, menyusun aplikasi, dan perencanaan keuangan—layanan yang tidak semua keluarga bisa dapatkan. Meskipun belum jelas berapa banyak perusahaan yang menawarkan manfaat ini, kebanyakan berada di industri bergaji tinggi dan beberapa hanya memberikannya untuk karyawan senior. Menurut National Association for College Admission Counseling, siswa SMA negeri hanya mendapat sedikit bimbingan individual akibat padatnya beban kerja konselor. Vasconcelos menilai akses bantuan konseling secara merata akan lebih baik, tetapi kenyataan di lapangan masih banyak celah, sehingga layanan khusus semacam ini dibutuhkan agar dapat mendukung keluarga dari beragam latar belakang. Meski para eksekutif lebih familier soal program ini, Vasconcelos kerap memberikan konsultasi juga pada staf yang menjadi generasi pertama keluarganya menuju kuliah. Artikel ini dipersembahkan oleh The Hechinger Report, organisasi nirlaba independen yang berfokus pada isu kesetaraan dan inovasi pendidikan.

Former UK Prime Minister Tony Blair will lead a distinguished panel in a unique debate, jointly hosted by CNN and the World Economic Forum (WEF), at this year's gathering in Davos, Switzerland. The event will be aired on CNN as part of its extensive coverage of the WEF, led by anchors Richard Quest, Becky Anderson, and Charles Hodson. Coverage features a daily blogger segment, live interviews with major participants, and will conclude with the joint debate featuring Tony Blair and other top leaders.

Senior Vice President of CNN International, Katherine Green, highlighted that, 'The world's most sophisticated communicators come together at Davos. CNN is engaging not only major newsmakers but also the dynamic world of blogging, which has become an important aspect of the Davos experience.'

A daily segment titled 'A Day in the Life of a Blogger,' fronted by prominent French blogger Loïc Le Meur, offers viewers an insider’s perspective from Davos. This segment appears during evening broadcasts and as part of CNN’s daily live coverage, which starts at 0500 GMT / 0600 CET on Tuesday, January 22.

The week’s programming culminates on Sunday, January 27 at 2200 GMT / 2300 CET, with an hour-long joint CNN/WEF debate, 'Dateline Davos,' hosted by CNN’s Hala Gorani. The prestigious panel includes Tony Blair; James Dimon, Chairman and CEO of JPMorgan Chase & Co.; Wang Jianzhou, Chairman and CEO of China Mobile Communications Corporation; and K. V. Kamath, Managing Director and CEO of ICICI Bank.

The debate will address global economic concerns such as recession fears, high oil prices, market volatility, the weakened U.S. dollar, and the rapid growth in China and India. It will also discuss what American voters are seeking in their next president.

CNN's coverage will feature the latest news, analysis, behind-the-scenes images, and staff blogs at www.cnn.com/davos. Additionally, viewers can participate in YouTube’s 'The Davos Question,' where users submit questions on how countries, companies, or individuals can help improve the world in 2008. The site offers user-generated content and exclusive reporter videos.

article_content: As people age, bones generally lose density and accumulate more fat, which makes them weaker and more susceptible to fractures. Until recently, the cellular reasons behind these changes were not entirely known. Now, research from NYU Grossman School of Medicine has revealed that the Notch signaling pathway—a group of molecular signals important for bone growth and repair—malfunctions with age. Skeletal stem and progenitor cells (SSPCs) in bone marrow can develop into bone-forming osteoblasts or fat-storing adipocytes. Youthful bones strike a balance between these cell types, but aging causes stem cells to favor turning into fat cells, decreasing bone mass and integrity. Dr. Sophie Morgani and her team analyzed bones from young and middle-aged mice. They found that older mice had more marrow fat, and gene analyses showed higher activity in the Notch pathway, which drove the stem cells’ shift toward becoming fat instead of bone. To test solutions, researchers genetically engineered mice without the protein nicastrin, essential for Notch signaling. These mice showed less marrow fat, higher bone density, and improved bone self-repair—sometimes even exceeding that of young mice. However, since blocking Notch signaling widely could cause negative side effects, this is not a complete solution. Looking further, the researchers identified the protein Ebf3, active specifically in skeletal stem cells and positioned downstream of Notch, as a safer target for therapy. Ebf3 might be key for developing treatments that revive bone health without unintended harm to other tissues. This study advances our understanding of osteoporosis and bone fragility in aging and highlights promising new strategies, such as targeting Ebf3, to help preserve bone strength as people get older.
translated_content: Seiring bertambahnya usia, tulang biasanya kehilangan kepadatannya dan mengandung lebih banyak lemak, sehingga menjadi lebih lemah dan mudah patah. Hingga saat ini, alasan perubahan seluler ini belum sepenuhnya dipahami. Namun, penelitian dari NYU Grossman School of Medicine mengungkap bahwa jalur pensinyalan Notch—serangkaian sinyal molekuler penting untuk pertumbuhan dan perbaikan tulang—mengalami gangguan seiring bertambahnya usia. Sel punca dan progenitor rangka (SSPC) di sumsum tulang dapat berkembang menjadi osteoblas pembentuk tulang atau adiposit penyimpan lemak. Pada masa muda, tulang menjaga keseimbangan antara kedua jenis sel ini, tetapi pada usia tua, sel punca cenderung lebih sering menjadi sel lemak, sehingga massa dan kekuatan tulang berkurang. Dr. Sophie Morgani dan timnya menganalisis tulang dari tikus muda dan paruh baya. Mereka menemukan bahwa tikus berusia lebih tua memiliki lebih banyak lemak di sumsum tulang, dan analisis gen menunjukkan peningkatan aktivitas jalur Notch yang menyebabkan lebih banyak sel punca berubah menjadi sel lemak daripada sel tulang. Untuk mencari solusinya, tim peneliti merekayasa genetika tikus agar tidak memiliki protein nicastrin yang dibutuhkan oleh sinyal Notch. Tikus tersebut memiliki lebih sedikit lemak di sumsum tulang, kepadatan tulang lebih tinggi, dan kemampuan memperbaiki tulang yang lebih baik—bahkan terkadang melebihi tikus muda. Namun, karena jalur Notch juga penting bagi banyak jaringan lain, memblokirnya secara total dapat menyebabkan efek samping berbahaya. Karena itu, peneliti berfokus pada protein Ebf3 yang spesifik di sel punca rangka dan berada pada jalur setelah Notch, sebagai target terapi yang lebih aman. Ebf3 dipandang sebagai kunci untuk mengembangkan terapi yang dapat memperbaiki kesehatan tulang tanpa mengganggu jaringan lain. Penelitian ini memperluas pemahaman mengenai osteoporosis dan kerapuhan tulang di usia lanjut serta menawarkan strategi baru yang menjanjikan, yaitu menargetkan Ebf3, untuk membantu menjaga kekuatan tulang seiring bertambahnya usia.

article_content: NEW DELHI: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Wednesday criticized Bihar Chief Minister Nitish Kumar for his controversial remarks about how educated women can contribute to birth control, made in the Bihar assembly the previous day. Modi also accused the opposition INDIA alliance of not objecting to Kumar's comments. Nitish Kumar has since apologized for his statements. During a public rally in Guna, Madhya Pradesh, PM Modi said, 'A prominent leader of the INDIA alliance used such inappropriate language inside the assembly yesterday that it is beyond imagination. They are not even ashamed. Not one leader of the opposition alliance has spoken against it. People who think like this about women—can they do anything good for them? Will they ever respect women?' Modi made these remarks without directly naming the Bihar Chief Minister. On Tuesday, Nitish Kumar caused controversy when he graphically explained in the assembly the role of women's education in birth control, using vivid language and gestures to describe how an educated wife could ask her husband not to complete the sexual act to avoid pregnancy. His remarks drew strong criticism from BJP leaders, who accused him of disrespecting women. Earlier today, the Bihar Chief Minister addressed the assembly and said, 'I have expressed my regret while talking to journalists outside the House. I am ready to do so again. If my words have caused any hurt, I condemn myself (main apni ninda karta hoon).' He added, 'The context in which I made the remarks must be understood. I have always strongly supported women's education, and I was struck by the connection between education levels among women and fertility rates.'

Modi juga menuduh koalisi oposisi INDIA tidak memprotes pernyataan Kumar. Nitish Kumar sejak itu telah meminta maaf atas ucapannya. Dalam sebuah rapat umum di Guna, Madhya Pradesh, PM Modi berkata, 'Seorang pemimpin terkemuka dari aliansi INDIA menggunakan bahasa yang tidak pantas di dalam majelis kemarin, yang sungguh di luar dugaan. Mereka bahkan tidak merasa malu. Tidak satu pun pemimpin dari koalisi oposisi yang berbicara menentangnya. Orang yang berpikir seperti ini tentang perempuan—apakah mereka bisa berbuat baik untuk perempuan? Apakah mereka akan menghormati perempuan?' Modi menyampaikan pernyataan ini tanpa langsung menyebut Kepala Menteri Bihar. Pada hari Selasa, Nitish Kumar memicu kontroversi setelah menjelaskan secara gamblang di majelis tentang peran pendidikan perempuan dalam pengendalian kelahiran, menggunakan bahasa dan gestur yang jelas untuk menggambarkan bagaimana seorang istri berpendidikan bisa meminta suaminya untuk tidak melanjutkan hubungan seksual demi menghindari kehamilan. Pernyataannya mendapat kecaman dari para pemimpin BJP, yang menuduhnya tidak menghormati perempuan. Hari ini, Kepala Menteri Bihar berbicara di majelis dan berkata, 'Saya telah menyampaikan penyesalan saya saat berbicara kepada wartawan di luar sidang. Saya siap melakukannya kembali. Jika kata-kata saya telah melukai siapa pun, saya mencela diri sendiri (main apni ninda karta hoon).' Ia menambahkan, 'Konteks saat saya mengeluarkan pernyataan itu harus dipahami. Saya selalu mendukung pendidikan perempuan, dan saya benar-benar melihat hubungan antara tingkat pendidikan perempuan dan angka kelahiran.'

article_content: A recent study suggests that insufficient care after surgery in NHS hospitals may lead to thousands of preventable deaths. Findings reveal nearly 4 in 100 people undergoing standard surgeries in the UK die as a result, which is twice what was previously believed. The UK’s post-surgery mortality rate is higher than in several European nations, including Finland, Estonia, and Hungary. Frequently, patients die from complications such as blood poisoning, kidney failure, heart attacks, or strokes that are not detected early enough by medical staff. One major issue identified is the shortage of intensive care unit (ICU) beds—the UK has fewer ICU beds compared to many other nations, impacting the quality of monitoring after operations and contributing to the death rate. Study co-author Andreas Hoeft, from Bonn’s University Hospital, recounted instances where patients with undetected sepsis died overnight. He acknowledged the gravity of the findings but believed there is potential for improvement. Rupert Pearse from Queen Mary University of London, who led the study, argued that a number of these deaths could have been prevented and called for reducing the mortality rate to 1 in 100. The study, published in The Lancet, analyzed data from over 46,500 patients in 28 European countries who had non-cardiac, non-brain, and non-obstetric emergency surgery and stayed in hospital at least one night. Researchers found 3.6% of UK patients died within 60 days of surgery, a rate above those reported in Finland, Norway, Estonia, Cyprus, Sweden, and Switzerland, though they stress that more research is needed for firm conclusions about NHS performance. In this survey, only 6% of patients received ICU care after their procedures—a lower figure than in many European counterparts. In 2010, comparative figures showed the UK had far fewer ICU beds per capita than Germany, the US, or France. Experts say that to curb such deaths, patients most at risk (like the elderly or those with existing health problems) must be monitored more carefully. Hoeft emphasized that adding ICU beds alone won’t solve the issue—novel and affordable monitoring solutions must be explored. The main problem is not the surgeries themselves, but rather a lack of adequate care and observation afterwards. Many hospitals don’t have enough well-trained staff to check patients’ signs—such as blood pressure and heart rate—throughout the day, which is essential for early intervention. NHS Medical Director Professor Bruce Keogh noted that although NHS excels in certain surgical fields, continual research is crucial for identifying and addressing areas that need improvement.
translated_content: Sebuah studi terbaru mengungkap bahwa kurangnya perawatan setelah operasi di rumah sakit NHS bisa menyebabkan ribuan kematian yang sebenarnya dapat dicegah. Temuan menunjukkan hampir 4 dari 100 orang yang menjalani operasi standar di Inggris meninggal dunia karenanya, jumlah ini dua kali lipat dari perkiraan sebelumnya. Angka kematian pasca operasi di Inggris lebih tinggi daripada beberapa negara Eropa lain seperti Finlandia, Estonia, dan Hungaria. Pasien sering meninggal akibat komplikasi seperti sepsis, gagal ginjal, serangan jantung, atau stroke yang tidak segera terdeteksi oleh staf medis. Masalah utama yang diidentifikasi adalah kurangnya tempat tidur di unit perawatan intensif (ICU)—Inggris memiliki lebih sedikit tempat tidur ICU dibandingkan banyak negara lain. Hal ini memengaruhi kualitas pemantauan pasien pasca operasi dan meningkatkan angka kematian. Andreas Hoeft, penulis studi dari University Hospital Bonn, menceritakan kasus di mana pasien meninggal akibat sepsis yang tidak terdeteksi pada malam hari. Ia menekankan betapa seriusnya temuan ini, meski percaya perbaikan masih mungkin dilakukan. Rupert Pearse dari Queen Mary University of London, pemimpin studi, menyatakan sejumlah kematian bisa dicegah dan menyerukan agar tingkat kematian diturunkan menjadi 1 dari 100. Studi yang dimuat di The Lancet ini menganalisis data lebih dari 46.500 pasien di 28 negara Eropa yang menjalani operasi selain jantung, otak, dan operasi darurat kehamilan—semuanya menginap di rumah sakit minimal satu malam. Peneliti menemukan 3,6% pasien di Inggris meninggal dalam 60 hari setelah operasi—angka yang lebih tinggi daripada Finlandia, Norwegia, Estonia, Siprus, Swedia, dan Swiss. Mereka tetap menegaskan perlunya studi lebih lanjut sebelum menyimpulkan kinerja NHS. Hanya 6% pasien yang menerima perawatan ICU setelah operasi, jauh di bawah banyak negara Eropa lain. Pada 2010, Inggris memiliki tempat tidur ICU jauh lebih sedikit per kapita dibandingkan Jerman, AS, atau Prancis. Para ahli menilai, untuk menurunkan kematian, pasien paling berisiko (lansia atau penderita penyakit kronis) perlu dipantau intensif. Hoeft menekankan menambah tempat tidur ICU saja tidak cukup; cara pemantauan baru yang efektif dan terjangkau sangat penting. Masalah utamanya bukan pada operasinya, melainkan kurangnya pemantauan dan perawatan setelah operasi. Banyak rumah sakit tidak punya staf terlatih cukup untuk memeriksa tanda vital pasien beberapa kali sehari, meski pemeriksaan ini krusial untuk deteksi dini. Direktur Medis NHS, Prof. Bruce Keogh, menyebut meski NHS unggul dalam beberapa bidang bedah, penelitian semacam ini sangat penting agar rumah sakit tahu persis area mana yang perlu ditingkatkan.

article_content: The Philippines is bracing for the arrival of Typhoon Megi, also known as Typhoon Juan, which is expected to begin affecting the country as early as Sunday, according to forecasters. The typhoon is anticipated to make landfall in northern Luzon by Monday, potentially reaching super-typhoon strength with wind speeds exceeding 200 kph (124 mph), said Science and Technology Secretary Mario Montejo. Authorities are most concerned about strong winds and storm surges. As of 4 p.m. Saturday, Megi was situated 820 km (510 miles) east of northern Luzon, with maximum sustained winds of 140 kph (87 mph) and even stronger gusts, as reported by the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration. Secretary Montejo expressed alarm at the typhoon’s speed and strength, warning of potentially severe damage in Luzon. After making landfall and moving through Luzon's mountainous terrain, Megi is expected to weaken before heading out over the South China Sea. Forecasters also warn that the heavy rainfall could trigger mudslides and localized flooding in mountainous areas. CNN’s Judson Jones contributed to this report.
translated_content: Filipina bersiap menghadapi kedatangan Topan Megi, yang juga dikenal sebagai Topan Juan, yang diperkirakan mulai berdampak pada negara itu sejak hari Minggu, menurut prakiraan cuaca. Topan tersebut diperkirakan akan mendarat di Luzon utara pada hari Senin, kemungkinan mencapai kekuatan super-typhoon dengan kecepatan angin lebih dari 200 kph (124 mph), menurut Menteri Sains dan Teknologi, Mario Montejo. Pihak berwenang sangat mengkhawatirkan angin kencang dan gelombang badai. Pada pukul 16.00 Sabtu, Megi berada 820 km (510 mil) sebelah timur Luzon utara, dengan kecepatan angin maksimum 140 kph (87 mph) dan hembusan lebih kuat, menurut Badan Meteorologi, Geofisika, dan Astronomi Filipina. Montejo menyatakan keprihatinan atas kecepatan dan kekuatan topan tersebut, serta memperingatkan potensi kerusakan parah di Luzon. Setelah mendarat dan melintasi pegunungan Luzon, Megi diperkirakan akan melemah sebelum melanjutkan ke Laut Cina Selatan. Para ahli cuaca juga memperingatkan curah hujan lebat dapat memicu tanah longsor dan banjir lokal di daerah pegunungan. Laporan ini turut disumbangkan oleh Judson Jones dari CNN.

article_content: Two minke whales were discovered dead on different UK beaches this week after becoming ensnared in fishing ropes. The Scarborough whale, about eight meters long, was first spotted floating off North Bay before washing up on South Bay beach in North Yorkshire. A post-mortem examination carried out by the Zoological Society of London confirmed the whale had drowned due to entanglement in lobster pot lines. The second whale, found on Thurso beach in Caithness, Scotland, measured 7.5 meters and had also died after being caught in ropes, with the Scottish Agricultural College determining it had been dead for several days before being found. Large crowds gathered in Scarborough, with some beachgoers approaching and even climbing on the beached whale, ignoring safety warnings about disease risks and rising tides. Local authorities — including Scarborough Sea Life Centre, RSPCA, and Scarborough Borough Council — coordinated the safe removal and incineration of the animal. In Scotland, Highland Council advised the public to avoid the whale's carcass before it was taken to a landfill. Wildlife specialists expressed sadness over the incidents, citing them as reminders of the rich marine life in British waters and the perils posed by fishing gear. Lindsey Crawford of Sea Life Scarborough observed that the Scarborough whale appeared otherwise healthy aside from injuries likely caused by ropes. Senior SSPCA Inspector Audrey Gunn described the Scottish whale’s case as tragic, emphasizing the threats that marine life faces from human activity.
translated_content: Dua paus minke ditemukan mati di pantai terpisah di Inggris pekan ini karena terjerat tali alat tangkap ikan. Paus di Scarborough, sekitar delapan meter panjangnya, awalnya terlihat mengapung di dekat North Bay sebelum akhirnya terdampar di South Bay, North Yorkshire. Pemeriksaan post-mortem dari Zoological Society of London memastikan paus tersebut mati tenggelam akibat terlilit tali jebakan lobster. Paus kedua ditemukan di pantai Thurso, Caithness, Skotlandia, dengan panjang 7,5 meter, dan juga tewas karena jeratan tali. Scottish Agricultural College memperkirakan paus ini telah mati beberapa hari sebelum ditemukan. Banyak orang berkumpul di Scarborough, bahkan ada yang mendekati dan memanjat bangkai paus, meski sudah diperingatkan soal risiko penyakit dan bahaya air pasang. Otoritas setempat — Scarborough Sea Life Centre, RSPCA, dan Scarborough Borough Council — bekerjasama mengevakuasi dan menginsinerasi bangkai paus tersebut. Di Skotlandia, Highland Council meminta publik menjauhi bangkai sebelum dibawa ke tempat pembuangan. Pakar satwa liar menyayangkan kejadian ini dan mengingatkan pentingnya menjaga kekayaan biota laut Inggris dari bahaya alat tangkap ikan. Lindsey Crawford dari Sea Life Scarborough mengatakan paus di Scarborough tampak sehat kecuali luka akibat tali. Inspektur Senior SSPCA Audrey Gunn menyebut kasus di Skotlandia ini tragis dan menyoroti bahaya yang dihadapi satwa laut akibat ulah manusia.

article_content: David Beckham, the legendary former England footballer and currently a UNICEF Goodwill Ambassador, is expected to make an appearance at Wednesday’s ICC World Cup semi-final between India and New Zealand. Beckham is in India on a short trip, during which UNICEF—now a global partner with the International Cricket Council for this World Cup—has coordinated various events. The much-anticipated match will take place at Mumbai’s iconic Wankhede Stadium and is likely to draw many celebrities. India secured their semi-final spot with a flawless record in the league stage, winning all nine matches. On the other hand, New Zealand earned their place after defeating Sri Lanka in their final league game. The second semi-final will be held at Eden Gardens in Kolkata on November 16, featuring Australia, who have won the title five times, against South Africa.

article_content: A team of Swiss engineers has introduced Cubli, a 15-centimeter robotic cube capable of balancing on its edges and corners, jumping upright, and moving across surfaces. Cubli operates using three reaction wheels powered by brushless DC motors, with integrated sensors, a processor, and battery. These sensors measure tilt and record the angular speed and direction of each reaction wheel. When Cubli’s wheels brake abruptly, the stored energy propels the cube upright, allowing it to balance on an edge or corner unaided. Cubli can adjust its balance in response to disturbances, spin in place, and, by combining jumps and controlled falls, ‘walk’ across surfaces. Though still a prototype, Cubli’s dynamic motion could inspire future planetary explorers and robots capable of assembling themselves. The Swiss Federal Institute of Technology in Zurich designed it to showcase advanced balancing and locomotion. Robotic missions beyond Earth face significant lag in communication. NASA’s Mars Curiosity, for instance, experiences a one-way delay of roughly 20 minutes between Earth and Mars, while the delay to Jupiter’s moon Europa exceeds 90 minutes. To overcome such delays, researchers have created TextureCam, an intelligent camera system that analyzes terrain and makes autonomous choices. Using two lenses and a dedicated processor, TextureCam distinguishes features like sand, rock, and sky, and evaluates rocks for scientific interest. When it finds an intriguing object, the system can either transmit a detailed image to Earth or instruct the rover to move closer. This adaptive technology operates similarly to smartphone facial recognition by improving with more examples. TextureCam was recently field tested in California’s Mojave Desert, a landscape chosen for its similarity to Mars. Granting robotic explorers such autonomy could greatly enhance future space missions despite communication constraints.

Cubli bekerja dengan tiga roda reaksi bertenaga motor DC brushless, lengkap dengan sensor, prosesor, dan baterai. Sensor ini mengukur kemiringan serta kecepatan dan arah putaran roda reaksi. Cubli mampu menyesuaikan keseimbangannya bila terganggu, berputar di tempat, dan melalui kombinasi lompatan dan jatuh terkontrol, ia dapat 'berjalan' di permukaan. Walau masih berupa prototipe, pergerakan dinamis Cubli dapat menginspirasi robot penjelajah planet dan mesin yang dapat merakit diri di masa depan. Swiss Federal Institute of Technology di Zurich merancang Cubli untuk mendemonstrasikan kemampuan canggih dalam menyeimbangkan dan bergerak. Misi robotik di luar angkasa kerap terkendala jeda komunikasi. Dengan dua lensa dan prosesor khusus, TextureCam mampu membedakan pasir, batu, dan langit serta menilai apakah sebuah batu punya nilai ilmiah. Jika menemukan objek menarik, sistem ini dapat mengirim gambar resolusi tinggi ke Bumi atau meminta rover mendekat. Teknologi adaptif ini mirip dengan fitur pengenalan wajah pada smartphone yang makin akurat semakin sering dilatih. Baru-baru ini TextureCam diuji di Gurun Mojave, California—lingkungan yang mirip dengan permukaan Mars. Pemberian otonomi semacam ini pada robot penjelajah bisa sangat membantu kelancaran misi luar angkasa di masa depan meskipun ada batasan komunikasi.

article_content: Chris Cornell, known for leading Soundgarden and Audioslave, has taken to Twitter as a way to engage directly with fans. Far from causing drama, Cornell appreciates answering long-standing questions and having genuine, concise interactions online. With more than 200,000 followers, Cornell posts glimpses into his life, whether it’s thanking enthusiastic crowds or sending affectionate tweets to his wife, Vicky. His newest solo project, 'Scream,' is a bold collaboration with famed producer Timbaland, blending his rock roots with dance rhythms. The unexpected combination has drawn mixed reviews—Trent Reznor of Nine Inch Nails even criticized the album on Twitter. While 'Scream' debuted at number 10 on the Billboard 200, it dropped significantly in the following week. Cornell anticipated the polarized response, acknowledging that critics doubted the partnership from the start simply because it was unconventional. Cornell found working with Timbaland both exciting and challenging; he had to leave behind his usual approach to adapt his gritty vocals to more structured, studio-driven beats. He stands by the album, claiming to listen to it more than his previous works. Addressing the idea of a fixed musical identity, Cornell insists he doesn’t want to be limited by labels and is eager to keep innovating in future albums. The collaboration with Timbaland, he says, let both artists contribute their strengths and resulted in music that defies categorization. Cornell tweets frequently on the road, often multitasking while doing vocal exercises or even watching CNN. He notes that insomnia is common in his profession, especially after late performances, and that the rockstar lifestyle is less about constant partying and more about travel, waiting, and hard work. Cornell recalls once throwing a small amplifier out a window as a playful way to imitate classic rockstar antics, having to quickly retrieve a sticker with his name from the scene afterward.

article_content: On Saturday, large groups of people assembled in Tehran to commemorate the anniversary of the 1979 seizure of the U.S. Embassy. The demonstration, organized with government support, featured strong criticism of America's backing for Israel amid ongoing military actions in Gaza. This event occurred as the Israel-Hamas conflict entered its fourth week, following Hamas's October 7 attack on Israel, which led to around 1,400 Israeli deaths and more than 240 hostages. In response, Israeli operations in Gaza have resulted in over 9,000 deaths. Protesters gathered near the site of the former U.S. Embassy, burning American and Israeli flags, and displaying banners with slogans such as 'Great Satan.' Images of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and U.S. President Joe Biden were trampled by participants. The main stage bore the sign: 'We trample America under our feet.' Iranian parliamentary speaker Mohammad Bagher Qalibaf addressed the crowd, blaming the U.S. for violence in Gaza and stating that Israel had experienced significant intelligence and security setbacks from the Hamas attack. In a written statement, rally participants demanded an immediate cease-fire in Gaza and warned the U.S., Britain, and France about the risk of the conflict spreading. The statement pledged continued Iranian support for the Palestinian cause until what they called its 'final victory.' The march began at Palestine Square in central Tehran and proceeded about two kilometers to the old U.S. Embassy compound. State TV aired similar demonstrations from other cities. The annual event is well known for attracting crowds who express anti-Western attitudes. Earlier in the week, Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei criticized the U.S. for its support of Israel, said Israel would be crippled without American assistance, and called for Muslim-majority countries to suspend economic ties with Israel. Iran continues to back militant groups opposed to Israel, including Hamas, Islamic Jihad, and Hezbollah. The U.S. State Department, commemorating the 44th anniversary of the embassy takeover, thanked diplomats working in dangerous posts. Spokesperson Matthew Miller condemned Iran's detention of foreign citizens and ongoing support of groups such as Hamas that practice hostage-taking.

article_content: The Election Commission (EC) has requested Congress leader Rahul Gandhi to clarify his recent comments about Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Gandhi used the Hindi word 'panauti' (suggesting 'bad luck') and compared Modi to a 'pickpocket.' He must respond to the notice by Saturday night. This action comes after the ruling Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) complained to the EC, criticizing such language as unfit for a national leader. The BJP's statement called for tough action against both Gandhi and Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge, alleging they habitually violate ethical and electoral guidelines. The EC reminded Gandhi that making baseless allegations against political rivals breaches the Model Code of Conduct. Gandhi's remarks were made during campaign rallies in Rajasthan and Madhya Pradesh, both set for upcoming elections. Responding to Gandhi, Home Minister Amit Shah claimed the remarks insult the Prime Minister and predicted that voters would react during the polls. The BJP also referred to Gandhi's 'pickpocket' comment from a recent Madhya Pradesh speech, where Gandhi suggested Modi distracts the public while industrialist Gautam Adani profits. The BJP described these statements as unsubstantiated and disrespectful, urging the EC to take legal action and possibly issue restraining orders against Gandhi and Kharge. Separately, the article reported on a high demand for recent IPOs, plans for new services by IndiGo airline, and data showing large numbers of insolvency cases withdrawn since the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code took effect.
