Ia diminta memberikan tanggapan terhadap surat peringatan ini paling lambat Sabtu malam. Langkah ini diambil setelah Partai Bharatiya Janata (BJP) yang berkuasa mengadukan hal ini ke KPU, menilai penggunaan bahasa tersebut tidak pantas bagi seorang pemimpin nasional. Dalam pernyataannya, BJP mendesak adanya tindakan tegas terhadap Gandhi dan Presiden Kongres Mallikarjun Kharge, dengan tuduhan mereka sering melanggar etika dan aturan pemilu. KPU mengingatkan Gandhi bahwa membuat tuduhan tanpa dasar terhadap lawan politik melanggar Kode Etik Pemilu. Komentar Gandhi disampaikan saat kampanye di Rajasthan dan Madhya Pradesh, yang keduanya akan segera menggelar pemilu. Menanggapi Gandhi, Menteri Dalam Negeri Amit Shah mengatakan bahwa ucapan tersebut menghina Perdana Menteri dan memperkirakan pemilih akan merespons saat pemilu. BJP juga mengangkat komentar 'pencopet' Gandhi dalam pidato terbarunya di Madhya Pradesh, di mana ia menuduh Modi mengalihkan perhatian publik sementara pengusaha Gautam Adani mengambil keuntungan. BJP menyebut pernyataan ini tidak berdasar dan tidak sopan, serta meminta KPU mengambil tindakan hukum dan mempertimbangkan larangan terhadap Gandhi dan Kharge. article_content: Last month, photos of a naked Prince Harry taken during his stay in Las Vegas were leaked online, drawing attention to the role of royal protection officers. Metropolitan Police Commissioner Bernard Hogan-Howe addressed concerns in front of British MPs, stating that officers are not allowed to interfere with the private lives of the royals, highlighting the importance of maintaining a balance between security and privacy. During his visit to Las Vegas, Prince Harry was pictured relaxing in a hotel jacuzzi with his close friend Tom 'Skippy' Inskip and a longtime protection officer, just days before the controversial photos emerged on the internet. This raised questions about whether the officers, whose expenses are covered by taxpayers, were too familiar with those they are meant to protect. Commissioner Hogan-Howe clarified that, although the photos sparked criticism, security officers must not breach the 'golden line' by becoming involved in the personal affairs of those they protect. He emphasized that what appeared improper in the photos did not accurately reflect the situation that occurred. Following the incident, two of Prince Harry's most senior protection officers were interviewed in London about the events in Las Vegas, but officials maintained there was no security lapse and that the officers were not responsible for preserving the prince's reputation. The naked photos, which showed Prince Harry in compromising poses, were first published by US celebrity website TMZ. In the UK, only The Sun newspaper printed the images, defying a request from St James’s Palace and the Press Complaints Commission. Later, the commission announced it would not investigate, as no official complaint had been made by Prince Harry’s representatives. After the controversy, Prince Harry resumed his public duties, attending the London Paralympic Games and later deploying to Afghanistan for a four-month tour as an Apache attack helicopter co-pilot.

article_content: A businessman was shot and killed, and his son was injured, following a dispute over a failed business deal in Auldhouse, Lanarkshire. Peter Thompson, 59, died in the early morning shooting at Meadowhead Farm, which also functions as a horse-riding centre. His son, John Thompson, 36, suffered shotgun wounds to his leg but managed to seek help at a nearby pub. Shortly after, the suspected shooter, Robert McCormick, 53, was found dead in a car near Meadowhead Farm. Police believe he died by suicide. Sources indicate the incident was related to a business disagreement and reported unpaid debts between Peter Thompson and Robert McCormick. Police Scotland confirmed the shooting was a targeted incident and are not looking for additional suspects. Peter and John Thompson had faced bankruptcy in the past, and Peter Thompson had been involved in previous disputes, including one regarding illegal dumping. Local residents expressed shock at the incident, with some noting Thompson's past conflicts in the community. Peter Thompson operated Meadowhead Farm with his wife Caron. John Thompson ran a paintball business on the premises. The injured John Thompson alerted authorities from a pub on Langlands Road after escaping the scene. It is unconfirmed whether other family members were present at the time. All activities at Meadowhead Farm have been suspended pending further notice. Police and emergency services responded quickly, and the area was secured. Robert McCormick, described by neighbors as reclusive and in business with Thompson, held a firearms license. Superintendent Elaine Ferguson assured the public that there is no ongoing threat. Past legal and financial troubles for the Thompsons were noted, including fines for illegal dumping and ongoing court cases. The police investigation is ongoing, and authorities request the public to remain calm.

Putranya, John Thompson, 36 tahun, mengalami luka tembak di kaki namun berhasil mencari bantuan ke pub terdekat. Tidak lama kemudian, tersangka pelaku, Robert McCormick, 53 tahun, ditemukan tewas di dalam mobil di dekat Meadowhead Farm. Polisi meyakini ia meninggal karena bunuh diri. Sumber menyatakan insiden ini terkait perselisihan bisnis dan utang yang belum dibayar antara Peter Thompson dan Robert McCormick. Police Scotland memastikan penembakan ini adalah insiden terarah dan tidak sedang mencari tersangka lain. Peter dan John Thompson pernah mengalami kebangkrutan sebelumnya, dan Peter Thompson pernah terlibat perselisihan lain, termasuk tentang pembuangan limbah ilegal. Warga setempat menyatakan terkejut atas kejadian ini, beberapa menyebut Thompson pernah berkonflik dengan komunitas. Peter Thompson mengelola Meadowhead Farm bersama istrinya, Caron. John Thompson mengelola usaha paintball di lokasi yang sama. John Thompson yang terluka melapor ke pihak berwajib dari sebuah pub di Langlands Road usai melarikan diri. Polisi dan layanan darurat merespons cepat dan area sudah diamankan. Robert McCormick, digambarkan oleh tetangga sebagai sosok tertutup dan rekan bisnis Thompson, memiliki izin senjata api. Superintendent Elaine Ferguson memastikan publik bahwa tidak ada ancaman lebih lanjut. Catatan masalah hukum dan keuangan keluarga Thompson, termasuk denda atas pembuangan limbah ilegal dan kasus pengadilan yang sedang berlangsung. Penyelidikan polisi masih berlanjut dan pihak berwenang meminta masyarakat tetap tenang.

article_content: At a rally in Shahpura, Jaipur district, Congress leader Priyanka Gandhi Vadra criticized Prime Minister Narendra Modi for attending a cricket match in Ahmedabad instead of visiting Manipur, which has faced ethnic violence for nearly seven months. She claimed that Modi attended the Cricket World Cup final between India and Australia, possibly to claim credit if India won, but avoided visiting Manipur amid the crisis. Priyanka Gandhi further questioned how the BJP has become the richest political party under Modi's leadership while he claims to live simply as a fakir. She also alleged that Modi and the central government have waived debts for large industrialists but neglected the poor. She asserted that mixing religion and politics is wrong. She accused BJP-led governments of working in favor of big industrialists and emphasized that the Congress government in Rajasthan provided relief from inflation through special camps. Priyanka Gandhi was campaigning for Congress candidates Manish Yadav and Indraj Gurjar ahead of the Rajasthan Assembly elections, scheduled for November 25, with vote counting on December 3.

Ia mengklaim bahwa Modi menghadiri final Piala Dunia Kriket antara India dan Australia, mungkin untuk mendapat kredit jika India menang, namun menghindari kunjungan ke Manipur saat terjadi krisis. Priyanka Gandhi juga mempertanyakan bagaimana BJP bisa menjadi partai politik terkaya di bawah kepemimpinan Modi, sementara dia mengaku hidup sederhana sebagai fakir. Ia juga menuduh Modi dan pemerintah pusat menghapus utang konglomerat besar tetapi mengabaikan orang miskin. Ia menegaskan bahwa mencampurkan agama dan politik adalah hal yang salah. Ia menuduh pemerintah yang dipimpin BJP bekerja untuk kepentingan konglomerat besar dan menekankan bahwa pemerintahan Kongres di Rajasthan telah memberikan bantuan terhadap inflasi melalui kamp khusus. Priyanka Gandhi berkampanye untuk kandidat Kongres, Manish Yadav dan Indraj Gurjar, menjelang pemilu Majelis Legislatif Rajasthan pada 25 November, dengan penghitungan suara pada 3 Desember.

article_content: Just one week into the new Premier League season, Manchester United's manager Louis van Gaal is already urging patience as he begins a challenging rebuilding phase. Van Gaal emphasized during a press conference that transforming the team is a gradual process and asked supporters to give him time, noting that the first three months would be particularly tough for both players and fans. He explained that the club hired him for his coaching philosophy and that such transitions can’t yield instant results — drawing from his previous experiences at Barcelona and Bayern Munich, where adjustments also required several months. Van Gaal said he’s expressed these expectations to key figures at United, including executive vice-chairman Ed Woodward and the Glazer family owners. Manchester United’s 2-1 defeat at home against Swansea highlighted the difficulties facing the squad, which is already struggling with injuries and a lack of depth. Meanwhile, rivals Chelsea and Manchester City have started stronger, both picking up away wins. The uneasiness among United supporters has been amplified by public comments from ex-player Paul Scholes, who voiced concerns over the club’s future direction. Van Gaal responded by urging both fans and club legends to trust in his long-term vision, although he admitted the team’s shaky start could worry many. New recruit Marcos Rojo, a £16m signing from Sporting Lisbon, appeared at Friday’s media conference but has not yet been cleared to play due to pending work permit paperwork. Another subplot involves England striker Danny Welbeck. While rumors swirl about his potential departure during the transfer window, Van Gaal neither confirmed nor denied decisions about Welbeck’s future, suggesting any conversations between them remain private. The situation evokes comparisons to last season’s short tenure of David Moyes, who was sacked before completing a year of his contract, underlining the high expectations and unforgiving culture at Old Trafford.
translated_content: Baru satu minggu memasuki musim baru Liga Premier, manajer Manchester United Louis van Gaal sudah meminta penggemar bersabar saat ia memulai fase pembangunan kembali yang menantang. Van Gaal menegaskan dalam konferensi pers bahwa membangun ulang tim adalah proses bertahap, dan ia meminta waktu lebih dari para pendukung, dengan mengingatkan bahwa tiga bulan pertama akan sangat sulit bagi para pemain dan fans. Ia menjelaskan bahwa klub menunjuk dirinya karena filosofi kepelatihannya dan transisi seperti ini tidak bisa memberikan hasil instan—merujuk pada pengalamannya di Barcelona dan Bayern Munich, di mana adaptasi juga memakan waktu beberapa bulan. Van Gaal mengatakan telah menyampaikan ekspektasi ini kepada tokoh-tokoh penting di United, termasuk wakil ketua eksekutif Ed Woodward dan keluarga Glazer yang merupakan pemilik klub. Kekalahan 2-1 United dari Swansea di kandang sendiri menyoroti tantangan dalam skuad yang sudah kesulitan akibat cedera dan kurangnya kedalaman pemain. Di sisi lain, rival Chelsea dan Manchester City mengawali musim dengan lebih baik, keduanya memenangkan pertandingan tandang. Kekhawatiran di antara pendukung United semakin memuncak setelah komentar mantan pemain Paul Scholes yang mengungkapkan keraguan tentang masa depan klub. Van Gaal menanggapi dengan meminta fans serta legenda klub untuk mempercayai visi jangka panjangnya, meski ia mengakui bahwa awal musim yang buruk bisa membuat banyak orang khawatir. Rekrutan baru Marcos Rojo, yang didatangkan seharga £16 juta dari Sporting Lisbon, hadir dalam konferensi pers hari Jumat namun belum bisa bermain karena proses izin kerja yang masih belum rampung. Kisah lain menyangkut penyerang Inggris Danny Welbeck. Meski isu kepergiannya selama bursa transfer terus berhembus, Van Gaal tidak menegaskan ataupun membantah kabar terkait masa depan Welbeck, menyiratkan bahwa apapun pembicaraan antara keduanya tetap bersifat pribadi. Situasi ini mengingatkan pada masa singkat David Moyes musim lalu yang dipecat sebelum genap satu tahun kontrak, menyoroti ekspektasi tinggi dan budaya yang tidak kenal kompromi di Old Trafford.

article_content: Russian President Vladimir Putin criticized comments made by Prince Charles comparing him to Adolf Hitler, describing them as 'unacceptable' and 'wrong.' Putin added that such remarks are 'not what monarchs do.' Putin's response followed reports that Prince Charles made the comparison during a private conversation with a Jewish refugee while on an official visit to Canada. The Kremlin responded angrily, with Putin's spokesperson accusing Prince Charles of 'historical ignorance.' The state-funded TV channel Russia Today aired a program highlighting alleged links between the Royal Family and Nazis. During a visit to Saint Petersburg, Putin discussed the comments with leading news agencies. He referenced the proverb, 'You are angry. That means you are wrong,' and noted, 'If he made such a comparison, it is unacceptable and I am sure he understands this as a man of manners.' The remark drew particular anger in Russia due to Russia's pride in its contribution to the defeat of Nazism during World War II. About 26 million Soviet citizens died in that conflict, including nearly eight million military personnel. While Putin did not directly invoke Russia's wartime losses in response to Charles's comment, he referenced them during discussions about the upcoming 70th anniversary of the D-Day landings in Normandy, an event both leaders are expected to attend. Russian media emphasized past connections between members of the British Royal Family and Nazi leaders, including Edward VIII's meeting with Hitler and a photo of Prince Harry in a Nazi uniform at a costume party. During a televised interview at the Constantine Palace in Strelna, held after an international economic forum, Putin took a conciliatory tone regarding Ukraine, saying he would respect the outcome of the upcoming presidential election. However, he reiterated his view that Viktor Yanukovych, ousted after protests, is still the legitimate Ukrainian president under the country's constitution, and described the regime change as an 'anti-constitutional coup.' When asked if the Ukraine crisis was leading to a new Cold War, Putin responded that he does not believe so, stating that 'no one is interested in that and I think it will not happen.'

Tanggapan Putin muncul setelah laporan bahwa Pangeran Charles membuat perbandingan tersebut dalam percakapan pribadi dengan seorang pengungsi Yahudi saat kunjungan resmi ke Kanada. Kremlin menanggapi dengan marah, dengan juru bicara Putin menuduh Pangeran Charles 'tidak memahami sejarah.' Saluran TV milik pemerintah, Russia Today, menayangkan program yang menyoroti dugaan hubungan Keluarga Kerajaan Inggris dengan Nazi. Selama kunjungan ke Saint Petersburg, Putin membahas komentar tersebut dengan sejumlah kantor berita utama. Ia mengutip pepatah, 'Kamu marah, berarti kamu salah,' dan mengatakan, 'Jika dia membuat perbandingan seperti itu, itu tidak dapat diterima dan saya yakin dia memahaminya sebagai orang yang beradab.' Komentar ini menimbulkan kemarahan khusus di Rusia karena kebanggaan negara tersebut atas perannya dalam mengalahkan Nazisme selama Perang Dunia II. Sekitar 26 juta warga Soviet tewas dalam konflik itu, termasuk hampir delapan juta personel militer. Meskipun Putin tidak secara langsung menyinggung pengorbanan Rusia dalam menanggapi komentar Charles, ia menyebutnya saat membahas peringatan 70 tahun pendaratan D-Day di Normandy, sebuah acara yang akan dihadiri kedua pemimpin. Media Rusia menyoroti hubungan masa lalu anggota Keluarga Kerajaan Inggris dengan pemimpin Nazi, termasuk pertemuan Edward VIII dengan Hitler dan foto Pangeran Harry mengenakan seragam Nazi di sebuah pesta kostum. Dalam wawancara televisi di Istana Constantine di Strelna, setelah forum ekonomi internasional, Putin bersikap lebih berdamai terkait Ukraina, menyatakan akan menghormati hasil pemilihan presiden yang akan datang. Namun, ia kembali menegaskan pandangannya bahwa Viktor Yanukovych, yang digulingkan setelah aksi protes, masih merupakan presiden Ukraina yang sah menurut konstitusi negara itu, dan menggambarkan perubahan rezim sebagai 'kudeta anti-konstitusi.' Ketika ditanya apakah krisis Ukraina dapat memicu Perang Dingin baru, Putin menjawab bahwa ia tidak percaya demikian, menyatakan bahwa 'tidak ada yang menginginkan itu dan saya rasa itu tidak akan terjadi.'

A common issue with electric scooters is their heavy weight, which often makes them challenging to fold and carry after use. Many scooters weigh over 35 pounds, and lighter models historically have faced stability problems. NIU Technologies addressed this with its KQi Air, a new lightweight carbon fiber scooter weighing just 26.2 pounds. Constructed from 70% carbon fiber and 30% magnesium, the KQi Air offers a strong yet light frame.

According to the brand, which also produces well-regarded e-bikes, the scooter provides an excellent power-to-weight ratio suited for city commuting. Key features include a 20-mph top speed, a 31-mile range, and a maximum power output of 700 watts. The KQi Air can handle hills with a 20% incline and features large 9.5-inch tubeless tires for improved ride quality.

The scooter is equipped with a lithium-ion battery that charges fully in five hours, a left handlebar brake lever connected to dual-action die-cast aluminum alloy calipers for smooth and safe braking, cruise control, a headlight, dedicated turn signal buttons, and five customizable riding modes: sport, dynamic, e-save, cruise, and pedestrian.

The deck is somewhat smaller than average, but the reduced weight is immediately noticeable when lifting the scooter. Assembly is quick and easy, requiring only six screws (with included tools). The bright display shows speed in miles per hour by default, but can be customized via a companion app, which is not necessary for operation.

During testing, acceleration was smooth, and the scooter climbed steep hills easily. However, the lower weight contributed to a slightly wobbly feel at higher speeds—previously noted as a common issue with lightweight models. Braking felt sensitive at first but improved with familiarity.

Overall, the KQi Air lives up to its promise of lightweight city mobility, combining speed, convenience, and a robust feature set. While it will eventually retail at $1,400, it is currently available for $949.

Masalah utama skuter listrik adalah bobotnya yang berat, sehingga susah dilipat dan dibawa setelah dipakai. Sebagian besar skuter beratnya lebih dari 16 kg, sementara model yang lebih ringan sering kurang stabil. NIU Technologies menjawab hal ini dengan KQi Air, skuter baru berbahan karbon fiber yang hanya berbobot 11,9 kg. Rangkanya terdiri dari 70% serat karbon dan 30% magnesium, membuatnya kokoh namun tetap ringan.

Menurut perusahaan yang juga dikenal dengan e-bike berkualitas, skuter ini menawarkan rasio tenaga dan bobot yang tepat untuk aktivitas harian di kota. Fitur utamanya termasuk kecepatan maksimum 32 km/jam, jarak tempuh 50 km, kapasitas daya maksimum 700 watt, dan ban tubeless besar 9,5 inci untuk kenyamanan berkendara.

KQi Air memakai baterai lithium-ion yang bisa diisi penuh selama lima jam, tuas rem di stang kiri yang terhubung ke kaliper rem aluminium ganda untuk pengereman halus dan aman, cruise control, lampu depan, tombol lampu sein, serta lima mode berkendara: sport, dinamis, e-save, cruise, dan pedestrian.

Deknya memang agak kecil, namun bobotnya yang ringan sangat terasa saat diangkat. Perakitannya juga mudah, hanya butuh enam baut lengkap dengan alatnya. Layar tampilan terlihat cerah dan berisi kecepatan dalam mil per jam sebagai setelan standar, tapi bisa diubah melalui aplikasi, walau aplikasi ini tidak wajib.

Saat diuji, akselerasi terasa halus dan KQi Air mampu menaklukkan tanjakan dengan mudah. Namun, bobot ringan membuatnya agak goyah di kecepatan tinggi, seperti keluhan umum model ringan lainnya. Rem terasa sensitif di awal, tapi makin halus seiring penggunaan.

Secara keseluruhan, KQi Air memenuhi janji mobilitas ringan di perkotaan, memadukan kecepatan, kemudahan, dan fitur lengkap. Harga normalnya sekitar Rp22,7 juta, tapi saat ini dijual seharga Rp15,4 juta.

article_content: The contest for the Kamareddy assembly seat in Telangana is heating up as the state prepares for its upcoming elections. This year, three main contenders will battle it out here: Telangana Chief Minister K Chandrashekar Rao (KCR), representing the Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS); Revanth Reddy, the Congress state president; and K Venkata Ramana Reddy from the BJP. KCR's decision to run from Kamareddy, leveraging both his role as Chief Minister and his local upbringing in Konapur village, is seen as strengthening BRS's position. After BRS dropped five-time MLA Gampa Govardhan from the ticket, the seat gained increased significance, especially since the former Congress minister, Mohammad Ali Shabbir, was shifted to contest in Nizamabad Urban. While the BRS is buoyed by KCR's local ties and the party's strong organizational presence, the Congress faces challenges since its candidate, Revanth Reddy, is viewed by many locals as an outsider. Some Congress supporters feel the party could have been more competitive with a local candidate. Meanwhile, BJP's Ramana Reddy is positioning himself as the accessible local choice, promising initiatives such as free healthcare, education, and a farmers' center if elected. He appeals to voters by stressing the benefits of having a representative from their own area. Key issues influencing Kamareddy voters include an ongoing shortage of irrigation, farmers' concerns over potential land losses due to urban development plans—which were recently paused following protests—and a declining jaggery industry that many hope will be revived. The outcome is particularly significant, as over 240,000 voters from six mandals will cast their ballots. Many residents hope that a victory for KCR will accelerate much-needed development projects in this strategically located constituency, which borders several key Telangana districts and Maharashtra.
translated_content: Persaingan untuk kursi Majelis Kamareddy di Telangana makin sengit jelang pemilu mendatang. Tahun ini, tiga kandidat utama akan bersaing: Ketua Menteri Telangana K Chandrashekar Rao (KCR) dari Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS), Revanth Reddy dari Kongres, dan K Venkata Ramana Reddy dari BJP. Keputusan KCR maju dari Kamareddy, memanfaatkan statusnya sebagai Ketua Menteri sekaligus putra daerah dari desa Konapur, dinilai memperkuat posisi BRS. Setelah BRS tidak lagi mencalonkan Gampa Govardhan, anggota legislatif lima periode, kursi ini jadi tambah penting, apalagi setelah Mohammad Ali Shabbir dari Kongres dialihkan ke Nizamabad Urban. Meski BRS diuntungkan kedekatan KCR dengan daerah dan kekuatan organisasi partai, Kongres menghadapi tantangan besar karena Revanth Reddy dianggap sebagai orang luar oleh sebagian warga. Sebagian pendukung Kongres merasa partai akan lebih berpeluang jika mengusung kader lokal. Sementara itu, Ramana Reddy dari BJP menonjolkan diri sebagai pilihan lokal yang mudah diakses, dengan janji layanan kesehatan dan pendidikan gratis serta pendirian pusat layanan petani jika terpilih. Ia mengajak warga memilih calon yang benar-benar berasal dari daerah mereka. Isu utama bagi warga Kamareddy antara lain kekurangan irigasi yang berlarut-larut, keresahan petani soal kemungkinan kehilangan lahan karena rencana pengembangan kota (yang kini ditunda pasca-protes), serta menurunnya industri gula merah yang banyak diharapkan bisa bangkit lagi. Possession of nitrous oxide (NOS) is now a criminal offence in the UK. The substance, widely known as laughing gas, has been reclassified as a class C drug, with individuals facing up to two years in prison for possessing it for its psychoactive effects. The government states that the ban will reduce anti-social behaviour and protect public health.

However, experts have previously warned that such a ban may be disproportionate relative to the actual harm caused by nitrous oxide. Medically, nitrous oxide is regularly used as a painkiller in procedures such as dentistry and childbirth, where it is often called 'gas and air.' At the same time, it remains one of the most commonly used recreational drugs among people aged 16 to 24, causing brief euphoria but also posing risks of neurological damage.

Under the new rules, those found in unlawful possession may face a prison sentence or unlimited fine, while those caught supplying or producing the drug could receive up to 14 years in prison. Earlier this year, the Advisory Council on the Misuse of Drugs reassessed nitrous oxide risks and did not recommend a ban, warning of possible unintended consequences, including users being less likely to seek medical help. Despite this, the government pressed forward, citing the need to address broader issues such as public misuse and increasing instances of discarded canisters.

Several deaths have been linked to drug-driving incidents, and cities like Birmingham report among the highest hospital admissions due to nitrous oxide misuse. A BBC Three documentary found that users have shifted from small personal canisters to larger catering-sized ones. Brands like Smartwhip, designed for culinary use, are reportedly being sold illicitly to addicts in some shops. Some users, mostly young men, have been seen inflating balloons with NOS while in moving vehicles to avoid detection.

Community worker Naveed Sadiq, who regularly picks up hundreds of Smartwhip canisters, says the issue is particularly pronounced in his community, noting that NOS is 'untraceable' and unrecognized compared to drugs like cannabis or alcohol. Ali, who used NOS heavily for a year, describes severe impacts on his health and independence, warning that the brief euphoric effects are not worth the long-term consequences.

According to the drugs information website Frank, nitrous oxide can be highly addictive. Another habitual user, Halima (name changed), told of her dependency on the substance and the negative impact on her daily life.

Medical experts like Dr. David Nicholl report patients experiencing neurological symptoms such as tingling or difficulty walking after heavy use. Scientific studies suggest frequent use can cause vitamin B12 deficiency, leading to nerve damage as the protective insulation around the spinal cord is eroded.

Announcing the ban, Crime and Policing Minister Chris Philp stated that nitrous oxide abuse poses serious health risks and sent a clear signal that users and dealers will face significant legal consequences. The BBC Three documentary 'Drugs Map of Britain' explores the impact of nitrous oxide in communities like Birmingham through users, shopkeepers, and activists. For further information, viewers are encouraged to visit BBC iPlayer or sign up for BBC News updates.

Pemerintah menyatakan bahwa pelarangan ini bertujuan mengurangi perilaku anti-sosial dan melindungi kesehatan masyarakat.

Meski begitu, para ahli sebelumnya telah memperingatkan bahwa pelarangan ini mungkin berlebihan dibandingkan dengan tingkat bahaya nyata nitrous oxide. Secara medis, nitrous oxide sering digunakan sebagai pereda nyeri dalam prosedur seperti kedokteran gigi dan persalinan, di mana disebut juga 'gas and air.' Namun, gas ini juga menjadi salah satu narkotika rekreasional yang paling sering digunakan oleh kelompok usia 16 sampai 24 tahun, menghasilkan euforia singkat sekaligus berisiko menyebabkan kerusakan saraf.

Dalam aturan baru, mereka yang ditemukan memiliki nitrous oxide secara ilegal dapat dikenai hukuman penjara atau denda tak terbatas, sedangkan yang menyuplai atau memproduksi bisa dihukum hingga 14 tahun penjara. Awal tahun ini, Dewan Penasihat Penyalagunaan Narkoba menilai ulang risiko nitrous oxide dan tidak merekomendasikan pelarangan, dengan peringatan bahwa pelarangan bisa berdampak negatif seperti membuat pengguna enggan mencari bantuan medis. Namun, pemerintah tetap memutuskan pelarangan, dengan alasan perlunya menangani masalah masyarakat secara lebih luas, termasuk penggunaan di tempat umum dan bertambahnya sampah tabung bekas.

Beberapa kematian telah dikaitkan dengan kecelakaan lalu lintas akibat narkoba, dan kota seperti Birmingham mencatat tingkat rawat inap rumah sakit tertinggi akibat penyalahgunaan nitrous oxide. Dokumenter BBC Three melaporkan bahwa pengguna kini beralih dari tabung kecil ke tabung katering yang lebih besar. Merek seperti Smartwhip, awalnya diperuntukkan dunia kuliner, kini dijual secara ilegal. Sejumlah anak muda laki-laki terlihat mengisi balon dengan NOS di mobil yang sedang berjalan agar tidak ketahuan.

Pekerja komunitas Naveed Sadiq yang kerap mengumpulkan ratusan tabung Smartwhip menyebut masalah ini sangat menonjol di lingkungannya, karena NOS tidak mudah terdeteksi dan kurang dikenal dibandingkan ganja atau alkohol. Ali, yang pernah menggunakan NOS secara berat selama setahun, menceritakan dampak buruk pada kesehatan dan kemandiriannya serta menegaskan bahwa sensasi sesaat tidak sebanding risiko jangka panjang.

Menurut situs Frank, nitrous oxide sangat adiktif. Pengguna rutin lainnya, Halima (nama samaran), mengaku sangat ketagihan sampai sulit lepas dari zat tersebut.

Dokter seperti Dr. David Nicholl menemukan pasien yang mengalami gejala saraf seperti kesemutan atau sulit berjalan setelah penggunaan berulang. Riset ilmiah membuktikan pemakaian intensif dapat menyebabkan kekurangan vitamin B12, merusak saraf dan lapisan pelindung sumsum tulang belakang.

Menteri Kriminalitas dan Kepolisian Chris Philp menyatakan bahwa penyalahgunaan nitrous oxide berbahaya bagi kesehatan dan menegaskan pengguna serta pengedar akan menghadapi sanksi hukum. Dokumenter BBC Three 'Drugs Map of Britain' membahas dampak nitrous oxide di Birmingham melalui kisah pengguna, toko, dan aktivis. Info lebih lanjut dapat ditemukan di BBC iPlayer atau dengan berlangganan newsletter BBC News.

During a break from his role at Real Sociedad, David Moyes attended Ewood Park where Middlesbrough, under Spanish manager Aitor Karanka, continued their impressive form. After just one defeat in 11 games, Middlesbrough sat third in the Championship, but were unable to move up to an automatic promotion spot as the match ended goalless.

Blackburn’s backup goalkeeper Simon Eastwood was the standout player, making several exceptional saves and earning man-of-the-match honors, while Middlesbrough struck the woodwork three times. Despite creating many opportunities and dominating possession, Middlesbrough couldn’t break through, and Blackburn almost stole victory late on when Rudy Gestede’s header was cleared off the line by Grant Leadbitter.

Aitor Karanka, who previously worked on Jose Mourinho’s staff at Real Madrid, expressed his disappointment that Boro could not convert their chances, but praised his team’s spirit. He noted that facing Blackburn often means dealing with inspired goalkeeping.

Blackburn manager Gary Bowyer complimented his youthful squad for their resilience, especially considering the team’s injury issues. He also had high praise for Eastwood’s performance, joking that Karanka “offered £200 million” for the goalkeeper after the match.

Middlesbrough’s fans provided strong support, seeing their side control much of the first half only to be denied by Eastwood, who played due to Jason Steele (on loan from Middlesbrough) being ineligible to face his parent club. Eastwood pulled off key saves to stop Jelle Vossen and Adam Reach from scoring.

After halftime, Blackburn showed greater attacking threat, with Alex Baptiste having a powerful shot stopped by Boro’s keeper Konstantopoulos. Substitute Patrick Bamford had a penalty appeal declined, and Middlesbrough continued to push, seeing further chances thwarted, including Kike’s shot tipped onto the post and Bamford striking the crossbar.

In the closing moments, Gestede’s header nearly gave Blackburn the win, but Leadbitter’s clearance preserved the draw. Despite their struggles in front of goal, Blackburn won’t be able to bolster their attack in January due to a transfer embargo for breaching Financial Fair Play regulations.

A mother in Naples, Florida is mourning the loss of her one-year-old son, who died four days after suffering head trauma while in the care of her boyfriend. Clarissa Rose said she was left speechless by the tragedy, telling Wink News, 'I really don't have any words for what's happened. It's just a mystery.'

Police are withholding many details as their investigation continues, but authorities confirmed that the boy, Ivan Rose, was found unresponsive at home on January 31 after Clarissa returned from work. Niklaus Booska, her boyfriend, had been watching Ivan at the time.

Ivan passed away at Joe DiMaggio's Children's Hospital on February 4. After securing a warrant for Booska's arrest, police found and arrested him at a motel on February 7. He now faces charges of manslaughter and child abuse. Police have yet to disclose how Ivan sustained his fatal injuries.

Clarissa said she has been advised not to discuss the case while investigations are ongoing. She shared a photograph cradling Ivan before his death and spoke about planning his funeral. Ivan’s father, Andrew Rose, also publicly expressed his grief on social media.

According to the Naples Daily News, Booska has a prior criminal record, including offenses such as driving under the influence, grand theft, burglary, and dealing in stolen property. He is being held on $1.5 million bail.

article_content: Australia advanced to the semifinals of the 2023 ODI World Cup after defeating Afghanistan, driven by Glenn Maxwell's outstanding unbeaten double century. Despite experiencing severe cramps, Maxwell stayed on the field to score 201 runs, greatly supported by team physiotherapist Nick Jones. Jones, part of the team for two years, focused on reducing Maxwell’s need to run and keeping him upright, crucial for managing the cramps. Jones explained that allowing Maxwell to sit or leave the field could have worsened his condition. 'I tried to keep him calm, regulate his heart rate, and reassure him he could continue as long as he stayed upright,' Jones said. Maxwell suffered cramps in multiple areas including his right calf and left hamstring, and even thought about retiring hurt. Jones encouraged him to keep moving, explaining that resting or cooling down could increase cramping risk. 'It’s not unusual; we often see this. The more you run, the faster the cramps come. I regularly reassured and helped manage him,' Jones shared. From a perilous 91 for seven, Maxwell guided Australia to a remarkable win. Even when Maxwell collapsed, Jones motivated him to keep going. Maxwell’s resolve resulted in a historic cricket innings. Jones later reflected, 'What happened was truly incredible—well beyond my expectations. Keeping him in play was the right decision.' Other news: Tata Group completed the acquisition of Wistron’s manufacturing facility, making it the first Indian company to assemble iPhones, in a $750 million deal. India has surpassed China to become the most represented country in the QS World University Rankings: Asia 2024, signaling academic progress. Additionally, directors of Religare Enterprises have reported allegations against the Burman family's takeover attempt to regulators.

article_content: A house in Morpeth, Northumberland, considered by many to be unsellable due to its poor condition, is attracting attention thanks to an unusually honest advertisement by Mike Rogerson Estate Agents. Listed for £275,000, the four-bedroom terrace is described in the advert as 'shabby', 'tatty', and in 'dire need of updating'. The agent openly details the property’s flaws, noting cracked walls, crumbling features, outdated interiors, and structural issues like a damaged handrail and worn stone steps. The advert goes so far as to say the house requires 'blood, sweat and tears' to restore it. Seller Stephanie Burn, 73, encouraged this approach, inspired by London estate agent Roy Brooks, known for his candid property descriptions in the 1970s. She believes that honesty gives buyers a realistic expectation. Despite the stark description, the ad has received plenty of interest, even generating an offer. Louise Wilkinson, the Morpeth branch manager, said the response has been overwhelmingly positive, with many people calling the approach 'refreshing'. She confirmed that the listing was intentionally written this way at the seller’s suggestion.

article_content: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has implemented new measures to tackle the risks stemming from the swift growth in consumer lending. Under these rules, both banks and non-bank financial institutions (NBFIs) must allocate more capital against unsecured loans, such as credit card and personal loans. Statistics reveal that credit card loans have climbed 29.9%, and personal loans have risen 25.5% in the first half of the financial year ending March 2024. Concerns over this rapid growth led the RBI to tighten regulations to prevent systemic financial problems. Fitch Ratings considers this a positive step for overall financial stability. The updated guidelines require banks to use a 150% risk weighting on unsecured credit card lending, while NBFIs' risk weighting increases from 100% to 125%. For NBFIs, microfinance loans remain excluded from these higher risk weights. Fitch estimates the banking sector’s Common Equity Tier 1 (CET1) capital ratio could drop by around 30 basis points, with Fitch-rated banks facing impacts between 6 and 34 basis points. Major private banks, like SBI and Canara Bank, may see double-digit reductions but should maintain strong capitalization. The regulations are not expected to significantly affect bank credit ratings. For NBFIs such as Shriram Finance, Muthoot Finance, IIFL Finance, and Manappuram Finance, the new requirements could affect capitalization, loan growth, and future asset quality. Still, the benefit is a lower risk to the financial system as a whole. Borrowing costs from banks could increase by 40–60 basis points for NBFIs, especially affecting smaller or less well-rated firms. Larger NBFIs may have more ability to negotiate better rates. Certain loans, like those to housing finance companies and NBFIs qualifying as priority sector advances, are not affected by the changes, which is advantageous for companies like Shriram Finance. Overall, the regulations aim to encourage responsible consumer credit growth while reducing the buildup of systemic risk. With a gradual implementation phase, financial players have time to adapt to the new standards. translated_content: Bank Sentral India (RBI) telah menetapkan aturan baru untuk mengatasi risiko dari pesatnya pertumbuhan kredit konsumen. Aturan ini mewajibkan bank dan lembaga keuangan non-bank (NBFI) menyediakan lebih banyak modal sebagai cadangan untuk pinjaman tanpa agunan, seperti kartu kredit dan pinjaman pribadi. Data menunjukkan pinjaman kartu kredit meningkat 29,9% dan pinjaman pribadi naik 25,5% pada paruh pertama tahun keuangan yang berakhir Maret 2024. Pertumbuhan cepat ini mendorong RBI memperketat pengawasan demi mencegah risiko sistemik di sektor keuangan. Fitch Ratings menilai langkah ini positif bagi stabilitas keuangan. Aturan baru meminta bank menerapkan bobot risiko 150% untuk pinjaman kartu kredit tanpa agunan, sementara NBFI kini memakai bobot risiko 125% (dari sebelumnya 100%). Untuk NBFI, pinjaman mikrofinansial dikecualikan dari peningkatan bobot risiko. Fitch memperkirakan rasio modal inti bank (CET1) bisa turun sekitar 30 basis poin, dengan dampak untuk bank yang dinilai Fitch antara 6 hingga 34 basis poin. Bank swasta besar seperti SBI dan Canara Bank mungkin mengalami penurunan dua digit, namun tetap dengan permodalan yang kuat. Kebijakan ini diperkirakan tidak akan berpengaruh besar pada peringkat kredit bank. Untuk NBFI seperti Shriram Finance, Muthoot Finance, IIFL Finance, dan Manappuram Finance, aturan baru ini bisa berdampak pada permodalan, pertumbuhan pinjaman, dan kualitas aset ke depannya. Namun, keuntungannya adalah sistem keuangan secara umum menjadi lebih aman. Biaya dana dari bank kepada NBFI bisa naik 40–60 basis poin, terutama bagi lembaga yang lebih kecil dan berperingkat rendah. NBFI besar lebih mampu menawar suku bunga yang lebih baik. Beberapa pinjaman, seperti ke perusahaan pembiayaan rumah dan NBFI yang masuk sektor prioritas, tidak terdampak aturan baru ini, menguntungkan perusahaan seperti Shriram Finance. Secara keseluruhan, regulasi ini dirancang untuk menjaga pertumbuhan kredit konsumen tetap sehat sekaligus menekan risiko sistemik. Penerapannya yang bertahap memberi waktu bagi industri keuangan untuk menyesuaikan diri dengan aturan baru. Di berita bisnis lainnya: peran perempuan di kepemimpinan perusahaan India makin menonjol, Tesla berencana investasi hingga $2 miliar untuk pabrik baru bergantung pada fasilitas bea impor, dan Komisi Keuangan direncanakan pertimbangkan aspek pembangunan manusia dan keberlanjutan dalam distribusi sumber daya.

article_content: Prescriptions for medications to treat hyperactivity, especially Ritalin, have increased fourfold in the past decade, with evidence that children as young as three are receiving the drug. NHS figures show Ritalin prescriptions rose from 158,000 in 1999 to 661,463 in 2010. Psychologists report more young children, including those under six, are being prescribed Ritalin, and that dosages are becoming stronger, often starting with a high morning dose. Ritalin (methylphenidate hydrochloride) can cause side effects such as nausea, fatigue, and mood swings, and has been linked to suicides. Most prescriptions are given to children diagnosed with attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), which involves difficulty concentrating and impulsive or restless behavior. A survey by the Association of Educational Psychologists in the West Midlands found more than 100 children under six on medication, with similar trends across the country. In 2011, nearly 1.7 million children in England—21% of those under 16—were identified as having special educational needs (SEN), up from 19% in 2006. There are concerns that children with behavioral problems are more often prescribed Ritalin alongside antidepressants, even though the effects of these drug combinations on children's brain development are largely unknown. Ritalin prescription data was obtained by Liberal Democrat MP Tessa Munt, who expressed concern about heavy reliance on medication over alternative or natural approaches to ADHD. Munt described the quadrupling of Ritalin prescriptions in a decade as 'extremely alarming' and noted that about 90% of prescriptions in 2004 were for addressing behavioral problems in school-aged children. A report by the RSPB indicated that activities in natural environments may be more effective in improving ADHD symptoms than indoor or urban outdoor play. Munt highlighted that many children are unable to enjoy outdoor environments because of limited school playing fields and the appeal of video games and social media. She emphasized the need to teach children coping skills for everyday life, warning that relying on powerful drugs could lead to greater issues in the future. Munt questioned how many children actually receive Ritalin, pointing out that without thorough data collection by the Department of Health, the true scale is unknown. Some experts believe poor parenting and inadequate teaching also play roles in the increasing number of special needs diagnoses. Katherine Ann Angel, an experienced SEN teacher, acknowledged that ADHD is real but noted some behavioral issues may stem from factors such as limited access to books, poor diet, and late bedtimes. Jean Gross, a former government speech and language advisor, commented that schools may sometimes use special needs diagnoses to explain underachievement or to ensure students get extra support during key academic periods.

Data NHS menunjukkan resep Ritalin naik dari 158.000 pada tahun 1999 menjadi 661.463 pada 2010. Psikolog melaporkan semakin banyak anak kecil, termasuk yang berusia di bawah enam tahun, diberi resep Ritalin, dan dosisnya kini cenderung lebih tinggi, sering kali dimulai dengan dosis pagi yang besar. Ritalin (methylphenidate hydrochloride) dapat menyebabkan efek samping seperti mual, kelelahan, dan perubahan suasana hati, bahkan dikaitkan dengan kasus bunuh diri. Sebagian besar resep diberikan kepada anak yang didiagnosis attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), yang melibatkan kesulitan berkonsentrasi serta perilaku impulsif atau gelisah. Survei oleh Association of Educational Psychologists di West Midlands menemukan lebih dari 100 anak di bawah enam tahun mengonsumsi obat, dan tren serupa terlihat di seluruh negeri. Pada 2011, hampir 1,7 juta anak di Inggris—21% dari mereka yang berusia di bawah 16 tahun—dinilai memiliki kebutuhan pendidikan khusus (SEN), naik dari 19% pada 2006. Ada kekhawatiran bahwa anak-anak dengan masalah perilaku semakin sering diberi resep Ritalin bersamaan dengan antidepresan, meskipun efek kombinasi obat ini terhadap perkembangan otak anak sebagian besar belum diketahui. Data resep Ritalin diperoleh oleh anggota parlemen Liberal Demokrat, Tessa Munt, yang menyoroti kekhawatiran tentang ketergantungan pada pengobatan dibanding pendekatan alternatif atau alami untuk ADHD. Munt menyebut lonjakan resep Ritalin selama satu dekade sebagai 'sangat mengkhawatirkan' dan mencatat bahwa sekitar 90% resep pada 2004 digunakan untuk mengatasi masalah perilaku pada anak usia sekolah. Sebuah laporan dari RSPB menunjukkan bahwa aktivitas di lingkungan alami lebih efektif untuk memperbaiki gejala ADHD dibanding bermain di dalam ruangan atau di area luar urban. Munt juga menyoroti bahwa banyak anak tak bisa menikmati lingkungan luar karena minimnya lapangan sekolah dan daya tarik video game serta media sosial. Ia menegaskan pentingnya mengajarkan anak cara menghadapi tantangan hidup sehari-hari, memperingatkan bahwa ketergantungan pada obat kuat hanya akan menimbulkan masalah baru di masa depan. Munt mempertanyakan berapa banyak anak yang sebenarnya menerima Ritalin, seraya menekankan tanpa pengumpulan data rutin oleh Departemen Kesehatan, skala sesungguhnya tetap tidak diketahui. Beberapa ahli meyakini bahwa pola asuh yang kurang baik dan kualitas pengajaran yang tidak memadai juga berkontribusi pada peningkatan diagnosis kebutuhan pendidikan khusus. Katherine Ann Angel, guru berpengalaman di bidang SEN, mengakui ADHD memang nyata, namun beberapa masalah perilaku bisa disebabkan faktor seperti minimnya akses buku, pola makan buruk, dan waktu tidur yang larut. Jean Gross, mantan penasihat bahasa dan bicara pemerintah, berkomentar bahwa sekolah kadang menggunakan diagnosis kebutuhan khusus untuk menjelaskan hasil belajar rendah atau memastikan siswa mendapat dukungan ekstra saat ujian penting.

article_content: Target Corp. is set to launch 27 new stores this month, bringing more than 4,300 jobs, according to the company. This move comes just weeks after Target trimmed 600 positions at its Minnesota headquarters, citing weaker sales. The latest expansion includes their first two stores in Hawaii, with one preparing for its grand opening on Sunday. The openings comprise 21 general merchandise Target stores and six SuperTarget stores, all scheduled for grand openings on Sunday. Each general merchandise store will add 150 to 250 jobs, while each SuperTarget will hire 200 to 300 employees. Target also plans to close an Arkansas distribution center, affecting 500 employees. This follows a late-January decision to cut headquarters staff by 9% and eliminate 400 unfilled positions. President and CEO Gregg Steinhafel stated these decisions are necessary for the company to remain competitive in challenging economic conditions. US retailers have faced declining consumer spending as the economy struggles; retail sales fell for six months in a row before a modest 1% rise in January, according to Commerce Department data. Despite this, Kohl's and Dollar General have both announced significant expansion plans—Kohl's with 55 new stores and Dollar General with over 400 planned for 2009. Target reported a 40.7% drop in fourth-quarter net earnings compared to last year. Same-store sales in January fell 3.3%, after a 4.1% decline in December. The new general merchandise stores are in Rogers, AR; Santa Clarita, CA; Pensacola, FL; Bethlehem, GA; Honolulu and Kapolei, HI; Council Bluffs, IA; Las Vegas, NV; Paramus, NJ; Cincinnati, Lebanon and Reynoldsburg, OH; Broken Arrow, OK; Philadelphia and Exton, PA; Memphis, TN; Houston, San Antonio and San Marcos, TX; Midlothian, VA; and Sun Prairie, WI. The new SuperTarget stores are located in Kissimmee, FL; Canton, GA; Hillside, IL; and Pflugerville, Allen, and Lewisville, TX. These additions will bring Target’s store count to 1,699.

Pembukaan toko ini terdiri dari 21 toko Target barang umum dan enam SuperTarget, semuanya dijadwalkan grand opening pada hari Minggu. article_content: Alpha Morgan Capital has completed renovations on the Library Lobby and Makerspace at the University of Lagos (UNILAG). During a ceremony to mark the official opening, Ade Burimo, Group Managing Director of Alpha Morgan Capital, shared that he first learned about the library project in 2022. "As a leading African institution, we believe in equipping students with relevant skills for the industry," Burimo stated. UNILAG's current Vice-Chancellor, Prof. Folasade Ogunsola, commended the project, noting that the renovation has turned the library into a vibrant, student-centered space that balances function, aesthetics, and community spirit. She emphasized that the transformation reflects a new approach to learning and positions the library to serve coming generations.

article_content: City farming and food sharing are flourishing across Europe, supported by local traditions and EU research. In Utrecht, Netherlands, a popular board game lets children collect ingredients for a meal and, at the end, receive a recipe card and map to find real food in their neighborhood's food forest. The Rijnvliet neighborhood’s food forest features passion flowers, pears, herbs, apples, and more, providing a place for community activities like cooking pizzas with locally sourced ingredients. These initiatives are part of a larger trend toward urban farming and communal food activities, motivated by sustainability and the desire for healthier diets. The CULTIVATE project—funded by the EU until 2026—encourages sustainable food sharing across Europe. Cities and local groups influence food production and consumption through decisions in public institutions, waste management, and local distribution. Such actions support the European Green Deal’s goal of an interconnected food system that benefits people, communities, and the planet. In Gdansk, Poland, 'Food Not Bombs' volunteers collect leftover food from markets to cook soup, offering it free to both tourists and homeless people. The previous EU project SHARECITY mapped food-sharing efforts like community gardens, kitchens, surplus food distribution, and seed sharing in 100 cities worldwide. Anna Davies, professor at Trinity College Dublin and CULTIVATE coordinator, says sharing food has always been central to human civilization. Researchers note that urban agriculture helps people reconnect with nature, build relationships, learn new skills, and improve well-being. Community gardens also reduce loneliness. Despite these benefits, urban food initiatives are often omitted from official city plans, partly because their impacts are rarely measured. CULTIVATE aims to change this by using AI to map, monitor, and report on European food-sharing initiatives with an online presence. The 'Sharing Solutions' platform will be tested in Utrecht, Barcelona, and Milan. Cristina Grasseni, professor at Leiden University, leads the EU-funded FOOD CITIZENS project. She observes that city farming offers more than supermarket shopping—it reconnects people with nature, relationships, and relaxation. Her research includes a Rotterdam land trust with 200 households sharing 20 hectares, employing a farmer, assisting in the fields, and sharing the harvest. More than 50 case studies show diverse approaches to self-organized food initiatives in the Netherlands, Italy, and Poland—there is no single model or average 'food citizen.' Food forests are popular in the Netherlands, while urban allotments remain common in Poland. Rijnvliet’s food forest celebrates its agricultural heritage, offering green space, local food, and a community hub. Children there are learning firsthand that food truly does grow on trees.
translated_content: Pertanian kota dan berbagi makanan semakin berkembang di seluruh Eropa, didukung oleh tradisi lokal serta dukungan riset Uni Eropa. Di Utrecht, Belanda, sebuah permainan papan populer mengajak anak-anak mengumpulkan bahan makanan, lalu di akhir permainan, mereka mendapatkan kartu resep dan peta untuk mencari bahan-bahan sungguhan di hutan pangan lingkungan mereka. Hutan pangan di daerah Rijnvliet memiliki bunga markisa, pir, rempah, apel, dan lainnya, menjadi tempat bagi kegiatan komunitas seperti memasak pizza dengan bahan dari hutan tersebut. Inisiatif-inisiatif ini merupakan bagian dari tren pertanian kota dan aktivitas pangan bersama yang lebih luas, dipicu oleh upaya keberlanjutan dan pola makan yang lebih sehat. Proyek CULTIVATE—didanai Uni Eropa hingga tahun 2026—mendorong berbagi makanan berkelanjutan di Eropa. Kota dan kelompok lokal dapat memengaruhi produksi serta konsumsi makanan melalui kebijakan institusi publik, pengelolaan sampah, dan distribusi lokal. Langkah-langkah ini mendukung tujuan European Green Deal untuk sistem pangan yang terintegrasi demi kebaikan manusia, komunitas, dan lingkungan. Di Gdansk, Polandia, relawan 'Food Not Bombs' mengumpulkan makanan sisa dari pasar untuk dibuat sup, lalu dibagikan secara gratis kepada turis maupun tunawisma. Proyek SHARECITY dari Uni Eropa sebelumnya telah memetakan inisiatif berbagi makanan seperti kebun komunitas, dapur umum, distribusi makanan sisa, dan berbagi benih di 100 kota di seluruh dunia. Anna Davies, profesor di Trinity College Dublin sekaligus koordinator CULTIVATE, menyebut berbagi makanan adalah inti dari peradaban manusia. Riset menunjukkan pertanian kota membantu orang terhubung kembali dengan alam, membangun relasi, mendapatkan keahlian baru, serta meningkatkan kesejahteraan. Kebun komunitas juga mengurangi kesepian. Meski bermanfaat, inisiatif pangan kota sering kali luput dari rencana resmi pemerintah kota, antara lain karena dampaknya jarang tercatat. CULTIVATE berupaya mengubahnya dengan memanfaatkan AI untuk memetakan, memantau, serta melaporkan inisiatif berbagi makanan di Eropa yang aktif secara daring. Platform 'Sharing Solutions' akan diuji di Utrecht, Barcelona, dan Milan. Cristina Grasseni, profesor dari Leiden University dan pemimpin proyek FOOD CITIZENS, menilai pertanian kota memberikan lebih dari belanja di supermarket—memberi kesempatan kembali bersentuhan dengan alam, membangun jejaring, dan suasana lebih rileks. Penelitiannya mencakup sebuah trust tanah di Rotterdam di mana 200 keluarga bersama-sama mengelola 20 hektare lahan, mempekerjakan petani, membantu di ladang, dan berbagi hasil panen. Lebih dari 50 studi kasus menunjukkan pendekatan beragam dalam inisiatif pangan mandiri di Belanda, Italia, dan Polandia—tidak ada model baku atau 'warga pangan' rata-rata. Hutan pangan sangat populer di Belanda, sementara kebun kota masih banyak ditemukan di Polandia. Hutan pangan Rijnvliet merayakan warisan pertanian di daerah tersebut, menyediakan ruang hijau, pangan lokal, dan menjadi pusat komunitas. Anak-anak di sana belajar langsung bahwa makanan memang bisa tumbuh di pohon.

article_content: Actor Hina Khan recently revealed on Instagram how continual coverage of global events—especially news from Israel and Palestine—has taken a toll on her emotional well-being. Just after her role as a showstopper at Lakme Fashion Week, Khan described being so impacted by the troubling updates that she needed time off to regain balance. On her Instagram Story, she admitted feeling depressed and said that her sense of optimism had faded, remarking, 'It feels like humanity is lost… I need a break, but let's keep praying.' If you’re experiencing similar feelings due to ongoing world events, remember you're not alone. The state of affairs in Ukraine and Palestine is leaving many people emotionally drained. According to Dr. Mazher Ali, a psychiatrist at CARE Hospitals, it’s valid to feel disturbed by the news, but there are steps you can take to support your mental health. He suggests cutting down on time spent on news and social media platforms. Set aside limited periods to check updates, and stick to trustworthy, balanced sources rather than those that might amplify fear. Dr. Ali advocates for sharing your emotions with people you trust, which can help lessen feelings of isolation. He also points to the value of consuming positive content—from uplifting stories to humorous posts—to counterbalance negative reports. Regular mindfulness practices and meditation can help with anxiety, while taking digital breaks for a day or weekend can refresh your perspective. Feeling guilty over stepping back from the news is common, but Dr. Ali warns against it. Be aware of your personal boundaries; you’re better equipped to help others when you look after yourself. Instead of consuming every distressing headline, find fulfillment in volunteering, supporting meaningful causes, or reading about issues like the Israel-Palestine conflict. It’s understandable to be affected by distressing news. By managing what you watch and focusing on self-care, you can maintain both your mental health and your awareness of global events.
translated_content: Aktris Hina Khan baru-baru ini membagikan di Instagram tentang bagaimana pemberitaan dunia, terutama dari Israel dan Palestina, berdampak besar pada kesejahteraan emosionalnya. Usai tampil sebagai showstopper di Lakme Fashion Week, Khan mengaku terhimpit oleh kabar duka hingga perlu waktu istirahat untuk menyeimbangkan diri. Di Instagram Story, ia berkata merasa depresi dan kehilangan optimisme, 'Rasanya kemanusiaan sudah hilang… Aku butuh jeda, tapi mari tetap berdoa.' Jika kamu memiliki perasaan serupa akibat kabar dunia akhir-akhir ini, kamu tidak sendiri. Kondisi di Ukraina dan Palestina juga membuat banyak orang merasa kelelahan secara emosional. Dr. Mazher Ali, psikiater di CARE Hospitals, menjelaskan bahwa wajar merasa terganggu oleh berita, namun ada langkah untuk mendukung kesehatan mental. Ia menganjurkan membatasi waktu di media sosial dan situs berita. Tetapkan waktu khusus untuk memantau update, dan pastikan memilih sumber yang kredibel serta berimbang, bukan yang memperbesar kecemasan. Dr. Ali juga menyarankan untuk berbagi perasaan dengan orang terdekat agar tidak merasa sendiri. Ia menambahkan bahwa menyeimbangkan berita negatif dengan konten positif, seperti cerita inspiratif atau humor, bisa membantu. Praktik mindfulness, meditasi, serta jeda digital selama sehari atau akhir pekan juga baik untuk menyegarkan diri. Merasa bersalah karena berhenti mengikuti berita buruk itu hal yang wajar, tapi Dr. Ali mengingatkan pentingnya menyadari batas diri; kamu akan bisa membantu orang lain jika sudah merawat diri sendiri. Sebagai alternatif daripada terus menyimak kabar memprihatinkan, cobalah terlibat dalam kegiatan sukarela, mendukung aksi sosial, atau membaca lebih dalam terkait konflik Israel-Palestina. Wajar jika kamu terpengaruh oleh berita-berita penuh tekanan. Dengan mengelola paparan informasi dan mengutamakan self-care, kesehatan mental tetap terjaga tanpa kehilangan kepedulian terhadap dunia.

article_content: Fourteen-day-old Azra survived almost two days beneath rubble in Turkey after a massive earthquake. Her dramatic rescue brought emotional applause from rescuers, as she was pulled out alive with no clothes in freezing conditions. Azra’s name means 'maiden' in Arabic and 'help' in Hebrew. Soon after, her mother Semiha and grandmother Gulsaadet were also rescued from the same collapsed building. Medics wrapped Azra in a blanket before taking her to the hospital, declaring her in stable condition and transferring her to Ankara. The rescue, captured on television, led to emotional scenes among emergency workers. A 10-year-old boy was subsequently found alive after spending 54 hours trapped. The earthquake, measuring 7.2, mainly impacted the towns of Ercis and Van, with the death toll rising above 432 as searches continued for survivors amid debris. Authorities have warned survivors to avoid unstable buildings, leaving thousands sheltering outdoors in near-freezing weather. Emergency worker Kadir Direk explained that a bakery at the building’s ground floor may have provided some warmth for Azra and her relatives. Semiha was semi-conscious but responded once found. Azra’s uncle, Senol Yigit, called her rescue a miracle after nearly losing hope. Rescuer Oytun Gulpinar shared that saving the family brought him incomparable joy. Sadly, Azra’s father was not found, and no new signs of life emerged in the collapsed building. The family was visiting Azra’s grandparents in Ercis but typically live in Sivas. Other survivors included nine-year-old Oguz Isler and his relatives, though Oguz continued to wait for news of his missing parents. Additional rescues included a teenager and a 13-year-old boy who endured many hours trapped under debris. The emergency response faced criticism for not providing enough shelter, a point reported by CNN Turk. Deputy Prime Minister Besir Atalay, leading relief work, vowed all needs would soon be addressed. Aid groups stepped in to help, underscoring Turkey’s ongoing exposure to powerful earthquakes given its position along major tectonic faults.

Blake Lively recently participated in a rapid-fire Vogue video interview, answering 73 questions in just five minutes. The 26-year-old actress, admired for her approachable yet stylish personality, discussed her fondness for baking and desserts—particularly chocolate soufflé—and revealed she often stays up late baking in the Westchester, New York home she shares with her husband, actor Ryan Reynolds. Lively shared that Reynolds once created a touching video compilation of people who have influenced her life, and she similarly planned a collection of stories from loved ones as a surprise for him.

During the interview, Lively decorated cupcakes, joking that her husband nicknamed their kitchen 'The Blakery.' She listed cake, chocolate soufflé, melted cheese, mayonnaise, and truffle pappardelle as her favorite foods and noted that sea urchin is her least favorite. Lively prefers hot chocolate to coffee and is not a frequent Starbucks customer. She also enjoys pianos, Paris, puppies, and the color pink, recalling that her prom dress was coral.

Interestingly, Lively said she relates more to the male characters from HBO’s 'Sex and the City' than the female leads. The interview aligns with her recent Vogue magazine cover, where she spoke warmly about Reynolds, attributed strong family values to him, and hinted at future family plans.

Lively also introduced her lifestyle website, Preserve, which she described as focusing on authentic stories, essays, videos, and goods designed to inspire and celebrate real life rather than a picture-perfect ideal. Developed over two years with a team of 12, the project has drawn comparisons to Martha Stewart (who is a supportive neighbor and friend) and Gwyneth Paltrow, but Lively stressed that her approach is unique and inclusive.

Despite her entrepreneurial pursuits, Lively remains active in her acting career and will star in 'The Age of Adaline,' a film about a woman stopping aging after an accident. Lively and Reynolds, who met filming 'Green Lantern,' married in 2012.

Janelle Schuurman, a 35-year-old former elementary school teacher from Michigan, spent 11 years in her dream career before leaving due to burnout in 2022. Despite common misconceptions, teaching is far from an easy job with a light schedule. Janelle typically spent 10 to 12 hours per day at school and dedicated an additional 20 hours per week to her responsibilities outside her contracted hours. The long hours left her with little time to recharge, even during summer breaks, much of which she spent preparing for the upcoming year.

She also noted dramatic changes in the work environment, especially increasing class sizes and a lack of support staff like teachers’ aides. Janelle had 29 students in her class when she left, describing ideal class sizes as 20 to 22 students. She believes that decreased funding for public schools contributes to these increasing challenges.

School safety was another major concern. After the Uvalde shooting, Janelle felt a deep sense of fear for her own safety and that of her students. She recounted that every teacher had a walkie-talkie to call for help, which was a constant reminder of potential danger.

Janelle criticized the guilt placed on teachers through societal messaging—encouraging them to focus on making a difference over earning a living wage. She was able to pay her bills, but she knows many teachers who left the profession due to low salaries. She also expressed frustration with widespread external opinions from parents and politicians, who often attempt to dictate how and what teachers should instruct, further contributing to exhaustion.

Ultimately, Janelle left teaching for a job at Costco, where she appreciates fair pay and strong benefits. Despite finding happiness in her new position, she is saddened that she had to give up her dream of teaching.

Bertentangan dengan anggapan umum, profesi guru jauh dari kata mudah dengan jadwal yang ringan. Janelle biasanya bekerja 10 hingga 12 jam per hari di sekolah, ditambah 20 jam per minggu di luar jam kerja resminya untuk menyelesaikan tugas-tugasnya. Keamanan sekolah juga menjadi sumber kekhawatiran besar. Setelah penembakan di Uvalde, Janelle merasa sangat takut akan keselamatan dirinya dan murid-muridnya. article_content: Nick Clegg announced that he had blocked more than £6 billion in what he described as ‘draconian’ welfare cuts proposed by the Conservatives. However, the Deputy Prime Minister insisted that certain pensioner benefits, such as free bus passes, free TV licences for those over 75, and the annual winter fuel payment, should not be provided to the better off. This stance from Clegg is in direct opposition to Prime Minister David Cameron, who has supported retaining universal pensioner benefits. Speaking at the CentreForum think tank, Clegg stated, ‘Money should not be paid to those who do not need it.’ Clegg, marking his fifth anniversary as Liberal Democrat leader, made these remarks amid growing speculation about his leadership. His deputy, Simon Hughes, acknowledged that Clegg was ‘in trouble’ and facing internal discussion about his position. Richard Reeves, Clegg’s former chief of staff, suggested that the Coalition government might collapse before 2015 unless the Lib Dems can recover from their falling poll numbers. Similarly, Lib Dem peer Lord Oakeshott warned that the party could face heavy losses in the next election if the economy does not improve significantly. While sources close to Clegg affirm his leadership is secure, they recognize the need for the Liberal Democrats to differentiate themselves from the Conservatives to regain voters' trust. In his CentreForum speech, Clegg explained that he had acted as a moderating force against more ‘extreme’ Conservative proposals on welfare cuts during the Autumn Statement. Clegg confirmed he had vetoed a suggestion from the Prime Minister to end housing benefit for under-25s, as well as Iain Duncan Smith’s idea to limit child benefit to the first two children per family. He noted, ‘That is the job of the Liberal Democrats – to anchor reform in the sensible centre ground.’ As a result, a proposed £10 billion package of benefit cuts was scaled down to £3.8 billion, with the remainder offset by increased taxes and cuts to other public services. Clegg said that the two Conservative proposals would have unfairly penalized young people and larger families. Returning to pensioner benefits, Clegg reiterated his call to review payments to wealthier retirees. Some Conservatives reportedly support his view, but David Cameron has ruled out means-testing these benefits before the next election. The winter fuel allowance is currently worth £200 per household and £300 for people over 80. Ros Altmann of Saga warned that means-testing pensioner benefits could hurt those who have been self-reliant and risk undermining the wider pensions system. A Downing Street spokesperson confirmed that existing universal pensioner benefits would not change, stating, ‘The Prime Minister made a commitment to protect those benefits and he believes in keeping his promises.’ Clegg addressed the challenge of maintaining a Liberal Democrat presence in government by emphasizing the need to make compromises as a party of power. Recent polls show the Lib Dems have slipped behind the UK Independence Party (UKIP), with one Survation survey placing the Lib Dems in fourth place at 9 percent.

Sikap Clegg ini bertentangan langsung dengan Perdana Menteri David Cameron, yang mendukung pemberian tunjangan pensiun secara universal. Demikian pula, Lord Oakeshott dari Lib Dem memperingatkan bahwa partai tersebut dapat menghadapi kekalahan besar pada pemilu berikutnya jika ekonomi tidak membaik secara signifikan. Walaupun sumber dari dalam dekat Clegg menegaskan kepemimpinannya masih aman, mereka menyadari perlunya Liberal Demokrat membedakan diri dari Konservatif agar bisa mendapatkan kembali kepercayaan pemilih. Dalam pidatonya di CentreForum, Clegg menjelaskan bahwa ia telah bertindak sebagai penengah terhadap usulan pemotongan tunjangan Konservatif yang lebih 'ekstrem' dalam Pernyataan Musim Gugur. Clegg mengonfirmasi bahwa ia telah memveto usulan dari Perdana Menteri untuk mengakhiri tunjangan perumahan bagi mereka di bawah usia 25 tahun, serta ide Iain Duncan Smith untuk membatasi tunjangan anak hanya untuk dua anak pertama dalam satu keluarga. Ia mengatakan, ‘Inilah peran Liberal Demokrat – memastikan reformasi tetap berada di jalur tengah yang masuk akal.’ Akibatnya, paket pemotongan tunjangan yang tadinya diusulkan senilai £10 miliar dipangkas menjadi £3,8 miliar, dengan sisanya ditutupi dengan kenaikan pajak dan pengurangan layanan publik lainnya. Clegg menyatakan bahwa dua usulan Konservatif tersebut akan menghukum kaum muda dan keluarga besar secara tidak adil. Membahas kembali tunjangan pensiun, Clegg menegaskan kembali seruannya untuk meninjau ulang pembayaran kepada para pensiunan kaya. Beberapa anggota Konservatif dilaporkan mendukung gagasannya, tetapi David Cameron telah menolak pengetesan kemampuan pada tunjangan ini sebelum pemilu berikutnya. Tunjangan musim dingin saat ini bernilai £200 per rumah tangga dan £300 untuk orang berusia di atas 80 tahun. Ros Altmann dari Saga memperingatkan bahwa uji kemampuan terhadap tunjangan pensiun dapat merugikan mereka yang sudah mandiri dan berisiko merusak sistem pensiun secara keseluruhan. Juru bicara Downing Street menegaskan bahwa tunjangan pensiun universal yang ada tidak akan berubah, dengan menyatakan, ‘Perdana Menteri telah berkomitmen untuk melindungi tunjangan tersebut dan beliau percaya untuk menepati janjinya.’ Clegg membahas tantangan mempertahankan eksistensi Liberal Demokrat dalam pemerintahan dengan menekankan perlunya kompromi sebagai partai yang berkuasa. Jajak pendapat terbaru menunjukkan Lib Dem kini jatuh di bawah Partai Kemerdekaan Inggris (UKIP), dengan satu survei Survation menempatkan Lib Dem di urutan keempat dengan dukungan hanya 9 persen.

article_content: Textbooks are becoming less common in UK classrooms as many teachers consider them regimented and outdated, according to Education Minister Elizabeth Truss. Truss noted that a growing preference for unstructured and free-flowing teaching methods means only one in ten ten-year-olds are given textbooks now, dropping to just 8% of 14-year-old science students. She warned that this 'anti-textbook orthodoxy' is harming children's education, as teachers are often creating their own materials, leading to inconsistent 'dog-eared worksheets' rather than comprehensive resources. Figures show the UK has the lowest textbook usage among 50 countries surveyed by the Amsterdam-based International Association for the Evaluation of Educational Achievement. In contrast, textbooks are used by 99% of teachers in South Korea, 86% in Germany, and 78% in Poland—countries that academically outperform the UK. Speaking at the British Educational Suppliers Association, Truss argued that textbooks help guide both students and parents, enabling pupils to take ownership of their learning and catch up or get ahead independently. She believes that ideology favoring child-centered, unstructured learning has led to inconsistent teaching materials and put UK students at a disadvantage compared to their international peers. While Truss and other experts advocate for textbooks as structured guides, teaching unions such as NASUWT say frequent changes to the UK curriculum make it difficult for schools to invest in books. Chris McGovern of the Campaign for Real Education argued that the decline in textbook use has hurt education, making learning less structured and more chaotic. High-performing countries like South Korea are innovating with digital and multimedia textbooks, but still depend on well-structured content. Truss emphasized that the principle of a good textbook—a clear, structured progression through essential knowledge—remains crucial.

Truss mencatat bahwa preferensi yang semakin besar terhadap metode pengajaran yang tidak terstruktur dan mengalir bebas berarti hanya satu dari sepuluh anak usia sepuluh tahun yang diberikan buku pelajaran saat ini, dan hanya 8% siswa sains usia 14 tahun. Dia memperingatkan bahwa 'ortodoksi anti-buku pelajaran' ini merugikan pendidikan anak-anak, karena guru sering membuat materi mereka sendiri, sehingga menghasilkan 'lembar kerja kusut' yang tidak konsisten ketimbang sumber belajar yang menyeluruh. Data menunjukkan Inggris memiliki tingkat penggunaan buku pelajaran terendah di antara 50 negara yang disurvei oleh International Association for the Evaluation of Educational Achievement berbasis di Amsterdam. Sebaliknya, buku pelajaran digunakan oleh 99% guru di Korea Selatan, 86% di Jerman, dan 78% di Polandia—negara-negara yang secara akademis melampaui Inggris. Berbicara di British Educational Suppliers Association, Truss berpendapat bahwa buku pelajaran membantu membimbing siswa dan orang tua, memungkinkan murid untuk mengambil alih pembelajarannya serta mengejar ataupun mendahului secara mandiri. Ia meyakini bahwa ideologi pembelajaran tidak terstruktur dan berpusat pada anak telah menyebabkan materi pembelajaran yang tidak konsisten dan membuat siswa Inggris tertinggal dibanding rekan-rekan internasional. Sementara Truss dan beberapa ahli lain mendorong buku pelajaran untuk panduan terstruktur, serikat guru seperti NASUWT mengatakan perubahan kurikulum yang sering terjadi di Inggris membuat sekolah kesulitan berinvestasi pada buku. Chris McGovern dari Campaign for Real Education berpendapat bahwa berkurangnya penggunaan buku pelajaran berdampak negatif pada pendidikan, membuat pembelajaran menjadi kurang terstruktur dan lebih kacau. Negara-negara berprestasi seperti Korea Selatan berinovasi dengan buku digital dan multimedia, namun tetap bergantung pada konten yang terstruktur dengan baik. Truss menekankan bahwa prinsip buku pelajaran yang baik—progresi terstruktur dalam pengetahuan inti—tetap sangat penting.

article_content: Nearly three tonnes of cocaine have been seized from a ship off the coast of Senegal, according to the country's navy. This marks one of the largest drug hauls ever conducted by Senegal's navy. The West African region is commonly used as a transit point by Latin American cartels smuggling drugs to Europe and other destinations.  The navy did not provide specific details about the vessel or its crew, other than stating that 10 people were on board, including one Senegalese national.  A naval patrol intercepted the ship about 150 km (93 miles) from Dakar in international waters. The vessel was taken to a naval base on Tuesday for identification and logging of the seized drugs, according to the navy.  Photos posted to X by the navy show a rusty vessel docked at port, with bundles of suspected cocaine and officers standing nearby.  It is not clear if any charges have been filed against those on board.  Earlier this year, over 800 kg of cocaine were seized from a ship off Senegal's coast. In 2019, authorities intercepted a ship traveling from Brazil carrying 750 kg of cocaine hidden inside 15 cars, with European countries listed as its destination.
translated_content: Hampir tiga ton kokain telah disita dari sebuah kapal di lepas pantai Senegal, menurut angkatan laut negara tersebut. Ini menjadi salah satu penangkapan narkoba terbesar yang pernah dilakukan oleh angkatan laut Senegal. Wilayah Afrika Barat sering digunakan sebagai jalur transit oleh kartel Amerika Latin yang menyelundupkan narkoba ke Eropa dan tujuan lainnya.  Angkatan laut tidak memberikan rincian spesifik tentang kapal atau awaknya, selain menyatakan bahwa ada 10 orang di kapal tersebut, termasuk satu warga Senegal.  Sebuah patroli angkatan laut mencegat kapal itu sekitar 150 km dari Dakar di perairan internasional. Kapal tersebut dibawa ke pangkalan angkatan laut pada hari Selasa untuk identifikasi dan pencatatan barang bukti yang disita, menurut angkatan laut.  Foto-foto yang diunggah angkatan laut ke X menunjukkan sebuah kapal berkarat sedang bersandar di pelabuhan, dengan tumpukan kokain yang diduga serta petugas berdiri di sekitarnya.  Belum jelas apakah para awak kapal telah dikenai dakwaan.  Awal tahun ini, lebih dari 800 kg kokain juga disita dari kapal di lepas pantai Senegal. Pada 2019, pihak berwenang mencegat kapal yang berlayar dari Brasil dengan membawa 750 kg kokain yang disembunyikan di dalam 15 mobil, dan negara-negara Eropa tercatat sebagai tujuannya.
