article_content: Moody’s Investors Service has lowered the credit ratings of 15 major global banks, intensifying concerns about the health of leading financial institutions. The announcement, made after US markets closed on Thursday, affected top banks including Bank of America, Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan, Morgan Stanley, Citigroup, Royal Bank of Scotland, Barclays, HSBC, Credit Suisse, UBS, BNP Paribas, Credit Agricole, Societe Generale, Deutsche Bank, and Royal Bank of Canada. Greg Bauer, Moody’s Global Banking Managing Director, said these banks have substantial exposure to the risks and volatility of capital markets. Moody’s grouped the banks into three tiers: JPMorgan, HSBC, and Royal Bank of Canada were rated as most stable, thanks to stronger capital reserves and limited European exposure. The second group—such as Goldman Sachs and Barclays—were noted for higher reliance on market operations and exposure to Europe. The least stable, including Bank of America, Citigroup, Morgan Stanley, and Royal Bank of Scotland, were cited for weak risk controls and thin financial safeguards. Many banks were critical of the downgrades. Citigroup, for example, called its two-notch drop 'arbitrary and completely unwarranted.' This has fuelled fresh debate over how ratings agencies operate and their influence over global finance. The credit ratings industry is dominated by three agencies: Moody’s, Standard & Poor’s, and Fitch Ratings, collectively known as 'the big three.' Their ratings are influential, guiding decisions by investors and governments. Agencies assign ratings from AAA (the highest) to D (default), with downgrades into 'junk' territory—like Greece’s—leading to higher borrowing costs and investor caution. Banks facing lower ratings typically pay more to borrow money, and may pass these added costs onto consumers through more expensive loans and mortgages. Similarly, nations with slashed ratings, such as Greece, see borrowing become more difficult and costly. The credibility of ratings agencies was questioned after the 2008 financial crisis, when they assigned top ratings to risky investments. Critics also highlight a conflict of interest since agencies are now paid by those they rate. Agencies respond that their ratings are opinions, not guarantees. Meanwhile, governments worldwide are investigating how to better regulate these powerful agencies.
translated_content: Moody's Investors Service telah menurunkan peringkat kredit 15 bank global besar, memperkuat kekhawatiran terkait kesehatan lembaga keuangan terkemuka. Greg Bauer, Managing Director Perbankan Global Moody's, menyatakan bahwa bank-bank tersebut memiliki eksposur besar terhadap risiko dan volatilitas pasar modal. Moody’s membagi bank-bank itu ke dalam tiga kelompok: JPMorgan, HSBC, dan Royal Bank of Canada dinilai paling stabil karena cadangan modal yang kuat dan paparan terbatas terhadap krisis Eropa. Kelompok kedua—seperti Goldman Sachs dan Barclays—dikenal sangat bergantung pada operasi pasar dan lebih rentan terhadap kondisi di Eropa. Sementara yang dinilai paling lemah, seperti Bank of America, Citigroup, Morgan Stanley, dan Royal Bank of Scotland, dikatakan memiliki manajemen risiko yang buruk dan penyangga keuangan yang tipis. Banyak bank mengkritik penurunan peringkat ini. Citigroup, misalnya, menyebut penurunan dua tingkat tersebut 'sewenang-wenang dan sama sekali tidak berdasar.' Hal ini kembali memicu perdebatan mengenai cara kerja dan pengaruh lembaga pemeringkat kredit di dunia keuangan. Industri pemeringkatan kredit didominasi tiga lembaga: Moody’s, Standard & Poor’s, dan Fitch Ratings, yang dikenal sebagai 'tiga besar.' Peringkat mereka sangat berpengaruh, menjadi acuan penting bagi investor dan pemerintah dalam mengambil keputusan. Lembaga-lembaga ini memberikan peringkat mulai dari AAA (tertinggi) hingga D (gagal bayar), di mana penurunan ke level 'junk'—seperti yang dialami Yunani—memicu kenaikan biaya pinjaman dan penurunan minat investor. Bank yang peringkatnya diturunkan biasanya perlu membayar lebih mahal untuk meminjam dana dan kemungkinan membebankan biaya tersebut ke konsumen melalui bunga pinjaman dan hipotek yang lebih tinggi. Negara-negara dengan peringkat terpangkas, seperti Yunani, juga mengalami kesulitan dan kenaikan biaya pinjaman. Kepercayaan terhadap lembaga pemeringkat mulai dipertanyakan pasca krisis keuangan 2008, ketika lembaga-lembaga ini memberikan peringkat tinggi pada investasi berisiko. Kritikus juga menyoroti konflik kepentingan sebab kini lembaga pemeringkat dibayar oleh pihak yang mereka nilai. Lembaga pemeringkat menyatakan bahwa penilaian mereka hanya berupa opini, bukan jaminan. Sementara itu, pemerintah berbagai negara kini sedang mencari cara mengatur lembaga-lembaga ini secara lebih baik.

article_content: In Israel, members of Standing Together, a grassroots group of Jewish and Palestinian Israelis, come together to paint bilingual banners that read, 'Good neighbors even in hard times; Arabs and Jews together even in hard times.' Displayed in both Hebrew and Arabic, these banners hang across bridges and public spaces to encourage unity amid the ongoing conflict. Samah Abou Shhadeh, an Arab Israeli economist from Jaffa, personally experienced these rising tensions. Two years ago, she became the first Arab employee at a Tel Aviv financial firm after graduating from college. Feeling the pressure to work harder and steer clear of politics at the office, she nonetheless formed close bonds with her colleagues. The situation changed following the October 7 Hamas-led attacks in Israel, which Israeli authorities say resulted in about 1,200 deaths and over 240 kidnappings. Israel’s response involved intense airstrikes in Gaza, leading to more than 12,000 reported deaths according to Palestinian health officials. After these events, Abou Shhadeh shared a clip on her personal Instagram from 'Tantura,' a 2022 Israeli documentary about a massacre in a Palestinian village during the 1948 war. After colleagues expressed offense, her manager asked her to take down the post. Her refusal led to a dismissal letter from human resources, despite the company emphasizing free expression. The letter stated that extra sensitivity was expected during wartime. Approximately 20% of Israel's citizens identify as Arab or Palestinian. Many say they have long felt marginalized. Human rights groups report a surge in reports of workplace discrimination, suspensions, and even criminal proceedings against Arabs since the war began. Haifa-based lawyer Sawsan Zaher notes a dramatic increase in such cases. One high-profile incident involves Haneen Zoabi, a former Israeli parliament member from the Balad party. Police arrested her and five others at a planned peaceful protest in Nazareth, after they were denied a permit. Their banners read messages like 'Stop Genocide' and 'Stop the war in Gaza.' Zoabi and her colleagues faced allegations of incitement and protesting without a permit. Since the war began, Israeli police have filed numerous indictments for incitement to violence and terror, and have opened multiple cases, though authorities have not released data by ethnicity. Palestinian citizens contend they are being targeted more frequently. An amendment to Israel's counterterrorism law now penalizes even passive consumption of materials deemed supportive of Hamas online. Rights organizations, including Article 19 and Adalah, argue that the law’s broad language threatens free expression and penalizes even passive social media use. Zoabi, experienced with previous detentions, said this arrest felt particularly intimidating, describing police celebrations during her detention. She and others feel such arrests are meant to intimidate the Palestinian community, leaving many afraid to voice their opinions—sometimes to the extent that remaining silent is viewed with suspicion. Despite these challenges, members of Standing Together continue to advocate for peace, painting banners and organizing gatherings where Jews and Palestinians work side by side. Even with personal and professional risks, individuals and groups persist in their pursuit of justice, equality, and peaceful coexistence.

Spanduk-spanduk ini, yang ditulis dalam bahasa Ibrani dan Arab, dipasang di jembatan dan ruang publik untuk menggalang persatuan di tengah konflik yang sedang berlangsung. Samah Abou Shhadeh, seorang ekonom Arab Israel dari Jaffa, mengalami sendiri meningkatnya ketegangan ini. Dua tahun lalu, ia menjadi karyawan Arab pertama di sebuah perusahaan keuangan di Tel Aviv setelah lulus kuliah. Ia merasa harus bekerja lebih keras dan menghindari politik di kantor, namun tetap menjalin hubungan erat dengan rekan-rekannya. Surat itu mengatakan bahwa pada saat perang, diperlukan sensitivitas ekstra dari karyawan. Sekitar 20% warga negara Israel mengidentifikasi sebagai Arab atau Palestina. Banyak yang mengaku telah lama merasa seperti warga kelas dua. Kelompok HAM melaporkan lonjakan laporan diskriminasi di tempat kerja, skorsing, bahkan proses hukum sejak perang dimulai. Pengacara Haifa, Sawsan Zaher, mencatat peningkatan drastis kasus-kasus itu. Salah satu kasus mencuat yaitu penangkapan Haneen Zoabi, mantan anggota parlemen Israel dari partai Balad. Polisi menangkap dia dan lima orang lainnya saat hendak protes damai di Nazareth, setelah izin demonstrasi mereka ditolak. Spanduk mereka bertuliskan pesan seperti 'Hentikan Genosida' dan 'Hentikan perang di Gaza.' Zoabi dan rekan-rekannya didakwa melakukan hasutan dan protes tanpa izin. Sejak perang dimulai, polisi Israel telah mengajukan banyak dakwaan hasutan terhadap kekerasan dan teror, serta membuka banyak kasus baru, walau tidak merinci data berdasar etnis. Warga Palestina berpendapat mereka paling sering jadi sasaran. Amandemen baru undang-undang antiteror Israel kini menghukum bahkan konsumsi pasif materi yang dianggap mendukung Hamas di dunia maya. Organisasi HAM seperti Article 19 dan Adalah menilai, bahasa undang-undang itu terlalu luas dan mengancam kebebasan berpendapat, bahkan untuk penggunaan media sosial yang pasif. Zoabi yang sudah berulang kali mengalami penahanan menyebut penangkapannya kali ini semakin menakutkan dan menggambarkan polisi yang tampak merayakan. Ia dan sumber lain menilai penangkapan seperti ini untuk menakut-nakuti komunitas Palestina, hingga banyak yang takut bersuara—diam sekalipun dianggap mencurigakan. Meski menghadapi tantangan berat, para anggota Standing Together tetap berjuang menggalang perdamaian dengan melukis spanduk dan menjalin kerja sama antarwarga Yahudi dan Palestina. Walaupun berisiko secara pribadi dan profesional, mereka terus berupaya mewujudkan keadilan, kesetaraan, dan hidup berdampingan secara damai.

article_content: Javier-Angel Balboa scored a dramatic late goal to lead Equatorial Guinea to a 1-0 victory over Libya in the opening match of the Africa Cup of Nations on Saturday. The former Real Madrid forward found the net three minutes from time, connecting with Daniel Ekedo's pass before slotting the ball past Libyan goalkeeper Samir Aboud. The co-hosts, alongside neighboring Gabon, had an earlier goal disallowed when Ivan Bolado’s 16th-minute effort was ruled offside. Libya had opportunities to level the score, including a notable attempt by Jamal Mohamed that was saved by Equatorial Guinea's keeper Danilo. Samir Aboud kept Libya in contention with a strong stop from Lawrence Doe’s free kick midway through the second half, but Balboa's late strike ultimately sealed the three points for Equatorial Guinea. The win earned Equatorial Guinea a $1 million bonus, a reward promised by the son of long-serving president Teodoro Obiang Nguema just before the tournament began. Libya's defeat was compounded by controversy when the Moammar Gadhafi-era green flag appeared on the official tournament website. Libyan officials protested and requested that the new black, red, and green national flag, representing the National Transitional Council, be displayed. In the day's other Group A match, Zambia secured a 2-1 win over Senegal. Emmanuel Mayuka and Rainford Kalaba put Zambia ahead by two goals within the first 20 minutes, and despite Dame N'Doye scoring for Senegal in the 74th minute, Zambia held on for a significant victory. Looking ahead, Zambia will face Libya, while Senegal will play against Equatorial Guinea on January 25.

Mantan penyerang Real Madrid itu berhasil mencetak gol tiga menit sebelum waktu normal berakhir, memanfaatkan umpan dari Daniel Ekedo sebelum menaklukkan kiper Libya, Samir Aboud. Sebagai tuan rumah bersama Gabon, Guinea Khatulistiwa sebelumnya sempat mencetak gol melalui Ivan Bolado pada menit ke-16, namun dianulir karena offside. Libya memiliki kesempatan untuk menyamakan kedudukan, termasuk peluang dari Jamal Mohamed yang mampu digagalkan oleh kiper Guinea Khatulistiwa, Danilo. Samir Aboud menjaga peluang Libya tetap hidup dengan menepis tendangan bebas Lawrence Doe di pertengahan babak kedua, namun gol Balboa di menit-menit akhir memastikan kemenangan Guinea Khatulistiwa. Kemenangan ini membuat Guinea Khatulistiwa berhak atas bonus sebesar 1 juta dolar AS, hadiah yang dijanjikan oleh putra presiden Teodoro Obiang Nguema sebelum turnamen dimulai. Kekalahan Libya semakin berat setelah munculnya bendera hijau era Moammar Gadhafi di situs resmi turnamen. Pejabat Libya mengajukan protes dan meminta agar bendera nasional baru berwarna hitam, merah, dan hijau yang mewakili Dewan Transisi Nasional ditampilkan. Pada laga Grup A lainnya, Zambia menang 2-1 atas Senegal. Emmanuel Mayuka dan Rainford Kalaba membawa Zambia unggul dua gol dalam 20 menit pertama. Walau Dame N'Doye memperkecil kedudukan untuk Senegal pada menit ke-74, Zambia tetap bertahan hingga akhir dan meraih kemenangan penting. Selanjutnya, Zambia akan menghadapi Libya, sedangkan Senegal akan bertemu Guinea Khatulistiwa pada 25 Januari.

article_content: Dartmouth College has suspended 64 students accused of cheating in a sports ethics class, charging them with violating the Ivy League school's honor code. College officials confirmed the number of students involved but declined further comment until the appeals process concludes later this month. The students under investigation are mostly athletes enrolled in special classes focusing on ethics and religion. Professor Randall Balmer noticed he was receiving more answers to questions via electronic clickers than there were students present in the class. The alleged cheating involved students passing their handheld electronic clickers to classmates, who then answered questions on their behalf. The situation emerged after Professor Balmer detected this discrepancy during lectures. Professor Balmer described the case as particularly ironic and regrettable, given the course's focus on ethics. He said, 'Many students will likely face a stain on their academic records, and trust between students and teachers has been undermined. I feel deeply saddened by this.' Initial concerns involved 43 of the 280 students in the class, with an additional 21 coming forward after the investigation became public. The college stated that honor code violations are considered 'major misconduct.' According to the campus newspaper The Dartmouth, Professor Balmer chose not to fail the students found guilty of cheating but instead reduced their grades by one letter. More than 70% of the students enrolled in the course are members of Dartmouth athletic teams. Professor Balmer explained, 'Part of my motivation in creating this course was to help student-athletes, who might feel overwhelmed academically, find early success and build confidence in the classroom.'

article_content: A. Altannar’s selection as the 10th Bogd Lama in Mongolia has sparked discussions about privilege and elitism. The country now faces the challenge of balancing its spiritual traditions with economic reliance on China. Originally expected to follow his family's industrial legacy, Altannar, age 8, has become central in a complex dynamic involving the Dalai Lama and the Chinese government. At a young age, Altannar and his identical twin were among a group of boys administered a secret test at a monastery in Ulaanbaatar. Altannar's choice of prayer beads and a bell, and his interaction with monks, were interpreted as significant signs by observers. These signs prompted scholars and monks to consider him as the reincarnation of the Bogd, Mongolia's highest spiritual leader. For years, this identity was kept confidential. In March, the Dalai Lama introduced Altannar publicly at a ceremony in India, celebrating his recognition among Mongolians while also reigniting debates about religious leadership and social class. China officially claims the right to appoint Tibetan Buddhist leaders, including those outside its borders. Mongolia’s acknowledgment of the new Bogd has raised concerns over possible diplomatic and economic repercussions from China. Questions persist about the relevance of recognizing child lamas in contemporary Mongolia and whether the process favors elites. Altannar’s parents, respected professionals, have expressed mixed feelings about their son’s new path, which entails years of spiritual education and responsibility. To protect their sons, the family often keeps Altannar’s and his twin brother’s public appearances together and avoids disclosing which is the reincarnate, aiming to maintain a sense of normalcy. The lengthy selection process for the Bogd involved historical research and matching ancient signs. Altannar’s actions during the ceremony reaffirmed his qualification to the examining monks. The story reflects Mongolia’s religious history, from suppression under communist rule to post-1990s revival, with significant encouragement from the Dalai Lama. Altannar’s family background—including his grandmother’s and mother’s prominence in business—has drawn public scrutiny, with some critics suggesting elite influence. The family disputes claims of privilege, referencing historical traditions of spiritual leaders from noble families. China’s strategies to influence the appointment of Buddhist leaders continue to complicate Mongolia’s position. As Altannar was born in Washington, D.C., his American citizenship has further fueled speculation about international dimensions of his selection. Despite the spotlight, the twins continue with routine education and religious instruction. The family emphasizes that when he turns eighteen, Altannar will be free to choose whether or not to continue as the Bogd. This case illustrates the intersections of tradition, family, politics, and international relations influencing Mongolia today.
translated_content: Pemilihan A. Altannar sebagai Bogd Lama ke-10 di Mongolia memicu diskusi tentang hak istimewa dan elitis. Negara ini kini menghadapi tantangan menyeimbangkan tradisi spiritual dengan ketergantungan ekonomi pada Tiongkok. Awalnya diperkirakan akan mengikuti jejak keluarganya di dunia industri, Altannar, yang berusia 8 tahun, kini ada di pusat dinamika kompleks antara Dalai Lama dan pemerintah Tiongkok. Sejak kecil, Altannar dan saudara kembarnya menjalani tes rahasia di sebuah biara di Ulaanbaatar. Pilihan Altannar terhadap tasbih doa dan lonceng, serta interaksinya dengan para biksu, dianggap sebagai tanda penting oleh para pengamat. Tanda-tanda ini membuat para cendekiawan dan biksu mempertimbangkan dia sebagai reinkarnasi Bogd, pemimpin spiritual tertinggi di Mongolia. Selama bertahun-tahun, identitas ini dirahasiakan. Pada bulan Maret, Dalai Lama memperkenalkan Altannar secara publik dalam sebuah upacara di India. Pengumuman ini disambut baik di Mongolia, namun juga memicu kembali perdebatan tentang kepemimpinan agama dan kelas sosial. Tiongkok secara resmi mengklaim hak menunjuk pemimpin Buddha Tibet, termasuk yang berada di luar wilayahnya. Pengakuan Mongolia atas Bogd yang baru ini menimbulkan kekhawatiran tentang kemungkinan dampak diplomatik dan ekonomi dari Tiongkok. Pertanyaan tetap muncul mengenai relevansi penunjukan lama anak-anak di Mongolia modern dan apakah prosesnya memang cenderung menguntungkan kalangan elit. Orang tua Altannar, yang merupakan profesional terkemuka, menyampaikan perasaan campur aduk mengenai jalan baru putra mereka yang menuntut pendidikan spiritual dan tanggung jawab besar. Demi perlindungan, keluarga seringkali menampilkan Altannar dan saudara kembarnya bersama di hadapan publik tanpa mengungkapkan siapa sebenarnya sang reinkarnasi, demi menjaga suasana normal untuk anak-anak mereka. Proses pemilihan Bogd melibatkan penelitian sejarah dan pencocokan tanda-tanda kuno. Tindakan Altannar saat upacara memperkuat keyakinan para biksu terhadap kelayakannya. Kisah ini mencerminkan sejarah agama di Mongolia: dari penindasan di era komunis hingga kebangkitan pasca-1990-an, didorong secara signifikan oleh Dalai Lama. Latar belakang keluarga Altannar—termasuk nenek dan ibunya yang terkenal di bidang bisnis—menjadi sorotan publik, dengan beberapa kritikus menuding adanya pengaruh elit. Namun, keluarganya menyangkal tudingan itu dan mengacu pada tradisi pemimpin spiritual dari keluarga bangsawan. Upaya Tiongkok untuk mempengaruhi penunjukan pemimpin Buddha terus memperumit posisi Mongolia. Karena Altannar lahir di Washington, D.C., kewarganegaraan Amerikanya memperkuat spekulasi tentang dimensi internasional dari pemilihannya. Meskipun jadi sorotan, saudara kembar ini tetap menjalani pendidikan dan pelatihan agama seperti biasa. Keluarga menegaskan bahwa ketika Altannar berusia 18 tahun, keputusan untuk melanjutkan sebagai Bogd sepenuhnya ada pada dirinya. Kisah ini menyoroti pertemuan antara tradisi, keluarga, politik, dan hubungan internasional yang membentuk Mongolia masa kini.

article_content: Fidel Castro, Cuba's former leader, turned 86, but has not been seen in public since March. Nevertheless, Cubans celebrated his birthday with concerts, special art exhibitions in Havana’s Plaza of the Revolution, and congratulatory messages broadcast by state media. Foreign leaders like Bolivia’s President Evo Morales and Nicaragua’s President Daniel Ortega sent greetings, and the Union of Communist Youth organized a party with a large cake and children singing Cuba’s version of 'Happy Birthday.' Castro relinquished his leadership due to illness in 2006 and officially stepped down in 2008, with his younger brother Raul taking over. The exact details of Castro’s health remain private, though reports suggest complications from diverticulitis. While Fidel no longer governs, he is said to support Raul's economic reforms, and Raul often seeks his counsel. Despite rarely appearing in public, Fidel Castro previously published regular opinion columns called 'Reflections,' which were sometimes cryptic or philosophical. The last of these was published in June. In a letter to Venezuelan President Hugo Chavez in July, Castro reflected on age and the passage of time. With his prolonged absence and fewer published writings, rumors about his health and whereabouts have grown. Opposition blogger Yoani Sanchez questioned if Castro has become a 'virtual figure,' noting the public is still told he is alive despite his absence. Castro remains a significant and admired figure for many Cubans. His birthday was marked by memories and tributes in the Communist Party newspaper Granma, with people recalling their experiences with the former leader. Notably, famous Cuban ballerina Alicia Alonso described her meetings with Castro as both inspiring and nerve-wracking. Even without frequent public appearances, Fidel Castro’s legacy continues to resonate across Cuba.

Meski begitu, rakyat Kuba tetap merayakan ulang tahunnya dengan konser, pameran seni khusus di Plaza of the Revolution Havana, dan pesan selamat yang disiarkan oleh media pemerintah. Pemimpin asing seperti Presiden Bolivia Evo Morales dan Presiden Nikaragua Daniel Ortega mengirimkan ucapan selamat, dan Uni Pemuda Komunis mengadakan pesta dengan kue besar serta anak-anak yang menyanyikan versi lagu 'Selamat Ulang Tahun' khas Kuba. Castro menyerahkan kepemimpinan karena sakit pada tahun 2006 dan secara resmi mengundurkan diri pada 2008, dengan adiknya Raul mengambil alih. Detail tentang kesehatan Castro tetap dirahasiakan, namun laporan menyebut komplikasi dari divertikulitis. Meskipun Fidel tidak lagi memerintah, ia dikabarkan mendukung reformasi ekonomi Raul, dan Raul sering meminta nasihatnya. Meskipun jarang muncul di publik, Fidel Castro sebelumnya rutin menerbitkan kolom opini berjudul 'Reflections,' yang kadang bersifat misterius atau filosofis. Kolom terakhir terbit pada Juni. Dalam suratnya kepada Presiden Venezuela Hugo Chavez pada Juli, Castro merenungkan usia dan perjalanan waktu. Dengan absennya yang berkepanjangan dan semakin jarangnya tulisan, rumor tentang kesehatan dan keberadaan Fidel semakin berkembang. Blogger oposisi Yoani Sanchez mempertanyakan apakah Castro kini menjadi 'figur virtual,' mencatat publik masih diyakinkan bahwa ia masih hidup meski tidak pernah terlihat. Castro tetap menjadi sosok penting dan dikagumi bagi banyak warga Kuba. Ulang tahunnya diperingati dengan kenangan dan penghormatan di surat kabar Partai Komunis, Granma, di mana orang-orang mengenang pengalaman mereka bersama pemimpin tersebut. Penari balet Kuba terkenal, Alicia Alonso, menyebut pertemuannya dengan Castro selalu membawa inspirasi dan rasa gugup. Meski sudah jarang tampil di hadapan publik, warisan Fidel Castro tetap menginspirasi masyarakat Kuba.

article_content: Struggling in the lower ranks of the Bundesliga, Borussia Dortmund is searching for ways to revive their fortunes. Under Jurgen Klopp’s leadership, the club recently found a lighthearted way to address their woes. After pop star Robbie Williams announced he was interested in working in Germany because he was 'bored' with the rock star lifestyle and wanted a 'proper job,' Dortmund seized the chance for some fun on social media. Williams had humorously mentioned playing German soccer but ruled it out due to age, then considered jobs in fashion or with cars. Responding on Facebook, Dortmund showcased their famous Westfalenstadion and offered Williams a unique mix of opportunities—highlighting football, stylish PUMA jerseys, and Opel cars. 'Robbie Williams, honestly: We can offer all of it!' the post read, welcoming him to enjoy thrilling matches at the stadium, check out the jerseys and cars, or simply immerse himself in the spirit of the game. The invitation was clearly tongue-in-cheek, adding a spark of fun to a tough season.

article_content: Peter Banks, a 23-year-old graduate in international studies, made a significant career change from politics to becoming a pastoral assistant at an Anglican church in Cambridge, England. This step marks the start of his path to ordination, which is rare for someone so young. He previously worked for the Liberal Democratic Party in the UK and D66 in the Netherlands. Peter, originally from a village near Winchester, moved to The Hague for university and began attending church mainly to meet other British expatriates. In 2019, a chaplain casually suggested he consider ordination, an idea he initially dismissed due to his earlier atheism and his openness about being gay. The suggestion lingered with him, growing more compelling after Brexit brought him back to England. Searching for opportunities, Peter reached out to Little St. Mary's in Cambridge, which led to an interview and, in January, a position as pastoral assistant. Though his stipend is just £600 a month, Peter feels content with his decision. With church-provided lodging, his main expenses are food and going out. He acknowledges that a church career doesn’t offer great financial rewards; most priests live in church accommodation while working, which can make retirement difficult. Peter’s daily routine includes mass, prayers, staff meetings, home visits for communion, writing sermons, leading prayers, and managing the choir. He finds satisfaction in these longstanding traditions. He notes that clergy are ordinary people, enjoying humor and social activities like anyone else. Addressing his sexuality, Peter observes that although his church does not bless same-sex marriages, several related churches do, and many LGBT clergy live openly with their partners. His prior political experience, particularly skills such as diplomacy and public speaking, aids his pastoral role. While the church and politics are distinct, both involve seeking peace and justice. Helping others through life’s challenges is especially meaningful for him. Peter believes anyone with a true passion should take risks—even without perfect circumstances—to discover what truly suits them.
translated_content: Peter Banks, lulusan studi internasional berusia 23 tahun, telah mengambil langkah besar dalam hidupnya dengan meninggalkan dunia politik untuk menjadi asisten pastoral di sebuah gereja Anglikan di Cambridge, Inggris. Langkah ini merupakan permulaan perjalanan menuju penahbisan, jalur yang tidak biasa bagi orang seusianya. Sebelum beralih ke pekerjaan gereja, Peter pernah bekerja untuk Partai Liberal Demokrat di Inggris dan D66 di Belanda. Ia berasal dari sebuah desa kecil di dekat Winchester, lalu pindah ke Den Haag untuk kuliah dan mulai rutin ke gereja agar bisa berkenalan dengan sesama orang Inggris di sana. Pada 2019, seorang pendeta secara santai menyarankan dirinya mempertimbangkan penahbisan, ide yang awalnya ia anggap tidak mungkin mengingat masa mudanya yang ateis dan fakta bahwa ia secara terbuka gay. Namun saran itu terus terbayang di benaknya dan makin terasa tepat setelah Brexit membawanya kembali ke Inggris. Saat mencari peluang kerja, Peter menghubungi Little St. Mary’s di Cambridge, lalu diterima setelah wawancara dan mulai bekerja sebagai asisten pastoral pada Januari. Meskipun penghasilannya hanya £600 per bulan, Peter tetap merasa puas dengan keputusannya. Karena gereja menyediakan tempat tinggal, pengeluarannya hanya untuk kebutuhan sehari-hari dan bersosialisasi. Ia sadar karier di gereja tidak menawarkan penghasilan besar; kebanyakan imam tinggal di rumah gereja selama masa tugas dan menghadapi tantangan keuangan saat pensiun. Rutinitas hariannya meliputi misa, doa, rapat staf, kunjungan rumah untuk komuni, menulis khotbah, memimpin doa malam, dan menangani paduan suara. Ia merasa nyaman dengan rutinitas kuno ini. Peter ingin membantah stereotip tentang para pekerja gereja—bahwa kami juga manusia biasa yang suka bercanda dan bersosialisasi. Ia juga terbuka soal orientasi seksualnya; meskipun gerejanya sekarang tidak memberkati pernikahan sesama jenis, beberapa gereja se-afiliasi mengizinkan dan memberkatinya. Banyak rohaniwan LGBT yang hidup bersama pasangannya secara terbuka. Kemampuan Peter di dunia politik, seperti diplomasi dan berbicara di depan umum, sangat berguna dalam pekerjaannya sekarang. Meski gereja dan politik bidang berbeda, keduanya sama-sama berfokus pada perwujudan kedamaian dan keadilan. Baginya, membantu orang melalui suka duka kehidupan sangat memuaskan. Peter meyakini, siapa pun yang punya hasrat mendalam harus berani mengambil langkah baru—walau situasinya tidak sempurna—untuk mencari kehidupan yang sesuai dengan hati mereka.

article_content: On Saturday, Baltimore residents came together to grieve the death of 3-year-old McKenzie Elliot, who was fatally struck by a stray bullet on Friday afternoon. Police and the child's mother, 21-year-old Nina Epps, have urged those in the community to share any details that could identify those responsible for McKenzie's death. McKenzie had been sitting on a porch on the 3600 block of Old York Road when gunshots rang out nearby, with one bullet taking her life. 'She meant everything to me,' said Nina, who asked anyone with information to step forward. Baltimore Mayor Stephanie Rawlings-Blake condemned the shooting as 'an act of cowardice.' She distributed flyers announcing a $2,000 reward for information, stressing, 'We cannot remain silent about the loss of a child on our streets.' Deputy Police Commissioner Jerry Rodriguez reported some leads, but maintained that community assistance is still urgently needed. The police assured the public that they are pursuing those responsible. This tragedy follows another violent incident: 20-year-old Devin Cook, a lacrosse player, was shot and killed Thursday night in Park Heights. These events have drawn the community together in mourning and in a shared demand for justice.

McKenzie saat itu sedang duduk di teras rumah di blok 3600 Old York Road ketika terdengar tembakan dari kejauhan; satu peluru menewaskannya. 'Dia segalanya bagiku,' kata Nina, yang meminta siapa pun yang tahu sesuatu untuk segera berbicara. Wali Kota Baltimore, Stephanie Rawlings-Blake, mengutuk penembakan itu sebagai 'tindakan pengecut.' Ia membagikan selebaran berisi penawaran hadiah sebesar $2.000 untuk informasi, dan menegaskan, 'Kita tidak boleh diam atas gugurnya seorang anak di jalanan kota kita.' Pihak kepolisian memastikan bahwa mereka akan terus memburu pelaku yang bertanggung jawab. Tragedi ini terjadi setelah insiden kekerasan lain: Devin Cook, pemain lacrosse berusia 20 tahun, juga ditembak mati pada Kamis malam di Park Heights. Kejadian-kejadian ini membuat masyarakat bersatu dalam duka dan tuntutan keadilan.

article_content: After years of debate, the UK's Online Safety Bill has officially become law. According to an October 26 report from TechRadar, the bill received Royal Assent on October 26, 2023, marking the final step before it is enacted. Despite its passage, many technology experts and civil liberties organizations remain deeply concerned about the regulation’s potential impact on internet freedom and privacy. The Online Safety Bill aims to make the internet safer, especially for children, by placing new requirements on social media platforms, search engines, and other online services. Companies such as Facebook, TikTok, and Google now have a legal 'duty of care' to protect users from harmful content. The 300-page bill requires tech firms to proactively identify and remove illegal content—including child sexual abuse, revenge porn, hate speech, harassment, and terrorism. Companies that fail to comply face fines of up to £18 million or 10% of their global revenue, whichever is higher. The law also requires platforms to offer adult users optional tools to filter out content that is legal but potentially harmful. Tech companies must verify users’ ages, enforce age restrictions, and prevent children from viewing inappropriate material. Parents have the right to access information held about their children and request its deletion. The bill introduces new criminal offenses, including cyberflashing and sharing AI-generated pornographic images. While the law’s intentions are considered positive by some, digital rights advocates caution that several provisions could threaten encryption and increase government surveillance powers. For example, Clause 122 allows authorities to access encrypted messages to detect illegal material, though the government has postponed this requirement until the technology is available. Experts warn that adding 'backdoors' to encrypted apps like WhatsApp and Signal could weaken privacy and security for all users, making systems more vulnerable to abuse. Several secure communication services, such as Proton and Element, have said they will not comply with decryption demands, arguing that these measures violate users’ privacy rights. Some have even threatened to withdraw their services from the UK. Matthew Hodgson, CEO of Element, noted that the company has introduced legal clauses to assure customers it will not implement government-mandated client-side scanning. Critics also worry that vague definitions in the bill could cause companies to over-censor legal content or political speech for fear of penalties, which might indirectly enable government control over online conversations. While improving child safety and combating cybercrime are widely supported goals, digital rights organizations urge policymakers to proceed with caution. They argue that the bill’s broad requirements could do more harm than good by undermining encryption and risking increased surveillance and censorship online. translated_content: Setelah bertahun-tahun perdebatan, RUU Keamanan Online Inggris akhirnya resmi menjadi undang-undang. Menurut laporan TechRadar pada 26 Oktober, RUU tersebut menerima Persetujuan Kerajaan pada 26 Oktober 2023, menandai langkah terakhir sebelum diberlakukan. Meski telah disahkan, banyak pakar teknologi dan organisasi kebebasan sipil yang masih sangat khawatir terhadap dampak regulasi ini terhadap kebebasan dan privasi di internet. RUU Keamanan Online bertujuan membuat internet lebih aman, terutama untuk anak-anak, dengan menetapkan persyaratan baru bagi platform media sosial, mesin pencari, dan layanan daring lainnya. Perusahaan seperti Facebook, TikTok, dan Google kini memiliki 'tanggung jawab hukum' untuk melindungi pengguna dari konten berbahaya. RUU setebal 300 halaman ini mewajibkan perusahaan teknologi secara proaktif mengidentifikasi dan menghapus konten ilegal—termasuk pelecehan seksual anak, pornografi balas dendam, ujaran kebencian, pelecehan, dan terorisme. Perusahaan yang gagal mematuhi dapat dikenai denda hingga £18 juta atau 10% dari pendapatan global, mana yang lebih besar. Undang-undang ini juga mewajibkan platform menyediakan alat opsional bagi pengguna dewasa untuk memfilter konten yang legal tapi berpotensi berbahaya. Perusahaan teknologi juga harus memverifikasi usia pengguna, menegakkan batasan usia, dan mencegah anak-anak mengakses materi yang tidak pantas. Orang tua berhak mengakses data tentang anak mereka dan meminta agar data tersebut dihapus. RUU ini juga memperkenalkan tindak pidana baru, termasuk cyberflashing dan penyebaran gambar pornografi hasil kecerdasan buatan. Meski niat undang-undang ini dianggap positif oleh sebagian pihak, para pegiat hak digital memperingatkan bahwa beberapa ketentuannya dapat mengancam enkripsi dan meningkatkan kekuasaan pengawasan pemerintah. Misalnya, Klausul 122 memungkinkan pihak berwenang mengakses pesan terenkripsi untuk mendeteksi materi ilegal, namun pemerintah menunda penerapan pasal ini hingga teknologi yang diperlukan tersedia. Para ahli memperingatkan bahwa penambahan 'backdoor' ke aplikasi terenkripsi seperti WhatsApp dan Signal dapat melemahkan privasi dan keamanan seluruh pengguna, sehingga rentan disalahgunakan. Beberapa layanan komunikasi aman seperti Proton dan Element telah menyatakan tidak akan memenuhi tuntutan dekripsi, dengan alasan bahwa langkah ini melanggar hak privasi pengguna. Bahkan, ada perusahaan yang mengancam akan menarik layanan mereka dari Inggris. CEO Element, Matthew Hodgson, menyatakan bahwa perusahaannya telah menambahkan klausul hukum untuk meyakinkan pelanggan bahwa mereka tidak akan menerapkan pemindaian sisi klien yang diwajibkan pemerintah. Kritikus juga khawatir definisi yang tidak jelas dalam RUU ini bisa menyebabkan perusahaan berlebihan dalam menyaring konten legal atau ucapan politik karena takut terkena sanksi, yang secara tidak langsung dapat memberi pemerintah kendali atas percakapan daring. Walaupun upaya meningkatkan keamanan anak dan memerangi kejahatan siber didukung banyak pihak, organisasi hak digital mendesak para pembuat kebijakan untuk lebih berhati-hati. Mereka berpendapat bahwa persyaratan yang luas dalam RUU ini justru bisa berdampak buruk dengan melemahkan enkripsi dan berisiko meningkatkan pengawasan serta penyensoran di internet. article_content: Caroline Alexander, who manages King’s Heath Cat Club, rescued four tiny kittens that had been abandoned inside a bag on a busy Birmingham road late at night. After hearing a car stop and speed away outside her Bank Street home, Alexander found the kittens on the pavement. The animals were extremely dehydrated, underweight, and covered in fleas. Acting quickly, Alexander, 33, took them to Cramar Cat Rescue and Sanctuary in Hopwood. Sue Warren from Cramar Cat Rescue said the kittens were simply left on the street and were in serious condition—barely able to breathe or walk due to dehydration. She added that if they hadn’t been found when they were, they might not have survived. Rescue staff remain concerned about what happened to the kittens' mother. The five-week-old kittens were treated by a veterinarian for dehydration and their heavy flea infestations. Rachael, a supervisor at Cramar, described this case as one of the most severe she’s seen in her eight years at the shelter, especially the level of flea infestation. The kittens received immediate medical attention due to their tiny size and weakness from the heat. Now named Dime, Dollar, Penny, and Tuppence, the kittens have all found new homes and are thriving. Rachael noted their friendly nature made it easy to find families willing to adopt them. For those interested in adopting from Cramar Cat Rescue and Sanctuary, information can be obtained by calling 0121 445 1840.
translated_content: Caroline Alexander, yang mengelola King’s Heath Cat Club, menyelamatkan empat anak kucing kecil yang dibuang di dalam tas di jalan ramai Birmingham pada larut malam. Dengan sigap, Alexander, 33 tahun, membawa mereka ke Cramar Cat Rescue and Sanctuary di Hopwood. Sue Warren dari Cramar Cat Rescue mengatakan anak-anak kucing itu benar-benar ditinggalkan di jalan dan kondisinya sangat memprihatinkan—hampir tidak bisa bernapas atau berjalan akibat dehidrasi. Ia menambahkan bahwa jika mereka tidak segera ditemukan, kemungkinan besar sudah tidak selamat. Staf penyelamat masih khawatir tentang keberadaan induk kucing mereka. Anak-anak kucing berumur lima minggu itu langsung dibawa ke dokter hewan untuk diobati karena dehidrasi dan serangan kutu yang parah. Rachael, pengawas di Cramar, menyebutkan kasus ini salah satu yang terburuk yang pernah ia tangani selama delapan tahun bekerja di penampungan, terutama karena banyaknya kutu. Mereka segera menerima perawatan karena tubuhnya sangat kecil dan lemas akibat cuaca panas. Kini, keempat kucing tersebut telah mendapatkan nama baru—Dime, Dollar, Penny, dan Tuppence—dan semuanya sudah mendapatkan rumah baru yang penuh kasih. article_content: The NHL has suspended Ottawa Senators forward Shane Pinto for 41 games, making the 22-year-old American the first modern-era hockey player banned for sports gambling. The league said the half-season suspension was for 'activities relating to sports wagering,' but found no evidence that Pinto bet on NHL games. Further details about the violation or how Pinto was discovered were not released. Pinto issued a statement through the team, apologizing to the NHL, the Ottawa Senators, his teammates, fans, the city of Ottawa, and especially his family, accepting full responsibility and expressing his desire to return to play. He is not appealing the suspension, which was agreed upon by the NHL, Pinto, and the NHL Players' Association, effectively closing the case unless new information emerges. Senators coach D.J. Smith said the team would support Pinto and welcome him back when he becomes eligible to return midseason, provided he signs a contract. Pinto remains an unsigned restricted free agent, and this suspension helps explain his lack of contract. The Senators described Pinto as a valued member of the organization, acknowledging his poor decisions while reaffirming their commitment to support him. They emphasized backing the NHL's gambling rules and pledged to help Pinto address his issues so he can be a positive member of the community. Pinto joins a growing list of professional athletes punished for gambling since the 2018 U.S. Supreme Court ruling that legalized sports betting in many states. At least 10 NFL players have been suspended recently, including Calvin Ridley, who missed the entire 2022 season for betting on league games. The NBA and MLB have not recently announced gambling-related suspensions, but concerns persist across college sports. Industry estimates indicate Americans have wagered over $220 billion on sports since the Supreme Court's decision. The NHL's collective bargaining agreement prohibits gambling on league games, and teams may forbid employees from joining paid fantasy leagues. The Senators were the first NHL team to feature a gambling sponsor on their helmets, with Bet99 and now Betway. The league previously investigated Evander Kane for alleged gambling but found no evidence of wrongdoing. The last NHL players suspended for gambling before Pinto were Billy Taylor, Don Gallinger, and Babe Pratt in the 1940s.

article_content: Southampton defender Jos Hooiveld has joined Millwall on loan until the end of the season. The 31-year-old has not made any appearances for Southampton this season under their new manager, Ronald Koeman. Hooiveld is Millwall's sixth signing of the January transfer window, following Paris Cowan-Hall, Dan Harding, Stefan Maierhofer, Shaun Cummings, and Diego Fabbrini to The New Den. Hooiveld, a former Celtic centre-back, is eligible to make his debut for Millwall in their upcoming Championship home match against Reading on Tuesday. 'I want as much success as possible - as many wins and as many clean sheets as we can get - which is what every footballer hopes for,' Hooiveld told Millwall's official website. 'It's very important to be playing regularly, and I'm no different from anyone else.' Earlier in the season, Hooiveld made six appearances while on loan at Norwich City, but he has not featured for the Canaries since November. He will wear the number 5 shirt at Millwall.

Hooiveld, bek tengah yang pernah bermain untuk Celtic, berpeluang melakukan debutnya bersama Millwall pada laga kandang Championship melawan Reading hari Selasa mendatang. 'Saya ingin meraih sebanyak mungkin kesuksesan - sebanyak mungkin kemenangan dan clean sheet - itulah harapan setiap pesepak bola,' kata Hooiveld kepada situs resmi Millwall. article_content: On October 7th, Israel endured a devastating attack that deeply affected the nation and left lasting emotional scars. In the aftermath, citizens, tech firms, and organizations quickly mobilized to provide essential support. Volunteers distributed food, medical aid, and supplies, and assisted bereaved families and border communities with harvesting and other urgent needs. Children have suffered especially severe impacts—many have lost one or both parents, or are still unsure about their relatives’ whereabouts. Immediate emotional support and restoring stability and routine are seen as vital for their recovery. To address these needs, Sheatufim and Zionism 2000 launched Resilience for Our Children (Yeladenu), a national emergency initiative aimed at helping traumatized children. Drawing on Israel’s fast-paced, innovative culture, the program rapidly deployed services for those most affected by the crisis. Ronny Douek, one of the initiative’s founders, stated that helping children build resilience is crucial for their futures and the nation’s strength. As the conflict continues, the plan adapts to changing circumstances, providing reassurance to both children and their families. The initiative quickly built resilience centers—safe, supportive spaces offering activities, therapy, and social connection. Within ten days, the first center was operational, equipped with activity areas and treatment rooms. The team works across emotional support, daily care, recreation, and education to meet children’s diverse needs. Serving over 10,000 children between ages 6 and 18, the operation uses a collaborative approach involving civil society, businesses, and government entities. Advanced technologies from partners like Palo Alto Networks, Google, and Monday.com help coordinate resources and scale services efficiently. Sheatufim and Zionism 2000 have a track record of leading emergency initiatives that are later adopted as national programs, such as pandemic support for seniors. The campaign relies on donations from organizations like JFNA, the Blavatnik Family Foundation, and several large tech firms, with ongoing fundraising to cover long-term operations. Israeli President Isaac Herzog and global partners have commended the project, viewing it as a symbol of Israel’s unity and resilience, particularly in supporting its youth. Organizers stress that safeguarding children’s well-being will help build a stronger future for the country. Through emerging civic leadership and decisive collective action, Israel is addressing its most pressing challenges to ensure its vulnerable children receive the care and attention they need during these difficult times.

article_content: For the second time in a month, a man has been pushed to his death in front of a train on a New York City subway platform, according to police. The New York Police Department on Friday identified the victim as Sunando Sen, 46, of Queens. Authorities are searching for a woman seen fleeing an elevated station for the No. 7 train in Queens on Thursday evening, Deputy Commissioner Paul Browne said. Witnesses reported that the woman was pacing the platform and talking to herself before pushing the man onto the tracks as an 11-car train entered the station. Sen was pinned under the second car after the train stopped. Police described the suspect as a heavyset woman in her 20s, wearing a ski jacket and sneakers. Security footage captured her running from the scene shortly after 8 p.m. Thursday. Sen's roommate, Ar Suman, 33, told CNN on Friday that after living together for over a year, they had become like family. 'I came home and I heard this happened,' Suman said. 'I am feeling very bad.' Sen owned a shop called New Amsterdam Copies and was a graphic designer for posters, Suman added. In early December, Ki-Suck Han, 58, was also pushed onto the tracks at a Times Square station as a train approached. Naeem Davis, 30, a homeless man, has been charged with second-degree murder in that case. CNN's Jesse Solomon and Rande Iaboni contributed to this report.

Pihak berwenang sedang mencari seorang wanita yang terlihat melarikan diri dari stasiun layang kereta No. 7 di Queens pada Kamis malam, kata Wakil Komisaris Paul Browne. Saksi melaporkan bahwa wanita tersebut mondar-mandir di peron dan berbicara sendiri sebelum mendorong korban ke rel saat kereta 11 gerbong masuk stasiun. Sen terjepit di bawah gerbong kedua setelah kereta berhenti. Polisi menggambarkan tersangka sebagai wanita bertubuh besar berusia 20-an, mengenakan jaket ski dan sepatu kets. Rekaman CCTV menunjukkan dia berlari dari tempat kejadian tak lama setelah pukul 8 malam, Kamis. Teman serumah Sen, Ar Suman, 33 tahun, mengatakan kepada CNN pada hari Jumat bahwa setelah tinggal bersama lebih dari setahun, mereka sudah seperti keluarga. 'Saya pulang dan mendengar kejadian ini,' kata Suman. 'Saya benar-benar sedih.' Sen memiliki toko bernama New Amsterdam Copies dan bekerja sebagai desainer grafis untuk poster, tambah Suman. Pada awal Desember, Ki-Suck Han, 58 tahun, juga didorong ke rel di stasiun Times Square saat kereta mendekat. Naeem Davis, 30 tahun, seorang tunawisma, didakwa dengan pembunuhan tingkat dua dalam kasus itu. Jesse Solomon dan Rande Iaboni dari CNN berkontribusi untuk laporan ini.

article_content: James Moreland and Lee-Ann O’Donoghue, a British couple, had their 14-month-old daughter taken into emergency care while vacationing in Portugal after reports alleged they were intoxicated and endangered their child. The couple denies these accusations, stating that police acted with excessive force, handcuffed them, and cited the 'Madeleine McCann effect' as the reason for their approach. They further claim that Mr. Moreland was assaulted by police and their holiday spending money was stolen. The incident occurred at Hotel Paraiso in Albufeira during a Thomas Cook holiday. Unnamed hotel guests reported concerns about the couple's behavior, but the parents strongly dispute these claims. Portuguese police responded and referred the case to local social services. The couple’s daughter was returned to them on Tuesday. A police spokesperson said authorities were called due to reports of a drunk and disorderly disturbance.

Pasangan ini membantah tuduhan tersebut, menyatakan bahwa polisi bertindak berlebihan dengan memborgol mereka dan menyebutkan 'efek Madeleine McCann' sebagai alasan. Mereka juga mengklaim bahwa Mr. Moreland dipukul polisi dan uang liburan mereka hilang. Insiden ini terjadi di Hotel Paraiso, Albufeira, selama liburan bersama Thomas Cook. Polisi Portugal menanggapi laporan itu dan meneruskan kasus ke layanan sosial setempat. Anak mereka dikembalikan pada hari Selasa. Seorang juru bicara polisi mengatakan mereka dipanggil karena adanya laporan keributan akibat mabuk.

article_content: OpenAI has temporarily paused sign-ups for its premium ChatGPT Plus subscription due to unexpectedly high demand following its first developer conference, DevDay. OpenAI founder and CEO Sam Altman announced on X (formerly Twitter) that usage after the event has exceeded the company's capacity. In his post, Altman stated, 'We are pausing new ChatGPT Plus sign-ups for a bit. The surge in usage post-DevDay has exceeded our capacity, and we want to ensure everyone has a great experience. You can still sign up in the app to be notified when subscriptions reopen.' OpenAI’s first DevDay, held in San Francisco’s Hayes Valley on November 6, brought together about 900 developers. The conference served as both a product launch and an opportunity to preview OpenAI’s commercial plans for artificial intelligence. During the keynote, Altman introduced several new features, including a GPT store, expected to launch later this month. The company is also enabling users to create custom versions of ChatGPT for specific purposes. Additionally, OpenAI launched the GPT-4 Turbo large language model, which offers current data, is easier to use, and is more affordable for developers. In other news, India’s economy is projected to grow by 6.7% in the July-September quarter, based on a survey of 10 economists, with the services sector driving the expansion. There is ongoing debate in India's telecom sector about the proposed technology to broadcast TV content directly to mobile phones without cellular data, with major industry players expressing concerns over its maturity. India is considering raising the GST evasion threshold for arrest and prosecution to ₹3 crore from ₹2 crore, aiming to reduce business harassment and improve ease of doing business.

article_content: Antonia Benitez, 35, from Santa Ana, California, faces several felony charges for allegedly starving her 4-year-old daughter. The child weighed only 18 pounds, far below the average 34 pounds for her age, according to national statistics. Benitez was arrested after taking her daughter, who was malnourished and had an infected leg, to the hospital last month. Hospital staff reported the case to social services, which then involved the police. Authorities say Benitez was the sole caregiver for her nine children. Since her arrest, her children have been placed in the care of social services or family members. The Orange County District Attorney has filed three felony child abuse charges against her, and she is scheduled to appear in court today. If she is found guilty, she could spend up to 14 years and six months in prison. It emerged that Benitez had previously brought her daughter to a hospital in July 2012 over concerns about her low weight, but that incident was not reported to police. The ongoing case has raised serious concerns about child welfare oversight.

Pihak rumah sakit lalu melaporkan kasus ini ke layanan sosial yang kemudian menghubungi polisi. Pihak berwenang menyatakan Benitez merawat sendiri sembilan anaknya. Setelah penangkapannya, anak-anaknya kini diasuh oleh layanan sosial atau kerabat keluarga. Kejaksaan Orange County telah mengajukan tiga dakwaan kejahatan pelecehan anak padanya, dan Benitez dijadwalkan hadir di pengadilan hari ini. Kasus ini menyoroti perhatian serius terkait pengawasan kesejahteraan anak.

article_content: The central government of India has launched retail sales of chana dal under the brand 'Bharat Dal' at a subsidized price of Rs 60 per kg (1 kg pack), aiming to make pulses more affordable. Bharat Dal is sold through NAFED, NCCF, Kendriya Bhandar, and Safal outlets. Additionally, the government has introduced 'Bharat Atta,' selling wheat flour at Rs 27.50 per kg nationwide via over 2,000 NAFED, NCCF, and Kendriya Bhandar outlets. To enhance availability, 800 mobile vans are also distributing Bharat Atta and Bharat Dal. To stabilize prices and protect consumers from volatility, the government maintains buffer stocks of chana, tur, urad, moong, and masur under the Price Stabilisation Fund. These are released strategically into the market. Imports of tur and urad are permitted freely until March 2024, and import duty on masur has been reduced to strengthen domestic supply. For Bharat Atta, 2.5 lakh tonnes of wheat from the Food Corporation of India will be allocated to NAFED, NCCF, and Kendriya Bhandar at Rs 21.50 per kg for conversion into wheat flour, to be sold at Rs 27.50 per kg under the Bharat Atta brand. Separately, the Indian Income Tax Department is investigating Apple, Google, and Amazon's Indian units for possible non-compliance with transfer pricing rules. This ongoing probe began in 2021 and involves queries to the companies. Indians have become the largest group of property buyers in Dubai, playing a major role in its real estate market. Razorpay, a digital payments company, is planning to relocate its parent company to India through a cross-country merger, which may result in a US tax liability of $250-300 million.

Bharat Dal dijual melalui outlet NAFED, NCCF, Kendriya Bhandar, dan Safal. Selain itu, pemerintah juga memperkenalkan 'Bharat Atta', menjual tepung gandum seharga Rp 27,50 per kg secara nasional melalui lebih dari 2.000 outlet NAFED, NCCF, dan Kendriya Bhandar. Untuk meningkatkan ketersediaan, 800 mobil van juga mendistribusikan Bharat Atta dan Bharat Dal. Untuk menstabilkan harga dan melindungi konsumen dari volatilitas, pemerintah menjaga stok penyangga chana, tur, urad, moong, dan masur di bawah Dana Stabilitas Harga. Stok ini dilepas ke pasar secara strategis. Impor tur dan urad diizinkan tanpa batasan hingga Maret 2024, dan bea masuk masur dikurangi untuk memperkuat pasokan dalam negeri. Untuk Bharat Atta, 2,5 lakh ton gandum dari Food Corporation of India akan dialokasikan ke NAFED, NCCF, dan Kendriya Bhandar seharga Rp 21,50 per kg untuk diolah menjadi tepung gandum yang akan dijual seharga Rp 27,50 per kg dengan merek Bharat Atta. Secara terpisah, Departemen Pajak Penghasilan India sedang menyelidiki unit Apple, Google, dan Amazon di India terkait dugaan ketidakpatuhan pada aturan transfer pricing. Penyelidikan ini dimulai pada 2021 dan masih berjalan, melibatkan permintaan penjelasan pada perusahaan tersebut. Orang India kini menjadi pembeli properti terbesar di Dubai, berperan besar dalam pasar real estate kota tersebut. Razorpay, perusahaan pembayaran digital, berencana memindahkan perusahaan induknya ke India melalui merger lintas negara, langkah yang bisa menimbulkan kewajiban pajak di AS sebesar $250-300 juta.

article_content: Noble Group was founded in Hong Kong in 1987 by CEO Richard Elman. This year marks the company’s 20th anniversary. Over its 20-year history, the Group has grown its global network to more than 40 countries with over 80 offices. Starting from its roots in the metals industry, Noble Group has diversified its portfolio to include a wide range of products in the agricultural, industrial, and energy sectors. Recognized by BusinessWeek for its forward-thinking approach, some Noble executives have conducted business in China for more than 35 years and were among the early entrants in Ethanol and Carbon Credits. Today, Noble Group is one of the world’s largest suppliers of essential raw materials. The company builds and manages global supply chains, transporting products from low-cost producers, such as those in South America and Australia, to high-growth markets, including China and India. Noble Group currently manages more than 20 product lines, ranging from clean fuels to grains, sugar, steel, coal, coffee, iron ore, and cotton, contributing to its $10.1 billion in revenues for the second quarter of 2007. Including its plants, warehouses, port operations, and managed vessels, Noble Group employs approximately 10,000 people worldwide. The company was the world’s top stock performer from 2001 to 2005, according to Forbes, was included for the second consecutive year on Forbes’ Fabulous 50 public companies in Asia, and was named a Best Employer in 2003 and 2005 by Hewitt Associates.

Diakui oleh BusinessWeek berkat visi ke depan, beberapa eksekutif Noble telah menjalankan bisnis di Tiongkok selama lebih dari 35 tahun dan menjadi pelopor dalam bidang etanol dan kredit karbon. Recent disclosures highlight that the UK government hired consultants for up to £3,000 a day, raising questions about the use of taxpayer money. Last year, at least 30 high-earning specialists worked with six government departments: the Department for Transport, Ministry of Justice, Department for Energy and Climate Change, Home Office, Treasury, and Ministry of Defence. Most consultants received £1,000 to £2,000 per day, while the Ministry of Defence admitted to paying £3,000 a day, exceeding an annual equivalent of £1 million.

Data shared with the BBC indicates government spending on consultants reached £317 million in 2013. While officials state this represents a 75% reduction since 2009, the Ministry of Defence reported an additional £137 million spent on technical consultants outside that main total. These figures, obtained through a Freedom of Information request, have attracted criticism from campaigners and unions demanding greater transparency and more detailed accounting for these expenses.

Jonathan Isaby of the Taxpayers' Alliance criticized high consultant pay, especially while civil service numbers decrease, suggesting this might not deliver genuine savings. Leslie Manasseh of the Prospect union said that taxpayers are entitled to know how their money is being spent, pointing to a lack of clear information about individual consultant earnings even though pay details for senior officials and politicians are public.

The government, without confirming how many consultants earn over £1,000 daily, maintains that tighter spending controls have been implemented. Officials say that only specialized roles, necessary for complex projects where skills are lacking in the public sector, are approved.

Tahun lalu, setidaknya 30 spesialis berpenghasilan tinggi bekerja di enam departemen pemerintah: Departemen Transportasi, Kementerian Kehakiman, Departemen Energi dan Perubahan Iklim, Kementerian Dalam Negeri, Departemen Keuangan, dan Kementerian Pertahanan. Sebagian besar konsultan menerima £1.000 hingga £2.000 per hari, sementara Kementerian Pertahanan mengakui membayar £3.000 per hari, setara lebih dari £1 juta per tahun.

Data yang dibagikan kepada BBC menunjukkan belanja pemerintah untuk konsultan mencapai £317 juta pada tahun 2013. Meski para pejabat menyatakan angka ini sudah turun 75% dibandingkan tahun 2009, Kementerian Pertahanan melaporkan pengeluaran tambahan sebesar £137 juta untuk konsultan teknis di luar jumlah utama tersebut. Angka-angka ini, yang diperoleh melalui permintaan Freedom of Information, memicu kritik dari kelompok advokasi dan serikat pekerja yang menuntut transparansi dan rincian pengeluaran yang lebih jelas.

Jonathan Isaby dari Taxpayers’ Alliance mengkritik tingginya bayaran konsultan, khususnya saat jumlah pegawai negeri sipil menurun, dan meragukan apakah langkah ini menghasilkan penghematan anggaran yang sesungguhnya. Leslie Manasseh dari serikat Prospect menegaskan bahwa pembayar pajak berhak mengetahui penggunaan dana mereka secara rinci, apalagi rincian penghasilan para konsultan masih tidak transparan, sementara gaji pejabat publik lain diumumkan.

Pemerintah, walau tidak menyebut berapa banyak konsultan yang menerima lebih dari £1.000 per hari, menegaskan pengawasan anggaran sekarang makin ketat. Pejabat menjelaskan hanya peran-peran khusus untuk proyek rumit yang membutuhkan keahlian yang belum tersedia di sektor publik yang dapat diizinkan.

article_content: At Prince George's christening at St James's Palace in London, the British Royal Family and the Middleton family presented a coordinated fashion front, favoring cream and blue attire for the event. The Duchess of Cambridge, Pippa Middleton, the Duchess of Cornwall, and Prince George himself all chose ivory outfits, while Zara Tindall and the Queen wore sophisticated navy and powder blue. Carole Middleton blended both colours, wearing a navy coat over a cream dress. Prince George donned a detailed lace gown replicating the historic christening robe made for Queen Victoria’s oldest child, upholding a royal tradition that dates back to 1841. Kate Middleton wore a ruffled ivory Alexander McQueen suit paired with a Jane Taylor straw pillbox hat for her son's significant day. Pippa Middleton selected a customized cream wool coat and Paris dress from designer Suzannah, featuring blush pink trim and an oyster silk lining. She accessorized with a fashionable Edwina Ibbotson hat and a pale blush clutch. Designer Suzannah expressed her excitement over creating the outfit, drawing from vintage styles and past influences. The Duchess of Cornwall, Camilla, wore a textured cream coat and dress, matched with pearls and a dramatic feathered hat. Queen Elizabeth II appeared in a sky blue cashmere coat by Stewart Parvin over a paisley silk dress, highlighted by mother-of-pearl buttons. Zara Tindall, around six months pregnant at the time, wore a stylish navy coat and dress with nude heels. Carole Middleton, mother of Kate, completed her look with a large cream hat and attended the ceremony with her husband Michael and their children. The article also references a prior royal gathering at the Order of the Garter service, where female royals wore complementary shades of cream and blush. There’s a lighthearted suggestion that these fashion themes might be prearranged, and a hope for bolder colours at future royal events.

article_content: The National Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission ordered Dr. Kabir Dutta to pay Rs 25 lakh to Kanika Das after her husband, Himangshu Das—a pharmacist with the West Bengal government—died following alleged medical negligence. In 2015, Himangshu Das visited Dr. Dutta with complaints of cough, fever, and vomiting. Despite a negative tuberculosis (TB) test, Dr. Dutta prescribed anti-tubercular medications. The prolonged use of these drugs, including rifampicin and isoniazid, caused serious side effects that severely damaged his liver and resulted in multiple organ failure, according to two other doctors. The commission noted that even after Das reported symptoms like discolored urine, Dr. Dutta advised him to continue the medication rather than stopping it. Dr. Dutta denied any negligence, saying he followed medical standards based on his 30 years of experience. The commission considered Das’s monthly salary of over Rs 30,000 and provident fund deductions of Rs 12,000 to estimate the family’s income loss at over Rs 27 lakh, but granted just over Rs 9.7 lakh due to lack of full family details. Kanika Das also received Rs 13.1 lakh for medical expenses and Rs 2 lakh for funeral costs, bringing the total compensation to Rs 25 lakh.
translated_content: Komisi Nasional Penyelesaian Sengketa Konsumen memerintahkan Dr. Kabir Dutta membayar kompensasi sebesar Rs 25 lakh kepada Kanika Das setelah suaminya, Himangshu Das—seorang apoteker pemerintah Benggala Barat—meninggal akibat dugaan kelalaian medis. Pada 2015, Himangshu Das mengunjungi Dr. Dutta dengan keluhan batuk, demam, dan muntah. Meskipun hasil tes tuberkulosis (TB) negatif, Dr. Dutta tetap meresepkan obat anti-TB. Penggunaan obat-obatan tersebut dalam waktu lama, termasuk rifampisin dan isoniazid, menimbulkan efek samping serius yang menyebabkan kerusakan hati berat dan gagal organ multipel menurut dua dokter lain. Komisi mencatat bahwa meskipun Das mengeluhkan gejala seperti perubahan warna urin, Dr. Dutta tetap memintanya melanjutkan obat alih-alih menghentikan pengobatan. Dr. Dutta membantah adanya kelalaian, dengan menyatakan bahwa ia mengikuti standar medis berdasarkan pengalaman lebih dari 30 tahun. Komisi memperhitungkan gaji bulanan Das lebih dari Rs 30.000 serta potongan dana pensiun sebesar Rs 12.000, sehingga memperkirakan kerugian pendapatan keluarga lebih dari Rs 27 lakh, namun hanya mengabulkan lebih dari Rs 9,7 lakh akibat kurangnya data lengkap tentang anggota keluarga. Kanika Das juga memperoleh Rs 13,1 lakh untuk biaya medis dan Rs 2 lakh untuk biaya pemakaman, sehingga total kompensasi menjadi Rs 25 lakh.

article_content: Dr. Benjamin Chang, 54, an orthopaedic specialist with consulting rooms on Harley Street in north London, has been arrested on suspicion of submitting false physiotherapy invoices to insurance companies. He is alleged to have provided fraudulent accident treatment claims for patients. Detectives from the City of London Police interviewed Dr. Chang in November this year, and officers reportedly searched his private surgery and his £1.1 million home in north London in connection with the investigation. Dr. Chang previously became controversial after participating in an elephant hunting trip in Zimbabwe in 2009, where he was photographed posing with animals he had killed, including elephants and a lioness. He was part of a hunting party in Hwange National Park that legally culled a herd of 11 elephants to address environmental concerns. The cull was permitted by the Zimbabwean government, and most of the funds reportedly went to park authorities. Dr. Chang explained the cull as a benefit to local communities, noting that the elephant meat was distributed to villagers. He told The Times, 'The meat goes to the village. They are queuing at the camp saying, "Please give us the meat." I was told one elephant will feed one village for three and a half months.' He also defended the practice of foreigners paying to hunt elephants, arguing that local authorities lacked the appropriate resources. Dr. Chang trained as a doctor in Ireland and is listed as director of Milton Medical Centre in Luton, with headquarters in Kenley, Surrey. His wife, Corrina Chang, is the company secretary. Dr. Chang is registered with the General Medical Council but has not held a licence to practise medicine since August. A spokesperson for the City of London Police stated: 'Insurance Fraud Enforcement Department detectives investigating suspected fake invoices for physiotherapy treatment arrested a 54-year-old man from north London on suspicion of fraud by false representation. He was released on police bail and is due to return in March 2015.' Attempts to contact Dr. Chang for comment have been unsuccessful.

Ia diduga membuat klaim perawatan kecelakaan palsu untuk pasien. Detektif dari City of London Police mewawancarai Dr. Chang pada November tahun ini, dan petugas dilaporkan menggeledah klinik pribadi serta rumahnya senilai £1,1 juta di London utara terkait penyelidikan ini. Dr. Chang sebelumnya menjadi kontroversial setelah mengikuti berburu gajah di Zimbabwe pada 2009, di mana ia difoto berpose dengan hewan yang dibunuhnya, termasuk gajah dan seekor singa betina. Ia merupakan bagian dari kelompok pemburu di Taman Nasional Hwange yang secara legal memburu 11 ekor gajah untuk mengatasi masalah lingkungan. Perburuan ini diizinkan oleh pemerintah Zimbabwe dan sebagian besar dana dikabarkan diberikan kepada pihak taman nasional. Dr. Chang menyatakan aksi perburuan tersebut memberi manfaat bagi masyarakat setempat, dengan mengatakan daging gajah dibagikan ke desa-desa. Ia mengatakan kepada The Times, 'Dagingnya diberikan ke desa. Mereka mengantre di kamp, ​​meminta, "Tolong beri kami daging." Saya diinformasikan satu ekor gajah bisa memberi makan satu desa selama tiga setengah bulan.' Ia juga membela praktik membayar untuk berburu gajah dengan alasan otoritas setempat tidak memiliki sumber daya yang memadai. Dr. Chang menempuh pendidikan kedokteran di Irlandia dan tercatat sebagai direktur Milton Medical Centre di Luton, dengan kantor pusat di Kenley, Surrey. Istrinya, Corrina Chang, adalah sekretaris perusahaan. Dr. Chang terdaftar di General Medical Council, namun izin praktiknya sudah tidak aktif sejak Agustus. article_content: New Jersey residents mourned the loss of James Gandolfini on Wednesday, gathering at locations made famous by his iconic role as Tony Soprano. Fans visited Holsten's Ice Cream Parlor in Bloomfield, where the final scene of The Sopranos was filmed, to leave tributes. The owner placed a 'Reserved' sign on the booth where Tony Soprano shared onion rings with his family in the show's last moments, honoring the late actor. Many visitors described Gandolfini as a 'regular Jersey guy' and a 'member of the family.' Chris Carley, co-owner of Holsten’s, recalled Gandolfini as a true gentleman and a generous celebrity who was always willing to take photos and sign autographs. He noted that the store saw a rush of fans after news of Gandolfini’s passing. Nearby, Satin Dolls, the real-life club depicted as the Bada Bing in the show, created a makeshift memorial for Gandolfini. Manager Bill Peppe expressed his deep shock, describing Gandolfini as accessible and friendly, always making time for admirers. Gandolfini died at age 51 in Rome following a suspected heart attack. He had been traveling with his son Michael, wife Deborah, and nine-month-old daughter Liliana ahead of the Taormina Film Festival in Sicily. Reports indicate he died in the hospital after doctors were unable to revive him. Co-stars and friends shared memories of Gandolfini’s kindness, with Joseph Gannascoli (Vito Spatafore in The Sopranos) recalling the actor's supportive nature, even under difficult circumstances. He remembered Gandolfini attending personal events and always making those around him feel comfortable. Local institutions quickly became gathering points for fans to honor Gandolfini’s memory, with many expressing their grief and admiration. New Jersey Governor Chris Christie also paid tribute, calling Gandolfini a 'fine actor, a Rutgers alum, and a true Jersey guy.' The renewed interest in locations from The Sopranos was evident as fans flocked to Holsten’s and joined guided tours of the show’s famous sites. Gandolfini remains remembered in his hometown of Westwood, New Jersey, where locals recall him as a down-to-earth figure despite his fame.

article_content: Ukraine is currently facing a period of rapid political turmoil. Ousted President Viktor Yanukovych, who fled to Russia, remains defiant, declaring himself the legitimate elected leader and refusing to step down. In Crimea—a southern Ukrainian region with a strong pro-Russian sentiment—armed men in military uniforms appeared unexpectedly outside two airports. This development alarmed Ukrainian officials, particularly as some of these armed men were stationed near a major Russian military base in Sevastopol. Despite looking threatening, these groups did not seize the airports, and Ukrainian officials later confirmed they prevented the takeover without violence. Ukraine has been divided between those who favor closer ties with Europe and others who look towards Russia. Last year, Yanukovych abandoned a European trade agreement for immediate financial support from Russia, triggering widespread protests from pro-European groups. These protests escalated into deadly clashes before a peace deal was brokered—though Yanukovych left Ukraine before the agreement was fully implemented. Speaking from Russia, Yanukovych asserted his presidential status, claimed threats to his life forced him to leave, and blamed Western powers for the ongoing unrest. However, he emphasized he does not seek Russian military intervention to regain power and dismissed suggestions of dividing Ukraine based on political allegiance. Ukraine’s Parliament has taken control, appointing an interim president, initiating the formation of a new government, and calling for elections in May. Lawmakers have also urged Russia to exhibit restraint and avoid provocative military actions. Russia’s interest in Ukraine stems from deep historical ties, shared borders, economic links, and military assets, including its Black Sea naval fleet stationed in Crimea. Ukraine also hosts vital gas pipelines operated by the Russian energy company Gazprom that supply Europe. The situation remains highly volatile, especially in Crimea, where pro-Russian forces control several government buildings and local lawmakers have ousted a pro-Kiev government. With a significant Russian military presence and many ethnic Russians living in the region, Crimea is emerging as a potential flashpoint for further conflict.

Selama ini Ukraina terpecah antara kelompok yang ingin merapat ke Eropa dan lainnya ke Rusia.
