article_content: Minneapolis, Minnesota (CNN) -- The U.S. has experienced several major disasters in recent years, including Gulf Coast oil spills, hurricanes, highway bridge collapses, and terrorist attacks. Graduate students at the University of Minnesota are now studying these events to better prepare for upcoming challenges and prevent future catastrophes. These students are enrolled in a newly launched Master of Science in Security Technology program, similar to a Homeland Security degree. The program began last month and draws students from a variety of backgrounds, such as a U.S. Marine, an IT specialist, and a postal worker. Students examine a wide range of disasters, from natural events like hurricanes and pandemics to failures in critical infrastructure and terrorist attacks involving biological or explosive devices. They also analyze disruptions in banking, postal services, power grids, and food supply chains. The program is headed by Massoud Amin, an experienced security expert and director of the university's Technological Leadership Institute. After the September 11, 2001, attacks, Amin was asked to assess risks to the nation’s electrical grid and reported his team's findings to the U.S. government. Amin's passion for harnessing technology to improve lives began when he was young, witnessing how access to electricity transformed villages in Iran. This formative experience inspired him to use his expertise to benefit others. Three years ago, Amin saw the impact of systemic failure firsthand when the I-35 West bridge over the Mississippi River in Minneapolis collapsed near his office, tragically killing 13 people. This event contributed to the inspiration for the graduate program. "We often take our critical systems for granted. It’s essential to prevent widespread failures," Amin noted. "If a disruption occurs, how can we recognize early warning signs before disaster happens?" A key challenge in the program is developing solutions that improve security while respecting civil liberties and privacy. Many program participants are professionals whose jobs require risk assessment and security. Nathan Hunstad, an IT analyst for Minnesota's Democratic caucus, stated that security is vital in politics, emphasizing the importance of both secrecy and privacy. Hunstad hopes to merge his interests in cryptology and public policy, aspiring to work for the Department of Homeland Security or devise broad security strategies for state or federal government. Student Bill Hagestad, a Marine Corps Reserve officer, has firsthand experience in protecting infrastructure from terrorist threats. During the initial Iraq invasion, he evaluated facilities to identify potential vulnerabilities. After graduation, Hagestad aims to become chief technology officer at a computer networking company, focusing on cybersecurity and defense against cyber threats. Professor Amin believes studying previous disasters can help anyone become better prepared. "At the risk of sounding grandiose, we can help save the world," he said. CNN's Thom Patterson contributed to this report.
translated_content: Minneapolis, Minnesota (CNN) -- Amerika Serikat telah mengalami beberapa bencana besar dalam beberapa tahun terakhir, termasuk tumpahan minyak di Gulf Coast, badai, runtuhnya jembatan jalan tol, dan serangan teroris. Mahasiswa pascasarjana di University of Minnesota kini mempelajari peristiwa-peristiwa ini untuk mempersiapkan diri menghadapi tantangan baru sekaligus mencegah bencana di masa depan. Para mahasiswa ini mengikuti program Master of Science in Security Technology yang baru saja diluncurkan, mirip dengan program Homeland Security. Program ini dimulai bulan lalu dan diikuti oleh mahasiswa dari berbagai latar belakang, seperti seorang Marinir AS, spesialis TI, dan pekerja pos. Mahasiswa menelaah berbagai jenis bencana, mulai dari peristiwa alam seperti badai dan pandemi, hingga kegagalan infrastruktur penting dan serangan teroris yang melibatkan perangkat biologis atau bahan peledak. Mereka juga menganalisis gangguan di sektor perbankan, layanan pos, jaringan listrik, dan rantai pasokan pangan. Program ini dipimpin Massoud Amin, pakar keamanan berpengalaman dan direktur Technological Leadership Institute di universitas tersebut. Setelah serangan 11 September 2001, Amin ditugaskan untuk menilai risiko jaringan listrik nasional dan melaporkan temuannya pada pemerintah AS. Semangat Amin dalam menggunakan teknologi untuk memperbaiki kehidupan berawal dari masa kecilnya, saat ia melihat listrik membawa perubahan besar bagi desa-desa di Iran. Pengalaman itu menginspirasinya menggunakan keahliannya untuk membantu sesama. Tiga tahun lalu, Amin menyaksikan sendiri dampak kegagalan sistem ketika Jembatan I-35 West di atas Sungai Mississippi, Minneapolis, runtuh di dekat kantornya, menewaskan 13 orang. Peristiwa ini turut menjadi inspirasi lahirnya program pascasarjana tersebut. "Kita sering menganggap remeh sistem kritis yang ada. Sangat penting untuk mencegah kegagalan yang meluas," ujar Amin. "Jika ada gangguan, bagaimana kita mengenali tanda-tanda peringatan lebih awal sebelum bencana terjadi?" Tantangan terbesar dalam program ini adalah mengembangkan solusi yang meningkatkan keamanan tanpa mengorbankan kebebasan sipil dan privasi. Banyak peserta program adalah profesional di bidang yang membutuhkan penilaian risiko dan keamanan. Nathan Hunstad, analis TI untuk kaukus Demokrat Minnesota, mengatakan bahwa keamanan sangat penting dalam politik serta menekankan kebutuhan akan kerahasiaan dan privasi. Hunstad ingin menggabungkan minatnya pada kriptologi dan kebijakan publik, serta bercita-cita bekerja di Department of Homeland Security atau merancang kebijakan keamanan di tingkat negara bagian maupun nasional. Mahasiswa lain, Bill Hagestad, perwira cadangan Korps Marinir, punya pengalaman langsung melindungi infrastruktur dari ancaman teror. Saat awal invasi ke Irak, ia menilai fasilitas untuk mengidentifikasi potensi kerentanan. Setelah lulus, Hagestad berharap menjadi chief technology officer di perusahaan jaringan komputer, dengan fokus pada ancaman dan pertahanan siber. Profesor Amin yakin mempelajari bencana di masa lalu membantu siapa pun menjadi lebih siap. "Mungkin terdengar berlebihan, tapi kita bisa membantu menyelamatkan dunia," katanya. Laporan ini disusun dengan kontribusi dari Thom Patterson, CNN.

article_content: James Anderson entered the second Test at Lord’s against India motivated by disciplinary allegations from the previous match, where he was accused by India of abusing and pushing Ravindra Jadeja—a claim he strongly denies. Despite the threat of suspension, Anderson made history by becoming the top wicket-taker for both England and at Lord’s. England were presented with perfect bowling conditions but failed to capitalize, allowing India to recover from a precarious position of 145 for 7 to finish the day at 290 for 9. Ajinkya Rahane was pivotal, anchoring the Indian innings with a determined century and building important partnerships with lower-order batsmen Bhuvneshwar Kumar and Mohammad Shami. While the pitch, prepared by groundsman Mick Hunt, favored England’s bowlers, they did not consistently bowl or field effectively. Their most productive spell came during the middle session, claiming four wickets for 67 runs. Although Anderson claimed four wickets and broke significant records, he missed the chance to bowl to both Jadeja and MS Dhoni, central figures in the ongoing disciplinary dispute. Captain Alastair Cook chose to field first, betting on the rare green pitch to trouble India, but England’s efforts were undermined by lapses—especially from wicketkeeper Matt Prior, who has struggled with injuries and dropped several catches this season. Tensions between England and India, heightened by formal complaints from both sides and an impending ICC disciplinary hearing, did not spill over into on-field confrontations. Gary Ballance, recently in the spotlight for off-field issues, contributed with two sharp catches. India began cautiously, scoring modestly in the first two sessions, but shifted momentum in the final session thanks to Rahane’s attacking play. England were further hampered by Liam Plunkett’s hamstring injury and fading bowling effectiveness, which allowed India’s tail to add valuable runs. A contentious decision by umpire Bruce Oxenford, who gave Stuart Binny lbw in the absence of DRS, also sparked debate. Despite early dominance, England finished the day facing a tougher task than anticipated and will need a strong response with the bat. As the Test continues, much attention remains on Anderson and the disciplinary proceedings set to follow.

Meski terancam larangan bermain, Anderson mencetak sejarah sebagai pengambil wicket terbanyak untuk Inggris dan di Lord's. Inggris mendapatkan kondisi lapangan yang sangat menguntungkan untuk bowler, namun gagal memanfaatkannya; India justru bangkit dari posisi rawan 145 untuk 7 dan menutup hari di 290 untuk 9. Ajinkya Rahane menjadi kunci, memimpin batting India dengan century penuh determinasi, menjalin kemitraan penting bersama Bhuvneshwar Kumar dan Mohammad Shami di urutan bawah. Meskipun lapangan karya Mick Hunt sangat mendukung bowler Inggris, mereka tidak konsisten dalam hal bowling maupun fielding. Periode terbaik mereka hanya terjadi di sesi tengah, saat berhasil mengambil empat wicket untuk 67 run. Anderson sendiri mengoleksi empat wicket dan mencatat rekor penting, namun belum mendapat kesempatan menghadapi Jadeja dan MS Dhoni—dua figur utama dalam sengketa disipliner ini. Kapten Alastair Cook memilih fielding lebih dulu, mengandalkan rumput hijau di Lord’s yang jarang terjadi untuk menekan India, namun usaha Inggris terhambat oleh kesalahan sendiri—terutama dari kiper Matt Prior yang mengalami cedera dan kerap gagal menangkap bola musim ini. Ketegangan antara Inggris dan India yang dipicu oleh pengaduan resmi kedua tim serta sidang disiplin ICC yang akan datang, tidak sampai memanas di lapangan. Gary Ballance, yang sebelumnya sempat disorot karena kasus di luar lapangan, justru menonjol lewat dua tangkapan apik. India bermain hati-hati di dua sesi awal, tapi berbalik unggul di sesi akhir berkat agresivitas Rahane. Inggris semakin tertekan setelah Liam Plunkett mengalami cedera hamstring, membuat bowling mereka kurang tajam sehingga ekor India menambah run berharga. Keputusan kontroversial dari wasit Bruce Oxenford yang menyatakan Stuart Binny lbw tanpa bantuan DRS juga menuai perdebatan. Meski sempat unggul, Inggris mengakhiri hari dengan situasi sulit dan butuh respons batting yang kuat. Seiring berlanjutnya pertandingan, perhatian tetap tertuju pada Anderson dan proses disipliner yang akan segera digelar.

article_content: A devastating rainstorm in Beijing has claimed at least 37 lives, raising concerns about the city’s capacity to handle severe flooding. Over the weekend, Beijing experienced its heaviest downpour in 60 years, with many roads submerged under waist-deep water for hours. According to the municipal government, the death toll reached 37 by Sunday night. Of these, 25 drowned, six died due to house cave-ins, five were electrocuted, and one was killed by lightning. The heavy rain affected 1.9 million people and caused nearly 10 billion yuan (almost £1 billion) in damages, according to state news agency Xinhua. The full economic impact is still being assessed by local authorities. The storm led to widespread power outages and road closures across Beijing. As of Monday, parts of the Beijing-Hong Kong-Macau Expressway remained underwater and closed to traffic. Residents took to the internet to express anger at the city’s inadequate drainage systems. Online commentators criticized the perceived focus on the city's appearance over substantive infrastructure improvements. Experts attribute the scale of the flooding to rapid urbanization, the prevalence of impermeable surfaces like concrete and asphalt, and insufficient drainage maintenance. Some drainage networks are clogged with sediment, limiting their capacity. Most of Beijing’s drainage system is designed to handle rainfall of between 36 and 45 millimeters per hour, with only select areas like Tiananmen Square able to withstand higher volumes. Reconstructing and upgrading drainage systems to modern standards would be a costly and complex endeavor, according to experts. They recommend establishing uniform urban flooding standards to guide future planning. Flooding and heavy rains have also disrupted other major Chinese cities such as Shanghai, Guangzhou, Chongqing, and Shenzhen this summer, highlighting a broader vulnerability.
translated_content: Sebuah hujan deras yang melanda Beijing telah merenggut setidaknya 37 jiwa, memunculkan kekhawatiran tentang kemampuan kota tersebut menghadapi banjir parah. Akhir pekan kemarin, Beijing mengalami curah hujan terberat dalam 60 tahun terakhir, dengan banyak jalanan yang terendam air setinggi pinggang selama berjam-jam. Menurut pemerintah kota, jumlah korban jiwa mencapai 37 orang hingga Minggu malam. Dari jumlah tersebut, 25 orang tewas akibat tenggelam, enam orang meninggal karena rumah roboh, lima orang tersengat listrik, dan satu orang tewas karena tersambar petir. Hujan lebat ini berdampak pada 1,9 juta penduduk dan menyebabkan kerugian hampir 10 miliar yuan (sekitar £1 miliar), menurut kantor berita Xinhua. Dampak ekonomi secara keseluruhan masih dinilai oleh pihak berwenang lokal. Badai tersebut menyebabkan pemadaman listrik dan penutupan jalan di seluruh Beijing. Pada hari Senin, sebagian ruas Expressway Beijing-Hong Kong-Macau masih terendam dan ditutup untuk lalu lintas. Warga menggunakan internet untuk mengekspresikan kemarahan atas sistem drainase kota yang dinilai tidak memadai. Warganet mengkritik fokus pada penampilan kota dibandingkan perbaikan infrastruktur yang substansial. Para ahli menyatakan bahwa besarnya banjir disebabkan oleh pesatnya urbanisasi, banyaknya permukaan tidak tembus air seperti beton dan aspal, serta kurangnya perawatan drainase. Beberapa jaringan drainase tersumbat oleh endapan, sehingga kapasitasnya terbatas. Sebagian besar sistem drainase Beijing dirancang hanya untuk menangani curah hujan antara 36 hingga 45 milimeter per jam, dengan hanya beberapa area tertentu seperti Lapangan Tiananmen yang mampu menampung volume lebih besar. Para ahli mengatakan bahwa membangun dan memperbarui sistem drainase agar sesuai dengan standar modern akan menjadi pekerjaan mahal dan rumit. Mereka merekomendasikan penetapan standar pengendalian banjir perkotaan yang seragam untuk perencanaan masa depan. Banjir dan hujan deras juga telah mengganggu kota-kota besar lain di Tiongkok seperti Shanghai, Guangzhou, Chongqing, dan Shenzhen musim panas ini, sehingga menyoroti kerentanan yang lebih luas.

article_content: Assembly elections in Rajasthan will be held on Saturday, November 25, 2023. The Rajasthan government has declared a public holiday on that day. As per an October 16, 2023 notification, the election date is officially a public holiday in the state. Banks in Rajasthan will be closed on November 25, as reflected in the Reserve Bank of India’s updated holiday list. Since November 25 is also the fourth Saturday, banks would have been closed regardless of the elections. Schools, government offices, and public offices in Rajasthan constituencies where voting will take place will also remain closed. Voting will occur from 7 a.m. to 6 p.m. on the day. article_content: A woman who fell overboard from a cruise ship with her boyfriend off Australia’s coast had expressed her excitement about the trip in a final tweet days earlier. Kristen Schroder, 27, and Paul Rossington, 30, are feared dead after falling from the Carnival Spirit cruise ship into the Tasman Sea, about 75 miles off New South Wales. CCTV footage captured the couple arguing in the ship’s casino before Schroder fell from the 65-foot-high deck on Wednesday night, followed closely by Rossington. In her final message on Twitter, Schroder wrote, ‘Gotta pack for the cruise!!! Cannot wait for the down time with the family! It’s going to be awesome to have the most important people in my world around me for 10 days.’ The couple, from Barraba near Tamworth, reportedly skipped a dinner with Schroder’s family, who were also on the cruise. Schroder’s brother-in-law, Sascha Percuoco, stated that neither was intoxicated and rejected suggestions that Schroder took her own life. According to Percuoco, Schroder ‘lost her grip and slipped backwards’ and Rossington, a paramedic, jumped in to save her. Senior police confirmed CCTV shows Schroder falling first and Rossington following about 20 seconds later. Footage also shows Schroder striking a lifeboat before hitting the water. The couple was part of a holiday group with family and friends. They were reported missing 12 hours after the ship docked in Sydney when their luggage remained unclaimed. A large search effort by sea and air was conducted, but experts say survival in such conditions is unlikely beyond a few days. Dr. Paul Luckin, an advisor to the Australian Maritime Safety Authority, doubted anyone could survive more than three days in those waters. Carnival Cruise Lines stated that onboard railings exceeded safety requirements and found no evidence of foul play after reviewing CCTV and ship protocols. Carnival Corp., the ship’s parent company, has faced several incidents and lawsuits in recent years, though their contracts limit passengers’ ability to pursue legal action.

It’s going to be awesome to have the most important people in my world around me for 10 days.’ Pasangan asal Barraba, dekat Tamworth ini, dilaporkan tidak menghadiri makan malam dengan keluarga Schroder yang juga ikut dalam perjalanan itu. Mereka berdua adalah bagian dari rombongan keluarga dan teman yang sedang berlibur. Keduanya dilaporkan hilang 12 jam setelah kapal bersandar di Sydney karena bagasi mereka tidak diambil. article_content: Samsung is expected to introduce significant changes with its upcoming Galaxy S6 handset, including reducing the amount of pre-installed 'bloatware,' according to reports. The Galaxy S6 will reportedly be available in two versions—one featuring a curved screen on both sides—and is set for unveiling on March 1. Bloatware refers to unwanted software or apps pre-installed on devices, which can take up valuable storage space and may slow down performance. Samsung has previously faced criticism for offering less usable storage than advertised, with examples showing that only about 10GB of the 16GB in its S5 device was available to users. The new Galaxy S6 is expected to come preloaded with Microsoft apps such as OneNote, OneDrive, Office Mobile (including a free Office 365 subscription), and Skype. Both S6 models are rumored to have all-metal bodies and 5.1-inch Quad HD displays. Sources like Sammobile and Bloomberg confirm that one S6 variant will feature a display curving around both edges, a technology previously used in the Galaxy Note Edge. Leaked specs suggest the S6 may include an octa-core processor, Mali-T768 GPU, and a 16-megapixel rear camera. Samsung aims to address competition from Apple and Chinese brands by revamping its product lineup, focusing on fewer models with better quality. Despite a drop in profits and a decline in market share (from 33% to 24%), Samsung remains the largest smartphone manufacturer globally. In response to the challenging market, Samsung plans to cut its number of smartphone models and use higher-quality components to differentiate its devices.

Galaxy S6 disebut-sebut akan tersedia dalam dua versi — salah satunya dengan layar lengkung di kedua sisi — dan dijadwalkan akan diumumkan pada 1 Maret. Bloatware adalah istilah untuk perangkat lunak atau aplikasi yang sudah terpasang di perangkat, yang bisa memakan ruang penyimpanan dan memperlambat kinerja. Samsung sebelumnya dikritik karena memberikan ruang penyimpanan yang lebih sedikit dari yang diumumkan; misalnya, hanya sekitar 10GB dari 16GB di perangkat S5 yang bisa digunakan oleh pengguna. Galaxy S6 terbaru diperkirakan akan dilengkapi dengan aplikasi Microsoft seperti OneNote, OneDrive, Office Mobile (termasuk langganan gratis Office 365), dan Skype. Kedua model S6 dirumorkan memiliki bodi metal sepenuhnya dan layar Quad HD 5,1 inci. Sumber seperti Sammobile dan Bloomberg mengonfirmasi bahwa salah satu varian S6 akan memiliki layar yang melengkung di kedua sisinya, teknologi yang sebelumnya digunakan di Galaxy Note Edge. Spesifikasi yang bocor menyebutkan S6 kemungkinan akan dilengkapi prosesor octa-core, GPU Mali-T768, dan kamera belakang 16 megapiksel. Samsung berupaya menghadapi persaingan dari Apple dan merek China dengan merombak jajaran produknya, serta fokus pada jumlah model yang lebih sedikit tetapi dengan kualitas lebih baik. article_content: Singapore and Saudi Arabia have upgraded their relationship to a 'strategic partnership,' aiming to further strengthen bilateral relations and cooperation, according to a joint statement from their foreign affairs ministries on Saturday (Oct 21). This follows a meeting in Riyadh on Wednesday between Singapore's Prime Minister Lee Hsien Loong and Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed Bin Salman. The leaders reviewed the historical relationship between their countries and explored ways to deepen collaboration across various sectors. During his official visits to Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates, Mr Lee also attended the ASEAN-Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) Summit in Riyadh on Friday. The strategic partnership is expected to expand mutually beneficial cooperation in all fields. Both sides also acknowledged the progress made by the Saudi-Singapore Joint Committee (SSJC), which held its third session on Oct 17.

Novak Djokovic secured a place in the China Open final after defeating Andy Murray in straight sets on Saturday, pushing his winning streak at the event to 24 matches. The world No. 1 triumphed with a 6-3, 6-4 victory and will now face Czech player Tomas Berdych in the championship match.

Djokovic, who remains undefeated at the China Open, told ATP Tour he’s happy with his current performance, especially on these courts. He also hopes to finish the season in style, just as he did last year.

In the final, Djokovic will aim for his 46th ATP Tour title. Berdych, who won the China Open in 2011—the year Djokovic sat out due to a back injury—earned his spot by beating Martin Klizan, who had earlier eliminated Rafael Nadal, in a straightforward 6-4, 6-1 semifinal match.

Berdych acknowledged the challenge of playing Djokovic, saying, “Facing the world No. 1 is always special. Novak is in fantastic form and has a strong record here. It’s a great opportunity for me, and I’ll give it my all to see what I can achieve.”

Petenis nomor satu dunia itu menang 6-3, 6-4 dan akan berhadapan dengan petenis asal Ceko, Tomas Berdych, di partai puncak.

Djokovic, yang belum pernah kalah di China Open, mengatakan kepada ATP Tour bahwa ia senang dengan performanya saat ini, apalagi di lapangan ini. Ia juga berharap bisa menutup musim dengan gaya, seperti tahun lalu.

Di final nanti, Djokovic membidik gelar ATP Tour ke-46. Berdych, yang meraih gelar China Open tahun 2011—saat Djokovic absen karena cedera punggung—melaju ke final setelah mengalahkan Martin Klizan, yang sebelumnya menyingkirkan Rafael Nadal, dengan skor meyakinkan 6-4, 6-1 di semifinal.

article_content: For years, the Israeli government has permitted widows to request the retrieval of sperm from soldiers who have died while serving in the Israeli Defense Force. As The Times of Israel explains, sperm is ideally retrieved within 24 hours of death to maximize viability for later use in fertilization. However, experts note that posthumous sperm retrieval (PSR) can be done even several days after death, as non-motile sperm may still be viable. “We look for and prefer sperm that are moving, but even non-motile sperm are not necessarily dead. We know how to induce motility after the sperm is unfrozen,” said Dr. Yuval Or, head of the IVF unit at Kaplan Medical Center. Following recent events, the Israeli Health Ministry has eased some of the regulations around this process, now allowing parents to request sperm retrieval from their sons who were killed in war — including civilians — without needing a family court order. [Reported by Renee Ghert-Zand

Seperti dijelaskan The Times of Israel, sperma sebaiknya diambil dalam waktu 24 jam setelah kematian agar peluangnya tetap hidup saat nanti digunakan untuk fertilisasi. Namun, para ahli menyatakan bahwa pengambilan sperma pasca-meninggal (PSR) masih bisa dilakukan beberapa hari setelah kematian, karena sperma yang tidak bergerak pun bisa tetap hidup. “Kami memang mencari dan lebih memilih sperma yang bergerak, tapi sperma yang tidak bergerak belum tentu mati. Kami tahu cara membuatnya bergerak kembali setelah sperma dicairkan,” kata Dr. Yuval Or, kepala unit IVF di Kaplan Medical Center. article_content: Superstorm Sandy, described by New York Mayor Michael Bloomberg as 'a storm of unprecedented proportions,' may not set records for being the most costly or deadliest storm. However, the mayor tweeted on Tuesday that Sandy is 'maybe the worst #NYC has ever experienced.' Sandy earned several historical distinctions. Its barometric pressure at landfall set a new low—an indicator of storm strength. Hurricane hunter aircraft measured central pressure at 940 millibars (27.76 inches) on Monday afternoon, the lowest recorded for an Atlantic storm making landfall north of Cape Hatteras, North Carolina. The previous record was held by the 1938 'Long Island Express' hurricane, which reached 946 millibars. Sandy's intensity and trajectory combined to cause a record storm surge in New York City. At Battery Park, the surge reached 13.88 feet at 9:24 p.m. Monday, surpassing the previous high of 10.02 feet set by Hurricane Donna in 1960. In New York Harbor, a buoy measured a record wave height of 32.5 feet on Monday—a full 6.5 feet higher than the 25-foot wave produced by Hurricane Irene in 2011. As Sandy neared the Northeast, forecasters noted the storm's area would make it the 20th largest country in the world, about twice the size of Texas. With tropical-force winds stretching 580 miles, Sandy was the second-largest Atlantic storm recorded. Hurricane Olga holds the record with winds extending 600 miles in 2001, according to the National Hurricane Center. Sandy's power outages set a new record in the Northeast, affecting 7.5 million businesses and households across 15 states and Washington, D.C., by late Tuesday morning, based on figures compiled by CNN from local utilities. New Jersey Governor Chris Christie reported 2.4 million outages in his state—double the number from Hurricane Irene last year. Con Edison's senior vice president for electric operations, John Miksad, called it 'the largest storm-related outage in our history.' Early cost estimates from Eqecat project property damage and business losses from $10 billion to $20 billion, while Kinetic Analysis Corp.'s Chuck Watson estimated $20–25 billion overall. Flooding in New York's subway tunnels and potential electrical system damage remain unpredictable factors, Watson said. Despite the devastation, Sandy is not expected to approach the $108 billion in damages caused by Hurricane Katrina in 2005, according to the National Hurricane Center. Social media reflected the storm's impact, with Instagram recording a record number of image uploads—nearly 10 per second—using the hashtags #hurricanesandy, #sandy, and #frankenstorm. CNN's Sean Morris contributed to this report.
translated_content: Superstorm Sandy, yang digambarkan oleh Walikota New York Michael Bloomberg sebagai 'badai dengan proporsi yang belum pernah terjadi sebelumnya,' mungkin bukan badai paling mahal atau paling mematikan. Namun, walikota menulis di Twitter pada hari Selasa bahwa Sandy adalah 'mungkin yang terburuk yang pernah dialami #NYC.' Sandy meraih beberapa rekor historis. Tekanan barometrik saat mendarat mencatat angka terendah baru—indikator kekuatan badai. Pesawat pemburu badai mengukur tekanan pusat sebesar 940 milibar (27,76 inci) pada Senin sore, terendah yang pernah tercatat untuk badai Atlantik yang mendarat di utara Cape Hatteras, North Carolina. Rekor sebelumnya dipegang oleh badai 'Long Island Express' tahun 1938 yang mencapai 946 milibar. Intensitas dan arah Sandy menyebabkan gelombang pasang tertinggi di New York City. Di Battery Park, gelombang pasang mencapai 13,88 kaki pada pukul 21:24, Senin, melampaui rekor tertinggi sebelumnya 10,02 kaki yang dicatat badai Donna tahun 1960. Di Pelabuhan New York, pelampung mengukur tinggi gelombang rekor sebesar 32,5 kaki pada hari Senin—6,5 kaki lebih tinggi dari gelombang 25 kaki yang dihasilkan Badai Irene pada tahun 2011. Saat Sandy mendekati wilayah Timur Laut, para peramal cuaca menyebut area badai ini sebanding dengan negara terbesar ke-20 di dunia, atau dua kali luas Texas. Dengan angin tropis sepanjang 580 mil, Sandy adalah badai Atlantik terbesar kedua yang tercatat. Badai Olga memegang rekor dengan angin 600 mil pada tahun 2001, menurut National Hurricane Center. Pemadaman listrik akibat Sandy juga menjadi rekor baru di Timur Laut, memengaruhi 7,5 juta bisnis dan rumah tangga di 15 negara bagian dan Washington, D.C., hingga Selasa pagi, menurut data utilitas setempat yang dikumpulkan oleh CNN. Gubernur New Jersey Chris Christie melaporkan 2,4 juta pemadaman di negaranya—dua kali lipat dari jumlah akibat Badai Irene tahun lalu. Wakil presiden senior operasi listrik Con Edison, John Miksad, menyebutnya 'pemadaman terkait badai terbesar dalam sejarah kami.' Perkiraan awal dari Eqecat menyebutkan kerusakan properti dan bisnis antara $10 miliar hingga $20 miliar, sedangkan Chuck Watson dari Kinetic Analysis Corp. memperkirakan total kerugian $20–25 miliar. Banjir pada terowongan subway New York dan potensi kerusakan sistem listrik masih menjadi faktor yang belum bisa diprediksi, kata Watson. Meski kerusakan yang ditimbulkan besar, Sandy diperkirakan tidak akan mendekati kerugian $108 miliar akibat Badai Katrina tahun 2005, menurut National Hurricane Center. article_content: Some of the strongest earthquakes ever recorded in the U.S. took place centuries ago deep within North America. According to new research published in the Journal of Geophysical Research: Solid Earth, regions in the central and eastern U.S. might still be feeling aftershocks from these powerful events nearly 200 years later. After a major earthquake, smaller tremors known as aftershocks can linger for years as the Earth's crust adjusts. Even though aftershocks are less severe than the initial quake, they can still damage buildings and slow down recovery efforts. Scientists are divided about whether today's earthquakes in these stable areas are lingering aftershocks or simply the region's natural background seismic activity. Yuxuan Chen, a geoscientist from Wuhan University and lead author of the study, tackled this issue with a statistical analysis. The study centered on three major events: the 1663 earthquake in Quebec, the 1811-1812 earthquakes near the Missouri-Kentucky border, and the 1886 quake in Charleston, South Carolina. These are three of the largest earthquakes in North America's stable interior, and large quakes typically produce more aftershocks. Because these regions are far from active tectonic boundaries, they rarely experience earthquakes—making the source of recent tremors especially intriguing. To investigate, the team used USGS earthquake data and focused on earthquakes of magnitude 2.5 or higher within 250 kilometers (155 miles) of the historic epicenters. They used the 'nearest neighbor' statistical method, which considers time, distance, and magnitude to see if quakes are related. USGS geophysicist Susan Hough, who was not part of the study, pointed out that while earthquake location can suggest aftershocks, other processes—like slow ground movement—might also explain clusters of activity. The research concluded that aftershock activity from the 1663 Quebec quake has ended, while roughly 30% of recent quakes near the Missouri-Kentucky border and about 16% near Charleston are likely to be aftershocks from historic events. Still, the majority of recent tremors are attributed to regular background seismic activity. Distinguishing between aftershocks and background quakes is key for assessing earthquake risk. The study indicates that ongoing seismic activity in these three areas mostly comes from background seismicity, suggesting slow, continued stress in the earth's crust. Monitoring both aftershocks and natural seismic activity remains essential for anticipating future hazards. As Susan Hough emphasized, understanding events from the distant past using modern scientific tools is vital for evaluating future earthquake risks.
translated_content: Beberapa gempa terkuat dalam sejarah AS terjadi berabad-abad lalu di daratan Amerika Utara. Berdasarkan penelitian terbaru di Journal of Geophysical Research: Solid Earth, daerah di tengah dan timur AS mungkin masih merasakan gempa susulan dari peristiwa besar tersebut, bahkan hampir 200 tahun setelahnya. Setelah gempa utama, gempa susulan—yang lebih kecil—masih bisa terjadi selama bertahun-tahun karena kerak bumi terus menyesuaikan diri. Walau lebih kecil, gempa susulan tetap dapat merusak bangunan dan memperlambat pemulihan. Ilmuwan masih memperdebatkan apakah gempa masa kini di wilayah yang relatif stabil ini adalah sisa gempa susulan atau sekadar aktivitas seismik alami. Yuxuan Chen, ahli geosains dari Wuhan University dan penulis utama penelitian ini, menggunakan analisis statistik untuk mengupas fenomena ini. Studi ini membahas tiga peristiwa besar: gempa tahun 1663 di Quebec, serangkaian gempa 1811-1812 di perbatasan Missouri-Kentucky, dan gempa tahun 1886 di Charleston, South Carolina. Ketiganya merupakan gempa terdahsyat di interior Amerika Utara, dan gempa besar memang cenderung menghasilkan lebih banyak gempa susulan. Karena lokasi studi jauh dari perbatasan lempeng aktif, gempa cenderung jarang terjadi—membuat sumber aktivitas terbaru menjadi semakin menarik untuk diselidiki. Untuk meneliti hal ini, tim menelaah data USGS pada gempa bermagnitudo 2,5 ke atas dalam radius 250 km (155 mil) dari episentrum bersejarah, memakai metode statistik 'nearest neighbor' yang mempertimbangkan waktu, jarak, dan magnitudo untuk melihat keterkaitan antar kejadian. Susan Hough, geofisikawan USGS yang tidak terlibat dalam studi ini, menilai bahwa pola lokasi bisa jadi petunjuk gempa susulan, tapi proses lain seperti pergerakan tanah perlahan juga bisa menyebabkan pengelompokan gempa. Hasil penelitian menyimpulkan aktivitas gempa susulan dari gempa Quebec tahun 1663 telah usai. Namun, sekitar 30% gempa terbaru di kawasan Missouri-Kentucky dan 16% di Charleston kemungkinan masih merupakan sisa gempa susulan dari peristiwa lama. Meski begitu, sebagian besar getaran terbaru masih merupakan aktivitas alami wilayah tersebut. Membedakan antara gempa susulan dan aktivitas alami penting untuk menilai potensi risiko gempa ke depan. Studi menyebutkan sebagian besar aktivitas gempa di ketiga daerah ini berasal dari seismicity latar, menandakan adanya akumulasi stres di kerak bumi. Memantau kedua jenis aktivitas tetap penting untuk mengantisipasi bahaya masa depan. Seperti ditekankan Susan Hough, memahami peristiwa masa lalu lewat metode ilmiah mutakhir sangat penting untuk menilai bahaya gempa ke depan.

article_content: On Wednesday, one of two wildfires in Oklahoma City advanced northward toward the suburb of Edmond, lighting up the windy night sky with spiraling flames and flying embers. The blaze, which started Tuesday in the sparsely populated northeast part of the city, is heading into densely wooded areas that could fuel its spread, according to Edmond Fire Chief Tim Wheeler. "The winds have shifted a bit," Wheeler said. "Given its current path, the fire will move through heavily wooded terrain, which may intensify its growth." Officials hope to stop the fire before it crosses Interstate 44 southeast of Edmond, but have already activated the Code Red alert system—automatically calling residents to urge evacuation. About 380 people received the initial evacuation notice, Wheeler said. Fighting the flames is especially difficult in such wooded areas, he added, as fire trucks can't easily access them. During the day, helicopters from the Oklahoma National Guard, equipped with water buckets, supported the firefighting efforts; but after dark, crews on the ground are continuing the battle alone. The northeast fire has burned roughly 15 square miles since it began Tuesday. On Wednesday night, aerial footage from CNN affiliate KOCO showed striking columns of flames bursting through trees and threatening homes in residential areas. Fire Chief Keith Bryant said that crews had nearly contained the fire on Wednesday, but it reignited when winds picked up again. Meanwhile, another fire broke out Wednesday afternoon on the city's southeast side, destroying two structures and prompting further evacuations. This second fire spanned an area 1.5 miles long and a mile wide. KOCO reported that a square-mile section was evacuated in the southeast. As a safety measure, a 40-mile stretch of Interstate 44 between Oklahoma City and Tulsa was closed, according to Jack Damrill from the Oklahoma Turnpike Authority. Bryant noted that evacuation orders have been targeted, as the threatened areas are not densely populated. However, the fire department's resources are stretched due to the combination of strong winds and extremely dry conditions. Like neighboring Texas, nearly all of Oklahoma is facing severe drought, with two-thirds of the state categorized as experiencing the most extreme level of drought by the U.S. Drought Monitor at the University of Nebraska-Lincoln.
translated_content: Pada hari Rabu, salah satu dari dua kebakaran hutan di Kota Oklahoma bergerak ke utara menuju kawasan pinggiran Edmond, menerangi langit malam yang berangin dengan pusaran api dan bara beterbangan. Api yang mulai berkobar pada Selasa di bagian timur laut kota yang jarang penduduk ini kini bergerak ke area berhutan lebat yang bisa mempercepat penyebarannya, menurut Kepala Pemadam Kebakaran Edmond, Tim Wheeler. "Arah angin sedikit berubah," kata Wheeler. "Dengan jalur saat ini, api akan melewati area hutan lebat, sehingga potensi pertumbuhannya semakin besar." Pejabat berharap api dapat dihentikan sebelum melintasi Interstate 44 di tenggara Edmond, namun sistem peringatan Code Red telah diaktifkan—memanggil warga secara otomatis untuk segera mengungsi. Sekitar 380 orang menerima pemberitahuan evakuasi awal, kata Wheeler. Pemadaman api sangat sulit di area berhutan seperti ini, tambahnya, karena truk pemadam sulit menjangkau lokasi. Pada siang hari, helikopter dari Garda Nasional Oklahoma membawa ember air untuk membantu pemadaman; namun begitu malam tiba, tim di darat melanjutkan upaya sendirian. Kebakaran di timur laut telah membakar sekitar 15 mil persegi sejak mulai berkobar pada Selasa. Rabu malam, rekaman udara dari KOCO, afiliasi CNN, memperlihatkan kobaran api menembus kanopi pohon dan mengancam rumah-rumah di kawasan pemukiman. Kepala Pemadam Kebakaran Keith Bryant mengatakan tim hampir berhasil mengendalikan api pada Rabu, namun api kembali menyala setelah angin bertiup lebih kencang. Sementara itu, kebakaran lain terjadi Rabu sore di sisi tenggara kota, menghancurkan dua bangunan dan menyebabkan evakuasi tambahan. Kebakaran kedua ini meluas di area sepanjang 1,5 mil dan lebar 1 mil. KOCO melaporkan bahwa area seluas satu mil persegi di tenggara ikut dievakuasi. Sebagai langkah pengamanan, jalur sepanjang 40 mil di Interstate 44 antara Kota Oklahoma dan Tulsa ditutup, menurut Jack Damrill dari Otoritas Jalan Tol Oklahoma. Bryant menyatakan perintah evakuasi ditargetkan karena wilayah terdampak tidak padat penduduk. Namun, sumber daya pemadam kebakaran makin terbatas karena angin kencang dan kondisi yang sangat kering. Seperti negara bagian tetangga Texas, hampir seluruh Oklahoma mengalami kekeringan parah, dengan dua pertiga wilayahnya dalam kategori paling parah menurut U.S. Drought Monitor dari University of Nebraska-Lincoln.

article_content: My fascination with rye whiskey began in the mid-1990s, inspired by my interest in American history and classic lounge music. Delving into vintage cocktail recipes, I noticed rye was a recurring ingredient—but it was challenging to find locally. My neighborhood liquor store in Manhattan only carried two bottles, one of which was Old Overholt, sporting an old-fashioned label. I bought it for around $15, knowing little about its background. At that time, rye whiskey’s popularity had significantly waned, a decline that started with Prohibition in 1920. Even after the repeal in 1934, American drinkers increasingly favored lighter spirits like Canadian whisky and vodka. I didn’t realize then that Old Overholt, founded in 1810, survived Prohibition by obtaining a 'medicinal whiskey' license. Originally produced in Pennsylvania, a state renowned for rye, the brand shifted to Kentucky in the 1980s after its acquisition by Jim Beam. Traditionally, Old Overholt was considered a basic, affordable rye—aged just three years and bottled at 80 proof. Despite its simplicity, I was immediately drawn to its light nutty flavor, caramel sweetness, and gentle spice, making it my preferred base for retro cocktails that I enjoyed sharing with friends. Recently, there’s been a resurgence of interest in rye whiskey. Brands like WhistlePig, known for strong, 100 proof rye, have reignited enthusiasm. Old Overholt, long reliant on bartenders and word-of-mouth, has been given renewed attention by Beam Suntory, led by the company’s rye whiskey expert, Bradford Lawrence. The primary Old Overholt now ages for four years and bottles at 86 proof, with special bonded and limited editions designed for collectors. This year highlights a major step: the release of Old Overholt Extra Aged Cask Strength Rye—the brand’s first cask-strength expression in over 80 years. Aged for ten years and bottled at 60.5% ABV, it matches the strength of its mid-20th-century predecessors. While production is no longer in Pennsylvania or with the original three-chamber stills, the whiskey offers familiar notes of honey, peanut brittle, and warming spice, with a robust yet drinkable high proof. At a suggested price of $99.99, this limited-release cask strength rye is considered reasonable for a decade-old expression, though its rarity means higher prices are likely on the resale market. The brand intends to continue cask-strength releases, though each batch will be distinct, as with this edition distilled in 2012. The famously frowning figure on the Old Overholt label is Abraham Overholt, the brand’s founder. Over time, as rye whiskey’s fortunes changed, his image was softened for modern appeal. With the whiskey’s revival, the original stern visage has returned—perhaps as a nod to the enduring dedication required to craft such a spirit.
translated_content: Ketertarikan saya pada wiski rye bermula di pertengahan 1990-an, karena minat saya pada sejarah Amerika dan musik lounge klasik. Saat menjelajahi resep koktail lawas, saya melihat rye sering jadi bahan utama—meski sulit ditemukan di sekitar tempat tinggal saya. Toko minuman keras di lingkungan Manhattan hanya menyediakan dua botol, salah satunya Old Overholt dengan label bergaya kuno. Saya membelinya seharga sekitar $15, walau belum tahu kisah di baliknya. Waktu itu, popularitas wiski rye sudah sangat menurun, sejak era Larangan Minuman Keras (Prohibition) pada 1920. Usai larangan dicabut di 1934, penikmat minuman Amerika beralih ke minuman lebih ringan seperti wiski Kanada dan vodka. Saya tidak tahu waktu itu, Old Overholt yang didirikan tahun 1810 berhasil selamat dari masa Prohibition berkat lisensi 'wiski obat'. Awalnya diproduksi di Pennsylvania—negara bagian dengan sejarah panjang rye—merek ini lalu pindah ke Kentucky di 1980-an setelah diakuisisi Jim Beam. Old Overholt dikenal sebagai rye sederhana dan ekonomis—hanya disimpan tiga tahun dan kadar alkohol 80 proof. Meski begitu, saya langsung suka dengan rasa kacang ringan, manis karamel, dan bumbu halusnya, membuatnya jadi favorit untuk koktail klasik yang sering saya bagikan bersama teman. Akhir-akhir ini, minat pada wiski rye mengalami kebangkitan. Merek seperti WhistlePig, terkenal dengan kekuatan 100 proof-nya, kembali memicu gairah di pasar. Old Overholt, yang dulu mengandalkan bartender dan promosi mulut ke mulut, mulai mendapatkan perhatian baru dari Beam Suntory di bawah arahan spesialis rye-nya, Bradford Lawrence. Produk utamanya kini disimpan empat tahun dan memiliki 86 proof, serta hadir dengan variasi bonded dan edisi terbatas bagi kolektor. Tahun ini menjadi catatan penting: peluncuran Old Overholt Extra Aged Cask Strength Rye—ekspresi cask strength pertama mereka dalam lebih dari 80 tahun. Disimpan sepuluh tahun dan memiliki kadar alkohol 60,5% ABV, kekuatannya sama seperti produk lama dari pertengahan abad lalu. Meski kini tak lagi dibuat di Pennsylvania atau dengan alat suling tiga-ruang yang khas, citarasa madu, kacang, dan rempah tetap terasa, bahkan di kadar alkohol tinggi yang tetap mudah dinikmati. Dengan harga resmi sekitar $99,99, rilis terbatas cask strength ini cukup wajar untuk wiski berusia 10 tahun, walaupun kemungkinan harga di pasar sekunder bisa lebih tinggi. Old Overholt berencana menghadirkan lebih banyak rilis cask strength, meski tiap batch-nya akan berbeda, seperti edisi tahun 2012 ini. Sosok dengan wajah cemberut di label Old Overholt adalah Abraham Overholt, sang pendiri. Dulu, ekspresinya sempat dibuat lebih ramah agar cocok dengan selera zaman. Kini, bersamaan kebangkitan reputasi Old Overholt, wajah aslinya yang tegas kembali—seolah menandakan bahwa membuat wiski hebat memang butuh dedikasi.

article_content: Three waitresses at the Boone County Family Restaurant in Caledonia, Vermont, were left in shock when a mysterious customer tipped them a combined $15,000 after overhearing their worries about affording school fees and bills. The generous woman, who asked for their names before writing three checks for $5,000 each, was moved by their heartfelt conversation. The staff members—Amber Kariolich, 28; Amy Sabani, 25; and Sarah Seckinger, 23—were initially hesitant to accept the unexpected gift. The woman insisted they take the money, telling them, 'God sent me here to help you. Take it; put that in your pocket.' Sarah Seckinger, who has worked at the restaurant for six years and hopes to become a police officer, plans to use the money to return to school. Amy Sabani, a mother working two jobs, said the tip will let her spend more time with her son and aspires to one day offer such generosity herself. Amber Kariolich shared that the money means a lot as they all have dreams of going back to school and paying off bills. Restaurant owner Matt Nebiu said, in his 30 years of running the diner, he has never seen anything like it. The Good Samaritan’s identity remains a secret, though staff say she is not a regular customer.

Wanita dermawan ini meminta nama mereka sebelum menuliskan tiga cek senilai masing-masing $5.000 karena tergerak oleh percakapan mereka. Para staf—Amber Kariolich (28), Amy Sabani (25), dan Sarah Seckinger (23)—awalnya ragu menerima hadiah tak terduga tersebut. Namun, wanita itu bersikeras agar mereka menerimanya sembari berkata, 'Tuhan mengirimku ke sini untuk membantu kalian. Ambil saja, masukkan ke saku kalian.' Sarah Seckinger, yang sudah enam tahun bekerja di restoran dan bercita-cita menjadi polisi, berencana menggunakan uang tersebut untuk kembali kuliah. Amy Sabani, seorang ibu yang bekerja dua pekerjaan, mengatakan tip itu akan membuatnya bisa lebih banyak menghabiskan waktu bersama putranya dan berharap suatu hari bisa membantu orang lain dengan cara serupa. Amber Kariolich menambahkan bahwa uang itu sangat berarti karena mereka semua ingin kembali sekolah dan membayar tagihan. Pemilik restoran, Matt Nebiu, mengatakan selama 30 tahun mengelola restoran, ia belum pernah melihat kejadian seperti ini. Identitas sang dermawan tetap dirahasiakan, meskipun staf mengatakan dia bukan pelanggan tetap.

article_content: A group of wild monkeys rampaged through Toddang Pulu village in eastern Indonesia, entering homes and attacking residents. The incident left a 16-year-old boy in critical condition due to serious bites, while six other people were also injured. According to Ambo Ella, the spokesman for Sidendeng Rappang District in South Sulawesi province, around 10 monkeys were involved in the attack. The animals are believed to have come from a nearby forest protected by a local tribe. The reason for the sudden aggression is unclear, as these monkeys typically avoid humans. Local authorities are investigating the incident, which caused panic among villagers. There are approximately 260 known species of monkeys worldwide, many of which interact with humans in different ways, including as pets, research subjects, agricultural pests, or tourists' attractions—sometimes resulting in human attacks.

Menurut Ambo Ella, juru bicara Kabupaten Sidendeng Rappang di Provinsi Sulawesi Selatan, sekitar 10 ekor monyet terlibat dalam serangan tersebut. Hewan-hewan itu diduga berasal dari hutan yang dilindungi oleh suku lokal di sekitar desa. Alasan perilaku agresif yang tiba-tiba ini masih belum diketahui, karena biasanya monyet-monyet tersebut justru menghindari manusia. Otoritas setempat sedang menyelidiki insiden yang memicu kepanikan di kalangan warga. Terdapat sekitar 260 spesies monyet yang diketahui di seluruh dunia, dan banyak yang berinteraksi dengan manusia dengan cara beragam, baik sebagai peliharaan, subjek penelitian, hama pertanian, ataupun objek wisata—dan kadang berujung pada serangan terhadap manusia.

article_content: Rachael Fried, an American LGBTQ+ advocate and executive director of Jewish Queer Youth, found herself in a surprising situation: experiencing relief upon landing in Dubai, despite being aware that homosexuality is considered a crime there. Fried and her wife had flown from New York to Israel to celebrate Sukkot, with a brief stopover in Dubai where same-sex relationships are punishable by imprisonment. The couple always researches local LGBTQ+ laws for safety, and in Dubai, even minor displays of affection could be risky. After a cautious two-hour layover, they felt safer heading to Israel, which, although complicated, is seen as comparatively more accepting—especially in cities like Tel Aviv. Their trip overlapped with the Simchat Torah holiday, but celebrations turned tragic when Hamas launched a surprise assault from Gaza, breaching Israeli borders, killing over 800 people, injuring many more, and capturing hostages. While in Jerusalem, Fried and her wife took shelter in their hotel as rocket sirens sounded. Fear grew as reports emerged that Ben Gurion Airport might become a target and face imminent closure. Ultimately, Fried and her wife managed to board their original return flight via Dubai alongside others desperate to leave the conflict zone. Upon landing back in Dubai, Fried was struck by the uncomfortable truth that she felt more at ease there, despite harsh anti-LGBTQ+ laws, than she had in Israel during the attacks. Israel subsequently declared war on Hamas and began airstrikes in Gaza, adding to the mounting casualties. Fried’s experience highlights the difficult situations LGBTQ+ travelers can face when navigating between countries with distinct risks—social and physical.
translated_content: Rachael Fried, seorang aktivis LGBTQ+ asal Amerika dan direktur eksekutif Jewish Queer Youth, mengalami kejadian tak terduga: merasa lega saat tiba di Dubai meski tahu homoseksualitas adalah kejahatan di sana. Fried dan istrinya terbang dari New York ke Israel untuk merayakan Sukkot, dengan transit singkat di Dubai, tempat hubungan sesama jenis dapat dipidana penjara. Mereka selalu memeriksa hukum lokal terkait LGBTQ+ demi keamanan, dan di Dubai, bahkan kontak fisik kecil bisa berisiko. Setelah transit dua jam yang penuh kewaspadaan, mereka merasa lebih aman melanjutkan ke Israel yang meski situasinya rumit, dianggap lebih terbuka—terutama di kota seperti Tel Aviv. Perjalanan mereka bertepatan dengan Simchat Torah, tetapi kegembiraan berubah menjadi kecemasan ketika Hamas melakukan serangan mendadak dari Gaza, menembus perbatasan Israel, menewaskan lebih dari 800 orang, melukai banyak lainnya, dan menculik sejumlah sandera. Saat di Yerusalem, Fried dan istrinya berlindung di hotel setelah sirene roket berbunyi. Kekhawatiran bertambah saat beredar kabar Bandara Ben Gurion bisa jadi target dan mungkin segera ditutup. Akhirnya, Fried dan istrinya berhasil naik penerbangan pulang lewat Dubai bersama orang lain yang juga berusaha keluar dari zona konflik. Saat mendarat di Dubai, Fried merasa ironi pahit—lebih nyaman di sana meski hukum anti-LGBTQ+ sangat ketat, daripada di Israel saat serangan berlangsung. Israel kemudian menyatakan perang terhadap Hamas dan mulai membalas dengan serangan udara ke Gaza, memperparah jumlah korban. Kisah Fried menyorot tantangan pelik yang dihadapi pelancong LGBTQ+ saat harus menentukan pilihan di tengah risiko sosial dan fisik yang tidak pasti.

article_content: On Monday, several stocks in Mumbai saw declines exceeding 5%, even as the BSE Sensex dropped by 371.9 points to close at 64,887.55 amid heavy selling in major bluechip companies. On the BSE, stocks like Perfect Octave (down 18.95%), Pasari Spinning (down 14.18%), Anjani Finance (down 13.56%), Colorchips New Media (down 10.00%), and Duroply Industries (down 9.98%) were among the biggest decliners. Within the Nifty index, only 11 stocks traded in the green while 38 were in the red. The Nifty was down by 104.3 points to 19,421.25. Certain companies, including Corp Courier, KD Leisures, Compuage Infocom, Prabhat Tech, and Welcon International, hit fresh 52-week lows, while others like Modern Steels, Shree Ganesh Reme(PP), Everest Kanto, Polson, and Crest Ventures reached new 52-week highs. The Indian Income Tax Department is investigating local units of Apple, Google, and Amazon over potential non-payment of taxes related to their transfer pricing practices. This probe began in 2021 and authorities have requested detailed explanations from the companies. Indians have become the largest investors in Dubai's real estate market, playing a crucial role in shaping the city's property sector. Razorpay, a digital payments platform, plans to relocate its parent company to India via a cross-country merger. This move could result in a tax payment of $250-300 million in the US, where the parent company is currently based.

Departemen Pajak Penghasilan India sedang menyelidiki unit Apple, Google, dan Amazon di India perihal dugaan ketidakpatuhan pembayaran pajak terkait transfer pricing. article_content:
A team of researchers—Kenny Travouillon (Western Australian Museum), Christine Cooper, Jemmy Bouzin, and Simon Lewis (Curtin University), as well as Linette Umbrello (Queensland University of Technology)—recently published a study titled "All-a-glow: Spectral characteristics confirm widespread fluorescence for mammals" in the journal Royal Society Open Science. While it’s well established that certain animals like birds, reptiles, amphibians, fish, scorpions, and other arthropods exhibit fluorescence under ultraviolet (UV) light, the extent of this phenomenon in mammals remained uncertain. The researchers aimed to determine how common fluorescence is among mammals, particularly by examining preserved and frozen specimens from the Western Australian Museum’s collection.

Their findings revealed that fluorescence is far more prevalent in mammals than previously suspected. By analyzing 125 mammalian species, spanning every known order, they confirmed the presence of true fluorescence rather than an artifact from preservation methods. Using fluorescence spectroscopy, they concluded that the glowing observed was due to biological features of the animals, not chemicals such as borax or arsenic used in preservation.

The study found clear fluorescence in the white fur, spines, skin, and nails of various mammals including koalas, Tasmanian devils, short-beaked echidnas, southern hairy-nosed wombats, quendas (bandicoots), greater bilbies, and even cats. Specimens that had been fresh-frozen or chemically treated displayed fluorescence, ruling out preservation as the cause.

Importantly, the researchers noted that white and light-colored fur are fluorescent, whereas dark pigmentation blocks this property. For example, a zebra’s white stripes glowed under UV light, while its dark stripes did not. The study also observed that nocturnal mammals were more likely to be fluorescent than aquatic ones.

The researchers propose that fluorescence may be a common characteristic in mammals, possibly the default for hair unless it is heavily pigmented. While they note there’s no evidence of a functional biological purpose, it’s possible that brighter, fluorescent patches could serve as visual signals, especially in low-light conditions—similar to optical brighteners in clothing and paper.

The published abstract confirms these findings, reporting fluorescence in 125 mammalian species covering all 27 living orders and 79 families. The researchers verified that the observed glow was true fluorescence, not just optical scatter or an artifact of storage. Fluorescence intensity was most pronounced in nocturnal, terrestrial, arboreal, and burrowing species. Whether this phenomenon plays a specific biological role remains undetermined, but it seems to enhance the brightness of unpigmented fur and skin, potentially aiding visual signaling, particularly at night.

The full study is available in Royal Society Open Science, and a summary for the general public is accessible via The Conversation.

Sekelompok peneliti—Kenny Travouillon (Western Australian Museum), Christine Cooper, Jemmy Bouzin, dan Simon Lewis (Curtin University), serta Linette Umbrello (Queensland University of Technology)—baru-baru ini menerbitkan studi berjudul "All-a-glow: Spectral characteristics confirm widespread fluorescence for mammals" di jurnal Royal Society Open Science. Sudah lama diketahui bahwa beberapa hewan, seperti burung, reptil, amfibi, ikan, kalajengking, dan artropoda lainnya, bisa berpendar di bawah cahaya ultraviolet (UV), tapi seberapa sering fenomena ini terjadi pada mamalia masih belum jelas. Para peneliti ingin mengetahui seberapa umum fluoresensi pada mamalia dengan memeriksa spesimen yang diawetkan dan dibekukan dari koleksi Western Australian Museum.

Hasil penelitian mereka menunjukkan bahwa fluoresensi jauh lebih umum pada mamalia dari yang diperkirakan sebelumnya. Dengan menganalisis 125 spesies mamalia dari semua ordo yang ada, mereka memastikan adanya fluoresensi sejati pada mamalia, bukan hanya efek dari metode pengawetan. Melalui teknik spektroskopi fluoresensi, mereka menyimpulkan bahwa cahaya pendar yang terlihat berasal dari ciri biologis hewan itu sendiri, bukan dari bahan kimia pengawet seperti boraks atau arsenik.

Studi ini menemukan fluoresensi yang jelas pada bulu putih, duri, kulit, dan kuku berbagai mamalia termasuk koala, setan tasmania, ekidna moncong pendek, wombat berhidung berbulu selatan, quenda (bandikut), greater bilby, dan bahkan kucing. Spesimen yang dibekukan segar maupun yang diawetkan dengan bahan kimia tetap menunjukkan fluoresensi; ini menyingkirkan kemungkinan pengawetan sebagai penyebab utamanya.

Para peneliti juga mencatat bahwa bulu putih dan warna terang cenderung berfluoresensi, sementara pigmen gelap menghambat efek ini. Contohnya, garis putih zebra akan menyala di bawah cahaya UV, tapi garis gelapnya tidak. Studi ini juga mencatat bahwa mamalia nokturnal lebih sering berfluoresensi dibandingkan spesies akuatik.

Mereka menduga bahwa fluoresensi mungkin merupakan ciri umum pada mamalia, kemungkinan menjadi kondisi bawaan rambut kecuali jika pigmen sangat gelap. Walaupun belum ditemukan bukti jelas tentang fungsi biologisnya, mungkin bagian tubuh yang berpendar bisa membantu sinyal visual, khususnya saat cahaya minim—mirip seperti pemutih optik pada pakaian atau kertas.

Abstrak penelitian ini menegaskan temuan tersebut, melaporkan fluoresensi pada 125 spesies mamalia dari 27 ordo dan 79 famili. Para peneliti memastikan cahaya pendar yang terlihat benar-benar berasal dari fluoresensi, bukan sekadar efek optik atau penyimpanan. Intensitas fluoresensi paling tinggi ditemukan pada mamalia yang aktif di malam hari serta yang hidup di darat, pohon, atau menggali lubang. Masih belum jelas apakah fenomena ini punya peran biologis khusus, namun kemungkinan membantu kecerahan bulu atau kulit yang tidak berpigmen sehingga mendukung sinyal visual, terutama di malam hari.

Studi lengkap tersedia di Royal Society Open Science dan ringkasannya untuk publik ada di The Conversation.

article_content: Mazda's CEO, Masahiro Moro, has highlighted Tesla as the only automaker making substantial headway in the U.S. electric vehicle (EV) market. He observed that other EV producers are struggling to attract buyers, leading to an accumulation of unsold vehicles at dealerships. 'EVs are an essential technology, and we are actively working on them,' Moro told Fortune. 'In the U.S., EVs accounted for about 6% of the market last year and have risen to 8% this year. Of that 8%, around 57% were Teslas. Other manufacturers are not gaining ground, and inventory is piling up.' Despite Tesla repeatedly lowering its prices, the company still commands over half of all U.S. EV sales. Experts suggest it could take about ten years for legacy automakers to bridge the gap with Tesla. Ford and General Motors have both launched EVs to challenge Tesla but have so far fallen short. By contrast, Mazda is advancing cautiously, aiming for 25% of its global sales to be electric by 2030. The company recently ended U.S. sales of its sole electric model, the MX-30, after it sold only 66 units in 2024; it continues to be available overseas. The broader EV industry is encountering obstacles as major auto companies scale back their EV ambitions, citing slow demand, high costs, and limited charging infrastructure. Ford has postponed a $12 billion investment in electric manufacturing, and GM scrapped its goal to produce 500,000 EVs by mid-2024. However, the outlook isn’t entirely bleak: Atlas Public Policy forecasts that over one million EVs will be sold in the U.S. this year for the first time. Moro stressed that consumer preference and improved public infrastructure will be decisive for growing EV adoption. 'Achieving zero emissions will depend on both consumer choices and the development of social infrastructure,' he said. Mazda declined to provide additional comment when reached outside standard business hours.

Dari angka 8% itu, sekitar 57% adalah Tesla. Produsen lain belum mampu mengejar, stok terus bertambah.' Meski Tesla berkali-kali memangkas harga, mereka tetap menguasai lebih dari setengah penjualan EV di AS. Baru-baru ini, Mazda menghentikan penjualan model EV satu-satunya di AS, MX-30, setelah hanya terjual 66 unit pada 2024; model ini tetap dipasarkan di luar negeri. Secara umum, industri EV tengah menghadapi hambatan karena perusahaan otomotif besar mengurangi target dan investasi, dengan alasan permintaan melambat, harga tinggi, dan kurangnya infrastruktur pengisian daya. Ford menunda investasi produksi kendaraan listrik senilai $12 miliar, sementara GM membatalkan target produksi 500.000 EV pada pertengahan 2024. Meski ada tantangan, ada juga perkembangan positif: Atlas Public Policy memperkirakan penjualan EV di AS akan menembus satu juta untuk pertama kalinya tahun ini. article_content: Liverpool is preparing for a tough Champions League draw this Thursday, potentially landing in a group with football heavyweights like Real Madrid, Paris Saint-Germain, and Roma. After missing out on the tournament for five years, Liverpool enters as a pot three team, which increases their chances of a difficult group stage. For Liverpool, the most favorable scenario would see them grouped with teams such as Porto, Basel, and either APOEL or BATE Borisov. The tournament seeding is divided as follows: Pot 1 features Real Madrid, Barcelona, Bayern Munich, Chelsea, Benfica, Atletico Madrid, Arsenal, and Porto. Pot 2 includes Schalke, Borussia Dortmund, Juventus, Paris Saint-Germain, Shakhtar Donetsk, Basel, Zenit St Petersburg, and Manchester City. In pot 3, alongside Liverpool, are Bayer Leverkusen, Olympiakos, CSKA Moscow, Ajax, Sporting Lisbon, Galatasaray, and Athletic Bilbao. Pot 4 completes the draw with Anderlecht, Roma, APOEL, BATE Borisov, Maribor, Monaco, Malmo, and Ludogorets. Liverpool hopes that new signing Mario Balotelli will play a leading role as the club aims to replicate its 2005 Champions League success. There's a real chance Liverpool could face current champions Real Madrid, or be drawn with Barcelona—a scenario that could see former Liverpool striker Luis Suarez return to Anfield. Paris Saint-Germain, led by star forward Zlatan Ibrahimovic, is considered the toughest team in pot two, while Roma, under the leadership of Francesco Totti, are strong contenders from pot four. Following a recent 3-1 defeat by Manchester City, Liverpool recognizes the need to raise their game, but manager Brendan Rodgers remains upbeat, expressing confidence that the team will continue to improve.

article_content: After setbacks from the 2011 natural and nuclear disasters, tourism in Tokyo has made a strong comeback. According to the Japan National Tourism Office, visitor arrivals increased by 21% between January and August 2013 compared to the same period the previous year. This resurgence is partly attributed to Tokyo’s successful bid to host the 2020 Olympics and Prime Minister Shinzo Abe’s efforts to boost the economy. Autumn is considered the best time to visit Tokyo. The city shakes off summer's humidity, vibrant autumn colors brighten parks, hearty seasonal foods abound, and Japan’s renowned fashion comes alive on the streets. Tokyo offers a wide range of experiences—from tranquil, centuries-old gardens to lively robot cabarets. Here are some essential tips for travelers: 1. Don’t tip. Excellent service is standard in Japan due to the culture of hospitality, or omotenashi. Tipping isn’t customary and may even be refused, although some restaurants charge a service fee. 2. Walk right—on the left. In Tokyo, pedestrians generally keep to the left on sidewalks, similar to car traffic. On escalators in Tokyo, stand on the left and walk on the right—though in Osaka, this is the opposite. 3. Drink outside, smoke inside. Smoking is permitted in many indoor venues, such as bars, restaurants, and certain train cars, but is often prohibited on sidewalks. Drinking alcohol outdoors is commonly accepted. 4. One card for all trains and buses. The Suica and Pasmo rechargeable cards allow seamless travel across Tokyo’s various train and bus networks. As of March 2013, a single card is usable on public transportation nationwide. 5. Find quiet spots throughout the city. Even in Tokyo’s bustling environment, peaceful pockets like hidden temples, canals, and residential streets are nearby. 6. Experience Japanese public bathhouses. Sento are affordable, soothing bathhouses that cost ¥450 and are becoming more foreigner-friendly ahead of the Olympics, with multilingual guidance posted. 7. 'Irasshaimase' means 'welcome.' Staff in shops and restaurants greet customers with this phrase. A response isn’t expected—a polite bow suffices. 8. Tokyo’s sushi is exceptional. The famous Tsukiji market’s tuna auction starts just after 5 a.m., with tickets claimed early. Even so, the market area offers some of the freshest sushi available, but it closes by 1 p.m. Note: Tsukiji market is set to relocate at the end of 2013. 9. Free WiFi is uncommon. While more locations offer WiFi, access usually requires a contract or pre-registration. Many visitors find it easiest to rent a pocket WiFi device at the airport. 10. Bacon appears in unexpected dishes. Despite Japan’s tradition of vegetarian cuisine, meat (especially ham or bacon) often turns up in dishes labeled 'vegetarian.' Check ingredients thoroughly if you have dietary restrictions. 11. Clear umbrellas are everywhere during rain. Sold at convenience stores for ¥300–¥500, these umbrellas are common but frequently lost to theft. Losing one is seen as a rite of passage for visitors. CNN's On the Road series occasionally features country-sponsored segments, but maintains full editorial control.
translated_content: Setelah mengalami kemunduran akibat bencana alam dan nuklir pada tahun 2011, pariwisata di Tokyo telah bangkit kembali dengan kuat. Menurut Japan National Tourism Office, jumlah kunjungan wisatawan meningkat 21% antara Januari hingga Agustus 2013 dibandingkan periode yang sama tahun sebelumnya. Kebangkitan ini sebagian dikaitkan dengan keberhasilan Tokyo memenangkan tawaran untuk menjadi tuan rumah Olimpiade 2020 dan upaya Perdana Menteri Shinzo Abe dalam meningkatkan ekonomi. Musim gugur dianggap sebagai waktu terbaik untuk mengunjungi Tokyo. Kota ini terbebas dari kelembapan musim panas, warna-warni musim gugur mempercantik taman-taman, makanan musiman yang lezat tersedia, dan fesyen khas Jepang terlihat di jalanan. Tokyo menawarkan berbagai pengalaman — dari taman kuno yang tenang hingga pertunjukan robot yang meriah. Berikut beberapa tips penting untuk para pelancong: 1. Jangan memberi tip. Layanan prima adalah standar di Jepang berkat budaya keramahan yang disebut omotenashi. Memberi tip bukanlah kebiasaan, bahkan bisa saja ditolak, meskipun beberapa restoran membebankan biaya layanan. 2. Berjalanlah di kanan—di sebelah kiri. Di Tokyo, pejalan kaki umumnya berjalan di sisi kiri trotoar, sama seperti kendaraan. Di eskalator Tokyo, berdiri di kiri dan berjalanlah di kanan—sedangkan di Osaka justru sebaliknya. 3. Minum di luar, merokok di dalam. Merokok diperbolehkan di banyak tempat dalam ruangan seperti bar, restoran, dan gerbong kereta tertentu, namun sering dilarang di trotoar. Minum alkohol di luar ruangan umum diterima. 4. Satu kartu untuk semua kereta dan bus. Kartu isi ulang Suica dan Pasmo memungkinkan perjalanan tanpa hambatan di berbagai jaringan kereta dan bus Tokyo. Sejak Maret 2013, satu kartu dapat digunakan di transportasi umum seluruh Jepang. 5. Temukan tempat tenang di seluruh kota. Meski Tokyo sangat sibuk, selalu ada sudut-sudut damai seperti kuil tersembunyi, kanal, atau jalanan permukiman. 6. Cobalah pemandian umum Jepang. Sento merupakan pemandian umum yang menenangkan dengan biaya ¥450 dan kini semakin ramah wisatawan asing jelang Olimpiade, dengan petunjuk multibahasa. 7. 'Irasshaimase' artinya 'selamat datang.' Staf toko dan restoran akan menyambut dengan kata ini. Tidak perlu membalas—cukup anggukkan kepala dengan sopan. 8. Sushi Tokyo memang luar biasa. Lelang tuna di Pasar Tsukiji dimulai sekitar pukul 5 pagi dan tiketnya cepat habis. Namun begitu, kawasan pasar menawarkan sushi segar terbaik, meski banyak toko tutup pada pukul 1 siang. Catatan: Pasar Tsukiji dijadwalkan pindah pada akhir 2013. 9. WiFi gratis jarang dijumpai. Meski makin banyak lokasi menyediakan WiFi, akses biasanya memerlukan kontrak atau pendaftaran sebelumnya. Banyak wisatawan lebih memilih menyewa pocket WiFi di bandara. 10. Bacon sering ditemukan di berbagai hidangan. Walau Jepang punya tradisi kuliner vegetarian, daging (terutama ham atau bacon) sering muncul pada hidangan berlabel 'vegetarian'. Periksa bahan makanan dengan teliti jika Anda memiliki pantangan. 11. Payung transparan sangat umum saat hujan. Dijual di toko serba ada seharga ¥300–¥500, payung ini sangat sering hilang atau dicuri. Kehilangan payung dianggap sebagai pengalaman yang lumrah bagi pengunjung. Serial On the Road dari CNN kadang menampilkan segmen bersponsor dari negara yang diliput, tetapi tetap menjaga kendali editorial sepenuhnya.

article_content: When weather conditions were too poor for rowing practice on the water, my high school crew team trained in a damp garage overlooking the turbulent Ohio River. Even before sunrise, groggy with sleep, we would line up in formation on our ergometers—commonly known as 'ergs'—to replicate our eight-person, 60-foot boat indoors. Regardless of the workout, the scene was always the same: we created near-gale winds and plenty of noise using the air resistance fans on our old, uncomfortable machines, rowing in sleepy unison. Since those days, indoor rowing machines have evolved dramatically. The $2,995 Peloton Row exemplifies this progression. It features a 23.8-inch touchscreen for streaming thousands of interactive classes (available with a $44 monthly subscription). Classes of various lengths include lively music, charismatic instructors, and detailed onscreen metrics for tracking your progress. Sensors in the seat and handle help monitor your form. If you already enjoy Peloton's platform—which has weathered its own set of public challenges, such as a controversial ad, a treadmill and bike recall, and rounds of layoffs—you’ll likely appreciate this machine. However, if your main aim is a solid indoor rowing experience, Hydrow offers a competing luxury erg. Hydrow also charges $44 monthly for class access, but its rower retails for $2,195. I especially appreciate Hydrow's extensive library of classes taught on the water—a category that Peloton offers as well, but not as extensively. Peloton Row's pricing begins at $2,995, including a wall anchor for vertical storage against a wall. Premium tiers—priced at $3,225 and $3,470—add accessories like a rower mat, an additional workout mat for off-erg classes, dumbbells, and a branded Camelbak water bottle. Accessories can be purchased separately, but be aware that a single mat costs $85. All Peloton Row purchases include white-glove delivery, meaning you won’t need to lift the 156.5-pound machine or assemble it yourself. However, installation of the wall anchor is not included; Peloton strongly recommends hiring a professional for this step, which I found somewhat inconvenient. The Row itself measures 7 feet 10 inches long, 2 feet wide, and 4 feet tall, and Peloton suggests keeping 2 feet of clearance on all sides for safe and easy use. If you plan to store it upright, your space will need to have an 8-foot ceiling. There are wheels to help with repositioning, but it’s important to note that the Row is a large, heavy machine—so you'll want to make sure delivery pathways in your home are accessible.
