article_content: As enterprises increasingly seek to process AI models locally, demand for powerful PCs continues to rise. The surge of interest in artificial intelligence through 2023 led to nearly every tech discussion including an AI component. Enterprises — both large and mid-sized — are urgently evaluating the impact of AI on their future operations. Historically, most have depended on public large language models (LLMs) and major providers like OpenAI, Microsoft, and Google to drive their AI strategies. However, training and operating large models in the cloud has put pressure on IT budgets, sometimes making AI workloads even more expensive than other cloud-based workflows. What sets AI apart in the corporate context is the unique intellectual property embedded in organizational data, which can drive significant productivity gains. Yet, running proprietary AI models in the public cloud can be cost-prohibitive. Many organizations are now assessing the scale of their structured data and considering how to fine-tune data models for specific productivity applications, such as sales, customer support, marketing, and business analytics. Running AI locally or at the edge is emerging as a solution, making advanced client-side hardware more critical. Enter the AI PC. Recognizing this trend, semiconductor giants like Intel, AMD, and Qualcomm have developed high-end processors designed for AI capabilities on personal computers. At Creative Strategies, we investigated whether Apple's new M3 Max processor could deliver edge computing and AI inferencing. In a recent technical analysis led by Ben, our CEO, we tested the 16-inch MacBook Pro equipped with the M3 Max and 48GB RAM for edge-based inferencing with various sizes of Llama 2 models. Key benchmarks included time to first token (TTFT), tokens per second (TPS), total RAM usage, and system power consumption. For example, the Llama 2 7B model required 6.5GB RAM, while the 34B model needed 29.5GB. Testing was performed both on CPU and with GPU (Metal) acceleration. Notably, GPU acceleration significantly improved performance — the 7B model's TTFT dropped from 3.39 to 0.23 seconds and TPS increased from 23 to 53, while reducing system power draw. Similar patterns were seen with larger models. These results illustrate the promise of local AI processing on advanced hardware like Apple's M3 Max, even though Apple markets these Macs primarily for creative and productivity tasks, not AI inferencing. Meanwhile, other chipmakers and PC manufacturers intend to push AI PCs for private, edge data inferencing. Our assessment aimed to position Apple in the competitive landscape of AI edge computing. As top semiconductor vendors and their partners emphasize edge AI in 2024, we anticipate a major wave of enterprise PC upgrades — potentially the most significant in tech history — as organizations equip staff to handle increasingly AI-powered applications.
translated_content: Seiring semakin banyak perusahaan ingin memproses model AI secara lokal, permintaan terhadap PC berkinerja tinggi terus meningkat. Lonjakan minat pada kecerdasan buatan sepanjang 2023 membuat hampir setiap diskusi teknologi kini mengandung unsur AI. Perusahaan besar maupun menengah kini sedang mengevaluasi dampak AI terhadap masa depan operasional mereka. Selama ini, mereka banyak mengandalkan model bahasa besar publik (LLM) serta penyedia utama seperti OpenAI, Microsoft, dan Google untuk strategi AI. Namun, melatih dan mengoperasikan model besar di cloud semakin membebani anggaran TI—bahkan seringkali membuat pekerjaan AI di cloud lebih mahal dari workflow cloud lainnya. Yang membedakan AI di ranah perusahaan adalah kekayaan intelektual unik dari data mereka yang bisa sangat meningkatkan produktivitas. Tetapi menjalankan model AI khusus di cloud publik sering dianggap terlalu mahal. Saat ini, banyak organisasi menilai besar data terstruktur mereka dan mempertimbangkan cara menyesuaikan model data demi aplikasi produktivitas spesifik seperti penjualan, layanan pelanggan, pemasaran, dan analitik bisnis. Menjalankan AI secara lokal atau edge pun menjadi solusi, sehingga perangkat keras canggih semakin vital. Munculnya PC AI. Melihat tren ini, perusahaan semikonduktor seperti Intel, AMD, dan Qualcomm sudah mengembangkan prosesor kelas atas untuk kemampuan AI di komputer pribadi. Di Creative Strategies, kami meneliti apakah M3 Max dari Apple mampu menjalankan komputasi edge dan inferensi AI. Dalam analisis teknis terbaru oleh Ben, CEO kami, kami menguji MacBook Pro 16 inci dengan M3 Max dan RAM 48GB untuk inferensi edge dengan berbagai ukuran model Llama 2. Tolok ukur utama meliputi waktu hingga token pertama (TTFT), jumlah token per detik (TPS), total RAM, dan konsumsi daya sistem. Misalnya, model Llama 2 7B butuh 6,5GB RAM, sedangkan 34B butuh 29,5GB. Pengujian dilakukan di CPU dan juga akselerasi GPU (Metal). Peningkatan signifikan terlihat dengan GPU — TTFT model 7B turun dari 3,39 detik ke 0,23 detik dan TPS meningkat dari 23 ke 53, sambil mengurangi daya sistem. Hal yang sama terjadi pada model yang lebih besar. Hasil ini menunjukkan potensi pemrosesan AI lokal di perangkat seperti Apple M3 Max, meskipun Apple sendiri menonjolkan MacBook ini terutama untuk kebutuhan kreativitas dan produktivitas, bukan untuk inferensi AI. Sementara itu, chipmaker dan produsen PC lain berniat memaksimalkan PC AI untuk inferensi data privat di edge. Penilaian kami bertujuan melihat posisi Apple di medan persaingan AI edge. Saat para vendor chip utama dan mitranya semakin menonjolkan AI edge di 2024, kami memprediksi akan ada gelombang besar pembaruan PC perusahaan—mungkin terbesar di sejarah teknologi—untuk mempersiapkan staf menghadapi aplikasi berbasis AI di masa depan.

article_content: JAIPUR: Rajasthan Chief Minister Ashok Gehlot fiercely accused the BJP of spreading lies and misusing the Enforcement Directorate and Income Tax department for political witch hunts. He insisted that Rajasthan’s people aren’t fooled by BJP’s desperate tactics and will reject the saffron party at the polls. After paying tribute to former Prime Minister Indira Gandhi, Gehlot went further, claiming that the BJP is obsessed with defaming Congress leaders at any cost, weaponizing central agencies. He said BJP’s Rajya Sabha MP Kirodi Lal Meena, contesting from Sawai Madhopur, has fabricated countless complaints to ED and Income Tax just to harass innocent Congress workers. Gehlot stated that agencies have shamelessly behaved like BJP’s slaves for an entire year in Rajasthan, driven completely by hatred for Congress. He assured that the people will give BJP the punishment it deserves in the upcoming elections. Gehlot highlighted Congress’s seven guarantees, arguing that—unlike BJP’s empty promises—they will truly uplift every real Rajasthani family: yearly honorariums for women, affordable LPG, reinstated old pensions, gadgets for college students, disaster insurance, and English medium school education. He openly mocked the BJP, challenging them to discuss real guarantees instead of spreading their usual lies. Voting is November 25 and, according to Gehlot, the corrupt BJP should prepare for the people’s wrath on December 3.

Ia menegaskan rakyat Rajasthan tidak tertipu oleh taktik putus asa BJP dan akan menolak partai saffron itu di pemilu. Setelah memberi penghormatan kepada mantan Perdana Menteri Indira Gandhi, Gehlot melangkah lebih jauh, mengklaim BJP terobsesi untuk mencemarkan nama baik para pemimpin Kongres dengan segala cara, menggunakan lembaga pusat sebagai senjata. Gehlot menyatakan lembaga-lembaga tersebut bertingkah seperti budak BJP secara memalukan selama satu tahun penuh di Rajasthan, didorong oleh kebencian pada Kongres. Ia memastikan rakyat akan memberi BJP hukuman yang pantas pada pemilu mendatang. Gehlot menyoroti tujuh jaminan Kongres dan menegaskan—berbeda dari janji kosong BJP—janji Kongres benar-benar bakal memberdayakan setiap keluarga Rajasthan sejati: honorarium tahunan untuk perempuan, LPG murah, kembalinya pensiun lama, gadget untuk mahasiswa, asuransi bencana, dan pendidikan sekolah berbahasa Inggris.
